[Event] Blessing of Spirits

When obtained, the following effects are granted:
- Life Skill Mastery +500
- Movement Speed +5

* Blessing of Spirits also recovers 10 Energy upon acquisition.

Duration: 5 min

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/b3756235cea39b9157c053a4d2d7e88d76958dc3.gif
▲Dig up every root and collect herbs via Hoe Gathering minigame!

 The minigame only appears if you've activated the Green Artisan feature under My Information (P) → Life Skill → Gathering category.

3. Chance for moles to spawn mole-tiplied by 2!
Number of spawned moles mole-tiplied by 3!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/cdab916eeec72bcbd47139f229564a5b2fd099cd.gif

 You cannot defeat moles on servers where Node or Conquest War is in progress.

notes.title: [Edania] The Five Demonlords
notes.content:
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/03c66fcabcc20250812080415050.jpg
* Click the image to enlarge.

Edania, the new region arriving on August 21 (Thu),
marks the end of Act I in Black Desert and the beginning of an entirely new saga.

Here, we’ve prepared stories of legendary figures—tales that, until now, have only surfaced in
whispers and scattered fragments of lore.

Uncover the secrets of these Demonlords in Edania, each ruling over their own domain within the region.

Meet Enslar, an apostle of the Church of Elion—the largest religious order in the world of Black Desert. 

Encounter Cartian, the first sorceress to grasp the true nature of the Black Spirit.

And unravel the mystery of Rusalka, queen of the Merfolk and Corsair’s maternal ancestor.

Discover the stories of the Demonlords and meet the five powerful rulers of Edania!
[hr][/hr]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/0e27643d98820250730120904828.png
«Demonlord of Azureach»
[color=#44b8ff]Jordine Ducas (Former Grand Chamberlain of Serendia)[/color]
[color=#b3d5f4]"Then I shall answer in kind—with all that I am."[/color]

He once served Serendia, but after a fateful incident, he ran off and joined the Shadow Knights, taking in the soul of Belmorn, the Monarch of Darkness.

Though the Adventurer kept him from falling entirely under Belmorn’s control, a mark was left behind. Hoping to erase it, he journeyed to the Mountain of Eternal Winter in search of Ynix’s Flame. But when he finally found it, the whispers from the flame turned him against the Adventurer, and he vanished without a trace.

[hr][/hr]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/378a1aca71d20250813100301869.png
«Demonlord of Amberwastes»
[color=#ffc6c3]Enslar (The First Valkyrie)[/color]
[color=#ffdbbb]"Justice in your mind, Elion in your heart, and the scales of your convictions... at the tip of the lancia!"[/color]

At the Holy College of Calpheon, a military school founded by the Church of Elion to train Valkyries, Enslar led the elite Valkyries.

But when the Church saw her Valkyries as a threat, they moved to wipe them out, planning to offer Enslar as a sacrifice to Kzarka. In the end, she managed to seal Kzarka away and slipped away.

[hr][/hr]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/7e76a43dd7220250730120936042.png
«Demonlord of Emeraltides»
[color=#9df9ff]Rusalka (The First Mermaid and Mother of All Merfolk)[/color]
[color=#c3ffff]"No.... All such thoughts... are meaningless now."[/color]

Rusalka, the very first Mermaid and mother of all Merfolk refers to Humans as "two-legged beasts" and holds nothing but contempt for them. Rumor has it, she guards a mysterious treasure.

But whether any of this is true is anyone’s guess. Hardly anyone in the world of Black Desert has ever laid eyes on a Mermaid.

[hr][/hr]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/40a961b44c720250730121514191.png
«Demonlord of Ebonshade»
[color=#e8b6ef]Cartian (The First Sorceress)[/color]
[color=#cf2be7]"So come... Test me and witness the glory of this newfound power!"[/color]

Cartian was the very first sorceress who founded Tarif together with Allan Serbin.

Legend has it that during the war between Humans and Cyclops over territory, Cartian drove the Cyclops away with her scythe.

The famed "Book of Cartian," a sorceress’s bible of sorts, is still kept in Tarif. But the sorceress of today cannot handle the power sealed within its pages.

[hr][/hr]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/889166beb7c20250730121532267.png
«Demonlord of Crimsonroot»
[color=#ffc95f]Caphras of Adùir (The Immortal Alchemist and the First Luthraghon)[/color]
[color=#fff5b3]"Only the worthy... have permission to stand before me."[/color]

Caphras is said to have studied Black Stones, trying to harness the Black Spirit’s power to stand against Hadum..

His journals are scattered all over the world of Black Desert, but the clues are so fragmented that no one can piece together his full story.

After he ventured to the Altar of Blood, there’s no sign or record of Caphras ever coming back.

[hr][/hr]
❮ Tip ❯
Check out the [color=#7FDBFF]quest prerequisites[/color] while waiting for Edania.
Have the title, "Gladios Champion"
[code]- This title is earned by completing the “[Atoraxxion] Back to the Society of Equilibrium” quest with a character at Lv. 60 or higher.
- To check if you have the title, go to My Information (P) > Title > World, and search for Gladios Champion.
- If you haven’t earned it yet, open the in-game Quests (O) window, type the quest name into the search bar for more info.[/code]

[hr][/hr]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/KR/Upload/News/c6f61df354c20250814125613960.jpg
"Where your long journey finally ends,
At the end of all ruin… I shall be there—waiting for you."

notes.title: Damage Calculation Formula Overhaul
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/2600c49738ae6d02214107c27b10223ce80c199f.jpg
Damage Calculation Formula Overhaul
 💬 Greetings, Adventurers.

We're here to share an update on the upcoming overhaul of the damage calculation formula, which we first announced at the recent Heidel Ball.

Our original plan was to gradually roll out these changes to the Black Desert Global Lab starting today, on July 11. However, due to the fact that every part of the combat system is deeply interconnected, testing would be less accurate if we applied only a portion of it first. Therefore, we've decided to apply all combat system improvements at once on July 18 (Fri) on the Black Desert Global Lab.  
* For the official servers, we're aiming to have the changes applied as early as July 24 and no later than July 31, depending on the results of our testing.

Since this patch includes a wide range of changes, today we'd like to give you an overview of the main improvements coming next week.

To make the transition as smooth as possible, we'll share detailed information on each change in next week's Black Desert Global Lab patch notes. We're committed to making sure everything is thoroughly prepared for a stable update.

Thank you.

* The following information is a preliminary overview of upcoming updates. It may be modified, expanded, or removed in the actual release.

Improved My Stats UI and Detailed Stats Addition
[code]To make it easier and more intuitive to view your character's applied stats, the Equipment (I) - My Stats UI will be improved, and a new Detailed Stats menu will be added.

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/1c09948a46420250724114430978.png[/code]

No Mouse Movement During Skill Use
[code]Using "mouse movement" or "Click-To-Move" during a skill had a significant impact on PvP balance, depending on whether it was available and the user's proficiency. Because mouse movement forcibly altered a character's action mid-skill, it also caused desync between the visible position and the actual position.

To provide a better PvP environment, you will no longer be able to use mouse movement while using a skill.

* When you're not using a skill (e.g., gathering or basic movement), mouse movement will function as before.[/code]
 
Increase in Extra AP Against Monsters Based on Displayed AP
[code]When your displayed AP reaches 310 or higher, you'll gain [color=#ff857a]Extra AP Against Monsters +8 for each additional AP[/color].[/code]
 
Monster Zone Balance Update
[code]Following the changes to damage rules—such as the boost to Extra AP Against Monsters based on your displayed AP—the overall balance of monster zones will be readjusted.
This monster zone balance update will include the following changes:

1. Monster AP & DP and AP Limit Adjustments
- Each monster zone will now have more specific AP and DP requirements.
- If your AP goes over the max limit for a zone, only 5% of the extra AP will count.
- For named monsters in certain zones, 50% of your extra AP will be applied instead.

* Examples of updated recommended AP and max AP limits

2. Loot Adjustment
- As stat requirements become more detailed, loot drops will be updated so your rewards match the zone’s difficulty.

3. Agris Fever Efficiency
- Before, only certain zones were optimized for Agris Fever.
- Now, Agris Fever will be equally effective in any monster zone matching your stats.

4. Tunkuta Zone Change
- Since fewer adventurers visit Tunkuta these days, it will be converted into a solo monster zone. This way, anyone after major loot like Flame of Despair can get in more easily.[/code]
 
Damage Reduction Stacking Rules Update
[code]1. Damage reduction buffs granted by skills will no longer stack with each other.
- Example: If you're under the damage reduction buff from Protected Area, the damage reduction from Elements: Generate will not apply simultaneously.

2. The Bodily Rejection effect will be changed.
While the Bodily Rejection debuff is active, you will be unable to receive any damage reduction buffs that last 6 seconds or more and offer 50% or higher effects.

* For Corsair Awakening's Labao's Help, the current rule still applies: you won't be able to get the same effect twice because of a separate debuff. (You can still get Protected Area's effect, but not Labao's Help if you have Bodily Rejection.)
[hr][/hr]
FYI: How Buffs Work in Black Desert
- If you get the same type of buff, the one with the higher effect takes priority. If the effects are equal, the one with the longer duration applies.
- Using a buff with the same effect as one you already have will refresh the duration.
- Applying a higher-value buff replaces the existing one; applying a lower-value buff has no effect.[/code]
 
Skill Add-on Effect Changes
[code]The following effects will be removed from Skill Add-ons:

- Extra AP Against Monsters
- Increased Extra Damage to Humans
- Decreased Extra Damage to Humans

* The Extra AP Against Monsters formerly granted by Skill Add-ons will be removed. Consequently, monster zones will be rebalanced, and updates—such as increase in Extra AP Against Monsters when displayed AP exceeds certain thresholds—will be implemented.
* Extra Damage to Humans will now only work on monsters, and in PvP, the buff will be switched to "Extra AP Against Adventurers." So, the Extra Damage to Humans effects will also be removed from Skill Add-ons. (This change ensures Skill Add-ons work the same in both PvE and PvP.)[/code]
 
Accuracy & Evasion
[code]As announced at the Heidel Ball, all skill Accuracy Rates and any Accuracy Rate increases from using skills (or on hits) will be removed. Skills that summon creatures will also lose their skill Accuracy Rate.

The previous Accuracy Rate +25% in each class's skills will be converted to Accuracy +100 and added to Infinite Mastery.

However, any Accuracy Rate increases from passive skills will be converted—every Accuracy Rate +1% becomes Accuracy +4. (This means classes with passive Accuracy increases will have better Accuracy overall.)

Effects that reduce Accuracy Rate, increase Evasion Rate, or decrease Evasion Rate will also be converted—each +1% becomes Accuracy or Evasion +4.
Accuracy Rate increases that affect allies will be switched to Accuracy, with their values adjusted accordingly.[/code]
 
Class Damage Ratios
[code]The class-specific damage modifiers (damage ratios) for PvP have been greatly streamlined. Instead of individual values for each attacker and defender, classes are now grouped into three categories based on their traits.

[Damage Ratio Group Relationships]
Vanguard - deal 5% more damage to Pulverizers.
Skirmisher - deal 5% more damage to Vanguards.
Pulverizer - deal 5% more damage to Skirmishers.

[Unified Damage Ratios for All Classes]
All classes will use a unified damage ratio of 89.29%. To keep PvP balance, each class's PvP damage will be adjusted as needed.
Example: Dark Knight's current average ratio is 91.79%, so after this change, all her PvP skills will deal 2.5% more damage.

[Updated PvP Damage Reduction Wording]
The phrase related to PvP Damage Reduction Rate in skill descriptions will be changed.
Example: Damage -68% in PvP only → 32% damage applies in PvP only[/code]
 
Summon Adjustments
[code]Summons will benefit from Special Attack Damage increases, raising their overall damage.
To keep things balanced, the damage of skills where summons attack directly will be adjusted so they don't become too powerful.[/code]
 
AP Increase, DP Reduction, and Special Attack Damage Effects Changes
[code]Right now in Black Desert, even if two classes wear the same gear, their actual AP can vary due to class traits. Until now, we've balanced these differences via skill damage multipliers.

Going forward, however, monster DP will be fine-tuned, letting you get the best results in monster zones that match your AP. This means your AP will matter more than ever.

To accommodate this, we're narrowing the AP gap between classes and adjusting skill multipliers that were previously tuned to those differences.

DP Reduction and Special Attack Damage Increase effects will also have a bigger impact, so we're revising them as well. To stop %-based reduction skills from becoming too powerful in top-tier monster zones, all skills that lower DP by a percentage (such as Shai's Misty Haze) will instead use a fixed reduction value.

* Party-based zones such as Olun’s Valley will also see balance updates, and Shai's PvP performance will be improved with damage increases and related adjustments.

Special Attack Damage Increase effects will be reduced or removed, then replaced with new effects tailored to each class’ playstyle.[/code]
 
Class Balance Updates
[code]Even after the damage formula overhaul, we will continue to monitor each class and make further balance adjustments if needed.[/code]

Grab Changes Following Resistance Removal
[code][Grab Skill Effects]
All grab skills will have a unique visual effect, making it clear when a grab is being used.
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/KR/Upload/News/dc150fef83020250711174158374.gif
This is crucial for PvP, so the effect will be optimized to display under any graphics setting, even with low opacity, ensuring it's always visible.

* Note: The effect won't appear if the opponent's character is outside your screen.

[Grab Skill Changes]
- Melee and ranged grabs will only let your character turn toward the camera right after you start the grab. After that, you can't rotate your character.
- For dash grabs, your character will only turn toward the camera at the start of the dash. Once your character is about to grab, rotation stops.
- Grab skills will no longer be affected by Attack or Casting Speed buffs or debuffs, whether you succeed or fail.
- Melee grabs will have a 0.3-second startup time before activating.
- Dash grabs will have a 0.3–0.4-second startup time (including the dash), depending on distance.
- Ranged grabs will take 0.4 to 0.7 seconds to activate, based on distance.
- After a failed grab, you'll be able to combo into another skill 0.4 seconds later.[/code]

[code]To ensure stable implementation of the damage calculation formula update, all character skills will be reset during the July 24 (Thu) maintenance. 

* All your learned skills, saved skill presets, and skill add-ons will be reset. We appreciate your understanding, Adventurers.[/code]

notes.title: [New Outfit] First Crush
notes.content:
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/KR/Upload/News/ab278e2a70520250526114242959.jpg
The First Crush Outfit has arrived.
Listen to your heart and try on the brand-new First Crush outfit! 
[expand type=details expanded=false]💬 The newest outfit, “First Crush,” was designed to capture the lighthearted, fluttering feelings of a new beginning.

We wanted to create a casual look that anyone could wear comfortably, centered around a warm, soft cardigan as the main piece. A charming new crossbody bag — a first of its kind — adds a playful touch, and to complete the look, we've also prepared matching glasses and earrings designed to fit the outfit's overall cozy aesthetic.

Following the release of the "Lookin' Frosh" outfit, we received a great deal of encouragement and feedback from many of you. Among the voices, there were also concerns that these more modern-style outfits might feel out of place in the distinct, immersive world of Black Desert. 

It’s a sentiment we understand — while the outfits may be beautiful, we recognize the worry that if this style becomes too common, it might dilute the unique atmosphere of the game world. And with First Crush also leaning into modern-day casual fashion, we know some of you may feel a bit more apprehensive. 

We’re not here to say one opinion is right or wrong. 
Instead, we aim to continue offering a diverse range of outfits — including both modern-inspired designs and those that remain true to Black Desert’s lore and setting. In the end, we believe what truly matters is that moment when you look at a piece and think,  “That’s beautiful. I want to wear that.” 

We hope First Crush can be one of those options — a delightful choice you can enjoy when the mood strikes. 

Please note that since this outfit is designed around a cardigan base, it does not support the Hide Cape feature. When capes are turned off, the cardigan remains visible, while only the bag is removed.

Thank you for understanding.[/expand]

notes.title: Events at a Glance feat. New Dream Horse Voltarion
notes.content:
Transcending Space and Time, the Lightning-Fast Voltarion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/5e0305aacc54b6565d5f9ae69299320c00a89fdd.jpg
[code][color=#ffdc00]Voltarion's Tale

Voltarion, imbued with the power of lightning, is a descendant of Narc, the ancient spirit of rain, and a godchild blessed by Krogdalo.

With the speed of light, Voltarion could surge across the land, running faster than anyone else.

As none could match its speed, Voltarion developed a fiercely independent nature, allowing only those it deemed worthy to stand by its side.

Voltarion cherished solitary exploration of this world, driven by an insatiable desire to tread uncharted paths. One day, it resolved to embark on a new endeavor: to leap through space using its light-speed prowess.

Though it succeeded in traversing the realms, Voltarion found itself trapped between spaces, slowly fading from the world's memory as it lingered in the darkness.

After a long trek through the deep shadows, Voltarion emerged, yet the world had changed beyond recognition, leaving it to continue its quest.

People have discovered traces of lightning across the land, heralding the return of the long-forgotten Voltarion to the world.[/color][/code]
[color=#ffdc00]New Dream Horse Voltarion[/color]

Upon breaking free from the confines of space and time, the world of Black Desert felt the electrifying presence of the lightning steed, Voltarion.            
With unparalleled speed, Voltarion leaps across space, striking with lightning fury and descending to the ground in an instant. A swift and powerful steed, it brings devastating debuffs while surging into battle.
Collect Traces of Thunderbolt to accept the quest from the Black Spirit and claim Voltarion as your own.

notes.title: Awakened to the Five Elements – What is His “Do?”
notes.content:
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/976c427b98620241008073753040.jpg
Awakened to the Five Elements – What is His “Do?”
[hr][/hr]Weaving a New “Do” with the Elements
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/6bb3215585c20241007113924008.jpg
▲ The Five Elements, which form the very essence of the universe
[code][color=#FF0000]Fire (火)[/color] - [color=#9ACD32]Wood (木)[/color] - [color=#00FFFF]Water (水)[/color] - [color=#E6E6FA]Metal (金)[/color] - [color=#F4A460]Earth (土)[/color][/code]
The Awakened Do wielder, enlightened to the Five Elements, wields the
Enlightened Blade as his weapon, which aids and amplifies the generation of
elemental energy, allowing him to freely command them on the battlefield.
[hr][/hr]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/537986746e920241007114946615.gif
▲ Using Fire: Spread leaves the energy of Fire on the field.

[table][tr][td]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/97487cb444920241007115842651.png [/td]
[td][color=#d9f4ff]Fire: Spread[/color]
Send forth flames conjured with your elemental orbs. Wherever they fall, the energy of Fire spreads.[/td][/tr][/table]
[hr][/hr]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/20601d4761c20241007115030025.gif
▲ Wood: Bend on lingering energy of Fire activates the Generative effect.

[table][tr][td]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/b43ff76877c20241007115854846.png[/td]
[td][color=#d9f4ff]Wood: Bend[/color]
Unleash the elemental power of Wood with your Do arts.
Weave vines into your enlightened blade to form a staff that you wield to further enhance your control over this element.[/td][/tr][/table]
[hr][/hr]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/aa8eb4dd7e820241007115050512.gif
[code][color=#ff5f54]Tip![/color]
When you wield the elemental powers of the Five Elements, a mark representing each element's color will appear on the field.
Moreover, as you combine these elemental skills, you can activate the mighty generative effects, marked by the elements themselves.
Harness the synergy between the Five Elements and their generative powers to transform into a true Awakening Do wielder![/code]
[hr][/hr]
[color=#d9f4ff]Past Forsaken[/color], He Awakens to the Elements
[previewyoutube=sRQSqi_wtRw;full][/previewyoutube]
▲ Dosa Awakening Trailer

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/af3cf38c7a720241007115326616.png
▲ Scene from Dosa’s Awakening story

[code]After glimpsing the shadow of his long beloved, the wandering Dosa delves back into forgotten memories.

A mysterious woman soon approaches as her magic will make him confront the past...

His wandering comes to a close, now enlightened to nature’s might
play the Awakened Dosa right now![/code]
[hr][/hr]
The Five Elements in His [color=#d9f4ff]Attire[/color]
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/7920092b8ce20241007115334736.jpg
▲ Dosa’s new outfit – The Enlightened Tiger

The primary golden hue of the Enlightened Tiger Outfit symbolizes Earth energy, which embodies people, balance, and kingship.
The Iron Tiger summoned with the power of the Five Elements, is also intricately woven into the robe’s design as well.

[hr][/hr]
[color=#d9f4ff]Checklist[/color] for Playing as Awakened Dosa!
[table equalcells=1][tr][td]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/e4f2e96579c20241007115347288.jpg
▲ Want to level a new Awakened Dosa with Season++ benefits? Click here![/td]
[td]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/bb7b86f136820241007115515299.jpg
▲ Check out the CM Note Bingo Step by Step for new/returning adventurers! [/td]
[/tr][/table]

TV Animation Berserk X Black Desert Collaboration Begins!

What is "Berserk"?
[code]Starting its serialization in 1989 in "Monthly Animal House" (Hakusensha) and later moving to "Young Animal", "Berserk" is a dark fantasy that has left a powerful shock and touched the hearts and lives of readers worldwide with its profound story, captivating characters, overwhelming and meticulous artwork, and unparalleled creativity. It has been translated into a total of 20 languages. Set in a world where swords, magic, and monsters exist, it depicts the fierce life of the protagonist, Guts. The series has recorded a total of 60 million copies (paper + digital) sold worldwide. Starting with a TV animation from 1997 to 1998, it was adapted into a trilogy of theatrical animations from 2012 to 2013, and a second TV animation from 2016 to 2017. The theatrical animation depicting the "Golden Age" was re-aired as a TV series in 2022 as a Memorial Edition, marking 10 years since its release. [/code]

notes.title: [New Class] Dosa - A Closeup
notes.content:
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/921bfac09ce20240625114755727.jpg
Appearing from the Clouds, Only to Vanish with the Fog
[color=#64c1f9]Dosa[/color] of Sangdo School

On a winter's night, with a high full moon, snow blankets the ground, a silent sigh.
In the ruins of Sangdo School, where echoes die, only two remain, in stillness they lie.

Master Hee shattered the stillness, her voice reaching the figure perched upon the worn rooftop.
"Reminiscing about the past again?"
 
The figure responded,
"The life I led before meeting you is long forsaken, master.
Worry not for your disciple’s sake. The night is cold. Head on inside."
 
Hee, in a graceful bound, joined him on the roof.
"The entire land is blanketed in snow, shimmering under the moonlight...
And you intended to witness this beautiful world... alone?"
she said, settling beside him.
.
.
.
.
On a summer night, with a half-moon's light, cicadas sing, piercing the quiet night.
In the ruins of Sangdo School, a solitary sight, only one remains, in the silent twilight.

Breaking the quiet, he steeled his gaze upon his sword, Hwando, while uttering a vow.
 
"Those who speak lightly dare claim you are no longer of this world, master.
But I shall scour the ends of the earth to find you."
.
.
.
.
On a winter night, with an old moon's gleam, the ruins of Sangdo School, a desolate dream.
No one remains, not even a beam, only silence, where memories teem.
[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=m755ABKXKZI;full][/previewyoutube]
"Behind the clouds, the moonlight smiles, how forlorn."
 
In the 21st year of King Yeongjong’s reign (Elionian Year 254), born as the second son of the noble house of Seonwoo, one of the seven prestigious families, he enjoyed a childhood of abundance and privilege.

in the 28th year of Yeongjong (261 EY), at the tender age of eight, the king's death plunged the realm into chaos, ensnaring his family in the ensuing purge. He alone survived, clinging to life amidst the ruins of his once-great house.

For years, he wandered aimlessly, stealing food to stave off hunger. In the 9th year of King Hyojo’s reign (267 EY), at the age of fourteen, fate led him to Seoul, where he encountered Gang Hee, a Do master of the esteemed Sangdo School.

Taken into the school as her disciple, he initially dismissed her, refusing to accord her the respect of a true master due to being of similar age.

However, upon learning that she too had suffered the annihilation of her family due to treachery, his heart softened.

Moved by her determination to revive the Sangdo School and her genuine care for him, he grew to follow her with unwavering loyalty.

notes.title: Heidel Ball Recap 🏰
notes.content:
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/aa35712213a20240621124902276.jpg
Heidel Ball 2024 was held on June 22 in Beynac, France, which was the inspiration for Heidel. In this year’s Heidel Ball, we introduced Land of the Morning Light - Seoul, the new class Dosa, and various other update news! ٩(˘◊˘)۶

Here’s a recap of the ball to go over the highlights! Shall we begin?

[color=#64c1f9]⦿ 2024 Future Updates[/color]

Land of the Morning Light - Seoul
Land of the Morning Light - Seoul will soon be available to you to explore. What adventures await us in Seoul?

Take a look at the trailer released during Heidel Ball 2024.
[previewyoutube=6ThJGEQTGGI;full][/previewyoutube]
Land of the Morning Light – Seoul GM Note
[hr][/hr]
New Class, Dosa
Black Desert’s 28th class, Dosa, will be updated on July 3.

Wielder of a massive Hwando and smoking pipe called Gombangdae! Check out Dosa in the official trailer!
[previewyoutube=m755ABKXKZI;full][/previewyoutube]
Appearing from the clouds, only to vanish with the fog – Dosa of Sangdo School. If you want to know more about Dosa, check out the GM note below.

28th Class, Dosa GM Note
* You can try out Dosa on the Global Lab on June 28. Details will be announced at a later date.
[hr][/hr]
Palace Management
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/669c753a97820240622163423534.jpg
Once you have completed all your adventures in the Land of the Morning Light - Seoul, several production nodes will be made available at the Gyeongbok Palace node, where unique materials can be obtained. 

What sets the Gyeongbok Palace production node apart from others is that it will have individual node levels. Increasing the level of a node will have many benefits, such as the greater chance of obtaining rare materials, or a change in the items that are produced. 

There will be various methods to raise the level of a node. This includes completing specific quests or retrieving items at the request of certain NPCs.

One advantage of Palace Management is that it will offer automated Processing & Trade that adventurers usually do manually. From material production to the trading of items, if you have the proper process in place, adventurers will only need to sell the finished goods to vendors. 
[hr][/hr]
Primordial Weapons - Sovereign
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/ec084148ca520240622143929990.png
The new, higher-grade weapon Sovereign will be released. 

Inspired by Dark Bonghwang from the Land of the Morning Light - Seoul chapter, Sovereign will initially be available first for both main and awakening weapons. 

There will be three main methods to craft Sovereign weapons. 

First Method: Combine PEN (V) Blackstar weapon with Primordial Flame obtainable from the Black Shrine!
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/f689a0a844020240622143935756.jpg

Second Method: Combine TWO PEN (V) Blackstar weapons
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/a84b49aaad920240622143942962.png

Third Method: Combine PEN (V) Blackstar Weapon + Caphras Lv. 20 Boss Weapon + Gem of Twilight!
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/4cdc85d41d220240622143950225.png

Sovereign weapons will have a total of 10 enhancement levels, which are as follows: 

[table equalcells=1][tr]
[td]PRI (I)[/td]
[td]DUO (II)[/td][/tr][tr]
[td]TRI (III)[/td]
[td]TET (IV)[/td][/tr][tr]
[td]PEN (V)[/td]
[td]HEX (VI)[/td][/tr][tr]
[td]SEP (VII)[/td]
[td]OCT (VIII)[/td][/tr][tr]
[td]NOV (IX)[/td]
[td]DEC (X)[/td][/tr][/table]
Similar to other enhancement levels, the difficulty level will increase when approaching the final stages of enhancement, however it is designed to be a balanced system overall. Upon failure, the Ancient Anvil will also be applied to ensure guaranteed enhancement.

Also, Sovereign weapons will allow adventurers to directly select their weapons’ desired effects. 

Up to 5 additional effects can be applied to the weapon, which lets adventurers tailor the effects of their weapon and set them to their needs.  

* J's Hammer of Loyalty cannot be used on the Sovereign weapons.
[hr][/hr]
Get a PEN (V) Blackstar Weapon
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/079d2854a2020240621155215677.gif
With the addition of Primordial weapons, Sovereign, we will be giving out one PEN (V) Blackstar Weapon to support faster growth for adventurers.  

Details on how to obtain a PEN (V) Blackstar Weapon will be provided in a separate notice on June 26, 2024 (Wed). 
[hr][/hr]
Summer Event
This summer, Adventurers can look forward to a chaotic event featuring the Earfolks and Shellfolks from the Sea Palace and Papus and Otters at Terrmian Beach.

Earfolks and Shellfolks, visiting Terrmian, will compete in a race against Papus and Otters, and engage in a series of events, including a showdown at the Sand Castle Crasher to see who comes out on top.
[hr][/hr]
Summer Outfit - Badakka
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/b2e267f4a4420240621131827135.jpg
A new summer outfit called Badakka will be released. 

The summer outfits for this year share the same overall look, but you can choose from a variety of different types.

Female characters can combine shirts and bikinis. And these are not underwear so you can wear them wherever you want.

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/48c99c8dd0320240621131846164.jpg

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/c45602623dd20240621131908268.jpg
* More items, such as various hats, sunglasses, and dances to go with the outfit will be added to the Pearl Shop.
[hr][/hr]
Jordine Saga
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/16cdd29ce6d20240621132121358.jpg
Jordine Saga will be updated on June 26 for global regions and July 10 for console. Please look forward to it!

[color=#64c1f9]⦿ Black Desert’s Future and Beyond[/color]

Dehkia’s Lantern Tier 2
Tier 2 will be added to existing Dehkia Lantern monster zones. Tier 2 is targeted to veteran adventurers, requiring a minimum gear score of 750.

To ensure you don’t spend too much time in monster zones, Tier 2 will have related weekly quests.
[hr][/hr]
Dehkia’s Lantern Tier 1 Monster Zones
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/0ac972a5eff20240621132154069.gif
The following monster zones will be updated to support Dehkia's Lantern:

[table equalcells=1][tr]
[td]Cadry Ruins[/td]
[td]Gyfin Rhasia Temple[/td][/tr][tr]
[td]Crescent Shrine[/td]
[td]Mirumok Ruins[/td][/tr][/table]
[hr][/hr]
Introducing the "Asadal" Accessories
The Asadal accessories will be added, obtainable from the current Black Shrine and existing monster zones. Asadal accessories, on par with the Tungrad accessories, have unique skills that can be activated when equipped, much like Taebaek's Belt.

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/5a62eec97a120240621132211467.png
[hr][/hr]
Guild Trait System
Guilds can now choose their preferred "Trait."

Guild traits are divided into three categories: PvP, PvE, and Life Skill, allowing guilds to align with their chosen path. 

Selecting a trait lets your guild accumulate related fame, unlocking benefits and honor elements based on your fame. Guild tiers will also be distinguished depending on the accumulated Fame of a guild, which can then be utilized as MMR in Node/Conquest Wars.

(Note that selecting a trait that is not PvP will not prevent your participation in Node/Conquest Wars.)

Guilds that achieve the highest tier will receive honorable rewards which notably includes the guild mount the Black Dragon.
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/7e4890fc76820240622163445113.gif
▲ The "Black Dragon" will be the ultimate honor reward for top-tier PvP guilds.
[hr][/hr]
Hardcore Server Season 1
A Hardcore server, where you cannot play for a while when you die, will be added.

You start at level 60 on the Hardcore server, and you can only equip distributed items, which start you off at 230 AP and 280 DP. You can enhance these up to 260 / 300 without much difficulty.

Also, you cannot see each other’s Family names, can’t form parties, and chatting is unavailable,PvP is always activated, so you can attack anyone you wish. If you die, you are considered to have been heavily wounded and sent to jail and can only escape after you’ve accumulated enough rest points.

The Hardcore server will be seasonal with an exclusive ranking system, where you can earn special character effects and exclusive titles with different colors.
[hr][/hr]

Console - PS5 Version Update
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/072b916439720240621132314645.gif
The update for the next generation of devices for console adventurers is finally here. Overall, the effects, texture quality, LOD levels have all been improved, which enhances the quality of long-distance views.

Loading speed has also been improved, allowing the map to load further distances, which is expected to greatly reduce the inconveniences experienced when moving quickly. The most noticeable improvement will be in frame rate, allowing you to enjoy Black Desert much more smoothly than before.

The development of the PS5 version of Black Desert is currently progressing smoothly, and we expect to inform adventurers about the application timing along with the final test in December.
[hr][/hr]
Mountain of Dawn Break
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/4fbbc4be8c520240621132339097.jpg
In the still undiscovered southern region of the Mountain of Eternal Winter, a sequel known as Mountain of Dawn Break is being prepared. 
Content that challenges your limits is planned, such as a 100-floor dungeon, along with stories following Caphras.
[hr][/hr]
Demon Land
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/41d2456433420240621132353852.jpg
The region that will be revealed after the Mountain of Dawn Break is Demon Land. Unlike general regions, the Demon Land is being developed to appear as one massive castle.

Here, you can explore every corner of the colossal fortress and embark on adventures that challenge you with new combat styles.
[hr][/hr]
The Start of a New Adventure - Black Desert’s Past
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/285517d516a20240621132434836.jpg
 ▲ The greenery of Valencia from thousands of years ago

Once you have completed your adventure to the Demon Land, all areas of the Black Desert world will have been revealed. From then on, you will embark on a new adventure into a completely different world. Through the Magnus, you will be transported to the Black Desert world as it was thousands of years in the past.

Here, you will explore new lands that cannot be found in the current Black Desert world, like the ancient grasslands of Valencia and a massive underwater city like Atlantis. You will delve deep into the historical Black Desert world, with the presence of the Black Spirit, and the wisdom of the Ancients, leading to an adventure unfolding into a grand story.
[hr][/hr]
[color=#64c1f9]⦿ 2024 Heidel Ball Gifts[/color]

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/775edaf987320240621132449269.jpg

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/KR/Upload/News/c21025d04bc20240621170840160.jpg
▲ Check out the gifts prepared with thanks from the Heidel Ball.

[color=#64c1f9]⦿ See Heidel Ball 2024 Events and Coupons[/color]

notes.title: [Dear Adventurer] Together for 10 Years and Beyond!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/91eb2a1c8be4c1d65e56e9c926a3bc90013288e3.jpg
06:00, December 17, 2014.

Our adventure began in the small town of Olvia with just 4 classes.
And our story continues!

We’ve prepared a [color=#83e2d4]Special 10 Years of Black Desert[/color] page.

Relive the heart-pounding moments you've experienced in Black Desert and admire the dedicated works of fellow adventurers. Explore the incredible 10-year journey we've embarked on together.

📖 10 Years of Black Desert
[hr][/hr]

Dear Adventurer,
Together for 10 Years and Beyond!

[color=#eed39e]A special tribute to the endless stories written by our Adventurers![/color]

[previewyoutube=Y5h0gNQMgUU;full][/previewyoutube]

In celebration of 10 years of Black Desert, we've made a tribute song and music video, 「Dear Adventurer」, with a collage of various pieces created by our Adventurers.
 
Today, we want to share this with you, as you continue to write your own adventure stories.
* 「Dear Adventurer」 video is also featured on our 10 Years of Black Desert page.

10 Years of Black Desert, 「Dear Adventurer」

Verse)
Together, there's no need to pretend
Anywhere's within our scope.
The adventure we've dreamed starts to unfold,
Destined together, you and I.

Pre Chorus)
We soar the sky, through winds we cleave
Towards the dreams that we believe.
With all our might, our hands we reach.

Chorus)
The song of adventure flows,
Melting our hearts as it goes.
When the door to dreams swings wide,
In this moment, side by side,
Our tales that will never cease,
Countless stories untold,
You and I (you and I), let our tales unfold.

Bridge)
Let's journey to the world's end,
Together, there's no need to pretend,
Anywhere's within our scope.
The adventure we've dreamed starts to unfold,
Our hearts about to burst, set me in that place,
Release me there.

Chorus2)
The song of adventure flows,
Melting our hearts as it goes.
When the door to dreams swings wide,
In this moment, side by side,
Our tales that will never cease,
Countless stories untold,
You and I.

Ending Chorus)
Wherever our footsteps land,
Our world unfolds, hand in hand.
Across the vast journey's span,
Countless songs await our band.
Our endless, lengthy quest,
Today we'll give our best,
We'll run through it yet again.

notes.title: [NA/EU only] [3000 Days] Happy 3,000 Day Milestone!
notes.content:
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/c299f844eff20240513192451108.jpgHappy 3,000 Day Milestone!

Our journey in Black Desert began in March 3, 2016 and has already reached its 3,000th day as of May 19, 2024!
The time has flown by because of our amazing NA/EU Adventurers.
In appreciation, we have special in-game events as well as special community events to celebrate this milestone!

Check out the details below! 🥳

Summary of all the 3,000 Day events!

[hr][/hr]
【1】

notes.title: [NEWS] April 1st, Believe It or Not!
notes.content:
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/5db6ee30d3d20240330042300870.png
[NEWS] April 1st, Believe It or Not!
【1】
A blue anomaly has been detected.
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/e61f160898720240329192729139.png
According to a book from Calpheon College, long-term borrowed by [GM],  
it is written that "if a blue Garmoth begins to appear in the Black Desert, hammers will turn blue and send ripples through the economy."
[hr][/hr]
【2】
The cutting-edge boss manual summoner [GM]
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/4165c70cea620240329192802332.png
"Just grabbing a bite, be right back." 

The [GM] is rumored to press the Field Boss summon button whenever an adventurer steps away for a moment. 
Given the occasional late spawn of the World Boss, whispers are growing louder in the back alleys about the existence of this high-tech manual summoner.
[hr][/hr]
【3】
All NPCs go to sleep during maintenance
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/4165c70cea620240329192802332.png
"Lights out. Have a good night."

It is reported that NPCs across all regions return to their homes and lie down in their beds during the 4-hour maintenance on every Wednesday.
Upon hearing this, the Furniture Dealer Guild announced plans to actively promote the bedding industry "to ensure the comfortable rest of NPCs.”
[hr][/hr]
【4】
Major shake-up on the horizon for the Enhancement system
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/a10197b35b920240329192918461.png
It is estimated that the total stack accumulated by adventurers worldwide so far is +16,618,572.

A [GM], who somehow found out a secret, confidently stated, 
"Soon, a wind of great change will sweep through the Enhancement system.”
[hr][/hr]
【5】
A mysterious sound echoes from the Coastal Cave...
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/a50d8395a0920240329192945109.png
"I went to the Coastal Cave to mine copper, and I heard some strange noises there."

This phenomenon was reported by several residents of Velia who visited the cave. 
So far, it is officially reported that 41 people have experienced it.
[hr][/hr]
COMING SOON on April 3rd (Wed)

notes.title: Scholar, the World Changing, Hammer Swinging Alchemist!
notes.content:
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/3030f3f2baf20231215110654069.jpg
Scholar, the World Changing, Hammer Swinging Alchemist!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aKeIy3_3Z9c

Brandishing Hammers crafted in earth's elements, a master of Alchemy!
Main/sub-weapon: [color=#e8c500]Hammers/Gravity Cores[/color]
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/4277e51444120231215100211668.png
Prevailing over the Black Death with her exceptional knowledge in Alchemy and Physics,
Scholar has the ability to manipulate gravity at her will.

Utilizing her two hammer types, Scholar attacks with targeted swiftness and immense power.
Her command of gravity allows Scholar to trick enemies with unpredictable movements and overwhelming counterforce.
[hr][/hr]A Maven of Alchemy transcending matter through [color=#c19e00]"Gravity Core fusion"[/color]
Awakening weapon: [color=#e8c500]Sledgehammer[/color]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/0212643a88df739abffbb62b72af00cb4dc3962a.png
Befitting her past in Alchemy, through particle acceleration and formulas.
Ascended Scholar accomplishes any alchemist's true desire: transmuting gold.

Her attacks freely manipulate speed, mass, and metals of the earth for a momentous counterforce like no other.

Abandoning the laws and rules of matter, Scholar writes her own formula to bring her enemies to their knees.
[hr][/hr][color=#e8c500]Main Skills[/color]
[previewyoutube=Fc9asUBJIDw;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/edec5de4fd920231215105020985.gif

Instantly adjust your gravitational pull towards the direction of your installed gravity core.
Take a brief moment to retrieve the core, then reorient the generated kinetic energy and unleash it as a kinetic blast.[/td]
[/tr][/table]

[hr][/hr]
The Last Prince of Mediah
[color=#cd9a27]Bareeds III[/color]

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/46daf3c1b7320231120092700129.png
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/b0aec58955620231120092834763.png

[color=#bc0c0c]The Three Days of Darkness[/color] – a calamity brought upon Mediah by Illezra.  

For three days, the people in Mediah trembled in fear, consumed by madness, as pitch-black darkness covered the lands, blotting out both sun and moon. 

And, alone in the dark, [color=#bc0c0c]Mediah Castle was lit ablaze.[/color]

Weak and incompetent, the monarchy easily crumbled, while Bareeds III barely escaped with his life, becoming the sole survivor of his royal bloodline. 
 
From Neruda Shen, the self-appointed premier who claimed to be speaking on the young prince’s behalf, 
to the Mediahn masses, whose favor he had long lost due to the oppressive rule of the Aksulp royal family, Bareeds III realized he was not safe and soon embarked to seek asylum in Valencia. 

However, during that very journey, an incident occurs...

Mediah Merchants Union Chairman
[color=#cd9a27]Neruda Shen [/color]

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/94eccd76c7520231120093704800.png
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/8070dee880320231120093721342.png

[color=#bc0c0c]The war between Calpheon and Valencia in the past[/color], and the continent of Mediah in between. 

In place of the rather passive Mediahn monarchy at the time, the Mediah Merchants Union foresaw the flow of events and took matters in their own hands. 

They gathered blacksmiths to support the Calpheon Alliance with resources, and successfully secured trading rights of the Black Crystals, whose value Calpheon didn’t fully realize.

They used part of the profits amassed from Calpheon to provide aid to Valencia, thereby also securing trade rights with the latter nation, who also would provide protection in return.

By single-handedly monopolizing the supply of goods in the region, they accumulated vast wealth, and with it, [color=#bc0c0c]the Mediah Merchants Union built Altinova.[/color]

Later, Neruda Shen would be voted in as chairman of the union with overwhelming support. 
The Mediah Merchants Union soon became renamed as the Shen Merchant Guild.

With all of Mediah completely under his thumb, and now premier, Neruda Shen’s gaze lays upon the untouched lands of Ulukita...

Captain of the Shroud Knights
[color=#cd9a27]Sarma Anin[/color]

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/548f47fe95120231120094036275.png
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/6d2624bbbfc20231120094059851.png

The Shroud Knights, [color=#bc0c0c]an order of knights who answer solely to the Mediahn royal family. [/color]

Yet during the Three Days of Darkness, the order failed to protect the royal family. 
The Shroud Knights were left with nothing and brought dishonor to their name. 

Their purpose lost, their body and soul in disarray, the remnants scattered throughout Mediah. 

Sarma Anin rose from the lowly ranks of a foot soldier to Captain of the Shroud Knights, solely due to her exceptional combat prowess.

[color=#bc0c0c]Having risked her life to rescue the Mediahn prince before,[/color] she continues to serve as loyal retainer to Bareeds III even to this day. 

But now, she requests an investigation into the incident which occurs during the prince’s exile...

Prophet of Altinova
[color=#cd9a27]Sirare[/color]

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/47598e5c53420231120094820554.png
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/ec7807e9e6a20231120094907679.png

[color=#bc0c0c]One of the sons of the famed prophet family of Mediah, Sirare.[/color]

"The dark shadow is returning with the witch of darkness.." 

His prophecies had never missed their mark, so when he foretold the coming of a threat equal in scale to the Three Days of Darkness to befall upon Mediah, all of Altinova was shaken to its core.

[color=#bc0c0c]Having stood by the side of Bareeds III as his childhood friend[/color], Sirare played a crucial role in aiding Bareeds III's exile, alongside Sarma Anin.  

Now, Sirare has a new prophecy to unfold to the Adventurer... 

[color=#cd9a27]Reunited at last[/color] 
The divide widens between [color=#cd9a27]Bareeds III and Neruda Shen[/color]
Long-buried secrets of Mediah uncovered 

A land where new history shall be written... 
[color=#cd9a27]Ulukita awaits you[/color], Adventurer.

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/419043e2fa020231120095752633.png

[color=#cd9a27]Darkseekers' Retreat[/color] is the newest addition to Ulukita; this monster zone contains various item drops that will help Adventurers, such as yourself, grow even stronger.
 
There are two mechanics to look out for, the first being the [color=#cd9a27]Eternal Darkseeker[/color]. This event has a chance to spawn after killing the different monsters within the Darkseeker’s Retreat. Large amounts of [color=#cd9a27]Followers[/color] will then start to spawn and attack you after killing the [color=#cd9a27]Eternal Darkseeker[/color]. Do not panic too much, as these monsters have reduced HP compared to their counterparts.
 
For the next event, after defeating the different [color=#cd9a27]Darkseekers[/color], you will have a chance to spawn the [color=#cd9a27]Blazing Embers[/color]. After destroying it, the [color=#cd9a27]Sealed Artifact[/color] will activate. For approximately five minutes, the activated Artifact will disorientate your enemies at certain intervals. However, [color=#cd9a27]Followers[/color] will not be affected by the Sealed Relic. Defeating a [color=#cd9a27]Blazing Ember[/color] will drop you a guaranteed [color=#cd9a27]Embers of Resonance![/color]

notes.title: [New Outfit] Wonderland
notes.content:
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/7fc9f10e1a320231016163641405.png
Where a savory aroma teases the nose
Wonderland

Where does the timepiece-clad Choppy hop
so merrily beneath the crimson full moon's glow?

Chase after the Choppy, down into the well,
falling down... down... into an endless abyss below...

Upon awakening, the Choppy is nowhere to be seen,
but towering trees and speckled toadstools surround.

A savory aroma teases the nose, follow the scent
to a most delightful tea-party, set before a cozy abode.
[color=#db3dff]A gentleman in a striking suit of violet hue...[/color]
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/2c3fe63590920231016163708935.png
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/7873ee9120320231016163727095.png
[color=#3dd0ff]A maiden in a gown of sky-blue hue...[/color]
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/0355cc0ae3d20231016163939536.png
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/3711d52764520231016164042133.png
And...what's this...

[color=#ff3dc6]a feline friend?[/color]
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/2f9d0e85a4b20231016164139741.png
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/57d3b03ba8420231016164725764.png


"Look yonder! Another wanderer from the woods draws near!
...here to nibble on mushrooms, I fear. Stop them!"

From afar, the mushroom spirits hasten,
for the tea-drinking trio now welcome in Polly's Forest,
had first devoured the mushrooms under Weenie's watchful eye.

Having savored their leisurely afternoon, as is their wont,
the three gradually awaken the mushrooms of Polly's Forest,
to assist Weenie, the culinary master of mushroom fare.

For a spoonful of Weenie's renowned mushroom soup
is all it takes to embark on a truly wondrous escapade!

In a world where dragons reigned supreme,
Under the shadow, black and extreme,

The world that shook in helpless fear, 
Has long since drawn its final tear.


Many a knight, in battles so grand,
Laid down their lives to defend the land,
Their bloodline lives, in heroes so brave,
Echoing tales of battles they gave.


To the remaining dragons, a nightmare they seem,
Almost as if, of two dragons they dream.


[color=#5566bd]Golden dragon, Labreska's fame,[/color]
No dragon dared, to its power lay claim,
Even challenged the power of gods, they say,
Moves with grace, in armor and blade, come what may.
Its presence reminds of a time so fine,
When Labreska hunted its own kind, in line.


[color=#5566bd]Black dragon, Markthanan, known to all[/color]
Slaughtered humans, made Drieghan fall,
If such knights of strength and zeal were near,
The battles with Sherekhan and Markthanan would easily clear.


As the moon hides behind the cloud's haze
Darkness blankets both land and skyways,
A brilliant strike breaks the night's trance,

In a blink, the great dragon falls, at the knight's stance.

In a forest where dragon's roar ceased to be,
Only the stars shine, in silent decree.

notes.title: [New Outfit] Selaine
notes.content:
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/f070283088620230811091115933.jpg
The messengers of Okiara
Selaine

Ranger, Corsair, Mystic, Lahn

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/031084b412020230811093652317.jpg

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/609ca581e7b20230811092808838.jpg

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/77e14f3dde720230811093337422.jpg

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/f070283088620230811091115933.jpg


Babbling brook,
a moonlit crystal alligator is asleep,
the musical spirit Moyamo is floating in the air,
on the calm waters of the Okiara River the Selaines come to visit as they do every night.

The Selaines are
[color=#7797bf]the messengers of Okiara,
the most gentle and humble ancient spirit who promised to embrace all.[/color]

Their cautious footsteps draw the water spirits
who are still tossing and turning in their sleep.
From the shores of Lake Flondor, the banks of the Okiara River
and the calm waves of Grándiha...
the water spirits flock to the streams that run through the lands of Kamasylvia.

They whisper softly to the Selaines.

And the Selaines, with their ever-loving eyes,
listen to the spirits’ tales.
Sometimes the Selaines and their mysterious friends.
dance together on the windy waves.

[color=#7797bf]This is how the Selaines follow the will of Okiara.[/color]
Not only for the sleepless spirits,
but also, for the wanderers who got lost in the stream,
with the burden of their heart, in a bleak loneliness.

Although the flowing stream can bring them to anywhere in the world,
the Selaines choose to go deeper here.
So they can embrace all the unspeakable stories and the pain...

The arid hearts are soothed by the comfort of the Selaines,
and filled with excitement to face the world again.

As time goes by,
the comfort of the Selaines might pass into oblivion in their memorie, but they don’t mind.
Because the water spirits, who kept their eyes on them, will flow eternally and remember the Selaines.

Once upon a time, in an undersea kingdom, there was a dragon king who was very sick. In his search for a remedy for his illness, he found a remarkable physician who told him that consuming the liver of a hare would surely bring back his failing health.

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/b5624ffd2e120230519081634921.jpg

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/b8975444f5320230519081639248.jpg

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/9fbf7a0915d20230519081645378.jpg

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/4d4ca3496f620230519081648912.jpg

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/dece2db7f0420230519081652164.jpg
"I’ve left my liver behind on dry land!"

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/be1deaf347520230519081655068.jpg
The king and turtle foolishly agreed to bring the rabbit back up to the land once again.

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/b6bd1896f9220230519081658612.jpg
Seizing the opportunity, the rabbit escaped into the distant forest, never to be seen again!

notes.title: Everything You Need to Know as a New Adventurer, A to Z!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/a10f636aa865630fa4b2feab580d8b6bc105205e.jpg
Hello and welcome to all Adventurers who are stepping into Black Desert for the very first time! ✿(′ᵕ′*)

You may run into some questions throughout your adventure,
so we’ve prepared a guide that covers everything from A to Z for you!

Have more questions beyond the ones below?
[hr][/hr]【1】
Check out the Adventurer's Board (F2)

You can open the Adventurer’s Board via the F2 shortcut or by
right-clicking the ‘Edan's Adventures’ item which is a quest completion reward from
the Black Spirit (,) - Main Quest (Q) - ‘[Adventure Manual] Edan's Adventures.’

【2】
Discuss questions and answers through the Lunar Halo Inn chat group!

You can enter the Lunar Halo Inn chat group through Menu (ESC) > Community > Chat Group. 
Learn more about chat group settings through the [Chat Group] guide!  (´∇｀*) 

❖ Season Servers

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. What is the difference between the 3 starting zones?[/color]
[expand type=details]
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/0dbc495109f20230613173346421.jpg
Once you’ve created your character, you will see three starting points: the Ancient Stone Chamber, Mountain of Eternal Winter, and the Land of the Morning Light.
Choose one of the three questlines to start off your first adventure and questline.

Whatever your first choice is, you will be able to experience the other storylines later on as well!

* If you are an Adventurer playing Black Desert for the first time, it is recommended that you start at the Ancient Stone Chamber to experience the full storyline, and for faster progression.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. How do I exchange my Naru gear for Tuvala gear?[/color]
[expand type=details]
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/b1d38bc37e320211124085214124.png
Enhance your Naru main weapon, sub-weapon, helmet, armor, gloves, and shoes to PEN (V) grade, 
then convert them to PRI (I) grade Tuvala gear through the “Enhancement window” or the Weapon Exchange button on the top lefthand part of your Inventory window.

More about Naru Gear[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. What should I do in a Season Server?[/color]
[expand type=details]
Once you’ve created a Season character, follow the main questline and the Season Pass to help progress your character.

Complete the Awakening/Succession questlines once you reach Lv. 56 to experience a new level of combat.

More about Season Server & Characters[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. Does my character get deleted after the Season ends?[/color]
[expand type=details]
No, it will not. At the end of each Season, all Season characters become normal characters, and you will be able to equip different, normal gear.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. Can I delete my Season character and create a new one? Can I claim the Season Pass rewards again?[/color]
[expand type=details]
You can either delete your season character and create an entirely new one, or use “Fughar’s Timepiece” to copy your current season character’s season privileges, Combat EXP and Skill EXP to an entirely new season character.
You can learn more about Fughar’s Timepiece in the [Season Character Transferal (Fughar's Timepiece)] page.

Season pass rewards can only be claimed by one character of your family per season, and you will not be able to reclaim them with an entirely new season character after having claimed them before on a deleted season character.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. What is a 'simplified questline’?[/color]
[expand type=details]
Adventurers who have already completed the main questline all the way up to Mediah on a previous character can opt to skip the main questline via this system. It is heavily focused on leveling your season character but also grants rewards similar to those from completing the main questline up to Mediah.

If you proceed with the simplified questline, you will not be able to do the Balenos, Serendia, Calpheon, and Mediah main questlines. Each time you reach new levels, you will be able to receive rewards. Complete the last quest ‘[Special Growth] Fughar's Memorandum - Chapter 11’ for the equivalent of completing the Mediah main questline; afterwards, you will be able to start the Valencia main questline. [/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I used Fughar’s Timepiece but I haven't graduated.[/color]
[expand type=details]
If you wish to change your season character’s class, utilize the Fughar’s Timepiece item to convert an entirely new character into your season character, which will add your previous season character’s Combat and Skill EXP onto the new character.

However, once you’ve used a Fughar’s Timepiece on a Season character to change to a normal character, you will not be able to re-enter Season servers using that character.
Using Fughar’s Timepiece does not mean you’ve automatically graduated from the Season server. 

More details about Season server graduation are provided in a later notice![/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I obtained some gear, but it says I’m unable to equip it. What other gear can I equip apart from Naru and Tuvala gear?[/color]
[expand type=details]
Season characters can only equip season gear labeled as “Tuvala” gear. 
In addition, you can also equip gear marked by the Black Spirit icon (https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/8d42ca14a5520230707072937105.jpg) as well.

Kzarka Main Weapons, Dandelion Awakening Weapons, Giath's Helmet, and other Boss gear can only be equipped by normal characters. Once you graduate from Season servers, you will be able to equip such gear.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. How do I quickly earn more skill points?[/color]
[expand type=details]
Skill points are obtained by monster hunting.

From the ESC menu → Adventure → Monster Zone Info, you can learn more details about different monster zones.  Zones marked with the #Skill EXP hashtag offer more skill points.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I’m stuck at Level 49 and can’t hit Level 50.[/color]
[expand type=details]
Complete the “[To Level 50!] Go Beyond Your Own Limits” quest via the Black Spirit!
Once you’ve completed the quest and obtained more EXP, you can reach Level 50.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. Where should I be grinding mobs?[/color]
[expand type=details]
From the ESC menu → Adventure → Monster Zone Info, you can learn more information about each monster zone’s suggested AP (Attack Power), DP (Defense Power), as well as loot items you can obtain, and more. Check out which monster zones fit best based on your character’s progress and enjoy the hunt![/expand]

❖ General FAQ

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I’m new to Black Desert, and I’m not sure what to do...[/color]
[expand type=details]
If it’s your first time in Black Desert, you’ve likely created a Season Character.

From the server selection screen, enter a Season server and follow the objectives from the Season Pass to grow your character.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. How do Black Desert servers work?[/color]
[expand type=details]
Black Desert’s servers work in a One World System, allowing you to meet different Adventurers no matter which server you select.
 
Apart from certain servers which require certain conditions, you can enter all servers and switch freely between servers, meaning that you do not have to choose just one server and stick to it after creating your character. 
You can find out more about server information, certain server entry conditions, and more via the ESC menu → Change Server → View Server Details.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. Everyone’s telling me I have to do the Magnus, but what is it? How do I start it?[/color]
[expand type=details]
In Abyss One: The Magnus, you, as the Adventurer, work with “Wuju”, the administrator of the Magnus, to investigate and resolve mysterious abyssal anomalies.

Once you’ve resolved all the anomalies (main quest), you gain the means to conveniently fast-travel around the world of Black Desert and to use the storage feature for all territories from any region.

Furthermore, once you’ve completed the Magnus, you can select a PEN (V) grade boss gear as a completion reward, which is especially helpful for new Adventurers!

You can find more details in the [Abyss One: The Magnus] guide.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I know the difference between parties and platoons, but how do I join one?[/color]
[expand type=details]
Party: Up to 5 Adventurers can group up in the Party feature.
Platoon: Up to 20 Adventurers can group up in the Platoon feature.
* Use the ESC Menu → Community (F9) or, search the “Find Party/Platoon” feature in the ESC menu to join one.

Advantages to being in a Party/Platoon:  
1. When proceeding with a weekly subjugation quest in the Season server, you can party up with another Adventurer to have their defeated monster numbers also count towards your weekly quest, so take advantage of this by working together! 

2. Party members are displayed on the World Map screen (hotkey: M) and on the minimap at the top right corner of your screen.

What’s the difference between the Party & Platoon system?
1. In a Party, you obtain the shared EXP gained by another Adventurer in the group.
In a Platoon, however, you cannot obtain the shared EXP of another Adventurer.
 
2. From [Season] Rift’s Echo, you can obtain various season-exclusive items.

Form a Party with different Adventurers and tackle Rift’s Echoes to obtain more rewards. In a Platoon, however, you cannot attempt Rift’s Echoes!

Learn more about Party & Platoon[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. What is the Item Collection Gauge UI / How do I use it?[/color]
[expand type=details]
When using Item Collection Increase Scrolls obtained from Season Passes or Challenges (Y), the Item Collection Gauge UI appears.

When the Gauge UI is activated, the increased item collection effect is applied, which increases the rates for various accessories, season-exclusive items (Time-filled Black Stone, Refined Magical Black Stone, Tuvala Ore, etc.) and more depending on the increase rate applied.

Effects based on Activated Level:   

Level 1 Activated: Item Drop Rate 100%, Item Drop Amount  50% 
Level 2 Activated: Item Drop Rate 100%, Item Drop Amount 100% 
* When Level 2 is activated, 2 seconds of charged time will be deducted for every 1 second of real time.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I went to the desert, but I don’t see my location on the map. How do I know which way to go?[/color]
[expand type=details]
Adventurers should have a Sealed Compass (120min) from progressing in the Season Pass as well as from arriving in the Valencia Desert.
 
In the desert, your current location is not marked in the world map and the minimap, so you must proceed with caution. If you are not sure where you are, you can use the Sealed Compass to check your location in the world map (M). 
 
You can also purchase 3 Explorer’s Compasses from the Central Market and open your Inventory (I) and arrange in a [-] position to combine them (+). Combining the parts results in an Ancient Explorer's Compass (which provides the same effects as a Sealed Compass).

https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/82963d2f9fd20230707072918058.png
Sealed Compass (120 min)
- Upon use, your location will be visible in the Desert and Great Ocean areas on the world map and minimap for 120 minutes.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. My character has hypothermia/heatstroke from the desert.[/color]
[expand type=details]
In the desert, you are susceptible to illnesses based on night/day. When your character is affected by the illness debuff, your health continuously decreases, and may even result in death once health reaches 0.
 
But fear not! You can use items to cure hypothermia/heatstroke.  

Use Purified Water for heatstroke, and Star Anise Tea for hypothermia. 
You can purchase Purified Water and Star Anise Tea from the Central Market.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. What is Contribution/Energy?[/color]
[expand type=details]
Contribution: You can use contribution mainly to invest in nodes and to purchase houses. You can also rent a variety of items such as Hunting Matchlocks, Flutes, and other special items. 
You can generally obtain Contribution EXP by completing quests. 

You can refer to the [Contribution Guide] for more information.

Energy: Energy is mostly used to become friends with NPCs, to acquire knowledge entries, and for certain life skill activities such as gathering, fishing, tanning, etc. 
You can increase your maximum energy limit by obtaining knowledge. 

Please refer to the [Energy Guide] for more information![/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I’m unable to use the items that are in the greyed-out slots in my Inventory. [/color]
[expand type=details]
You can use these items by moving the items to slots that are open within your inventory.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. Do World Bosses appear on all servers? Can I defeat them wherever? Are there specific conditions?[/color]
[expand type=details]
There are a total of 9 World Bosses in the Black Desert world. World bosses spawn in all servers except for Olvia and Arsha servers.

World Bosses appear at specific locations, meaning anyone can join to take them down.
However, we recommend that you have enough DP to stand your ground against general attacks, and enough AP to be eligible to receive loot for defeating the bosses.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I can’t obtain NPC knowledge.[/color]
[expand type=details]
If your NPC amity is negative, you will not be able to obtain knowledge from the NPC.
Amity can become negative when you move behind an NPC to steal from them, so be careful!

If your amity is in the negatives, try greeting NPCs in order to raise it back up![/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. There are too many chat notifications. Is there a way to change the settings so I can choose what I want to see?[/color]
[expand type=details]
You can hover your mouse over the chat window and click on the settings (gear icon) on the top left to select which chats you wish to see.[/expand]

❖ Enhancement FAQ

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. How do I increase enhancement chance? Why do I need stacks, and how do I stack them?[/color]
[expand type=details]
A higher stack means a higher chance to succeed in enhancement.
Enhancement chance increases when you fail enhancement, or when you use Advice of Valks and Valks’ Cry items.  

For more information, please refer to the [Enhancement Guide].[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I have some Beginner Black Stones left over. Where can I use them? Can I sell them?[/color]
[expand type=details]
Beginner Black Stones (Weapon, Armor) are materials only used to enhance Naru gear.
If you’ve upgraded all of your Naru equipment to PEN (V), you can sell the Beginner Black Stones to a vendor NPC.

If you’re looking for more Beginner Black Stones, you can use Heating from the Processing window (L) to obtain more of them![/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I was enhancing/hunting monsters when my equipment durability dropped to 0! Where do I repair/restore gear durability? And where can I find what materials are needed to repair gear?[/color]
[expand type=details]
If you’ve been grinding away at a monster zone, you’ll reach a point where you must repair your equipment’s durability.   

To find the nearest Repair NPC, click the magnifying glass on the minimap (top right) and click the “Repair” icon to set navigation to the nearest one automatically! 

The maximum durability of your gear decreases when you fail enhancement attempts. 
When this happens, you can take it to a Blacksmith NPC and use another of the same equipment OR Memory Fragments to restore maximum durability. 

If you wish to recover the maximum durability of a Season item, we recommend that you use Tuvala Ore to do so![/expand]

❖ Mount FAQ

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. How do I get a horse?[/color]
[expand type=details]
You can obtain a horse from a Stable Keeper NPC through the horse market or tame a wild horse in the world of Black Desert.

[color=#ff5f54]*Attention Adventurer![/color] We currently have an Event, where you can get a Dream Horse just for logging in. You can find all the information about this event [here]!
 
If you do not own a horse, try renting a "Traveler's Horse” from the Stable Keeper! 
The Traveler's Horse has useful skills that you can use while traveling.

However, please note that if 5 minutes pass after dismounting from the Traveler's Horse , it will automatically disappear.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. My horse died. What do I do?[/color]
[expand type=details]
If your horse has died, you can move to a nearby Stable Keeper NPC to recover it. 
As long as the mount does not have any trade items in its inventory, it will be moved to the stable of the territory you are in, and you can get right back to using it.

If your mount was holding trade items before dying, it will be stored in the stable of the territory where it died.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I left my horse in Velia and came to a different village. Do I have to walk back to Velia to get it?[/color]
[expand type=details]
Move to a nearby Stable Keeper and try using the “Remote Collection” feature! 

This will move the horse to the stable of the territory that you are located in. However, you will have to recover its health before being able to use it again.[/expand]

❖ Quest FAQ 

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. How much of the main questline do I have to complete?[/color]
[expand type=details]
While the main questline is not required, you obtain contribution as well as many items for your adventure. 
Completing the Abyss One: The Magnus questline holds many benefits, so we recommend that you complete at least the Calpheon main questline which will allow you to proceed with the Magnus questline![/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I’m unable to accept an NPC quest.[/color]
[expand type=details]
From the Quests (O) screen, click the quest filters at the bottom to “All” and try again to accept a quest from the NPC.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. When do daily/weekly quests reset?[/color]
[expand type=details]
Daily quests reset daily at 00:00 UTC, and weekly quests reset every Thursday at 00:00 UTC.[/expand]

❖ Coupon FAQ 

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. How do I redeem a coupon?[/color]
[expand type=details]
You can redeem coupons in-game through the ESC menu → Adventurer Support → Redeem Coupon Code.[/expand]

[color=#b3d5f4]Q. I redeemed a coupon but don’t see it in my mail (B). Where is it? [/color]
[expand type=details]
Log into the Black Desert official website, and check Account → [Web Storage].[/expand]

notes.title: [New Outfit] A Flower that Bridges the Sky and Earth, 'Maiden of Wisteria'
notes.content:
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/7abdedc941720230421101332035.png
"A Flower that Bridges the Sky and Earth"
Maiden of Wisteria
- New outfit for Lahn, Woosa, Maegu, Tamer
[hr][/hr]
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/7c10e99b3e220230421101350819.png
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/6ce8f18eb5020230421101406748.png
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/3b40e0bbb0720230421101421564.png
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/c65a28670e820230421101440428.png
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/a1c622cb31f20230421101454696.png
Once upon a time, the offspring of a celestial maiden descended from the heavens.

Blessed with beautiful and mysterious powers,
they lived their lives traveling between the sky and the earth.
They soared the skies, listening to the wind’s whispers, cloud’s dreams,
and they shared their joys with the beasts and spirits of the mountains.
Where the flowers bloomed, their smiles shined upon,
And where it rained, their songs resonated.

One day they came upon a village infested with demons and begrudged souls...
They saw the ground frozen over, people suffering from cold and hunger,
and a giant tree that died many years ago.

The descendants of the benevolent maiden called upon a shining rain of flowers over the village.
The rain cleansed the lands of bitterness, and brought warm winds in its wake.
Birds sang as fresh shrubs and blooming flowers washed the village with color.
It was like an eternal spring had come over the lands.

With a grateful heart, the people of the village asked them to stay.
After planting a young wisteria next to the dead tree,
the maiden’s offspring told the wisteria:

“You are our most special gift to this village.
Protect this place while we are gone,
and always deliver to the people hope like that of today.”

As soon as the wisteria heard these words, it grew along the dead tree
and bloomed a wreath of light pink flowers.
Such beautiful flowers could not be found anywhere else.

Ever since, the villagers have treasured this tree
and have passed this story on for generations upon generations.

[color=#ffc6c3]"A flower that bridges the sky and earth. Wherever it comes to linger, spring follows."[/color]

May they have bloomed across this world just as these flowers have.
[hr][/hr]
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/15e1b1bb91820230421100238794.png
https://s1.pearlcdn.com/NAEU/Upload/News/111a89f9e3e20230421100256485.png

Williar, a family with an extensive legacy of unrivaled leaders

Members of the Williar family pledge allegiance to their country before they’re old enough to wield a sword, and it is tradition to undergo rigorous military education and training.

Their fierce movements and excellent command overwhelm many a battlefield.

Never do they show emotion, nor do they revel in the thrill of battle,
Only a cold, merciless stance that devours enemies like a furious flame.

One day,
another general of the family was appointed commander-in-chief of the entire border.

A flame that never withers
With a glorious cape swirling around her, she leaves a solemn air in her wake as others look on in awe.

[color=#FF4136]'The world will know no peace as long as there exist different beliefs.
I shall color the world scarlet, and it shall not fade away.'[/color]

She cares not what others think.
