notes.title: Black Desert Online Account Transfer Registration
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/d0f3dec0e370d3cc61e7c001809419f7697883c7.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,

The Kakao Games Black Desert Online service ends on February 24, 2021, after that Black Desert Online in the European and North American regions will be serviced by Pearl Abyss. At that time, all rights and duties related to the continuation of the service and use of personal data will be transferred to Pearl Abyss. To retain access to your account and its progression, you have to transfer it to a new platform via this page.

You will still be able to access Black Desert Online via the Kakao Games launcher even after your account transfer request is complete, until February 24th 2021.

Kakao Games and Pearl Abyss are committed to making this transition as seamless as possible.

Data transfer will be protected by the standard data protection clauses agreed between Kakao Games Europe and Pearl Abyss. GDPR Article 46. 2.(c)

[Black Desert Online Account Transfer Registration Schedule]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/91d26f0a5e0d55117cb6ad80a7e437308852c25b.png

[How to Make an Account Transfer Registration]

Step 1. Login to your accounts

Login to your Kakao Games Black Desert Online account and Pearl Abyss Black Desert Online Account.
If you do not have a Pearl Abyss Black Desert Online account, please create one at the Pearl Abyss Black Desert Online website.
Multiple Kakao Games Black Desert Online accounts cannot be transferred to a single Pearl Abyss Black Desert Online account. You will need a destination account for each current account that you wish to transfer.

Step 2. Agree to the Account Transfer Agreement

Read and agree to the Account Transfer Agreement.
If you do not agree to the terms, data transfer will not be available.

Step 3. Check your account

Ensure the current information of the account you wish to transfer is correct. Is it not? Make sure to connect to the correct Kakao Games account in Step 1.

Step 4. Verification

Verify your Account Transfer Registration by entering the code sent to the email address you registered your Kakao Games account with.

Step 5. Account Transfer Registration complete

You can continue to play the game normally until the February 24 maintenance. All progress you make between your Account Transfer Registration and the termination of service will be transferred.
Prior to the February 24th maintenance, you can cancel your Account Transfer Registration by contacting Kakao Games. After the February 24th maintenance, you can cancel it by contacting Pearl Abyss.

*What if I don’t submit an Account Transfer Registration before February 24?

You can register for an account transfer until May 31, 2021, even after the transfer of service is complete. Please note that the Account Transfer Registration page will not be available during the February 24 maintenance.
After May 31, 2021, registration for an account transfer will no longer be available and all untransferred data will be deleted.


Black Desert Online Data* Transfer Process Details

If you register for an account transfer, all of your game data will be transferred to Pearl Abyss. After the transfer is complete, you can continue to play via the Pearl Abyss Black Desert Online official website.
However, the Kakao Games Black Desert Online website membership and payment data will not be transferred over to Pearl Abyss.
After May 31, 2021, Kakao Games’ Black Desert Online website membership data, game data, and forum data will be permanently deleted. However, payment information will be stored for 7 years under the Netherlands law for tax and accounting purposes.
Users who agreed to the Terms of Use (effective December 22, 2020) will be able to use future Kakao Games services.

*Data Details
Website membership data - email, birthdate, coupon history, payment history, web cookies, login history
Forum data - email, login history, profile info (picture, name, gender, E-mail, birthdate, social network information, location, job, personal website)
Billing data - payment method, payment amount, full name, billing address, IP, email

GO TO ACCOUNT TRANSFER REGISTRATION

Transfer of Data FAQ

Q. What is happening?

On February the 24th, 2021, Kakao Games will hand over the publishing responsibilities for Black Desert Online NA and EU service to its developer, Pearl Abyss.

About Pearl Abyss
Best known for the MMORPG franchise Black Desert, Pearl Abyss is a leading developer in the game industry. More information about Pearl Abyss is available at www.pearlabyss.com.
Company Name: PEARLABYSS H.K. LIMITED
Contact: contact@naeu.playblackdesert.com
Address: UNIT A 18/F PUBLIC BANK CTR NO 120 DES VOEUX RE CENTRAL HK

Q. What does this mean?

The Kakao Games Black Desert Online service contract ends on February 24, 2021. Kakao Games will no longer be responsible for or involved with the live operation of Black Desert Online. This will be solely managed by Pearl Abyss.

Q. What will change?

Any platform run by Kakao Games such as the current website, official forums and social media channels will be closed down or repurposed along with the current player support process. Game service,  localisation, customer support and all other publishing responsibilities will be handled directly by Pearl Abyss.

Q. How long will the transition maintenance be?

The service transition maintenance will begin on February 24 (09:00 UTC) and is expected to take more than 24 hours to complete. Therefore, the Pearl Abyss Black Desert Online service will be available from February 25. For a more detailed time schedule, please visit Pearl Abyss' website

Q. When can I register for an account transfer?

It will be possible to register for an account transfer from January 27 until May 31.
If you do not register for an account transfer within the given period, you will not be able to continue playing Black Desert Online with your existing account and all your game data will be deleted.
Please make sure to complete the transfer process by May 31, 2021 to continue playing Black Desert Online with your existing account.

Q. Which accounts can be transferred? Are there any limits?
Any eligible Kakao Games and Steam Black Desert Online account registered in the EU/NA region can be transferred.
Certain exceptions will apply
To be eligible an account must have a registered Family name. If no Family name is created, please login to the game and create a Family name prior to registering for an account transfer.

Accounts that have been permanently banned for any violation of the Kakao Games Terms of Use will not be eligible to register for an account transfer.


Q. Will I still be able to purchase Black Desert Online game packages , Kakao Cash and in-game Pearl Boxes?

You can purchase Black Desert Online game packages, Kakao Cash and in-game Pearl Boxes until February 10, 2021. After this time, the possibility to purchase Black Desert Online game packages, Kakao Cash and in-game Pearl Boxes will be restricted.
Black Desert Online game packages and Kakao Cash sale end on February 10 (09:00 UTC).
Pearl Box sale ends on February 10 (13:00 UTC).

Q. Will I be able to use the Pearl Shop?

The in-game Pearl Shop can be used normally until the transfer of service (excluding Pearl Box purchases).

Q. Can I get refunds for the game and/or Kakao Cash?

Your right of withdrawal is unaffected by the transfer of service and all refund policies remain the same. For Steam users, the regular Steam refund policies apply.

Q. What happens to any remaining Kakao Cash?

Any Kakao Cash remaining on the account at the beginning of the maintenance on February 24, 2021, will not be transferred to Pearl Abyss. Please spend all remaining Kakao Cash before February 10, which is when Pearl Boxes will no longer be sold.

Q. What happens to unused web coupons?

Unused web coupons will not be transferred to Pearl Abyss. Please use any remaining coupon before the end of Kakao Games’ Black Desert Online service. Any unused coupons will be automatically sent via in-game mail to the region (EU/NA) with the highest accumulated play time. If no Family exists, unused coupons will be deleted.
You can find out more details about the coupon list that you have to select rewards yourself from the link below. coupon rewards will be sent as mentioned on the list.
[Coupon Name & rewards list link]

Q. What happens to Gift Packages?

The sale of Gift Packages will end on February 3, 2021 during maintenance (09:00 UTC).
The Gift Package system will not be transferred to Pearl Abyss. Please claim any remaining Gift Package rewards you may have before the end of Kakao Games’ Black Desert Online service. Any unclaimed rewards cannot be redeemed later.
Any unredeemed Gift Package codes will not be transferred to Pearl Abyss. If you have purchased a Gift Package but have yet to send the code to your friend, please make sure to have it redeemed before the end of Kakao Games’ Black Desert Online service, otherwise it will be lost.

Q. What happens to pre-order name reservations?

Family and Character names reserved as part of the pre-order package benefits will be released and no longer be tied to the accounts they were reserved on.
If a previously reserved Family or Character name is not transferred to Pearl Abyss’ Black Desert Online service, it will be available for use by anyone.

Q. What happens to forum posts?

Forum data will not be transferred.
Please save any posts or images from the forum before February 24 if you wish to store them.
The Kakao Games serviced Black Desert Online forum will be shut down on February 24.

Q. I’ve completed my Account Transfer Registration. Can I still continue to play? Will all of my progress be transferred on February 24?

All Account Transfer Registrations received prior to February 24 will only be processed once the Kakao Games’ Black Desert Online service ends on February 24 (09:00 UTC). After the service transfer is complete, you will be able to continue your progress on Pearl Abyss’ service from the same state you left it on the Kakao Games service.
Any Account Transfer Registrations submitted after the service transfer will be processed immediately.

Q. Can I transfer my Steam account to a web-based account?

Transferring from Steam to a web-based account is not possible. Accounts created on the Steam platform shall continue to play via Steam only.

Q. What happens if I don’t agree to the transfer of data?

If you do not register for an account transfer within the given period, you will not be able to play Black Desert Online with your existing account and all of your game data will be deleted.
Please make sure to complete the transfer process by May 31, 2021 to continue playing Black Desert Online on your existing account.

Q. Will guild data be transferred as well?

Guild data will be transferred only once on February 24, if at least one member of the guild registers for an account transfer. If no member of the guild registers for an account transfer prior to February 24, the guild data will be deleted.
If the Guild Master of the guild did not register for an account transfer and the guild is transferred, the ‘Accept Appointment to Guild Master’ button will be activated and available for any guild member. The first guild member to press the button will be able to take the position of Guild Master.
All guild members, including the Guild Master, who do not register for an account transfer prior to February 24, 2021, 09:00 UTC will be removed from the guild.

Q. What happens to guild node data?

All guild node and territory data will be reset upon the transfer of service.

Q. Who do I contact if I have issues with the account transfer?

If your issue relates to the process of the data transfer then you should contact Kakao Games. If the process has been completed but you encounter further issues, then you should contact Pearl Abyss. We will continue to work alongside Pearl Abyss to ensure a smooth transition for a certain period after the migration.

Q. When will my data be deleted if I don’t submit an Account Transfer Registration?

All stored game data for accounts that did not agree to transfer or did not register for an account transfer by May 31, 2021, will be permanently deleted on June 1, 2021.

Q. What will be unavailable after the transfer of service?

The below Kakao Games-based services will no longer be available after the transfer of service on February 24.

Black Desert Online game
Black Desert Online website (excluding Account Transfer Registrations)
Black Desert Online download
Black Desert Online Forum and Wiki

Q. WIll my account continue to be linked to Twitch after the service transition?

No. If the Twitch Drops events are re-executed on Pearl Abyss’ service, you will have to re-link your accounts.

Q. Can I withdraw my use of personal data agreement?

Customers can withdraw their agreement. Please contact Pearl Abyss customer service if you want to withdraw.

Q. Can I make any changes once my account transfer registration has been completed?

Once your transfer registration has been completed, please contact Pearl Abyss for any changes you need to make.

More content may be added to the FAQ during the transfer process if necessary.

Thank you.

 Old Moon Grand Prix Opening


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/cb72bbc1e18f4dc42388f5269c57315d4d2ad546.png


 When morning dawns, the chickens at Bartali Farm begin to escape.

 Added the new repeat quest "[Repeat] Runaway Chicken in the Bartali Farm."
 You can accept and complete this quest from Emma Bartali at Bartali Farm every 4 hours.
 When morning dawns in the world of Black Desert, 10 chickens will fly the chicken coop at Bartali Farm.
 Runaway Chickens are easily scared, and will flee if you get too close.
 You must approach them while crouching, and wait until they lay an egg and flee.
 You can interact with the egg to obtain one, which has a chance to turn into a Golden Egg as well. You can exchange these eggs with Emma Bartali for Egg items.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/bdaa0287ea17a19e1ae1d6768bd9e87d75249fa2.png


 Once a chicken has laid an egg twice, it will no longer have the energy to flee. Capture it then, and take it to Emma Bartali to complete the quest.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/0c3c1b56fe66a0c794991aff82088688172d5343.png
※ You cannot catch additional chickens if you already have a Captured Chicken in your inventory.
※ The chickens will disappear if you do not catch them within 5 minutes of their escape.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/d0195de28ab175b93b84b5ec462185152b5a1ce2.gif
▲ Morning dawns, and chickens fly the coop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/252af60e3caf0f40038116a09bda129190f0a35c.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/2ccd4ceb62c995c5626fae444d2f73c87c642aef.gif
▲ Once the chicken lays an egg twice, it won't have the energy to run anymore


 Added the quest "Runaway Chicken in the Bartali Farm" to the Recurring quest tab.
 Changed the chance for a mole to appear based on the number plots occupied by your fence when farming.

 Normal, High-Quality, and Special crops that occupy 2 plots will have double the chance compared to crops that occupy only 1 plot, and Magical and Mysterious crops that occupy 10 plots will have double the chance compared to crops that occupy 5 plots for the mole to appear.

 Duvencrune and O'draxxia's storage keepers now rent out containers.
 Changed the Old Moon Grand Prix times to 16:00–9:00 (UTC) for NA servers.

[System]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/bedcb9f5ef8bd971f5cbcf4b88b71c4825fe97b1.png

 Accept the quest "[Season Server Graduation] At the Crossroad" from Leyla in Velia.
 Accept and complete the above quest, then accept the quest "[Season Server Graduation] Into the Big Wide World" from Fughar.

 This quest requires a season-graduated character who has a "[Season] Boss Gear Exchange Coupon" in possession, who will then be able to accept the quest from Fughar to exchange for the appropriate weapon or gear. Please note that you can choose to accept and complete this quest only once.
 Once you've accepted the quest, go to Tranan Underfoe with the exchange coupon and Tuvala gear to exchange them for a Boss gear of appropriate enhancement level.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/961c93377be71b6c286e8ba5590bdd5ba92aac03.png

 Adjusted the size of cutscene audio played in-game by 60%.
 Fixed certain areas of the Scarlet Sand Chamber.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/37bf22c31e5216756ab16f65cb7fd703b587d3f5.png

 Set the basic AP of all class summons to match the summoning class's AP.

 The summoning class's AP must be at least the same as the basic AP of the summoned minion in order to control and wield the summoned minion at 100%.
 For example, Gorr's basic AP is 100. If the summoning Witch's AP is at 50, then Gorr's AP will be limited to 50 as well, and only return to 100 when the Witch's AP also hits 100 or higher. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/7dcbae3993b2653534d6e7b180f7bc0dfafa29c8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/65297b086842cb3a4a657b2989b902b4d28fb6fb.png

WARRIOR

 Fixed an issue where weapons appeared unnatural when using certain skills.

SORCERESS

 Core: Violation – Fixed an issue where weapons appeared unnatural when using the skill.

TAMER

 Fixed irregular movement animations.

VALKYRIE

 Prime: Judgment of Light I–III – Fixed the issue where the skill's 1st hit wasn't applying damage when using the skill.

MUSA

 Fixed an issue where weapons appeared unnatural when using certain skills.

NINJA

LAHN

SHAI

NOVA

notes.title: Winter Season Graduation
notes.content:
A month has passed since the Winter Season started on December 22, 2020.

On January 27, 2021, adventurers who have enjoyed the Winter Season can proceed with early graduation. Read below to find out more about the coming early graduation and other new updates!

Please keep in mind adventurers who graduated their Season Character can no longer obtain rewards and items offered on the season servers.

So give your decision a second thought before graduating early!

Winter Season Early Graduation Schedule

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/48fc41711bd79f6f018f30a373636116027bbd51.png

Adventurers who graduate early from the Winter Season can obtain a “Season Special Gift Exchange Coupon”

At the end of this quest, you’ll obtain a “Season Special Gift Exchange Coupon” as a reward which can be exchanged into one of the three items below by speaking to NPC Fughar. However, if you’ve already received the Season Special Gift from the Summer and Autumn seasons, you cannot receive them again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/e6b50f7b9502c5fff9d4827571dec7120604b6d1.png

Winter Season Graduation Benefits
Here are the benefits and rewards awaiting you after you graduate the Winter Season!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/a061c08e68802a00279ba5418609a592bdb77203.png

 Click  for further details on Boss Gear Exchanges!

Graduation is not required from the get-go! Adventurers who wish to continue playing with the benefits of the Winter Season Server are welcome to stay longer!

Various Season benefits such as [Weekly] Quests, Regional Quests, Old Moon Grand Prix, Red Battlefield, Savage Rift, Rift’s Echo, Ancient Weapon Invasion, other rewards and content to acquire Tuvala enhancement materials will be available until the very end of the Winter Season Server.

New Adventurers, Behold!
We are also preparing new updates and benefits for new adventurers to settle in nicely in the normal servers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/b6317e2acc9b9ae0997577e01d18ae44ee218606.png

First! Exclusive content after the Season Server

This exclusive content will involve entering a secret location and completing various challenges. Time in this secret location flows faster than the ordinary Black Desert world and you'll be able to receive many rewards if you correctly complete them.

Second! Daily “Short Missions" to help you get settled into normal servers after Winter Season.

We hope new adventurers who are slightly confused as to what to do after graduation can find the way to adapt through these short missions. They also provide you with rewards to help you through!

We have more plans to add contents and rewards to help you adapt to the ever-evolving world of Black Desert!

From the Winter Season to the new class Nova! We’d like to take this chance to thank all of you for the warm support you’ve shown us in the recent months. We’ll do our best to return your support with better and more exciting content.
We’ll keep you posted on the details of the upcoming updates through our official website.
In the meantime, enjoy your time with the Winter Season!

Key Points to Remember

Graduation available on January 27th after maintenance.

You can receive a Season Special Gift Exchange Coupon after early graduation.
    
Select one of the three Season Special Gifts (Summer, Autumn, and Winter) with the Exchange 

Coupons. (Previously obtained gifts cannot be selected again).
    
Lastly, wait for the new content to be updated soon!

notes.title: Post Calphe:ON Ball: 2021 Update Roadmap
notes.content:
Greeting Adventurers!

The Calphe:ON Ball offline event held in Korea was filled with excitement and rewards, not to mention the development plans for 2021.

Here's a recap of new updates to come in 2021 as announced in the Calphe:ON Ball. Let's check them out!

*Please note the dates mentioned are for the Korean server and global release dates may differ.

Node War Revamp
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/711e3aeb659ed63f22b3bc86db0aee4f11f68682.jpg

Just like the improvements announced in the Black Desert Global Labs, the main brunt of the revamps for Node Wars will focus on turning it into a form of warfare where adventurers could expand their territory by conquering and protecting nodes, involving more active combat and bolstered rewards.

We plan on changing from the current system where Nodes are designated on certain days of the week, to expand to warfare on a regional scale.

Main Server System and Server Wars
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/0edc9d06bf307520413d648efe68d332a3b181a1.png

Soon all Guilds in Black Desert will be able to designate one server, out of many, and gain certain benefits from playing in that specific server.

We’ll make sure these benefits aren’t too generous, so adventurers never feel forced to tie themselves down to one server.

One of these benefits will be moving between different numbered servers under the same name without any cooldown time.

We are also developing minor and major contents to tie in with main servers, of which is Server Wars.

Server Wars is an upgraded version of World Conquest Wars. Once activated, servers will be placed within the camps of Calpheon and Valencia.

Once every month, or some other preset period, guilds of each camp will either invade the opposing server or defend against the invading camp, leading to a gigantic war.

Since we plan on developing this content so most guilds will be able to participate, we expect the scale to be much larger than our World Conquest Wars. With more adventurers participating, we will continue developing it so multiple skirmishes will take place in different areas around the world of Black Desert.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/97b503c9264e7bf9ebacee9aa64ec46e30fdc5c5.jpg

Also, to add a strategic element, we are developing guild campsites and tactical elephants that will serve as headquarters on the front during these local skirmishes.

Despite the “war” aspect, we don’t want those guilds with mightier battle prowess to use this format to pick fights with smaller guilds, and we are seeking to develop it so that guilds placed in their respective camps will cooperate and protect each other during the war.

Guilds with stronger members in their ranks would head to the frontlines, while other guilds would strategize with indirect skirmishes or supplying the war effort from the rear. We will do our best to develop this content with the MMORPG format in mind, where adventurers will be able to help each other and receive help from others through means of play that they enjoy and excel in.

Relating to the Main Server content, we seek to expand it to include PvE or Life skill-based content to encourage competition within server camps.

10 vs 10 Crew
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/9a514d1e17e324af6e3e705e527b7ed52791e996.jpg

Unlike guilds, 10 vs 10 Crew is for those adventurers who commit to PvP, and group up with like-minded comrades-in-arms to form a crew to compete against others.

Crews will consist of 10-person teams (each being a different character) with 3 people in reserve. Regarding the arena, we are thinking of offering a variety of options such as the traditional Capture-the-Flag format or the more Black-Desert style of mini-Seige Wars.

Also, we hope to host these Crews in a global tournament, like a Champion’s League of sorts, along with plans on implementing a rank system fit for the crew Champion’s League.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/15edf6591b2c6d5784fd7dcc952f8a75b541b026.jpg

While not solely PvP-related, we would like to address the growing gap in gear levels between adventurers. When the Fallen God Armor was first introduced to the Korean servers, this led to a large demand for Caphras Stones that is yet to be fulfilled.

As of November, there are countries, like Russia, whose markets are stocked with Caphras Stones, while, at the same time, there is a growing number of countries whose supplies are slowly being depleted.

We sought to address this issue by providing a variety of new ways to acquire Caphras Stones, but the supply still could not meet the demand, especially since most of these routes involved Life skill content such as Farming. And so, to support our adventurers in their growth, we’ve come up with an entirely new way to obtain these stones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/8668337c3fe69bab4a9fa181d024e96810a6802a.jpg

First, we’re implementing additional enhancement levels to Blackstar defense gear. After tapping a Blackstar to TET, most adventurers felt weary of trying the low success chance of enhancing PEN, which halted any room for further growth. After this new update, you’ll be able to improve your Blackstar defense gear in several stages. The stats of the gear will increase once you improve your TRI or TET Blackstar gear. You will also be able to tap for a PEN, even after the gear is improved.

Materials required for improving and enhancing the Blackstar gear will mainly be through the Possessed in Hadum hunting grounds on the special server as revealed in the Black Desert Global Labs. Since this will be the way to obtain the best-in-slot gear, you can be assured that these hunting grounds will be quite the challenge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/78af1978c5991ff63efd8ddeca7aad342f595568.png

Also, we’ve laid out plenty of ways to acquire Caphras Stones, but we will continue to find more routes for you to acquire them. Specifically, we are planning to have Caphras Stones as a basic reward for PVP contents.

Once the improved Blackstar gear update goes live, we expect Caphras Stone supply to recover, but if necessary, we are examining means of adjusting the maximum prices on the Central Market.

Caphras Stones have a direct relationship with the growth of our adventurers. We will continue to make adjustments based on accurate data to provide a better path for our adventurers to become stronger, and thereby help narrow the gap between the gear levels of all our adventurers.

Blackstar Raid
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/a9d91a126b62f642a04fb896ad2aad9c04e27fb7.jpg

The true nature of the ominous meteorite floating above Star’s End is none other than the new World Boss itself.

We plan on adding features to the encounter that will allow adventurers to hit the meteorite, which will continue to spawn Incarnations of Corruption. To take down this boss, adventurers will need to take up different roles and work together. Also, one of the main drops from the boss will be materials needed to improve Blackstar gear.

Epic Quests
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/67fe1b4458bb1d789c89c7f0d055f0fedd9fe414.jpg

Some time ago, one adventurer on the Korean servers completed the mystical fish content to summon Vell. The mystical fish content was content we felt that we could develop because this was an MMORPG, and we hope to expand in our offering of such challenging contents.

We hope to maintain the idea that such contents are challenging, so upon completion, the partaking adventurers will feel great in their accomplishment and be well-deserving of their fellow adventurers’ praise.

New Region: Mountain of Eternal Winter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/bfb4080adebfb5a8807dbdb4adc03828f095a640.jpg

The new region is the home of the Guardian, it is a place buried in winter all year long.

Due to the frighteningly cold weather, the region is susceptible to sudden snowfall, which will require adventurers to light a fire or seek shelter, lest they risk a frigid death due to hypothermia.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/85bafb4f73e7f92b75f7f962dfc9b3846070950f.jpg

Only Guardians who hail from this region will have resistance to hypothermia, while Shais can use buffs to protect their allies and themselves from the cold.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f81284c9a7842a0a3c9dce2ff6cb0908ee306e3a.jpg

In the image above, we see the Okjinsini who reside on the Golden Mountain, one of two new hunting grounds located at the Mountain of Eternal Winter. The “Okjin” in Okjinsini means “Snow,” and they boast both large physique and strength as masters of the mountain. Adventurers will face them head-on in one-on-one bouts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/62019c55f87ad0ab733459c64d1fc224a817f20d.jpg

Second, we have the Murrowak Labyrinth, where you will find monsters inspired by pill bugs you may have encountered during your childhood. While their appearance may be akin to the pill bug, they’ll display behavioral patterns like ants, especially in how they live in deep holes beneath the mountain.

If adventurers achieve certain conditions in each of these “ant” holes, the queen’s nest will be activated. While fighting the queen, countless Murrowaks will flood in from all corners, and we expect this fight to be truly chaotic. However, defeating the queen will award you with loot befitting the challenge.

Also, here at the Mountain of Eternal Winter, the Golden Dragon lays in slumber. Expect the raid to show mechanics you’ve never seen before.

We are developing the Mountain of Eternal Winter update to release next winter.

Hardcore Hunting Ground: Terror of the Deep Sea
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/1a23ffc0ef40b660e7a7b2a41e55f3eb3c8c246e.png

Since a person can only run through the same location so many times before getting bored, we decided to create a hardcore hunting ground, starting with the Terror of the Deep Sea.

This hardcore hunting ground will set you the adventurer to explore the Deep Sea ruins by yourself. We designed the place where the more monsters you kill, the difficulty level begins to climb. Monsters hit harder, or random bombardments, or elite monsters suddenly appearing are some of the ideas we’ve thought of so far.

You may leave these hunting grounds with whatever loot you pick up, but if you die while in this zone, you will be forced to return with only half the loot you’ve obtained. This will bring more levity to your decision to further remain on these grounds to continue the challenge.

As the hardcore hunting grounds are being developed with hopes to breathe new life into this content, we plan on placing a 2 week to 1-month time restriction for re-entering the grounds, whether you were killed or left voluntarily. Of course, we will make sure the loot that drops fit its difficulty.

A New, Grandiose Residence, the Mansion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/57b4548927b262eebcb1bfe404b798d4c8735798.jpg

If you invest some contribution points and achieve certain conditions in a city like Heidel or Calpheon, you will be granted ownership of land in the town and also the property deed for the Mansion.

You can upgrade Mansions using various materials, and as they'll be quite spacious, you will be able to design the interior however you like.

Also, we are planning to allow adventurers to customize the exterior of their mansions as well. You will be able to install trees, your very own garden, statues, and/or lighting outside the Mansion. We plan on implementing a whole variety of related furniture, too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/64aaf64bb6595e0bd4ca83d70a0481acf2e386e3.jpg

This is not confirmed as of yet, but we are also thinking of adding a competitive rank system for Mansions. But it will be more than a means to collect expensive furniture. We are considering taking a new approach.

We will do our best to create a space for our adventurers where they can actualize their artistic ambition and/or desires through the Mansion.

Co-op Dungeon: Ataraxion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/a6c3f47d9847abd8ed3e4a62a7f11773bbe8e154.jpg

We will be adding a new dungeon for those who want to play co-op with other adventurers, which won’t force those who prefer solo play. The name of the new dungeon is "Ataraxion."

During the Valencia main questline, you will end up visiting the secret room within the Ancient Stone Chamber where you'll see a big entrance behind the Ancient Guardian. This is the gateway leading to the new dungeon.

This dungeon is not a separate instance. As an open dungeon, you will be able to meet other adventurers just as you would in the Gyfin Rhasia Temple. It will be much grander in scale compared to the Gyfin Rhasia Temple, as certain chambers and structures of the dungeon will require 3 to 5 adventurers to cooperate

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/471a0f907fed7eca99e7782c712a28ec3134a99e.jpg

Unlike the existing hunting grounds, this dungeon will require both long sessions of defeating monsters combined with strategic play, as there will be certain moments where each adventurer will have to play a certain role to complete the dungeon. This will be a uniquely "Black Desert-style” dungeon that will allow any class to complete by the use of mechanics and solving puzzles.

Also, we are thinking of creating a special role for adventurers with lower AP and DP so that they too can participate in the co-op dungeon.

As the main conceptual design is based on an ancient temple, you will be facing off a variety of ancient weapons, as we were able to fully flesh out some unique ancient weapon designs and concepts.

Despite the addition of this dungeon, please note that we will continue to release new hunting grounds that stick to the current solo play model as well.

New Continent: Land of the Dawn
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/3de432bdd0a0d3d371942a9dab4fda7904ef367a.jpg

The Joseon Dynasty, the last imperial dynasty of Korea, will be the base of design for the Land of the Dawn, a new continent with central communal areas having ancient palaces designed after those in Korea.

Here, the hidden stories of Musa, Maehwa, and Lahn, who crossed over to the lands familiar to our adventurers, will slowly unfold within the distinct eastern environment.


We hope you enjoyed the recap of the thrilling development plan for the coming year!

Please remember that the contents introduced above are subject to change in name, schedule, and form.

We will do our best to deliver a variety of updates for the remainder of 2020 for all of you to enjoy together. Thank you!

notes.title: Post Calphe:ON Ball: Keyword Talk
notes.content:
Greeting Adventurers!

Did you enjoy the roadmap presented in the other post Calphe:ON Ball article?

Here's another recap post on the keyword talk held during the Calphe:ON Ball. Read on below to see the keywords presented by adventures all over the globe!

*Please remember that the contents introduced are subject to change in name, schedule, and form.
*Some of the content addressed below may not pertain to Black Desert Online serviced in every region.

New Class NOVA
Nova is a new class that uses a one-handed blunt weapon and a large shield called Quoratum. The main weapon is literally called "Morning Star" in Korean. As a blunt weapon, it's mostly used for melee attacks but its head is attached to a retractable chain that can be extended for ranged attacks. So you could say that Nova is a mid-ranged class. The most distinct characteristic of Nova is in her shield and the Thornwood Guard spirits that dwell in it. These guard spirits will protect Nova when she shifts to a defensive stance and can be ordered to unleash attacks on her enemies. The Thornwood Guards can join Nova in her skills as well. The design concept of Thornwood Guards is based on chess pieces. They can be distinguished mainly from their two distinctive forms: infantry and calvary. Nova is a class where we've tried to implement new concepts into the battle so I'm sure adventurers will find it refreshing just as they did with the Hashashin.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/061075069026c2818da74547167bf864f3756629.jpg
Nova is the last remaining heir of the Seric Dynasty that once ruled the continent before the rise of the republic. She is the hidden daughter of King Dahad Seric the Conqueror, the sister of the poisoned King Guy Seric and Leonadro Seric who went to Olivia. Her full name is  and she is also the mysterious figure of "S'' behind the secret invitation letters. Until now, playable classes such as Tamer, Musa, Maehwa, Lahn, and Striker had background stories that can be identified as a class rather than a specific individual. But for Nova, we've taken a step further and given her a name to develop a more interesting and personal story element. We expanded the storyline by writing about the secret of her birth, why she had to stay in a monastery all this time, and etc. We have prepared a lot about Nova for adventurers so I hope you have fun!

Balance
We've also made quite a few rebalancing efforts in the 3rd and 4th quarter, but it seems most adventurers still thirst for more. Let's first take a look and compare the Succession and Awakening ratios.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/8806ed84c9dcc9188da05e4be73c39699e273d05.png
Succession was very dominant at the beginning of this year, but numbers are showing a lot of progress. There is still room for improvement as there are characters with a slightly wider disparity between Succession and Awakening than others, but we plan to continue the rebalancing process until we've hit the right mark. In the broader sense of things, we plan to add another Awakening-only skill. Awakening tends to put a lot of pressure in swapping skills, especially so if the class is old, which results in lesser use of Awakening skills, so we aim to compensate for this avoidance by adding another Awakening-only skill. It's only one skill, but we want it to be meaningful. Of course, adding a new skill just on Awakening might be a little disappointing for our Succession users, so we'll add the so-called the C-skills to Succession as well. We also plan to add one more skill that can be used in conjunction with the Awakening Skill.

We've also tried our first Balance FGT in Korea and there were a lot of shortfalls that we weren't able to plan ahead. We would really like to take this opportunity to thank all the participants who helped us out in ironing out the details. We plan to continue the FGTs in the future and keep upgrading it as we go. There were a lot of requests from our servers abroad for the FGTs but we couldn't go through with it because there was difficulty in meeting offline. So we're trying to do it using voice chat. The purpose of FGT has always been to hear the voices of adventurers who have a remarkable understanding of how each class works. We would love to hear their voices and what they have to say on how to improve the game.

There were many voices saying that certain classes were OP. As we've mentioned in the Heidel Ball, it's important for us to consider how the users feel as well so we're trying to buff other characters instead of nerfing the powerful classes. Sometimes we'll need to nerf because of Conquest Wars and or other large scale battles as they have very different mechanisms but we'd like to keep the nerfing to a minimum.

We're mopping up on development for the elevation problems so we might be able to make it to next week's update if possible. It took us a lot of time trying to change the structure of action mechanics. I hope that Rangers and Wizards can find this update meaningful. That elevation problem with the clunky motion when riding horses? We're trying to fix all that as well.

For frame rates, I think we can only say at this moment that we'll try to optimize settings as much as possible. Black Desert emphasizes free movement and action as much as possible so framerates are going to be slightly different with each PC setting. A quick fix would be to fix all frame rates to 60 during PvP and this is an easy solution to close the gap but limiting frame rates will also influence strategy and gameplay so we're trying to avoid that. We'll try to optimize frame rates as much as possible.

Story
We're trying hard to think of ways to include the story so that it fits in naturally with the gameplay. I want to be careful at this moment because nothing is decided, but some of the options we're considering are story dialogues through voice acting, more active role for NPCs, and story progression on the field instead of quests in front of NPCs. Our main purpose is to really do away with the RRR smash.

Recently, we've been experimenting with individual space without interruption of other adventurers for a more immersive story environment. Once fully developed, it'll be called the "Independent Story System". For example, in the Calpheon questline before renewal, there was a scene where Belmorn would lead the Shadow Knights and the Black Harpy Elites in the invasion of Calpheon. In our system, adventurers would be able to join that very invasion as a participant. I can't say when we'll be able to release this but we'll let you know as soon as we have news.

PvP Contents
We've mentioned focusing on PvP contents during our Roadmap introduction, but we aim to focus on it until the beginning of 2021. I think we might've been too careful in approaching PvP content. We're reflecting on this and would like to change things by trying to be more active in renewing the Node/Conquest War first, then Thornwood Castle.

Season Server
As we've said during our Roadmap, we'll be releasing the new class Nova with the Winter Season. The focus we've put on the Winter Season was new content exclusive to the Season Server and helping new adventurers get settled in to the game. One of the advantages of Season Servers is that people who started together can party up and have some fun. We're thinking of more Season Server exclusive content like Tuvala gears so we've made some improvements there.

We've been analyzing the data constantly and we saw a lot of adventurers confused as to what they're supposed to do once the Season Servers were over. We definitely have plans to compensate for this by giving lots of rewards to warm the winter and help new starters settle into the game.

Co-op Contents
The new dungeon, Atoraxion, that we introduced earlier is highly focused on cooperative play. The boss battle will require challenging tactical choices, straying away from the traditional “holy trinity” role system. In addition, there was a lot of feedback about wanting more guild contents, so we are also thinking of implementing this dungeon content for guilds. Either way, it will be a content that is well worth waiting for.

Existing Content Renewal
The latter half of this year, we’ve made many small and big content updates, world and field boss updates, and the Old Moon Grand Prix update. We will also continue to improve and change existing contents in 2021. However, we will be putting more focus on improving trade. There’s still a lot to prepare, so I can’t go into full detail on what’s actually going to be made until sometime in the latter half of 2021. However, Jesang will tell you which direction we plan on taking for trade.

We also received a lot of feedback regarding rewards for existing content. We are looking into it and want to rebalance and change some of the current rewards. However, we won’t be applying this change to every content. This will cause an issue where people with less time might feel forced to play a certain content, while those who have a lot more time will end up profiting a lot more than others. So, we plan to group up a couple of contents for a specific reward and adventurers will be able to choose which content they wish to play to receive this reward. For example, let’s say we group up Savage Rift, Altar of Blood, and Altar of Training. Adventurers who play Altar of Blood will end up receiving the same reward as those who play Savage Rift.

Papua Crinea was created for adventurers who wish to just relax and explore new places. It wasn’t a necessary spot that you had to go to get stronger, so the rewards aren’t as good as other areas and we wish to keep it this way. However, we would like to add other attractive rewards for the many adventurers who do visit. You may not know, but many adventurers enjoy using stoneback crab or mischievous jack transformation scrolls. With this in mind, we want to diversify transformation scrolls and make Papua Crinea the transformation hotspot.

Life Contents
I remember the open beta days. At that time, I remember working hard to get myself a noble wagon and doing only trade all day long. I really miss those days, so I want to somehow revive the trade content. However, rather than simply improving profitability, we are preparing to make a more detailed and advanced trade content.

To tell you a little bit about the current concept, you would join the Xian, Shen, or a specific region’s merchant guild and compete with each other. Our goal is to bring you this update sometime in the second half of next year. Oh, for reference, what I just said is only in the idea stage, so please note that it may change when it is released.

One of the mottos of Black Desert's development is to make it enjoyable and regret-free when choosing to play any of the numerous contents. We will work hard to make sure trade and hunting does exactly that.

Ocean
We prepared new large ship designs. However, since existing ships are faithfully performing their respective roles, it is unlikely that the new designs will be released as new ships. We are preparing a variety of ways for you to obtain it, so get ready.

And I would like to take this opportunity to apologize for the update delay of the Great Expedition Part 2. In fact, the initial direction we wanted to take with the blue battlefield has completely changed and some of the plans for Great Expedition Part 2 has been moved to our Morning Country project.

The blue battlefield was initially designed as a team-to-team battle, like the red battlefield, but where each team would capture specific spots and protect it. After doing some internal tests, we concluded that it wasn’t enjoyable due to ship movement and cannon range limitations. Thus, we steadily improved the usability of cannons and later added a pirate system. If you are an adventurer who has been sailing steadily since the days of the sailboats, I think you will have felt that the use of cannons has become really easy. All this was done to turn the entire Black Desert sea into a blue battlefield. You might not have noticed the reason for these changes, since there really isn’t much need to compete with each other. In the future, small content updates like the addition of limited quantities of trade goods at sea nodes may be added to stir up some small competition.

However, we plan to maintain the stance that no advantage will be given to pirate adventurers. The fact that you can interfere with other adventurers is judged to work well as content, and we believe that the number of people who visit the ocean will steadily increase only when adventurers who play peacefully are given priority.

Also, we are preparing a supply ship for the convenience of those who enjoy sea hunting. You will be able to call the Old Moon supply ship anytime, anywhere to resupply on cannon shells and food. Of course, you already know that the Old Moon Guild loves money. It will be a lot more expensive than the price provided at the port.

Composition
As someone who also enjoys the music composing content, I, too, feel frustrated because of this issue. It might take some time, but we are doing our best to solve it. Also, we are preparing more high-end instruments that can reproduce better quality sound. In addition to that, new methods and effector functions will be added to these instruments, allowing you to enjoy various performances with a much richer sound. Please look forward to it.

New Class
I think I’ve fully explained our stance about creating new characters during the roadmap presentation. We are definitely willing to add a Dwarf and Papu character, but I can’t promise it. All I can say is that it will arrive one day. We've been thinking about more customization options, including hairstyles, but... I’m sorry. There are no plans of anything new being added during the first half of next year.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/94f8bd1b99a5350786e17860edeaf854620ea47a.jpg
 The image that you are seeing right now is a hint of the character that is planned to be released next year. It's still in development, so I can't give you a more detailed image, but I can tell you that it'll be a fun character to play. Also, we believe that the opinion of our adventurers regarding new characters are very important. For example, the concept of Hashashin first derived from your opinions. We created him, tested him and now he's live on our servers. In MMORPGs, our characters represent us or what would like to be. However, 20 characters are not enough. We would love to hear from you about what type of character you want to play and be. With enough data, we'll make sure to develop one with them in mind.

Treasure
Of course, new treasures will continue to be added. However, it is difficult to say what will be added as there is no confirmed content at this time. If you have any good ideas, please feel free to contact us through customer support. We will actively review it.

I also use some of my spare time trying to get myself a treasure. I have over 1 million sulfur in my warehouse but no treasure map pieces. This makes me want me to change the content so that you can get a treasure after reaching a certain requirement. But, that’s also when I’m reminded of Jaehee Kim telling me, “A treasure should be a treasure.” Just like in life, the charm and value of a treasure seems to shine even more when connected with the element of surprise.

We increased the role of Afuaru to give you a better chance, added scrolls to Dreighan to slightly improve the benefits from treasures… and we plan to continue releasing such updates one at a time.

Gear Enhancement
For this part, I don't think there's anything else I can tell you, but good luck. I think there are areas that we can change and areas that we shouldn’t. Gear enhancement is an area that should never be touched. Instead, we will continue to review and improve ways to make preparation for the enhancement a little more convenient, such as Naderr’s Band or Stack Workshop events.

Mounts
We are thinking and experimenting with many different ideas for a new mount. As you have suggested, snow bears and O’dyllita giant wolves are also included in our experiment. I can’t tell you when or what will be released, but once we finish testing and are satisfied with the result, we will make sure you know. Also, tier-10 horses, airships, hot air balloons, and water mounts are not going to be released in the first half of 2021. However, a fantasy version of Diné and Doom is planned for release.

First of all, in the case of Diné, we are developing a function where it can run on water. It's not 100% finished yet, but I'll show you a little.
[previewyoutube=kEsVRobS8lI;full][/previewyoutube]
If you’ve seen or read martial arts novels, the first stage of flight and after that comes walking on water. I thought it would be really cool if Diné could run on water. Of course, that doesn't mean you’ll be able to run all the way Port Ratt. We’re going to make it so that you can easily cross to some extent.

New Outfit
Jaehee talked about creating a Costume Task Force during the Heidel Ball. Soon after, we established it and got right to producing a variety of costumes and outfits.

I would like to show you a few outfits that are being prepared to make an appearance next year.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/48b00f3851ced8e10eaced11839ea3de2d3b8da9.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/adfef89a7be245c389e7c2458f4008bd317b2a64.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/6ef8f46bb6778ef9c43dd48153207d97ffb14982.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/54aa2358aeb4895e2d80cede666d89570388a984.jpg
A couple of months have passed since the establishment of the task force and we are doing our best to make an efficient working process to maintain a steady production pace. Just know that TF is a work in progress and will continue to produce awesome costumes that will be to your taste.

Unauthorized Program/Macro
Eradicating behaviors that negatively affect the game, such as usage of unauthorized programs and macros, is one of the major tasks of Black Desert. We have been detecting and preventing these problems through usage of security programs, 24-hour monitoring, adding a report function, and we even developed and applied our own macro detection program called "Pearl Protect”. We have had success in detecting and banning accounts abusing these programs. We are also reviewing and developing programs to block the movement of silver using the marketplace.

Before we had the current system, reports from our adventurers have been the biggest help. I would like to sincerely thank all our adventurers around the world for lending us your strength. I know that we will have to continue to improve in many areas. We will continue to improve Pearl Protect, and in addition to this, we will continue to strengthen our internal processes so that any abnormal play that may occur in the game can be detected and be taken care of more quickly.

Translation
During the past two years, our company has been focusing much more on delivering quality translations for our titles.

We have made many changes within our company, Localization Center, and processes to ensure the quality of localized content, and we are continuing to work towards providing you all with the best content possible in your respective languages. Our localization specialists are hard at work reworking past and current game content to match your expectations, and to also provide you with better future content. So, although this is a priority for us, it is also a time-consuming process. We ask that you be patient with us as we work towards this goal.

Events
We are trying by first making different variations. For example, this year, our usual Thanksgiving guest, Targargo, showed up with a mate, Halloween was dealt differently in Florin, and moles appeared in gardens. It will be difficult to change everything at once, but we will continue to make changes so that adventurers can feel that something was new and fun.

We believe that events are an invigorating factor in gameplay and an important factor that directly or indirectly influences growth. We have held a lot of events this year. For next year, we will avoid events with high difficulty, events that will make only some adventurers happy, and events that are difficult to participate in. We will solely focus on making events that are accessible by majority of the adventurers. Also, with the exception of special weeks like Christmas and other holiday seasons, there were weeks where multiple events were ongoing at the same time, while during some weeks, there were little to none. We will do our best to balance out and schedule the events better.

Communication
We're constantly observing and listening to feedback from adventurers around the world, and yet, since we've mainly communicated through the patch notes, I feel there were some mishaps in getting all we wanted to say through to the adventurers. So starting from next year, we will create a new channel of communicating with our adventurers, that developers won't only be listening to adventures but can actively share their opinions directly, too.

Also, we seek to actively utilize the Black Desert Global Labs starting from next year as well. Currently, the Global Labs are used as teasers for upcoming content, but we mainly do this to also have adventurers try it out and give us their feedback. Currently, our only source of gathering your opinions on upcoming content is solely through the official website, and we seek to improve the Global Labs by creating a better means of collecting such feedback. As always, we will actively continue our efforts to update our projects currently underdevelopment, polish them as best we can before revealing them in the labs.

Content that's released in Korea usually is released globally as long as there are no issues, but sometimes there may be some delays in the release schedule. This may sound like an excuse, but... due to our weekly updates, we clearly have a tight schedule to maintain. Every week we have new deadlines to meet, and this includes localization and other translation work that factors into the release schedule. I'm always apologetic to our localization center, but we will do our best to develop our updates at a faster pace so that we can ship out our weekly content polished and on-time.


Thank you for your continuous support and interest as always.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/5731643a6ec70cdd3189d6656e10756444cb140e.jpg


 Old Moon Grand Prix has opened wide!

 Learn more about it on our official Wiki page .

 Opened the Old Moon Grand Prix hosted by the Stonetail Horse Club.

 Old Moon Grand Prix is a horse race where 5–10 adventurers compete against each other in a racetrack.
 Anybody can join the race by using the new race horses. We hope the races are an enjoyable competition for our adventurers.
 You can participate in the Old Moon Grand Prix anytime between 9:00 AM–2:00 AM (UTC).
 Old Moon Grand Prix is not held during Node/Conquest Wars.

 Added new race horse "Giorga Brisa."

 You can purchase "Horse Emblem: Giorga Brisa" for 30,000,000 Silver from Stonetail Horse Ranch NPC Stable Keeper "Gula" and Old Moon Grand Prix NPC Stable Keeper "Miles."
 You can now keep up to maximum 5 race horses in the stable as it has 5 slots.
 Race horses begin to gradually pick up speed as they sprint. They will reach their height if you maintain sprint for a certain period of time.
 Every race horse has their own unique "Power of Wind" and a gauge that will slowly charge as you sprint and drift in the race.
 Large amounts of "Power of Wind" can be charged while drifting as long as you can. Short drifts will slower down the speed of the horse so use it with care.
 Once the "Power of Wind" gauge becomes full, "Sweeping Movement" can be activated. When used, it will immediately propel the horse into a fast frontal sprint.
 Use the "Power of Wind" and "Sweeping Movement" as a strategy to win the race.
 Race horses are handled differently than normal horses. See below for the controls.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/ed53c490f8bc5e4b6b535f9a68f9339f4ac96397.png


Acceleration gauge must be charged up to a certain amount to be able to use Sweeping Movement. Acceleration gauge can be seen at the Stamina UI and it will be charged when using drifts.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/a5b436074301a7a262f6f6e22548413f7bd58b33.jpg


 Added "Balenos: Coastal Cave" as an Old Moon Grand Prix Race Track.

 Balenos: Velia Coastal Cave has numerous curves and obstacles making the use of drift and obstacle evasion very important to win the race.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/c20afaae93adbd52bb843a2988b5589ecb72aeda.png


 Follow the steps below to participate in the Old Moon Grand Prix race:

 ESC menu → Life → Select Old Moon Grand Prix menu or press the Race Icon on the top-right side of the screen to participate in the race.
 Register the race horse emblem in the stable, enter the racetrack and speak to Stable Keeper "Miles" to get ready for the race.
 3 minute waiting time will be first granted when the first participant enters the waiting room. Every time another participant enters the room, another 3 minute will be added to the waiting time. No more waiting time will be added once there are more than 5 participants.
 If there are less than 5 participants, the race will be cancelled and you will be forced to exit back to the racetrack.
 If there are 5 participants or more, the waiting time will end and 1 minute will be given to allow preparations for the race.
 The Grand Prix race will begin once the preparation time is over.
 If you have gone on the wrong path during the race, you can come back to the racetrack by clicking the "Escape" button top-left side of the screen.
* "Escape" cooldown time is 5 seconds.
 Race Winners will be ranked in the order they come into the finish line after passing all the checkpoints.
 1st, 2nd, 3rd places in the Grand Prix will be granted the honorable Grand Prix Gold, Silver, and Bronze Trophies.

 Rewards for winning the Old Moon Grand Prix are as following:

* Grand Prix Trophy is an item that represents the Rider's honor and achievements in the participating race. Each trophy can be exchanged into a rewarding item depending on its tier.
 Riders that have participated in the Old Moon Grand Prix can receive various rewards depending on their weekly performance in the race.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/cb385c85d34a4a517635bb8efd3ada5d9532753b.png


 You can exchange Old Moon Grand Prix Coins via  Gula at the Stonetail Horse Ranch for the below items.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/de0e1422e6e3e444ad400fc3e64ba3e06fc4bfe2.png


 Old Moon Grand Prix Coins are rewarded as a prize after the race depending on how you were ranked.
 Hand over "Grand Prix Participant Certificate" to Stonetail Horse Ranch  Gula to exchange it for Training EXP.

 Exchanging 1 Grand Prix Participant Certificate for Training EXP will boost a Training Beginner Lv. 1 to Lv. 6 75%.
 Training EXP obtained from exchanging Grand Prix Participant Certificates does not affect Life EXP gain effects.

 Added food and elixirs that extend Training-related effects when used.

 Stonetail Wind's Meal shares the cooldown period with Cron Meal and the two cannot be overlapped to extend time.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/263b567af726b42160d693e27326952419b09592.png


 Tuvala enhancement materials are now rewarded when participating in the Old Moon Grand Prix.

* "[Season] Frost Leaf" can be obtained from the reward box obtained by participating in the Old Moon Grand Prix.
 Take "[Season] Frost Leaf" to Gula to obtain the following Tuvala enhancement materials:

 Frost Leaf x10: Time-filled Black Stone Bundle x1
 Frost Leaf x15: Tuvala Ore Bundle x1
 Frost Leaf x20: Refined Magical Black Stone Bundle x1

 You'll obtain "[Season] Frost Leaf" x1 regardless of variations of the box.
 ※ All remaining "[Season] Frost Leaf" in your inventory will be deleted once the Winter Season is over. It will no longer be obtainable from the Old Moon Grand Prix reward boxes.

 Added race horse exclusive horse gear "[Race Horse] Giorgiaro Horse Gear".
 Horse gear can be enhanced up to +10 enhancement level with "Gale Black Stone."
 Giorgiaro Horse Gear provide additional benefits as shown below:

notes.title: Old Moon Grand Prix Opening
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/667cd004f1e2f7dcddfc138157ce7332e93ca723.jpg

Event 1. Old Moon Grand Prix!
Period: January 13 (after maintenance)–January 27 (before maintenance)

Is your steed ready for the race of a lifetime? The Old Moon Grand Prix is finally here!
Become the most prominent rider worthy of the golden trophy in the Grand Prix!

During the event period, the Black Spirit will give you special event quests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/838cc771cac0f692106dc69b47b3beee1a61a6db.png

This is a series of consecutive quests that must be completed in order. If you do not complete the previous quest, you cannot proceed to the next one.

These quests can be completed once per family during the entire event period.

The Grand Prix Participant Certificate required to complete the event quest can be obtained from the Old Moon Grand Prix.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/5731643a6ec70cdd3189d6656e10756444cb140e.jpg

Old Moon Grand Prix

The Old Moon Grand Prix requires you to ride your race horse through all checkpoints and cross the finish line at the end of the lap. The faster you are, the higher rank you will finish and better rewards you will receive.
You can apply for the race via ESC > Life > Old Moon Grand Prix (under the new menu) or ESC > Old Moon Grand Prix (from the old menu).
    After you enter, you need to register Horse Emblem: Giorga Brisa with NPC Miles.

- You can purchase Horse Emblem: Giorga Brisa from Stonetail Horse Ranch Stable Keeper Gula and Old Moon Grand Prix Stable Keeper Miles.

After one adventurer logs in to participate in the Old Moon Grand Prix, a 3-minute wait time will be given with an additional 3-minute wait time being added for every adventurer who joins. However, once at least 5 adventurers gather, the race will start.
    The rewards including different types of trophies, Old Moon Grand Prix Coins, and Grand Prix Participant Certificates you can obtain will depend on the results of every race.

- 1 Grand Prix Participant Certificate will be given for participating in an Old Moon Grand Prix race regardless of your ranking or whether you successfully complete the race or not.

- Old Moon Grand Prix rewards will be sent to your Black Spirit's Safe.

Old Moon Grand Prix will be held from 09:00 UTC–02:00 UTC (in real life time), and there will not be any Old Moon Grand Prix races held during Node War and Conquest War times.


Event 2. Item Drop Rate +50%
Period: January 13 (after maintenance)–January 27 (before maintenance)

During the event period, enjoy item drop rate +50%!
    • The boost will stack with other boost items and also be given in addition to existing hot time boosts.
    • The boost will be only for lootable items from defeating monsters.
    • The item drop rate boost will be applied to most servers including Olvia, and season servers. However, this boost will not be applied to Arsha servers.

Black Desert Online offers various ways to increase item drop rate, and item drop rate boost events like this give drop rate boost on all loot gained from defeating monsters. However, the item drop rate boost does apply to certain content and/or in cases where 2 or more adventurers can obtain loot. Please refer to the table below.

Party content that gets item drop rate boost applied. (As of January 13, 2021)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/091a6097f451d19bdc26165ee376be5023804d2d.png

Party contents that do not get item drop rate boost applied. (As of January 13, 2021)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/ebbc98279b34ae61c404cf11c00e4ad4b166f958.png

Event 3. Double Skill EXP at the Red Battlefield
Period: January 13 (after maintenance)–January 27 (before maintenance)

During the event period, enter the Red Battlefield via the ESC menu to enjoy double Skill EXP gained from your battles! 
    • Red Battlefield is a PvP content everyone above level 50 can enjoy. Battle as team Black Desert or team Red Desert without restrictions on karma or guilds.
    • Learn more about the Red Battlefield via our official wiki 
[table]
[tr][th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/0fb36caf1562f415881312acd1858fac929c4d18.png
Double Skill EXP gained in the Red Battlefield during the event period![/th][/tr]
[/table]
Differential distribution of Skill EXP will be given based on your Red Battlefield Win or loss results and the amount of skill points held.
    • Previously, if you had a certain amount of Skill points, you acquired less Skill EXP. However, this was changed so that you can obtain a fixed amount of at least a certain amount of Skill EXP in all of the skill point tiers.
    • The Skill EXP noted above will be automatically given at the end of a Red Battlefield session.


General Event Notice:

Reward items given out during events can be bound or not depending on the items and some cannot be moved or restored.
        • Please refer to the individual item descriptions for more detailed information.

Any exploit or abnormal ways of entering in-game events may result in the restriction of your account.

Event period and specs may change with future notice.

Event 2. Steel Nux Strikes
Period: January 6 (after maintenance)–January 20 (before maintenance)

Steel Nux will swarm the entire world of Black Desert Online. Interact with a Lost Nux first to spawn a Steel Nux you can face off for bountiful rewards!

Event 3. Get a [Jukebox] Snow Flower
Period: January 6 (after maintenance)–January 20 (before maintenance)

Complete special quests to get an exquisite jukebox now.
Event 4. Mysterious Knight is back
Period: January 6 (after maintenance)–January 20 (before maintenance)

Simply interact with the Mysterious Knight who will appear randomly all over to get Skill EXP +300% for 180 minutes.

Bonus. Rookie and Returning Attendance Rewards Refreshed
Period: January 6 (after maintenance)–April 7 (before maintenance)

Both Rookie and Returning attendance reward boards have been refreshed. Log-in daily as a rookie or a returning adventurer to claim cool rewards to help you get started (again)!

Click  for full details on these celebratory events!

Pearl's Blessing: Get Bonus Rewards Back! - January Edition

Period: January 1–January 31, 2021 (23:59 UTC)
Monthly Loyalty program from before has been renamed to "Pearl's Blessing"! You can still earn bonus items depending on how many Pearls you spend during the special promotional period!
The bonus items will stack.

If you cancel a purchase of a Pearl item during the promotional period, the cost of that item will be subtracted from the total amount of the Pearls we deemed you spent during the period.

If applicable, the bonus items you claimed but are no longer qualified for may be removed from your possession (if the items were used, the equivalent Silver value may be taken from you).

Rewards will be claimable directly from the "Pearl's Blessing" button located on the top right corner of the Pearl Shop (F3) window.

Check your Inventory > Pearl tab to find your bonus rewards.

You can check the amount of Pearls you have spent so far during the promotional period by doing the following in the Pearl Shop (F3) window.

Clicking the "Pearl's Blessing" button.
Clicking the Buy button to purchase a Pearl item.

In the course that this event is extended and the promotion runs for months, the "Pearl's Blessing" information which tracks how much Pearls you have spent will reset on the first day of every month at 00:00 UTC.

Advice of Valks (+100) x1

notes.title: Level Up Nova Again!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/4fc9d44f210c7ed6e050a734a856eebd1221c645.jpg

Nova Succession and Awakening have both arrived!

Enjoy the following events to celebrate the Nova updates and the beginning of a new year!

Event 1: Level Up Again
Period: January 6 (after maintenance)–February 3 (before maintenance)

During the event period, level up a Nova character (both regular and Seasonal characters allowed) and reach the following levels to get rewards via the Challenges (Y) tab.
           • The event challenge can only be completed once per in-game family during the entire event period.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/364cdc4471513a84f60ecbe0bdbceb057889ce3c.png

Event 1 Notice

You can only participate in this event and claim rewards from the Challenges (Y) tab with a Nova character once per family during the event period.
        • If you have more than one Nova character, the Nova character that reaches the level challenges first will receive the challenge rewards.

You cannot participate in this event with a trial character.

You can participate in this event with a Nova season character.

Reward items given out during events can be bound or not depending on the items and some cannot be moved or restored.
      • Please refer to the individual item descriptions for more detailed information.

Any exploit or abnormal ways of entering in-game events may result in the restriction of your account.

Event period and specs. may change with future notice.


Event 2: Steel Nux Strikes
Period: January 6 (after maintenance)–January 20 (before maintenance)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f10d6835fca03a53a5e16c8c328b8289f7438e64.png

During the event period, Steel Nux will swarm the entire world of Black Desert Online and spawn at random times and places! Interact with a Lost Nux to spawn a Steel Nux you can face off for bountiful rewards!

First, you will get to meet a Lost Nux randomly with which you interact (R) with to call forth a Steel Nux of different levels by consuming different amounts of Energy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/a6450ae1785691c6bf4aadce37ee5f388be0d37f.png

The more Energy you consume, the stronger Steel Nux you will get to battle with, which also means you will have a chance to obtain higher-tier rewards if you successfully defeat the stronger Steel Nux you spawn.

Steel Nux will not appear in Valencia regions. Also, Steel Nux will not appear at sea or underwater regions.

Steel Nux will appear in all servers except Arsha and Olvia servers.

If you are in a Party, you cannot spawn the Steel Nux by interacting with the Lost Nux.

Only the adventurer who spawns the relevant Steel Nux will be able to defeat it.

Once you engage in combat with a Steel Nux, it will disappear 10 minutes after the combat starts. If unattacked, Steel Nux will despawn in 10 minutes.

Only one Steel Nux will appear for an Adventurer at a time, and PvP will not be allowed once you engage in battle with the Steel Nux.

You will not be able to spawn another Steel Nux even if you spend more Energy while you are in battle with a previously spawned Steel Nux.

As Steel Nux spawns in Danger Zones, you may receive death penalty for being killed by it.

Obtain random rewards from the following list upon defeating the Steel Nux:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/0e638c6a55ec1824862654b2c13481c6a6208699.png

[Event] Nux's Fragment obtained from defeating a Steel Nux can be sold at NPC shops or be used in the event quest, [Event] Echoing Hammers.
    • This quest can be completed with a character at Lv.20 or above.
    • This quest is allowed once per in-game family.
    • You can complete this event even after the event period if you have it under progress, but you cannot accept it after the event period.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/e1f85aef932fd5df3f1e733e8895b54c99b27e68.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/042aa1f8e21417b7e668c4170dc13dad45a20479.png

Event 3: Get [Jukebox] Snow Flower
Period: January 6 (after maintenance)–January 20 (before maintenance)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f6cc2dce112f857722d8a2a1bd8fb65cc3d60177.jpg

Have you heard of a jukebox with Snow Flower? Complete the special quests below to get your hands on this exquisite jukebox now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/4f8c9a71a55db08b48dcf5770268bdad7527867b.png

These quests are available once per in-game Family and must be completed in consecutive order as they are listed in the table above.

You can only accept the quests with a character at Lv.20 or above.

Event 4. The Mysterious Knight is back
Period: January 6 (after maintenance)–January 20 (before maintenance)

During the event period,  Mysterious Knight will randomly appear all over the world of Black Desert Online (in Danger Zones only). Simply Interact (R) with the NPC to get the following boost for 180 minutes!

[table][tr][td]Skill EXP +300%
[/td][/tr][/table]

If you are already under the EXP boosts from the Mysterious Knight and you interact with him again, your EXP buff timer will be reset to 180 minutes. For example, if you had 50 minutes left on your boost, the timer will be reset to 180 minutes.

Mysterious Knight will disappear 30 minutes after it spawns, regardless of whether you interact (R) with him or not.

Mysterious Knight will appear in all servers including Olvia, Arsha, and Season Servers.


[Don't Forget]
Rookie and Returning Attendance Rewards Refreshed
Period: January 6 (after maintenance)–April 7 (before maintenance)

Rookie Attendance Rewards
Are you new to Black Desert Online? Enjoy the following rewards to help you get started!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/e38d7cdf7ef9fbb0549ef38ac38a5b5e18be4b36.png

Returning Attendance Rewards
Have you returned and want to catch up? Check in daily and get the following rewards to help you settle back into the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f6739d1a175d903457574f96eb72fba775b04caf.png

Event Notice

All attendance rewards can be claimed once per family during the event period.

“Rookie” attendance rewards can be claimed by those who are logging in within 30 days (720 hours) of when they first created their account.

“Returning” attendance rewards can be claimed by those who have not logged in for at least 30 days (720 hours) and have not used the Web Central Market  for at least 30 days (720 hours) before starting to play again.

Players who do not fulfill the above requirements to claim “Rookie” or “Returning” attendance rewards, but have played for less than 1,440 hours and have not logged in for 30 consecutive days will be able to enjoy the “Returning” attendance rewards.

The possibility to claim the attendance reward of the day will be reset at 00:00 UTC every day. This means that if you have already claimed the reward for the day, you will be able to collect the next one after 00:00 UTC. There may be a 1–2 minute delay during the reset.

Every Saturday and Sunday, if you play for over one hour, you can make up for a missed attendance reward. This is only possible if you have missed an attendance reward from a previous day during the event period. If you have collected all the attendance rewards so far within the event period, then this will not happen.

Reward items given out during events can be bound or not depending on the items and some cannot be moved or restored.
        • Please refer to the individual item descriptions for more detailed information.

Any exploit or abnormal ways of entering in-game events may result in the restriction of your account.

Event period and specs. may change with future notice.
