notes.title: Nova Awakening and Succession
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/b7e46b5b814d1a8c8649822cdd227077a1b8ee95.jpg

Nova's Succession & Awakening update will be released on January 6, 2021!

Nova Awakening and Succession

"Warriors who bear the thorns, you are the living embodiment of Quturan.
As long as you live, Orzeca will be eternal."


Is there any other word that presses down on your heart like “eternity?”

Father, I have rediscovered the story about the kingdom long gone,
the story you never got to tell me.
It was in the Promised Land, abandoned by the God of Light. 
The story of High Priestess Echidna who led the abandoned children to the root of Quturan. 

"The thorn is the gift bestowed by the goddess with eternity as its condition."

Echidna’s children armed themselves with weapons created with the thorns of Quturan
and slaughtered their enemies.
Records stated that the blood they spilled became nourishment for Quturan 
and ushered in the glorious golden age of the ancient kingdom.
So I followed Echidna’s steps down into the dead root of Quturan. 

"Only good children who overcome the trial can become the queen of thorns."

As I went in deeper, the smell of blood and something burning pierced my nose.
And with the smell Echidna’s whispers in my ear. Or was it just my imagination?
Then, when I opened my eyes again, I found myself soaked in cold sweat.
I do not remember how I escaped. 
But father, I suddenly remembered the last night we saw stars together in Calpheon.

"Forgive my sins"
You said, as you handed me the golden key decorated with eagle wings. 

"Forgive me for forcing you into eternal struggle."

This was the first and last time I saw tears in your eyes.
I didn’t understand, but your words felt so distant.
Thus, I buried the key deep into my heart. 

"Do not forget who you are. You are my one and only Francesca Seric."


"Axian, the King of the Dead"

The last king of the ancient kingdom bears the bloodstained crown even after death.
He waits for the Queen of Thorns to deliver his salvation.

Father, after the day I visited the root of Quturan following Echidna’s trail,
I reread the history of the ancient kingdom every time I had a nightmare.
I awaited the promised day when I gather the abandoned followers to form an army
and reclaim the throne as I plant the young branch of Quturan. 


Delore La Sylvia.
The cold star shall rise once more over my kingdom of Calpheon.

However, my nightmare became a reality before the promised day came.
The girl I saw at the root of Quturan, whom I did not believe to be real, found me.

With the power of the goddess distorted by life and death,
I seek to reclaim what is mine.

Is she the trial of the goddess Echidna mentioned?
Or is she the fruit of the sins you confessed, father?

My name is Francesca Seric, the rightful heir to the kingdom of Calpheon

She has my face, my voice, my memories, my emotions.
She wields the Morning Star and emanates the chill of the distorted goddess.

Father, pray to the goddess for my victory.
An inevitable strife for the true heir of the throne awaits,
and only one will survive to wield the thorn of the divine tree.




Succession

Nova gained a new form of power by making a pact with Axian, the King of the Dead, with the Thorn of Quturan.

Axian is a gigantic and ghastly undead creature with wings and horns. He was summoned by sacrificing Nova’s vitality and the Thornwood Guards to bring death to the land of the living.

Axian simultaneously attacks from the skies and taints the Morning Star in black to make it recover Nova’s HP and SP at the same time.

Nova can swiftly move across the battlefield more than ever as her Thornwood Guards bring destruction to anyone who defies her.

Nova is capable of exerting vast control over a large battlefield as she dominates her enemies through her command of Axian.


Succession Skills

Nova in Succession continues to make most of her Morning Star and Quoratum to deliver heavy blows to her foes in a balanced combat style.

Her growth in strength can be especially seen in enhanced movement skills along with more diverse combos between skills.

However, the most notable development in Nova’s Succession can be seen in the summoning of her new guard "Axian”.

Axian can be summoned by sacrificing Nova’s Thornwood Guards and portions of her own HP. When commanded, Axian will accompany Nova in a joint attack just as the Thornwood Guards did.

Axian will recover Nova’s HP & SP whenever she uses a skill and it will also dive into a state of frenzy if it feels that Nova is in danger.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/15215e88c0905ff0b03120a40531e5bd9ced0ba2.png
- Prime: King of the Dead
Summon Axian, the King of the Dead, by sacrificing Nova’s HP and her Thornwood Guards.
Axian brings in the chill of death into battle at the price of Nova’s HP.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/8edbe569e7880fc720874183715628e81a474129.png
- Prime: Entangling Icy Thorns
Create a circle of icy thorns to entangle Nova’s foes.
Axian emerges from the center to attack the tied down enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/faac8df6e0ad023803b941ba2088784589a1ebe7.png
- Prime: Fianchetto
Rip out the thrown morning star from the ground. Axian attacks the enemies that have been thrown into the air.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/0f6c84e3238b75bde1ed3c855b38ebcaccae9b51.png
- Prime: Icy Prison
Nova commands pure destruction to Axian.
Axian summons the chill from the world of the undead to freeze her enemies.




Awakening

Nova acquires Sting from the duel. This weapon was created with the thorn of Quturan and empowered by the distorted goddess. She wields it freely and slaughters her enemies with it.

Sting’s wielder can switch its form between a sharp sword and formidable scythe.

Sting in its sword form is a rapier-like weapon with quick piercing attacks, while her attacks in the scythe form are ring-shaped strikes making it difficult for enemies to predict her movement.

The Awakened Nova also acquires a special resource called "Star's Breath" when she successfully hits her enemies during combat. Once she has amassed the full extent of these resources, her skills are enhanced, allowing her to unleash faster and more powerful forms of her skills.

Be careful to not get mesmerized by the grand Queen of Thorns.


Awakening Skills

Awakened Nova switches gears to Sting, the thorn of Quturan that wraps around her arm and becomes her weapon.

Sting’s standard form is like a rapier, so many of her awakening skills revolve around Royal Fencing.

Additionally, Sting can transform into a formidable scythe, which enables her to hit a large area.

Awakened Nova’s major trait is "En Garde” and the incredible boost of speed it gives her.

She is able to stack “Star’s Breath” with every skill she uses. This resource can be used to enable “En Garde” to give her explosive speed.

When she enters “En Garde,” all her awakening skills are enhanced.

More importantly, she becomes extremely quick and pours out flashy attacks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/fc74a750fe8ca5f5687f63d505544fe1cd40ce7d.png
Royal Fencing: Remise
Quick and accurate thrusts of Sting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/d10700b0611bb76137c18b154288d2e98c0fa3b5.png
Comet
Point Sting forward and dash in the direction to strike the enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/d580d99ca911c40edb38cc93414dabdc0483d650.png
Starfall
Create countless blades of light then shoot them forward to deal astronomical damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/1e8ecd60bf1b55f6b05684d7d4cade97811deba1.png
Star's Ring
Summons a star by swinging the scythe around 3 times then throwing it.
Enemies near the star will not be able to move due to its gravity.

Nova Awakening & Succession Combat Video

[previewyoutube=Q67PjXcNovw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Winter Season is Here
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/6c61ec055a79cf94bf495cb0dd3ba46d004b06e1.jpg

Winter Season, the third addition of season servers has arrived. Take a look at what's in store below!

You can also find this guide 

[How Do You Create a Season Character?]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f6c963143f62c4230dc1439f2a2d142950591f68.png

As with previous season servers, go to the Create Character window, choose your character, and select Season Character to create a season character.

You must first have enough character creation slots of course, and you can create only one season character per Family. If you want to create another season character, you must delete the one you had previously created.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/2d3426a12b603852073959ef5b73a0e1608b7079.png
[Season Server Benefits]

EXP BOOSTS WITHOUT LEVEL RESTRICTION

Unlike the regular servers, the season servers provide special buffs that will allow your season characters to level up more quickly.

Only season characters can enter the season servers. However, season characters can enter both regular and season servers. Starting from the same point as all other players, you will feel the excitement that a new seasonal content brings you once more.
Also, although the season server provides a Combat EXP increase buff as Olvia server does, this buff does not have any maximum level restrictions on the season server, allowing you to level up your season character incredibly fast.

After the December 22nd (Tues.) regular maintenance, there will be five season servers added just like during previous seasons.

Enjoy 4 Season servers for all adventurers!

Enjoy the regular season servers and get tips from the other adventures who may have experienced season servers before.


Enjoy an exclusive season server for PvP-lovers!

The PvP exclusive season server will offer you higher item drop rates! It's high risk, high return!


LEVELING AID BOXES

If you reach Lv. 10 with your season character, you will get a Leveling Aid Box as a Black Desert Season Pass challenge completion reward.
You receive more items from Leveling Aid Boxes as you level up your character.
Leveling Aid Boxes can be used up to Lv. 61.
Using a Leveling Aid Box will instantly grant you a Combat EXP +100% buff for 24 hours to help boost your character’s growth.
Other enhancement aid items and inventory slot expansion coupons are offered as well.

That's not all, Winter Season will offer boosted rewards for reaching level 60 and 61!

GET SKILL EXP THROUGH MAIN QUESTS

You can obtain the "[Season] Secret Book of the Misty Breeze'' from  Fughar whenever you complete main quests for Balenos, Serendia, Calpheon, Mediah, Valencia, Grána, and Duvencrune.

Use the [Season] Secret Book of the Misty Breeze to get plenty of Skill EXP and grow your character by learning more powerful skills.



GET ENHANCEMENT GEAR FOR ADVICE OF VALKS

You can accept season exclusive quests from Fughar, one per Family.
Excluding accessories, if you equip 7 TRI (III) Tuvala gears, you will receive 7 Advice of Valks (+40), and if you equip 7 TET (IV) Tuvala gears, you will receive 7 Advice of Valks (+60).

WINTER SEASON PASS

Black Desert Season Pass challenge completion reward rewards (and Black Spirit Pass rewards in addition for those who have the pass) will also be available during the new Winter Season. Compared to the previous season, 10 more challenges were added for the Winter Season!

One of the new rewards offered this time around is the Old Moon Costume Box!
If you complete one of the challenges offered in the season pass, you can get one of the three new boxes: Old Moon Costume Box (Viper), Old Moon Costume Box (Swiftness),  or Old Moon Costume Box (Valor).

Not only will these boxes contain a costume suitable for the class you open it with, but you can also heat the costumes to extract Ancient Spirit's Crystal - Viper, Ancient Spirit's Crystal - Swiftness, or Ancient Spirit's Crystal - Valor!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/7c837cb2719ecf67db8da56c99678de6ff84eb35.png

In addition, the [Season] Coco Leaf from the Autumn Season is no longer available. Instead for the Winter Season you will be able to get [Season] Morning Frostflowers!

Collect [Season] Morning Frostflowers by completing season pass challenges and from Leveling Aid Boxes to exchange for various items.

You will be able to exchange [Season] Morning Frostflowers for big rewards like Manos accessoires, a Tier-8 horse, and so much more! Winter Season, here we come!

See details of the Black Desert Season Pass for the Winter Season below:

Complete the challenges listed on the Black Desert Season Pass available for Season Characters to receive many rewards. If you have a Black Spirit Pass in possession, you can get additional rewards for completing the same challenges.

For details about each item, please refer to the item descriptions in game.
Try asking questions in chat group “Lunar Halo Inn” by going to (New) Menu (ESC) > Community > Chat Group and get answers from other adventurers!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/2d3426a12b603852073959ef5b73a0e1608b7079.png
Old Moon Costume Coupon

Old Moon Costume Coupon, the new addition to the Winter Season can be used to exchange with the Black Spirit to get an Old Moon Costume Box (Valor), or Old Moon Costume Box (Viper), or an Old Moon Costume Box (Swiftness). 
Note you can heat the costumes obtained to get Ancient Spirit's Crystals as well.

• Open Old Moon Costume Box (Valor) to get a costume suitable for your class:

Male Classes = Delphe Knight Armor (Costume)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/43c199ea68578509ba0b54df75eb75592e7aa891.png

Female Classes = Ahon Kirus Armor (Costume)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/7bc45dbae9ede2292e25bd0d9d48571533e30996.png

Shai = Florin Herb Gatherer Clothes (Costume)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/a2a45aaae752a594eec4f219bbd93ff2741283b5.png

Open Old Moon Costume Box (Viper) to get a costume suitable for your class:

Male Classes = Jordine's Casual Wear (Costume)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/c402ae576ab5ff62505ed94f7ed52183efd1309a.png

Female Classes = Jarette's Armor (Costume)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/bb08c5e97524344bb2949680008f973f44ff6d5c.png

Shai = Drieghanese Winter Clothes (Costume)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/82d30732fd9c4eeea5c332afac57da9bb94c157d.png

Open Old Moon Costume Box (Swiftness) to get a costume suitable for your class:

Male Classes = Serendia Formal Suit (Costume)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/92f9830e667313aa8b9062165c1f5dabbb16fd6d.png

Female Classes = Terrmian Casual Wear (Costume)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/6abb5de1b33e1e1c816154fc6ad65ef18cdae916.png

Shai = Kanna's Naga Disguise (Costume)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/29f0564de8b9e377095feb4f4b9a40ef30722c8a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/2d3426a12b603852073959ef5b73a0e1608b7079.png
SEASON CHARACTER GEAR - TUVALA AND NARU

As with the previous seasons, Season Characters will need to use season-exclusive Tuvala gear.

The Naru gear first introduced in the Autumn season was slightly weaker than Tuvala gear, but they can be obtained during your adventures from Balenos to Mediah.
Naru gear can also be enhanced with Beginner Black Stones and allow you to reach higher enhancement levels more easily compared to enhancing Tuvala gear.

How far did you get with enhancing Naru gear last time? If you want to aim higher this season, run over to  Fughar now!

Show Fughar a Naru gear enhanced up to PEN (V) level and he will upgrade it to a Tuvala gear of PRI (I) level (of the same gear part) for you!

Don't forget Naru gear and Beginner Black Stones can be obtained in regular servers as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/2d3426a12b603852073959ef5b73a0e1608b7079.png
WINTER SEASON GRADUATION

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/388565a0b61f30974f794dddc16a9643f845938c.jpg

How to Convert Tuvala Gear

When you graduate, you can obtain a total of 13 Tuvala Conversion Stones which matches a full set of gear that allows you to convert the season-exclusive Tuvala gear to normal gear.
Keep in mind that using the Tuvala Conversion Stone will result in items that can no longer be enhanced.
Beware! Each Conversion Stone can only convert one Tuvala item. That’s why you need to be careful when choosing which Tuvala gear to convert for each gear slot! You don’t want to regret accidently converting a TET (IV) Tuvala Helmet instead of a PEN (V) one...
The converted Tuvala gear will retain their “Item Branding”, “PEN (V) Creator Name”, and “Transfused Crystals”.

Lastly, the converted Tuvala gear will be changed to Family bound and can be moved to and equipped by regular characters.

Boss Gear Exchange

You can use the [Season] Boss Gear Exchange Coupon you acquire during graduation on a converted Tuvala gear to exchange it for a Boss gear. However, you cannot use Tuvala gear which has a crystal inserted via transfusion for Boss gear exchange.
Only one [Season] Boss Gear Exchange Coupon is given per Family and since you can convert only one of your Tuvala gear parts into a Boss gear, be careful before making the selection!
Tuvala gear used for [Season] Boss Gear Exchange Coupon must be between PRI (I) and PEN (V).

Here are the boss gear that can be exchanged from a Tuvala gear using the [Season] Boss Gear Exchange Coupon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/99a785e20568e740fab69327a6dd3b71a21272fc.png

When you exchange a Tuvala gear for a Boss gear, it decreases the enhancement level by one.
Please refer to the table below for details.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/fd88ec6589ccae085ef5d2ac9d2c4ed0389e34c5.png

Boss gear received via [Season] Boss Gear Exchange Coupon will become Family bound and cannot be registered on the Central Market, but are available for enhancement and Caphras enhancement.

Graduation Gifts

The Gift Box Full of Memories containing many beneficial items and conversion items for graduation will be offered once again for the Winter Season.
For Summer Season, PEN (V) Capotia accessories were offered and for Autumn Season, the Perilla's Star.
For winter season, the PEN (V): Capotia Belt as Winter Season's special reward. The special reward can be exchanged for "Season Special Gift Exchange Coupon," which can be used after graduating the Winter Season.

Don't forget to check out season character exclusive events going on right now via our official announcements!

notes.title: Nova Launch Events
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/4a03d345e2876f86b89badae33b2686dc523ff5a.jpg

Celebrate global launch across all regions and platforms with the following events!

Event 1. Attend for Nova
Period: December 23, 2020 (00:00 UTC)–January 20, 2021 (23:59 UTC)

Special attendance rewards have been prepared to celebrate the global launch of Nova. Log in daily to claim your rewards that will earn you hundreds of Cron Stones, a bunch of Advice of Valks items, an [Event] Shakatu's Mystery Box, a Contract: [Storage Maid] Fairy Irene, and so much more!

Check the Attendance tab via the ESC menu to see what rewards you'll get.

Your attendance rewards will be sent to your Black Spirit's Safe.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/4c2227669aac5b9b2afff0d26b818bd98c510b87.png

Event 1 Notice

Attendance rewards can be claimed once per family during the event period.

The optionpossibility to claim the attendance reward of the day will be reset at 00:00 UTC every day. This means that if you have already claimed the reward for the day, you will be able to collect the next one after 00:00 UTC. There may be a 1–2 minute delay during the reset.

Every Saturday and Sunday, if you play for over one hour you can make up for a missed attendance reward. This is only possible if you have missed an attendance reward from a previous day during the event period. If you have collected all the attendance rewards so far within the event period, no additional rewards will be given.

Reward items given out during events can be bound or not depending on the items and some cannot be moved or restored.
• Please refer to the individual item descriptions for more detailed information.

Any exploit or abnormal ways of entering in-game events may result in the restriction of your account.

Event period and specs. may change with future notice.


Event 2. Level Up Your Characters!

During the event period, enjoy two different level-up challenges! For all adventurers, simply level up your Nova to get rewards. For new and returning adventurers, level up a character of any class to claim rewards via the Challenges (Y) tab!

[For All Newly-created Nova Characters]
Period: December 22, 2020 (after maintenance)–January 20, 2021 (before maintenance)

This level-up challenge, available once per family, can be completed by only a Nova character on either regular or season servers..

[For All New and Returning Adventurers]
Period: December 22, 2020 (after maintenance)–January 20, 2021 (before maintenance)

This level-up challenge for new and/or returning adventurers, available once per family, can be completed by any character on both regular and season servers.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/6c43220fed9c7c48a1a73342fde9cad8724e1a12.png

[For Season Characters]
Period: December 22, 2020 (after maintenance)–February 3, 2021 (before maintenance)

This level-up challenge for season characters, available once per family, can be completed by only a season character on season servers. 
• You can complete the season character level-up challenge only with a season character, but you can claim the challenge completion rewards via the Challenges tab with a regular character as well.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/b969a27a8c661a9e51592f120e83fdc3f4ede817.png

Tip!

As a regular adventurer, why don't you try leveling up a Nova character on Season Servers to claim both Nova and Season Character level-up challenge rewards altogether?

As a new or returning adventurer, why don't you try leveling up a Nova character on Season Servers to claim all of the level-up challenge rewards listed above?


Event 2 Notice

*You can exchange [Event] Golden Seal of Panto for Morco of the Crow Merchants Guild who can be found in Velia, Heidel, Calpheon City, Altinova, Valencia City, Grána, and Duvencrune during the event period.

For Nova level-up challenges, you can only participate in this event and claim rewards from the Challenges (Y) tab with a Nova character once per family during the event period.
• If you have more than one Nova character, the Nova character that reaches the level challenges first will receive the challenge rewards.
• If you reach level 56 with your Nova, you will be able to claim all of the rewards listed above.
    
For new and returning adventurers' level-up challenges, you must be either a new or returning state to be able to participate.
• New adventurers who are logging in within 30 days (720 hours) of having first created their Family Name are eligible for and can claim the New Adventurer Rewards.
  - If you do not see your rewards to claim for having reached the designated levels, please move out to the Character Selection window, then log back into your game to see the refreshed Challenges tab (Y).
• Returning adventurers who have not logged in for at least 30 days (720 hours) and have not used the Web Central Market for at least 30 days (720 hours) can claim the Returning Adventurer Rewards.

notes.title: New Class Update - Nova
notes.content:
Black Desert Online's newest class, Nova, is here. Play as the last remaining heir of Calpheon who wields a morning star and shield into battle.

For a limited time only, you can purchase an exclusive item pack that contains a special, Nova-themed Horse Gear Set.

Nova's shield covers her body like an iron fortress, and she can flatten even distant enemies by extending the chain of her heavy morning star. Nova's shield is also possessed by the spirit guards who follow her every word. She commands them to attack while remaining fortified behind her giant shield, where she effortlessly combines offensive and defensive tactics to overwhelm her enemies.

The chance to fish up a Mystical Fish is extremely low, but if you can catch a bunch of them, it is said that you will bring about a big change to the world of Black Desert.

notes.title: Transfer of Service
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

Since its launch in March 2016, it’s been our privilege to share your adventures in Black Desert Online but it is now time for Kakao Games’ part in this to come to an end. As of February 24th  2021 Kakao Games will cease service and it will become the responsibility of the developers, Pearl Abyss. 

Many great memories have been forged over the last five years and we have the utmost confidence that many more will be created as the service continues under their management. The finer details of the handover are still being established so we will be sure to keep you informed on the process as the final date draws closer. We can already inform you that in order to comply with data protection practices there will be an opt-in process to have your game data transferred that will begin on January the 27th 2021. Exact details will be announced soon, but this will be mandatory if you wish to continue playing the game.

Be assured that we are fully committed to a smooth transition with as little disruption to you as possible, and your enjoyment and progress in the game will be unaffected. For now, nothing will change immediately, the game will be updated and as new content gets added we will continue striving to make your experience in Black Desert Online the best it can be.

You can find an FAQ on our support pages which we will keep updated as and when new information becomes available. We will also make sure you are informed through all of our usual channels, so please keep an eye out for news.

It’s been an amazing journey and one that we are extremely proud to have been a part of over the last five years but now we look forward to the next chapter in Black Desert Online and sharing our own journey with you in future Kakao Games titles.

- Kakao Games BDO Team

notes.title: The Last Star of the Kingdom of Calpheon "Nova"
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/61b79b4d93afd4a2b7d1e6aca30c2937182b6b02.jpg

Pre-Creation December 16th

Class Update December 22nd

Check out the Pre-launch Events 

[previewyoutube=TsZJR1QGduI;full][/previewyoutube]

“The Quturan only allows good children to enter the promised land of O’dyllita.”

Father, I’ve heard your lullabies from the days of a kingdom long gone
from within the sandstorms that tore you away from me:
the tale of one Thornwood Tree that took in poor children,
those born in the distant Arid Lands abandoned by the God of Light.

"Every year, on the day of the brightest moon, the children would pray
seven times each day to Quturan, the only door set for O’dyllita.
In times of war, they would head to the frontlines, the morning star and shield in hand."

And when the burning sands swallowed you up without leaving a trace,
I saw that Thornwood Tree of legend comfort those children,
whose sleeves were wet with tears, then swallow them whole.

Upon returning to scenes of your death, you who were the entire world to me,
why, oh why, did I see images of your kingdom?

“The demon who buried her own father in the desert”
 “A monster with the blood of a horrid witch”

The night I realized that such loyalty and pity were all for naught,
I dreamed of your words, that no throne remains untainted by blood.
There I witnessed a lone woman, seated with the crown of Quturan, the Thornwood tree.
I wasn’t sure if that woman, seemingly wrapped in the icy cold winds of winter, was me.

And yet...

“Every year, on the day of the brightest moon, the children would pray
seven times to Quturan, the only door set for O’dyllita.
Hearing that they received the blessing of the goddess who was cast aside
from the promised land like themselves, they came to shed a tear no more.”

Father, I heard the laughter of children abandoned by a kingdom long gone,
while cleaning this basement filled with your memories.
With the heart of the child who sought to enter Quturan’s roots,
filled with the joy of how the world had rid any trace of me,
I left the embrace of Elion, He who could not protect you, and came to this promised land.

 “Kamashalah Delore La Sylvia.
The cold star shall arise once more
over my kingdom of Calpheon.”

Now, with the power of the goddess distorted by life and death,
I seek to reclaim with blood what is rightfully mine,
for my name is Francesca Seric, the true heir to Calpheon’s throne.

I am the last eagle, reigning over the skies,
bearing the thorn of the tree that brought the earth to its knees,
and this once hopeless world shall not cast me aside anymore.

notes.title: Patch Notes - December 2nd 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/ba9bbaf48f98ec29ecde325d8eaeb236d1f16bba.png

Greetings Adventurers, 

December is here and brings some winter scenery to the world of Black Desert Online. Enjoy the snowfall during the entire day and beautiful auroras during nighttime!

We will also add a new Family Inventory system and an option to transport your mounts. We hope this will help you in your adventures!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f620b57fc70b8044ec3c338c6a3b04a58648fc63.png

New Events

Winter is Here!

Period: December 2 (after maintenance)–December 30 (before maintenance)
During the event period, enjoy heavy snowfall during the entire day and beautiful auroras at night!

Heavy snowfall and magical auroras have come to Black Desert. We wish you a happy, albeit cold, winter season in Black Desert.

Who will Win? KR vs TW

Have you noticed the global siege rounds happening in other serviced regions of Black Desert Online? This time, Korea will face off against the Taiwan (Taiwan & Hong Kong & Macao) team in a world conquest war. Though this global conquest war isn't for our region, we wanted to give the chance for NA and EU adventurers to take part by rooting for and guessing who may win!
During the 2 siege round periods, simply claim an [Event] Nutritious Bibimbap if you think the KR team will win, or claim [Event] Sweet Milk Tea if you think TW team will win offered in the Challenges tab (Y).

Pick the winner for 1st round: December 3, 00:00 UTC–December 6, 09:00 UTC

1st reward distribution (to mailbox (B)) on December 9 regular maintenance.

Pick the winner for 2nd round: December 7, 00:00 UTC–December 12, 09:00 UTC

2nd reward distribution (to mailbox (B)) on December 16 regular maintenance.


You may use the [Event] Nutritious Bibimbap or [Event] Sweet Milk Tea claimed in your Inventory to get the energy recovery effect. Even if you had used the item, your vote will still be eligible to receive the reward.
If you guessed correctly and claimed the item that belongs to the winning team, you will receive:

Advice of Valks (35–45) x1
[Event] Enhancement Help Kit II x1

If you didn't guess correctly and claimed the item that belongs to the losing team, you will still receive:

Advice of Valks (25–35) x1
[Event] Enhancement Help Kit I x1

If you'd like to tune in to the world conquest war (KR vs TW), the schedule is:

1st round: December 6, 2020 (Starts 13:00 CET/04:00 PST)
2nd round: December 12, 2020 (Starts 13:00 CET/04:00 PST)
You can watch the KR stream (unavailable in English) .


Ongoing Events

Happy Thanksgiving!

Event 2. Go Fishing: November 25–December 9 (before maintenance)
Event 3. Arcana Log-in Challenge: November 25–December 31 (23:59 UTC)


Ended Events

Happy Thanksgiving!

Event 1. Weekend Season Server Coupons!

Basilisk Subjugation

Those who have the quest [Event][Weekly] Gorgo's Nightmare (Hard) accepted already will be able to complete this quest by defeating Basilisk Guardian and receive Gorgo's Nightmare Fragment as loot until December 9 (before maintenance).

Bonus! Attention All Season Characters
Targargo and Targarga
November Enhancement Aid

Challenge 2. [Event] Morden Secret Trade Voucher I II, lll will end December 1 (23:59 UTC) as scheduled.
However, you can still claim [Event] Morden Secret Trade Voucher I, [Event] Morden Secret Trade Voucher II, and [Event] Morden Secret Trade Voucher III items from the Challenges tab (Y) until December 16 (before maintenance).
NPC Tawner Morden with whom you hand over the blue-grade accessories will also stay until December 16 (before maintenance).
After today's maintenance, in-game tooltip of the voucher items will also be changed to state that you can complete the quest as long as you have a voucher, and only during the event period up to Dec. 16 (before maintenance).
Please make sure to exchange all of your voucher items with Tawner Morden until December 16 (before maintenance) as no more exchanges will be allowed from then on even if the voucher items will not be deleted. 


Reward Distribution

Thanksgiving Mail! 

'Stay Secure and Earn a Reward' rewards were sent out via in-game mailbox.
Please claim these rewards sent out today before January 20, 2021 regular maintenance or they will disappear.
Please note this event runs until December 31, 2020 and you can check the full announcement .


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/cb72bbc1e18f4dc42388f5269c57315d4d2ad546.png

Family Inventory

Shakatu, the Valencian Mogul, discovered a special ancient artifact at Cantusa Desert and has called upon adventurers to visit Shakatu's Territory. After witnessing the ancient artifact, adventurers have dubbed it the "Family Inventory."

What is a Family Inventory?
Family Inventory is a convenient bag that all characters in the same family have access to. However, only consumable items listed below can be placed in this inventory.

1) Scrolls
2) Food
3) Elixirs
4) Pet Feed
5) Worker Stamina Recovery Food

The Family Inventory can be obtained through quests or through the Pearl Shop by purchasing the Family Inventory Slot Coupon with Pearls or Loyalties, which creates a "Family Inventory" category within the Inventory upon use.
Starting weight of Family Inventory is 100LT. The Family Inventory can be expanded up to 28 slots.
Please note that the below items cannot be moved to the Family Inventory.

1) Items bound to characters
2) Oasis exclusive items
3) Items purchased from the Guild Shop
4) Content-specific items (such as Guild, Red Battlefield, Savage Rift items)
5) Certain event items

Items that do not have “Can be placed in The Family Inventory” in their item description cannot be placed in The Family Inventory. Check out the item's tooltip for more details.
Added quest to obtain the Family Inventory.

Accept Black Spirit Suggested Quest [Shakatu's Gift] Invitation (Lv. 60 and above) to receive a Family Inventory +2 Expansion Coupon.
The quest can be viewed in both Quest List (O) - Recommended tab and [Lv. 60] Bag of the Stars in the New Quest tab. Quests related to Shakatu’s hidden gifts will not be shown separately.
This quest is only available once per family.

You can check the official WIKI page on Family Inventory .


Over the past few years, we've had many voices from all over the world requesting a Family-shared inventory space. We thought having the Maid/Butler system and the addition of the Central Market would satisfy this need, but the requests were still frequent. So we decided to finally add the Family Inventory. However, only certain types of items can be placed in the Family Inventory. You can obtain the Family Inventory via a quest, which will start you off with 2 slots and 100LT. Slot expansion coupons can be purchased with Pearls and Loyalties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/7b90c7e4b1c598e2b0195d1edfe7b3b95a6e33b8.png

End of Autumn Season

All remaining Autumn Season characters who've yet to convert will be converted to regular characters.

All unaccepted nor incomplete "Season-related quests" will be deleted.
Adventurers who have yet to complete the quest “[Season Server Graduation] Into the Big Wide World” will receive the following items in their Mailbox (B) - Gift Box Full of Memories, Fughar's Letter of Encouragement, [Season] Tuvala Conversion Stone Box.

Gift Box Full of Memories, Fughar's Letter of Encouragement can be claimed without an expiration date from your mailbox.
[Season] Tuvala Conversion Stone Box must be claimed from your mailbox and used before December 9 regular maintenance.

You may use the Tuvala Conversion Stone for each corresponding piece of gear until December 9, 2020 (Wed) before maintenance. After December 9 regular maintenance, all Tuvala gear will be automatically converted.

All adventurers who have graduated from the season may still complete the quest "[Perilla's Star] Fughar's Woe" by talking to the Black Spirit (,).
Perilla's Star is a special alchemy stone obtainable by season characters who were created during the Autumn Season.
"[Season] Boss Gear Exchange Coupon" obtained after graduation can now be used after the end of the Season Server.
Graduated characters can now progress and receive special rewards for "Fughar's Secret to Success" whenever they want.
Black Spirit Pass and Season Pass objectives have all been deleted. Any unclaimed rewards from the pass are gone.
After Maintenance on Dec 9, 2020 (Wed.), all Season-related items are scheduled to be automatically converted or deleted: Tuvala Enhancement Material, Tuvala Conversion Stone, Unconverted Tuvala gear, and other Season-related items.

Changed the conditions and time period for retrieving the rewards when reaching levels 60 and 61 with a season character.

Before: Can be retrieved by a Season character before December 2, 2020 maintenance
Now: Can be retrieved by a normal character before December 9, 2020 maintenance
※ Only Season characters that have reached Lv. 60, 61 before December 2 maintenance are eligible for retrieving rewards by December 9.

From today's maintenance as Autumn season has concluded, these Season Servers will convert back to the following servers:

NA/EU_Season1 → NA/EU_Kamasylvia1
NA/EU_Season2 → NA/EU_Kamasylvia2
NA/EU_Season3 → NA/EU_Kamasylvia3

Game World

You can transport mounts held in another Wharf/Stable to the current Wharf/Stable. Guild mounts are excluded from this function.
Transporting a mount costs 1 million Silver and will take 10 minutes to complete.
Transporting mounts with trade or barter goods in their inventory have a certain chance to lose all those items, so please take note.
Large ships cannot be transported to areas they cannot traverse to (i.e. rivers).

To bring a mount in a different region, you would previously have to log onto a different character located close to where that mount was stabled to send them to your current character. We've created this function to address the inconvenience of the existing method of transporting mounts.

After the introduction of the Naval Fame system, many adventurers found themselves unable to retrieve their ships from certain wharfs due to the drop in their Naval Fame. Now, with this function, adventurers with "Pirate" Naval Fame can still transport their mounts stored in other locations to the Kuit Islands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/6d4ab290b209aa7d91cc6667f0e3de0eb51c0fac.png

[*The chance of obtaining Mass of Pure Magic at the Crypt of Resting Thoughts node is now the same as that of obtaining it at the Star's End node.

Guild Boss Ferrid has absorbed the heat of the hottest lava in Omar Lava Cave and become even more ferocious and powerful.

Ferrid's attacks, which contain the full might of its power, shake the cave and stimulate the unstable lava, causing a destructive explosion.
When this overflowed lava creates a swamp, Ferrid's attacks will cause explosions and continuously produce Ferrid Talis.
Ferrid Tali is very dangerous as it approaches its nearby adventurers and spits out its lava.
There's a low chance  Ferrid Tuny will appear in the Lava Swamp.
When  Ferrid Tuny reaches Ferrid, it will pass on its energy of lava to the Ferrid, making the latter more powerful.
When the Grapple or the CC status effect is applied to  Ferrid Tuny, it will immediately vanish, but if it's near Ferrid at this point, it will still be able to pass on its lava energy of lava to the Ferrid.

notes.title: Patch notes - 18th November 2020 (Part 1)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/55e280f1e5b754be84ee4bf5c2211bd611d5beb0.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

This week, you can finally graduate from Season server if you haven't already and take advantage of Fughar's Success Secrets!

We also bring the new Arcana system to the Black Spirit's Adventure and a brand new Tag system with Marni's Suspicious Device.

Finally, we are adding Core Skills and a third Enhanced Skill to help you in your battles!

Read on for more information!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f620b57fc70b8044ec3c338c6a3b04a58648fc63.png

New Events

Basilisk Subjugation

Period: November 18 (after maintenance)–November 25 (before maintenance)

Ongoing Events

Reward Distribution

November Enhancement Aid

The following has been sent via in-game mailbox for those who could not complete or proceed with the event quests of this event from November 11 00:00 UTC to November 11 (before maintenance) 
Please make sure to claim them before December 1, 23:59 UTC or they will disappear.

[Event] Morden Secret Trade Voucher I x3 
[Event] Morden Secret Trade Voucher II x1
[Event] Morden Secret Trade Voucher III x1


Compensation of Kalqueesh non-loot issue

Additional reward of Kalqueesh Spoils Bundle will be sent via in-game mailbox to adventurers who were affected by the issue but did not receive the compensation on last week's maintenance. Please see the whole announcement .



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/cb72bbc1e18f4dc42388f5269c57315d4d2ad546.png

Marni's Suspicious Device / Tag Character

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/651a867fcd6a80f8b3b2cd44d123470f9aed9015.jpg

A rather interesting tale is spreading from the black market of Mediah, which opens once every 15 days. According to rumor, a great adventurer has discovered Marni's Suspicious Device from the Arsha Sea. If you burn Marni's Unstable Fuel in it, the items you shall obtain will help you become quite the outlaw. To share this power to activate Marni's Suspicious Device, the great adventurer has spread fragments of clues all over.

Added a new function to Tag Character. Now you can share equipment between Tagged Characters via "Marni's Suspicious Device." In other words, two characters will be able to share a set of gear together.

How to use Marni's Suspicious Device

Complete the questline "[Marni's Suspicious Device] A Splendid Deal" with a character Lv. 56 or higher.
Once you've completed the questline, the "Item Copy" function will become available.
Tag the main character with the desired gear equipped to a different character in the Character's Tag Setting menu.
Once tagging is complete, you will see how much "Marni's Unstable Fuel" will be required to copy the gear to the selected character.
You can purchase "Marni's Unstable Fuel" from Old Moon Managers located in major cities.
Once you have all the required materials, use Item Copy to copy your gear from the main character to the tagged character.
Login to your tagged character, where you'll be able to equip and use the copied gear.

Detailed Information:

All 4 pieces of armor, 3 weapons, 6 accessories, 1 tool, and 1 spirit stone equipped by the main character will be copied into the tagged character's inventory.
To use Item Copy, you will need "Marni's Unstable Fuel" that is sold by Old Moon Managers for silver (10 million each).
Copied items will remain bound to both the main character and the tagged character. However, once a character is untagged, all copied items will disappear. You may tag a different character to the main character and use Item Copy then as well, and you will need additional Marni's Unstable Fuel to do so.
The cost for Item Copy will be converted into the amount of "Marni's Unstable Fuel" required.

Item Copy cost formula = (All 3 Weapons) Central Market Price x 3% + (All 3 Weapons) Number of Caphras Stones used for Caphras Enhancement x 43,000 Silver
The minimum cost to use Item Copy is "Marni's Unstable Fuel" x20.

Enhanced gear that can no longer be registered onto the marketplace will use the price of the gear before enhancement.
Item Copy will require all gear equipped on the main character to have max durability recovered, and the selected tagged character will require 14 free slots of inventory space.
The enhancement level, branding, socketed crystals, and Caphras Stone EXP will be copied exactly for Item Copy.
You may destroy socketed crystals in copied gear, yet you cannot extract the crystals themselves for reuse. You may transfuse new crystals onto copied gear with empty sockets.
 You may not use such functions as enhance, upgrade, Caphras enhancement, and devour on copied gear.
You may not use copied gear as materials for the Adventure Log or the Fallen God's Armor.
If the enhancement level and/or Caphras enhancement level of the main character's gear changes, the tagged character's gear will change accordingly. However, changing the transfused crystals, branding, or durability of the main character's gear will not impact the tagged character's gear.
If the main character's gear is deleted, the tagged character's gear will also be deleted (for example, if you delete Bheg's Gloves on the main character, the tagged character's Bheg's Gloves will also be deleted).

By deleted, we mean the item itself was destroyed (either thrown into the trash can, or an accessory was destroyed upon failed enhancement attempt).

Both the main and tagged gear cannot be placed in storage nor registered on the marketplace. Adventurers who especially enjoy using multiple characters and storage/maids for life skills should unequip their tool from the "tool slot" before using Item Copy.
Note that extracting Garmoth's Heart from the main Fiery sub-weapon will delete the tagged sub-weapon. This goes for ultimate gear as well. On the other hand, if the main gear was normal when tagged, then is upgraded to Fiery or Ultimate, the tagged weapon will NOT be upgraded but remain as normal.
If a tagged character with negative Karma (including those in the desert) is killed, ALL copied gear will be destroyed "regardless of location," and the protections offered by the set effects of Pearl outfits and Oasis buffs won't be applied here.



Added the Item Copy (Tag Character) function, which will allow two characters to share the same gear. Now you can tag your main character with your second-most favored character and open up a whole new bag of different gameplay options. Black Desert boasts a roster of 20 different action-packed and visually-stunning classes, each displaying its own unique style and flavor. Yet Black Desert has long been a game that brings out the MMORPG aspect of fully focusing on one main character, and yet, especially considering its diverse roster, this has been a side that we've thought long and hard about improving. One solution was the now difficult-to-obtain, and still most-requested globally, Weapon Exchange Coupon. And "Marni's Suspicious Device" is content that we hope will address this concern from the forefront. We developed this content to allow for a more convenient means of playing new classes, and we hope many of our adventurers are inspired to put this content to use. 

In addition, once it appeared on the Global Labs, it was one of the most requested, but we focused on honing the edges before finally deciding to release it today. However, please understand that we've applied some tight restrictions such as not allowing copied gear to be registered on the marketplace, nor placed in storage, in order to prevent any abuse of this feature.

The following gear cannot be copied.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/acde7c6a4627f986b6abcda23b7aac5989dfebdc.png

Fughar's Secrets to Success

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/dcddf718819f92e1eff6f987629e46484688c3a6.png

Rumors abound of Fughar circulating a book containing his secrets to success to help fresh graduates of the Autumn Season Server adjust to normal servers.

Go to Fughar with a character that has graduated from the Autumn Season and has converted to a normal server character to accept the quest "[Grad. Support] Fughar's Secrets to Success." Completing this quest will grant you access to Fughar's book filled with his secrets.
You may complete this questline once per family.
Use Fughar's book of secrets to automatically accept the quest. Completing the quest will allow you to accept the following books.
If you accidentally lose a book, talk to Fughar to obtain another one.

Adventurers who complete all of Fughar's Secrets to Success up to the final chapter will be rewarded the surprise gifts of "[Season] Boss Gear Exchange Coupon" and "Fughar's Crow Skill Book," the latter being the very "book which contains Fughar's secrets."
Characters who have graduated from the Autumn Season can proceed with the quest "[Grad. Support] Fughar's Secrets to Success" up until you create a new season character for the next season, and after completing the final chapter, you may obtain the special rewards whenever you wish.

Please note that you can proceed with the rest of the quest as long as you complete the first quest of the entire questline. If you create a season character for the next season, this quest will not be available. 
Start of the winter season servers is unconfirmed as of now and we will announce this date officially with a future notice.

The quests for Fughar's Secrets to Success are as follows.

Adventurers who have already completed the requirements for certain quests can interact with the Black Spirit (/) to complete Fughar's Secrets to Success.

Rumors are spreading all over Valencia that the long-forgotten nightmares of Gorgo in Valencia Canyon have begun once again. Gorgo's Nightmare is a tale found in the first chapter of , written by the ecologist Pitor. It is in regards to the snake possessed by darkness, born within the modern-day Basilisk Den. The Katan Military have found suspicious-looking crow feathers near the place where the snake of nightmares first appeared. They suspect someone may have had a hand in this.

You can purchase "Gorgo's Nightmare Summon Scroll" for a Gold Bar 10G from Tarek Yanzi at Rock Post.
Using this scroll will summon a giant Basilisk Statue along with smaller statues emitting yellow pillars of light on top of the hill.
Destroying the summoned giant Basilisk Statue will reveal the  Basilisk Guardian, which will simultaneously activate the smaller statues on top of the hill.
The  Basilisk Guardian will draw a greater power from the smaller statues, and thus will require at least two adventurers to join forces to take it down.
The adventurer who hasn't used the summon scroll may preemptively move to the top of the hill to prepare to destroy the smaller statues. Destroying the statues on the hill will greatly weaken the Basilisk Guardian, so fighting with another adventurer is crucial to taking it down.
The Basilisk Guardian will reappear for a maximum of 5 times. If there are multiple adventurers nearby, it will become empowered by a greater darkness. So, it is crucial that only one adventurer faces the Basilisk Guardian.
After destroying the giant Basilisk Statue of Gorgo's Nightmare, if there are no adventurers who take on the Basilisk Guardian, then the Basilisk Guardian will disappear back into the nightmare with the statues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/6215199b868c7fef4c36a69976ed445403f8d43b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/8ff3271245570635f6a8eb143b68743f36125d83.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/66a061f3ee4f679affebb47deb53884842f8a2c2.png


Arcana cards are chance cards used in the Black Spirit's Adventure game board.

The Arcana cards will help you on your Black Spirit's Adventure. Use them well to obtain your desired rewards or to increase the probability of completing a round.

Once your Black Spirit piece lands on the CARD square, you will randomly obtain one type of Arcana card.

You will no longer be able to accept the existing Early Graduation quest.

"Core" skills were added to Awakening of all classes. These skills further enhance the existing skills the way Absolute skills do for Main Weapon skills, but their acquisition and roles differ. First of all, you may only select and learn one out of all Core skills. Only defensive effects, such as either Debuff Resistance or block effects will be added to the Core skills, without any additional damage or increased number of hits. With today's patch, we hope that this addition of Core skills will relieve the discrepancy between Succession and Awakening's performance, which many adventurers have already pointed out to us. We appreciate and look forward to your feedback and opinions.

You can learn the third Enhanced Skill at Lv. 58.

notes.title: [Maintenance] Regular Maintenance November 18th 2020
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/hm73DDo.gif

Dear Players,

We will perform our weekly maintenance as follows:

Date: Wednesday, November 18th 2020

Duration: 4 hours.

Global 9:00 UTC ~ 13:00 UTC
Central (EU) 10:00 CET ~ 14:00 CET
West Coast (NA) 1:00 PST ~ 5:00 PST
East Coast (NA) 4:00 EST ~ 8:00 EST


Reasons:

Marni's Suspicious Device which allows two tagged characters to share one set of gear together will be available.
Normal graduation for the Autumn Season will be available and Fughar's Secrets to Success will be available to graduates of Autumn Season.
Core Skills and a third Enhanced Skill will be added.
The new Arcana system which gives you chance cards to be used in the Black Spirit's Adventure game board will be added.
Basilisk Subjugation event will start.
Log-in challenge reward will be given to the Season Character.
Loyal Attendance Rewards will be refreshed.


Ending Events:

Hoof it Up!
"Thanksgiving Event

Event 6. Sweet Candy Stick Box"



Follow us on Twitter & Facebook to stay up to date.

Thank you for your support and understanding.


Best regards,
BDO Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - November 11th 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/b36f3585bd52c62a51176ba242aaf5c81dc4a045.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

This week The Great Expedition update opens up new opportunities: Equip a brand new sea crystal and fight against Lekrashan or Goldmont Pirates battleship roaming the sea. 
We will also add new quests to obtain more Mass of Pure Magic and three new Caphras Journals.
Finally, look forward to our Thanksgiving Events!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f620b57fc70b8044ec3c338c6a3b04a58648fc63.png

New Events

Targargo and Targarga Updated November 12

Period: November 11 (after maintenance)[strike]–November 25 (before maintenance)[/strike] December 2nd (before maintenance)
King Targargo has returned to the Balenos again and this time, the king has been spotted on the Ehwaz Hill near Finto Farm along with the queen, Targarga! Challenge the king birds for abundant rewards in this thanksgiving season!
Click  to find out more about defeating the ferocious turkey bosses.



Thanksgiving Event

Event 1: Stack Up 
Period: November 12 (00:00 UTC)–November 25 (23:59 UTC)

Complete the various challenges offered below to obtain [Event] Half-left Seed Potato which you will combine to exchange for Advice of Valks items in the end.



Event 2. Holy Mole!
Period: November 11 (after maintenance)–November 25 (before maintenance)

Protect your garden from moles appearing at a chance while you harvest special seeds.



Event 3. Scared Turkey Hunt
Period: November 11 (after maintenance)–November 25 (before maintenance)

Defeat scared turkey that appear randomly while you defeat monsters for additional rewards



Event 4. Wacky Toshi Seeks Help
Period: November 11 (after maintenance)–November 24 (23:59 UTC)

Fill up Marni's Stones to hand them over to Wacky Toshi for cool rewards.



Event 5. Joy of Turkey
Period: November 11 (after maintenance)–November 25 (before maintenance)

Slaughter some turkeys and obtain their meat to give to the imperial chefs for bountiful rewards.



Event 6. Sweet Candy Stick Box
Period: November 11 (after maintenance)–November 18 (before maintenance)

Simply log-in once during this one-week event period to get [Event] Sweet Candy Stick Box that gives Skill EXP +100%!



Click  for more details on these bountiful events.



[Promotion] Play for a Free Game Pass - November edition

Period: November 11 (after maintenance)–November 25 (before maintenance)
Black Desert Online will be available for free for during this 2 week period to anyone who has had their trial period run out or made an account but didn't play the game.
In addition, for those of you who register during this time, your 7-day trial will become a 14-day trial! 
This is a chance not only to try out the game for longer, but also to get a free game pass by reaching Lv. 50.
Sign-up now and enjoy plenty of time to live the full Black Desert Online experience!
Click  for full details on how you can get your free game pass!



Refer-a-Friend is back

Period: November 11 (after maintenance)–November 25 (before maintenance)
Invite your friends and earn rewards! New players that use your Referral ID after joining Black Desert Online will get special rewards upon reaching in-game milestones.
Check out the details of the promotion 



Ongoing Events

November Enhancement Aid

Event 1. The Legendary Thief: November 4–December 2 (before maintenance)
Event 2. Moonlight Stone Challenge: November 5–December 1 (23:59 UTC)
Event 3. Morden likes Accessories: November 4–December 2 (before maintenance)

There will be an update on the event from November 11 (after maintenance). You can now collect [Event] Morden Secret Trade Vouchers and blue-grade accessories and hand them all over to Morden. Please check the details of the updated information .




Hoof it Up!: November 4–November 18 (before maintenance)


Ended Events

Halloween in Florin
Magical Elixir
O'dyllita Launch Events
O'dyllita Attendance Check
Bloodstorm Nouver confirmed spawns
Nightmarish Kzarka confirmed spawns


Reward Distribution

Kalqueesh Loot Issue Compensation

Item Drop Rate +50% Buff for 2 weeks: November 11 (after maintenance)–November 25 (before maintenance)

This item drop rate boost will stack with other drop rate boost giving items.
The item drop rate boost will be applied to most servers including Olvia, and season servers, however this will not be included in Arsha servers.




Items Given to All Adventurers

Item Collection Increase Scroll: Advanced (60 min) x5
GM’s Blessing 3 (1h) x3




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/cb72bbc1e18f4dc42388f5269c57315d4d2ad546.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/a3033cb7f766f983f78b8795aab2c24ace274a63.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/11fffd5b6fc087fad033d6acd44c1257c409059a.jpg

Lekrashan & Goldmont Battleships

The Old Moon Rescue Party has reported that Lekrashan, which used to appear in the border between Ross Sea and Margoria Sea, has moved to the border between Juur Sea and Margoria Sea.

Ninesharks and Black Rusts, attracted by Lekrashan's concentrated black energy, have formed a habitat in the border between Juur Sea and Margoria Sea.
Defeat  Nineshark and  Black Rust inhabiting the border between Juur Sea and Margoria Sea. Then Lekrashan will show itself from the depths of the ocean at a certain chance.
Lekrashan is weak to external shock since it hasn't got out of the sea for a long time and focused fire will stun it.
Up to 3 adventurers may collect loot after defeating Lekrashan.
You may obtain Junk items that can be sold for crystals or Crow Coins by defeating monsters in Lekrashan's habitat.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/6d6c4ce5c6080e092e042d59c08ba7ae9dd779c4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/db3d81b1e3bc30a66c468b9cc7bbfa1f5a9ce7bf.jpg

The Old Moon Rescue Party has reported that the Goldmont Pirate has expanded their influence to Vadabin Sea near Port Ratt and is attacking the traders of the merchants that pass through the port. Hence the Port Ratt coast guard is recruiting experienced sailors to exterminate the Goldmont Pirate.

The Goldmont Pirate will issue an alert at a certain chance when you defeat  Goldmont Pirate. Once the alert is issued, the Goldmont battleships will appear. Depending on the situation of the battle, these battleships will receive support from the nearby pirate ships.
You may obtain crafting and upgrade materials for Epheria Caravel/Epheria Galleass as loot when you defeat  Goldmont Pirate.
You will obtain more sailor EXP when you defeat  Goldmont Pirate than the amount obtained from defeating the normal Goldmont Pirate.



The Agris Fever points consumed when defeating monsters at Lekrashan's habitat or the Goldmont Pirate's areas are as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/7a0ad584a863bd1f7b5e26ceb0609d27603cedb7.png
The Naval Fame points recovered when defeating monsters at Lekrashan's habitat are as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/4084855d14f742b950bbb020c9ceeabe651ee2c1.png


It's been more than a year since we launched The Great Expedition. First off, we'd like to thank all our adventurers who continue to show their love and support for this content.
Until now, Black Desert Online's ocean content mainly consisted of seeking profit through barter while defeating monsters such as Hekaru or Pirate Ships. However, many adventurers who were expecting a wild naval battle with enormous carracks have expressed their disappointment. Hence, starting with this update, we are planning to add monster zones in which you can experience the immense power of the carracks. Here, you will feel the full power of the carracks and be rewarded for your efforts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/7a4af62f05d7acab5cd454cf10776ce194c6a6db.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f593b6a3812798df1eb954479bd400757417b7db.jpg

Sea Crystals

Added "Sea Crystals" which can be equipped to Large Ships.

Sea Crystal grades are (in ascending order): Eltro, Serni, Zulatia, and Margoria. Higher grade crystals have better stats.
If you use a Crystal, you may obtain 1 Sea Crystal of the same grade.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f358692522ac8997858631bd8d07bcca038d2f0f.png
The Crystals can be obtained by defeating monsters at Lekrashan's habitat and Goldmont battleships.
Equip a Sea Crystal to your ship to increase 1 of the 8 stats.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/cca567cd23309c8794f516790ee4251f0a080b92.png
You may obtain crystals of higher grade using the following crafting methods.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/418c5e98c8de2943e0f2c3bdcfc063878a688511.png
Perform Simple Alchemy on each sea crystal to obtain its Origin, the source of its power.
You can purchase Oquilla Emerald Fresh Water, Oquilla Aquamarine Fresh Water, Oquilla Golden Fresh Water, and Void Sea Crystal from Ravinia at Crow's Nest and Port Ratt.




Added the effects where you can use 100 Energy with Black Spirit to gain Combat EXP +20% for 60 min or Skill EXP +8% for 60 min.
The effects and durations of the Combat/Skill EXP buffs obtainable by using Energy from Black Spirit will now be displayed on the Exchange buttons.

The actual duration and effect remain the same.



Added Villa Scrolls usable at the Campsite.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/e9e98cb324a16ee9c47579f7bdf5af0aaae7b9e0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/bda60e6d6a3935d3bfea322ddb23bc465ec9619a.png
Guards have started to protect the following ports as pirates are disrupting the order in the Great Ocean by becoming more active.

Velia Wharf
Port Epheria
Ancado Inner Harbor
Arehaza Wharf
Port Grándiha
Starry Midnight Port



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/961c93377be71b6c286e8ba5590bdd5ba92aac03.png

NPC
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/dc91cd5f5e04d51ef811d672b826ce55bec07030.png

Fixed the awkward navigation path to the event NPC Tawner Morden.
According to nearby villagers, a never before seen storm rages on at Karanda's nest.

Karanda's nest grew wider due to the effects of the storm.



Fixed the issue where NPC Konion's neck was split.
Fixed the issue where the inside of NPC Nahava's body was empty.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/b9bbbb6dcf95d808bebbf50b6ab76c593d6d94d0.png

Updated November 13

The information window of large ships will now separately display the stat increases from Sailing Mastery for Speed, Acceleration, Turn, and Brake.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/37bf22c31e5216756ab16f65cb7fd703b587d3f5.png

All Classes



"Core" skills, which make existing Awakening skills one step more powerful, and "Rabam's Enlightenment: 3rd Skill Enhancement" will be coming in the November 18 update. We hope you'll look forward to these expanded and more powerful skills.



Berserker

Feral Rage - Fixed the issue where you could use the skill regardless of stamina.


Witch

Healing Aura I–V - Changed the skill description as follows (the skill effects that are actually applied remain the same).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/0fa2aa1d06a0ec09b66e110c4cb6695acf054400.png

Three new Caphras journals, "Caphras - Journal of Destruction," "Caphras - Journal of Nature," "Caphras - Journal of Glory," which hold the dark past of Caphras, have been unveiled. Transform "Caphras - Journal of Light and Shadow" obtained during Caphras' Adventure Logs into one of the three journals. Each of them has its own latent ability.

After completing Caphras's Adventure Logs Vol.1–4 and the quest "Caphras: Book of Immortality" from the Black Spirit, accept "Caphras: The Life of Light and Shadow" from the Black Spirit and go to Velia to talk with Alustin.
After completing the relevant quest from Alustin of Velia, accept the quest "Caphras' Journal, Mysterious Power" and take "Caphras - Journal of Light and Shadow" and Caphras Stone x10 to Alustin to complete the quest. Then you may choose to receive one of the three Caphras - Journals.
You may exchange the transformed Caphras journals into another journal by doing the quest "[Repeat] Caphras' Journal, Mysterious Power" from Alustin of Velia and use the journal with the stats you wish depending on the situation.



The crafting method for the Ancient Kingdom of Orzeca's Mass of Pure Magic has been discovered at the Crypt of Resting Thoughts and its mass production has initiated under the command of Queen Viorencia Odore. However, this mass production requires a material called "Essence of Tunta" and the Verti, a direct subordinate organization of the queen, is looking for assistants who can supply the essence.

If you become the Verti's assistant, you can supply Essence of Tunta once per week to them and receive Mass of Pure Magic x5 as a reward.
If your Amity with Queen Viorencia Odore is 1 or higher, you can activate the "Life" Quest Type and talk with Celphie, the Audrite Holy Priestess of O'draxxia, to accept the [Essence of Tunta] questline.
Be acknowledged as the Verti's assistant by completing the [Essence of Tunta] questline and talk with Celphie again to do the [Weekly] Essence of Tunta quest. This quest requires you to activate Quest Type "Other" and can be completed only once per week.
Note that you will fail to craft Essence of Tunta through alchemy if you do not have the knowledge "Celphie's Special Alchemy." The knowledge is obtainable by completing the [Essence of Tunta] questline.



O'draxxia has initiated the mass production of Mass of Pure Magic based on Orzeca's records and the capital is now in need of help. Queen Viorencia Odore has hence given the order to reward those who help the capital with the Ancient Kingdom of Orzeca Coins.

Added Ancient Kingdom of Orzeca Coin as a reward for the quest [Lv. 60] O'dyllita City Contribution under the Recurring tab in the Quest window.
Right-click on the Ancient Kingdom of Orzeca Coin to navigate to the Exchange NPC.

We are aware of the issue where some Adventurers were able to accept and complete the [Event] A Very Secret Deal I, II, III quests even though the quests were planned to be changed to be unacceptable and uncompletable from November 11 at 00:00 until today's maintenance.

We are currently investigating this issue. Adventurers who did not accept and complete the quests from November 11, 2020 (Wed) at 00:00 until the start of today's maintenance will be sent the [Event] Morden Secret Trade Voucher by in-game mail during the November 18, 2020 (Wed) maintenance to allow them to be able to accept and complete the [Event] A Very Secret Deal I, II, III quests.
Adventurers who forfeited the quest after accepting the quest between November 11, 2020 (Wed) at 00:00 until the start of maintenance will also be sent the [Event] Morden Secret Trade Voucher.

The timetables have been updated and divided into 2 weeks (one for the timeslot of Nov. 11–Nov. 18, the second for the timeslot of Nov. 18–Nov. 25). We sincerely apologize for the confusion and inconvenience.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

Dear Players,

We will perform our weekly maintenance as follows:

Global 9:00 UTC ~ 13:00 UTC

notes.title: Patch Notes - November 4th 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/1a6b2c143b1d8612e15098e3a9ac500016f8438d.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,

This week, O’dyllita is ready to unveil more of its mysteries with the second part of the main quests.

Nouver awakens and will challenge seasoned adventurers as mighty Bloodstorm Nouver.

Finally, take advantage of the enhancement aid events to upgrade your gear or grab some mount experience and more during our horse-related event.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f620b57fc70b8044ec3c338c6a3b04a58648fc63.png

New Events

November Enhancement Aid

Event 1. The Legendary Thief
Period: November 4 (after maintenance)–December 2 (before maintenance)

You can purchase special items from NPC Fawner Morden who will appear randomly in Velia, Heidel, Calpheon, or Altinova. You can also perform Simple Alchemy to process these special items with others to create items like Advice of Valks!

Event 2. Moonlight Stone Challenge
Period: November 5 (00:00 UTC)–December 1 (23:59 UTC)

Complete Black Spirit quest, log-in challenge, and playtime challenge to obtain items to create tempered stones and ultimately [Event] Iridescent Moonlight Stone which you can exchange for Advice of Valks items!

Event 3. Morden likes Accessories
Period: November 4 (after maintenance)–December 2 (before maintenance)

Exchange accessories with NPC Tawner Morden to get Ancient Spirit Dust items.
Some blue-grade accessories of TRI (III) enhancement level or lower exchangeable for the "Fawner & Tawner Morden, Thieving Merchants!" won't be allowed to be registered on the Central Market, and accessories already registered will be cancelled and returned to respective warehouses as of November 3, 22:30 UTC.
During this event period, all weapon/armor vendors, and blacksmiths will stop selling Mysterious Rings, Mysterious Earrings, Mysterious Belts, and Mysterious Necklaces.

Click  to learn all about these series of new events to help you obtain items to aid in your enhancement!




Hoof it Up!

Event 1. Mount EXP Boost
Period: November 4 (after maintenance)–November 18 (before maintenance)

Enjoy Mount EXP +50%, 24/7 during the entire event period!

Event 2. Imperial Horse Delivery
Period: November 4 (after maintenance)–November 18 (before maintenance)

Perform Imperial Horse Delivery to get additional [Event] Imperial Training Delivery Invoices which can be exchanged for rewards to help your Courser Training and even an [Event] Tier-8 Horse Emblem Box!

Click  for more details on this event to help train your horses.




Bonus ! Special Dice for Halloween

Period: November 4 (after maintenance)–November 11 (before maintenance)
We hope you are enjoying Halloween in Florin! We have added another special event so during this event week, visit Kunata Don in Florin to receive the event quest to obtain Black Spirit's Special Dice for the all new Black Spirit's Adventure board game!
This quest can be completed once per in-game family per day during the event period.

This quest will reset daily at 00:00 UTC.
You can also find this quest under the quest window (O) under New quests tab.
Be sure to check out more Halloween events going on via the Halloween in Florin event post .



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/3093b194d7f1dec02596f28d75da296167b23178.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/c4f4149040990f6f5ee4c5b982fcd3b6469ddbcd.png


Additional Bloodstorm Nouver will spawn for an event period.

Please note Bloodstorm Nouver may spawn at random times in any of its set spawn times besides the fixed schedules above.
Adventurers will be able to get up to IV Nouver Sub-weapons (possible enhancements: +0, I, II, III, IV) as well as enjoy increased drop rates for Belongings of an Adventurer, Gold Bars (up to 1,000G), and each type of Magical Black Stones for bringing down Bloodstorm Nouver!
As world boss spawns in Danger Zones, you may receive death penalty for being killed by world bosses.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/b4e800d3fdc9146c9ac70dd091ae4fe1c012f8c5.png

Ongoing Events

Halloween in Florin: October 28–November 11 (before maintenance)

Thanks to the strong interest and affection from our players, we have decided to change the Mischievous Jack Transformation Scroll (7 Days) x1 you can obtain from the Halloween events in Florin to a ‘permanent’ edition with November 4th regular maintenance. This will work retroactively as well so any 7-day scrolls obtained before the maintenance will also be changed to permanent ones. Continue collecting [Event] Soul-infused Cotton Wad and obtain the scroll to enjoy your mischievous self, even after the event ends!



Magical Elixir: Period: October 30 (00:00 UTC)–November 8 (23:59 UTC)
O'dyllita Launch Events

Event 4. Flower of the Burning Moon: October 7–November 11 (before maintenance)



O'dyllita Attendance Check: October 7–November 11 (before maintenance)
Nightmare Comes True - Extended for 1 week

Ended Events

Refer-a-Friend Promotion
Set Sail Again
Spooky Witchy Halloween!

"Event 3. Halloween Challenges" will still be available until November 4 (23:59 UTC)


Reward Distribution

Enhanced Skill update

Be sure to check out changes made to Enhanced Skills with this week's update under class changes below, and we hope you enjoy customizing your skill set with a complementary Armstrong's Skill Guide (1 Day).
Make sure to claim them before December 2, 09:00 UTC or it will disappear. Thank you



NA Node War Tax Collection

Due to the node tax collection issue that occurred on NA servers last week, the Silvers missed out by guilds who occupied nodes before and after the urgent maintenance was performed has been distributed.
The Silver amount was sent to Guild Funds of the relevant guilds.



Kalqueesh Loot Issue

The issue where you were unable to obtain Ancient Power - Black Shard, Black Stone (Armor), Power Engine of Ancient Weapons from defeating the Kalqueesh after the October 21 (Wed.) maintenance has been fixed with today's maintenance.
Please check the details of the issue and compensation to be given out with next week's (November 11th) regular maintenance .



Content

O'dyllita Main Quests Part II
Added the main quest in Pt.2 "[Lv.60 O'dyllita II] Gem of Imbalance" where the Flower of the Burning Moon and shadows with the blessings of Queen Viorencia Odore are preparing for the encroaching Hadum's Realm.

Must have completed the quest "[Lv. 60 O'dyllita I] Flower of the Burning Moon" to get this new quest.

Added the story about the Fallen Ahib in Thornwood Forest.

The quest "Ones Seized in Evil Aura" can be accepted from Black Spirit in Thornwood Forest after completing the quest "[O'dyllita] Song of Phantoms."

Discovered Vol. 1 and 4 of the Caphras' Adventure Logs that contains Caphras' Biography. Adventurers that have already completed all of Caphras' Adventure Log Vol. 2 and 3 will get Vol. 1 and 4 without doing any other quests.



Here is the long awaited update! The main quests in O'dylitta Part 2 takes our Adventurers through the story about the daughters of Sylvia. An exciting story will unfold about the events that happened in this peaceful and beautiful looking forest.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/536bb32f74dc444050ba79bec666f9a7fa1bd735.png


Bloodstorm Nouver

Nouver the Sand Tyrant will occasionally be stained by the blood of victims that died in the desert sandstorms. The tyrant is rumored to appear even more vicious than before. It is called "Bloodstorm Nouver" and is greatly feared by desert travellers, merchants, and even the military.

Bloodstorm Nouver is even more powerful than the pre-existing Nouver. It blows whirlwinds at distant Adventurers and attacks from beneath the desert sands.
Bloodstorm Nouver drops much better loot. Adventurers will be able to get up to IV Nouver Sub-weapons (possible enhancements: +0, I, II, III, IV). It also has increased drop rates for Belongings of an Adventurer, Gold Bars (up to 1,000G), and each type of Magical Black Stones.
Bloodstorm Nouver will have new attack patterns.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/7729d0c505ce694d1e67b6e0acdd964703eeaae8.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/8446510dafaef8cebe12b400f829c0e60241005f.gif
▲ Appears with a powerful storm (Left) / Fires two fire breathes right after each other (Right)

▲ Creates a phantom using the sandstorm (Left) / Cries out and summons a huge whirlwind (Right)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f1830a5c2dda750f1c43493ef9494c159d0b846b.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/d264ba5000f659cf6ec9143804cbb3a1a8bf8ad6.gif
▲ 3 stage attack from the air (Left) / Slams down on the ground to bring utter destruction in the area (Right)

Last time when we released Nightmarish Kzarka, we were worried about our adventurers' response as it was significantly harder. To our surprise, it received a lot of positive feedback from the community. Adventurers were pleased to see that we finally have a great world boss. Of course, the loots that dropped also helped in this.
We are now glad to announce to you the release of an even more powerful Nouver: the "Bloodstorm Nouver." This world boss demands quick decisions to be made with a variety of attack patterns and attacks with sharper claws and teeth. We hope it will be an exciting experience for our adventurers. We are currently working on Karanda and Kutum as well. We hope to hear a lot of suggestions and feedback for our world bosses.

Changes to Node/Conquest Wars, boss spawns, and Tribute Wagon departure time have been reflected so please follow the start and closing times of the local time for the North America servers accordingly.

[Warrior] Hatchet Job Outfit - Fixed the graphical issue with the shoulder portion of the armor that occured after changing your character's appearance via customization.
Fixed the issue with the Carmadun Owl's actual range for looting items.
Fixed the issue where Naval Fame decreased when hitting a ship with smuggled goods loaded on it.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where the quest that appears on the 3rd chapter of Book 1 of Caphras' Record appears untranslated. This issue will be resolved shortly.


Updated November 5

We are aware of the issue where defeating the Guild Boss Khan twice before the November 4th maintenance causes the number of summonable times to appear abnormal.  

This issue will be resolved during the reset time of Monday at midnight (00:00) and the number of summonable times will become 1.



Updated November 10

We are aware of the issue where using Khan's Heart: Life in certain situations can cause a ship’s stats to abnormally rise. As a result, we’ve temporarily blocked the ability to use Khan's Heart: Life. This issue will be resolved during the November 11, 2020 (tomorrow's) regular maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience.


Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.
