notes.title: Heidel Ball: AT HOME – 2020 Update Roadmap
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/49e4eeda6e626c2b9ff3f73829cb0475687d6b79.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,  

On May 30th, the upcoming update roadmap for the remaining time of 2020 was revealed!    
Now then, don’t you wanna see what kind of updates are in store for Black Desert?  

New Class - Hashashin

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/af05f87cb17488be33ce35a16320b3959ab14d73.jpg

Hashashin is Aal’s warrior, who can manipulate sandstorms with the power of the native Valencian god.
He engages in melee combat with the Shamshir as his main weapon, and also wields the sandstorms to quickly escape from danger or suppress his opponents. 
Hashashin has minor passives suitable for the desert. He can travel slightly faster in the desert and has a mildly higher resistance to desert diseases compared to other classes. 
Once Awakened, his faith in Aal will grow stronger, allowing him to receive the hidden power of the god. 
 
[previewyoutube=pqksdXVM9bU;full][/previewyoutube]

The skill in this video is one of Hashashin’s main skills, the Apostle’s Descent. 
In addition, he has a skill that allows him to imbue the memory of a specific place in a sandstorm which allows him to teleport to that place, given that he is not too far away. He can also create sandstorms to chase enemies or ambush them from above.


Siege of Thornwood

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/9ada1d03c6912d775ab72bfc1a54bf848e56681b.jpg

Thornwood Fortress is a new content in O’dyllita, previously introduced as the Siege of Thornwood.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/c79f2d73e7a1aaaa49db5ad6d27d0c6f4ca6eeef.jpg


5 Adventurers will band together and form one team, then randomly be assigned to either the Ganelles or the Vedirs. Both teams will participate in a PvP plus boss-raid type of combat. The team that defeats the final boss, Sephir Odore, will claim victory. 
As each team moves towards their destination, they must react quickly to the given situations, balancing between monsters and the enemy team.
Thornwood Fortress is a new content founded on simple PVE rules with a dash of PVP. A variety of tactics and strategy can come into play as Adventurers will be required to effectively communicate with their team members.


Grand Prix & Race Horses

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/2835951ef08f8f60b45d0f69717ac19965933979.jpg


Thanks to the donations of the Old Moon Guild, Gula, the Chairperson of the Riding Association of Stonetail, will be introducing new horse breeds. 
Brisa, Viento, Rafaga, Tempesta are similar in appearance to existing horse breeds, but have totally different and unique skills.
According to Gula, they are Race Horses from a faraway continent.
These new breeds of Race Horses possess a type of Stamina called the Power of Wind. The Power of Wind is consumed when performing Sprint & Instant Acceleration during a race, and slowly recovers while cornering or sprinting normally. 
Managing such limited resources and strategizing against the course will best aid Adventurers achieve victory in the race and win the competition. 


Bounty

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f0964ecd5df699b0a49f2e3a4d76781b36867e5f.jpg


With the addition of ocean content, including bartering, sea monster hunting, Khan, and Vell, more and more Adventurers have shown interest in the high seas. 
Using these newly-introduced systems and content to make ships, then engaging in PVP with self-built boats over the high seas, can provide a wholly different experience compared to PVP on land.
We expect to see a variety of new systems that may be implemented as more Adventurers participate in PVP on water. Amongst these that may be implemented, we’d like to introduce the possible implementation of “Bounty.”  
Adventurers who’ve been attacked by other Adventurers in PVP can place a bounty on them. Adventurers who can take down those with a bounty will be rewarded honor points proportionate to the bounty amount. 
There’s plenty of room for improvement as this is still in the early development stage, yet we believe this will offer new and exciting gameplay for those who may have grown a bit bored with their current playstyle.


Zodiac Signs?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/d70b47de1645407a9f2f1d68133fa2e14475d655.png


Do you remember the Zodiac Sign you chose when you first made your character? There are a multitude of Zodiac Signs in Black Desert, such as the Goblin, Black Dragon, Hammer, Owl Treant, Giant, and Camel. 
Zodiac Signs are inherent to your character and allow you to converse with NPCs with the same Zodiac Sign without the required level of Amity, as well as grant a slight bonus in the Amity game, which doesn’t hugely impact your gameplay. 
This time, we thought long and hard about where else we could utilize these Zodiac Signs that were implemented as a stress-free in-game content. 
We will introduce a new feature by which your characters’ daily fortune changes depending on their Zodiac Sign. For example, if today’s Zodiac Sign is the Shield, all characters of the Shield sign would gain either an 1% increase to item drop rates, +1 enhancement stack, additional EXP, an increase to their enhancement success rate, immunity to desert sickness, and other minimal yet fun effects.  
We feel this will add a little spice to each day in-game, and later it could develop into a content such as Zodiac Tarot Shops. 


New Challenge in Node Wars

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/2134bea91f2fb953ed257909d79ab5fad5ce7932.jpg


While there are still servers with very active participation in Node Wars, it isn’t the same as it was in the past. There may be a variety of reasons why, but we believe that the current situation calls for at least a slight change. 
At the center of this change for Node War, is a form of warfare where one slowly expands one’s territory based on the initially acquired node, similar to how you had to connect the nodes to conquer them in the past. 
Depending on the node, you would discuss carefully with your Guild Master, Officers, and Members on which node to attack or protect next, strategizing and preparing for the next move. 
Despite dividing up the nodes into different tiers, we’ve also been collecting the feedback you’ve sent us, such as the high barrier of entry for novice guilds, making mercenaries into permanent War Heroes, rewards for acquiring nodes, and we will continue to look into each and everyone of them in order to improve Node War. 


Global Arena of Arsha

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/c549a45ec58e44dd6d4b8d248133421e7c8cf9f1.jpg


With the stability that we've achieved with BDO over the past years, we believe we can take novel approaches to its direction.
That’s why we are planning to select representatives of each country, invite them to Korea, and host a global Arena of Arsha tournament. Of course, we won’t be able to host it now during these difficult times, but we will as soon as we can safely see each other. 


Specialized Servers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f91fca924e754f5e1af55ff145a6c0e17c179efe.jpg


As our Adventurers continued to progress, leveling became much faster, and hunting grounds in the initial leveling routes are being forgotten. For example, the Fogan and the Red Orc regions in Serendia are traversed only once during the leveling process and never seen again. 
Here we seek to develop a new system: a special server where the power of Hadum continues to grow stronger. 
In these specialized servers where the power of Hadum grows, monsters in lower level zones will become greatly empowered. As such, those forgotten hunting grounds mentioned earlier will become dangerous once more.  
And to match this danger, they will award Adventurers with suitable rewards. We hope to provide Adventurers who’ve grown too powerful a small sense of danger to their daily travels. 


This isn’t the End of the World

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f062d600d06b1a015c5e1f46ed3affe900b403da.jpg


Currently, we plan for developing a high-altitude region covered with snow, located south of Mediah.
Legend has it that a gigantic dragon, different from Garmoth, resides in this place. At the moment, we are aiming for a Winter 2021 release. 
Next is a region previously announced as the Land of Demons, located above Valencia. This is where Hashashin fought arduously against demonic foes. You can expect a rather different type of power and monsters to inhabit this place. 
A new region shrouded in mystery...but wait, there’s more. What lies beyond the lands of the Kingdom of Haso? If our current technology is not enough to incarnate and introduce these undiscovered lands to all of you, we will seek out new means and techniques to make it true. 


Everything from the wielder of sandstorms, Aal’s warrior, Hashashin, to a new region that’s planned for development!   

During the remaining time of 2020, we will do our best to deliver a variety of updates that we can enjoy with our Adventurers together.   

*Please note the content above is subject to change in name, schedule, and form.


This isn't the end! We also held a Global Q&A session during Heidel Ball: AT HOME and collected questions from adventurers across the globe. Due to limitation in time, we couldn't get to all the wonderful questions provided.

Therefore, we wanted to present the questions and answers on this for our EU and NA players and we will be offering this via our official forums a little later.

notes.title: Patch Notes - June 3rd 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/4a58188e8a486ee6467d5828ae7a8e3f1c47d523.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Last week we announced that Season Servers are coming to the EU and NA servers of Black Desert Online. Starting today, you will be able to pre-create a new Season Character for these new servers and earn rewards just for doing this. Soon, the Season Servers will be open and you will be able to play with your new Season Character and earn more rewards just by playing!

In addition, new weapons are available that many of you have been waiting for: Obsidian Abyssal Main Weapons, Sandstorm Sub-weapons, and Ultimate Katan Awakening Weapons.

As usual, this patch brings fixes and changes that you can read about below.


Events & System

New Events

Season Character Pre-creation

Period: June 3 (after maintenance)–Until Season Server Launch (exact date to be announced)
During the event period, simply create a Season Character early and prepare for the Season Servers launching soon.

The release of Season Servers for the NA and EU servers, which was originally set for June 10, has been postponed. We will announce further details at a later time. Thank you for your understanding.
After creating your Season Character, you will not be able to play with them until the Season Servers officially opens.
The very first season is called Summer Season and it will last until September 2 (before maintenance).
You should see a special icon marking the Season Character in the Character Selection window.



For having created the Season Character early, you will receive the following rewards:

Item Collection Increase Scroll (60 min) x5
[Event] Shining Shakatu's Seal x5
Time-filled Black Stone x100
Trainer's Flute (7 Days) x1
Inventory +8 Expansion Coupon x1
Gold Bar 1,000G x1
1 Papu Emoji (Permanent) x1



Important: You can delete and re-create season characters during the pre-creation period, however, please make sure to have the season character created and active in your account before the official release of Summer Season (the very first global Season Server period) in order to receive the rewards. Stay tuned for the Season Server release date.
Click  for the full details on the pre-creation event!
Click  for more information about the upcoming Season Servers.



Drop Rate Boosts

Period: June 3 (after maintenance)–June 10 (before maintenance)
During the entire event period, drop rate for the following items will increase:

Defeat monsters to enjoy drop rate boost on Black Stone (Weapon) and Black Stone (Armor)
Gather to enjoy drop rate boost on Sharp Black Crystal Shard and Hard Black Crystal Shard



The drop rate boosts will run 24/7 and will apply to all servers excluding Olvia servers.
The drop rate boost will stack with the Arsha server item drop rate boost and other item drop effects including that of Item Collection Increase Scrolls.
The drop rate boost will be applied to the listed items from defeating monsters and gathering. However, it will NOT apply when fishing.
Event period and specs. may change with future notice.



Ongoing Events

Arsha Leaderboard Returns: May 27–June 24 (before maintenance)

Mid Season Events

Event 1: Amazing Attendance Rewards: May 21–June 17 (23:59 UTC)



Newly Discovered Treasures: May 27 (after maintenance)–June 10 (before maintenance)

Shai's Got Talent

Submission period: May 20–June 7 (23:59 UTC)
Staff Pick: June 8–June 10
Community Vote:June 11–June 16
Winner Announcement: June 17
Reward Distribution: June 24 (during maintenance)



Ended Events

Giddy Up!

Season of Life

Mid Season Events

Event 3: Shakatu Gives Gold: Available until June 3 (23:59 UTC)!
Event 4: Black Spirit's Adventure: UPGRADED
Event 5: Daily Item Collection Increase Scrolls



Reward Distribution

Heidel Ball: AT HOME Rewards

Relive the Heidel Ball: AT HOME stream held last Saturday .
Enjoy the following rewards announced during the stream and thank you once again for tuning into this global online get-together.

J's Special Scroll x5 
Cron Stone x530 
Advice of Valks (+100) x1 
[Event] Horse Emblem Box 
Cron Stone x530 

By opening the [Event] Horse Emblem Box, you have a chance to get a Tier 7 – 8 horse.
The rewards listed above are shown in the order as announced in the stream. This does mean Cron Stone x530 will be sent twice.





Content

Added new weapons.

Added Obsidian Abyssal main weapons.

These weapons are more powerful than Black Abyssal weapons. You can get this type of weapon by heating a Black Abyssal weapon with the new item Obsidian Alloy in the Processing window (L).




Added Ultimate Katan awakening weapons and Sandstorm sub-weapons to ease the journey through Valencia.

Ultimate Katan awakening weapons and Sandstorm sub-weapons can be enhanced. The chances of successfully enhancing them are higher than usual.
Ultimate Katan awakening weapons and Sandstorm sub-weapons cannot be registered on the Central Market.



Obsidian Abyssal main weapons, Ultimate Katan awakening weapons, and Sandstorm sub-weapons can be obtained through the rewards for the Mediah and Valencia main quests.

Characters that have already completed the relevant main quests can obtain the new Obsidian Abyssal main weapons, Ultimate Katan awakening weapons, and Sandstorm sub-weapons once per family via the following NPCs.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/8007f3626f68e80bd959abc9a470ff5ec4358541.png

You can now choose whether or not you want to use Agris Fever points when defeating monsters.

If Adventure Log: Agris, the Ancient Secret is completed and you have at least one Agris Fever point, press RMB on the icon for Agris Fever to choose whether to use Agris Fever points.
If you choose to use Agris Fever points when defeating monsters, there will be a light effect swirling around the icon for Agirs Fever.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/8216dadaaaf8a318b53f3415b39293d57d4f52af.png



Mining the following will now be influenced by pet hedgehogs.

Rainbow Stone
Strange Rock
Coal, Opal
Clear Quartz
Muddy Quartz
Red Quartz
Green Quartz
Black Quartz
Violet Crystal
Blue Crystal



Added text to the item description of Scorched Fragment saying it is used to make Manos accessories.

Increased the maximum number of character slots to 20.


System

Fixed the issue where the navigation around a certain part of Port Ratt was abnormal.


Game World, NPC & Effects

NPC

Added a button that will appear when conversing with Shepherd Ron of Epheria Valley that will allow you to discover the Gathering Node of Epheria Valley.


Item Changes

Added 6 gathering tools that you can rent from the Leight family with Contribution Points.

Each gathering tool can be rented for 50 Contribution Points apiece from Norma Leight the Northern Wheat Plantation Owner.
These gathering tools have the following effects.
Gathering Item Drop Rate +30% (For the type of gathering associated with the tool)
Reduces Gathering Time by 11 sec
Gathering Mastery +200 (For the type of gathering associated with the tool)
Gathering EXP +10%
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/43d8df245a31ddf2b5c3695c22c77dd96968561b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/9e8e2047533556303a4924b7a14c1794a661c250.png



Changed how to summon Khan as follows.

You can no longer summon Khan with Leanar's Celestial Map items.
Go to NPC Curio of Oquilla's Eye to exchange your Leanar's Celestial Map for [Guild] Emperor of the Great Ocean Khan Summon Scroll.
For one [Guild] Emperor of the Great Ocean Khan Summon Scroll, you can summon Khan once, under the following conditions.
[Guild] Emperor of the Great Ocean Khan Summon Scroll can only be used by a Guild Master to summon Khan for one additional time after Khan has been summoned via a guild mission.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/1fa7ccd79e731abeb382a9018192092146fa3201.png



Added more details to the item descriptions of the following life tools about how to enhance them.

Loggia life clothes and tools
Dostter life tools
Izaro Trainer's Clothes and Izaro Riding Crop
Carta Gatherer's Clothes and Carta Craftsman's Clothes
Gorgath Alchemist's Clothes
Crio Fisher's Clothes
Srulk Sailor's Clothes
Robeau Hunter's Clothes
Roroju Cook's Clothes



Added text explaining how to obtain [Guild] Sea Monster's Neidan ten at a time to the item descriptions of Young Sea Monster's Neidan and Sea Monster's Neidan.

For details on the newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Mechanic Changes

Pressing the Recharge button in the Pearl Shop (F3) will now not only direct you to the official homepage but also automatically log you in.


Monster Changes

Improved the sound effect which plays when Muskan appears from the Dark Rift.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Added Light of Illezra buff as a quest reward to the Succession quests of certain classes that are performed at Glutoni Cave.

Specifically, this buff will be given out as an award for completing certain Succession quests called A Strange Reunion. The buff's effects are immediately activated and will light up the surrounding area for 10 minutes.



Interface Changes

Added Background images to the loading screen that appear when going to the Change Character or Character Selection window.

Removed the unfunctional button for BDO Wiki from the Guild House window.

Reworked the design of the menu that appears in the Inventory (I) when you press RMB on materials or items that can be exchanged.

Fixed the issue with how the word "Silver" appeared twice next to the price for leveling up the storage, lodging, workshop, etc. at your house.

The Barter Information window will no longer close if it's in Sticker UI mode when you are supplying your ship.

If you successfully barter while the Barter Information window is open, the window will now immediately refresh.

The class of the character you are currently playing on will now be selected by default in the Gallery and Download Ranking tabs in the Beauty Album window.

Fixed the issue where the Patrigio's Secret Shop window closed if you tried to purchase an item without enough Silver.

Fixed the issue where if you tried to throw away an item from the Inventory (I) but missed the trash can icon, the icon became emphasized and remained so even after visiting the World Map (M) or Beauty (F4) windows.

Fixed the issue where the button for bidding and the explanatory text was overlapping in the View Details part of the Guild House window.

Fixed the issue where the Redeem button did not appear in the ESC menu when not using the Steam client.

Fixed the issue where the icons of certain items did not appear in the Crafting Notes (F2) window.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where playing instruments in an ensemble was not possible in a party of five.

Fixed the issue where dragging the title list in the My Information (P) window made the titles appear in abnormal colors.

Fixed the issue where the camera angle did not move to the right when the game was under certain screen resolution settings.

Fixed the issue where the game window did not appear correctly after the screen was minimized during the loading screen.

Fixed the issue where characters would get stuck near a certain area near the wharf of Iliya Island

Fixed the issue where it was possible to walk through tree roots at a certain area in Southern Kamasylvia.

Fixed the issue where gatherable resources did not appear properly in a part of Oquilla's Eye.

Fixed the issue where you could not catch local fish near the inaccessible areas around Tuir Valley or Al Halam Sea.

Fixed the issue where certain text didn't appear when trying to report it with the Suggest Change function.

Removed the "[Quest] How to Obtain a Sealed Accessory!" button from the Black Spirit Guide, which led to outdated information about certain quests.

Fixed the graphical issue where hair, or the fur on apparel, sometimes shook unnaturally.

[Guardian] Fixed the graphical issue with the belt and thighs of the Shudad Black outfit.

[Witch] Fixed the graphical issue with the lower part of the Shudad Black outfit.

[Dark Knight] Fixed the graphical issue with the neck of the Shudad Black outfit.

Fixed the issue where you could not Communicate (F9) with certain Tier 7 horses.

[Kunoichi & Ninja] Fixed the graphical issue with the sub-weapons that occurred when a shuriken and sub-weapon apparel were equipped, then the apparel was unequipped.

Fixed the issue where your ship would stop moving if you tried to use the skill BreezySail continuously while equipping Ebenruth's Nol without meeting the conditions for using Ebenruth's Nol.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where the Black Spirit symbol sometimes pops up when you are fighting monsters.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - May 27th 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/7a7a354b4e943682e3461434af5e870b111b950a.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Mounts are an important part of Black Desert Online, and many adventurers enjoy catching wild horses and train them in order to acquire the best ones. Today's update brings a new system that will allow horse trainers to rent their horses to other adventurers for a small fee. Also, some new events will be available that will help you train and develop your favorite mounts, so don't miss out on them!

We also have a special event for PvPers: the Arsha Leaderboard is back again! Kill as many players as you can in the Arsha server to accumulate points. Players who achieve the most amount of points will win rare prizes!

As usual read the details of the new content and events below! Enjoy!


Event & System

Advance Notice

Season Servers

Starting June 10, we will introduce the "Season Servers" to Black Desert Online!

Enjoy this new feature dedicated to help you grow faster and more easily. Stay tuned for more information coming up next week
Season Character Pre-creation begins next week on June 3 maintenance! You can start creating an exclusive character for the Season Server and receive special rewards for doing so! More information on the pre-creation event will also be shared next week.




Heidel Ball: At Home

This Saturday May 30 08:00 UTC, Black Desert Online will hold its first ever online global event, Heidel Ball: At Home where you will have a chance to get cool rewards, enjoy a special event, take a sneak peek at what's coming for the second half of this year, and tune into a global Q&A session.

Stay tuned and watch the global stream via our official Twitch and YouTube channels below:

[Black Desert Online Official Twitch Channel]
[Black Desert Online Official Youtube Channel]
Click  for the full announcement.





New Events

Giddy Up!

Period: May 27 (after maintenance)–June 3 (before maintenance)
Event 1. Time for Courser Training 

Defeat monsters, gather, and fish during the event period to collect items for Courser awakening.



Event 2. Mount EXP Boost

Enjoy Mount EXP +50% during the entire event period.



Event 3. Boosted Breeding/Exchange Chances

Breed or exchange your horses and enjoy a boost in your chances of getting a higher-tier horse!



Event 4. Imperial Training Delivery

Perform Imperial Horse Delivery with your horse and obtain [Event] Imperial Training Delivery Invoice which can be exchanged for horse-related items!



Click  to gallop into this festival of events.



Loyal Attendance Rewards Refreshed

Period: May 28 (00:00 UTC)–July 1 (23:59 UTC)
Check attendance daily and stack up on rewards including Cron Stones, Valks' Cry, [Event] Shining Shakatu's Seals, Fine Accessory Box II, and so much more!
Click  to see the entire attendance board.



Arsha Leaderboard Returns

Period: May 27 (after maintenance)–June 24 (before maintenance)
Arsha Leaderboard is back in style, kill (via PK or Guild War) as many players as you can in the Arsha server to accumulate points—players with the most kill points win rare prizes!

Click  for full details of the event.
Click  to see your standing in the Arsha Leaderboard.




Ongoing Events

Mid Season Events

Event 1: Amazing Attendance Rewards: May 21–June 17 (23:59 UTC)
Event 3: Shakatu Gives Gold: May 20–June 3 (23:59 UTC)
Event 4: Black Spirit's Adventure: UPGRADED: May 20–June 3 (before maintenance)

Staff Pick: June 8–June 10
Community Vote:June 11–June 16
Winner Announcement: June 17

Event 3: Life Skill Boost: May 14–June 2 (23:59 UTC)



Ended Events

Mid Season Events

Event 2: Hot Time Boost



Patrigio's Shop Renewal: Week 2


Reward Distribution

Wishes for the Sky

[Event] Secret Book of Old Moon (7 Days) x1 sent to those who have turned in at least 1 [Event] Wish-Scribbled Paper to Lara during the event period.
If you were eligible for the reward, please claim it via in-game mailbox (B) after maintenance ends before June 24 23:59 UTC or it will expire. Thank you!



Content

Ship Material Barter
To try and lower the difficulty of preparing for the Great Expedition, we devised a system to upgrade your ship all the way from a Bartali Sailboat to an Epheria Carrack. However, we understand that gathering the necessary materials to upgrade your ship is still difficult for many of you. Therefore we have decided to add a separate "ship material barter" system to the existing bartering system.

In this new system, materials to upgrade ships have been separated out from other sea trade goods. These materials include those needed for an Epheria Caravel or Epheria Carrack, as well as items needed for blue grade Epheria Carrack gear. You can refresh these ship material barters separately from the others via the new "Ship Material Refresh" function, and even if you already have your dream ship you can still use this function and watch your Crow Coins pile up.

Bartering can be a break from the usual to make some profit out at sea if you are willing to brave the rough waters of the Great Ocean. That is why we wanted to minimize any negative impact this new system will have on those of you who enjoy bartering, and thus experimented on the Global Lab to see how a new system will impact both hardcore and casual barters and their profits. We also made Epheria Carrack materials appear more frequently than other materials so that Epheria Caravel and Epheria Frigate owners can get the materials they need faster to get an Epheria Carrack.

Due to the increasing demand for materials to upgrade ships, the Crow Merchants Guild will now provide separate bartering opportunities for them, called "ship material barter."

However, there will be some exceptions for certain ship upgrade materials. Please consult the chart below for more details.
A separate "Ship Material Refresh" function has been added to the existing Barter Refresh system.

You can use the "Ship Material Refresh" function twice a day.
When you use the "Ship Material Refresh" function, there is a small chance that you will uncover all the possible barters you can make for Crow Coins at every island. You can use Crow Coins to barter any Level 2 to 5 sea trade goods.



During ship material barter, you will get material for upgrading a ship. You may also get materials to enhance ships as well as treasures.
The Accumulated Number of Exchanges needed to barter for the following items will drastically decrease when using ship material barter.

Brilliant Pearl Shard
Brilliant Rock Salt Ingot



The items available for ship material barter are as follows.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/722d368a30f3ef2ca7c2ac3114d9ae739f4df686.png

Reworked the Barter Refresh system.

Changed "barter refresh count" to "barter refresh point" in certain instances.
Everyday at 06:00 UTC, your barter refresh points will be reset to 100.
If you have an active Value Pack, you can recover 50 extra barter refresh points.
(I.e. Your points will be reset to 150 instead of 100.)
The number of barter refresh points consumed when using the Barter Refresh function depends on the number of barters you have left for that day.
Using instant refresh will consume an additional 30 points.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/6b9f39c57885df0b9b49177402dd7add5fe4b916.png

Updated the information about how to barter for the following items in each of the items' descriptions.

Island Tree Coated Plywood
Rock Salt Ingot
Ruddy Manganese Nodule
Cobalt Ingot
Pure Pearl Crystal
Enhanced Island Tree Coated Plywood
Great Ocean Dark Iron
Tide-Dyed Standardized Timber Square
Luminous Cobalt Ingot
Deep Tide-Dyed Standardized Timber Square
Bright Reef Piece
Seaweed Stalk
Deep Sea Memory Filled Glue
Cox Pirates' Artifact (Parley Expert)
Cox Pirates' Artifact (Parley Beginner)
Cox Pirates' Artifact (Combat)
Cox Pirates Extermination Seal
Brilliant Rock Salt Ingot
Brilliant Pearl Shard
Moon Vein Flax Fabric
Moon Scale Plywood
Tear of the Ocean



Added a horse rental function to the stable.

This function allows you to either rent a horse, or rent out your own horse.
For a fee of 100,000 Silver you can rent a horse for seven days. The owner of the horse may forcefully retrieve their horse when the rented horse is checked into a stable, or if you are not connected to the game.
You can enjoy the effects of the gear already equipped on the rented horse, but you will not be able to unequip any gear from the rented horse.
You can rent out up to Tier 8 horses.



Added the following farming items. Anyone can plant them, but you must be at least Farming Artisan 1 to care for, harvest, or breed them. You can get these new farming items by using Plant Breeding on Special Chicken Feed or Special Haystack.

Spellbound Chicken Feed: This item takes up 4 grids in a fence garden and gives a 15% bigger yield than Special Chicken Feed.
Spellbound Haystack: This item takes up 5 grids in a fence garden and gives a 25% bigger yield than Special Haystack.



System

For optimization purposes, notifications for when an adventurer whom you have registered as a friend the Friend (N) window logs in or out of the game will no longer appear if you are participating in a Node/Conquest War.

Specifically, this will only apply if: you are participating in a Node/Conquest War; the war is happening at the moment; and you are in the correct server for the war.
This change will not affect the notifications that appear when a fellow guild member logs in or out.



Mounts

You can no longer perform any social actions immediately after entering FocusFire mode.

You can no longer perform social actions to recover Stamina while mounting a ship.


Class Changes

Sorceress

Stamina will no longer recover while Prime: Crow Flare is in use.


Berserker

The cooldown for Awakening: Tantu's Iron Buster will now be applied when changing from Axe to Iron Buster mode by using the skills Headbutt, Frenzied Destroyer, then Ground Lifting.

Fixed the issue where Berserker would momentarily slow down when using Buster Training laterally after certain skills.

After Succession, combo to Prime: Raging Thunder from Lava Piercer will now be easier.


Valkyrie

You can now use Ultimate: Blitz Stab immediately after Blitz Stab.

After using Blitz Stab, press RMB to use Ultimate: Blitz Stab.
Therefore, Ultimate: Blitz Stab was changed to a combo skill that cannot be used separately from regular Blitz Stab.



You can now use Blitz Stab by pressing ↑ + RMB while using a longsword.

The movement distance for Shield Chase I, Shield Chase II, and Prime: Shield Chase has been changed to match that of Shield Chase III.

The block effects for Shield Chase I, II, and III were unified to all be Forward Guard effects, and an immunity to CC status effects was added for the Forward Guard effects.

The cooldown for Verdict: Lancia Iustitiae was adjusted as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/a8a6b89a115ba6ee6bd8e33d4254f88158dd90bf.png

Added an All DP decrease effect to Wave of Light.

You will now remain in lancia mode when using Death Line Chase backwards.
However, the skill switches to Shield Chase when used consecutively.



The attack range for Flow: Lucem Fluxum was adjusted to match its effects.

The attack range for Terra Sancta was increased (matching the range of the wave hit), and a 100% Critical Hit effect was added for PvE.

The number of hits for Promptness in PvP was reduced to 4 hits, and the amount of damage per hit was decreased.

When used when the skill is not in cooldown, Promptness will have a 100% Critical Hit effect.


Item Changes

Removed the sentence " The time may be reduced by enhancing this processing stone." from the descriptions of Loggia, Techthon, and Manos Processing Stone items.

Added a list of daily quests you can complete to get flares to the item description of flare.

For details on the newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Fixed the issue where the first attack was delayed after summoning certain boss monsters during the main quests.

Reduced the population of the following monsters in Balenos.

Grass Beetle
Parasitic Bee
Fox
Wolf
Weasel



Quests & Knowledge

Quests

Fixed the issue where you could not get the following titles if you chose to do the renewed Mediah main quests. Talk to the following NPCs after completing certain quests to get the titles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/9ef2c3f55bfdc3d0036de943bda27a922536c627.png

Added a warning that you need to have at least two empty Inventory slots for the quest [Kamasylvia] A Poacher's Suggestion, and made Friella's pet mouse easier to steal.

Smoothed out the Calpheon main quests between Behr and Hexe Sanctuary as follows.

Moved certain quest NPCs to the front of NPC Becker's cabin, and made it so that you would return to Behr after completing the main quests at Hexe Sanctuary.



Increased the number of boxes or crates you can interact with to complete quests in the following regions.

Duvencrune
Grána
Calpheon City
Port Epheria
Brellin Farm
Outpost Supply Port
Heidel
Altinova
Valencia City


After the first discovery of Igor Bartali's Adventure Log, many more adventure logs have been discovered in the world of Black Desert Online. To help those of you who might have felt intimidated by all the different quests needed to start these adventure logs, we have gathered up all the quests necessary for starting an adventure log under one tab in the Quests (O) window. We hope that changes like this will make this content feel less daunting and more like adventures you can't wait to start.

Added a tab that has all the quests for starting an adventure log to the Suggested tab in the Quests (O) window.


Interface Changes

Added automatic line breaks to the topics listed in the Interest Knowledge Status window.

If the name of quests or conversation topics that appear when you converse with an NPC is cut off from the UI because it is too long, you can now hover over the text to read the entire entry.

If you try to throw away an item from the Inventory but miss the trash can icon, the icon will become emphasized.

A notification window will now appear if you try to exchange items with certain NPCs. The window will allow you to confirm the exchange that is about to happen.

Added the following text to the explanation for Central Market Warehouse Capacity: Additional Central Market Warehouse Capacity based on Family Fame Bonus can only be applied to a maximum of 2,000 VT.

Matched the color of the grades of ecology themed knowledge entries in the Knowledge (H) window to the color that appears when you first get those certain grades of knowledge.

The following message will now appear when trying to change the position of your guild member who is registered as a War Hero of another guild: You cannot assign a position to War Heroes.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where the Find NPC function is sometimes not working for NPCs who exist in multiple locations.

[Ranger] Fixed the issue where MP did not recover when activating the skill Penetrating Wind by using Flow: Kiss of the Wind.

[Maehwa Succession] Fixed the graphical issue with Maehwa's weapons when auto-navigating in combat mode.

Fixed the issue where "Node Tax Info." button was visible when interacting with the node managers of certain regions where there are no Node Wars.

Fixed the issue where you could not catch local fish near the inaccessible areas around Sherekhan Mine Road or Blood Wolf Settlement.

Fixed the issue where there were safe zones where there should not be near the Quartermaster NPC of Battle Arena.

Fixed the issue where certain structures and characters looked unnatural in the following places.

Titium Valley
Duvencrune Farmland
Sycraia Underwater Ruins



You will now get a notification if you try to do certain actions with insufficient guild funds like repairing guild mounts at the stable or wharf, or treat injuries.

The button to declare war on other guilds will no longer appear in the Guild (G) window if your guild has reached the maximum number of guilds it can declare war against.

You can no longer use the buttons on the bottom of the Inventory (I) window (i.e. buttons for Totem, Alchemy Stone, Processing, Palette) if you have it set as a Sticker UI, then open a full-screen window such as the Pearl Shop or Dye windows.

Fixed the issue where Today's Journal did not display entries for the times your ship was wrecked.

Fixed the issue where the display for Combat EXP was acting abnormally after reaching Lv. 66.

Fixed the issue where the size of the My Information (P) window reset after adjusting it then reconnecting to the game.

Fixed the issue where you could sometimes not progress with taming a baby elephant if you were disconnected in the middle of capturing one.

[Shai] Fixed the graphical issue with the background for the icons for horse, camel, and campsite gear in the Dye window.

Fixed the graphical issue with underwear that occured when dyeing with Merv's Palette.

Made the camera angle more natural when interacting with the walls of Valencia Castle.

[Witch & Wizard] Added a graphical effect to make the Glorious Shudad Staff glow.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/6adefec255a129811350f118c78408f6f960167f.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Our little Shai is getting ready today for a special feature that will make her more unique than ever. Starting today Shai will be able to play her own musical compositions! We also have a special competition for the most talented and creative; participate in the Shai Got Talent contest to win special rewards and titles!

Moreover, our shelves are receiving a new adventure journal, and this time we will look back at the adventures of Dorin Morgrim. By completing his journal you will not only get reward items but a temporary Item Drop Rate buff!

Last but not least, new mid season events are starting after maintenance. These include new attendance rewards, EXP boosts, and an upgraded version of the Black Spirit Adventure game!

What are you waiting for? Read the rest of the details in this week's patch notes below! Enjoy the new contents and good luck!

Major Update: Dorin Morgrim's Adventure Log

Added a new adventure log, "Dorin Morgrim's Secret Journal."

You can access this adventure log after reaching Lv. 56 by accepting and completing the quest "Adventure Log: Stories of a Great Blacksmith" via the Black Spirit.

You can now compose scores and make songs of your own.
Though any character can compose, only a Shai character can play the composed songs.

A song in composition is regularly auto-saved by the system, but you can also name the song and save it manually.
As a Shai, select a song from your list in the Music Album and press the play button to play the song as your character. Before you play the song, you have to choose which instrument you are going to play from all the instruments that the song was written for.

notes.title: Game Package Renewal
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/902215bf40ce68c9e4f2c5f74af482d0b0ae9fa4.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,

It has been three years already since Black Desert Online was first introduced on the Steam platform. How time flies!

We have been striving to provide better service in line with a constantly changing game environment, so we wanted to bring changes to the current game packages on sale next week, May 27, 2020.

Please find the new package name, price, and details below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/6dcb4206894f57979d6f5fe7e9638407872dc198.png

Please find the new upgrade bundles below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/805b76ed5d55c352f452866643ee9a3733576ea5.png

FAQ

• Can I upgrade the package I have purchased?

- Yes, you can! Simply log into your account, then to Shop > Packages, and choose the package you want to upgrade to.
- If you have a Basic Package, you will receive the contents listed under Standard Package if you buy the Standard Package Upgrade bundle. However, if you upgrade to a Deluxe Package from Basic Package, you will not receive contents from both Standard Package and Deluxe Package; you will only receive the contents listed under Deluxe Package Upgrade 1 bundle.

• If I have already purchased Starter's Package, Traveler's Package, or Explorer's Package, is it possible to upgrade to the new packages?

- Yes. If you have bought any kind of previous version of the package before May 27, 2020, you can purchase a new upgrade package (Standard Upgrade Package , Deluxe Upgrade Package) and will get all extra items. All kinds of the previous version are treated as a Basic package.

• If I upgrade the package, do I receive all benefits again?

- As you are only paying the price difference between the two packages, you will only receive the item difference between them. For example, if your previous package contained one Value Pack and the upgraded package contained two Value Packs, you would receive one additional Value Pack with your purchase.
- The difference in packages will be shown on the page before you confirm your purchase, so you can review it before making a decision.

Have you bought a game package recently?

For those of you who have made a recent purchase of a game package or upgrade package, you may be disappointed with the sudden change in game packages.

Therefore, we have prepared a small token of compensation. If you have bought a game package in the period listed below, you will be eligible to receive the compensation.

Your Game Package Purchase Period: May 6, 2020 (14:00 UTC)–May 27, 2020 (05:00 UTC) 
Compensation Distribution: During May 27, 2020 regular maintenance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/baed5ab1720bb2579ca6643c5677f76fcb11cfd4.png


Thank you,
BDO Team

Open the Black Spirit's gift to obtain items that will increase enhancement chance.




Interface Changes

The View Server Details button will now change to a "Hide Server Details" button once the server details are opened up.

The control commands guide was revamped for quests during which you interact with places or structures and observe them closely.

A description was added to the bottom of the controls guide for quests during which you interact with places or structures and observe them closely.

The Arsha server from the Select Server window will now display a sword and shield icon, instead of the fort icon.

Fixed the issue where it was not possible to use the Invite War Hero function if the font size was set to "Big" or "Bigger."

Fixed the issue where the description text when installing a curtain at a Residence was bleeding outside of the text box.

Fixed the issue where the equipment window was abnormal in certain situations in Personal Transactions.

Fixed the issue where the cow milking minigame sometimes automatically started after successfully milking another cow.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where looting was not possible in certain servers after defeating world boss Garmoth.

Please check the official forum post  for details.



Fixed the intermittent issue that occurs when your guild status does not get updated for guild members.

[Mystic] Fixed the issue where the [Mystic] Zebra Underwear would be displayed on top of certain outfits.

Fixed the issue where items equipped with crystals could not be fixed from Anvil.

Fixed the issue where characters would be pushed back by monsters when using skills with charging effects against monsters.

[Maehwa] Fixed a text issue in the skill description about how to use Petal Drill.

[Maehwa] Fixed a text issue in the skill description about how to use Frost Pillars. 

Fixed the issue where you were directed to the incorrect NPC when searching for Furniture Dealer in the Find NPC feature at Calpheon City.

Fixed the issue where the Toxic Watermelon appeared to look unnatural at Titium Valley.

Fixed the issue where the grass in certain areas of Khalk Canyon appeared as if it were floating in the air.

Fixed the issue where certain structures at certain parts of Rhua Tree Stub appeared to be floating in the air.

Fixed the issue where FocusFire would occasionally not work properly (switch modes or fire) after demounting after initially using FocusFire.

Fixed the issue where the Adventure Log progress UI would occasionally not be displayed.

Fixed the issue where the durability notification would not be displayed on the bottom right of the screen when the durability of gathering tools were below 10%.

[Maehwa] Fixed the issue where unnatural motions would be displayed when pressing the Tab key to switch to combat mode while crouching down with the Q key.

Fixed the issue where a Ross Sea node appeared near the Oquilla Coast on the World Map.

[Shai] Fixed the graphical issue with Shai's vitclari that occured when she was wearing the Kibelius Divinus outfit.

[Valkyrie] Fixed the graphical issue with the longsword that occured when wearing the Solaria outfit.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where [Daily Special] items sold in the Pearl Shop (F3) may not be refreshed. This will be resolved with next maintenance. For now, please exit to the character selection screen then log back into the game to see the refreshed daily specials. 

We are aware of the issue where the [Witch] Ivies Outfit Set and Lychnia Headpiece items for all classes appear even if you filter for a single class in the Apparel tab of the Pearl Shop (e.g. even if you filter for Tamer you will still these items that are not meant for Tamer).

We are aware of the issue where [Special] Pearl Box - 10000+1500 does not appear in the Pearl Shop (F3).

This issue is expected to be fixed with the May 20 maintenance.
Therefore, this item will be available to purchase from the Pearl Shop until May 27 (before maintenance), instead of May 20 (before maintenance) as previously announced.



We are aware of the issue where the Ancado Inner Harbor storage expansion coupons are not tagged as "New" in the Pearl Shop (F3).

This issue is expected to be fixed with the May 20 maintenance.




Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - May 13th 2020 (Part 1)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/fc42cd299c1c5eb1c9d2ee37c08ee5f189b28940.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Enhanced skills have finally arrived for our new latest classes, Shai and Guardian. Push your powers to the new limit and discover new skills for both of them!

Also, we are approaching the Season of Life, and that means Life Skillers are in luck as they will be enjoying Life EXP boost and new events for a limited time. This is the perfect time to reach a new level in your favorite Life Skill and earn some good rewards!

Last but not least, help Lara and some children make their wishes come true by sending wish lanterns to the skies of Black Desert Online!

As usual, you can find the details of the new events and contents below. Enjoy!

Event & System

New Events

Season of Life

Event 1: Life Skill Boost

Period: May 13 (after maintenance)–June 3 (before maintenance)
During the entire event period, enjoy Life EXP +50% 24/7 (Trading and Barter is excluded).



Event 2: Life of Florin

Period: May 14 (00:00 UTC)–June 1 (23:59 UTC)
Log in to get event items like [Event] Valentine's Special Catalyst and [Event] Floramos Sprout that will lead you to bigger rewards!



Event 3. Life Skill Challenges

Period: May 14 (00:00 UTC)–June 2 (23:59 UTC)
During the series of 3 weeks, log in daily to obtain the following rewards that will help boost your Life Skills from the Challenges tab (Y).
Click  to learn about how you can become a life skill master in this season of life!




Wishes for the Sky

Period: May 13 (after maintenance)–May 20 (before maintenance)
Head over to the Coastal Cliff in Balenos, then accept and complete one of the following random quests from NPC Lara located on the Coastal Cliff to obtain [Event] Seal of Wishes.
Click  to see how you can help wishes come true.



Patrigio's Shop Renewal

Period: May 13 (after maintenance)–May 20 (before maintenance)
During the event period,  Patrigio will present new and changed offers in his secret shop.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/75e9094d4ad8cbc56601abdde486531c01e9a0f9.png
 Patrigio can be found in various regions like Velia, Heidel, Calpheon City, Altinova, and Valencia City. Or search his name in Nearby NPC menu window brought up by pressing Find NPC icon on top right corner of your screen.
 Patrigio will only open up his shop from 10:00 PM–07:00 AM (in-game time).
Don't forget 50 energy will be consumed to check his list of offers.



Newly Discovered Treasures

Period: April 29 (after maintenance)–May 27 (before maintenance)
During the event period, the following rare items, considered as treasures, will be available in additional areas.
The treasures will be available to obtain in all servers including Olvia and Arsha.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/bb8ea633e6cb14413534c718c97d377d0276d0d4.png



Ongoing Events

Springfest

Special Attendance Rewards: April 30 (00:00 UTC)–May 13 (23:59 UTC)



Ended Events

Springfest

Hidden Surprise
Got Milk?
No Train No Gain



Wacky Toshi's Research


Reward Distribution

The following compensation will be sent to all adventurers (EU and NA) for the staggered maintenance performed earlier this week to resolve the non-loot issue that occurred on April 30 when Garmoth spawned in the NA Kamasylvia 4 server.

Case 1: For both EU and NA adventurers.

This applies to any adventurer who were logged into the game 30 minutes before and after Garmoth's death (April 30 19:55 PDT–April 30 20:55 PDT or April 30 21:55 CEST–April 30 22:55 CEST) but were not in the NA Kamasylvia 4 server.
Compensation: Garmoth Reward Bundle (Advanced) x1



Case 2: For NA adventurers who experience the non-loot issue

This applies to any adventurer in the NA server who were logged into NA Kamasylva 4 server 30 minutes before and after Garmoth's death (April 30 19:55 PDT–April 30 20:55 PDT). 
Compensation: Garmoth Reward Bundle (Advanced) x2



Please note Case 1 and Case 2 compensations do not stack and Case 2 takes precedence over Case 1. This means if you fall under Case 2, you will receive only the compensation for Case 2.
If you were logged in but inactive during the periods mentioned above, you may not be eligible to receive the rewards.
Please check your in-game mailbox after maintenance if you fall in the group above.



Additional Garmoth Summon

On Thursday May 14, Garmoth will appear one additional time in both EU and NA servers. 

After the initially-summoned Garmoth is defeated on Thursday, a second one will appear within a few minutes.




Content

Major Update: Guardian

Guardian Enhanced Skills were added.

The first Enhanced Skill can be learned after reaching Lv. 56, and the second Enhanced Skill can be learned after reaching Lv. 57.
You must first learn any relevant preceding skills in order to learn the Enhanced Skills.
You can only learn one out of the two Enhanced Skills available for each level (this means you will ultimately have a choice of two skills out of four).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/624b05a5fcbf270fa9d548f240a972312dd0a3da.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/e31a4c4394b90a64a641c5932a3d51cf079819a4.png



Major Update: Shai
Shai is such an unique class, and we originally envisioned that through Talent her skillset will be solid enough without Skill Enhancement. However, many of you have constantly asked for Skill Enhancement for Shai. That is why we have decided to add in this content after all, in a way that will highlight Shai's uniqueness.

The Lv. 56 Enhanced Skills will summon light from the vitclari that will follow an enemy or ally for various effects. Over There! will follow one enemy and attack them, while Sharing is Caring will follow an enemy or ally to heal your nearby allies. During the skill Sharing is Caring, if the light comes across an enemy before an ally it will follow the enemy, but it will still heal any of your allies near that enemy and will not heal any enemies.

The Lv. 57 skills will use the florang to deal damage. Twirl-Boom! swiftly and powerfully attacks enemies while Tumble Wumble! deals less damage but raises your defense and applies a bound effect in PvE.

Shai Enhanced Skills were added.

The first Enhanced Skill can be learned after reaching Lv. 56, and the second Enhanced Skill can be learned after reaching Lv. 57.
You must first learn any relevant preceding skills in order to learn the Enhanced Skills.
You can only learn one out of the two Enhanced Skills available for each level (this means you will ultimately have a choice of two skills out of four).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/db64943098df854ee11936729d5fe82dcb13aaff.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/77dc2aadafa63921e27d7aec4a44ca995a0ff46d.png



Added the "Garnier Troupe" Chat Group where you can discuss Compose and Play related content.

The actual Compose and Play feature will be added during the May 20 maintenance. 



Increased the maximum level of the guild skill Ample Storage.

Therefore, the maximum number of guild storage slots have been increased too.



Changed the rate at which Black Spirit's Rage recovers as follows.

Before

+0.15% per sec



After

+1.5% per 10 sec



Therefore, the description of Shai's skill Time to Shine! has been changed.



System

Optimized the system to improve upon the lag issues that occur when too many adventurers congregate in one location.

Added Performance Optimization settings to the Settings > Performance Settings > Optimization settings.

Turning on the Performance Optimization settings will enhance the game's performance, but will increase the memory usage.



Game World, NPC & Effects

NPC

Many adventurers have visited Oquilla's Eye, and now the areas around Oquilla Coast have been expanded, opening up new seaways.

Improvements were made so that interactions with Cook Weikid Taha at Kusha in Mediah would not be impeded by the cooking objects.

Fixed the issue where the Enhanced Manshaum Totem at the cave in Manshaum Forest would remain as a question mark (?) on the minimap even after gaining the relevant knowledge.

The question mark for the NPC above can be removed by obtaining the knowledge of "Brand of Ahib."



Yianaros the Spirit, which only appears during the Kamasylvia sub-quests, will no longer appear as a question mark (?) in the minimap.


Mounts

The aiming point for FocusFire was changed.

It shapes into the form of an arc depending on the distance.

notes.title: Together with Adventurers Worldwide - Black Desert Heidel Ball: AT HOME
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/eb5fac23d44448d1609b72afe7184e4f834825ac.jpg

Who can participate?
All Adventurers who love Black Desert!

Event Date
[table]
[tr]
[th]Black Desert Heidel Ball: AT HOME[/th]
[th]May 30, 2020 (Sat)[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

Where will it be held?
To be Announced

★ Hooray! Announcing Black Desert’s 1st Online Ball! ☆

With everyone around the world practicing social distancing, we invite Adventurers worldwide to an online ball!

After much thought while in the midst of event preparation, we decided to hold our first-ever “Global Ball” through the form of an “Online Event” to let Adventurers of NA/EU meet Adventurers from across the globe.

Living up to the title, “Black Desert Heidel Ball: AT HOME”, you’ll be able to meet Adventurers from Korea, Japan, Russia, North America, Europe, Taiwan, South America, Turkey, the MENA region, and Southeast Asia from the comfort of your own home.

Many regions, united by the love for Black Desert… ♥

Keeping in mind that we may all speak different languages and come from different cultural backgrounds, we did our best to create a meaningful and festive event for all Black Desert Adventurers. (๑˘ꇴ˘๑)

We wanted to bring together Adventurers worldwide, and share what's coming up for Black Desert. On top of that, we wanted to host a variety of fun-filled events for everyone!

We hope you’re just as excited as we are!

This will be for PC and console players in Korea, Japan, Russia, North America, Europe, Taiwan, South America, Turkey, the MENA region, Thailand, and Southeast Asia.

Don’t miss this extraordinary chance to join your fellow Adventurers worldwide who all enjoy Black Desert in their own, unique ways!

Plus, we’ve prepared a place to be with you in the Black Desert world, so we can soothe the pain of not being able to see you in-person.
 
Where could that be?
Find out the answer to that question by checking out all the details of [Princess Jarette's Invitation] below!

■ What is [Princess Jarette's Invitation]?

[Princess Jarette's Invitation] is a ticket that lets you enter the online space specially prepared for the Black Desert Heidel Ball: AT HOME.
Up to 200 Adventurers will be selected from everyone who submits their story in the [Princess Jarette's Invitation] survey linked below.
Adventurers with [Princess Jarette's Invitation] will get together in a special place on the day of the ball to enjoy the event and participate in a Q & A session.
Adventurers who are selected for [Princess Jarette's Invitation] will receive in-game rewards (title and items).
The entire Heidel Ball: AT HOME will be broadcasted live on Youtube and Twitch, so anyone can join from the comfort of their home even without [Princess Jarette's Invitation].


Though we are sad that we cannot enjoy the event together in real life, we hope that Heidel Ball: AT HOME will be a fun opportunity to spend time together as characters in the game.

[Princess Jarette's Invitation] Survey Period
May 12, 2020 (Tue) [After Announcement]–May 18, 2020 (Mon) at 07:00 UTC

Number of Winners
Up to 200 Winners

Winners Announcement Date
May 20, 2020 (Wed)

[Princess Jarette's Invitation] Delivery Date
During the maintenance on May 27, 2020 (Wed)

[Princess Jarette's Invitation] Survey Link
Click here!

★ Special Event
In the survey, please provide a video message of something you want to say to Adventurers worldwide!

We will select videos to be used in our celebratory video for the Black Desert Heidel Ball: AT HOME, so we hope you’ll participate in the celebrations!

P.S. If your video is included in the celebratory video, you’ll receive a Special Goods Package!

※ Notices

More information regarding [Princess Jarette’s Invitation] will be provided at a later date in the [Princess Jarette’s Invitation] winners announcement.

In-game rewards (title and items) will be announced in the [Princess Jarette’s Invitation] winners announcement.

Up to 200 Adventurers will be selected from participants who properly complete the [Princess Jarette’s Invitation] application.

The [Princess Jarette’s Invitation] winners will be announced on our official website on May 18, 2020 (Mon). However, this date is subject to change depending on the circumstances.

Winners of the [Princess Jarette’s Invitation] ticket will be contacted separately by email.

The [Princess Jarette’s Invitation] ticket cannot be given away to someone else.

Pearl Abyss and Kakaogames reserve the right to change or cancel the event depending on circumstances. Any changes made to the event will be posted on this event page.

Participating in the event using inappropriate methods will result in a cancellation/retrieval of your reward and restriction from the game.

Violating the Terms of Service may result in your disqualification and withdrawal of any prizes/rewards even after the winners announcement has been posted.

If you have any questions about this event, please send a ticket through [Support > Submit a Ticket] on the official website.

Please contact Customer Support if you would like to remove information from your event application or if you would like to cancel your application.

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 29th 2020
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/oIyoCKM.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

From the skies of Drieghan, hear her roar! Garmoth's threat is increasing, as her attack pattern changes. 

In the meantime, celebrate Spring with our Springfest. Gathering, Fishing and Defeating Monsters comes with a hidden surprise and we have a special additional Combat/Skill EXP +50% bonus when using Book of Training to help you.

Finally, Wacky Toshi needs help with his research and is looking for more samples!

You can read the rest of details of this week's update below:

*Please note we will perform a server restart for 2 hours next Wednesday (May 6th) instead of performing a regular maintenance. Check out our official website for more information!


Event & System

New Events

Springfest: Spring into action and enjoy the following events all prepared for the warm weeks ahead!

Event 1: Hidden Surprise

Period: April 29 (after maintenance)–May 13 (before maintenance)
Defeat monster, gather, and fish [Event] Matryoshka Pieces to exchange with Sealus for [Event] Matryoshka dolls.



Event 2: Got Milk?

Period: April 29 (after maintenance)–May 13 (before maintenance)
Process [Event] Nutritious Pellet with haystack or feed items to get event more nutritious crops. 



Event 3: No Train No Gain

Period: April 29 (after maintenance)–May 13 (before maintenance)
Enjoy the additional Combat/Skill EXP +50% when using Book of Training items.



Event 4: Special Attendance Rewards

Period: April 30 (00:00 UTC)–May 13 (23:59 UTC)
Check the 'Special' tab in your attendance board daily and stack up on golden rewards including Golden Dagger, Golden Backpack, Golden Coelacanth, and even Advice of Valks (40–60)!



Click  to learn more about these series of events.



Wacky Toshi's Research

Period: April 29 (after maintenance)–May 13 (before maintenance)
Bring back a lot of Marni's Stones to use as samples for Wacky Toshi and he will reward you heavily.
Click  to learn more about how you can help Wacky Toshi!



Ongoing Events

Boost Boost Boost!: April 22–May 6 (23:59 UTC)


Ended Events

Mystical Ellie's Water Festival 2020

Finto's Juice Challenge


Content

Major Update - Changes in Garmoth's Attack Pattern

Changed the World Boss Garmoth's attack pattern.
Along with the release of Drieghan, Garmoth was introduced as a force to be reckoned with. However, as adventurers have become more powerful, Garmoth no longer seemed to pose a threat you would expect from a "Dragon". Attack patterns, such as when she is invincible while floating in the air, were merely an inconvenience to those fighting against Garmoth. Therefore we made some changes to her attack patterns.
In addition, we are thinking of ways to attach a sense of "challenge" and "rewards" to the world boss monsters, including Garmoth. However, we are trying to avoid suddenly increasing the difficulty, which may ruin your existing "play patterns".

The pattern in which Garmoth interacts with sculptures when first appearing or when her HP was reduced to a certain level was removed.
When Garmoth flies up during battle and begins to charge up magic, you must now hit the magic a certain amount of times for it to be destroyed.
If you do not disrupt Garmoth from charging up magic, Garmoth will cast a powerful magic attack.
The Kagtums which appear when Garmoth cries out as she flies up into the air will now have increased HP, and more of them will now appear.
Fixed the issue where Garmoth would go back immediately into the air after landing on the ground during combat.
Reduced the amount of times Garmoth deals a jump attack while fighting on the ground.
Added a slight standby period after Garmoth deals a powerful attack.



Garmoth's HP was increased by around 10%.
Garmoth's DP was decreased.



Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

Fixed the visual issue where underwater effect appeared when moving the camera in a certain region of Cokro Chamber.


NPC

You can now obtain the knowledge of Bochlo by talking to the NPC when you don't have this knowledge.


Class Changes

Sorceress

Removed the dispersed damage effect which would be applied on certain Main Weapon and Succession skills.

Sinister Energy
Absolute Darkness
Mark of the Shadow
Claws of Darkness
Signs of Agony



Valkyrie

Removed the dispersed damage effect which would be applied on certain Main Weapon and Succession skills.

Shield Strike
Shield Counter
Shield Push
Counter
Sharp Light
Punishment
Prime: Shining Dash 2nd Hit



Removed the dispersed damage effect which would be applied on certain Awakening skills.

Glissade
Black Spirit: Radiant Explosion


The dispersed damage effect refers to the damage reduced or divided by the number of targets when attacking several enemies. Though it was our intention to add this effect to some specific skills only, we have identified cases in which the effect was unnecessarily applied on certain skills. Hence we have examined all skills and removed the dispersed damage effect which was unnecessarily applied on certain skills for all classes. You can check those skills on which the dispersed damage effect is applied in each skill description.

Item Changes

Changed the grade of the following 4 cooking items from green to blue and the ration provided when using these items for Emergency Ration Supply was increased from 100 to 240.

Lean Lizard Kebabs
Fragrant Borscht
Chewy Desert Dumpling
Sour Pickled Fish



Improved the recipe for [Guild] Sea Monster's Neidan so that you could craft 10 of it at once.

Use Heating on Young Sea Monster's Neidan x100 and Black Stone Powder x10
Use Heating on Sea Monster's Neidan x100 and Black Stone Powder x10



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

CC status effect will now be applied normally when using attacks with this effect to any monsters from Drieghan's Blood Wolf Settlement.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Added a text that guides you to the NPC you should talk to when losing the item needed for accepting the quest "Collecting Traces" to its quest summary.

You can now accept the following quests when you have activated the Combat quest filter.

Cron's Current Condition
Story of Cron Castle



The notification text that appears when forfeiting a quest is now more precise and detailed.

Fixed the quest line for completing the quest "Black Spirit's Gift (Adventurer's Tome)."

Fixed the issue where the name of The Vengeful Spirit of Cron was being displayed incorrectly.


Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where the World Map (M)'s Node Information still showed the Investment Level gauge of the Node to which you had previously invested.

Added spacing to some of the texts that represent the day, hours, minutes, and/or seconds.

Added a text that informs you about the expiration date to the item descriptions of Weapon Exchange Coupons or Combat/Skill EXP Exchange Coupons with expiration dates.

Fixed the issue where the fog did not disappear from certain regions in the World Map (M) even after having found all nearby nodes.

Removed the word "Difficulty" from the Dark Rift list. Now, only the words that represent the difficulty (Normal, Difficult, or Very Difficult) will be displayed.

Fixed the issue where the texts for Occupying Areas from the Guild window overlapped when there were too many of them.

Fixed the issue where the Inventory and Storage balance from NPC Repair menu > Equipment window overlapped with the relevant category's description text.

Fixed the issue where the Navigate button of some unaccepted quests did not appear in the Quest Summary window.

The alert that appears together with the alert on low durability on the bottom right corner of the screen will now be displayed for 6 seconds instead of 60 seconds.

However, this change does not apply to Central Market alerts.



A message that indicates you don't have enough money will now be displayed when trying to recover a guild mount from the guild stable without sufficient guild funds.

Fixed the issue where the production time from the World Map (M)'s Map Production window was sometimes wrong.

Fixed the message that appears when trying to get an item while there is not enough space in the inventory to match the situation.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where you could not accept the quest for reobtaining Dim Magical Sub-weapon for the Witch class.

Fixed the issue where your character was pushed back by the monster when using a skill that had Charge effect to this monster. 

Fixed some monster names and texts that are related to items, quests, or knowledge to make them sound more natural.
        	
Fixed the typo in the following skills’ descriptions.

[Musa] Prime: Blooming
[Sorceress] Turn-back Slash               	



Weapon Exchange Coupons' tooltips regarding Caphras Stones have been updated. 

There is no spec change on weapon exchange coupons.


       	
[Witch] Fixed the issue where the distance moved when using Succession: Magical Evasion to the left was short compared to the distance moved when using the skill to the right.

Fixed the issue where the size of the NPC decreased when doing Conversation with the NPC Weikid Taha.

Fixed the issue where the name displayed after installing and interacting with Golden Amethyst Chandelier (Fluorescent) was incorrect.

Added a text to Golden Sunset Dining Table's item description.

Fixed the issue where the horse disappeared upon dying.

Fixed the awkward sound that played when using Volley or FocusFire with any Carrack.        


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where the Event tag for the following premium outfits on sale may not be removed:

[Musa] Western Frontiers Premium Set: Sale ends April 29th
[Wizard] Lord Red Premium Set: Sale ends May 6th

The sale on these outfits ended/will end according to the schedule announced and the event tag will be removed with May 13th maintenance. We apologize for the confusion.




We are aware of the issue where you can fire ship cannons with a character that is under Lv. 50. No damage will be applied when firing the ship cannons with such a character. We will inform you about any updates on this issue as soon as possible.

We are aware of the issue where the Hot Time icon for normal server boosts of Combat EXP +100%/Skill EXP +20% on weekdays and Combat EXP +200%/Skill EXP +20% is not showing up on the top part of your game screen after the Boost Boost Boost! EXP buff event ends with May 6 (23:59 UTC). Please note that Hot Time EXP boost is properly applied and this is just the icon not showing. The icon missing issue will be fixed with May 13th maintenance. We apologize for the confusion.

We are aware of the intermittent issue where [Oasis] Dream Chest can be obtained from the Challenge tab (Y) without having completed the necessary playtime. We are currently looking into resolving the issue. We apologize for the confusion.

[Updated May 1] We are aware of the issue where looting was not possible in certain servers after defeating world boss Garmoth. We are looking into the issue and will try to resolve it as soon as possible. We apologize for the inconveneince in your gameplay and we will continue to update you on the issue via our official forum .

[Updated May 5] We are aware of the intermittent issue that occurs when your guild status does not get updated for guild members. If this occurs, please return to the server you have first joined the guild in to see your status shown correctly for now. This issue will be resolved with the next maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience.

[Updated May 11] We are aware of an issue where using Breezy Sail in sequence while having Ebenruth's Nol equipped will stop your ship abnormally.
This issue will be fixed with May 13 maintenance.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Black Desert Online’s Executive Producer J’s Surprise Gift
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

As we endure the current global situation, Black Desert Online’s Executive Producer, Jae-Hee Kim, prepared a gift to all adventurers.

The Black Desert Online team wishes all adventurers and their families the best, and hope we can all pull through the situation together.

We would also like to ensure that all voices are heard so that we can continue to make the world of Black Desert a better place for all.

So please, do not hesitate to reach out to us as we appreciate all your feedback and endeavor to improve upon Black Desert Online together.
Thank You!


J’s Gift Coupon: BDOHOME
