notes.title: [Maintenance] Regular Maintenance March 11th 2020
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/hm73DDo.gif

Dear Players,

We will perform our weekly maintenance as follows:

Date: Wednesday, March 11th 2020

Duration: 4 hours.

Global 9:00 UTC ~ 13:00 UTC
Central (EU) 10:00 CEST ~ 14:00 CEST
West Coast (NA) 2:00 PDT ~ 6:00 PDT
East Coast (NA) 4:00 EDT ~ 8:00 EDT


Reasons:

Fourth Anniversary Celebration Part 2 will start. 

Three new bosses will appear from the Dark Rift for an event period.
Playtime Challenges will begin.
Wacky Toshi's Secret Request event will begin.



World Boss and Node/Conquest War schedule for the North American server will change due to the start of daylight saving.
The amount of Contribution EXP needed to gain Contribution Points will be reduced.
Class balance including changes to the accuracy rate of certain skills will be made.


Ending Events:

Pre-Anniversary Celebration

Event 1: Rebellion of Bosses
Event 2: Lara’s Four Requests



[Fourth Anniversary Special!] Thank You for Four Years
Festival of Horses

Note:

For Europe, summer time 2020 will begin on Sunday, March 29 (02:00 CET) and end on Sunday, October 25 (03:00 CET).


Follow us on Twitter & Facebook to stay up to date.

We apologize for the inconvenience and we ask for your generous understanding.


Best regards,
BDO Team

notes.title: O'dyllita Teaser - New Region Coming to Black Desert Online!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/9b354acca05ff65c7ed69d8aef5325ee420c0e7d.jpg

Players will be exploring a new region full of adventure and challenges soon!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F0ejC_H4e0Q

As appropriate for its dark reputation, O’dylitta has the most difficult areas currently in the game and as such will mark a true challenge for any adventurers that journey there. From the barren and rocky valleys inhabited by the downtrodden Olluns to the ruins of an ancient kingdom overrun by vicious Ahib in the dark forest of O’dylitta, this land is unforgiving but can yield immense rewards.

Intrepid players will be rewarded for braving the dangers of O’dylitta with the possibility of forging and collecting a new, marquee armor set; the Blackstar armor. By collecting materials in the various areas of O’dylitta players can start working on the long but rewarding journey towards completing and improving this new armor set that will surely make them the envy of many an adventurer.

The new update also brings a new suite of music with it, of which the O’dylitta overture is a highlight. Composed by Hwiman Ryu and arranged by Inro Joo both from Pearl Abyss and performed by the Staatskapelle Weimar

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lpUxziyNgeI

The cursed and haunted land of O'dyllita

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/a5532428f91d46af62f8dc698621fe2692f79aba.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/28eddc7d20c42ecd8fc9a6fe7228fa4edc02966c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/147afffa4f40832f93395cd9cae912fdd2b88aaa.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/d748ee44bb70b799abd300e3cbee2ed4e43c14ad.jpg

New armor set: Blackstar Armor

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/9c6dc47373448c6e92a21fd5f4b1e5a3e9b2931f.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/bb8b21af2ddea070a97206de9c28479d1ad81680.jpg

In addition to the new information shared about O’dyllita, today also marks the fourth anniversary of the game in North-American and European markets. To celebrate this occasion, multiple events and promotions have started and some noteworthy statistics were shared on the official website. Players can also start amassing up to $200,- in Pearl Shop items by logging in daily during the event period, more information about this event can be found here:

notes.title: Patch Notes - March 3rd 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/983931194e8761dda0a447a43adfeb77e7cf2be8.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

The fourth anniversary is here and to celebrate these four years spent with you, we prepared a lot of events for you!

This new update also brings a new challenge for the most ambitious adventurers with the newly added monster zone at Ash Forest! The AP and DP recommendation for this new area is 300 AP and 400 DP, so you better be prepared before you step foot there!

That's not all, the succession skills of the Guardian are becoming available this week! Enjoy the new powerful skills of the Black Desert Online's newest class!

Also, please note that daylight saving time 2020 for North America will begin on Sunday, March 8 (02:00 PST) and end on Sunday, November 1 (02:00 PST). For Europe, summer time 2020 will begin on Sunday, March 29 (02:00 CET) and end on Sunday, October 25 (03:00 CET).

Continue reading for details of the changes, fixes, and events including in this patch:


Event & System

New Event

Web Event

A Shift in the Dark Rift

Period: March 3 (16:00 UTC/ 17:00 CET/ 08:00 PST)– March 25 (09:00 UTC/ 17:00 CET/ 08:00 PST)
Check our official website the unstable Dark Rift that seems to be shifting every day and face off against a Dark Rift boss or answer a question correctly from one of several NPCs. For discount coupons, after you claim them from the in-game mailbox, you will have 3 days to register them from Inventory to coupon book on the Pearl Shop (F3), then 7 days to use the coupons before they expire.





Content

New Monster Zone at the Ash Forest
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/efe018c589e48a393afcc8fdf36b122da9ec5f83.png
We hope that this new monster zone gives ambitious adventurers a fresh new challenge. Just like how the difficult Aakman and Hystria Ruins monster zones were eventually bested by many of you, we eagerly anticipate you eventually mastering this new monster zone.

Added a new monster zone at the Ash Forest.

The recommended AP is 300 and the recommended DP is 400, the highest so far in Black Desert Online.
The aura of hatred caused by the ghosts of Ash Forest makes it difficult to use spirits or magic in the Ash Forest.

This means that if even if your character has any summoned creatures, the monsters will attack your character first. The monsters will only start attacking the summoned creatures after the number of monsters your character can detect has been exceeded.




The following monsters will appear at Ash Forest.

Volkras
Barnas
Gairas



Added a new accessory, Deboreka Necklace, which can be looted from monsters at the Ash Forest.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/d2a4bcb7217fcb5f39a3f74cc308d5fe77fa0fc7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/c071b52cb7f19cfb6522309c62edc700dbbe7079.png


Blue Grade Epheria Carrack Ship Parts

Added blue grade ship parts that can be equipped on Epheria Carrack: Advance, Epheria Carrack: Balance, Epheria Carrack: Volante, or Epheria Carrack: Valor.

Please note that the type of ship parts must match the type of Epheria Carrack you own.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f77b9107f43e3221a28a982c3b49725dd9a149c6.jpg
The effects of the new blue grade Epheria Carrack ship parts may differ depending on the type of Epheria Carrack they are meant for, to complement the characteristics of each type of Epheria Carrack.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/250ecb5b936c80abb0125273265f2fd9e24657c6.jpg
The following is a list of Epheria Carracks in the order of most to least amount of damage their cannons deal.

Epheria Carrack: Valor > Epheria Carrack: Volante > Epheria Carrack: Balance > Epheria Carrack: Advance



The cannon reload speed of Epheria Carrack: Volante and Epheria Carrack: Valor gets faster when they are equipped with the new Epheria Carrack: Volante (Chiro's Cannon) or Epheria Carrack: Valor (Chiro's Cannon), respectively.

Epheria Carrack: Volante: Cannon reload speed -1 sec
Epheria Carrack: Valor: Cannon reload speed -2 sec




The materials needed for each new blue grade Epheria Carrack ship parts are as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/eb5313b5aaad4d41e68aa66e4d622dacecf4e03f.jpg

Added the new items "Starlight Powder" and "Sunset Black Stone."

Starlight Powder is needed to craft Sunset Black Stone, which is needed to enhance the new ship parts.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/c9383d7f2218ba15813e3dcdee097be050589449.jpg



You can now get some of the materials needed to make the new blue grade Epheria Carrack ship parts (Starlight Powder and blueprints suitable for each ship part) at a certain chance at the nodes listed below. 

Chiro's Cannon Workshop at Al-Naha Island
Chiro's Sail Workshop at Racid Island
Chiro's Prow Statue Workshop at Tinberra Island
Chiro's Black Plating Workshop at Lerao Island



You can spend 10 Energy at each island's node manager to discover these new nodes. The node managers for each island are as follows.

Al-Naha Island: Rundgel
Racid Island: Kunka
Tinberra Island: Shanjo
Lerao Island: Leph



Added Chiro's Ship Part Workshop to the house at Iliya Island 3.

At Chiro's Ship Part Workshop you can craft the 16 new blue grade Epheria ship parts as well as Sunset Black Stone which is needed to enhance them.



You can get the Epheria Carrack Parts Upgrade Permit items from Philaberto Falasi of Port Epheria.


New Sea Monster Content

Added a new Sea Monster Habitat in the northern waters of Margoria.

Fierce monsters swim from even further north to feed there. According to some courageous adventurers, we know that the following sea creatures frequent the area.

Saltwater Crocodile
 Black Rust
 Nineshark




You can loot Violent Sea Monster's Bone, Violent Sea Monster's Scale, or Violent Sea Monster's Ooze at a certain rate from Saltwater Crocodile,  Black Rust, or  Nineshark.

You can loot Saltwater Crocodile's Scale from Saltwater Crocodile.

A maximum of three adventures can loot from monsters at this new habitat. Item Collection Increase Scroll items do not take effect there.

Added the following new items to the Sea Coin Exchange shop.

Wave Residue Adhesive
Starlight Hardener
Starlight Emulsifier



Reduced the number of parley points consumed when bartering at the following locations in Margoria by 20%.

Shipwrecked Cargo Ship
Incomplete Ship
Langtia's Combat Raft



Reduced the number of amity points needed to buy donkey gear sold at the amity shop of Partus, the stable keeper of Keplan, from 500 to 50.


System

Fixed the issue where the client crashed with certain hardware.


Mounts

Destroying a Galley in forced PvP mode will decrease your Karma by 200,000 alike the other boats.


Class Changess

Berserker

You can now control the direction of Prime: Raging Thunder skills by moving during the skill with directional keys.

Therefore, the movement speed of these skills has decreased.



You can now combo Ultimate: Evasion or Shake Off skills faster after a combo of Prime: Predatory Hunt and Lava Piercer.

Prime: Ancient Wave can now be used instantly after the following skills.

Prime: Fierce Strike skills
Prime: Frenzied Destroyer skills with Double Smash
Prime: Storming Beast



You can now combo Prime: Devastation after the following skills.

Prime: Fierce Strike skills
Prime: Frenzied Destroyer skills with Double Smash
Prime: Storming Beast



Fixed the issue where you could not move or perform combos after Prime: Ancient Wave.

Changing the direction during the last hit of Prime: Beastly Wind Slash skills should now be easier.

You no longer have to hold LMB + RMB to continue using Black Spirit: Raging Thunder or Black Spirit: Prime: Raging Thunder skills.

You can end the above skills by pressing the LMB or Space Bar to trigger the last hit.



Fixed the issue where the accuracy rate of Prime: Ancient Wave was not correctly applied.

Fixed the issue where the wrong number of hits appeared in the skill descriptions of Black Spirit: Prime: Raging Thunder skills.

We were not satisfied with the number of suitable Succession versus Awakening skills the Berserker could use during the cooldown of Raging Thunder and Feral Rage skill. Therefore, we reworked Succession skills such as Prime: Ancient Wave and Prime: Devastation so they can be used instantly after certain skills. We also reworked the Prime: Raging Thunder skills. Instead of simply increasing the movement speed, which might make the skills trickier to use, we decided instead to allow you more control over how Prime: Raging Thunder moves.

Tamer

Increased the casting speed of Ultimate: Echo Pierce to match that of other Echo Pierce skills.

Changed the damage dealt by Legendary Beast Dance skills as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/3620f0835f78ffec63cf2f336513599047c7b256.jpg

Changed the damage dealt by the Flow: Ascension, which needs to be used after a Garuda skill, to correlate to the extra hit damage of the Garuda skill.

Changed the damage dealt by Flow: Intimidation as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/ffc8a9914d6c762238d5455e51afd495fa779c11.jpg

Tree Climb skills are now quick slot available.

We have noticed that many still use the Tamer's Main Weapon skills due to the relatively low damage dealt by her Awakening skills. Therefore, we have adjusted the damage stats of Awakening skills such as Legendary Beast Dance, Flow: Intimidation, and Flow: Ascension skills to be comparable to Main Weapon skills such as Heilang: Whiplash. We have also changed how Echo Pierce skill works. We have increased the casting speed of Ultimate: Echo Pierce so the only remaining difference between it and the regular Echo Pierce skills should be the amount of damage and attack range. If you want a skill with higher damage we recommend you choose regular Echo Pierce and if you want to concentrate on forward attacks we recommend Ultimate: Echo Pierce.

Valkyrie

You can now combo Lancia Training lateral attack or Sacrum Ferit lateral attack after Sanctitas de Enslar skills.

You can now combo Flow: Revelation Sanctus after Sanctitas de Enslar skills.

The following will now take effect if you use a Breath of Elion skill after learning Flow: Breath of Elion.

Critical Hit Rate 10% for 15 sec to self and nearby allies
Increase Movement Speed 20% for 15 sec to self and nearby allies



You can now combo forward Death Line Chase or Promptness before the last hit of a Hastiludium skill.

Casting a Hastiludium skill during Death Line Chase is now faster.

Fixed the issue where entering the command keys for Purificatione during Death Line Chase activated Promptness and its cooldown.

Fixed the issue where text saying that Succession: Flow: Spinning Shield consumes Stamina was not included in the skill description.

We wanted to add more ways for the Valkyrie to approach her opponents in Awakening mode. Therefore we added the possibility to combo Death Line Chase, Hastiludium, and Promptness. We also changed certain skills so you can combo them with Sanctitas de Enslar skills.

Ninja

Changed the graphical effects of the following Awakening skills.

Vengeful Barrier
Flow: Execution
Murderous Intent during transition stance
Corrupt Sword Dance during transition stance
Sudden Decapitation during transition stance
Serpent Ascension during transition stance
Corrupt Sword Dance during Seamless
Sudden Decapitation during Seamless



Lahn

Increased the casting speed of Prime: Salp'uri Purge.

Increased the casting speed of Prime: Blooming Nether Flower.

You can now use Prime: Phantom Dance while during the pulling stage of Prime: Cymbidium.

Using Prime: Blade Dance will now have an Critical Hit Rate +50% effect.

Prime: Cymbidium skills have been changed as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/b8f0a0dec6ed96ff4733d075e1a36c907cf37c26.jpg

Changed the amount of HP recovered per every hit of a Prime: Crescent Barrage skill as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f8cd0ed74a46aeb628f1b34e5687fd300fa67e91.jpg

Fixed the skill description of Prime: Bleeding Hearts to match the actual throw damage skill effect.

Fixed the issue where slashing would start before the dash during Prime: Spring Breeze skills on uneven terrain.

Fixed the issue where the Super Armor and Invincible effects of Nimbus Dismount and Fragrant Stigma skills were applied incorrectly during airborne moves.

Fixed the issue where the Super Armor effect disappeared before the last hit of Black Spirit: Prime: Pendulum Kick skills.

Added text to the skill description of Prime: Spring Breeze III saying a Super Armor effect will be applied when gliding down with the skill.

Fixed a text issue in the skill descriptions of Black Spirit: Cymbidium and Black Spirit: Prime: Cymbidium skills about down attacks.

Fixed the graphical issue with the Crescent Pendulum that occurred when climbing walls.

Our concept for Lahn's Succession skills was that her attacks will get stronger the longer she continues certain skills. However, even though Prime: Blade Dance and Prime: Cymbidium skills do get stronger when maintained, the risk taken when continuing the skills is so great it was a deterrent from using these skills as we designed. Therefore we adjusted the amount of damage that can be done with these skills, to make using these skills continuously more worth it. We also added more skill combo options so you can choose to combo certain skills instead of continuing the skill you are currently casting.

Guardian

Added the "Succession" content.

After Awakening the Guardian, accept the quest "[Guardian Succession] For Justice" from the Black Spirit to start the Succession quest series. 
You will learn the skill "Succession: Guardian's Glory" which will allow you to learn more powerful Battle Axe and Shield skills. 
You will no longer be able to use your Jordun skills. 
Added the "Succession" tab to the Skill window. The skills in this tab are affected by the AP of both Main and Awakening Weapons. 
You will be able to learn and use skills in both the "Main" and "Succession" tabs. However, if there is both an "Absolute" and "Succession" versions of the same skill, you must choose as you cannot use both versions of the skill. 
To learn certain Succession skills, you will first need to learn the preceding skills from the "Main" tab first. 
After completing the Succession quests and learning the skill "Succession: Guardian's Glory," you can go back and forth between Succession and Awakening skills by resetting your skills. 
To go from using Succession to Awakening skills, you need to reset your skills to unlearn "Succession: Guardian's Glory." 
To go from using Awakening to Succession skills, you need to reset your skills and relearn "Succession: Guardian's Glory."


With Succession, Guardian can use her battle axe and shield for even more ferocious skills. Not only will she be able to overpower her opponents, but she will also be able to take the brunt of their attacks for her allies and change the course of the battle.

Foretold Encounter can now be used while jumping in awakening mode.

You can now combo God Incinerator faster after Searing Fang or Flow: Suppress.

You can now combo Infernal Nemesis faster after Cleansing Flame or God Incinerator.

The All Accuracy Rate effect of all levels of Cleansing Flame has been changed to: All Accuracy Rate +9% for 10 sec. upon using skill.

Changed the location of the rocks that appear during Flow: Black Blood Eruption to be more natural.


Item Changes

Added text in the item description of Adventurer's Tome to say that you can upgrade the tome into Chenga - Sherekhan Tome of Wisdom.

Fixed the item descriptions of the following types of items that specified how many days you have to wait to use the items on a character of a recently released class.

(Main/Sub/Awakening) Weapon Exchange Coupon items
Combat/Skill EXP Exchange Coupon items



Fixed the item descriptions of crystals that can be fused into main weapon sockets to specifically say "main weapon" and not just say "weapon."

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Interface Changes

Updated the following UIs.

Lakario minigame
Hunting minigame
Server Change



Fixed the graphical issue with the background of the key guide that appears when exchanging items via an NPC.

Fixed the issue where the message that appears after you successfully combine items appeared multiple times.

Fixed the issue where the All Worker List window did not close when opening the World Map.

Fixed the issue where pets acted contradictory to what was set in via the Pet Command options after they were checked in and taken out.

An icon will now appear next to the names of servers with an ongoing EXP event.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the awkward auto-navigation paths around Arehaza Town.

[Guardian] Fixed the issue where the Guardian would not close her eyes while resting on a bed.

[Guardian] Fixed the issue where the plate of food would not disappear after the Guardian cheered after eating certain food items.

Fixed the issue where sound effects would be muted when logging into the game with a Lv. 1 character.

Fixed the issue where the following outfits looked awkward in certain situations when equipped.

[Ranger] Bern Armor
[Valkyrie] Solaria Shield
[Witch] Arcanis Robe



Fixed the issue where certain trees pierced the walls around Calpheon City.

Fixed the issue where a Sausan Watchtower spawned inside a building at the Sausan Garrison.

Fixed the issue where the amount of EXP to level up the following pets was set too low. Due to this issue, we have sent a compensation of Kanpacho's Chewable Tablet items based on the number of the listed pets you own or have exchanged. Please check your in-game mailbox (B) for the compensation.

Arctic Fox
Emperor Hawk
Haetae  



Resolved the issue where crashing would occur when launching the game from Alienware computers. 


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where the text "Growth Server" appears when placing the mouse over the EXP icons next to servers with an EXP event in progress. Please note this is a text issue and the icon itself has nothing to do with the Olvia (Growth) Server. The icons instead indicate the Combat EXP +200%, Skill EXP +30%, Life EXP +30%, and Item Drop Rate Boost +50% buffs from the promotional EXP event that are applied to all servers up to the March 18 maintenance.

We are aware of the issue where the following limited pets on [4th Anniversary] Limited Pet 2+2 Bundle show wrong availability periods:

Drifty Gosphy
Emperor Hawk
Lost Penguin
Snowflake Reindeer
Snowball Rosefinch
Snowflake Rosefinch

Please note [4th Anniversary] Limited Pet 2+2 Bundle and permanent pets included are sold until March 11 (before maintenance). We apologize for the confusion and inconvenience.





Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/d4686599874536e6bb2f7f49fb69c4afe422b40c.jpg

Event 1: SUPER FEVER TIME
Period: February 26 (after maintenance)–March 18 (before maintenance)

During the event period of 3 weeks, enjoy the following EXP boosts in every server including Olvia and Arsha servers. No matter where you take your adventures in, you will be able to enjoy the same EXP boosts!

[table]

(excludes Trading and Bartering)[/th]

EXP gained as quest completion reward is not affected by the EXP boosts above.

notes.title: Patch Notes - February 26th 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/3fe925e26741c6021a65557dbb40bbd2e671ca94.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Succession skills arrive for the Striker and the Mystic! This time the masters of the Echo Spirits and the Sea Dragon will recover their forgotten powers. Crush your enemies with the fiercest of punches and kicks!

Also, last week we started the celebrations of our 4th anniversary which we are continuing with our pre-anniversary celebrations. Can you believe it? It's been almost four years already, and we will continue celebrating this milestone with new events and special rewards!

To celebrate the official launch date of Black Desert Online for North America and Europe, we will be holding our regular maintenance next week on Tuesday March 3rd, 2020.

Thank you for playing Black Desert Online and for your continuous support!

Continue reading for details of the changes, fixes, and events including in this patch:


Event & System

New Events

Pre-Anniversary Celebration

Event 1: Super Fever Time

Period: February 26 (after maintenance)–March 18 (before maintenance)
During the event period of 3 weeks, enjoy Combat EXP +200%, Skill EXP +30%, Life EXP +20% (excluding Trading and Bartering), and Item Drop Rate boost +50% in every server including Olvia and Arsha servers. No matter where you take your adventures in, you will be able to enjoy the same EXP boosts!



Event 2: Rebellion of Bosses

Period: February 26 (after maintenance)–March 11 (before maintenance)
Vell will spawn 2 extra Saturdays (on February 29th and March 7) in the same location and same time as its regular spawn:

Saturday 14:00 PST/Saturday 16:00 CET 



During the event period, Kzarka, Nouver, Kutum, and Karanda will drop [Event] Shiny Ring that can be exchanged for Belongings of an Adventurer.



Event 3: Lara’s Four Requests

Period: February 26 (after maintenance)–March 11 (before maintenance)
Lara at Heidel has four requests that you can complete for rewards including Black Gem, Memory Fragment, and [Event] Rare Tungrad Accessory Box.



Click  for full details on these celebratory events.



Succession of Events: Striker and Mystic

Period: February 26 (after maintenance)–March 18 (before maintenance)
Adventurers who reach a certain level with their Striker and Mystic characters during the event period can obtain rewards via the Challenge tab (Y)!
Click  for full details!



Ongoing Events

[Fourth Anniversary Special!] Thank You for Four Years: Feb. 19–Mar. 11

Festival of Horses: Feb. 19–Mar. 11

[February Update] Black Spirit's Adventure: UPGRADED: Feb.19–Until further notice

Succession of Events: Lahn: Feb. 19–Mar. 11

Succession of Events: Witch and Wizard: Feb. 12–Mar. 4 (09:00 UTC)


Ended Events

Valentine's Day Adventure Log

Fairy's Faves

Guardian Awakening Events

Valentine's Day Events: Will end Feb.26 (23:59 UTC)


Reward Distribution

Charity Event: Join us to aid Victims of Australia's Fires and Turkey's Earthquakes

Please note titles given as rewards in this event have been sent directly to your My Information (P) > Title section.
Thank you once again for taking part in the good cause.



Content

Major Update - Gyfin Rhasia Temple Monster Zone Update

The conflict between the Ganelle and the Ahib has aggravated, increasing the security level of the Gyfin Rhasia Temple.
The majority of Gyfin Rhasia Statues of Earth switched to combat standby mode, and they have become combat monsters.
The Gyfin Rhasia Temple was updated to be a Monster Zone with a Recommended AP of 270.
The stats of Gyfin Rhasia Temple's monsters increased.

HP increased by 180%, AP increased by 7%, DP increased by 8%.



The time that it takes for a Gyfin Rhasia Temple's monster to find an enemy and enter combat mode decreased by 30%.
The Combat EXP that can be obtained from defeating Gyfin Rhasia Temple's monsters decreased by 50%, and the Skill EXP for this increased by 100%.



The number of Junk Items you can obtain by defeating the following monsters in the Gyfin Rhasia Temple increased.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/2ae3d60b9acffcbd2f0aea26db6e633d8c2da07f.jpg

Together with Kamasylvia Part 2, Gyfin Rhasia Temple was the first Monster Zone to be released in Black Desert that required 5 players to cooperate.

At the time of its release, it required very high combat skills, with a Recommended AP of 240, and its befitting highly compensating reward, Tungrad Belt, motivated the adventurers to jump into this monster zone.

However, the rough topography, the large distance between monsters, and the inconvenient flow for defeating monsters didn't allow the players to get the most of this monster zone before they could get used to it.

Moreover, as Mirumok Ruins was updated to be a monster zone for a party of 3 and became more approachable, players who visited Gyfin Rhasia started to decrease.
Gyfin Rhasia Temple has now become a monster zone that requires even higher combat skills than before, with a Recommended AP of 270.

Its monsters are now stronger and their number has increased. Instead, we have adjusted the placement of the monsters and the flow to defeat them so that the players could enjoy their party play without necessarily having an experienced party member.
The number of monsters per area has increased significantly, the time that it takes for a monster to reappear has decreased, and the reaction speed of the monsters has increased, therefore decreasing the flow length and the fatigue caused for defeating monsters. The number of the majority of the Junk Items obtainable from these monsters has increased too.
Nevertheless, given that the Combat EXP gain per defeated Gyfin Rhasia Temple monster was the highest among all Black Desert monsters, the increase in the number of Gyfin Rhasia Temple monsters was balanced with a decrease in the Combat EXP gain, and the comparably low Skill EXP gain has increased.

Additionally, we expect the application of the Item Collection Increase Scroll effect will make this monster zone more enjoyable.

You can now exchange Level 4 trade goods for Sea Coins in certain islands.

Adjusted the Parley that is consumed when bartering in the Margoria region with floating objects or the Valencian island.

The rate at which you can exchange Island Tree Coated Plywood at the Netnume Island increased.

We are making preparations to present you more varied and special goods with the Sea Coin Shop.

Our plan is to add Sea Coin acquisition locations so that there are other ways available for you to obtain the Sea Coins, apart from bartering. So you can now exchange Level 4 trade goods for Sea Coins. Instead, the parley consumption in certain regions was adjusted to keep the overall balance.

We will keep paying attention to all your opinions and continue doing our best to create a more enjoyable game.

Fixed the issue where succession skill add-ons did not reset when using EXP Transfer Coupons.


System

With the optimization of some features, the game client's memory was also optimized.


Mounts

Fixed the issue where the skill acquisition message appeared to the nearby players when a player learned the two-seater skill.


Class Changes

Sorceress

Fixed the issue where casting speed increase effect was applied to the target when using Prime: Crow Flare in certain situations.


Witch

Fixed the issue where bound effect was applied in PvP when activating instantly Prime: Earthquake: Evade.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't activate a combo with RMB during Prime: Residual Lightning's cooldown when using Prime: Lightning.

Fixed the issue where damage was not being applied during Prime: Earthquake: Evade's cooldown.


Wizard

Fixed the issue where bound effect was applied in PvP when activating instantly Prime: Earthquake: Evade.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't activate a combo with RMB during Prime: Residual Lightning's cooldown when using Prime: Lightning.

Fixed the issue during Succession, where the next succession skill couldn't be instantly activated when using Teleport while having pressed the Move Forward key.

Fixed the issue where the preceding skill that would activate Ultimate: Teleport as a separate skill was not Elemental Flow but Burning Pulse.


Striker

Added the "Succession" content.

After Awakening the Striker, accept the quest "[Striker Succession] Discussing Effort" from the Black Spirit to start the Succession quest series.
You will learn the skill "Succession: Striker's Vigor" which will allow you to learn more powerful Gauntlet skills.
You will no longer be able to use your Gardbrace skills.
Added the "Succession" tab to the Skill window. The skills in this tab are affected by the AP of both Main and Awakening Weapons.
You will be able to learn and use skills in both the "Main" and "Succession" tabs. However, if there is both an "Absolute" and "Succession" versions of the same skill, you must choose as you cannot use both versions of the skill.
To learn certain Succession skills, you will first need to learn the preceding skills from the "Main" tab first.
After completing the Succession quests and learning the skill "Succession: Striker's Vigor," you can go back and forth between Succession and Awakening skills by resetting your skills.
To go from using Succession to Awakening skills, you need to reset your skills to unlearn "Succession: Striker's Vigor."
To go from using Awakening to Succession skills, you need to reset your skills and relearn "Succession: Striker's Vigor."



Mystic

Added the "Succession" content.

After Awakening the Mystic, accept the quest "[Mystic Succession] Discussing Endurance" from the Black Spirit to start the Succession quest series.
You will learn the skill "Succession: Mystic's Force" which will allow you to learn more powerful Gauntlet skills.
You will no longer be able to use your Cestus skills.
Added the "Succession" tab to the Skill window. The skills in this tab are affected by the AP of both Main and Awakening Weapons.
You will be able to learn and use skills in both the "Main" and "Succession" tabs. However, if there is both an "Absolute" and "Succession" versions of the same skill, you must choose as you cannot use both versions of the skill.
To learn certain Succession skills, you will first need to learn the preceding skills from the "Main" tab first.
After completing the Succession quests and learning the skill "Succession: Mystic's Force," you can go back and forth between Succession and Awakening skills by resetting your skills.
To go from using Succession to Awakening skills, you need to reset your skills to unlearn "Succession: Mystic's Force."
To go from using Awakening to Succession skills, you need to reset your skills and relearn "Succession: Mystic's Force."


Once she achieves Succession, the Mystic can perform combo attacks by which one attack is connected to the other most fluently and deal a power strike using the charged Fighting Spirit.

At the beginning, she has to perform a combo with several skills until she can charge the Fighting Spirit, but once the combo persists for a certain level, she will recover the Fighting Spirit in tremendous amounts. The Mystic then cannot only perform combo attacks more easily but also deal Fighting Spirit-consuming strikes relentlessly.

Lahn

Major Update - Lahn succession update

The PvP damage of Prime: Blooming Nether Flower increased by 36%.
The PvP damage of Prime: Salp'uri Purge increased by 21%.
Changing the camera perspective during Prime: Furious Chase's Striding Slash 1st hit will now change the movement direction of your character too.
Among the attack range that is applied to each hit for Prime: Bleeding Hearts, the range to which max hits are applied increased.
The fall damage reduction and movement speed increase buffs of Nimbus Stride that is used as a combo after Prime: Spring Breeze or a glide will now be applied normally.
You will now be able to use the skills that are used as combos after using Prime: Primrose Sprint more rapidly.
The speed at which Stamina is consumed during a glide that is used as a combo after Prime: Spring Breeze or Prime: Primrose Sprint doubled.


Lahn succession focuses on combo attacks, based on mobility and stability. However, we concluded that, in order to firm up such a characteristic, it was necessary to adjust the damage of some skills first.
Firstly, we increased the PvP damage of Prime: Blooming Nether Flower and Prime: Salp'uri Purge.

Prime: Bleeding Hearts was changed from being a forward-moving attack to a focused attack. Hence the attack range decreased, but the damage dealt to the point of attack increased.

Guardian]

Fixed the description about HP Recovery from Flow: Black Blood Eruption's skill description to match the actual skill effect.

HP Recovery +50 on good hits → HP Recovery +50 per every good hit



The visual effect of the normal right attack now looks natural.

Fixed the issue where the bound effect of Rockslide III would sometimes be applied as stiffness effect.

Fixed the issue where even after putting back your weapon while moving with the battle axe, the weapon would sometimes be taken out again.

Fixed the issue where Down Attack was being applied to Infernal Nemesis, but it was missing from the skill description.

You can now use the following item with the Guardian.

[Event] Classic Outfit Box
Please note [Guardian] Ynixtra will be available via Premium Outfit Box with March 11 maintenance.



Item Changes

The Burn Damage of the Flame Cannonball increased.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/c97890569e272c0d1c1834e811cff9b401c43b79.jpg

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Fixed the issue where buff would be applied when being hit by a certain attack of an Org that is summoned from the Ancient Relic Crystal.

Item Collection Increase Scroll effect will now be applied when defeating monsters in the following regions.

Mirumok Ruins
Gyfin Rhasia Temple
※ Partially adjusted the High Quality Item Drop Rate of these monster zones.



The drop rate of the items obtainable from the following monsters doubled.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/fb2afdf81fb0173d5ccea6cf26a1e2f5deac2c80.jpg


Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Fixed the location of the quest NPC icon for "How to Face the Sun."


Knowledge

A text stating that you cannot obtain the Elixir of Thorn using alchemy was added to the item's Knowledge Description.


Interface Changes

The scroll length of the Item Restore window will no longer get shorter than a certain size.

The item description will no longer cover the item list in the Black Spirit's Safe window.

Adjusted the blank spaces at the left and the right sides of the Item List window that appears when obtaining an item to be the same.

The War Installation Info UI will no longer appear when switching to Installation Mode by interacting with the Indomitable Flag.

Adjusted the Carefully/Boldly button sizes for the Bargaining minigame.

You can no longer use the Processing window while the Fairy window is open.

Character icon will now be displayed together with the character's portrait in the Disconnect (End Game) window.

The portrait in My Information (P) window will now be displayed in the appropriate aspect ratio.

You can now adjust the number of Artisan's Memory you want to quickly purchase with + and - icons in the Max Durability Repair window.

Auto-fishing-related UI will no longer appear in the Harpoon Fishing UI.

The NPC Shop UI and the Wharf UI will no longer open together.

Fixed the issue where the Ocean Current and Wind UI appeared when saving UI settings or opening the character selection window while not holding the ship's wheel after boarding the ship.

Time information will now be displayed in the Quest UI during a Timed Quest.

Fixed the issue where the Kill Notification was not being updated when the number of notification went above 10 during Final Battle.

Improved the way in which sales period is displayed in the Pearl Item tooltip.

Fixed the issue where Place Mode's Installation menu did not appear normally when adjusting the UI size.


Resolved Issues

[Valkyrie, Kunoichi, Dark Knight, Lahn, Guardian] Fixed the unnatural motion that the character adopted when sprinting after mounting the horse.

Fixed the issue where the following outfits looked unnaturally when equipping them in certain situations.

[Witch] Queen Heart Underwear
[Sorceress] Dahlia Nocturna
[Mystic] Queen Heart Underwear
[Shai] Crayodel Soldier Uniform
[Archer] Gorca Swimsuit



[Berserker] Fixed the typo in Prime: Beast Form's skill description.

[Shai] Fixed the issue where using Sprinkle-Sparkle caused the screen to flash.

[Shai] Fixed the issue where visual effects were not being displayed sometimes when using Sprinkle-Sparkle.

Fixed the issue where the quest completion NPC for "Leader of the Ahib" would be flickering.

Fixed the issue where certain structures in the following regions were located at awkward places.

Balenos Mountains
Calpheon Castle Site
South Kaia Mountain
North Kaia Mountain
Cyclops Land
Grána
Iliya Island



The chat type will no longer reset when participating in a Chat Group.

Fixed the typo in the Imperial Training Delivery exchange button.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where the following limited pets on [4th Anniversary] Limited Pet 2+2 Bundle show wrong availability periods:

Drifty Gosphy
Emperor Hawk
Lost Penguin
Snowflake Reindeer
Snowball Rosefinch
Snowflake Rosefinch


These wrong lines will be removed with March 3rd regular maintenance. Please note [4th Anniversary] Limited Pet 2+2 Bundle and permanent pets included are sold until March 11 (before maintenance). We apologize for the confusion and inconvenience.


Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

Ended Events

Charity Event: Join us to aid Victims of Australia's Fires and Turkey's Earthquakes

Thank you adventurers for taking part in this charity event. We want to show our token of appreciation by giving [Event] Lara's Warm Black Tea as an additional bonus to those who took part in this move for the good cause. Thank you once again!
Please note titles given as rewards in this event will be sent directly to your My Information (P) > Title section on the regular maintenance on Feb. 26th.



Guardian Awakening Events:

Accessories for Syrmin
Ynix Seed’s Power
Unstable Ember



Content

Kamasylvia Main Quests were renewed.

The main quests of Kamasylvia, the land of the Goddess Sylvia's descendants, were renewed. This update has three main goals. One is to redesign the quest flow in order to allow those adventurers who have graduated from Valencia to approach these quests more easily. Our second goal is to shape the attractive characters of Kamasylvia in more detail and create a richer story. And our last goal is to start the preliminary work for O'dyllita's continuing story and additional content that will follow the completion of the main quests.
During the renewed Kamasylvia main quests, you will ride a Sky Ballon and travel to Grána. We hope you enjoy the story we've prepared while looking around the beautiful sceneries.
Your perspective on the world of Black Desert Online will broaden and a clear distinction of relationships between NPCs and associations will be made.
Those players who already have an ongoing old main quest can start the new questline and can still proceed on the old questline too. They can proceed on the new questline after completion of the old questline as well. However, if the player abandons the old quest, he/she will no longer be able to start the old quest again. Also, if the player has never received the old quest, he/she will only be able to proceed on the new questline.
Accept the quest that starts with "Kamasylvia, the Land Behind the Veil" from the Black Spirit's Main Quest tab to start the renewed main quests of Kamasylvia.
You must be Lv. 58 or higher to be able to accept the new main quests.
Go to the Quest List (O) window > Main Quest tab [Kamasylvia] Kamasylve's Light to see the quests.
"Sylvia's Legacy Adventure Journal II" knowledge category was added.
A new quest was added to Kamasylvia

You can accept this quest from Papu who is watering the flower garden at Grána Plaza after completing the renewed main quest of Kamasylvia, "Healing Light," which can be accepted from Lv. 58.
You must activate the Combat quest filter to be able to start the new quest.



Given the update of the main quests of Kamasylvia, you can no longer accept the consecutive quests that start with the following quest.

Unsung Hero



The monsters that appear near the following Kamasylvia quest NPCs and location have either been moved or removed.

Klaruss Mushroom in Polly's Forest
Khalid of Loopy Tree Forest
The entrance of the cave in Manshaum Forest




You can now use the Chat Group's Recommend feature not only in the Lunar Halo Inn and the Dancing Marlin Tavern, but in all Chat Groups.

The number of Cumulative Recommendations will reset through the April 22 (Wed) maintenance.

The Recommend feature will reset every 3 months and a small reward will be given based on the number of Cumulative Recommendations at the time when the reset process is being carried out.
As of the April 22 (Wed) maintenance, those adventurers who have the Black Spirit icon given the number of their Cumulative Recommendations will receive a temporary Title for 90 days for their diligent participation.
The gold, silver, and bronze trophy icons that used to be displayed based on the number of Cumulative Recommendations in the Chat Group were changed to Black Spirit icons.
Check Chat Groups in detail .



System

Added a feature by which you can restore your removed items.

Go to the Inventory (I) window and press LMB on the Throw away item icon to use the Item Restore feature.
Each family may use the Item Restore feature twice in a calendar month.
Items are only eligible for restoration for 30 days after deletion.
Only certain items can be restored.
Some items, such as items with an expiration date may not be eligible for restoration.
Your access to this service will reset on the 1st of each month. Any unused restorations will not be carried over into the new month.
If you wish to restore an item that is not available with this system, please contact customer support. However, restoration can not be guaranteed.
Items are only eligible for restoration for 30 days after deletion.
Only items of a blue grade or higher are eligible for restoration.
Item Restore subcategory was added to the Adventurer Support category in the New Menu.



Fixed the lag issue that occurred in the following situations.

When you get near an NPC by auto-navigating to the NPC who is near the coast while you are on a ship or swimming.
When you are near an NPC who is near the coast and auto-navigate to this NPC.



Fixed the issue where selecting Quick Route from World Map (M) > Navigation Settings > Ocean Navigation Settings, stopped the game while auto-navigating.

The invincible effect which is applied for 10 sec when reviving at Fort/Command Post during a Node/Conquest War will now be maintained even after switching to combat mode or using combat skills.

This change only applies to when reviving at Fort/Command Post



Mounts

The cost for recovering all mounts' HP (Repair) and Stamina (Power) was changed from 15 Silver to 500 Silver per 1%.

The cost for supplying large ships' cannonballs was changed from 10,000 Silver to 1,000 Silver per cannonball.

We hope you can enjoy defeating monsters in the Great Ocean in a less burdensome way.

The cost you need to pay for supplying rations and cannonballs, and sustaining ship durability as you try to defeat monsters in the Great Ocean with your large ship is not small. Adventurers who are still learning to drive their ships would perceive this cost as a huge burden.

Hence we have decreased the cost for supplying cannonballs for large ships to 1/10 of the original cost.

Fixed the issue where the Ration consumed for using BreezySail with large ships did not match the description.


Class Changes

Witch & Wizard

The PvP damage of the following skills was increased.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/4a011d9dcfe1eb86aa70ab8d28c32954ff4380b3.jpg

The damage of Prime: Frigid Fog: Control was increased as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/9913ea922e75627f3e42c830c40d22e7888ff61c.jpg

The extra hit damage of Prime: Lightning was increased.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/8f5f4d2d97567f59e602a588945701c3d55e5174.jpg

The casting speed of the following skills is now faster.

Prime: Voltaic Pulse
Prime: Equilibrium Break
Prime: Bolide of Destruction
Prime: Aqua Jail Explosion
Prime: Residual Lightning: Combo/High Voltage
Prime: Lightning Extra Hit
Prime: Blizzard: Storm/Domain
Prime: Frigid Fog: Control/Disrupt
Prime: Meteor Shower: Focus/Areal
Prime: Lightning Storm: High Voltage
Prime: Earthquake: Destruction



You can now activate a combo more rapidly after using the following skills.

Prime: Fireball Explosion: Focus
After Prime: Lightning's additional hit
Prime: Earthquake: Destruction/Evade
After using Prime: Earth's Response: Destruction to the right.
Combo with RMB after using Prime: Residual Lightning: Combo
Combo with Earth's Response during Prime: Earthquake: Evade's backward movement



The required preceding skill for the following succession skills was changed to Succession: Elemental Revelation.

Prime: Fireball Explosion: Focus/Areal
Prime: Meteor Shower: Focus/Areal
Prime: Residual Lightning: Combo/High Voltage
Prime: Frigid Fog: Disrupt/Control
Prime: Blizzard: Storm/Domain
Prime: Earthquake: Evade/Destruction
Prime: Earth's Response: Flow/Destruction



You can now maintain the state in which casting is complete before firing when using Prime: Lightning Storm: High Voltage.

A good Prime: Earth Arrow hit will now activate Magic DP decrease effect.

Fixed the issue where pressing LMB + RMB after using Succession: Magical Evasion activated Prime: Earth's Response: Flow/Destruction first.

Backward movement distance for Prime: Earthquake: Evade was increased.

Cooldown time for Prime: Frigid Fog: Disrupt II and III was decreased to 9 sec. and 8 sec., respectively.

Cooldown time for Prime: Fireball Explosion: Areal II and III was decreased to 10 sec. and 9 sec., respectively.

The extra hit damage of Prime: Lightning will now be activated when holding the F key.

A good Prime: Residual Lightning: Combo hit as well as a good Prime: Residual Lightning: High Voltage hit will now activate MP recovery effect.

The attack range of Prime: Lightning Storm: Combo was changed so that it matches the skill's visual effect.

Prime: Aqua Jail Explosion's effects were optimized.

The firing position of Prime: Magic Arrow's last hit will now match the character's motion.

Fixed the issue where the damage of Prime: Lightning was being applied abnormally in certain situations.

Fixed the issue where you could see two Prime: Blizzard: Domain and Prime: Blizzard: Storm skills each in the Level Up Info window when reaching Lv. 60.

Though Witch and Wizard share the same succession skill, we have differentiated the two classes' play styles by creating a variation in their skill usages. Our goal was to provide you two different enjoyments.

Upon learning Elemental Flow, the Wizard can use a skill after which he can immediately activate the next skill without casting motion through commands. By activating his skills continuously, the Wizard can deal great damage to his targets. On the other hand, the Witch Succession consists of being able to use Magical Evasion while on casting motion whenever she activates a skill. Each of her skill causes great damage and by using Multiple Magic Arrows' additional hit continuously after using a skill, she can deal constant damage to her targets. Our internal test showed that the average damage dealt by the Witch was a bit lower than that dealt by the Wizard, so we tried to increase the damage of the Witch's skills.

However, Wizard players have expressed many opinions regarding how the Witch's succession skill damage was greater than that of the Wizard even when they are the same skill, how the effect of the Wizard's Elemental Flow was not as distinct as the effect of the Witch's Elemental Flow, etc. And with last week's Global Lab updates, which included a fix whereby using a succession skill after Magical Evasion would immediately activate the former for the Witch, some players shared the opinion that Wizard Succession was no longer distinct.

We have decided to reflect the opinions of our Witch and Wizard players to the following adjustment, thereby minimize the difference between Witch and Wizard Successions and allow each class to have only one single characteristic. Hence we are going to equalize the damage of the Witch and Wizard's succession skills, to maintain the combo attacks that can be performed by suing Magical Evasion and Multiple Magic Arrows for the Witch, and to remove the Teleport prerequisite for Ultimate: Teleport and allow the skill's independent use for the Wizard.

Secondly, we have simplified the casting motion of Lightning Element skills for Witch and Wizard. It was no longer possible to use Sage's Memory with succession and Lightning Element skills would interrupt the flow between combos. We have concluded that this interruption could be a bigger problem than being unable to use Sage's Memory, and therefore have simplified the casting motion of all Lightning Element skills.

We will continue reviewing the different opinions you provide us and do our best to make a more enjoyable class.

Valkyrie

Fixed the issue where you couldn't use Shield Strike or Righteous Charge immediately while using Guard.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't activate Just Counter immediately as a combo after using Guard.


Witch

You can now activate a combo more rapidly after using Prime: Multiple Magic Arrows' additional hit.

You can now activate another succession skill through commands without casting motion after using Succession: Magical Evasion.

Fixed the issue where MP was not consumed when using Prime: Multiple Magic Arrows' additional hit only.


Wizard

You can now activate a combo by pressing commands after Prime: Earthquake: Evade's backward movement.

You can now activate a combo by using the Elemental Flow effect more rapidly after using Prime: Lightning Storm: Combo.

Fixed the issue where the projectile slowed down when using Prime: Fireball through commands after learning Elemental Flow.

The number of hits of Prime: Residual Lightning: Combo was changed as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/9eb722fca0c22f0b499443ba48198d26c3d76587.jpg

Fixed the issue where you could not use succession skills without casting motion when using Teleport through Quick Slot

You can now activate Ultimate: Teleport separately during Teleport's cooldown.

The damage of the following skills was changed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/9913ea922e75627f3e42c830c40d22e7888ff61c.jpg


Striker

Fixed the issue where the Critical Hit Rate increase effect was not being applied when using Absolute: Crimson Fang after certain skills, even upon learning Bloody Fang.

Fixed the issue where the floating effect was being applied when using Hidden Claw after using Knee Hammer even during Hidden Claw's cooldown.


Lahn

Added the "Succession" content.

After Awakening the Lahn, accept the quest "[Lahn Succession] Pondering on Death" from the Black Spirit to start the Succession quest series.
You will learn the skill "Succession: Heavenly Waltz" which will allow you to learn more powerful Crescent Pendulum and Noble Sword skills.
You will no longer be able to use your Crimson Glaives skills.
Added the "Succession" tab to the Skill window. The skills in this tab are affected by the AP of both Main and Awakening Weapons.
You will be able to learn and use skills in both the "Main" and "Succession" tabs. However, if there is both an "Absolute" and "Succession" versions of the same skill, you must choose as you cannot use both versions of the skill.
To learn certain Succession skills, you will first need to learn the preceding skills from the "Main" tab first.
After completing the Succession quests and learning the skill "Succession: Heavenly Waltz," you can go back and forth between Succession and Awakening skills by resetting your skills.
To go from using Succession to Awakening skills, you need to reset your skills to unlearn "Succession: Heavenly Waltz."
To go from using Awakening to Succession skills, you need to reset your skills and relearn "Succession: Heavenly Waltz."



Guardian

The color of the awakening skills are now more reddish than before.

The AP buff will now be applied normally when using Fireborne Rupture in combo by pressing Q after using God Incinerator.

A description of the Awakening Weapon was added to the character description that can be seen from the character selection window.


Item Changes

Mount pearl items that fall in the category of Horse Gear, Ship, or Wagon were changed from being character bound to being Family bound.

When you equip the item for the first time, it will be Family bound, and you will be able to use it through the Storage.



[Guild] Cannonball and [Guild] Flame Cannonball were added to the list of items sold by a Guild Military Supply Manager.

The amount of damage applied to [Guild] Cannonball and [Guild] Flame Cannonball will be the same as that of the old Cannonball and Flame Cannonball.
Adventurers who are Quartermasters or up can spend 200,000 Silver of their Guild Fund to purchase [Guild] Cannonball or [Guild] Flame Cannonball from a Guild Military Supply Manager.



The damage of the Crafted Cannonball and Flame Cannonball was increased.
Cannonball

Damage increased by 30%



Flame Cannonball

Before: 3 sec. of 15 Flame Damage for 45 sec.
After: 3 sec. of 30 Flame Damage for 45 sec.



The crafting method remains the same.



Fixed the issue where it was indicated that some equippable items that can't be dyed could be dyed.

The following text about enhancement was added to the Manos clothes' description.

Can be enhanced with Black Gems up to enhancement level +14, and with Concentrated Magical Black Gems from enhancement level +15.



The Central Market's max price of the following items was changed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/3d666a1438bd474cea203edb25cadd4059e5413b.jpg

The max number of items per purchase for the following items at the Central Market was changed from 10 to 50.

Ancient Relic Crystal Shard
Forbidden Book
Scroll Written in Ancient Language
Manshaum Voodoo Doll



Fixed the issue where the quantity of Wolf Blood required for crafting Clown's Blood from Alchemy Tool was not accurate.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't use the Valks' Main Weapon Box with Guardian.

You can now obtain Sol with the Trial Character version of Shai.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

The Frenzied Skeleton Decurion and Frenzied Skeleton Centurion that appear at Soldier's Grave will now attack you regardless of your level.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest

The instructions for the quest A Poacher's Suggestion will now appear only in Kamasylvia.


Knowledge

The following knowledge details were changed.

Ancient Stone Chamber, Mural of Prophecy I
Ancient Stone Chamber, Mural of Prophecy II
Ancient Stone Chamber, Mural of Prophecy IV
Fallen Giant Walls
Cron Castle's Altar



Interface Changes

Hotkeys will now be applied to the first row of your installation list when placing an installation in your residence or garden.

You can use the number keys 1–8 for the hotkeys, starting from the left side.



When a fairy has learned the highest available skill for its level, the skill icon and text bubble will now reveal the relevant information.

An "M" icon was added on the top left of the Fairy skills.
The following text will be displayed in the Fairy skill description.

This skill is at the highest level your fairy can learn.




Dark Rift was added to the New Menu's "Adventure" tab.

The Fishing UI icon is now fish-shaped.

The Enter button for the Altar of Blood on the bottom of the Old Menu was removed and a banner indicating that you can see the newly added menu from the New Menu was added.

Clicking this banner will open the New Menu.



The font size of the basic text bubble description was increased.

The location of the Items Required for Contract window that appears when talking with a sailor NPC was adjusted.

Only basic rewards will appear when there is no optional reward in the quest window that appears when deciding whether or not to accept a quest from an NPC and in the quest rewards window.

The way by which you can adjust the opacity of your Friend List's 1:1 Chat window was changed.

Fixed the issue where opening the Manage Workers UI from the World Map and then opening and closing another UI caused the Manage Workers UI to reopen.

Fixed the issue where the location of the Set Allowances button was abnormal when selecting a user while having the scroll down in the War Hero tab from the Guild window.

Fixed the issue in the World map's Territory tooltip where the description about Max HP increase within the Occupation Information text did not fit inside the Tooltip window.

Fixed the issue where the Find NPC window opened behind the other windows.

Fixed the issue where the Alarm UI did not disappear when setting the UI after exposing the Sailor event alarm UI while on sail.

Fixed the issue where the last tab you had selected would be selected when opening the Owner list for the second time.

Fixed the issue where the icon of some items that are required for a conversation appeared awkward.

Fixed the issue where the quest rewards window that appears from an NPC when completing a quest was being displayed abnormally.

Fixed the issue where the name of some installations did not fit inside the War Installation Info window that shows up during a Node/Conquest War.

Fixed the issue where the scroll bar sometimes did not work properly in certain sections of the Challenge Reward tab from My Information window.

Fixed the issue where the crop collection message showed up when retrieving the items by pressing the Retrieve All button while on Place Mode in Residence.

The NPC Shop UI and the Wharf UI will no longer open together.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where it was possible to hit the Siege Defense Tower of Conquest War during a World Boss's appearance.

[Ninja] Fixed the issue where the character's facial expression looked unnatural when making a specific pose in the Beauty (F4) window.

[Guardian] Fixed the issue where the shield's appearance was sometimes unnatural when changing directions and trying to switch between combat and non-combat stances while moving.

[Guardian] Fixed the issue where the Jordun appeared unnaturally when using Awakening: Juggernaut in a combo after using Frigid Wind.

Fixed the typo in the following skills' descriptions

[Mystic] Soul Basher
[Mystic] Flow: Blowdrive
[Mystic] Thunder Pound
[Kunoichi] Flow: Block Jump



[Shai] Fixed the issue where the character moved abnormally when pressing directional key while on ScrollLock Walk mode.

[Shai, Guardian] A Hanbok-exclusive social action was added.

Fixed the typo in the following texts.

[New/Returning] Cliff's Weapon quest summary
Marni's Stone exchange button



The Steel Imp Warrior that was stuck in a certain rock in Altar of Agris was moved.

Fixed the issue where the NPC who's at the border zone near Kamasylvia was floating in the air.

The stones that were floating in some parts of Cyclops Land were removed.

Fixed the issue where you could do Gathering in some parts of Port Epheria even when there was no Gathering item.

Fixed the issue where topography sometimes did not appear in some parts of Garmoth.

Fixed the issue where the location of the selected area was abnormal when clicking on the Edit window after selecting an area by pressing Shift + Directional Key in the Guild Description window from the Guild (G) window or the Bio window from the My Info (P) window.

Fixed the issue where 2D and 3D minimaps appeared together when you loaded the UI preset with 3D minimap while using 2D minimap.

Fixed the start point of the bar that represents the total progress in the Title tab from the My Information window.

Fixed the issue where the chat type icon sometimes did not disappear when changing the chat type.

[Guardian] Fixed the issue where the hip area appeared unnatural when equipping the Ynixtra Clothes together with the Nude Basic Underwear and the Nude Deep Black Underwear.

[Dark Knight] Fix the issue where the character's right finger became invisible when equipping the Glorious Shudad Outfit Set and the Kibelius Vediant together.

Fixed the issue where the following outfits looked unnaturally when equipping them in certain situations.

[Guardian] Silver Embroidered Trader's Clothes
[Guardian] Silver Embroidered Craftsman's Clothes
[Kunoichi] Heidel Masquerade Phantom Mask
[Mystic] Queen Heart Underwear
[Dark Knight] Queen Heart Underwear
[Lahn] Queen Heart Underwear
[Witch] Queen Heart Underwear
[Kunoichi] Queen Heart Underwear



The following are the changes we failed to announce in the December 24, 2019 and the January 8, 2020 update notes. We apologize for any inconvenience we have caused for not announcing this content.

December 24, 2019 (Tue)

[UI] The white wave effect from the Fishing minigame was removed.



January 8, 2020 (Wed)

[Content] Another exit was added next to the exit of the resurrection place for Red Battlefield's Black Desert team. Some topography was changed accordingly.




Known Issues

Updated 20/02


We are aware of the issue where the [Event] Golden Seal of Panto you obtained from Playtime Challenges (Under Thank You for Four Years) event post is leading you to a wrong NPC-to-exchange. We will be replacing the [Event] Golden Seal of Panto in possession with the correct seals that will lead to Morco to make an exchange with February 26 regular maintenance. We apologize for the confusion and inconvenience.

[strike]We are aware of the issue where the system message "Imperfect Skill Awakening Information" appears when trying Skill Add-ons on certain skills for characters that have received Combat/Skill EXP transfer by using [Event] Combat/Skill EXP Exchange Coupon. This will be fixed with March 3 regular maintenance.[/strike]

A hotfix for this issue has been applied and it will no longer occur upon using a Combat/Skill EXP Exchange Coupon. However, if your character was affected before the hotfix applied on Feb. 20 13:00 UTC, please send a ticket to our Customer Support along with a mention of the Character Name you are experiencing problems with to have them resolved.



We are aware of the issue where description under Item Restore window appears to leak out of the box. This will be fixed with February 26 regular maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience.


Updated 21/02

We aware of the issue where the Mount EXP boost icon is not appearing on top part of the game screen. This is only a visual issue, so please note that the Mount EXP +50% is ongoing from Feb. 19–Mar.  3 (before maintenance). This visual issue will be fixed on the regular maintenance on Feb. 26.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: [Maintenance] Regular Maintenance February 19th 2020
notes.content:

Dear Players,

We will perform our weekly maintenance as follows:

Date: Wednesday, February 19th 2020

Duration: 4 hours.

Global 9:00 UTC ~ 13:00 UTC
Central (EU) 10:00 CEST ~ 14:00 CEST
West Coast (NA) 1:00 PDT ~ 5:00 PDT
East Coast (NA) 4:00 EDT ~ 8:00 EDT


Reasons:

Succession for Lahn will be added, and the level-up challenge for the class will begin.
Festival of Horses event will start.
4th anniversary celebration will begin with pre-anniversary events.
Kamasylvia Main Quests will receive a renewal.
Item Restore feature will be added.
Mount skins (Donkey, Horse, Camel, Wagon, Ship, Boat, Frigate) will change from being Character-bound to Family-bound.


Ending Events:

Charity Event
Guardian Awakening Events: 

Accessories for Syrmin
Ynix Seed’s Power
Unstable Ember



Follow us on Twitter & Facebook to stay up to date.
