BDO Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - February 12th 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/716bbd14d2a4b7ca75c02c07f7e42f9fe433c1f6.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

The succession series is back with the Witch and the Wizard this week! The two masters of the staff get new skills for their main weapon to cast devastating spells!

Adventurers will also be able to enjoy the new Valentine’s Day Adventure Log, newly-refreshed Loyal Attendance rewards and A Fairy’s Delicacy event.

Learn more about this week’s patch notes below:

Event & System

New Events

Succession of Events: Witch and Wizard

Period: February 12 (after maintenance)–March 3 (before maintenance)
Adventurers who reach a certain level with their Witch and Wizard characters during the event period can obtain rewards below via the Challenge tab (Y)!
Click  for full details!



Valentine’s Day Adventure Log

Period: February 12 (after maintenance)–February 26 (before maintenance)
A special Adventure Log is available during this romantic time. Become the messenger love and help villagers of Velia realize their love.
Click  for the details.



Fairy's Faves

Period: February 12 (after maintenance)–February 26 (before maintenance)
Combine [Event] Sweet Concoction, [Event] Chocolatey Beehive, and Sweet Honey Wine to obtain [Event] Fantastic Honey Wine which will gain you 12 times more EXP compared to the regular Sweet Honey Wine to help grow your Fairy.
Click  for the sweet details.



Ongoing Events

Guardian Awakening Events: Feb. 5–Feb.26 (before maintenance)

Charity Event: Join us to aid Victims of Australia’s Fires and Turkey’s Earthquakes: Feb.5–Feb.19 (before maintenance)

Valentine’s Day Events:  Feb. 5–Feb.26 (23:59 UTC)

Ended Events

None


Reward Distribution

Black Spirit's Adventure: UPGRADED

Gold Bar rewards for completing designated amount of laps during the event period have been distributed to the in-game mailbox (B) of those who qualify. Congratulations!



Content

Dark Rift Contraction has begun.

Due to the contraction period starting with this maintenance, the following bosses will no longer appear from the Dark Rift and all existing ones of its kind will disappear as well.

Giath
Dastard Bheg
Gehaku
Moghulis
Ancient Puturum
Ahib Griffon



Please stay tuned for further announcement on Dark Rift Contraction/Expansion periods.



The amount of Max HP increased for Conquest Wars at Balenos, Serendia, Calpheon, Mediah, and Valencia Territory was increased from 500 to 5,000.

The Max HP will now be reduced by 500 each time when occupying each territory in succession.

E.g. If you were to occupy a certain territory, then the Max HP will be reduced from 5,000 to 4,500 when participating in the next Conquest War.




The amount of Max HP increased per Conquest Level will now be displayed in the Territory information within the World Map (M).

The Conquest Level increases by 1 each time you occupy a territory, and the amount of Max HP increased will be reduced depending on the Conquest Level when participating in Conquest Wars. When a guild which had occupied a territory loses its territory due to being defeated at a Conquest War, the Max HP increase effect will be recovered by 500.
e.g. Guild "A" occupies the Valencia Territory for 4 consecutive weeks, and then the guild attempts to continue its streak for the 5th week of Conquest Wars (while receiving a Max HP of +3,000) but then is defeated. When participating in a Conquest War again after 3 weeks of preparations, guild "A" will now receive a Max HP +4,000 effect.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/1543c32af5c5c4a75766c906aca84032fb739d0e.jpg



The Max HP increase/decrease effects for participations in Conquest Wars only apply within the range of 0–5,000.

When you bring the mouse cursor over the question mark button on the occupying area of the Guild Information window, you can view the information about the Max HP increase for Conquest Wars and about the Max HP decrease for consecutively occupying territories. It will also show you the amount of Max HP you will have increased when your guild participates in Conquest Wars.



The amount of Max HP increased for Node Wars was increased to 500.

Bartering was added to Guild Rank > Ranking.

Now, if your character dies near the Old Wisdom Tree and you choose to resurrect at the closest Town, your character will resurrect at the Old Wisdom Tree, instead of the Caduil Forest Path.

New Adventure Log for celebrating Valentine's Day was added.

Now you are required to collect 1 type of item used to promise an eternal friendship instead of 2 types for completing Deve's Encyclopedia Book 6 Chapter 4.
Please refer to the event page above for details on the Valentine’s Day Adventure Log.



System

The game client's memory was optimized.


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

Fixed the issue where some parts of Polly's Forest appeared as Elsana Sea.

Fixed the graphical issue where rocks appeared floating in some regions of Balenos Mountains.

Fixed the issue where grass near Serendia Shrine and Iliya Island appeared floating.

Fixed the issue where the topography of a certain area of the Loopy Tree Forest was abnormal.


NPC]

You will now be able to search NPC Adelph, the Work Manager of Epheria, by using dFind NPC.

Fixed the issue where the appearance of Radolf Hansen, the Imperial Delivery NPC of Heidel, was abnormal.


Mounts

Fixed the issue where you could mount a guild mount even after leaving the guild.

Ticking the Continuously use BreezySail checkbox will now allow you to use the skill while auto moving.

You can now remove that coin you had stuck in your keyboard. Use BreezySail conveniently, whenever you want to.
Added a text about the Continuously use BreezySail checkbox to the description that appears when you bring the mouse cursor over the BreezySail skill in Large Ship Information window.



Revised the BreezySail skill description in Mount Info window to have more straightforwardly worded conditions for using the skill.

Destroying any ship such as Raft, Rowboat, etc. in forced PvP mode will decrease your Karma by 200,000

However, Guild Galley will be excluded from this.



Dream Horse Arduanatt's teeth color is now white.

Fixed the issue where the dyeing of the Granverre Leather Stirrups looked awkward.


Class Changes

All Classes

Fixed the issue where you could hear steps and voice while the character was still when selecting Ranger, Sorceress, Tamer, or Lahn from the Character Creation window.


Warrior

You can now activate the Charging Thrust skill with Great Sword by pressing W + F.

The number of Smash Attack hits of Grave Digging was increased by 1 hit.

The PvE damage of Grave Digging and Black Spirit: Grave Digging was increased and their PvP damage was increased by 10%.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/8ce834738ffac7100c0eb8ed16a750b7c077c2f9.jpg

The number of Chop Attack hits of Flow: Slashing the Dead was increased by 1 hit.

Fixed the issue where not all Chop Attack damage of Flow: Slashing the Dead was applied in certain situations.

The damage of Frenzied Strikes was increased.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/83aeff7aa750808d16293a3ada63f74b7c38684b.jpg

The number of hits of Armor Break when the skill's cooldown is over was increased by 2 hits.

The damage of Flow: Armor Break was increased.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/1c80204991ca24cb73de3ee7eb91f72549ee3828.jpg

Adjusted the hit damage of Pulverize and Black Spirit: Pulverize skills.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/183cb8fb1010b1f5b45ce648772b020e5287c666.jpg

Now, monster spinning effect will be applied on good hits when using Pulverize.

The hit range of Pulverize and Flow: Tempest was changed to cover your character's surroundings. Now these skills will apply more hits than before.

Now, Down Smash effect will be applied on good hits when using Flow: Tempest.

You can now use Merciless during cooldown.

Adjusted the damage of Prime: Scars of Dusk.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/3b27ced231818400cbafd7e166b809bb6ce4d351.jpg

Prime: Ground Smash's Bound effect will now be applied to PvE only.

The character balance adjustments we have started since our last updates do not only aim at finding the balance between Monster Zones and PvP, but also that between characters, and between Awakening and Succession. The last skill adjustments we made for some characters will be followed by Awakening-Succession adjustments, starting with Warrior.

Our main concern is to allow you to choose between Awakening and Succession depending on your individual preferences or tastes, instead of weighing these two for their damages or efficiencies. We will also do our best to release the Successions of other pending characters successfully.

Valkyrie

The Down Attack effect will now be applied normally when using Prime: Ultimate: Divine Power.


Witch

Added the "Succession" content.

After Awakening the Witch or the Wizard, accept the quest "[Witch Succession] Word of Wisdom" or "[Wizard Succession] Infinite Intelligence" from the Black Spirit to start the Succession quest series.
You will learn the skill "Succession: Elemental Revelation" which will allow you to learn more powerful Staff skills.
You will no longer be able to use your Aad Sphera or Godr Sphera skills.
Added the "Succession" tab to the Skill window. The skills in this tab are affected by the AP of both Main and Awakening Weapons.
You will be able to learn and use skills in both the "Main" and "Succession" tabs. However, if there are both an "Absolute"" and "Succession" versions of the same skill, you must choose as you cannot use both versions of the skill.
To learn certain Succession skills, you will first need to learn the preceding skills from the "Main" tab first.
After completing the Succession quests and learning the skill "Succession: Elemental Revelation," you can go back and forth between Succession and Awakening skills by resetting your skills.
To go from using Succession to Awakening skills, you need to reset your skills to unlearn "Succession: Elemental Revelation."
To go from using Awakening to Succession skills, you need to reset your skills and relearn "Succession: Elemental Revelation."



Wizard

Added the "Succession" content.

After Awakening the Witch or the Wizard, accept the quest "[Witch Succession] Word of Wisdom" or "[Wizard Succession] Infinite Intelligence" from the Black Spirit to start the Succession quest series.
You will learn the skill "Succession: Elemental Revelation" which will allow you to learn more powerful Staff skills.
You will no longer be able to use your Aad Sphera or Godr Sphera skills.
Added the "Succession" tab to the Skill window. The skills in this tab are affected by the AP of both Main and Awakening Weapons.
You will be able to learn and use skills in both the "Main" and "Succession" tabs. However, if there are both an "Absolute"" and "Succession" versions of the same skill, you must choose as you cannot use both versions of the skill.
To learn certain Succession skills, you will first need to learn the preceding skills from the "Main" tab first.
After completing the Succession quests and learning the skill "Succession: Elemental Revelation," you can go back and forth between Succession and Awakening skills by resetting your skills.
To go from using Succession to Awakening skills, you need to reset your skills to unlearn "Succession: Elemental Revelation."
To go from using Awakening to Succession skills, you need to reset your skills and relearn "Succession: Elemental Revelation."



Fixed the issue where pressing E after using Hellfire activated Flame Knot instead of Lava Field.


Dark Knight

The skill damage and the visual effect will now coincide when using Black Spirit: Prime: Obsidian Ashe.


Shai

During a Node/Conquest War, if a Shai who is not participating uses Over Here!, the skill will not block external attacks anymore.


Guardian

Added a text to Juggernaut: Smite's skill description saying you can use the skill in a combo after using Sturdy Step.


Item Changes

Added Simple Alchemical Formula for Concentrated Magical Black Stone (Weapon) and Concentrated Magical Black Stone (Armor).

You can purchase the Old Moon Solvent from an Old Moon Manager NPC for 100,000 Silver.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/15717a86f4ac28e162e8e9b08b56c631f3154532.jpg



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Some bees have gathered near Florin and additional Wooden Beehives were created.


Quests & Knowledge

The My Information (P) window was simplified.

The default size has been adjusted so that it will not take up too much space in the game screen.
Major information will be displayed as icons. You can view the details of the icons by bringing your mouse cursor over the icons.
You can still adjust the size of the window.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/c5ce1e1a1bfe39faccdbcc488edddef958ab721c.png



The Combat Fame tooltip will now appear near the Combat Fame icon in the Basic tab of the My Information (P) window.

Fixed the issue where the Forest Path Wagon Flag icon would be displayed incorrectly on the Crafting Notes (F2).
 
When you close and re-open the chat window while you can select the type of chat, the UI for selecting the chat type will now be closed when the chat window is opened up again.

Added a notification which is displayed when you defeat an opposing guild's guild member during a Guild War.

You can move, turn on, or turn off the notification through the Edit UI menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/54f05f78d58c56aef9f5bee2ac2d4fdf51264826.gif


Defeating an enemy during a war is not a walk in the park. This was prepared for that moment of hard-earned victory.

The size of the button for opening up the Barter Information window was changed at the Wharf's Load Cargo window for better visibility.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/94a159152a71d7017a5267a23f1f6d68805f2c75.png

Added a description about conditions for automatically using BreezySail.
Skilled Lv. 1 or above in Sailing, Ship Durability 50% or higher, mount inventory weight less than 100%

The Halloween Adventure Log's book design was revamped, due to being changed into an event adventure log.

Fixed the issue where the "Retrieve All" button would overlap with the description text of the Farming guide text when it was too long within the Installation List window in Place Mode.

Fixed the issue where the graph was incorrectly displayed on the Quotation Board for Trading.

Fixed the issue where the name of the Party Leader in the Find Party UI would be displayed as another party member's name.

Fixed the issue where the description from the Skill Add-on text bubble would not match the actual effects of the skill add-on.

Fixed the issue within the My Information window where the button on months without journal entries in the Journal tab was not being highlighted correctly.

Fixed the issue where continuous processing would not work in the Storage when attempting continuous processing with an item which does not stack.

Changed the layout of the Crop Information UI. The gauges will be displayed from top to bottom in order, and the size of the UI has been adjusted.

Fixed the issue where an abnormal text would be displayed when changing the Manage Workers window to the sticky UI mode while the World Map is opened.

Fixed the issue where the interaction key (R) in the NPC conversation window would not be activated for quests after having a conversation with an NPC using the R key.

Fixed the issue where tooltips for furniture would not appear properly in houses when there was too much furniture installed.

Fixed the issue where the automatic town resurrection time would not be applied when the time waiting for revival would have elapsed completely while in spectator mode or viewing your ally's perspective after dying in a Node/Conquest War.


Resolved Issues


You can now set the quantity of the item with the number pad when purchasing an item at the Pearl Shop (F3).

Fixed the issue where the line break of quest description became abnormal after adjusting My Information (P) window size.

The Display Name settings for Chat window will now appear normal when Loading Preset.

Fixed the issue where the following outfit looked awkward in certain situations when equipping it.

[Dark Knight] Eclipse



Fixed the issue where Frost Iron Jordun's appearance looked awkward.


Updated 13/02

Fixed an issue where the invincible effect from using the skill Command to Gather during Node/Conquest War would linger even when switching to combat stance.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where the icon and text of Sweet Honey Wine’s Usage in Crafting Notes are not being displayed properly. This issue will be fixed by the February 19th maintenance.

We are aware of the graphical issue where the icon of the event item required to progress in chapter 5 of the Valentine’s Day Adventure Log appears to be cut-off. This is a graphical issue only and will not hinder your progress of the log. This issue will be resolved in the near future.


Updated 13/02

We are aware of the issue where the location of the NPC Jarette changed when completing the quest "What Happened that Day" from the main quest line "[The Great Expedition] Oquilla's Eye," and it wasn't possible to complete the quest "[Event] Lovely Jarette" normally.

In case this issue occurs, please complete up to the quest "The True Culprit" from the main quest line "[The Great Expedition] Oquilla's Eye," and you will be able to start the quest normally for now. We will resolve the issue shortly.




Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

Best regards,
BDO Team

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/139835b205c603a2919e7cccfb6d4aa9a310c29f.jpg

Join us to aid Victims of Australia’s Fires and Turkey’s Earthquakes

Period: February 5 (After Maintenance)–February 19 (Before Maintenance)

The fires have already burned through millions of hectares of bushes, forests, and parks across Australia, taking the lives of more than thirty people and more than one billion animals and destroying thousands of homes.

In Turkey, the recent deadly earthquake strikes left hundreds of buildings in rubble, taking the lives of many and injuring thousands more.

We want to show our sincere sympathies to the victims of the global catastrophes together with our adventurers. All serviced regions of Black Desert Online and Black Desert Mobile will take part in this charity event where up to ￦ 100,000,000 (Korean Won) will be donated to the victims of Australia's Fire and Turkey’s Earthquakes.

Here’s How to Participate

Every [Event] Charity Token purchased by every adventurer who participates will be tallied up towards the donation made for the victims of Australia’s fires and Turkey’s earthquakes. 

[Event] Charity Token can be purchased from Lara in Heidel for 1,000,000 Silver each.

notes.title: Patch Notes - February 5th 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/d277fd8237cf0f1aeb2bf84daba87bb941747597.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

The Guardian awakens this week and gets access to Jordun, a massive polearm that will crush all her enemies! And to accompany this awakening, we have a lot of events for you!
Talking about events, Valentine’s Day is almost here, which means it’s time for love and chocolate related events as well!
That’s not all, keep reading the patch notes to learn more about Cliff’s weapon quests for new and returning players, the charity event, Theia’s Orb, class balance and more.

Event & System

New Events

Guardian Awakening Events

Event 1: Level up your Guardian, Part 2

Feb. 5 (after maintenance)–Feb. 26 (before maintenance)
Level up your Guardian to Lv.58, 59, 60, and 61 and claim your rewards via Challenges tab (Y).



Event 2: Accessories for Syrmin

Feb. 5 (after maintenance)–Feb. 19 (before maintenance)
Complete the event quest to get Item Collection Increase Scrolls.



Event 3: Ynix Seed’s Power

Feb. 5 (after maintenance)–Feb. 19 (before maintenance)
Interact with Ynix Seed to enjoy Combat EXP, Skill EXP, and Item Drop Rate boosts.



Event 4: Unstable Ember

Feb. 6 (00:00 UTC)–Feb. 19 (before maintenance)
Obtain materials and combine to exchange for Cron Stones.



Click  for full details.



Charity Event: Join us to aid Victims of Australia’s Fires and Turkey’s Earthquakes

Period: February 5 (After Maintenance)–February 19 (Before Maintenance)
We want to show our sincere sympathies to the victims of the global catastrophes from the Australia’s fires and Turkey’s earthquakes together with our adventurers. All serviced regions of Black Desert Online and Black Desert Mobile will take part in this charity event.
Click  to see how you can help.



Valentine’s Day Events

Event 1: Chocolate Fun

Feb. 5 (after maintenance)–Feb. 26 (before maintenance)
Defeat monsters or gather [Event] Cacao which can be processed and combined with other ingredients to make [Event] Cacao Chocolate.



Event 2: Love in a Bottle

Feb. 5 (after maintenance)–Feb. 19 (before maintenance)
Fish to get [Event] Message in a Bottle which you can right-click to open to receive various quests to complete for rewards or items that can be sold at NPC shops.



Event 3: Letter to a Fellow Adventurer

Feb. 6 (00:00 UTC)–Feb. 26 (23:59 UTC)
Play an hour a day to complete the special Challenge and receive the reward [Event] Sweet Gift Letter via Challenges tab (Y)
Please make sure to enter the Character Name (Not Family Name) of the receiver of your gift letter!



Click  for the full details.



Get Cliff’s Weapons

A permanent addition.
Special quests to obtain Cliff's Main/Sub/Awakening Weapon (+15) Box are available for New and Returning adventurers.
Click  for the full event details.



Ended Events

Guardian Launch Events

Toshi's Request

Succession of Events: Dark Knight

Black Spirit's Adventure: UPGRADED

Finding Mysterious Knight


Reward Distribution

Guardian Pre-creation Event: Create & Win!

Congratulations to the winners! Please check your in-game mailbox (B) for your rewards.



Content

All existing gear currently equipped by or in the Inventory of your Trial Characters will be deleted. Please note the gear sold from  Haz will be simplified.

This deletion includes gear for characters already deleted and characters pending for deletion.



Changed the minimum level at which you can reset all skills, from Lv. 55 to Lv. 56.

Given this change, the requirement for using Armstrong’s Skill Guide was changed to Lv. 57 and the relevant description was fixed accordingly.   



System

Increased the max EXP you can obtain within Olvia server as below.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/f0899386f3f495fad9d823c39b2a864e7e56e91e.jpg

Fixed the issue where you could not load saved settings to the Setting Archive even when there are files you can import.

Optimized certain functions of the game to decrease the amount of memory used.


Class Changes

All Classes

Unified the staggering action that all classes do when Emergency Escape (V) ends.


Warrior

Fixed the issue where the dyeing of the cape looked awkward when dyeing the Bolyn armor.


Ranger

Fixed the graphical issue where the cape looked awkward when equipping the Lephria outfit.

The Down Attack effect was removed from Prime: Ultimate: Blasting Gust.

Changed the following skill's number of hits.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/43c2ed5819988d398031b0fade59f460cf32eab1.jpg

The cooldown times for Prime: Charging Wind I, II, and III were changed to 7 sec, 6 sec, and 5 sec.

The Super Armor effect will no longer be applied when charging during Prime: Charging Wind's cooldown.

PvP damage reduction will now be applied to Prime: Charging Wind I, II, and III's cumulative damage.


Sorceress

Fixed the issue where the Trilby Hat was covered by the outfit when equipping the Trilby Hat and the Khilath armor at the same time.

Fixed the issue where a certain part of the hair looked unnatural when equipping the Cartian Helmet.

Fixed the graphical issue with the Glorious Shudad outfit's pants.

Given that the PvP damage of when instantly activating Prime: Abyssal Flame in certain situations was changed from cumulative damage to normal damage, the relevant damage decreased by 35% compared to before.

The PvP damage of Prime: Bloody Calamity decreased by 39%.

The PvP damage of Prime: Dark Flame decreased by 28%.

Accordingly, the PvP damage of Succession: Ultimate: Dark Flame also decreased.



The number of hits decreased by 1 hit for when instantly activating the last hit of Prime: Black Wave by consuming a shard, during PvP.


Berserker

Improvements were made for Berserker

A successive attack with Smack Down can now be rapidly used in combos while using Prime: Tackling Rock when Flow: Beastly Instincts is learned.
The movement speed while using Prime: Raging Thunder is now faster.
A successive attack with Beastly Wind Slash, Fierce Strike, or Frenzied Destroyer can now be rapidly used in combos after using the Rock Smash Succession skill.
The PVP damage of Prime: Frenzied Destroyer's last hit was increased by 25%.
The PVP damage of Prime: Fierce Strike's regular hit was increased by 15% and the PVP damage of its additional hit was increased by 20%.
The PVP damage of Prime: Beastly Wind Slash's hit was increased by 20%.
Fixed the issue where the hit damage dealt with Ultimate: Beastly Wind Slash, when Extreme: Beastly Wind Slash was learned, was too low.
The number of hits described when using Lava Piercer I, II now equals the actual number of hits.
Fixed the issue where you could use Prime: Frenzied Destroyer's Double Smash consecutively even when you had insufficient WP.
Fixed the issue where Claw Scar's recovery effect was not applied during cooldown when using Prime: Fierce Strike.
Fixed the issue where the WP was abnormally recovered when attacking with Prime: Fierce Strike while Claw Scar was learned.
Added a text that explains it is not possible to recover the WP during cooldown to Prime: Fierce Strike's skill description.
Fixed the issue where damage could not be inflicted when using Beastly Wind Slash after taking the Beast Form while Prime: Beastly Wind Slash was not learned.
Fixed the issue where damage proportional to Max WP was not applied when using Fierce Strike with insufficient WP after learning Ultimate: Elastic Force.
Claw Scar's recovery effect will now be applied to every hit when using Fierce Strike.
Tackling Rock will now be activated first when pressing W + F after using Storming Beast or Fierce Strike.
Fixed the typo in Prime: Storming Beast's skill description.
Fixed the issue where the damage dealt with Raging Thunder IV, V, VI, or Absolute: Raging Thunder while mounted was too low.
Fixed the issue where the last hit's knockback effect was not applied when using Raging Thunder I or II while mounted.
Fixed the issue where the last hit's knockdown effect was not applied when using Raging Thunder III, IV, V, VI, or Absolute: Raging Thunder while mounted.
Fixed the issue where the max number of Raging Thunder that can be dealt while mounted did not match the skill description.
Added a description of Raging Thunder and Prime: Raging Thunder's mounted hit.
Fixed the issue where the number of hits applied was less than what's specified in the skill description when using Fearsome Tyrant I, II, III, or Absolute: Fearsome Tyrant while mounted.
Claw Scar's recovery effect will now be applied to every hit when using Prime: Fierce Strike while mounted.
Fixed the issue where the WP was not consumed during cooldown when using Prime: Fierce Strike while mounted.
Fixed the issue where your character became briefly invisible when entering the water while on Prime: Beast Form.


In order to improve the way in which Berserker's attacks couldn't be connected smoothly in combos, we changed the connecting actions to look more natural. The PvP damage of certain skills was also changed.

We will continue with our balance adjustments. Any opinion on these issues will be greatly appreciated.

Fixed the issue where the dyeing of the Khaled Axe looked unnatural.


Tamer

Fixed the issue where the dyeing of the Rabbit Underwear looked awkward.


Valkyrie

Fixed the issue where the graphics on the chest area would appear broken when equipping the Atanis Armor and the Lahr Arcien Underwear A together.

The PvP damage for the Ultimate: Divine Power skill, which is used as a combo after using the Prime: Divine Power skill, was reduced by approximately 64%.

Fixed the issue where the character's movement would be unnatural when holding in Shift + Q + W after using Shield Chase.


Witch

Fixed the issue where the text about PvP reduction effect was missing in the following skill descriptions.

Flow: Gorr Roll
Flow: Gorr Launch
Flow: Voltaic Tett
Flow: Rage Tett



Wizard

Fixed the issue where the text about PvP reduction effect was missing in the following skill descriptions.

Flow: Arne’s Guidance
Flow: Arne’s Stream
Flow: Fire Fist Marg
Flow: Fire Breath Marg



Fixed the issue where the 1st hit's range differed from the other hits' ranges when using Cataclysm II.

You can now use the Teleport skill in succession after using the Hellfire skill.


Musa

The MP/WP/SP Reduction effect that used to affect the target when using Prime: Blooming will now be activated only on good first hit rather than on good extra hit.

The PvP damage of Prime: Blooming was reduced by 23%.


Maehwa

Fixed the issue where the waist area would appear as if there were a hole when wearing the Ladybell clothes.

Fixed the issue where the hair area would appear empty when wearing the Te'enah Headpiece.


Ninja
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/d11021f462a86d2a68a5e7f06fa1d61b5f9bdd9d.jpg

Kunoichi and Ninja's basic faces are now more attractive than before.

Changed the appearance of Kunoichi and Ninja's 4th faces. Each will be applied as each class's basic face.
Given the changes in Kunoichi and Ninja's basic faces, all adventurers who have connected to the game more than once between Jan 5, 2019 (00:00 UTC)–Feb 5, 2020 (09:00 UTC) will be given an Appearance Change Coupon (1 Time).
Please claim the item from your in-game mailbox (B) before Mar 4, 2020 (09:00 UTC) or the coupon will disappear.



The cooldown for the Prime: Shuriken Malice IV and Prime: Evasive Shuriken Malice skill was increased by 1 second.

The Accuracy Rate adjustment effect for Prime: Blade Spin I, II, and III was changed like the following.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/0f29ecae800eb833d28a021ae709ebf588aa95af.jpg

The air attack damage was removed for Prime: Black Moonlight and Prime: Beheading the Dead, and the Accuracy Rate adjustment effect was also removed for these skills.

The Accuracy Rate adjustment effect was removed for Prime: Shuriken Flight and Prime: Fatal Blow.

Upon Succession, the Shadow Clone skill will activate first instead of the Smokescreen skill when pressing the spacebar after using the Shadow Stomp skill.


Kunoichi

Kunoichi and Ninja's basic faces are now more attractive than before.

Changed the appearance of Kunoichi and Ninja's 4th faces. Each will be applied as each class's basic face.
Given the changes in Kunoichi and Ninja's basic faces, all adventurers who have connected to the game more than once between Jan 5, 2019 (00:00 UTC)–Feb 5, 2020 (09:00 UTC) will be given an Appearance Change Coupon (1 Time).
Please claim the item from your in-game mailbox (B) before Mar 4, 2020 (09:00 UTC) or the coupon will disappear.



Fixed the issue where some parts of the hair would appear cut under certain situations when equipped with the Ayo Helmet.


Dark Knight

Fixed the issue where MP would be consumed when using the Unveiled Dagger skill during cooldown.

Fixed the issue where hair 15 would appear graphically broken for the Dark Knight.

Fixed the issue where a certain part of the Ataraxia Clothes would be cut off when simultaneously equipped with Ataraxia Clothes and Purnado Shoes.

Fixed the issue where HP Recovery would not be applied when using the Prime: Lunacy of Vedir skill on a mount.

Fixed the issue where using the Succession: Imperious Command skill while on a mount would result in using the Imperious Command skill.


Archer

Fixed the issue where the graphics would appear broken when simultaneously equipped with the Crayodel Soldier Uniform and Glorious Shudad Ra'ghon.


Shai

Fixed the typo for the skill descriptions for Rage Absorption (Innate).


Guardian

Slayer of the Light, Guardian Awakening is now available.

Accept the quest "[Guardian Awakening] Storm of Oblivion" from the Black Spirit and complete the consecutive quests with a Guardian of Lv. 56 or higher to awaken the Guardian.
Upon completing the awakening quest for Guardian, the title ‘Slayer of the Light’ will be given.



Fixed the issue where the character would look awkward in certain situations when equipped with the following outfits.

Da-Dum Da-Dum Diving Suit
Venecil Dress
Desert Camouflage



Fixed the issue where the shield for the Treant Camouflage would look unnatural in the Dye (J) window.

Fixed the issue where the Critical Hit Rate increase effect for Flame of the Calling would not be applied when using the jump attack for Frost Strike.

Fixed the issue where the WP recovery effect would not be applied when attacking enemies on the right side while using the Fierce Disdain skill.

Fixed the issue where the reduced speed effect (Movement, Attack, Casting Speeds) for Flame of the Calling would not be applied on targets hit with the Merciless Kick skill.

Fixed the issue where the increased speed effect would not be applied when sprinting after on Guard, while the Juggernaut I skill was already learned.

Fixed the issue where the increased Critical Hit Rate effect for Flame of the Calling would not be applied on the headbutt attack which is activated when pressing F or RMB while using the Chokeslam skill.

Fixed the issue where the charge effect would not be applied on monsters when using the Black Blood Circle I skill.

Fixed the issue where occasionally the incorrect animation effects would be displayed when switching weapons.

Descriptions about the Bound effect for the 4th hit for Frost Strike was added to the skill description.

Frost Strike was added to the list of dual-hand attack skills in the skill description for Dragon's Calling.

Fixed the issue where the HP Recovery effect of Flame of the Calling would be applied to the 3rd forward hit for Frost Strike.

The skill recovery effect (excluding the HP Recovery effect of Flame of the Calling) will now be properly applied on the 2nd hit of Boulder Crush.

Fixed the issue where the recovery effect of Flame of the Calling would be applied when successfully landing the 2nd hit during cooldown of Boulder Crush.

The reduced speed levels (for Movement, Attack, Casting Speeds) will now properly reflect as it is written in the skill descriptions for Axe Throw I, II, III.

The Bound effect when hitting targets with the Black Blood's Descent skill will now be applied properly.

The number of hits for Black Blood's Descent III and Absolute: Black Blood's Descent will now match the number of hits written in the skill descriptions.

The recovery effect for the Flow: Black Blood Eruption skill will now be applied upon the number of hits as written on the skill description.

The knockdown description was added for successful hits on the Black Spirit: Black Blood Circle skill description.

The damage for the final hit and the DP reduction effect will be applied properly according to the level as written in the description for the Savage Hack skill.

Jump attacks and the Foretold Encounter skill will now properly be activated even when used on a slightly elevated location.

The skill lock feature for the Rockslide I skill was removed, and it is now applied to the Rockslide II and III skills.

Added a description about the Forward Guard effect not being applied during the cooldown of the Claw Reveal skill.


Item Changes

You can now use Item Branding Scroll -> Item Brand Spell Stone on tool items which can be repaired such as the Manos Lumbering Axe.

Added the item information of Forest Path Wagon Wheel, Forest Path Wagon Cover, Forest Path Wagon Flag, Forest Path Wagon Badge, and Krogdalo's Origin Stone on the Crafting Notes (F2) list.

Increased the chances of obtaining the Brilliant Fairy Wings from the Sealed Fairy Wings by 2 times.

Reduced the required EXP per level for Brilliant Fairy Laila by 15%.

Therefore, adventurers who already have Brilliant Fairy Laila may see EXP exceeding 100% in the Fairy window depending on how much EXP you had.
If the EXP indicates more than 100%, then you can go up to the next level by using Grow Fairy through the use of Honey Wine or green grade equipment.



The amount of Durability recovered for Artisan's Memory will be properly displayed on the item descriptions for Forest's Eye Earring, Red Sand Crystal Ring, and Rock Heart Belt.

The description for [Guardian] Loranne Bikini was added to the description for the [Event] Loranne Bikini Box.

Fixed the issue where using the [Event] Traces of a Festival would cancel Emergency Escape.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/c27e9f3a7f7b6f0523896523c82dbe68b9b5adf7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/76d06631d56fb7c8aea415d942a0065826446750.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/c61a5d52da37e55ac0176a9d1d3344c1a01379d9.jpg


Added the new item, Theiah's Orb, which allows you to change fairy skills.

You can change the skills learned in the Fairy Information window by using Theiah's Orb.
The number of Theiah's Orbs needed depends on the number of skills the Fairy has.
Theiah’s Orb is currently available as a Pearl item sold under the in-game Pearl Shop (F3).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/3d33f321e4733ca85c6296ba708fcb139eb073ac.jpg



Simplified the goods sold by NPC Haz.

[Guardian] Mueburus Classic Set will be available from [Event] Classic Outfit Box items. Right-click on the [Event] Classic Outfit Box to obtain the classic outfit set suitable for your class.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Updated 06/02

Family Name Change Coupon's purchase limit has been removed.


Monster Changes

Increased the damage received when mounts (cannons and ships) enter Oquilla's Eye during guild subjugation against Khan by 670%.

Damage from entering Oquilla's Eye during guild subjugation against Khan affects all players, not only the guild members participating, so please be careful not to enter the area during this period.



The Black Crystal Cannon from defeating Black Crystal Seaweeds summoned by Khan can now only be obtained by the player who inflicted the most damage.

Decreased the chance to receive Rumbling Earth Shard from Manshaum Forest and Forest Ronaros areas by 50%.

Monsters in Star's End do not drop Ancient Magic Crystal of Nature - Adamantine anymore.

More monsters were added to the outskirts of the Blood Wolf Settlement.

Fixed the issue where Sensitive Giant Elks in Balenos' Sniper Rifle Hunting Zone could be hunted at once regardless of their striking part.


Quests & Knowledge

Quests

Added "Recover 200 Energy" to the reward of the Savage Rift quest "[Repeat] Face the Endless Army."

"[Repeat] Face the Endless Army" is a daily repeat quest you can get from Juana Teron in the Savage Rift.
Monsters in the Savage Rift cannot be damaged easily with ordinary attacks. Purchase and use Matchlocks or Flame Towers available in the Savage Rift.
You can receive the quest again after 00:00 UTC.



Fixed the issue where the quest completion NPC for the "Leader of the Ahib" quest was at an abnormal location.


Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where the Buff UI sometimes disappeared.

Changed the UI for very hard bosses from Expanded Dark Rifts so they will now be easier to differentiate.

You can now properly sell mount related items to shops while on mounts.

Added a pop up description to the barter information button in the Load Cargo UI.

Updated the following UIs.

Setting Archive
Edit UI



Changed the location of the buttons at the bottom of the Processing window.

Items from the Camping Containers can now only be moved to your inventory by pressing RMB.

Fixed the issue where the Camping Container did not open when the Inventory (I) was set as a Sticker UI.

Fixed the issue where the level numbers in the image for Dark Rifts overlapped.

Fixed the issue where the local tax settings changed in the Lord Information UI when logging into the game.

Updated the following UIs.

Manage Furniture
Crop Management
War Installation



RMB on the following items will now open the Fairy Information UI.

Fairy Queen's Might
Sweet Honey Wine
Ornette's Dark Honey Wine
Theiah's Orb



Fixed the message displayed when you try to change to a character repairing or resting in their residence to display the correct content depending on the situation.

Fixed the issue where mouse cursor scroll did not work in the NPC dialogue UI if there are too many lines in the quest, guide, and chat list.

Messages for when you obtain, learn, accept, forfeit, contract, and perform will now be displayed in front of other UI elements.

Fixed the icons in the Lord menu's Tax Rate tab.

Fixed the issue where the description of promotions in the Manage Workers UI did not fit in the window.

Fixed the unnatural location of keys displayed during the Fishing minigame.

Fixed the issue where all search results during ESC menu search had the NEW mark them.

Fixed the issue where the effects did not fit the window when you change the size of the Skill Guide UI.

Fixed the issue where the minimap disappeared when you set the minimap to 3D and level up after level 7.

Fixed the issue where you could not click other UI elements when you click quickly in the Trade Bargain minigame.

Fixed the issue where random appearance did not apply when you select a certain appearance during pet exchange.

You can now continue with enhancement with the same Black Stone using the following Black Stones even after a successful enhancement.

Stabilized Magical Black Stone
Cleansed Magical Black Stone
Pure Magical Black Stone



Fixed the issue where the War Installation Info window showed up abnormally when installing a War Installation through an allied guild during Node/Conquest War.

Fixed the issue where the effect appeared abnormal when adding in the same material repeatedly in Cooking or Alchemy windows.

Removed the quests in progress that appear on the bottom of the Disconnect (End Game) window. Now a maximum of 2 most recently completed quests will be shown. 

Fixed the issue where the numbers did not appear correctly in the Disconnect (End Game) window when a character's Enhancement Chance was greater than 100.

Fixed the issue where Serendia Territory's Local Tax section would sometimes become invisible in the Adjust Rate tab from the Lord menu.


Resolved Issues

[Sorceress] Fixed the typo in the skill description for Black Spirit: Prime: Bloody Calamity.

Attempting to activate Forced PvP mode in Olvia servers will now display a message saying you cannot activate the mode.

Fixed the abnormal navigation route to Altinova's Black Spirit's Training NPC Jamey Drucker.

Fixed the issue where Activate Alc. Stone buff did not apply when you changed to a different type of Alchemy Stone.

Fixed the issue where the trajectory for the Ballista and Hwacha used in Node Wars and Conquest Wars did not properly show.

Fixed the issue where you could create a Guild Alliance after building a fort and then changing servers.

Fixed the issue where allied guilds could not see the status of enemy forts or damage them due to the above issue.



Fixed the issue where the name of  Juana Teron's name was not displayed.

Fixed Crafting Notes to not mention wrong NPCs.

Fixed the issue where some trees were floating in parts of Garmoth's lair.

Fixed Hotkeys to not work when searching within the Help UI.

Fixed the issue where the pop up description for the pet exchange button did not show the correct information.

Fixed the villa buff window to close when you retrieve your campsite.

Fixed the typo in the description of the Fairy skill Tingling Breath III.

Fixed the issue where Change Appearance did not work properly for the Emperor Hawk pet.

Appearance change for the Emperor Hawk will be properly applied when Appearance Coupon is used or tier change via exchange is done after today's maintenance.



Fixed the issue where a Tier 3 or 4 Emperor Hawk pet sat on a character’s shoulder.

Fixed the issue where activating the altar in the Altar of Blood caused the screen to flash.


Updated 10/02

Fixed an issue where the time for automatic resurrection at the closest town was being applied when dying in locations where Node/Conquest War was not in-progress.

Fixed an issue where the time for automatic resurrection at the closest town was not being applied when a character died during Node/Conquest War.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where trying to perform continuous processing on an item that cannot be stacked in the same slot of your inventory does not work properly. 

Please note that this issue will be fixed by the next maintenance.



We are aware of the issue where the “About” button in the Fairy Skill Change window is not being displayed properly.

Please note that this issue will be fixed by the next maintenance.



We are aware of the issue where the “Close” string is not being displayed properly while in Place Mode.

Please note that this issue will be fixed by the next maintenance.



We are aware that the 10% Discount Coupon that's included in the [Event] Master Trainer Haetae, [Event] Valentine's Day Horse Pack, and [Event] Horse Charming in Shining Armor package items cannot be redeemed. This will be fixed as soon as possible.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - january 22nd 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/7fea417f3f6c4add2b8432dba290908665538cf2.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Guardian has finally arrived in the world of Black Desert! Guardian wields a powerful battle axe and shield to crush her enemies without mercy. Also with her arrival you will be enjoying leveling up events and a drop rate boost! Tag the Guardian and share 100% of her EXP gained with another character!

Finally, we bring you a special event related to Marni and assistant Toshi. Help him fill in lots of Marni's Stone and get special rewards in return! As you already know: Marni is great!

Read the rest of the details and fixes of this week's patch notes below. We hope you enjoy the new class and the events!


Event & System

New Events

Guardian Launch Events

Event 1. Level up your Guardian

Period: January 22 (after maintenance)–February 5 (before maintenance)
During the event period, simply level up your Guardian and claim your rewards via the Challenges (Y) tab!



Event 2. Special Boosts

Period: January 22 (after maintenance)–February 5 (23:59 UTC)
Enjoy Mount EXP +50% and drop rate boost on Black Stones.



Event 3. Eternal Winter Enhancement

Period: January 22 (after maintenance)–February 5 (before maintenance)
Enhance then exchange Necklace of Eternal Winter for big rewards.



Event 4. Guardian EXP Share Event

Period: January 22 (after maintenance)–February 5 (before maintenance)
Tag your Guardian with a sub-character. It will gain all of the amount of the EXP your Guardian (main character) obtains (excluding EXP boosts) until your sub-character is at 99% of Lv. 59.



Click  for full details.



Toshi’s Request

Period: January 22 (after maintenance)–February 5 (before maintenance)
Bring lots of Marni’s Stones for Wacky Toshi and get rewards in return!
Click  for full details.



Ongoing Events

Guardian Pre-creation Events

Event 2: Customize & Win: January 15 (after maintenance)–January 29 (09:00 UTC)
Rewards will be sent with February 5th maintenance.



Succession of Events: Dark Knight: January 15 (after maintenance)–February 5 (before maintenance)

Black Spirit's Adventure: UPGRADED: January 15 (after maintenance)–February 5 (before maintenance)

Winter Wonderland

Event 1: Let it Snow: January 9 (00:00 UTC)–January 29 (23:59 UTC)



Finding Mysterious Knight

Period: November 27 (after maintenance)–February 5 (before maintenance)
End date for the event has been decided. Find the Mysterious Knight for your Skill EXP +100% before he disappears!



Ended Events

Guardian Pre-creation Events

Take your Whispering Frost Crystal to NPC Blacksmith Tranan Underfoe and exchange it for something special!



Pre-registration for Guardian

Winter Wonderland

Event 2: DIY Snowman



Grab the Mysterious Axe


Reward Distribution

Guardian Pre-registration (for subscribing to newsletter) rewards have been sent via your Account > Coupon in the main website. Please log in and claim your rewards.

Steam players can receive their rewards via ESC > Community > Redeem menu.



Guardian Pre-creation Events

Create & Win!: Guardian Pre-creation rewards have been sent straight into your Guardian character’s Inventory (I). Please check your inventory for rewards.



Succession Slow-Mo Contest

Rewards for winners have been sent! Please check fun and awesome slow-mo videos here.
Don’t miss on the second part of slow-mo contest with additional class successions to arrive later. More details will be shared soon.



Content

You can now immediately enter the Altar of Blood only when you have finished the relevant level and the one before it (e.g. if you have knowledge of levels 2, 5, 6, 7, 9, and 10, you can immediately enter levels 1, 2, 6, 7, 10).

Added new scrolls which are now available at the Campsite.

New scrolls will be available for the Campsite you can obtain for free as well.


The newly added [Camp] Adventurer's Luck has been created to provide you a wider variety of options based on the purpose of hunting rather than to guarantee you the profitability of hunting.

The effects of this scroll can stack with the effects of other Item Collection Increase Scroll items. However, you should always consider the amount of Silver that must be paid in order to maintain the buff.

Unlike the effect of an Item Collection Increase Scroll, the Item Drop Rate Increase effect does not increase the number of looted goods, but increases the rate at which you obtain items. So depending on the situation, one could be a better option than the other.

Newly added buffs are as follows.

The [Camp] Adventurer’s Luck buff can stack with other buffs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/57d0af3c9665ec050516d8967106c50744a258df.jpg



Changed the item description for the Adventurer's Confidence Scroll as follows.

The above effects do not stack with that of Villa Scrolls.



Reduced the amount of Parley consumed when exchanging Tide-Dyed Standardized Timber Square at Wandering Merchant Ship.


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

Fixed the location of the Exploration Point in the southwest of Grána.


NPC

Fixed the issue where you couldn't complete the following quests because some NPCs were invisible.

[Repeat] People Looking For An Inn
Her Secretive Request



Added a button with which you can obtain the knowledge of Jarette Domongatt or Horio Tinya.

Added a button with which you can obtain the knowledge of Crucio Domongatt after completing the quest "Confronting Jordine."


Class Changes

Berserker

Fixed the graphical issue with the left hair of the Khaled Ornamental Knot that occurred when in combat mode.


Valkyrie

Fixed the issue where the head looked awkward when you applied a certain hair customization after equipping the Solaria Helmet. 


Lahn

Applied the remastered effect to Lahn’s Awakening skills.


Archer

Camera effects will no longer be applied to the skills used during the Black Spirit Training.


Shai

Camera effects will no longer be applied to the skills used during the Black Spirit Training.


Guardian

Guardian out now!


Item Changes

Changed the conditions for using the Awakening Weapon Exchange Coupon as follows.

Before: Cannot be used by a character within 30 days of the class's release.
Now: Cannot be used by a character within 30 days of the class's awakening release.



Given the changes in the conditions for using the Awakening Weapon Exchange Coupon, a related text was added to the item description.

Added 10 types of Marni's Stone sold by Wacky Toshi.

Marni's Stone (Crescent Shrine)
Marni's Stone (Basilisk)
Marni's Stone (Pila Ku)
Marni's Stone (Navarn Steppe)
Marni's Stone (Manshaum)
Marni's Stone II (Crescent Shrine)
Marni's Stone II (Basilisk)
Marni's Stone II (Pila Ku)
Marni's Stone II (Navarn Steppe)
Marni's Stone II (Manshaum)



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Mechanic Changes

Decreased the difficulty of the Horse capturing minigame which can be played when capturing a horse.


Quests & Knowledge

Quests

NPCs will no longer exchange High-Quality Wines for Energy Recovery.

We have removed the feature in which you could recover your Energy by giving High-Quality Wines a Cooking Merchant sells to an Inn NPC.

This feature used to be a hidden way of getting a small reward by interacting with an NPC, but different from the time when BDO first started, the price of a High-Quality Wine is now affordable and consequently this item has become a way through which one can constantly recover Energy with Silver.

It was not an easy decision to make, since this feature was used by many players. However, preserving the value of various Energy-related contents such as Gathering, Conversation, and Secret Shop was more important to us. We hope you will understand our decision.

We will continue making our best efforts to study and improve even the smallest feature in our game that may affect the value of the game's content.

Thank you for your understanding.

※ Please note that Silver that equals the number of High-Quality Wine you possessed x200,000 has been sent to your in-game mailbox.

Also, the option to purchase High-Quality Wine from NPCs is back.

The NPC-to-complete-quest of the quest "Where is the last glass shard?" will still be visible even when the Hide Certain NPCs option is applied.

Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where the price at which a worker had been sold appeared incorrectly when this worker's level was increased by the buyer before the seller collected the Silver for the completed trade.
 
The order of the "Processing Knowledge List" from Processing UI - Imperial Cuisine will now be organized based on Cooking level, from high to low (e.g. Guru - Master - Artisan - Professional - and so on).
 
Fixed the issue where setting the Preset Quick Hotkey from Edit UI and running the UI settings reduced the Chat window to its minimum size.
 
Fixed the issue where the camera movement effect sometimes did not work when interacting with an NPC.
 
Added a button with which you can open the Barter Information window from the Load Cargo UI.

Press this button to see the Barter list when loading a ship.



Fixed the issue where Central Market prices did not appear in the item tooltip.

Pressing the Tab key from the chat input box will no longer switch the Chat tab.

Fixed the issue where the Chat tab disappeared when enabling and disabling Combat Focus Mode from Interface Edit Mode after having added the Chat UI tab.

Fixed the issue where the Receive button appeared abnormally when opening a town's transport status after having checked those towns with completed status.

Increased the time for which the banner that appears on the right bottom of the screen is visible.

Fixed the issue where Quick Hotkeys could be used in the death screen.

Fixed the issue where characters bled out of the Pet UI.

Fixed the issue where the Black Spirit's dialogue was abnormal when the quest acceptance UI appeared after the Black Spirit window had appeared automatically.

Fixed the issue where animation would appear in certain situations even when having checked the "Skip Animation" box in the Forge's Extraction window.

Fixed the issue where the PK penalty description icon was displayed on the death screen when your character died during a Conquest War.

Fixed the issue where the Promotion feature did not work properly when promoting a worker in the Worker List window.

Fixed the issue where an awkward text appeared on the bottom of the Recover All Workers window when opening this window after having set the Town and Grade in the Manage Workers window.

While closing the Manage Workers window, you won't be able to change to Sticker UI mode.

Fixed the issue from the Barter window where the filtered Item Grade Color did not match the Item Grade Color in the list.

Fixed the issue where the last page of the Fish Guide didn't get updated properly.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where you were moved to Weita Island when escaping from Iliya Island.

Fixed the location of the monsters that were stuck in certain areas of the following regions.

Star's End
Sycraia (Abyssal Zone)



Fixed the issue where unnatural structures were located in certain areas of Margoria Sea.

Fixed the issue where the trees looked awkward in certain regions.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't place furniture at Noble Quarter 2-4, 1F and 2F residences in Calpheon City.

Fixed the issue where starting the navigation near Macalod Hill made you go around a long way.

Fixed the issue where the Ocean Navigation settings reset when reconnecting to the game.

Fixed the incorrect item description for the Horse Emblem: Tier 7 White Horse (Female) item.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where certain crafting information is displayed in the Korean language in Crafting Notes.


Updated 23/01

We are aware of the lag issue which occur during the following situations.

When you get near an NPC by auto-navigating to the NPC who is near the coast while you are on a ship or swimming
When you auto-navigate to a nearby NPC who is near the coast.



Updated 30/01

We are aware of the issue where the completion NPC Viorencia Odore may appear underground and the quest 'Leader of the Ahib' cannot be completed. We apologize for the inconvenience. This issue will be resolved with Feb. 5th regular maintenance.


Updated 03/02

We are aware of the issue where a Tier 3–4 Emperor Hawk pet sits on a character's shoulder (excluding Shai).
We are aware of the issue where more than one Emperor Hawk sits on a character’s shoulder.

Please note the two issues above will not occur with an Emperor Hawk that has used a Pet Appearance Change Coupon.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Guardian Awakening Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/24dca45907b6cc4cbb38e9813bb2d8a3eaab348d.jpg

The class will become available next week on January 22, with her Awakening update to follow on February 5!

With her Awakening, the Guardian wields the Jördun, a massive polearm that burns with the holy flame of Ynix, the magic fire that has the power to slay even the gods themselves. The Guardian’s Awakening skills massively improve her Area of Effect potential, allowing her to take on large groups of enemies at once.

Additionally, as part of their ongoing Succession update, this week another class receives her Succession skills. The elegant but mysterious Dark Knight can wield updated skills of her original main-weapon, the Kriegsmesser. By giving up the versatility of her Awakening skills, players can choose to specialize in Succession skills which give them powerful versions of their main-weapon skills. Players can unlock their Succession skills at level 56 by accepting a quest from their Black Spirit companion.

Starting today, you will be able to pre-create the Guardian, the master of the Holy Flame. Upload to the gallery your best and unique creations to win special rewards! Remember that you will be able to play with the Guardian on January 22nd!

Also, another week we are receiving the succession for a new class: this time the Dark Knight will recover her forgotten powers to crush her enemies!

Finally, Dark Rifts will be getting a boost for a limited time: get more rewards and complete them more frequently with this new special event.

As usual you can find the details of today's patch notes below. Enjoy!

We feel now is the time to give Dark Rifts some tweaks to freshen them up. Now Dark Rifts will have periods of expansion where monsters emerge as Very Hard versions and appear 30% faster than before. notes.title: Post Calpheon Banquet: 2020 Development Plans
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/0560ce5522577954ebca987979af9f82189886fc.png

Greeting Adventurers!

The Executive Producer in charge of development for Black Desert, Jae-hee Kim, announced the 2020 Development Plans at the Calpheon Banquet offline event held in Korea.
He recapped the changes that followed after the Heidel Ball, and announced the various new updates coming in 2020 for Black Desert.

(Please note the dates mentioned are for the Korean server and global release dates may differ.)

Let's check them out!

Between the Heidel Ball and now

There were a variety of improvements and changes made after the Heidel Ball. They included: Buff UI rework, talking with NPCs while mounted on horses, more ways to get enhancement stacks, UI rework, Imperial Crafting Delivery rework, any more.
The Great Expedition, Altar of Blood, the Shai class and her "Talent," and other tremendous content updates came in.
We were not able to show you O'dyllita and Territory War as of yet. There are still a number of details that need to be worked out for them to fit the world of Black Desert. Please be patient with us as we strive to develop them to a quality with which we are satisfied.
As for Fish Farming, it was presented as a possible idea in the past and it received such good feedback that we expect to start developing this content soon.

Click here to read the Heidel Ball Recap

Currently under development
[olist]
Succession

We are focused on getting Succession out for the pre-existing classes. The original plan was to have all of the classes out by the end of the year, but we wanted to make sure we are putting forth quality content.
This is especially true with Berserker Succession. It was pretty close to completion, but it lacked refinement so it's undergoing development again.
Succession will continue to get released in mid-January starting with Witch & Wizard. They will be followed up with Striker, Mystic, and Lahn in the coming weeks.

Guardian, Slayer of the Light
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/a7635036c6ec09ed4823267c7fc9248b65cc13e9.png

Guardian makes her pact with the Black Spirit knowing that she will lose her memories. This was so that she can descend from the Mountain of Eternal Winter to reclaim Ynix, the Holy Flame that can immolate gods.
She meets the followers of Ynix and undergoes the trial of the Holy Flame on her journey with the Black Spirit.
Guardian comes in possession of Ynix to become the judicator of the flame. She wields a new mighty weapon to slay her enemies.
Guardian's Awakening Weapon looks like a pole weapon with the Holy Flame burning in its blade.
Guardian will be able to use devastating skills with her newfound powers. She will learn skills where she takes flight and crashes down to the ground, brings forth incredible might with a small gesture, and performs other awe-inspiring feats.
Guardian's Awakening is being developed in full-force and is planned to be revealed on January 15. (Please note the dates mentioned are for the Korean server and global release dates may differ.)


O'dyllita

Black Spirit, Edana the ancient, Elionism, and Sylvia are some of the cornerstones in the lore of Black Desert. Another chapter of the tale pertaining to the children of the goddess Sylvia will be added in O'dyllita.
The story will follow the Ahibs who were chased out of Kamasylvia by the Ganelles and their frantic vendetta, the secrets behind the once arid land of O'dyllita, and the immortal alchemist Caphras.
New and exciting battles against the Turos, with their rugged bodies and cow's heads, as well as formidable golems powered by ancient technology and the Ahibs will be revealed on the Korean server soon in 2020.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/0a67ca33848d5f60363086130b02f91bd64c53eb.png
                                                                ▲ Turo habitat
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/cd06b1b174f595b92bd4e5e788267b1461974ec6.png
                                                   ▲The view at Thornwood Castle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/9d2b4d00d7618632dc919fa500bf20b68dc223b1.png
                                                         ▲The capital of O'dyllita
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/8ccae9d5a05128da68e50469abf02f5fa3381627.png
                                                         ▲ Ancient Golem habitat
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/94d53d6aeeb878a515e49f15e8b97f4e0687a50f.png
                                                         ▲ Ancient Golem habitat
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/8e2191df223a8a2913d8c5b2ed54e053c73c72a9.png
                                                        ▲ Inside Thornwood Castle


Thornwood Castle

Thornwood Castle is located in the southernmost region of O'dyllita. This new island zone will include a unique combination of PvP and PvE elements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/c7bbee45cf07ffeb7d709bcc0196a06250a72d98.png
There are multiple entrances to Thornwood Castle, although at first, you can access the castle through one entrance. You can advance to the center of the zone as your complete more missions.
Adventurers can choose to fight each other or cooperate with one another.
Thornwood Castle will be included in the future O'dyllita update. We are planning to release more details and please be sure to keep an eye out on the Global Lab.


Blackstar Defense Gear

A new boss defense gear will be implemented. The appearance of the Blackstar defense gear will be vastly different from regular boss defense gear.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/82d2015607db0e5f5001e821034708c4b524d166.png
We will carefully make changes to the existing boss defense gears to ensure that it still holds value.
We will gradually update existing boss defense gear parts starting with the oldest part.


Papua Crinea

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/074bdc3f719c402adc1b36488c6d3e0e42a9d29c.png
Papua Crinea is an island region located on the outskirts of the world of Black Desert and the home of the Papus and Otters, two iconic and adorable races. In this region, these two races are waging a massive war against each other called the Thousand Years' War
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/06ef6f5eb4b1c22918c978db35fdc4404c9391cb.png
The Papus and Otters you are going to meet on the isles are going to be quite different from the ones you have met in other regions. Many of the types of interactions you have with them such as dialogues, quests, and knowledge will be applied with unique rules established by the native islanders.
You will have to pick a side between the Papus or Otters on the isles. Fight monsters, or do a series of quests for one side, and participate in their war for survival!
Due to the hostile relationship between the Papus and Otters, you will be on bad terms with the Otters if you help the Papus, and vice versa. Knowing that they have been at war for a thousand years, this is no surprise.
It'll be hard for them to lower their guard towards you as they've been waging war for such a long time. The Papus and Otters you will meet on the isles generally do not welcome outsiders.

[/olist]

Starting with Papua Crinea where the secrets behind the Papus and Otters will come to the surface, to the awakening of Guardian as she takes on the trial of the Holy Flame, we will be developing many exciting updates that you can look forward to in 2020!

Happy New Year!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/855bd88af25d060bce3c62e0330b6bc88d4d1a6c.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Time for the Sorceress and the Berserker to shine! The double-axes master and the dark magic expert receive their succession this week, and to celebrate that, we continue the Succession of Events. Talking about events, Winter Wonderland is also starting this week which is a good occasion for you to get some cool rewards!

And don’t forget to visit the Ancient Stone Chamber, a mysterious axe seems to have been discovered there.

More updates to discover about this week's patch notes below:


Event & System

New Events

Winter Wonderland

Event 1: Let it Snow

Period: January 9 (00:00 UTC)–January 29 (23:59 UTC)
Collect [Event] Snowflakes just by playing the game via Challenges tab and exchange them for cool rewards.

January 8 (after maintenance)–January 22 (before maintenance)

Click  for full details on the event!




Grab the Mysterious Axe

Check out the mysterious axe in Ancient Stone Chamber, consume energy and get Item Drop Rate +20% boost!
Click  for full details!



Loyal Attendance Reward Refreshed

Period: January 9 (00:00 UTC)–February 12 (23:59 UTC)
Check attendance daily to get rewards including Extra  Skill EXP scrolls, Fine Accessory Box, Valk’s Cry, and more!
Click  to see the attendance rewards.



Succession of Events: Berserker and Sorceress

Period: January 8 (after maintenance)–January 29 (before maintenance)
Adventurers who reach a certain level with their Berserker and Sorceress characters during the event period can obtain rewards below via the Challenge tab (Y)!
Click  for full details!



Ongoing Events

Pre-registration for Guardian!: December 24–January 22, 2020 (before maintenance)

Pre-register from the website 



New Year's Surprise

Event 2: New Year’s Attendance: January 1 (00:00 UTC)–January 15 (23:59 UTC)
Event 3: 2020 Fever Time!: January 1st (09:00 UTC)–Until further notice



Succession of Events, Part 4 (Kunoichi & Ninja): December 24 (after maintenance)–January 15, 2020 (before maintenance)

Succession Slow-Mo Contest

Duration: December 6–January 12, 2020at 11:59pm PST
Community Voting: January 15–January 19
Winner’s Announcement: January 20
Rules are now updated! You can now participate with your Berserker and Sorceress!
Click  to see how you can participate to win Succession outfits and more!



Ended Events

Thank You for 2019!

Event 1: Item Drop Rate +50%
Event 2: Boss Drop Boost 
Event 3: Auto-fishing Event



Piku is back!
Xmas Surprise
New Year Gift
Succession of Events, Part 3


Reward Distribution

Dirty Santa Christmas Party

Thank you for your valuable feedback. All rewards have been sent out to the winners and participants to the very first, feedback library event.
Be sure to check our official Forums > General Discussion section to take polls, share your feedback, and more! 



Content

Changed the number of Sea Coin Coupons required for the following item when exchanging with Ravinia

Manos Accessories



Added the new Refresh Barter Information function.

Added refresh buttons in the barter information UI.
Barter Refresh has 3 types; Regular Refresh, Instant Refresh, and Reduce Refresh Cooldown.
Regular Refresh: Uses 1 barter refresh count to immediately refresh the list.
Instant Refresh: Ignores the remaining cooldown and refreshes the list immediately by consuming 2 barter refresh counts.
Reduce Refresh Cooldown: You can use all the parley you have remaining to reduce the cooldown of the regular barter refresh.



10,000 Parley reduces the cooldown by 1 minute. You can consume up to 50,000 Parley each time.

You cannot choose the amount of time to reduce when you press the Reduce Refresh Cooldown button.


Dev Comment

Barter refresh is now divided into 3 types.

The first is Regular Refresh. This is the same as the previous refresh where you use 1 barter refresh count every 4 hours to refresh the list. When you can use Regular Refresh after 4 hours, a message will indicate that it is available for use.

The next is Instant Refresh for you to use when regular refresh is still in cooldown but you have enough barter refresh counts. This will refresh your barter list immediately regardless of cooldown time left. Use it when you want to see new items in a hurry, but remember that it will consume 2 barter refresh counts.

The last is Reduce Refresh Cooldown. This is for when you have refresh cooldown, used up Instant Refresh, and don't have enough barter refresh counts left.

Each time you press the Reduce Refresh Cooldown button, you consume 50,000 Parley to reduce 5 minutes off your cooldown.

This is a fixed value, so if you want to reduce cooldown by 20 minutes, you have to press the button 4 times.

When you have Parley below 50,000, Reduce Refresh Cooldown will consume all the Parley you have left and reduce the amount of cooldown left depending on how much was consumed. For example, if you had 38,000 Parley left and press the button, all of your Parley will be consumed and your cooldown will be reduced by 3 minutes and 48 seconds.

Chance to find Barter Support Box from island exploration was reduced by 35%.

More barter items were added to certain islands available for barter.

Barter information will have more variety compared to the previous static list.



Greatly increased the chance for Special Barters to occur.

Rates were adjusted to reflect upon newly added barter information.
Barter information obtainable from existing Special Barters were maintained.



As announced with the Global Lab Dec 26 maintenance, Barter Information List and Parley were reset due to changes in the Barter system.

Please note that Special Barter Information was maintained.



Delivery Gift Box will not be given as rewards for Imperial Cooking Delivery and Imperial Alchemy Delivery.

Dev Comment

Originally, the gift boxes were given to ease your next delivery by providing you with some ingredients required to make more deliveries. 

However, with changes to the difficulties of making these deliveries, more gift boxes were collected than intended, which in turn affected the games economy. Hence, we decided to delete the gift boxes.

We are preparing a different method to reward you for making the deliveries. We hope to bring you news of this soon.

Pets can now collect items when perched on your shoulder.


System

Added an option for auto routes to have a more streamlined movement.

This can be set in Settings -> General Settings -> Misc.
Choose ‘Smooth’ under Navigation Path Setting for a streamlined movement.

Now you can search adventurers through the Mysterious Man with banned words within their character names.


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

Mounts

Added an effect for large ships able to use Volley to determine the distance of cannon fire.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/64628471b847569aca6faadf70812b3e27241a03.png

The following large ships are able to use Volley.

Improved Epheria Sailboat, Improved Epheria Frigate, Epheria Caravel, Epheria Galleass, Epheria Carrack (Advance, Balance, Volante, Valor)




You can now determine the distance when using the Monsterbane Cannons used during the battle against Khan, the

This does not change the actual canon cooldown.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/ce904542da77db05b863df72aa8b879e2a356c0e.jpg
※ Please note there are no changes to actual reload speeds.


Class Changes

Warrior

Fixed the text in the description of Prime: Scars of Dusk, Prime: Spinning Slash, and Black Spirit: Prime: Spinning Slash.


Sorceress

Added the "Succession" content.

After Awakening the Sorceress, accept the quest "[Sorceress Succession] The Choice" from the Black Spirit to start the Succession quest series.
You will learn the skill "Succession: Abyssal Contract" which will allow you to learn more powerful Amulet and Talisman skills.
You will no longer be able to use your Scythe skills.
Added the "Succession" tab to the Skill window. The skills in this tab are affected by the AP of both Main and Awakening Weapons.
You will be able to learn and use skills in both the "Main" and "Succession" tabs. However, if there is both an "Absolute" and "Succession" versions of the same skill, you must choose as you cannot use both versions of the skill.
To learn certain Succession skills, you will first need to learn the preceding skills from the "Main" tab first.
After completing the Succession quests and learning the skill "Succession: Abyssal Contract," you can go back and forth between Succession and Awakening skills by resetting your skills.
To go from using Succession to Awakening skills, you need to reset your skills to unlearn "Succession: Abyssal Contract."
To go from using Awakening to Succession skills, you need to reset your skills and relearn "Succession: Abyssal Contract."



Berserker

Added the "Succession" content.

After Awakening the Berserker, accept the quest "[Berserker Succession] The Valor" from the Black Spirit to start the Succession quest series.
You will learn the skill "Succession: Feral Roar" which will allow you to learn more powerful Axe skills.
You will no longer be able to use your Iron Buster skills.
Added the "Succession" tab to the Skill window. The skills in this tab are affected by the AP of both Main and Awakening Weapons.
You will be able to learn and use skills in both the "Main" and "Succession" tabs. However, if there is both an "Absolute" and "Succession" versions of the same skill, you must choose as you cannot use both versions of the skill.To learn certain Succession skills, you will first need to learn the preceding skills from the "Main" tab first.
After completing the Succession quests and learning the skill "Succession: Feral Roar," you can go back and forth between Succession and Awakening skills by resetting your skills.
To go from using Succession to Awakening skills, you need to reset your skills to unlearn "Succession: Feral Roar."
To go from using Awakening to Succession skills, you need to reset your skills and relearn "Succession: Feral Roar."



Tamer

Fixed the issue where MP was not properly consumed when using Prime: Roaring and Prime: Void Lightning during horseback combat while on cooldown.

Fixed the issue where you could continue to rise into the air when using Prime: Throat Burn repeatedly from quick slot.


Valkyrie

Musa

Ninja

Prime: Dark Frenzy now damages enemies close to the Ninja as well.


Kunoichi

Added description to [Ninjutsu: Ghost], [Ninjutsu: Soul], and [Ninjutsu: Spirit] with their buff names and skills required to trigger them; [Prime: Shadow Stomp], [Prime: Shadow Clone], and [Prime: Shadow Explosion].

All AP +30 for 30 sec.

After

Item Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28674304/cc981b0cfe6a4a2f732c5675f8a37f385400bead.jpg

The Extra Damage to All Species damage was changed as below per enhancement level.

Design: Edan's Travel Wear, Orwen's Travel Wear: 2,000 Silver
