https://i.imgur.com/YarDyQO.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/LUIKGjZ.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/ALo0Ns7.jpg


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

The damage from horses will now also be included in the AP restriction for Tier 1 Node Wars.

This restriction only applies to damage to another adventurer from horse skills and mounted combat skills.
This restriction does not apply to damage to cannons, barricades, and wooden fences from horse skills and mounted combat skills.



Removed extraneous items from which you could gather from (i.e. fish nets) from the Longleaf Tree Sentry Post.


Mounts

Reworked the design of the Mount Information window.

Added information about extra damage against ships and PVP damage to the item descriptions of ship cannons.

Added information about mount skill effects and resource (e.g. Stamina) consumption to the Mount Information window, for all mount skills.

The information was added to the mouseover tooltip of each mount skill's icon.



Reworked the camera perspective and effects for when certain ships move and use skills.

Your camera perspective when you are sailing on an Epheria Carrack should now be broader.
Changed the camera perspective and effects for the skills BreezySail, Ram, and PowerAccel. when they are used by the following ships to hopefully be more immersive: Epheria Cog; Epheria Sailboat; Improved Epheria Sailboat; Epheria Frigate; Improved Epheria Frigate; Epheria Caravel; Epheria Galleass; Epheria Carrack.



Class Changes

All Classes

Improved way fights are displayed for Battle Arena and Arena of Arsha, so character movements look more natural.

We made this change in hopes that it will help alleviate the location lag issues at Battle Arena and Arena of Arsha, so you can experience a smoother gaming experience there. We will work to keep providing updates to help improve your gaming experience.

Shai

Fixed the buff effects of the following skills. These are the same skills for which buff effects were disabled during a previous patch because Shai's DP was being applied abnormally when using these skills.

Misty Haze
Twirl-Three
Kwik-Two
Hop-Three



Item Changes

Added a new item called Abyssal Gem.

Abyssal Gems can be obtained through a newly added daily quest at Oquilla's Eye.

You can check which quest via the Quest, or Knowledge windows.



Use Simple Alchemy in the processing window to combine Abyssal Gem x2 into a Tear of the Ocean.



Pearl apparel that are not bound yet can no longer be enhanced with Black Spirit's Claw.

Your character will no longer cheer when it gets Everlasting Herb.

Added instructions on how to use Elixir of Regeneration and Tears of the Star in their item descriptions.

You can now put [Guild] Breezy Crystal and [Guild] Origin of Wind in the inventory of your guild's Galley.

Added a set effect for equipping Loggia, Geranoa, or Manos life skill accessories.

Life EXP Gain +2% for every two Loggia accessories
Life EXP Gain +3.5% for every two Geranoa accessories
Life EXP Gain +5% for every two Manos accessories"


We developed life skill mastery accessories so adventurers with lower life skill level could improve their life skills faster, while adventurers with higher life skill levels could also benefit since the items improved their life mastery. Since these accessoires are not restricted to specific life skills they had a buff to increase Life EXP gain, which applies to all life skills.

This update adds an additional Life EXP gain buff if you equip life skill accessories of the same set. We hope that will help you improve your life skills even faster than before. This set effect is not affected by the enhancement level of your life skill mastery accessories. However, because the set effect takes into affect even when you only have two accessories from a set, we hope that these new set effects are accessible to all sorts of adventurers, new and seasoned.

Added instructions on how to use [Guild] Breezy Crystal and [Guild] Origin of Wind to their respective item descriptions.

Changed the drop rate of Black Magic Crystal items in the following locations.
https://i.imgur.com/p2eqPMv.jpg
Changed the specs of some of the items NPC Haz sells.

Increased Arsha's Gloves (Accuracy)'s DP by 4.
Increased Arsha's Earring (AP)'s DP by 4



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Moved the Grass Beetles near Loggia Farm farther from the farm.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Added daily quests for Oquilla's Eye.

You must have completed the following quests to be able to accept the new daily quests: [Daily] Our Guild is not a Charity Group; [Daily] Do You Have What it Takes?; [Daily] Win-win Situation.
You must choose between the new daily quests or the following old quests because you cannot accept both the new and old daily quests at the same time: [Daily] Old Moon Guild's Candidum Hunter; [Daily] Old Moon Guild's Nineshark Hunter; [Daily] Old Moon Guild's Black Rust Hunter.
You can choose one of the following quests daily. 
https://i.imgur.com/V2oE6G2.jpg



Added the following guild missions specifically for defeating  Margoria sea monsters.

Due to this addition, defeating  Margoria sea monsters for the old [Subjugation] Protect the Villagers missions will no longer count towards the mission objectives.
https://i.imgur.com/7IY2s42.jpg



Due to the addition of new Imperial Crafting Delivery boxes, the objectives of some quests have been changed to require the new Imperial Crafting Delivery boxes and not the old ones.

Added information about needing to hand in a specific Marni's Stone II to complete each of the following quests.

Sample of the Living - Bashim
Sample of the Living - Cadry Cultists
Sample of the Living - Desert Naga
Sample of the Living - Desert Fogan



Interface Changes

Removed the "Ship Type" text from the Ship information window.

Temporarily removed the Combat Focus Mode and Adventure Focus Mode from Edit UI in order to revamp the systems.

Changed the enhancement levels at which you can choose enhancement type.

This applies to green grade gears that are enhancement level +14 or lower (including reformed gears).
This change has been made since the probability of successfully enhancing +7–8 weapons and +5–6 defense gear are the same.
Before

Weapon: +7–14
Defense Gear: +5–14



Now

Weapon: +9–14
Defense Gear: +7–14




Reworked the design of the Adventure Log window.

The mouseover tooltip for certain nodes in the World Map (M) now contain information about what kind of items can be produced there.

You can now assign a hotkey for opening Campsite window that appears when you press LMB on the camping tool button.

You can no longer close alert messages that appear while performing enhancement by pressing the ESC key.

You will no longer get the alert that you have better gear in your inventory for gear of classes you are currently not playing.

Added information about sea monster zones to the World Map (M).

The names of the courser awakening materials in the Dream Horse Awakening window will now wrap within the UI.

Moved the location of the question mark (?) that was on the upper part of the Dream Horse Awakening window downward, to better accommodate for the UI text.

The progress meter measuring your horse's skill mastery when they are connected to a wagon (go to Mount Information > Connected Horse List > Connected Horse Info) is now circular.

Added mouseover tooltips for the skills of horses connected to wagons (go to Mount Information > Connected Horse List > Connected Horse Info).

Adjusted the lower part of the Learned Skill tab of the Manage Skill window for horses, which you can access at stables.

Changed the conditions under which the message recommending you to optimize your UI size will appear.

When UI scale is set to 100
When vertical screen resolution is under 860



When you see the message recommending you to optimize your UI size, you are now given the option on the message window to choose not to see the message again.

Reworked the design of the Party and Platoon UIs.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where the Mount Information window did not display properly when checking up on your donkey on the World Map.

Fixed the issue where sometimes the wrong tab would be displayed after reopening the Settings window and clicking on certain tabs.

Fixed the issue where irrelevant information would appear in the Disconnect (End Game) window when the only character you have is a trial character.

Fixed the issue where you got an alert that you have better gear in your inventory even if the gear had zero durability.

Fixed the issue where unequippable gear was color-coded as equippable in the inventory.

Fixed the graphical issue with certain parts of Weita Island that appeared with the lower graphic settings.

[Shai] Fixed the issue where Shai characters would get stuck at certain locations in the Marni Farm Ruins.

Fixed the graphical issue with certain rocks at Oquilla's Eye.

Fixed the graphical issue with the roads in Kamasylvia and Drieghan when it rained.

Fixed the issue where you could interact with an invisible NPC at Oquilla's Eye.

Fixed the issue where some of the text from the Worker Exchange window would bleed into other UI.

[Archer] Fixed the issue where the Forward Guard effect would occasionally not work when moving backwards while in Awakening mode.

Fixed the issue where the Death Count reset menu would not appear for the Miniature Elephant in the Stable.

Fixed the issue where the text at the bottom of the Load Cargo window would bleed out of the window.

Fixed the issue where text would occasionally not appear when Khan, the  would recover HP.

Fixed the issue where Khan would occasionally not recover HP even when a text would notify that HP was being recovered.

Fixed the issue where a notice about expiring items would abnormally appear when collecting items from the Mailbox.

Fixed the issue where the Black Spirit's speech bubble which appears on the bottom right side of the screen would be shortened.

[Sorceress] Fixed the graphical issue with the back of the Khilath outfit that occurred with certain character customizations.

Fixed the issue where the milk bottle would not fill up when playing the Cow-Milking minigame.

Fixed the issue where both the messages "The exchange was successful" and "There is no empty slot" appeared when you tried to exchange an item with an NPC via the Item Exchange List window and was unsuccessful due to lack of free inventory slots.

Fixed the issue where the End Game confirmation window would not close when receiving an attack while the End Game confirmation window is being displayed.

Fixed the issue where stamina would be abnormally applied momentarily when you de-mount a ship after using stamina-related buff items.

The UI for the item collection count will no longer overlap with the Red Battlefield participation button in the Arsha server.

Fixed the issue where the Node Information would be displayed in the World Map when you close it and open it back despite selecting the option to hide Node Information from the World Map.

Fixed the issue where you could not click on certain areas of the Storage after you scroll all the way down from the Storage menu.

Fixed the issue where the status of disabling the Speak/Listen settings in the Voice Chat UI would not be saved.

Fixed the issue where ships would get stuck in certain areas while moving around Oquilla's Eye.

Fixed the issue where the "Fire" button in the Manage Sailors menu would not fit within the button.

[Dark Knight] Fixed the graphical issue with the Ornamental Knot that occurred when going from main weapon standby to combat mode.

[Ranger] Fixed a text inconsistency issue between the skill descriptions of different levels of Spirit Healing.

[Archer] Fixed a text issue with the skill description of Grace of Sylvia XXI.

Fixed the issue where you could claim Challenge rewards even when you had not picked which reward to receive from the list of pickable rewards.

Fixed the issue where a Lv. 15 or above horse sometimes could not be sold to Imperial Delivery.

Fixed the issue where guild officers could not use the Emergency Supply function on their guild's Galley.

Fixed a text issue with certain guild skills' effect descriptions.

Furious Roar

Before: Accuracy
After: Accuracy Rate



Keen Insight

After: Evasion Rate




Fixed the issue where there was sometimes no system response appeared after a courser awakening attempt.

[Archer] Fixed the graphical issue with the neck that occurred when wearing Goyen outfit.

Fixed the issue where wild horses would run and then get stuck in certain locations.

Fixed the issue where wagons would move unnaturally when travelling a short, looped auto-path.

Fixed the issue where the guild, family, and character names of your character would appear abnormally low when the character rode a wagon.

Fixed the image that appeared for the Extra Combat EXP Scroll in the Pearl Shop.

Fixed the issue where the "Save Looped Auto-Path" window did not appear when clicking the "Set Looped Auto-Path" button after pressing ALT + RMB in the World Map (M). 

Fixed the title of the mouseover tooltip for the "Minimize to Tray" button in the Disconnect (End Game) window to match the button.

Fixed the issue where the location of NPC Deian would be marked with a question mark (?) even after you have gained knowledge about him. His location will no longer be marked on the minimap once the relevant knowledge is gained.

Fixed the issue where scrolling did work in the Disconnect (End Game) when your mouse was, for example, over the Energy or Enhancement Chance icons.

Fixed the issue where the quest description for The Meaning of Training told you do something different from the actual quest objective.

Fixed the issue where geographic knowledge was gained when conversing with a quest NPC during the quest Secret of the Mysterious Sol.

Fixed the issue where monsters would get stuck at certain locations in the Sycraia Upper Zone.

Fixed a text issue with the item description of Spirit Essence of Wind.

Before: When a Cron Meal's effect is still active, you will only receive the Stamina EXP.
Now: When a Cron Meal's effect is still active, you will only receive the Breath EXP.



Fixed the issue where the button for toggling the visibility of equipped mount gear or appearance items in the Mount Information window was appearing in the wrong color.

Fixed the issue where courser training progress would be displayed in the skill list of the Mount Information window.

Fixed the issue with the Suggest Change window for requesting NPC dialogue text fixes (Shift + LMB) not working.

Fixed the issue where certain dialogue buttons for the quests "Public Opinion in Altinova" and "The Sausans and the Crow Merchants" did not appear, impeding quest progress.

Updated 07/11

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 30th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/E7pSii2.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

All hands on deck! It's time to lower the ship flags and get those cannons ready! This week the bravest sailors will be able to earn more Sailing EXP when defeating ocean monsters.

Also, the Loyal Attendance Rewards have been revamped with new rewards, so do not miss the chance to earn great rewards by just logging into the game.

Enjoy the new sailing event and remember that the Halloween and the Great Expedition events are still available for one more week!

Good luck in the Margoria sea!


Event & System

New Events

Sail and Prevail

Event 1: Get 5 times the Sailing EXP
Period: October 30 (after maintenance)–November 13 (before maintenance)

During the event period, you will receive 5 times the Sailing EXP for defeating the following monsters such as Hekaru, Ocean Stalker, and more!



Event 2: Loyal Attendance Rewards revamped
Period: October 31 00:00 UTC–December 4 23:59 UTC.
Click  for full list of sea monsters and attendance rewards!



Community Event: 2020 Calendar Contest

The tradition is back! Veterans and newcomers alike, take a screenshot of your characters in the theme of each season and help us create the official 2020 Black Desert Online Calendar!
Final Submission Date: November 17, 11:59PM PST
Voting period: November 19–November 24
Winners announced on: November 25
Please check the full schedule of themed background and UI below:

Click  for full details of the 2020 Calendar Contest!



Ongoing Events

Halloween 2019

Halloween 2019 Continues

Launch of a Great Expedition

Free Game Pass for a Friend

SNS Event - #BDOGreatExpedition SNS Contest

Announcement of the Winners: November 8



Community Event: Halloween Costume Contest

Submission Period: October 16th to November 4th
Community Voting Phase: November 5th - November 11th
Kakao Games Staff Voting Phase: November 12th - November 13th
Winners Announcement: November 14th



Ended Events

Prepare for the Expedition

Build Your Guild

Reward distribution will be on November 6th maintenance.



Content

Changed the sea currents and the wind in the following sea area.

The sea currents at Al Halam Sea will be applied up to 20, and winds up to 300.



New titles related to the Great Expedition have been added.

You can obtain these new titles by fulfilling the requirements such as reaching a certain number of barters, obtaining a specific item or Sea Coins, defeating a specific monster, etc.
The number of barters you have reached before patch will count toward the acquisition of a new title that is related to this number, but you must do 1 additional barter to obtain the title.
The amount of specific items you have obtained through bartering before patch will not count toward fulfilling the 'obtaining a specific item' condition, but only the amount of items you may obtain after patch.
Equally, only the number of monsters you may defeat after patch will be counted.



Changed the objective for the Halloween Adventure Log, Tears Behind the Pumpkin Mask, to be clearer.


Game World, NPC & Effects

NPC:

The Otter merchant of Oquilla's Eye who used to disappear after just one conversation will no longer disappear before you have done several exchanges with him.

Maryan Pero, the Connoisseur of Calpheon, is temporarily away from his place.

Please note that Maryan Pero will reappear after the next maintenance.



Class Changes

Shai

Added the following Shai crafted costume which can be crafted at a Lv. 1 Costume Workshop.

[Shai] Kanna's Naga Disguise



In order to make '[Shai] Kanna's Naga Disguise,' you need 'Design: Kanna's Naga Disguise - Shai.' 

You can receive 'Design: Kanna's Naga Disguise - Shai' as a reward by completing the quest series of 'The Naga Enthusiasts Club' from the NPC 'Kanna' in Glish.

The Naga Enthusiasts Club
First Test: Understanding the Nagas
Second Test: How Much Do You Know About the Nagas?
Third Test: Naga, I Want You
Fourth Test: Teaching the Fogans a Lesson
Naga Enthusiast



These quests can be completed once per family, and can be accepted by a character of Lv. 40 or above without any restrictions.
After completing the quests, you can purchase the costume through the Amity Shop of 'Kanna' in Glish.
Titles that can be obtained by completing the relevant quests and crafting the costume have been added. 

Naga Enthusiasts Club
I'm a Naga
We're all Nagas Now




The following Shai costume that can be crafted in Lv.1 Costume Mills was added.

[Shai] Florin Cook's Clothes



The item "Design: Florin Cook's Clothes - Shai" is required to make the costume "[Shai] Florin Cook's Clothes".

The item "Design: Florin Cook's Clothes - Shai" can be obtained by completing the quest line "A Glorious Past". The quest can be accepted from Izella in Florin.

A Glorious Past
No Change is the Problem
Cleaning is Important
Focus On What You Do Best
Share the Good News
You, Me and the Oak Inn




* This quest line can be completed once per family. The character must be Lv. 40 or higher to accept and complete the quests.

* The item "Design: Florin Cook's Clothes - Shai" is purchasable from Izella's Amity Shop, the Florin Innkeeper.

Item Changes

Changed the following Energy Potion items to Blue Grade.

Energy Potion (Small)
Energy Potion (Medium)
Energy Potion (Large)
Energy Potion (Extra Large)



Changed the warning message for a guild item as follows.
The guild item will be erased if you leave or disband a Guild/Clan/War Hero.

The item name of "Incomplete Leanar's Celestial Map" has been changed to "[Guild] Incomplete Leanar's Celestial Map."

The condition for retrieving the following items from guild storage has been changed, from Quartermaster to Guild Master. Following this change, the item description for these items has also been changed.    

[Guild] Leanar's Celestial Map: Extra Large 
[Guild] Leanar's Celestial Map: Large
[Guild] Leanar's Celestial Map: Medium 
[Guild] Leanar's Celestial Map: Small 
[Guild] Leanar's Celestial Map: Extra Large (Summon Scroll)
[Guild] Leanar's Celestial Map: Large (Summon Scroll)
[Guild] Leanar's Celestial Map: Medium (Summon Scroll)
[Guild] Leanar's Celestial Map: Small (Summon Scroll)
[Guild] Incomplete Leanar's Celestial Map



The condition for exchanging the following items from Kanilla Delcas has been changed, from Guild Member to Guild Master.

[Guild] Leanar's Celestial Map: Extra Large
[Guild] Leanar's Celestial Map: Large
[Guild] Leanar's Celestial Map: Medium
[Guild] Leanar's Celestial Map: Small
[Guild] Incomplete Leanar's Celestial Map



You can now Force-Enhance some (Lumbering Axe, Butcher Knife, Tanning Knife, Fluid Collector, Pickaxe) of the Manos Life Tools from level +8.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

The security system of Kratuga Ancient Ruins has been partially changed.

Kratuga Ancient Ruins is a hunting ground for those adventurers whose AP approximates or equals 250. In order to keep these adventurers active in combat, we added monsters that require more focus to be defeated, a security system that is frequently activated, along with other factors.
However, we have received a lot of feedback that the event (security system) is difficult to complete, and therefore adjusted its difficulty to make it more suitable for the intended group of adventurers.   

The monsters that appear after the security system has been activated will now be displayed on the minimap as rare monsters.
The time limit of Level 1 security has been changed from 1 minute to 2 minutes.
The HP of Belloten and Elqueesh that appear when Level 2 security system is activated has decreased by 50%.
The AP of Belloten and Elqueesh that appear when Level 2 security system is activated has increased by 16%.
The DP of Belloten and Elqueesh that appear when Level 2 security system is activated has decreased by 20%.
A security system shutdown message has been added.



Readjusted the Skill EXP you can obtain from defeating the monsters of Valencia, Kamasylvia, or Drieghan territories as follows.

We have been adding updates to help lift the burden of leveling. There were updates that lowered the level requirements on combat skills, improved quest rewards and the different methods for leveling, among others.
On the other hand, Skill EXP was left untouched. This was because we wanted our adventurers to learn and familiarize themselves with the skills they had learned. The thought at the time was that the amount of Skill EXP given matched this pace. However, the difference between the difficulty of obtaining Combat EXP and that of obtaining Skill EXP became apparent. This naturally became a point of concern as the number of adventurers’ feedback asking us to make changes that will make it easier for them to obtain Skill EXP increased. The addition of the area in Crescent Shrine where the monsters “Possessed by Darkness” dwell was a part of the solution for this specific problem.
So, we have decided to increase the amount of Skill EXP obtainable in these areas (especially in areas where the number of monsters is low). We will continue to monitor this situation closely and carefully plan out the next steps.

10% Increase for Cadry Ruins / Crescent Shrine / Aakman / Hystria
20% Increase for Basilisk Den / Taphtar Plain / Manshaum Forest / Star's End
30% Increase for Pila Ku Jail / Roud Sulfur Mine / Tooth Fairy Forest / Blood Wolf Settlement / Sherekhan Necropolis (Day)
50% Increase for Sherekhan Necropolis (Night)



Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Added a new quest which can be started with the Mysterious Picture that you obtain from the Suspicious Cargo Ship.

The Mysterious Picture that has been discovered this time has sharp blue scales painted on it. By having this picture in your inventory, you will be able to accept relevant quests.
The Mysterious Picture that you can obtain from the Suspicious Cargo ship has been changed to be family-bound.



Changed the completion text for the quest 'A Cold Hero.'


Knowledge

Changed the knowledge category name of "Legacy of Goddess Sylvia" to "Legacy of Goddess Sylvia I."

The following knowledge details have become more natural and enriching.

Manshaum Hunting
Bow of Forest Ronaros
Krogdalo Hoof
Tooth Fairy Wing
Light of Kamasylvia
Forest Ronaros Riddle I–V
Hero Journal of Vedir
Record of the Moon's Darkness
Record of the Sun's Brightness



You can now obtain the knowledge of Shakatu by talking to Shakatu, in case you couldn't obtain this knowledge.


Interface changes

Shai will be displayed in the correct order in the Character Creation list.

You can now save the View Character Information (simplified or close view) you have chosen at the end from the End Game window.

The Level Up Info window has been updated.

The Read Mail window size will now change depending on the presence of the Send to Storage button or that of an enclosed item.

The confirmation message that comes out when making a purchase at a Sea Coin Shop will now mention the Sea Coin instead of Silver.

Unified the way in which Weights are displayed in Central Market's Warehouse.

The description that best fits the current look of your portrait will now be displayed when putting your mouse over the Zoom Out/Zoom In Portrait button from the End Game window.

The resolution optimization window will now pop up when logging in while using a resolution that is higher than the recommended one.

Changed the location of the Simple Settings by PC Specs menu from Settings.
Added UI optimization feature to Simple Settings by PC Specs from Settings.

Moved the ration description part from the Ship Info window one line below its previous location.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the awkward camera movement of Outpost Supply Port's Villager NPC.

Fixed the issue where sound effects played repeatedly when putting the mouse cursor over the Clan/Guild button from the Register Clan/Guild window.

Fixed the intermittent issue where, after having succeeded a Pet Exchange, abnormal pet level was being displayed in the Result window.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't use the item you have registered to the quick slot when logging in or loading for the first time after registration.

Fixed a typo in the Manage Sailors description.

Fixed the issue where selecting the simplified view of your character from the End Game window made the text bubble on the top right side of the window display the wrong description.

Fixed the intermittent issue where the wrong item was being displayed in the system message when using the Exchange feature from an NPC consecutively.

Fixed the issue where combat music played even when you were not in combat at an area near the sea.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't pass through certain regions of Gahaz with a wagon.

Fixed the issue where the character couldn't move normally around the NPC Merindora of Grána.

Fixed the issue where the character could pass through a rock in certain areas of Oquilla's Eye.

Fixed the issue where the structures in certain places of the Weita Island were floating in the air.

Fixed the issue where the waterfall of Kratuga Ancient Ruins looked awkward in Remastered and Ultra Mode.

Fixed the issue where Floor Materials couldn't be applied to certain parts of Olvia 2-4, 2F, while in Place Mode.

Fixed the issue where some washing lines were being abnormally displayed on the windows in certain parts of Olvia 2-4, 2F.

Fixed the issue where objects disappeared and couldn't be seen inside certain buildings of Altinova.

Fixed the issue where a stone was abnormally sticking out in certain region of Duvencrune.

Fixed the issue where a certain road of the Shady Tree Forest Path was cut on the minimap.

Fixed the buff icon that appears when using Khan's Heart: Destruction, Protection, or Life.

Fixed the content of the text bubble for Ranger's Halloween Outfit Box.

Fixed the issue where you could not obtain the knowledge for Tranan Lead Shot Chest.
You can obtain this knowledge by talking to the NPC Tranan Underfoe of Velia.

Fixed the navigation in the quest 'Ghost of the Past' to lead to the proper location.

Fixed the issue where the conditions for the following quests were wrongly displayed in the Recurring tab of the Quests (O) window.

[Repeat] Hunting Skeletons
[Repeat] Hunting Skeleton Warriors and Archers
[Repeat] Hunting Skeleton Wolves
[Repeat] Hunting Skeleton Lizards



[Kunoichi, Ninja] Fixed the issue where 1 hit damage was not being applied during Level 3 Ghost Greeting skill's cooldown.

[Witch/Wizard] Fixed the issue where you couldn't change to main weapon mode when trying to quickly switch from awakening weapon mode to main weapon mode.

[Witch/Wizard] Fixed the issue where guard effect would be applied continuously while moving after having switched to awakening weapon.

[Archer] Fixed the issue where the head area looked awkward when equipping the Cone Hat.

[Lahn] Fixed the issue where the dye disappeared when equipping a Jade Navillera Outfit without full durability.

[Berserker] Fixed the issue where the material of the bottoms looked different and the right foot area looked awkward when equipping Valencian Travel Wear.

[Ninja] Fixed the issue where a specific part of the shortsword appeared disjointed when equipping Narusawa Outfit.

[Ninja] Fixed the issue where the left sword appeared dark when equipping Dandelion Sura Katana.

[Ninja] Fixed the issue where the Pirate Eyepatch was displayed over the helmet when equipping the Pirate Eyepatch and the Rosa de Sharon Helmet at the same time.

[Shai] Fixed the issue where it looked as if there was a stain on the skirt when equipping the Marine Romance Outfit.

[Archer] Fixed the issue where the back left shoulder area looked awkward when equipping the Luanwulf Outfit.

[Wizard] Fixed the intermittent issue where the main weapon skill wasn't activated immediately after having switched from awakening weapon mode to main weapon mode.
 
[Witch] Fixed the issue where you returned to awakening weapon when you had switched from awakening weapon to main weapon while moving forward.

Fixed the area from which the [All] and [Send to Storage] buttons can be selected from the Mail/Read Mail window.

Fixed the issue where the berserk effect was deactivated when the World Boss Ancient Kutum attacked by entering into the ground.

Fixed the issue where the World Boss Ancient Kutum didn't disappear when not engaged in combat for 30 minutes.

Fixed the intermittent issue where the Guild Boss Khan didn't fail to recover even when you destroyed all Black Crystal Seaweeds during a combat with Khan.

Fixed the issue where the camera movement was abnormal when interacting with the Abducted Merchant of Basilisk Den.

Fixed the issue where closing the Storage by pressing the X button from the World Map closed the Search House window.

Fixed the issue where the location of the gift item list and that of item slots were in the Give Gift to an NPC window were out of place by 1px.

Fixed the issue where the frame dropped momentarily while adjusting the volume from the Voice Chat Options window.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't use the [Event] Design Bundle with Archer.

Fixed the issue where you could recover the health of a sailor boarding Ship A from the Manage Sailors window of Ship B.

Fixed the issue where the 'Looped Auto-Path' button's text that appears when using RMB in the World Map (M) overflowed out of the UI. * Only applicable to those countries that had the issue where the translation text for the 'Looped Auto-Path' button was too long.

Fixed the issue where the 'additional damage against humans' text was repeated in the description for Dandelion Awakening Weapons.

Fixed the line breaks and the issue where the ‘additional damage against humans’ text was included twice in the Enhancement Effect description for Dragon Slayer Awakening Weapons.

[Witch] Fixed the issue where the hair dye could only be partially applied when equipping the Weenie Looney Staff.

[Ninja] Fixed the issue where the Narusawa Shortsword was disjointed in the middle.

[Valkyrie] Fixed the awkward location of the Banha Outfit's earring.

Fixed the issue where the ship name text from the Register Ship window overflowed out of the UI.

Fixed the issue where the resolution resolution optimization UI was visible in the introductory video.

Fixed the issue where the notification text for a single Skill Training button and that for Train All button were the same while on Horse Skill Training.

Fixed the issue where the appearance of the Prancing Lamb in Calpheon City looked abnormal.

Fixed the issue where the item icon from the Rent Item window stuck out of the UI.

[Archer] Fixed the issue where the inside of the Goyen Outfit appeared empty.

Fixed the issue where the equipment weight of the guild elephant was accumulated every time you opened the guild elephant's Mount Information window.

[Dark Knight] Fixed the issue where the character's right hand disappeared when equipping the Awakening Weapons Kibelius and Stella after equipping the Enslar Outfit.


Known Issues

We are aware of the intermittent issue where the Main Weapon, Sub-Weapon, and Awakening Weapon are not being displayed while in non-combat stance.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 23rd 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/PZbEODf.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Here we are, set sail for the great expedition and search for the treasures that will make your dreams come true! New boats, bartering, sailors, treasure chests and even more features have been added to the game with this new update.

To celebrate the launch of the Great Expedition, we also have an event dedicated to it on top of the Halloween and Daily Reward Frenzy events!

Are you ready to conquer the great ocean? Go fish all the information of this huge update in the patch notes below:


The Great Expedition

The Great Expedition extends the existing ocean content by adding additional maritime features to the Great Ocean content. Upgrade your boat, hire your crew and go barter and fight monsters on the huge and vast ocean! Here are some of the highlights:

Ocean Current and Wind: Tame the wind and take advantage of it in this new navigation system.

New boats: This new update increases the total of large ships, and also introduces brand new ships, Cogs. Trade or fight lovers, there is something for every taste.

Bartering System: Cross the ocean and trade goods to receive a new currency or new ship materials.

Sailors: Hire NPCs on your boast that will help you through the turmoil of the sea

Khan: Defeat this giant maritime boss and get rewarded with valuable treasure.

The full patch notes on The Great Expedition can be found 



Event & System

New Events

Daily Reward Frenzy

Period: October 24 (00:00 UTC)–November 13 (23:59 UTC)
The Daily Blood Frenzy challenge rewards (skill & combat exp boosts) will be available as permanent scrolls!
Up to 3 [Event] Shakatu's Luxury Boxes and 30 Shakatu Seals will be available via special attendance!
Click  to see for details!



Launch of a Great Expedition

Period: October 23 (after maintenance)–November 6 (before maintenance)
Event 1: During the event period, enjoy Sailing EXP +30% boost!
Event 2: Luel the new NPC makes his first appearance and has opened up a secret shop in the Dancing Marlin tavern on the wharf of Velia to offer you a variety of items like Design: Epheria Frigate and Design: Epheria Sailboat.
Event 3: Double the Sailing EXP for completing the following daily quests which will be offered during the event period.
Click  to see for details!



Halloween 2019 Continues

Period: October 23 (after maintenance)–November 6 (before maintenance)
Event 1: Halloween Adventure Logs will be newly introduced for this event period.
Event 2: Hexe Marie will make a special appearance from the Dark Rift.
Event 3: Isabella the Black Witch is back and ready to cast her spells.
Click  to see for details!



SNS Event - #BDOGreatExpedition SNS Contest

Contest Period: October 23–November 6 (before maintenance)
Announcement of the Winners: November 8
Simply "post" a screenshot of you playing the Great Expedition content in-game! Be creative and fun to catch our attention. Please post your ‘own’ screenshot!
Even simpler, "share" on Facebook or "retweet with comment" (this is different than a “retweet!!”) on Twitter the official trailer of the Great Expedition on your SNS channel to enter. Trailer links are listed below per SNS platform.
Click  to see how you can participate with your SNS account!



Free Game Pass for a Friend

Period: October 23 (after maintenance)–November 6 (before maintenance)
During this event, each player who has played Black Desert Online for at least 500 hours will receive a key code for a free coupon. To qualify, you will also have to have logged into the game at least once between August 1 and October 22, 2019. This coupon can be used by your friend to claim a free Starter's Package.
Click  To get your coupon key code if you qualify!



Ongoing Events

Prepare for the Expedition

Event 1: Collect Cog Pieces: October 17 (00:00 UTC)–October 23 (23:59 UTC)
Event 2: Favor of the Falasi Family: October 16 (after maintenance)–October 30 (before maintenance)



Halloween 2019

Event 1: Spook is Back!: October 16 (after maintenance)–November 6 (before maintenance)
Event 2: Hunt Pumpkin Ghosts: October 16 (after maintenance)–November 6 (before maintenance)
Event 3: Collect Halloween Items: October 17 (00:00 UTC)–November 6 (23:59 UTC)
Event 4: Halloween Quests: October 16 (after maintenance)–November 6 (before maintenance)



Community Event: Halloween Costume Contest

Submission Period: October 16th to November 4th



Season of the Hunt, Part 3

Special Challenges 2: October 10 (00:00 UTC)–October 23 (23:59 UTC)



Build Your Guild

Recruit New Guild Members: October 2 (after maintenance)–October 30 (before maintenance)
Guild Attendance Reward: October 2 (after maintenance)–December 31 (23:59 UTC)



Ended Events

Season of the Hunt, Part 1

Fall Festival

Health, Breath, Strength

Prepare for the Expedition

Event 3: Special Quests: October 16 (after maintenance)–October 23 (before maintenance)



Reward Distribution

Added Special Attendance Rewards.


Content

You can now put a Matchlock in Morco’s Bag.

Changed the animation effect that plays when the door to the Kratuga Ancient Ruins opens.

Changed the location to which you are transferred when entering the Kratuga Ancient Ruins, somewhere a bit further from the door.

Receiving the reward for the 'Daily Blood Frenzy!' challenge in the form of scroll will no longer let the reward be immediately used.


System

Added a function through which a sound effect plays depending on the item shape when manipulating an item from the Inventory (ex. by using RMB).


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

The sea route that connects the Ancado Inner Harbor to the Hakoven Island has become wider.

Changed the name of the area which appears when you enter an area of the Great Ocean as follows.

Before: Margoria => Now: Great Ocean 



Mounts

The Stun effect will no longer be applied during cooldown when using the Dream Horse Doom's Dark Flame Steps skill.


Class Changes

All Classes

A character's passive skills have been expanded up to XI or XXI.

The level from which a Ranger, Musa, Maehwa, Ninja, Kunoichi, Dark Knight, Witch, or Wizard can learn his/her passive skills, has been adjusted.
Accordingly, the passive skills of a Ranger, Musa, Maehwa, Ninja, Kunoichi, Dark Knight, Witch, and Wizard have been reset.
Following the adjustments on character level to learn skills, some passive skill effects have changed.
You can now learn those skills of which the Max Level equals 10 (X) up to Level 11 (XI), when achieving Lv. 63. For those skills of which the Max Level equals 20 (XX), you can learn them up to Level 21 (XXI) when achieving Lv. 63.
Passive skills have been reset given their expansion, so relearning your passive skills will be necessary.



By Class

Ranger

Added Increase Max Stamina effect to Spirit Healing.


Tamer

A new passive skill called 'Beastial Instincts' has been added.


Item Changes

The following sentence has been added to the tooltip of Morco's Gear Bag.

You can change into those equipment items that also occupy the Outfit category (Trina Demolition Axe and matchlocks) only if your outfit slot is empty.



Unattainable items will no longer appear in Crafting Notes.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Mechanic Changes

Cancelling a fishing that consumes your energy when you have equipped the Fishing Chair and remained standing without sitting on the chair will no longer make you sit, but retain your standing position.


Monster Changes

You will now be able to get the "Heroes' Song" when defeating a field boss monsters, Quint and Muraka.

The Heroes' Song will be immediately used when you obtain it. The item will recover your HP by 5000 over 30 sec.
The field bosses from whom you can get the Heroes' Song are as follows.

Dim Tree Spirit
Giant Mudster
Red Nose
Bheg
Katzvariak
Quint
Muraka




The World Bosses will now go berserk and the time of their disappearance has changed.

World Bosses will now disappear 30 minutes after their initial appearance.
They will go berserk for the first time 15 minutes after their initial appearance.

Their AP will increase and DP decrease after going berserk for the first time.



They will go berserk for the second time 25 minutes after their initial appearance.

Their AP will increase even more and DP will decrease significantly after going berserk for the second time.



Garmoth will not appear if the structures that appear before Garmoth arrives are not destroyed within 15 minutes.
This is applicable to the following bosses.

Kzarka, Nouver, Karanda, Kutum, Offin, Garmoth



The Gold Bar with which you are rewarded when defeating the World Bosses Kzarka, Nouver, Karanda, Kutum, or Offin has increased.

Advanced Reward (top 20): 100% chance to obtain 1G, 10G / A low chance to obtain 100G, 1KG
Intermediate Reward (top 21st– 50th): 100% chance to obtain 1G, 10G / A low chance to obtain 100G, 1KG
Basic Reward (below the top 51st, more than 90%): 100% chance to obtain 1G / A high chance to obtain 10G / A low chance to obtain 100G 




Readjusted the Skill EXP you can obtain from defeating the monsters of Valencia, Kamasylvia, or Drieghan territories. The changes in Skill EXP for each region are as follows.

10% Increase for Cadry Ruins / Crescent Shrine / Aakman / Hystria
20% Increase for Basilisk Den / Taphtar Plain / Manshaum Forest / Star's End
30% Increase for Pila Ku Jail / Roud Sulfur Mine / Tooth Fairy Forest / Blood Wolf Settlement / Sherekhan Necropolis (Day)
50% Increase for Sherekhan Necropolis (Night)



Quests & Knowledge

Quest

You can now use the Gyfin Rhasia Stone, which is intended for the main quest 'Dangerous Negotiation II' in Kamasylvia, only when you are progressing through this quest.

Changed the requirement for accepting the quest 'Occupied Cron Castle' from Lv. 48 or higher to Lv. 21 or higher.


Knowledge

You will now be able to obtain knowledge when defeating the following sea creatures. You can also obtain it from the hungry marine creatures and young sea monsters.

Hekaru
Ocean Stalker
Candidum
Nineshark 
Black Rust
Goldmont Small Battleship
Goldmont Medium Battleship
Goldmont Large Battleship



Interface Changes

LED animation will now be performed in specific situations for adventurers with RAZER/ASUS devices that support LED animation effects. (Applicable RAZER devices include keyboard, mouse, mouse pad, headset, and Chroma Link)

When LED animation is not in effect, the F1–F8 keys will be interlocked with the character’s HP bar.
When LED animation is not in effect, W/A/S/D keys and C/F keys will be glowing.
When your client is first booted up, an LED animation will come into effect.
When your inventory (I) is full, an LED animation will come into effect.
When your character levels up, an LED animation will come into effect.
If you proceed, succeed, or fail in Enhancement, an LED animation will come into effect.
When the boss notification is on, an LED animation will come into effect.
If the character’s HP is between 40%-20% and the screen blinks red, an LED animation will come into effect.
If the character’s HP falls below 19%, an LED animation will come into effect again.
When you open up a chest item and obtain a rare item, an LED animation will come into effect.
When the Black Spirit’s Rage gauge reached 100%, an LED animation will come into effect.
If you go into a body of water, an LED animation will come into effect.
When night setting becomes day setting in-game, an LED animation will come into effect.
When it’s 07:00 or 22:00 ingame time, an LED animation will come into effect. 
When you claim a new in-game mail via mailbox (B), an LED animation will come into effect.
If you or another adventurer uses the Golden Bell item, an LED animation will come into effect. 
You can always turn on/off LED animation from your options under Settings.



Standardized the weight indicators in all weight-displaying UIs.

Updated the design of several minigames, including mount capturing, mount training, Medicinal Herb Device, and Crystal Extractor.

The Set Looped Auto-Path and the Retrieve Looped Auto-Path windows will no longer open simultaneously.

Adjusting the Mic Volume in the Voice Chat window will now activate the Speak function.

The description text will now change depending on the materials you need to forcefully enhance an item through the Equipment Enhancement window.

You can now easily distinguish whether there is an enclosed item or not in the Mailbox (B).

The Maximum Quantity in the Guild Shop will now be limited to 1000.

The remaining Breeding count will now be displayed in the Exchange Horse window from the Stable.

Mouse over the Breeding Price (Request Breeding) button from the Stable's Breeding Market to see the Request Breeding text.
The Horse List window that appears when pressing the Breeding Price button from the Stable's Breeding Market will now display the remaining Breeding count.



The corners of the updated UI are now round. The design of the UI buttons has been improved.

The Auto Loop window will now appear if you have set the looped auto-path in the World Map (M) by using Alt +RMB.

Readjusted some of the updated UI locations.

NPC Shop
Give Gift
Maid/Butler List
Guild Auction House
Worker Exchange
Boss Alert
Hotkey Settings
Item Brand
Weapons Exchange
Event
Ranking
Mail
Find Party
Life EXP Transfer
Storage and Search Storage



Moved the navigation button of the Item Drop window to the bottom.

Moved the close button of the updated Item Obtained window to the top right side.

Clicking on the item name or the item quantity in possession from the NPC's Exchange Items list will now allow you to do an exchange.

The dialogue that used to change when pressing the 'Quest' or the 'Exchange' button in the NPC Chat window will now remain unchanged even when pressing the other buttons below.

The setting UI that has been opened by using RMB on the new ESC menu's Recently Used menu can now be closed when selecting menus other than the Recently Used menu.

Starting the mini game after changing the hotkeys will now make the new hotkeys appear on the key guide at the top.

Selecting a list by using LMB in the Exchange window with an NPC will now move the activation indicator (R) to the selected list.

The camera will now move to the region where you can barter when clicking on the Barter icon from the World Map.

Closing the Quick Hotkey Settings window after selecting a feature and not assigning a hotkey will now cancel the changes made.

Added a message that tells you the exchange result for a brief time when exchanging items with an NPC.

You can now check the message that displays the item obtained from exchanging items with an NPC without closing the Talk to the NPC window.

Changed the images of [Event] Halloween Bag and [Event] Halloween Goodie Bag.

If the description text on the top of Shipyard Crafting window becomes too long, it will now be abbreviated.

You can see the whole text from the tooltip that appears when putting your mouse over the abbreviated text.



Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where the automatically-moving structure of the Cyclops Land was not working properly.

Fixed the issue where opening the Repair window immediately after opening the Storage in the Campsite closed this window.

Fixed the issue where the region name displayed on the top of the minimap was cut or overflowed out of the UI when the text was too long.

Fixed the issue where setting the Inventory (I) window as Sticker UI caused the Guild Storage to become invisible.

Fixed the issue where taking out an item after opening the Guild Storage and setting the Inventory as Sticker UI caused the storage to disappear.



Fixed the issue where you couldn't tag your character even when you have turned on the tag setting.

Fixed the issue where the Deposit Guild Funds window from the Guild (G) window couldn't be closed.

Fixed the issue where the character moved unnaturally in certain underground region of the Valencia Castle.

Fixed the issue where the flag pierced through the wall in certain region of Altinova Arena.

Fixed the issue where the phrase 'Until We Meet Again' was displayed on the Quest Widget when selecting '[Crossroad] For Altinova' among the main crossroads quests in Mediah.

Fixed the auto navigation to the wharf manager Dario in Iliya Island.

Fixed the navigation for Chapel 2-1, 1F in Calpheon City.

Fixed the issue where escaping from the Kratuga Ancient Ruins moved you to the wrong place.

Fixed the issue where the camera movement of some NPCs in Grána City, Khimut Lumber Camp, and Calpheon Slum, was unnatural.

[Lahn] Fixed the issue where the neck area looked awkward when equipping the Bloody Outfit and the Loranne Bikini at the same time.

[Lahn] Fixed the issue where the dyed part of the Sanguine Petal Outfit looked different when zooming out from the character.

[Ranger] Fixed the issue where the heel area looked awkward when equipping the Bloody Shoes.

[Witch] Fixed the issue where the dyed part of the Weenie Looney looked different when zooming out from the character.

Fixed the issue where some buttons among the Dialogue buttons of Hexe Sanctuary's Crow Merchant and those of Shadow Shrine's Bacho Ladericcio were being displayed incorrectly.

Exchange UI was being displayed even though there is no Exchange function.



Fixed the issue where item and skill descriptions closed whenever you were attacked while your 'Hide UI When Attacked' setting was turned off.

Fixed the issue where the horse appearance selected from Change Horse Appearance window was not retained.

Fixed the issue where the mouse cursor was deactivated when opening the Black Spirit's Safe from the new menu.

Fixed the issue where the location of the Quest Rewards window was unnatural for those quests that can be completed immediately after accepting the quest, followed by a conversation.

Fixed the issue where the new menu's Recently Used menu settings UI became invisible when it was opened on the right side of the screen.

Fixed the issue where the Event button was being displayed on the new menu which appears by pressing the ESC key.

In the case the notification text of Lakiaro minigame is too long, the background image will now get longer too.

Fixed the issue where the message '[Voice Chat] The microphone is not connected or there is a problem with the connection.' continuously popped up when changing the Mic Volume from the Voice Chat Settings window by using the mouse, while the microphone was not connected.

Fixed the issue where the horse appearance selected from Change Horse Appearance window was not retained.

[Ninja] Fixed the issue where the shoulder area looked awkward when equipping the Petroglyph Outfit.

[Ninja] Fixed the issue where it looked as if there was a hole in a certain area of the outfit when equipping the Yurei Outfit.

[Witch] Fixed the issue where the chest area looked awkward when equipping the Purnado Outfit.

Fixed the issue where the text of the Ship Info window overlapped.

Fixed the issue where the LED Animation Effect description from Settings didn't have a line break and looked awkward.

Fixed the issue where the message 'You must first select a mount' did not appear when requesting breeding without having selected a horse in the Stable's Breeding Market.

Fixed the issue where the ship's skill name overflowed out of the screen.

Fixed the issue where the Race Info UI did not appear when clicking on the Race Info icon at the top of the screen.

Fixed the issue where the description text overflowed out of the UI background while transferring a ship.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where knowledge entry category Ocean of Destiny is not showing up in German, Spanish, and French. This is to be resolved soon.


Updated 24/10

We are aware of the intermittent issue where your ship may become imobile after taking it out from the Wharf. If this occurs, please exit to the character selection screen and log back into client to resolve the issue for now. We will soon fix this issue


Updated 28/10

We are aware of the issue where the character’s stamina becomes abnormal when getting off the wheel of a large ship.

Please note that the character’s stamina will return to normal when you reconnect.
This issue will be fixed next week.




Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: [Maintenance] Regular Maintenance October 23rd 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/hm73DDo.gif

Dear Players,

We will perform our weekly maintenance as follows:

Date: Wednesday, October 23rd 2019

Duration: 4 hours.

Global 8:00 UTC ~ 12:00 UTC

notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/MjhEsYa.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Halloween is coming and to prepare it like it should be, we have concocted four events for you! Ready to meet Spook and Mischievous Jacks again?

Plus, as you may already know, The Great Expedition is coming really soon and in order to get you prepared for the big journey, we got you some other events that will help you to sail on the great ocean!

Learn more about this week's patch notes below!


Event & System


[New Events]
Prepare for the Expedition
Event 1: Collect Cog Pieces: October 17 (00:00 UTC)–October 23 (23:59 UTC)
Play 1 hr. daily to collect [Event] Ship License Piece: Epheria Cog and exchange them for Ship License: Epheria Cog (Kalis-Certified).
The exchange for Ship License: Epheria Cog (Kalis-Certified) will be possible after October 23 regular maintenance.
Event 2: Favor of the Falasi Family: October 16 (after maintenance)–October 30 (before maintenance)
Enjoy this daily recurring quest from Philaberto Falasi to get materials for building your ship.
Event 3: Special Quests: October 16 (after maintenance)–October 23 (before maintenance)
Accept and complete special quests to gather more materials.
Click  for full details of the events to get ready for The Great Expedition!
Halloween 2019
Event 1: Spook is Back!: October 16 (after maintenance)–November 6 (before maintenance)
Hunt down Spook the event boss for Halloween that may appear suddenly in front of you! 
Event 2: Hunt Pumpkin Ghosts: October 16 (after maintenance)–November 6 (before maintenance)
Defeat Mischievous Jacks and get [Event] Halloween Gift Box.

Collect Halloween items and exchange or combine them for better rewards.
Event 4: Halloween Quests: October 16 (after maintenance)–November 6 (before maintenance)
Accept and complete event quests to get Halloween props. Arooooo~! 
Bonus: October 16 (after maintenance)–November 6 (before maintenance)
Halloween themed UI and music will be added to the world of Black Desert Online!
Click  for full details of the spooky events!
Community event: Halloween Costume Contest
Halloween Costume Contest is on where you can show off your fun and spooky costumes for a chance to win awesome prizes like MSI MPG X570 GAMING EDGE WIFI, Ryzen 5 3600X, and in-game items!
Submission Period: October 16th to November 4th
Community Voting Phase: November 5th - November 11th
Kakao Games Staff Voting Phase: November 12th - November 13th
Winners’ Announcement: November 14th
Click  for all the details!

 

[Ongoing Events]
Season of the Hunt, Part 3
Special Challenges 2: October 10 (00:00 UTC)–October 23 (23:59 UTC)
Season of the Hunt, Part 1
Trina Knight’s First Support Kit: (September 25 (after maintenance)–October 23 (before maintenance)

Build Your Guild
Recruit New Guild Members: October 2 (after maintenance)–October 30 (before maintenance)

[Ended Events]
Season of the Hunt, Part 2
Item Drop Rate Boost +50%

 

[Reward Distribution]
Rewards for Complete Marni’s Stones event included in the Season of the Hunt, Part 1 has been distributed.

 

[System]
You can no longer perform actions that limit your entrance to the server where the action is performed (e.g. reading a book) for servers that have entry requirements (e.g. Olvia).
This means that actions such as reading at bookshelves are no longer possible in Olvia servers.
Warehouse Weight Increase based on Family Fame
The total Warehouse Weight based on Family Fame will now be displayed on the bottom of My Items, in the Weight Limit information.
Changed the Enhancement information of +13 Green Grade Equipment to (+13–+15) in the mobile web version of the Central Market.


Game World, NPC & Effects


[Game World]
Changed the placement of some doors to Kratuga Ancient Ruins to improve the visibility of the ruin's entrance and exit.
The place to which you are transferred when entering the Kratuga Ancient Ruins has been changed.

 

Mounts


[strike]While a Value Pack is active, Breeding or Trading a horse will return you a 5% of additional Tax.[/strike]

 

Item Changes


Added a warning message to the item description of Sweet Honey Wine that you cannot cook this food without the knowledge of "Sweet Honey Wine."
For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click  !



Quest Changes

 

[Quest]
Added a description of Investigation methods in the quest summary for "Marumin Monument."
Changed the completion goal text for the quest "An Entangled Mess in the Swamp."
Added a warning message stating quest requirement to the Quest Summary window of the quests that can be obtained with the following items.
Licensed Adventurer's Seal
Acknowledged Adventurer's Seal
Outstanding Adventurer's Seal
*If you complete one of these quests, you cannot accept the other quests on the same day.

 

Interface Changes


A warning icon and a description text bubble will now be displayed when the Ship Inventory Weight exceeds the maximum weight allowed.
Changed the name of the UI which is displayed when setting up a looped auto-path to "Set Looped Auto-Path."
Only after setting up your green completed loop in the World Map (M) will the save button for that path appear.
After the completed loop has been set up, this save button's description text bubble will change to indicate how to save a path.
The Maximum Quantity to be displayed in the Guild Shop will now be limited to 100.
Included enough space to the title that indicates "Levels" and "Members" in the [Find Party] window so that the terms could be clearly distinguished.
For newly-created accounts from October 16 maintenance, the third slot on the upper widget of the new ESC menu will appear with a [+]. You can edit the menu yourself to place in a shortcut feature in this slot. Existing adventurers can also edit the ESC menu through Edit Menu option.
The [Dialogue] button will now display an effect when there is any dialogue available in the NPC Chat window UI.
Now, even when there is a knowledge required to talk to an NPC in the NPC Chat window UI, you can use the hotkey for the button that appears below.
You can now close the dialogue list even when you select "Rent" from the conversation with an NPC.
Selecting the Search Results menu from the new ESC menu will now allow you to add the former to the Recently Used menu.
You can now see the main menu of the menu you have searched in Search Results from the new ESC menu.
Fixed the issue where the chat window scrolled down to the bottom when changing the size of the chat window while having a 1:1 chat with a friend.
In the case the text for displaying the item number in the Exchange window with an NPC becomes too long, it will display the item number only.

 

Resolved issues


Fixed the issue where navigation was stopped by the topography when interacting with the Old Pier Sign at Velia.
Fixed the issue where a random NPC became visible when failing to steal from Jordine at Heidel.
Fixed the issue where Emma Bartali became visible when failing to steal from Igor Bartali.
Fixed the issue where NPC Edan became visible when failing to steal from Cheremio at Glish.
Fixed the issue where the flower basket disappeared when greeting Saya Nesser.
Fixed the issue where Lemoria Armor wasn't included in the Polly's Forest drop list in Item Drop Information UI.
Fixed the issue where the warning UI wasn't displayed on the top right corner of the screen when the durability of your Miniature Elephant's equipment had been consumed.
Fixed the issue where the location of some UIs that had been set up with the Edit UI reset when creating a new character and initiating a tutorial.
Fixed the issue where the DP of the item whose Durability was completely consumed was summed when opening the Mount Information window.
Fixed the issue where clicking on the Character Selection window while reading a book at your residence did not move you to this window.
Fixed the issue where the function with which you can set up the hotkeys for Preset 1, Preset 2, Preset 3, Combat Focus Mode and Adventure Focus Mode buttons in the Edit UI was removed.
Fixed the issue where the function with which you can set up a quick hotkey for the Alchemy Stone button in the Inventory (I) was removed.
Fixed the issue where the skill description text bubble didn't appear in the Stable's Manage Skill window.
Fixed the issue where the Game Menu UI appeared when ending Spectator Mode by pressing ESC while using the old Menu window.
The Game Menu UI will no longer appear when closing Spectator Mode by pressing ESC.
Fixed the issue where the letters overlapped because the text was too long when selecting Worker Grade in the View Workers Continuously window.

Fixed the issue where even without the knowledge of Katzvariak, the field boss of Drieghan, this monster's HP would be displayed.

Fixed the issue where characters would get trapped in certain region of Sycraia Abyssal Zone.
Fixed the issue where characters could enter the Kratuga Ancient Ruins in an abnormal way.
Fixed the intermittent issue where items would be enhanced consecutively.
[Warrior] Fixed the issue where abnormal particle effects were being displayed when using the Awakening skill, Black Spirit: Solar Flare.
[Witch] Fixed the graphical glitch that occurred when using the Alchemy Tool while equipping the Purnado Armor.
[Mystic] Fixed the issue where the dyed part of the Dhyana Outfit looked different when zooming out from the character.
[Ninja] Fixed the graphical glitch that appeared when equipping the Petroglyph Outfit.
[Shai] Fixed the awkward movement that Shai had when getting off a Camel or a Wagon.
[Shai] Fixed the issue where after defeating a monster and collecting items while in Talent mode, Shai would switch to Non-combat stance.
Fixed the issue where the fish icon remained above the character's head even after having caught a fish by doing Auto-fishing with Crio's Fishing Chair equipped.
Fixed the issue where the stats of equipment whose Durability was completely consumed would be applied to a mount at the Stable or the Wharf.
Fixed the issue where a notification message, which made it look as if it was possible to dye even an unequipped item when dyeing, was being displayed.
Fixed the issue where you couldn't select a menu or it looked as if you couldn't do so when using the keyboard to move in the new Menu.
Fixed the issue where the Security Budget didn't appear when a Lord player of Mediah or Valencia Territory entered the Tax Collection tab from the Lord menu.
Fixed the issue where the Quotation Board window on the left side of the Trade window would intermittently overlap with the bar below.
Fixed the issue where the wrong effect was being displayed for some skills when using the Remastered Mode or Ultra Mode.
Fixed the issue where it was possible to do Gather in the areas where Gathering cannot be performed near the Old Wisdom Tree.
Fixed the issue where using Stub Arrow after equipping Blackstar Blade caused abnormally high damage to be applied.
Fixed the issue where some moving NPCs went into the river near the Northern Wheat Plantation.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't see the Memorial Stone with the Ancients' Memories, the completion NPC for the quest "Ancients' Memories - Memory Fragment."
Fixed the typo in the description of the Earth's Roar buff.
Fixed the typo in the item description for Loggia Fisher's Clothes.
Fixed the typo in the conversation that comes out upon accepting the quest "[Repeat] Heidi's Fundamentals of Cooking."

Fixed the issue where the mouse cursor was displayed as a finger instead of an arrow in the Ship Info window.
Fixed the issue in the Pet Group UI under Pet List window where the tooltip description for Group 5’s button came out on the Group 4’s button.
Fixed the issue where the screen would scroll to the top when adjusting the window size or doing 1:1 Chat from the Friend List window.
Fixed the progress and completion sound effects for Weapons Exchange in the Weapons Exchange window.
Fixed the issue where the background of the progress bar in use did not fit with the location of the Adjust button when adjusting the Tax Rate from the Lord menu.
Fixed the issue where it looked as if the Reset and Apply buttons were activated for areas to which you cannot Impose Local Tax in the Tax Rate tab from the Lord menu.
