notes.title: Patch Notes - October 8th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/MDmmb9k.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Are you ready for a new high geared monster zone? From this week, you can access the Kratuga Ancient Ruins, a 250 AP Monster Zone, provided that you open the doors using a Black Spirit's Claw Piece or an Unsealed Ruins Slate.

Kill new monsters while enjoying your +50% of drop rate and extra rewards for your playtime with the third part of the Season of the Hunt.

And what better way to enjoy all the new content than a revamp of the User Interface?

Discover all the details of the new features below!


Event & System

New Events

Season of the Hunt, Part 3: 

Item Drop Rate Boost +50%

Period: October 8 (after maintenance)–October 16 (before maintenance)
During the event period, item drop rate for defeating monsters will increase by +50%. (This does not apply to when fishing or gathering).
Item drop rate boost from the event stacks with item drop rate buffs from items such as [Event] Item Collection Increase Scroll and Blessing of Kamasylve items. However, this drop rate boost does not apply to event items such as [Event] Rarity Pouch and [Event] Fortune Pouch.



Special Challenges 2

Period: October 10 (00:00 UTC)–October 23 (23:59 UTC)
During the event period, play daily and get the below rewards via the Challenge tab (Y) based on your accumulated playtime.
Click  to learn all about the part 3 of events for the Season of the Hunt.




Ongoing Events

Season of the Hunt, Part 2: October 2 (after maintenance)–October 16 (before maintenance)

Build Your Guild

Recruit New Guild Members: October 2 (after maintenance)–October 30 (before maintenance)
Guild Attendance Reward: October 2 (after maintenance)–December 31 (23:59 UTC)



Health, Breath, Strength: October 2 (after maintenance)–October 23 (before maintenance)

Season of the Hunt, Part 1 

Trina Knight’s First Support Kit: (September 25 (after maintenance)–October 23 (before maintenance)
Special Challenges: September 26 00:00 UTC–October 9 23:59 UTC



Fall Festival: September 25 (after maintenance)–October 23 (before maintenance)


Ended Events

Season of the Hunt, Part 1 

Complete Marni’s Stones
World Boss Drop Rate Boost
Fever Time Boost



Kratuga Ancient Ruins

Kratuga Ancient Ruins, a new Monster Zone, have been discovered by the adventurers. 



We hope each of you, adventurers, enjoy your battle at a Monster Zone optimal for your own level or equipment. We went through several optimization processes of Monster Zone balance and displayed the optimal AP for each Monster Zone in the World Map, all in order to allow you to find the most appropriate Monster Zone for you each time you enhanced your equipment and made a development.

Kratuga Ancient Ruins, the new Monster Zone, are for those adventurers whose AP approximates or equals 250. You can now enjoy your play at the new Monster Zone without having to stay at a Monster Zone with a Recommended AP of 210-240 anymore. If Aakman or Hystria Ruins feel a bit overwhelming, the new Ancient Ruins could become a good training place for you.


By using the Black Spirit's Claw Piece or Unsealed Ruins Slate at the door located somewhere in Hasrah Ancient Ruins, you can temporarily activate the door to Kratuga Ancient Ruins and enter there.

If one adventurer opens the door to Kratuga Ancient Ruins, other adventurers can go in or out as well for a limited amount of time. 



You can create the Unsealed Ruins Slate by combining Sealed Ruins Slate x3, obtainable from the Kratuga Ancient Ruins monsters.

The Recommended AP for Kratuga Ancient Ruins is 250 and above.

Crystal of Elkarr, a new crystal that can be equipped to your main weapon, has been added. You will need to perform Simple Alchemy with materials below to create one:
https://i.imgur.com/F7Co98W.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/CqFDwQr.png
By equipping the new crystal, you can obtain the following effects: All Accuracy +12, Ignore All Resistance +10%.

You can get Elkarr, the necessary material for making Crystal of Elkarr, in the new region Kratuga Ancient Ruins at a very low chance.


System

You can now move a quantity of items that equals the maximum weight a mount can possess (214,000 LT for a horse) at once, when moving the items from the Storage to the Mount Inventory.

It is now more comfortable and easier to move a Storage item to a mount when selling any Processed Trade Goods.
These rules will be applied to Land Mounts only.
The rules are not applicable to Guild Mounts.



Group 4 and 5 have been added to the Pet list and now you can set more types of groups.

You can now check the Storage through your Maid/Butler even when they are not in Standby mode.

Improved the saving system of the World Map's "Set Auto-run Path" function. (The existing auto-navigation data file will be removed.) 


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

Fixed the issue where certain masts were not visible when logging into the game in the middle of the ocean.


Class Changes

Warrior

Changed the Head Chase I, II, and III skills to Head Chase.

The skill points you have achieved for your previously selected skill will be returned.
Added new Awakening skills “Frenzied Strikes I, II, III.”




Most of the Awakened Warrior's main skills cannot be used during cooldown. This is something we considered to be characteristic of Warrior who deals continuous heavy attacks, and therefore was not updated. However, players who would switch to use Normal Mode skills in order to fill this gap have been increasing lately, which did not only cause many inconveniences but also create a difference between these players and those who did not use the Normal Mode skills. 

In the end, we decided to add a new skill that matches Warrior’s Awakening. The newly added “Frenzied Strikes” is a skill that has a short cooldown and great attack damage, apt for activities such as defeating monsters. We have also unified the three Head chase skills and made adjustments so that the effect of the previous Head Chase III would be applied when learning the unified skill. This new skill is a balance patch unrelated to Transcendence and we will keep doing this kind of balance patch for each character in the future.


Ranger

Fixed the issue where attack range increase was included in the skill description of Absolute: Evasive Explosion Shot.


Shai

Shai has discovered a new skill.

Shai is now able to ride Wagons and Camels.



Due to the issue where Shai’s DP was applied abnormally, adjustments were made so that using or playing the following skills would not activate any buff effect.

Misty Haze
Twirl-Three
Kwik-Two
Hop-Three




On October 2nd, we verified that when playing Misty Haze, Shai’s DP was applied abnormally, and therefore restricted the skill effect application. Later we verified that Twirl-Three, Kwik-Two, and Hop-Three had the same issue and adjustments were made so that using these skills would not activate any buff effect.
The way how these skills’ buff is applied can be changed with the adjustments and we will notify you about these changes with the update notes.
We will try our best to fix the issue as soon as possible, and we apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused you.


Item Changes

The workload and the production output of Farming, Gathering, Mining, and Lumbering Production Nodes have doubled.

Added Celerity Draught and Unbridled Celerity Draught, which are beneficial for Trainings that require long time.

Formulas to craft these items have been added to Crafting Notes.
Perform Simple Alchemy following the formula to obtain the new draught items.



Removed the least frequently used items such as Old Flame Tower, Old Hwacha, Oil for Old Flame Tower, and Old Hwacha Arrows from the Guild Shop Purchase list.

However, you can still use the items you have in the Guild Storage or the Inventory.



Fixed the awkward expression in the item description of some Ship Licenses and Horse Emblems.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Fixed the issue where some monsters of the Southwestern Gateway appeared during your progress through the quest "Impossible Task" and caused hindrance.

The monsters were moved to a place further from the road.



Fixed the issue where Ahib Griffon's appearance was not intermittently visible when this Guild Boss was flying.

Changed and fixed the Weakening effect that any of the following Mirumok Ruins monsters inflicts on nearby players by exploding itself from DP +1 to DP -50.

Mirumok Lookout
Mirumok Watcher



Fixed the issue where the Boss summoned by using the Awakened Boss Summon Scroll didn't disappear even after 30 minutes.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Added information on how to use the Summon Scroll to the following quests' summaries.

[Boss] Illezra's Creation
[Boss] Helm Tribes' Shield
[Boss] Slayer of the Arena



Fixed the awkward expression in the quest summary for "Desire for Power" and simplified its quest completion text.

Changed the requirement for the quest [Repeat] Evidence of Someone to catching Snapped Rope x3.


Interface Changes

UI Revamp

Black Desert's UI has been updated.



The UI update has begun. With today's update, Black Spirit-related UI (including Enhancement), the NPC Chat window UI, and the Shop UI have been improved. In fact, these improvements represent our greatest wish, since we've continuously received feedback such as "the UI is uncomfortable," "hard to see," "too complicated," etc. from our players since the beginning. The process was not easy, as we had to be careful not to harm the existing familiarity these UIs had, but the positive feedback we received about the new UI after releasing the Black Desert Console helped us to reconsider the UI update for PC. Another reason why we made this decision was that the UI issues coming from servicing PC and Console at the same time caused a setback to the schedule of our new content development. Hence, we recollected as many opinions from our existing players as we could and started the UI update that would unify the two versions—Console and PC—of UI.

We think that among all kinds of content, the UI in particular has great influence on your playing experience and sensibility. And because we are also players whose playing styles and perspectives differ from each other, it was necessary to test and fix the relevant content over and over again. So, since June 14th, the day we revealed the new UI system for the first time through the Global Lab, we have recollected various opinions and made improvements of different scales, until we were finally able to present you our first result today.

However, we will not rush and try to change everything at once, since it could cause many confusions. Also, maintaining the existing familiarity and increasing the functionality of the UI will be one of our priorities. Though it may be difficult to come up with a result that would satisfy all players, we promise that we will make continuous improvements to convince more of you.


The following UI were reworked.

Maid/Butler
Find Party
Attendance Reward
ESC Menu
Ranking
NPC Vendor
Cleanse Gear
Register Clan/Guild
Worker Exchange
Guild Auction House
Interaction
Forge
Secret Shop
Conversation
Storage
Trade
Lordship Menu
Item Reform
Transport
Confess
Transfusion
Imperial Auction House
Message boxes
Stable
Wharf
Black Spirit Enhancement/Extraction
Traveler's Map
Boss Notification
Notice
Fish Guide
Name Change
Weapon Exchange
Life EXP Transfer
Voice Chat Settings
Mail
Quick Hotkey Settings
Certain Minigames (Cart)
Dark Rift
Storage Search
Item Brand/Remove Item Brand
Item looting
Item drops



The new menu has a function that allows you to check your “Recently Used” menu.

“Recently Used” keeps a record of up to 15 menus that you’ve accessed through the new menu in order and removes the oldest record.
Recorded menus in the “Recently Used” function can be fixed or deleted.



A search function was added to Storage.

A random animation will be played when enhancing equipment from IV (TET) to V (PEN).

The Exchange and Chat functions were separated into different buttons in the NPC interaction screen. You can click on these buttons and only see the options related to that function.

Gaining Knowledge, proceeding with a quest, and other functions from the button interact can be found by pressing the “Chat” button.
Exchanging seals and items can be found by pressing the “Exchange” button.
You will now be able to see all the items, even the items you current do not have, that can be exchanged through the NPC in the Exchange window.
https://i.imgur.com/48vYsXv.png



Quests, Vendor, Storage buttons were made accessible with hotkeys in the NPC interaction window.

Quests, Chat, and Exchange will always have fixed hotkeys. Other buttons in the UI will use number hotkeys (1) - (4).



The Interest Knowledge Status window was changed to not open in the NPC interaction window if it is related to Quest/Chat/Exchange or if the Storage window is open.

The (R) hotkey will only be displayed on a button below if the hotkey is actually available in the NPC interaction window.

When you press (R) for the Quest button and open the Quest List window, the (R) will disappear and only the text Quest will be displayed.

Conversation was improved so that you can scroll through Knowledge in the Knowledge of Interest using your mouse wheel.

Color was added for the hotkey "Acquire All (R)" in the Get Item window.

The design and effects in the Enhancement window were changed.

The extraction of Enhancement Chance function using the Blacksmith's Secret Book was moved to the Extract tab.

The Transfusion window was enlarged to make it easier to see the effects of the crystals getting transfused. Additionally, you can now select the crystal and equipment you wanted to transfuse the crystal to in the Transfusion window.

Blacksmith extraction was improved so that multiple outfits can be extracted through a single attempt.

You can now select the upgrade material and equipment you want to upgrade in the Upgrade window.

The design of the Trade window was changed to allow you to see more items at once. Additionally, Trade Item Display was removed. The function was moved to the Buy and Sell tabs.

Stable, Wharf, guild stable, and guild stable windows, that used to display 4 mounts, will now display up to 8 mounts at a time.
https://i.imgur.com/h0mbuog.png
https://i.imgur.com/jpsVOgA.png

The Mount Information window that is displayed on the right of the Stable UI will now only display the skills the mount has. Delete Mount Skill and Desired Skill functions can now be used through the Change Skill button.

It will now be easier to connect and separate from wagons in the Connect Wagon window.

The list of horses that can be exchanged will be displayed together with the Exchange Horse window.

Breeding Market and Horse Market will now display mount information clearly. Additionally, HP, Stamina, Weight were removed from these windows as they do not affect the trade significantly. It was changed to show the number of skills the horse has.
https://i.imgur.com/qdqpUK3.jpg

The following hotkeys were added to the Select Server screen.
https://i.imgur.com/anbnY8r.jpg

Express Goodwill window was changed to show items that can be used as gifts.

Recover Max Durability window was changed to show equipment with reduced max durability and recovery materials.

Cleanse Gear window will now display +15 equipment.

Transport, Send, Conversation, Vendor, Guild Auction House, Register Clan/Guild, Worker Exchange, Secret Shop, and Lordship Menu windows were reworked.

View Workers Continuously function was added in the Contract Workers window.

Set the grade and number of workers you want to see then press the View Workers Continuously button. It will automatically refresh workers for the number of views you’ve selected or when a worker at the grade you wanted or higher becomes available for hire.



A warning message will be displayed when attempting the following enhancement.



You really want to smack that Black Spirit when you happen to waste high fail stack by a mis-click. Now there will be a new warning message to be displayed to prevent you from making a mistake.


When attempting to enhance on a character with 50 stacks or higher and the  Enhancement Chance goes over +70%.

When attempting to enhance on a character with 100 stacks or higher with the following items and enhancement levels.


The number of materials you can use when Chopping or Heating in Processing was increased to the following. 

Chopping: 3 Max
Heating: 4 Max



Other

Added a graph that displays the market price of the last 30 days in the Central Market.

Select Product Details to see the product's market price of the last 30 days displayed in a graph.



Fixed the issue where the item's Dye information in the Quest Rewards window differed from the actual Dye information.
 
Added a highlighting color to the Hotkey in the "Get All (R)" text from the Get Item window.
 
Now each worker's level will be displayed in the Worker Market.
 
You can now see the detailed information of a skill in the Mount's Skill icon.
 
Fixed the issue where the "Auto Loop" button's UI size was abnormal.

Moved the location of the "Set Auto-run Path" panel to above the "Set Auto-run Path" icon.
The highlight that used to remain on the button slot when opening and closing the "Set Auto-run Path" panel will now disappear.


 
Added a function which allows you to edit the Stamina bar in UI Edit mode.
 
The Menu will now be displayed as "New Menu" if you log in with a new account.
 
Changed the Capture Location of the fish registered in the Fish Guide, from "Can be caught, somewhere" to "..." 

Fixed the issue where the location of the Villager Happiness Level description from the Lord menu was not adequate.

Fixed the issue where it looked as if it was possible to adjust the Tax Rate from the Adjust Rate tab in the Lord menu when it was not.

Fixed the issue where Balance from the Collection tab in the Lord menu indicated "0" even when it was not.

Fixed the issue where it wasn't possible to adjust the Local Tax from the Adjust Rate tab in the Lord menu.

Added a notification message that appears when controlling the Voice Chat UI in certain situations.

Fixed the issue where the ship's durability and related warning messages were not being displayed.


Resolved Issues

Moved and improved the camera location of some NPCs of Duvencrune, Grána, and Southwestern Gateway in Serendia.

Fixed the issue where the NPC near the Shady Tree Forest was floating in the air.

Fixed the issue where the location of the Horse Saddle icon and that of the Stirrups icon in the Dye (J) window were changed.

Now, whenever the changed price and the term "Base Price" from the Volatile Price Items of the Central Market overlap, the latter will not be visible.

Fixed the issue where the scroll would go up whenever you put an item to the Guild Storage after scrolling down.

Fixed the issue where the message "Please try again in a moment" was displayed when you invited someone to a party and he/she accepted the invitation.

Fixed the issue where the system message "Character does not exist" was displayed intermittently when entering the NPC Repair window while the Guild Galley was under repair.

Fixed the issue where the Mail list did not update intermittently when selecting a mail/mails from the Received Mail List (B) and pressing the Delete button.

Fixed the issue where the item names displayed in the Dye Notice window's text when dyeing Horse Saddle and Stirrups did not match the corresponding items.

Fixed the issue where BDO Wiki did not appear even when pressing the question mark button from the New Knowledge window.

Fixed the issue where the type of the items resulting from Mass Process was not displayed normally.
The issue where the same type of items appeared to be overlapped.
The issue where an unrelated item appeared in the tooltips.

Fixed the issue where the camera movement became unnatural when closing the Observe Mode by pressing ESC while on a mount.

Fixed the issue where the information about Server Change Restriction was not displayed when changing to a server of a character below Lv. 5.

Fixed the issue where some furnitures couldn't be placed on the 2nd floor of the Olvia 2-4 house.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't build a node fort on Sunday during a specific time slot.

Fixed a typo in the quest summary for "A Time of Rest Before the Journey.

Fixed the issue where only numbers were displayed in the View Ranking window when the character's Life Skill Level was 21 or higher.

Fixed the issue where the character would enter the ground in certain area of Kamasylvia Old Wisdom Tree.

Fixed the issue where the description of the Unlearned Skill in the Manage Mount Skill window overflowed out of the window.   

Fixed the issue where the screen color became too bright when entering Place Mode while Graphics were set to Very Low.


Wacky Toshi on Weita Island and Iliya Island were fixed to exchange Marni's Stone (Stone Waragon) and Marni's Stone (Stone Waragon) II.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where Celerity Draught and Unbridled Celerity Draught cannot be sold at NPC shops.

We are aware of the issue where the icon that indicates the number of remaining deliveries for Imperial Delivery is not being displayed.

[Updated 10/10]  [Warrior] We are aware of the issue where the wrong effects are being displayed when using Solar Flare with Black Spirit’s Rage. This issue will be fixed next week.

[Updated 10/14]  We are aware of the issue where Witch/Wizard classes are able to maintain Forward Guard when switching to Awakening weapons in certain situations.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 2nd 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/3mLxizO.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Our latest event "Season of the Hunt" is expanding with the addition of part 2. By defeating monsters, fishing, or gathering, you will have the chance to acquire special pouches which contain great rewards!
Also, for those following the path of peace and not into hunting stuff, you will be able to enjoy EXP bonuses for Mounts and Training, and also more chances to get a higher tier foal when exchanging your horses!
But that is not all: From now on, there will be some permanent quests to obtain three pets for free! Take good care of them!
Who said second parts were never good? Enjoy the events and see you next week with more exciting content!

*Notice: Next week’s regular maintenance will start on Tuesday, October 8, 2019 at 08:00 UTC instead of Wednesday. Exact times of the maintenance will be announced with the next maintenance announcement.


Event & System

New Events

Season of the Hunt, Part 2

Period: October 2 (after maintenance)–October 16 (before maintenance)
Event 1: Special Pouch Drop

During the event period, defeat monsters, fish, and gather to obtain one of the two random pouch items: [Event] Rarity Pouch or [Event] Fortune Pouch



Event 2: Ride the Tide

Ride to your favorite hunting grounds while enjoying Training EXP +100% and Mount EXP +50% boosts during Fever Time, get rewarded for performing Imperial Delivery, and enjoy increased chance to exchange your horses for a higher tier foal!



Click  to learn all about the part 2 of events for the Season of the Hunt.



Build Your Guild

Event 1: Recruit New Guild Members

Period: October 2 (after maintenance)–October 30 (before maintenance)
Join a guild as a new adventurer and check in for 8 days while reaching Lv.56 to help grow your guild with guild funds, skill exp, and guild items!



Event 2: Guild Attendance Rewards

Period: October 2 (after maintenance)–December 31 (23:59 UTC)
Guild attendance reward will be offered to guild members who are in a medium-sized guild (starting from 31 members) or above during the event period.



Click  to see this guild promotion event in detail.



Health, Breath, Strength

Period: October 2 (after maintenance)–October 23 (before maintenance)
During the event period, complete these new quests offered by the Black Spirit in-game and receive Finto’s items to help you boost your Breath, Strength, and Health.

These event quests can be completed once per family.
These event quests can be found under Recommended tab from the Black Spirit.
These event quest can be found under New Quest tab in quest window (O) during the event period.
https://i.imgur.com/oTTQlcb.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/Erby3F7.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/7SYAwRP.jpg




Ongoing Events

Season of the Hunt Part 1 

Trina Knight’s First Support Kit: (September 25 (after maintenance)–October 23 (before maintenance)
Complete Marni’s Stones: September 25 (after maintenance)–October 8 (before maintenance)
Special Challenges: September 26 00:00 UTC–October 9 23:59 UTC
World Boss Drop Rate Boost: September 25 (after maintenance)–October 8 (before maintenance)
Fever Time Boost: September 25 (after maintenance)–October 8 (before maintenance)



Fall Festival: September 25 (after maintenance)–October 23 (before maintenance)


Reward Distribution

Dedicated Gift of Appreciation

A special gift of appreciation was gifted to thank loyal adventurers for their love for Black Desert Online.

"There are many new players who take their first steps into Black Desert and there are those who return for more adventure, but there are adventurers who traverse and enjoy the world of Black Desert every day. 
Today, we would like to extend our gratitude to these avid adventurers with our sincere thanks and a gift from our hearts.
We hope to present you with more future content for you to enjoy, with a pleasant and smooth ride along the way. And as always, thank you."

Reward for the highest level character in your family.

Lv50–Lv59: Advice of Valks (+70)
Lv60 and above: Advice of Valks (+101)



All existing adventurers who logged in to the game at least once between September 18 (after maintenance) and October 2 (before maintenance) will receive the gift via the in-game mail.
Adventurers who received login rewards for new and returning adventurers during September 18 (after maintenance)–October 2 (before maintenance) are not eligible to receive this gift.
Please make sure to claim your gift before the maintenance on October 8. 



Content

Free pet quests!

New quests were added for you to acquire pets to accompany you on your journey. 
The below quests are available once per family and can be accepted from the quest menu under Suggestions tab.
https://i.imgur.com/6LMjlPW.jpg
This is a permanent addition, so try to get all three pets!



Guild skill Ample Storage levels 9 to 16 were added.

Guild Storage Increase per level: Lv9–Lv10 +2 Slots, Lv11–Lv14 +3 Slots, Lv15–Lv16 +4 Slots.
Guild Point Requirement per level: Lv9–Lv11 5 points, Lv12–Lv15 10 points, Lv16 15 points.



System

Central Market Warehouse Capacity now increases with your Family Fame.

0.2 Warehouse Capacity Increase per Family Fame point. 
(For example, Family Fame of 1402 will increase the Warehouse Capacity by 280.4)



Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

The rowboat at the Outpost Supply Port was swept away and has disappeared.

Fixed the unnatural stones in some parts of Lamo Valley.

Fixed the issue where you could perform abnormal gathering near the Mausoleum of Mediah.

Fixed the frame drop issue in certain parts of the Old Wisdom Tree area.


NPC

Fixed the issue where you could not sell items to Samantrina of the Acher Guard Post.

Fixed the issue where the auto-run navigation for Kaia Feresio via Find NPC sent you to the 2nd floor of the Great Library of Calpheon.

Fixed the issue where the Find NPC route for general goods merchants in certain areas, such as Helms Post, sent you to the wrong location.


Item Changes

The functions of the Epheria Contract Renewal and Frigate Contract Renewal are now combined.

Both the Epheria Contract Renewal and Frigate Contract Renewal can be used to renew either the Epheria Sailor Contract or the Frigate Sailor Contract.
The description of the Epheria Contract Renewal explains how you can obtain it.



Now you can acquire the "Heroes’ Song" from World Bosses.

The item drops from Kzarka, Nouver, Karanda, Kutum, Offin, and Garmoth. The item is a poem written to commemorate the heroes who together defended the world. The item heals the character for 5000 HP over 30 sec. and is used upon acquiring it.



You can now hand in Marni’s Stone after Lv 64 to Wacky Toshi.

You can collect samples and exchange from Lv 62, but will receive very little Combat EXP after exchanging.



Changed Mastery items available for purchase from NPC stores to not be shown in the Crafting Note.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Quest

Fixed the issue where there was a metal structure between the rocks when you head down the well during the "The Place Where the Wind Blows" quest.

Fixed the issue where you could not accept the "Death of the Cows" quest.

Fixed the issue where the navigation path of the "Flowers in the Desert" quest sent you across the ocean.

Fixed the issue where one of the options with Nella Encarotia for the "Curiosity Becomes Fear" quest gave you the wrong NPC as target.

The quest icon for the "[Gathering Advancement Lv50] From the Hand of a Person" quest was changed to better fit the quest.

Fixed the issue where the following quest did not properly give their rewards.

Wanted: Hekaru
Wanted: Ocean Stalker
Looming Threats from the Ocean
Ocean Predators
A Treasure Swimming in the Ocean
Outlaws in the Ocean
Stay Sharp!



Fixed the issue where you could not repeat the “[Repeat] Sacrifice for Aal” quest.

This quest was automatically removed from characters that had accepted this quest. Please accept again to complete the quest.



Knowledge

Fixed the issue where you did not receive Energy for acquiring the Ash Forest knowledge.


Interface Changes

Now you can save and load navigation routes from the World Map (M).

RMB on the World Map to set and save 3 routes.
You can load and delete the saved routes by pressing the buttons located at the bottom of the World Map.
Alt+RMB to save consecutive routes.
The routes are saved locally to your PC, so they won't be loaded when you play from another PC.



Now you can set key bindings for ship controls.

Now you can view the inventory of your other characters.

The bag button in the End Game menu shows you the contents of their inventory.



Changed the item image of the Giant Grouper.

Updated the HP, Durability, Stamina, Food, and Lifespan UI of the Mount UI.

Fixed the low equipment durability UI to display descriptions when you mouse over the UI.

The UI showing low durability for mount (horses, wagons, ships) equipment now shows both the navigation button and the description text.

Fixed the issue where the correct text color was sometimes not applied when you receive a Black Spirit's Gift reward.

Fixed the issue where the Health UI and Family Buff UI overlapped if you toggle the Health UI to be disabled and use a shortcut to toggle a preset UI that has the Health UI enabled.

Fixed the issue where the Bartali Sailboat was displayed as an Epheria Sailboat in the UI that shows your mounts in use at the End Game menu.

Fixed the guild storage window to pop up on the left of your inventory window.

Changed the guild storage window to close when you press the tab button in the guild window.

Fixed the issue where the Imperial Fishing Delivery displayed the "Connection to the Node is required." error message, which does not require Node connection.


Resolved Issues

[Kunoichi] Fixed the issue where Ghost Greeting did not activate by using the LMB after Ninjutsu: Shadow Explosion.

[Kunoichi] Fixed the action of returning to standby mode after Tendon Cutter to be more natural.

[Musa] Fixed the issue where you could not move the character if you use Absolute: Rising Storm after a forward Blind Thrust without having learnt Ultimate: Rising Storm.

[Witch, Wizard] The following text from the description of Summon: Keeper Gorr, Keeper Tett, Keeper Arne, and Keeper Marg were moved to the tooltip. 

If there is no summoned creature, press F to summon Arne/Gorr.



[Shai] Fixed the issue where the "Secret Duty" quest was shown as available in the World Map to Shai characters.

[Shai] Fixed the issue where you could not cancel "Do it Better!".

Fixed the issue where you could not dye a normal equipment with a Pearl outfit of the same slot equipped.

Fixed the issue where the UI indicating low durability of your horse gear overlapped with the Altar of Blood matchmaking UI so you could not cancel matchmaking.

Fixed the issue where the mount skill description text in the stable UI overflowed out of the window if it was longer.

Fixed the issue where the lighting looked abnormal around the Magoria Pirate Ship.

Fixed the issue where grass appeared to be floating in thin air at certain locations in Loopy Tree Forest.

Fixed the abnormal navigation path to Bipache of the Abandoned Land from Dimanthor, the stable keeper of west Calpheon City.

Fixed the navigation path to the Chapel 2-1, 1F of Calpheon City.

Fixed the issue where you could not auto-run to Black Spirit Training NPC Jamey Drucker at the north of Calpheon.

Fixed the issue where grass appeared to be floating in thin air at certain locations in Calpheon Castle Site.

Fixed the rankings info of the Valtarra Altar of Training to be displayed properly.

Fixed the issue where the word Skill List in the World Map's (M) mount information window was not displayed.

Fixed the description of Loggia Trainer's Clothes and Izaro Trainer's Clothes.


Known Issues

We have temporarily blocked the effects of Shai's Misty Haze skill. This is due to an abnormal effect being applied by using the skill. This will be resolved in a future maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - September 25th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/zzYzXus.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

This week we finish the series of the Life Skill Mastery updates with the Manos-grade gear and accessories. Equip and upgrade your Manos-grade gear to be the true Life Skill master!

On top of that, tons of events are prepared starting with the Season of the Hunt! Get your Trina Knights kit and kill monsters and world bosses for awesome rewards!

Don’t forget to check out the Fall Festival as well as the refreshed Loyal attendance tab. Please find all the details of this week patch notes below:


Event & System

Season of the Hunt

Week 1 of Season of the Hunt is comprised of 5 events all geared toward helping you hunt down monsters and gain on your EXP and previous loot!

Event 1: Trina Knights First Support Kit

September 25 (after maintenance)–October 23 (before maintenance)
Trina Knights First Captains Support Kit (7-days) will be given to adventurers of certain levels!
Trina Knights First Captain's Support Kit (7 Days) Challenge will be deleted from the Challenges tab (Y) during the October 23rd maintenance.



Event 2: Fever Time Boost

September 25 (after maintenance)–October 8 (before maintenance)
Enjoy up to Combat EXP +300% and Skill EXP +30% during Fever Time.



Event 3: Special Challenges

September 26 00:00 UTC–October 9 23:59 UTC
Get rewarded for playing 30 min., 60 min., 90 min., and 120 min. for some of the best rewards including [Event] Item Collection Increase Scroll (60 min).



Event 4: World Boss Drop Rate Boost

September 25 (after maintenance)–October 8 (before maintenance)
Chance to receive certain loot items from world bosses will double.



Event 5: Complete Marni’s Stones

September 25 (after maintenance)–October 8 (before maintenance)
Fill up the target number of monster kills for Marni’s Stones and get rewarded for Marni’s Stones completed. 




For full details on the Season of the Hunt, please click !




Fall Festival

Period: September 25 (after maintenance)–October 16 (before maintenance)
Log in daily or reach certain levels and depending on your status!

For new adventurers: Reach certain levels to get rewards.
For returning adventurers: Log in for certain number of days to get rewards.
For all adventurers: Reach certain levels to get rewards.



For full details of the Fall Festival, please click !



Loyal Attendance Rewards Refreshed

Period: September 26 00:00 UTC–October 30 23:59 UTC
Check attendance daily to get huge rewards including Fine Accessory Box and Black Gems, and Concentrated Magical Black Gems!



Ended Events

Altar of Blood event.

The rewards offered for completing stages will return to normal, but the lowered difficulty of the stages will remain.
Monsters in the Altar of Blood will no longer grow stronger during the night.
Your score and rankings for participating in Altar of Blood does not get recorded.



Book of Training Event
Life Skill Mastery Events
Dark Rift Special Monster Event
Gold Rush II

Ends September 25 23:59 UTC



Content

Expanded the character level on which you can complete the Combat Rewards from Level 56 to Level 59.

[Combat Reward] Faster and Stronger I

Requirement: For Lv. 15 and up, Combat Fame 300 and below
Rewards: [Fame] Combat EXP +20% (60 min.), [Fame] Skill EXP +20% (60 min.)




[Combat Reward] Faster and Stronger II

Requirement: For Lv. 15 and up, Combat Fame between 301 and 600
Rewards: [Fame] Combat EXP +40% (60 min.), [Fame] Skill EXP +20% (60 min.)




[Combat Reward] Faster and Stronger III

Requirement: For Lv. 15 and up, Combat Fame between 601 and 900
Reward: [Fame] Combat EXP +60% (60 min.), [Fame] Skill EXP +20% (60 min.)




[Combat Reward] Faster and Stronger IV

Requirement: For Lv. 15 and up, Combat Fame between 901 and 1200
Rewards: [Fame] Combat EXP +80% (60 min.), [Fame] Skill EXP +30% (60 min.)




[Combat Reward] Faster and Stronger V

Requirement: For Lv. 15 and up, Combat Fame between 1201 and 1500
Rewards: [Fame] Combat EXP +100% (60 min.), [Fame] Skill EXP +30% (60 min.)




[Combat Reward] Faster and Stronger VI

Requirement: For Lv. 15 and up, Combat Fame 1501 and up
Rewards: [Fame] Combat EXP +100% (60 min.), [Fame] Skill EXP +30% (60 min.)




Life Skill Mastery

New Manos-grade Mastery equipment and items have been added.

Manos Trainer's Clothes
Manos Hunter's Clothes
Manos Sailor's Clothes
Manos Cook's Clothes
Manos Alchemist's Clothes
Manos Fisher's Clothes
Manos Gatherer's Clothes

Manos Processing Stone - Energy

Manos Processing Stone - Lava
Manos Riding Crop
Manos Lumbering Axe
Manos Fluid Collector
Manos Tanning Knife
Manos Butcher Knife
Manos Pickaxe


 
Below is the table of required materials per enhancement level for Manos clothes.
https://i.imgur.com/NyRNKy0.jpg

Below is the table of required materials per enhancement level for Manos necklace and belt
https://i.imgur.com/uLfS4VD.jpg

Below is the table of required materials per enhancement level for Manos Ring and Earring
https://i.imgur.com/xrdjT9S.jpg

Manos items can be Manufactured with the below items.
https://i.imgur.com/dpSB5zn.jpg

Crafting the above items will grant you their knowledge.
 
New repeat quests were added where you can acquire the Manos Cooking item “Fundamentals of Cooking”.

You can repeat the quest after completing it on a character from level 15 above.
The quests are available from the below NPCs and will give you the Fundamentals of Cooking by handing in a Professional's Satisfying Dinner Meal.
https://i.imgur.com/Fa106kO.jpg
Professional's Satisfying Dinner Meal can be acquired by processing and Imperial Cuisine Packing Meat Pie x30, Steak x20, and Tea With Fine Scent x30.
Sunset Dyed Wool can be acquired as reward from Heidel General Goods Vendor Lara’s daily quest or by exchanging Shiny Golden Seal - [Imperial Cuisine] x100.
Scorched Fragment can be acquired as reward from Heidel General Goods Vendor Lara’s daily quest or by exchanging Shiny Golden Seal - [Imperial Alchemy] x100.
Enlightened One's Cotton Fabric can be acquired through Simple Alchemy with EXP Elixir x50 and Cotton Fabric x50.
Dusk Laden Cotton Fabric can be acquired through Processing - Grinding with Oil of Fortitude x50 and Cotton Fabric x50.Dawn Fallen Silk can be acquired through Processing - Grinding with Oil of Storms x50 and Silk x50.
A new repeat quest was added where you can acquire the Manos Fishing item “Tear of the Great Ocean”.
https://i.imgur.com/BX4wCbK.jpg



Manos Stone was added to items available for purchase to the below jewelry vendors.

Marsella
Corin
Dora Fonti
Bianstimi
Ardan
Belgar
Thyshelle Arms
Yara
Binvane
Gagaru

The below knowledge can be acquired by interacting with the NPCs listed below each of the knowledge.

[Knowledge] Manos Gatherer's Clothes

Zaaira
Flaviano
Kara
Lashir
Geranoa 


[Knowledge] Manos Fisher's Clothes

Dobart




For the full Life Skill Mastery patch notes, please click .


System

Improved the sound quality issue that occurred when using the Guild Voice Chat.

Improved some of the sound effects played when the character performs an action in areas with water.


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

Removed abnormal resources from the Velia Wharf.


NPC

Ornella will no longer receive the item "Origin of Wind" as a gift.

The button to exchange High-Quality Wine with Constante, the Golden Toad Inn's Manager, was moved under the dialogue button.

Fixed the issue where searching a Material Vendor with the Find NPC function in certain areas of Helms Post and other locations gave you the wrong direction.


Class Changes

Warrior

The character's body will now spread red energy when using the Awakening Executioner skill.


Dark Knight

Changed the commands and the descriptions of Flow: Ravage Rake and Absolute Skill as follows.

S + LMB + RMB while using Ravage Rake
LMB + RMB after the last attack of Ravage Rake



Shai

Horse mount action for Shai was improved to be more natural.

Mounting from the left or right was changed to her using her hands to lift herself up.



Item Changes

You can now use the High-Quality Carrot when polishing the Alchemy Stone of Life.

Fixed the Acceleration, Speed, Turn, and Break stats in the item description of "Wagon Registration: Forest Path Wagon" to match the wagon's actual stats.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't gain Processing EXP when processing the .

Fixed the issue where the instrument's appearance was not displayed when using the Talent Skill after equipping the item  in the Trial Character Server.

Sailboat and Frigate Sailor Contracts were combined into the new Epheria Sailor Contract.

Epheria Sailor Contract can be used for both Epheria Sailboat and Epheria Frigate.
Frigate Sailor Contracts and Frigate Sailor Renewal Contracts can be exchanged to Epheria Sailor Contracts and Epheria Sailor Renewal Contracts with Falasi. Adventurers with the quest to upgrade their Frigate Sailor Contract can complete the quest after exchanging the contract to the Epheria Sailor Contract.



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Fixed the issue where the HP of the following monsters at the Bashim Base was displayed when attacking them while not having the relevant knowledge.

Terruda Infantryman
Terruda Thrower
Terruda Reinforced Infantryman
Terruda Bandsman



Fixed the Giant Treant that wanders around the Treant Forest to not be displayed in the Minimap.

The Crystal Alligator, which was believed to have gone extinct, was found in the Shady Tree Forest of Kamasylvia.

Karma will be reduced by 50 when killing a Crystal Alligator.



You can now obtain the "Upgraded Compass Parts," which are the same as the ones you can obtain from Elten, at a certain rate by killing the following monster of Hystria Ruins.

Tukar Balten



Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Fixed the issue where you couldn't reaccept the quest "[Repeat] Sacrifice for Aal" when having already completed it. Also, you will now have the navigation arrows displayed for the quest.

Increased the speed of the Goblin whom you have to bring during the quest "Why Did the Goblins Run Away?" and changed the dialogue that appears when you take the goblin to Santo Manzi.

Fixed the issue where the location of the completion NPC of the quest "Through the Rough Tides: Velia" differed from his/her actual location.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't accept the quest "[Combat Promotion] Mediah Trio" or the quest "[Awakening Weapon] Artisans in Mediah.." with Lahn, Archer or Shai.

Fixed the issue where you could receive an abnormal item through the quest "A Gift for You." You will be able to accept this quest after today's patch.

The abnormal item you had received through this quest has been removed during September 25 (Wed) maintenance.



Changed the quest name of "[Co-op] Story on Cron Castle" to "Story of Cron Castle" and lowered the recommended level for the quest.

The recommended level for Cron Castle at the moment of the quest development was high, but now that this region has become a Monster Zone of the game's beginning stage, the quest name and the recommended level have been changed.



Knowledge

Changed the requirement for making the button that allows you to obtain the Tinberra Island knowledge and node from Shanjo, the Node Manager of Tinberra Island, appear.


Interface Changes

A new event banner was added to the bottom right of the game screen. 

This event banner only pops up once a day. 
Clicking this banner will open up the event page of the official website.



Selecting another product after having selected and pressed the Buy button for a product at Pearl Shop (F3) will now cancel your purchase of the latter and close the Purchase window.

You can now see the full skill description displayed as a text bubble when you put your mouse cursor over the text abbreviation mark for a very long skill description in the Fairy's "View Learnable Skills" window.

Changed the term "Equipment Info" to "Appearance Info" in the Mount Information window.
 
Added Item Grade sort function to the Central Market.

This sort function will be displayed on the right side of the Back button when entering the market after having selected an equipment that can be enhanced.



You can now view the Wagon's appearance more comfortably at the Pearl Shop (F3).
 
Added descriptions displayed as text bubbles to Preset 1, Preset 2, Preset 3, Combat Focus mode, and Adventure mode buttons in the UI Edit mode.
 
Fixed the issue where you couldn't see the Quick Hotkey Settings window when trying to assign quick hotkeys in the UI Edit mode.
 
Fixed the issue where the Shop window opened when closing the Imperial Delivery window by pressing ESC while on a Fishing Delivery.

Fixed the lag issue that occurred when using Trade by talking to a Trade Manager NPC.

Fixed the issue where the registered item's text bubble showed the wrong description when opening the Processing window from the Storage.

Fixed the issue where the "Sale Complete" and the "Purchase Complete" texts in the Marketplace Notifications window were cut because they were too long.

Fixed the issue where the Difficulty icon was not updated normally in the Dark Rift list.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the Camera Perspective to gradually exit the Observe mode by pressing ESC while on a Boat, a Sky Balloon or at a Viewpoint.

[Warrior] Fixed the issue where wrong Preceding Skill levels were displayed in the skill descriptions of "Shield Assault," "Absolute: Charging Slash" and "Absolute: Shield Strike."

[Warrior] Fixed the issue where the effect of knocking back enemies was missing in the skill description of Forward Slash.

Fixed the issue where a structure's wall had a hole in certain region of Hystria Ruins.

Changed the Black Spirit's dialogue that appears when the Dark Rift opens to be more natural.

You will now get the correct error message whenever an error occurs while using a pet-related function.

Fixed the issue where the UI texts with abbreviation marks looked intermittently abnormal.

Fixed the issue where the Event text and EXP image were displayed in the Character's Tag Setting window even when the event had ended.

Fixed the issue where the quest "Secret Duty" was displayed in Shai's World Map even though Shai cannot accept this quest.

[Lahn] Fixed the issue where Lahn could use the following elixirs.

[Party] Elixir of Energy
[Party] Surging Energy Elixir
[Party] Elixir of Mentality
[Party] Elixir of Clear Mentality
Elixir of Energy
Surging Energy Elixir
Elixir of Mentality
Elixir of Clear Mentality



Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where you cannot exchange expired Epheria Frigate Sailor Contract to an Epheria Sailor Contract.

We recommend you exchange your Epheria Frigate Sailor Contract before they expire. This issue will be resolved with next week’s maintenance.



We are aware of the text issue where [Event] Rookie Adventure Pack in the Pearl Shop (F3) states that the item is sold until September 25. This item is sold until October 16 and we will fix the text issue with next maintenance.


Updated 26/09

We are aware of the issue where Marni's Stones cannot be exchanged with Wacky Toshi for characters of Lv. 64 and above. This issue will be resolved with next week's maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience.

We are aware of the issue where after performing the Talent skill "Do it Better!" Shai character becomes immobile for a few seconds. We are looking into resolving this.

We are aware of the issue where certain quests that give out Origin of Wind and Breezy Crystal as completion rewards are not giving them out properly. This will be resolved with in next week's maintenance and any Origin of Wind and Breezy Crystal items unrewarded for completing the relevant quests will be sent out via in-game mail (B).



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: [Patch Notes] September 10th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/xNYznad.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Life Skill Mastery update continues one more week with the addition of blue grade gear and accessories. Achieve new levels of Life Skill Mastery thanks to this new equipment and remember that we will have more updates for this system soon!

Also, Altar of Blood is receiving a new event which will offer double and better rewards! Keep reading to know all the details.

Have fun and good luck!

Notice:
Please note that next week’s (September 18) maintenance will be a hardware-only maintenance to secure service stability and will be shorter than the usual maintenance hours. There will be no new content additions or fixes applied during this maintenance, but there will be new in-game events starting and the Pearl Shop will be updated. Stay tuned for new event pages and pearl shop update to be posted on our main website on September 18!


Event & System

New Events

Altar of Blood Event

Period: September 10 (after maintenance)–September 25 (before maintenance)
During the event period, the difficulty of the stages in the Altar of Blood will be lowered, and you will have a chance to get better rewards!
The chance of gaining better rewards such as Gold Bar 100G, Gold Bar 1,000G, and gears (ranging from green-grade TRI gear to yellow- grade PEN gear), will nearly double
The number of Black Stones (Armor) gained from Stage 1 and the Caphras Stones gained from Stage 2 and above as a reward will nearly double.
You will gain the Stage 10 rewards once more if you defeat the Ancient Kutum that appears intermittently in Stage 10. This means you will have a random chance to win Stage 10 rewards twice.



Book of Training Event

Period: September 10 (after maintenance)–September 25 (before maintenance)
During the event period, enjoy the additional benefits on Book of Training items:

Book of Training (Combat and Skill): +50% EXP (Stackable with EXP boosts)
Book of Training - Combat (1 Hour) and Book of Training - Skill (1 Hour): Sold with 50% discount at the Pearl Shop (F3).

1,000,000 Silver > 500,000 Silver (50% off)
Max 5 purchases per Family per day during the event period.




For details on the above events, please click .



Updated 18/09
New event!

Gold Rush II

Period: September 19 00:00 UTC–September 25 23:59 UTC (1 week)
During the event period, play daily and win rewards based on your accumulated playtime.

Rewards on your accumulated playtime include items such as Cron Stone, Blessed Message Scroll (100 min), and [Event] Golden Seal of Panto which can be exchanged for [Event] Shakatu’s Luxury Box.
For details on the above events, please click .




Ongoing Events

Life Skill Mastery Events: September 4 (after maintenance)–September 25 (before maintenance)

Dark Rift Special Monster Event: September 4 (after maintenance)–September 25 (before maintenance)

Adventurer Support Program Part 1: Aug. 22–Sept. 11 23:59 UTC


Life Skill Mastery

New Blue grade Mastery equipment and items have been added.

Crio Fisher's Clothes
Srulk Sailor's Clothes
Robeau Hunter's Clothes
Gorgath Alchemist's Clothes
Roroju Cook's Clothes
Izaro's Training Clothes
Carta's Gatherer's Clothes
Carta's Craftsman's Clothes
Dostter’s Steel Hoe
Dostter's Steel Lumbering Axe
Dostter's Steel Fluid Collector
Dostter's Steel Tanning Knife
Dostter's Steel Butcher Knife
Dostter's Steel Pickaxe
Techthon's Processing Stone – Lake
Techthon's Processing Stone – Vitality
Techthon's Processing Stone - Energy
Techthon's Processing Stone - Sun
Techthon's Processing Stone - Wind
Techthon's Processing Stone - Lava
Izaro's Riding Crop
Geranoa Necklace
Geranoa Earring
Geranoa Ring
Geranoa Belt



Newly added Blue grade Mastery items can be purchased from NPCs.
https://i.imgur.com/mNWt40X.jpg

https://i.imgur.com/lPNqAoH.jpg

Blue grade Mastery outfits and Geranoa accessories can be purchased from the following NPCs:

Geranoa of Calpheon for 10 million Silver.
Zaaira of Velia for 15 million Silver.
https://i.imgur.com/od4L34b.jpg



Techthon's Processing Stones can be purchased from the following NPCs for 10 million Silver.

Heidel: Techthon
Calpheon: Geranoa
Ahib Conflict Zone: Marutuba
Duvencrune: Hughol



Dostter's Steel gathering tools can be purchased from the following NPCs for 10 million Silver.

Calpheon: Geranoa
Duvencrune: Derjeen



Techthon's Processing Stones and Dostter's Steel gathering tools can be purchased from the following NPCs for 15 million Silver.

Velia: Zaaira



Izaro’s Horse Crop is available for purchase from Izaro of Heidel, Zaaira of Velia, and Geranoa of Calpheon, and is also available from stable keepers who have the Amity shop function.

The above items can be enhanced from +1 to +15 with Black Stone (Weapon) and requires Concentrated Magical Black Stone (Weapon) from PRI and above.

The above items will receive Enhancement Chance +1 when you fail enhancement at +8 and above.

Enhancement is affected by your Enhancement Chance, which is reset once you are successful with an enhancement.

You will lose 1 enhancement level when you fail enhancement at DUO and above.

For the Life Skill Mastery patch notes,  please click .


System

Fixed the issue where you couldn't talk to a GM character through the server chat when the channel chat settings of the GM character were different from yours.

You can now talk to a GM character even with different channel chat settings.



Game World, NPC & Effects

NPC

The stable keeper NPC Ashrogue from Southern Calpheon City will now be displayed in the World Map with a Stable icon.


Class Changes

By Classes

Warrior

You can now use Rage Absorption and Fury Transfer while on combat stance with your main weapon and shield. 


Ranger

You can now lock the Moving Shot skill.


Tamer

Fixed the issue where you could not roll when moving backwards while with a trade item load on your back and without a main weapon equipped.


Valkyrie

Among the Counter skill descriptions, the "Spin Hit Damage" and "Additional Movement" descriptions were unified to "Spin Attack."

You can now use Rage Absorption and Fury Transfer while on combat stance with your main weapon and shield. 

You can now right-click to use Skyward Strike while using Shield Chase.


Shai

Fixed the issue where you could not roll when moving backwards while with a trade item load on your back and without a main weapon equipped.


Item Changes

Adjusted the number of Caphras Stones and Memory Fragments you can purchase and/or sell per trade at the Central Market.

Max number of items per purchase/sale before change: x10 to purchase, x100 to sell
Max number of items per purchase/sale after change: x100 to purchase, x1000 to sell



Fixed the hint that appears when not having obtained the Savory Steak knowledge.

Added text to the item description of the Seal of Panto explaining that you can exchange the item at Duvencrune.

The Mastery items that can be purchased from NPC shops will no longer be displayed in Crafting Notes.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Updated 18/09
New items have been added on the Pearl Shop, check this out !


Monster Changes

Added an exclamation mark effect to the monster [Event] Titium from Dark Rift for when it discovers you.

Moved certain monsters from Mirumok Ruins so that they would not get stuck.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Changed the name of the quest "Beneath the Depths of the Well" to "Following Nella’s Traces" as well as its requirement.

These changes were made to avoid confusion and prevent you from taking the wrong path.



You can now accept the quests "[Boss] Helm Tribes' Shield" and "[Boss] Illezra's Creation" only if you do not possess the Boss Summon Scroll that you get when you accept the quests.

You can now learn the skill "Talent: Melody of Light" through Artina in case you have not learnt it after completing the Shai Talent quest "[Shai] Beautiful Melody of Light."

Added a new quest that allows you to obtain an additional "Artina Sol," Shai's Talent Instrument, per family.

Shai Talent instrument "Artina Sol" could only be obtained once per character and could not be registered on the market. The quest was added to improve on this situation.



Interface Changes

Removed the Altar of Blood banner that used to be displayed at the bottom right corner of the screen.
 
System message and Notification Widget will now be displayed whenever a reward is sent to your Black Spirit's Safe.
 
You can now register a keyword to Central Market's Favorites and search it.
 
You can now check your history of pre-orders and sales with the Marketplace Notifications list on the bottom right corner at the Central Market.

Mail sent to all adventurers was changed to be always at the top of the mailbox.

When collecting items attached to these mails, you must collect all of the items at once.



Changed the location of the image which is displayed on the right side of the Mirror of Illusion at the Pearl Shop.

The buttons Preset 1, Preset 2, Preset 3, Combat Focus Mode, Adventure Focus Mode from UI edit mode can now be set to Quick Hotkey slots for easy access.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where the name of a Volatile Price Item stuck out of the UI when it was too long.

Fixed the issue where Forest Path Wagon's durability was displayed as HP when registering or checking the wagon.

Fixed the intermittent issue where the Processing window stick out of the screen when processing at a Storage.

Improved the RolePlay Chat Window by enabling item links.

Fixed the issue where you couldn't see the effect when you cancelled the Alchemy Stone growth by pressing Recharge or Polish and restarted the growth.

Fixed the issue where the Sell window remained when you opened it through a Transaction Maid and went to World Map.

Fixed the issue where the key appeared as "SPACE" during the quest "My Little First Pony" even when you had changed the key.

You can now see the changed key during the quest "My Little First Pony" after changing the key.



Fixed the issue where you were transported to the "Pilgrim's Sanctum: Purity" Node instead of the area near the General Goods Vendor within Hystria Ruins when you got stuck and had to escape from Hystria Ruins.

Fixed the issue where some grass in the Loopy Tree Forest was floating in the air.

Fixed the issue where grass in certain areas of Calpheon Castle was floating in the air.

[Ranger] Fixed the issue where the chest area looked awkward when equipping the Tyrie Armor and the Priyah Bikini at the same time.

[Striker] Fixed the issue where it looked awkward when equipping the Syahzar Gauntlet and another apparel at the same time, since the latter's gloves were displayed instead of the former.

[Mystic] Fixed the issue where the lower area looked awkward when mounted with the New Year Hanbok Outfit equipped.

[Shai] Fixed the issue where the pot of the Vitclari looked awkward when equipping the Canape Costume.

Fixed the discrepancy between the location of the completion NPC and his/her actual location for the quest "Ghost of the Past."

Fixed the discrepancy between the location of the completion NPC and his/her actual location for the quest "[Fishing] Croix, the Ship Expert."
Fixed the dialogue of Neruda Shen to be more natural when obtaining the knowledge "Leader of Altinova."



Fixed the issue where the game would occasionally shut down.

Fixed the issue where the quest [Repeat] The Furious 24 Hours could not be accepted.

[Ninja] Fixed the issue where sound did not play when using "Ninja Step I" while in Sura Katana mode.
 
[Ninja] Fixed the issue where twice as much Stamina was consumed when using "Ninja Step" with Quick Slot while in Sura Katana mode.

Fixed the issue where the guild position of Apprentice guild members would be changed abnormally upon registering for a guild.


Known Issues

Updated 12/09

We have found an issue where the quest A Gift for You was giving out an abnormal completion reward. We have temporarily blocked this quest and the pre-requisite quest The Fairy Who Loves Music. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Please note that the abnormal completion reward will be automatically deleted from the players' accounts during the September 25 maintenance.



Updated 18/09

We are aware of the issue where certain items such as Whale Tendon Potion displays a
different Market Price in the tooltip than the actual Set Price in the Central Market.

[strike]We are aware of the issue where [Event] Surprise Thank You Gift is appearing for players who have not met the conditions to have the item visible. This visibility issue will be resolved with next maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/strike]



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - September 4th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/6VHFQuT.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

The highly-anticipated Life Skill Mastery feature is finally making its way this week with the first part accompanied with a related event that we prepared for you!
Quest lovers will also be happy to get the additional chapters of the Rulupee's Travel Log. Get rewarded for completing 29,999 quests!
Take a look at the rest of the patch notes to learn more about this week’s update.

*Friendly reminder: Next week’s regular maintenance will start on Tuesday, September 10, 2019 at 08:00 UTC instead of Wednesday. Exact times of the maintenance will be announced with the next maintenance announcement.


New Events

Life Skill Mastery Events

Period: September 4 (after maintenance)–September 25 (before maintenance)
Event 1: Help the Old Moon Guild!

Accept and complete event quests to get Black Gems and [Event] Old Moon Life Skill Guru Seals.



Event 2: Life Skill EXP Boost

During the event period, enjoy a 20% boost on Life Skill EXP during Fever Time.



Click  for full details on these celebratory events.



Rookie and Returning Attendance Rewards have been refreshed.

Period: September 4 (after maintenance)–December 11 (before maintenance)

Check attendance daily and stack up on rewards like [Event] Lv. 57 Travel Kit*, Advice of Valks, Value Pack, and more!

*About [Event] Lv. 57 Travel Kit: When you open an [Event] Lv. 57 Travel Kit you will get, among other items, an [Event] Lv. 58 Travel Kit. The level in the item name indicates minimum level a character needs to be at to open the travel kit. You will keep getting higher level travel kits, until you get an [Event] Lv. 60 Travel Kit, which contains Gold Bar 100G, Shakatu's Luxury Box x1, Concentrated Magical Black Stone (Weapon) x5, Concentrated Magical Black Stone (Armor) x5, Artisan's Memory x10, and Advice of Valks (25-35) x1.





Ongoing Events

Adventurer Support Program Part 1: Aug. 22–Sept. 11 23:59 UTC


Ended Events

Adventurer Support Program Part 2: Item Drop Rate +50%!

Adventurer Support Program Part 2: Get Item Collection Increase Scrolls!

Ends Sept. 4 23:59 UTC



Adventurer Support Program Part 1: Fever Time (COmbat EXP +200%/Skill EXP +30%) bonus.

Adventurer Support Program Part 1: Playtime Challenge
Ends Sept. 4 23:59 UTC


Content

Life Skill Mastery will extend the depth of the existing Life Skill-related content by adding additional value to current Life Skills. Life Skill Mastery will be affected by a combination of a character's Life Skill Level and the new Life Skill Mastery gear. The higher the Life Skill Levels and enhancement levels of Life Skill Mastery gear, the higher the character’s Life Skill Mastery will be. Increasing your Life Skill Mastery gives additional benefits to the current life skills such as the following:

Processing Mastery: Gives the option to Mass Process which increases the amount of materials able to be processed at once.

Gathering Mastery: Increases both the amount of items acquired as well as the drop rates for all items from gathering.

Sailing Mastery: Increases the Acceleration, Speed, Turn, and Brake stats of your ship while sailing.

Fishing Mastery: Increases the chance to catch new Orange grade fish worth 1,000,000-100,000,000 Silver each and Ancient Relic Crystal Shards.

Hunting Mastery: Increases both the amount of items acquired as well as the drop rates for all items from butchering hunted animals.

Alchemy Mastery: Increases the amount of items gained per craft, added new rare items to obtain per craft depending on Mastery level.

Training Mastery: Increases the chance to capture a wild horse, mount EXP gained, the chance to obtain a higher tier horse from breeding or exchanging, and the chance for mounts to learn skills upon leveling.

Cooking Mastery: Increases the price that Imperial Delivery Boxes sell for, the chance to obtain better food from cooking, the chance to activate mass cooking, and the opportunity to get Bonus Cooking quests.


On top of the Life Skill Mastery system, there are new items, systems, and quests added for life skills that will make Life Skills more rewarding such as the new Sniping technique for Hunting and a revamp of the Training life skill. We hope you enjoy this new content and find a renewed sense of enjoyment for Life Skills in BDO!

For full detailed patch notes on Life Skill Mastery, please click .
Also, this announcement will be updated as series of Life Skill Mastery update will continue in the following weeks. Please check for updates on the Life Skill Mastery system via the link above.

New chapters of Rulupee's Travel Log were added.

The courageous traveler Rulupee journeyed to Port Ratt and wrote her tales in her travel log. You can find out more by opening it.
The new Rulupee's Travel Log works the same way as her previous logs. Complete quests and the counter will go up each time you complete them. When you reach a goal, you can get a reward.
You can get additional rewards from the Black Spirit and a special title for achieving the goals set in the travel logs.



Added the title “30K” for completing 30000 quests.

The title can be acquired after completing all of Rulupee’s Travel Logs and completing the “A Surprise Secret Hidden Between the Pages of the Travel Log” quest given by the Black Spirit.



Thanks to your continued exploration, we have discovered a new entrance at the upper levels of the Altar of Blood.

The exploration of the upper levels of the Altar of Blood (1-10 Illusions) was concluded successfully with great enthusiasm.
The records of exploration through the upper levels of the Altar of Blood will be preserved as  with next week's maintenance (Tuesday, Sep 10). If you wish to have your name preserved as one of the First Expedition, please challenge the rankings of the Altar of Blood.
Also, the upper levels of the Altar of Blood will begin a reorganizing event after next week's maintenance. Altar of Blood will have event rewards added with a modified balance during this period.However, records set during the event will not affect your rankings.
We will share with you more about the newly discovered depths of the Altar of Blood soon.



Game World, nPC & Effects

NPC

Now you can see Maudi Budar captured at the Mediah prison after completing the Mediah quests.


Class Changes

Shai

Shai can now perform other actions while playing the flute to call mounts.


Item Changes

The effect of Seafood Cron Meal was increased as below.


The above also applies to the below Cron Meal.

[Event] Seafood Cron Meal


 
Added the recipe for Seafood Cron Meal.

Balenos Meal x3, Savory Steak x1, Sute Tea x3, Ancient Cron Spice x1



Changed the item description of Seafood Cron Meal and Ancient Cron Spice to reflect the addition of the Seafood Cron Meal recipe.

Added the recipe description to the Seafood Cron Meal knowledge.

[strike]When you successfully enhance an equipment to PEN, your character name will be added to the item instead of your family name.[/strike]

[strike]This does not apply to items that do not have max enhancement as PEN.[/strike]



Updated 05/09]]

The adventurer's Family Name will now be shown on all equipment that is successfully enhanced up to "PEN (V)" (e.g. Asula accessories).
However, the adventurer's Family Name will not be shown on equipment that does not show "PEN (V)" level when enhanced to its maximum potential.



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Added method to reacquire the quest item for "Dangerous Negotiation II" in the quest description.

The condition to acquire the "Secrets to Infinite Life" quest was fixed to better fit the main questline.

Added quest condition guides to the description of the following quests.

[Boss] The Overlord of Omar Lava Cave
[Boss] Commander of the Abandoned Iron Mine
[Boss] Illezra's Creation
[Boss] Ancient Power, Moghulis
[Boss] Illezra's Servant
[Boss] Awakened Black Spirit



Knowledge

Knowledge for Mirumok Destroyer Offin is now acquired when it is killed.

Added new acquisition points for the knowledge of "Mediah Merchants Union", "Shen Merchant Guild", and "Leader of Altinova", which were unavailable after the revamp of Mediah main quests.

After completing the "Mediah Merchants Union" quest, you can obtain them from Kuldu, Belgar, and Neruda Shen.



Interface Changes

“Main Weapon (Appearance)" and "Sub-weapon (Appearance)" texts in the Dye window were changed to "Main Weapon (Skin)" and "Sub-weapon (Skin)".

Now you can directly register discount coupons from your inventory at the Pearl Shop.


Resolves Issues

Fixed the issue where the expiration date, trade item price guarantee expiration 2 hours, and equipped item durability 0 notifications (red background) in the inventory and equipment window overlapped with the item tier frame.

Fixed the issue where items in the inventory did not display the class limited icon.

Fixed the issue where the speed of ships did not drop when their durability reached 0.

Fixed the issue where the description of "Insectivore Plant Sap" did not match the actual method to acquire it.

Fixed the unnatural camera perspective of the Velia Wharf Resident.

[Shai] Fixed the issue where Shai could not do the "Black Spirit's Gift (Inventory Slot)" and "Black Spirit's Gift (Inventory Slot and Black Stones)" quests when selecting "[Crossroad] The Lamenting Head of the League of Merchants".

You will receive these quests after completing the "Howling Voice" and "Secret Book" quests from the Black Spirit.



[Shai] Fixed the issue where "[Shai] Beautiful Melody: Joy" remained in the quest list as incomplete even after completing it.

[Shai] Fixed the graphical issue of Night Sky Ear Studs, Ignis Ear Cuff, and Raven Ear Cuff sticking out of the hat when the Marine Romance Hat is equipped.

[Striker] Fixed the Desert Camouflage Armor where the neck area was hollow when equipped.

[Striker] Fixed the issue where a specific area on the chest of the Desert Camouflage Armor to be dyed with the rest of the piece.

[Striker, Mystic] Fixed the issue where Stiffness was applied to enemies when using Flow: Prey Hunt in the Battle Arena while the world boss is summoned.

[Warrior] Fixed the description of Scars of Dusk, Absolute: Scars of Dusk, and Solar Flare to include that they push back targets.

[Kunoichi, Ninja, Dark Knight, Witch, Wizard] Fixed the issue where the fishing float was displayed when equipped with only the float during standby mode.

[Warrior, Valkyrie, Archer, Shai, Striker, Mystic, Lahn] Fixed the issue where the fishing float was displayed during weapon changing and swimming when equipped with the fishing float.

[Lahn] Fixed the graphical issues with the [2nd Anniversary] Lollipop accessories.

[Sorceress] Fixed the issue where the dye number 1 for the Khilath Armor was applied to dye number 2.

[Mystic] Fixed the graphical issue of the Marine Romance clothes where the underwear clipped out when adjusting chest size.

[Archer] Fixed the graphical issue of the Gorca Swimsuit clipping through the Kibelius Armor.

[Archer] Fixed the graphical issue of the back of the neck of the Ignis Outfit.

Fixed the issue where there were Rulupee related NPCs at Epheria Ridge.

Fixed the issue where the camera moved abnormally when ending the observation mode with ESC during observation at the viewpoints of Sky Balloons and Ships.

Fixed the issue where you could not use Gathering near Saunil Battlefield.

Fixed the issue where the outside view was unnatural from inside some houses in Calpheon and other places.

Fixed the issue where Trial characters could acquire the Node War reward "Shining Medal of Honor".

We are aware of the issue where you cannot get the “[Repeat] The Furious 24 Hours” quest because you cannot interact with the NPC in Altinova who gives the quest.

[strike]We are aware of the issue where you cannot get the “Slum in the City” knowledge from Rubin even when you meet the conditions to acquire it.[/strike]

We are aware of the issue where the guild position of Apprentice guild members is changed abnormally.

This issue will be resolved during next week’s maintenance.




Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.
