notes.title: Patch Notes - June 12th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/UgMQqpL.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

This week we are adding a new travelling route to the world of Black Desert Online, the Sky Balloon! Get to your next destination while enjoying the beautiful view!
 
On the other hand, new Subjugation Quests are being added to the Hexe Sanctuary and Mediah region, so do not miss the opportunity to complete these quests if one of them appears suddenly!
 
As usual, new changes and fixes have been added to the game, so keep reading to know all the details. Enjoy!


Event & System

New Events

Loyal Attendance Rewards have been refreshed

Period: June 13 00:00 UTC - July 17 23:59 UTC



The monsters from the regions below will now appear twice as fast after they die.

Mediah: Shultz Guard, Hasrah Ancient Ruins
Valencia: Bashim Base, Basilisk Den, Roud Sulfur Mine, Aakman Temple
Kamasylvia: Forest Ronaros
Drieghan: Tshira Ruins, Sherekhan Necropolis (during the day)
Other: Sycraia Underwater Ruins (Upper zone)
 Updated 6/17 This will be effective for an event period ( June 12 after maintenance - June 19 before maintenance) of 1 week only.



Ongoing Events

Call of the Ocean: May 22 after maintenance - June 19 before maintenance.

Black Spirit’s Adventure 1: June 5 after maintenance - June 19 before maintenance.

Traces of the Black Spirit: June 5 after maintenance – June 26 before maintenance.

Community Event: Art of Thrones: May 31 - July 8

Submission period: Until the 24th of June 10:00 UTC
Click  for the full details.



SNS event: June 8 - June 26 before maintenance (3 weeks)

Winners Announcement: June 27
Click  for the full details on how to enter the SNS event to have a chance to win Tobii 4C Tracker and a brand new item, [Event] Sealed Book of Life (7 Days)!



Ended Events

Operation Guild Support


Item Distribution

Compensation for the Pet issue

With today’s maintenance, we fixed the issue where unintended skill would be learned during registering and Exchanging of pets, and Pet Exchange is now possible again. We have sent out the Wizard Gosphy Pet for compensation of every affected pet in your possession. Please find the details via our official forum post .



Heidel Ball Stream Gift: Wizard Gosphy

If you missed the Heidel Ball stream on June 8th, here is a recap and the script of the keynote .
Wizard Gosphy has been sent out to all adventurers of NA/EU during June 12th maintenance.
Please find your Wizard Gosphy ‘Coupon’ on your account page after logging in on our main website. Please make sure to claim the coupon before August 31st, 23:59 UTC or the coupon will expire.

Steam users can claim the coupon through ‘Redeem’ button under ESC menu in-game.




Content

https://i.imgur.com/vmenK6C.jpg


Sky Balloon has been added.

The Encarotia Family, Gavinya Great Crater Dwarf Artisans, and Old Moon Guild have created the Old Moon Sky Balloon, which travels through Calpheon, Altinova, and Valencia.
You can use the Old Moon Sky Balloon by purchasing a ticket from the following NPC's at their stations.

Calpheon: Kalix
Altinova: Lisam
Valencia: Mason



You can purchase the ticket with the Black Stone (Weapon) or Black Stone (Armor). The sky balloon will arrive once you hand over your ticket to Dwarf, who is in charge of handling the sky balloon.
Up to two adventurers can board the sky balloon.
Once a sky balloon has been summoned, you cannot interact with Dwarf, because he will be busy in preparation for the next sky balloon.
Though you can get off from the sky balloon immediately after you board it, you cannot get off once it departs. 
If you go back out to Character Selection screen and come back into the character en route in a Sky Balloon ride, the character would fall down to the ground. There is no Death Penalty for dying from this fall but we recommend you to sit tight on your Sky Balloon ride. 
Once the sky balloon arrives at its destination, you will automatically get off, and the sky balloon will disappear.
The routes Sky Balloon can travel are as follows:

Calpheon  Altinova
Altinova  Valencia




Added a new "Pioneers of the Sky" knowledge category.


Developer’s Comment

The Old Moon Sky Balloon has been created to help new adventurers who had a difficult time exploring the vast world of Black Desert. 
You can now move from city to city more conveniently by hopping onto the Old Moon Sky Balloon. 
Try taking a flight from Calpheon to Mediah, and get a view of the lands from high above. How about you take a special journey today with a friend on board the sky balloon?


System

The creator name for PEN items will now remain even after selling or buying them from the Central Market. This will affect only the PEN items created and traded after today’s maintenance.

Reduced the price gap between items bought individually and items included in Pearl outfit sets.


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

Most of the Grass Beetles which were near the dairy cows at Olvia have been relocated.

The beginner's Common Rack located at Olvia and Western Guard Camp no longer has any more potions.

Beginners can continue to obtain various helpful supplies through quests or events.



A ladder leading up to the top of Cron Castle has been added for the "Memorial Service for the Fallen People" quest.

If you moved to another area without completing the quest at the top, then you can climb up to the top through the following methods.

Talk to the NPC of the Cron Castle Altar again.
Use the ladder to go back up.




Fixed the issue where frame rates would drop when moving a character from a certain area at Mirumok Ruins.

Fixed the issue where characters were unable to get out of certain areas around the Gervish Mountains.

Fixed the issue where frame rates would drop in certain areas of Velia.

Fixed the graphical issue with the beard of NPC Basquean Ljurik of North Kaia Pier.


NPC

Fixed the issue where Nella Encarotia would not disappear while playing the "Missing in Action" Calpheon main quest.

Nella Encarotia will appear again once you complete "The Qualities of a God" quest.



Certain NPCs at Grána have returned their weapons to the armory. These NPCs are no longer armed with weapons.

Certain guards walking around inside Calpheon City have been relocated.

Fixed the issue where you could not have a conversation with Bernatisha when interacting from a certain distance.


Mounts

Fixed the issue where you were able to move your mouse abnormally during the motions of taking the wheel on a large ship (such as Galley, Epheria Sailboat/Frigate).

When you select the tier-5 horse which can be obtained by registering the "Seal of the Secret Guards" horse emblem, it will now be properly displayed at the Stable.

Galleys, Epheria Sailboats, Epheria Frigates, and Old Bartali Sailboats can now be damaged if they have at least one passenger onboard who is at least Lv. 50 and able to engage in PvP.

The quick walking motions of the donkey have been changed to a cantering motion.


Class Changes

All Classes

Fixed the issue where the character would occasionally turn its head towards the camera even in situations when it shouldn't (such as while using a skill).

Fixed the graphical issue with eyelashes when characters fell a certain amount of distance.


Ranger

Fixed the issue where Stamina would recover during the cooldown for the Razor Wind skill.


Sorceress

Fixed the issue where using the Night Crow skill towards a cliff while in Scythe mode would display an error message and bring the character back to its original location.

Fixed the issue where using the Flow: Night Crow skill on a hill would result in the character using another skill after showing a landing motion instead of showing the intended attack motion.

Fixed the issue where using the Night Crow skill in mid air 3 times while in Scythe mode and then using the skill immediately in the air again would result in showing a falling motion.

Fixed the issue where Emergency Escape did not activate when pressing V while moving during the main weapon mode.


Berserker

Fixed the issue where Emergency Escape did not activate when pressing V while moving during the main weapon mode.


Tamer

Fixed the issue where Emergency Escape did not activate when pressing V while moving during the main weapon mode.


Valkyrie

Increased the speed at which the character switches from awakening weapon combat stance to auto-move.


Witch

Increased the speed at which the character switches from main weapon/awakening weapon combat stance to auto-move.


Wizard

Increased the speed at which the character switches from main weapon/awakening weapon combat stance to auto-move.


Musa

Increased the speed at which the character switches from main weapon/awakening weapon combat stance to auto-move.


Maehwa

Increased the speed at which the character switches from main weapon combat stance to auto-move.


Ninja

Increased the speed at which the character switches from main weapon combat stance to auto-move.


Kunoichi

Increased the speed at which the character switches from main weapon/awakening weapon combat stance to auto-move.


Dark Knight

Increased the speed at which the character switches from awakening weapon combat stance to auto-move.


Striker

Developer's Comment

This week, we have updated BDO with a patch focusing on balancing the PVE damage for Striker.
We agreed with many feedback about the Striker's skill combinations feeling a bit clunky compared to other characters, so we improved the skills and how they combo with other skills.
We will continue to provide updates which balance out the characters.


The camera perspective effect for the Fallout skill has been changed.
 
You can now use the Fist Fury skill when pressing S + RMB while in Gardbrace mode.

The range for the final hit for the Fist Fury skill has been reduced, which in turn will allow the attack to be more focused.

The transition to the Roaring Tiger skill while using Fist Fury has been improved to flow more naturally.

You can now use the Ferocious Assault skill by pressing W + RMB while in Gauntlet mode.

The attack area for the final hit of Ultimate Crush has increased and its range has decreased so that the attack can be more focused.

The final 4th hit of Ultimate Crush has been changed from a wide attack to an attack which focuses on a target in front of you.



The location for the Echo Spirit which is summoned when hitting with the Ultimate Crush skill has been changed.

The location has been changed so that it can attack where the Striker character is attacking.
The PVE damage for the Ultimate Crush skill has been increased to the following.

Ultimate Crush I: 588% x3 → 643% x3
Ultimate Crush II: 707% x3 → 799% x3
Ultimate Crush III: 827% x3 → 955% x3
Ultimate Crush IV: 945% x3 → 1111% x3




The Critical Hit Rate for the Skull Crusher skill in PvE has been changed to 100%.

Added a command which activates the Skull Crusher skill when pressing the F key while in the air during the Ferocious Assault skill.

The attack range for the Echo Spirit, which is summoned when using the Infernal Destruction skill, has been increased.

The spin PVE hit damage for the Infernal Destruction skill has been increased like the following.

Infernal Destruction I: 538% x 4 → 699% x 4
Infernal Destruction II: 618% x 6 → 803% x 6
Infernal Destruction III: 709% x 6 → 921% x 6
Infernal Destruction IV: 800% x 6 → 1040% x 6



2 hits have been added for PVE hits for the Rampaging Predator skill.

The PVE damage for the Endless Fight skill has been increased like the following.

1-hit damage: 763% x 3 → 1066% x 3
2-hit damage: 610% x 3 → 959% x 3



Critical Hit Rate has been added to the PVE hit for Endless Explosion.

Added a command which combos 2-hits with Endless Fight when pressing LMB after the final hit with Endless Explosion.

When entering the commands for Flow: Mass Destruction and Ferocious Assault during the Endless Explosion skill, the skills will now be activated.

When using the following skills, other skills will now be activated more quickly than before.

Ferocious Assault
Rampaging Predator



The PVE damage for the Wolf's Fang skill's attack which pushes away the target in front has been increased.

Wolf's Fang I: 51% x 4 → 255% x 4
Wolf's Fang II: 79% x 4 → 397% x 4
Wolf's Fang III: 107% x 4 → 539% x 4
Wolf's Fang IIV: 136% x 4 → 681 % x 4
Wolf's Fang V:164% x 4 → 823% x 4
Absolute: Wolf's Fang: 352% x 4 → 1230% x 4



The description for the explosive hit for the Wolf's Fang skill has been removed, and the description for the Flow: Prey Hunt effect has been added.

The number of hits for the Wolf's Fang skill's regular hit and Flow: Prey Hunt has been increased by 2 hits.

The camera perspective effect during the attacking motions for the Wolf's Fang skill has been changed.

The direction of movement and effects should now match for the skill Endless Fight.

The Stiffness effect for the skill Flow: Prey Hunt which activates automatically when used after having 30 Martial Spirit Shards will now be applied in PvE.


Mystic

Increased the speed at which the character switches from main weapon/awakening weapon combat stance to auto-move.

The Stiffness effect for the skill Flow: Prey Hunt which activates automatically when used after having 30 Martial Spirit Shards will now be applied in PvE.


Lahn

The 8 skill points which were consumed to learn the Earthly Pain I skill, which can be obtained through a quest (which was a revision made on June 5th), have been returned.

However, there are no changes made to the maximum amount of skill points, and this does not include adventurers who have received all skill points through a skill reset after the maintenance on June 5th.



Archer

Increased the speed at which the character switches from main weapon/awakening weapon combat stance to auto-move.


Item Changes

A caution message has been added to the item description for the Reset Mount Growth item.

You now have to be Lv. 56 or higher to exchange the [Event] Shakatu's Seal with items.

You can now equip items from your Pearl Inventory even while moving.

The description of certain guild items have had the following information updated.

Who can retrieve the item from the guild storage. This information has replaced the information about who can use the item in certain guild item descriptions.
If the item will be erased if you leave a Guild.



The item descriptions for the items below have been revised to suit their names.

Skilled Sailor's Clothes (Costume)
Professional Sailor's Clothes (Costume)



The information about the conditions for being able to accept the quest Materials for Skills, which is needed to acquire the knowledge Heating: Skilled, has been fixed.

The description for Asula's Weakened Magic Necklace has been revised.

Specification changes have been announced for the Main/Sub/Awakening Weapon Exchange Coupons and Combat/Skill EXP Exchange Coupons. 

Please find the full announcement via our official forum post .



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

The chances of obtaining the Dragon Scale Fossil by defeating the monsters below at Sherekhan Necropolis during the day have been increased sixfold.

Garud
Lateh
Belcadas
Nybrica
Federik



You will now have a certain chance to obtain the Dragon Scale Fossil when defeating the following monsters at Sherekhan Necropolis during nighttime. There is a higher chance to obtain the Dragon Scale Fossil at Sherekhan Necropolis during the night than during the day.

Garud
Lateh
Belcadas
Nybrica
Federik



https://i.imgur.com/KhERSDA.png

Developer’s Comment

When you complete the Mediah main quests, you normally head towards Valencia. However, while Valencia being a desert can be a challenge to certain adventurers, it can be a stress factor to some adventurers.
Therefore we would like to now allow adventurers to select a path (Valencia or Kamasylvia) to continue on with their journey.
Starting with the Fadus Habitat, we will continue to provide these types of updates.
Also, you can now obtain Asula accessories from the Fadus Habitat.This should be the beginning of updates which will allow the unpopular monster zones to become utilized more frequently.


The Fadus have become more fierce due to the white ash from Ash Forest. They have become numb towards pain and now obsess about attacking others.

Fadus Habitat (in the Loopy Tree Forest) will now have a recommended AP of 120-190.
Monsters at Fadus Habitat now have 30% increased HP increased and 15% increased AP, but also have 10% decreased DP.
The amount of Combat EXP you obtain from monsters at Fadus Habitat has been increased by 30%, and the amount of Skill EXP you obtain from them has been increased by 25%.
The amount of "Fadus Armor Fragment" junk items you can obtain from the following monsters has been increased.
Fadus Challenger: 1-4 → 2-4
Fadus Shaman: 1-3 → 2-3
Fadus Warrior: 1-3 → 2-3
When defeating monsters at Fadus Habitat, you will now have a chance to obtain Destructive Illusion and Dew of Tranquil Forest.



Fadus Warrior Chief will appear at the Fadus Habitat.

The Fadus Warrior Chief is much stronger than the other Fadus monsters.
Once you begin to fight the Fadus Warrior Chief, you must watch out for nearby Fadus which continue to join in on the battle.
You can obtain the following items by defeating the Fadus Warrior Chief.
Dew of Tranquil Forest, Destructive Illusion, Lemoria Helmet, Lemoria Gloves, Destruction Spirit Stone, Bares Shortsword, Yuria Shortsword, Bares Axe, Yuria Axe, Bares Staff, Yuria Staff, Trace of Battle, Earth Spirit Stone Fragment, Manshaum Voodoo Doll, Caphras Stone, Swaying Wind Shard, Black Stone (Armor), Black Energy Residue, Fadus Armor Fragment, Silver



Knowledge for Fadus Warrior Chief has been added.

The amount of Energy you can obtain through the knowledge of The Fadus Kind has been changed like the following.

Before: 11x Knowledge of The Fadus Kind = Energy +1
Now: 6x Knowledge of The Fadus Kind = Energy +1, 12x Knowledge of The Fadus Kind = Energy +2



NPC Herbin, who can be found at an inn in Kamasylvia, has returned to Kamasylvia from the Kamasylve Temple in Mediah.

You can exchange a Dew of Tranquil Forest for an Asula's Weakened Magic accessory via Herbin.
You can exchange three Asula's Weakened Magic accessories for an Asula's Crimson Eye accessory of the same type via Herbin.



A new item, Dew of Tranquil Forest, has been added.

You can get this item at a certain rate by defeating monsters in the Fadus Habitat. (Dew of Tranquil will also be available in Polly’s Forest after a future update.)
You can exchange Dew of Tranquil Forest for an Asula's  Weakened Magic accessory.
Dew of Tranquil Forest can be sold to NPC vendors for 100,000 Silver.



Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Mediah Subjugation Quests have been added.

You will be able to accept these quests when you are in Mediah, and will be rewarded in your efforts in defeating various monsters in Mediah. Adventurers who are struggling with the Mediah main quests could especially enjoy the enhanced accessories available as quest rewards to amp up their gear.
They will automatically appear on the left side of the minimap when you enter the relevant region.
https://i.imgur.com/km49idT.jpg



The following quests to get Witch's Earring have been added to Hexe Sanctuary. These quests available for characters Lv. 51 or up.

Accessory Filled with the Witch's Power I
Accessory Filled with the Witch's Power II
Accessory Filled with the Witch's Power III



The quest objective for [Returning] Removing the Fishy Smell has been changed. This was changed due to the feedback we received from many returning adventurers about the difficulty in obtaining the Grape and Olive because they were already gathered while going through the returning quest.

Before: Giving David Finto Grape or Olive
Now: Consuming Energy by interacting with the Grape Crate next to the grape tree storage.



The "Village by the Beautiful Coast" quest will not be displayed for adventurers who have completed "The Sage of Velia" before the "Village by the Beautiful Coast" quest was added. This is to prevent adventurers from being confused with the quest lines.

The quest-giving NPC for certain Black Spirit's Gift II quests has been changed for the older version of the Balenos to Calpheon main quests. Now, NPCs from the questline will give you the gifts instead of the Black Spirit. Such quests have had the text "Black Spirit's Gift II" removed from the quest name.

Changed the quest icon for "[Farming Lv. 40] Nature and Abundance" to suit the quest description better.

Fixed the issue where the Kamasylvia Weasel would occasionally not be summoned again after initially being summoned during the "[Repeat] Looking for Weasels" quest.

A quest icon will now be displayed on top of Al Rhundi when going through "The Scale of Justice" quest.

For clarity when accepting the Adventure Journal for the Traces of the Black Spirit, the description below has been added to the conditions.

Complete Quest [Event] Evidence of Black Spirit



Knowledge

Title for "The Fall of the Knights of Dawn" knowledge has been changed to "The Fall of the Knights of Dawn I".

The title for "The Shadow Knights, Fraternity of Light , and the Secret Guards" knowledge has been changed to "The Fall of the Knights of Dawn II", and the contents of it has been simplified.



When you obtain the knowledge of Barricade for the Star's End region, the camera angle will now better capture the background than before.


Interface Changes

The completion effect for the Complete button will now be properly displayed when completing the Black Spirit's Adventure Journal.

It has been changed so that the creator name reset popup message will no longer appear when moving an item enhanced to PEN level into the Central Market Warehouse.

Warning notification of item data reset in regards to dye, branding, and etc will still appear.



When attempting to plant crops or place garden tools while your character is outside of a fence garden, the following message will now appear.

Please install the item inside a fence or residence.



When a Life Skill levels up, the information displayed will now be more detailed.

For example, when going from Gathering Beginner 1 to Gathering Beginner 2, instead of saying Gathering Level Up it will say Reached Gathering Beginner 2.



When purchasing the Appearance Coupon from the Customization window (F4) while in Toggle UI mode, the purchase window can now be closed by pressing the ESC key.

Fixed an issue where a list of other items was displayed in certain situations when placing an order for Volatile Price Items at the Central Market.

Fixed an issue where the weight of the current mount would be displayed in the Max Load information for the mount information at the Wharf.

When you select a tab or check a checkbox, the color of the text for the checked tab or checkbox will now change so that it is more clear that you have checked it.

The text for the following buttons has been changed as follows.

The text for the “Switch Menu” button on the older version of the ESC Menu has been changed to “Switch to New Menu.”
The text for the “Switch Menu” button on the newer version of the ESC Menu has been changed to “Switch to Old Menu.”



The description which appears when you press the recover button in the Worker List window has been changed to the following.

Shift + RMB the item to recover Stamina. → Press Shift + RMB on the item to continuously recover Worker Stamina.



The weight information for the mount you call from the Wharf will now be properly displayed.

Fixed an issue in the Find NPC window where clicking on the Imperial Delivery icon would make it disappear.

When using a skill registered on the skill guide widget, the effect which shows that the skill has been used will now be properly displayed.

When a customization file did not have the creator information included, there used to be an awkward blank space in the UI. This has been replaced with a hyphen (-).


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where the fairy's Miraculous Cheer skill would occasionally not work even when the HP and Resource become lower than set value on the Potion Setting window.

Fixed the issue where an unintended skill would be learned when exchanging pets.

Fixed the issue where the DP Increase buff icon would be displayed when Nouver and Kutum are enraged.

Fixed the issue where certain potions could not be used by a Fairy with the Miraculous Cheer skill.


Updated June 14th

Unfortunately "Refined Grain Juice" still cannot be used and this will be resolved in a future maintenance.


Known Issues

Updated June 13th

You can no longer equip saddles and horseshoes intended for horses on donkeys.


Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - June 5th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/Bekl7aL.gif

Greetings Adventurers, 

This week, we are finally introducing the long-awaited, Star’s End! Battle fierce monsters and challenge yourself to obtain the powerful Blackstar weapons!

Also, join the ultimate hunt to find the 100 Black Spirit Marks spread all over the world of Black Desert, and don’t forget to get your dices ready for the Black Spirit’s Adventure 1 making a comeback. 

Please read below to learn more about this week Patch Notes.


Event & System

New Events

Traces of Black Spirit event will start

Event Period: June 5 after maintenance - June 26 before maintenance
New logs where you need to track down the traces of the Black Spirit has been added to Adventure Log! Find 100 Black Spirit Marks spread all over the world of Black Desert for awesome rewards!
Click  to learn how you can track down the Black Spirit in detail.



Black Spirit’s Adventure 1 will return

Event Period: June 5 after maintenance - June 19 before maintenance



Ongoing Events

Call of the Ocean: May 22 after maintenance - June 19 before maintenance.

Operation Guild Support: May 29 after maintenance - June 12 before maintenance.


Ended Events

Special Challenges (Y): Ends June 5 23:59 UTC 

Hands of Gold Returns


Reward Distribution

In-game title “Lights, Camera, Action!” and relevant items to the winners of 2019 Spring Video Contest has been sent out. Please check your in-game mailbox (B) for the rewards.

Winners that won offline prizes will receive them at a later date. Please check your email inbox for our official email. 



Content

A new area in western Calpheon, Star's End, has been added.

This area is located in the area covered by fog on the west of Calpheon City. You must be careful here, since powerful monsters roam the area.
New nodes and NPC's have been added to the Star's End area, and new relevant knowledge topics have been added as well.



The overlords of Star's End have finally been unveiled.

The recommended AP for the Star's End Monster Zone is 260.
The Remnants of Corruption deal attacks which reduce your DP, so it's recommended that you take care of them first in order to thrive in combat.
When the Apostle of Immorality dies, there's a certain chance for it to absorb dark energies from Star's End and turn into an Apostle of Malevolence.
The Apostle of Malevolence is more powerful than other regular monsters. It will disappear if you cannot defeat it within 5 minutes after it spawns.
The Unstable Star Debris is placed around Star's End. When destroyed, nearby monsters will momentarily collapse. There will also be a small chance for these nearby monsters to immediately disappear.
The monsters of Star's End have a slightly higher chance of dropping the Mass of Pure Magic item compared to monsters of different regions.



The new Blackstar Weapons have been added.

The Blackstar weapons are higher in grade than the previous weapons.
All adventurers, new and old, will have a chance to obtain the Blackstar weapons.
However, we designed the new Blackstar weapons in a way that still preserves the values of weapons which already existed in the game. You can achieve growth by either enhancing your old weapons through Caphras enhancements, or by obtaining and enhancing the new Blackstar weapons.
The Blackstar weapons are a new challenge for future updates to come.
The Blackstar weapons consume 1 Concentrated Magical Black Stone (Weapon) for +0-15 enhancements.
The Blackstar weapons consume 1 Pure Magical Black Stone for PRI-PEN enhancements.
You can receive a quest which allows you to craft the Blackstar weapon from the Legendary Blacksmith Dorin Morgrim by completing the [Blackstar Weapon Piece] quest. Once you complete the quest you receive from Dorin Morgrim, you can obtain a Blackstar weapon.
Blackstar main weapons can only be crafted through quests.
Caphras enhancement is not available for Blackstar weapons.



A Star's End main quest which allows you, along with the Comitia of Tantinis, to unravel the secrets of the restricted area of Star's End has been added.

You can immerse yourself into the Star's End region by accepting the [Drawn by Fate] quest from the Black Spirit with a character who has completed the [A Gift for a Hero] quest, which is a Drieghan Main Quest.



[Blackstar Weapon] quests have been added.

To start this quest, you need to have the "Remnants of the Rift" item and the knowledge of "The Three Legendary Blacksmiths of Mediah."
The Remnants of the Rift can be obtained at a low chance by defeating a boss from the Dark Rift.
You can obtain the knowledge of "The Three Legendary Blacksmiths of Mediah" by obtaining and completing "The Three Blacksmiths" quest from Tulem, after you complete the renewed Mediah Main quests once you reach Lv. 56 or higher. Adventurers who have already completed these quests can obtain it by talking to Tulem. 
The [Blackstar Weapon] quests can only be completed once per character.
During the quests, you will be able to choose between battling the boss at its full strength, or fighting a weakened version of the boss. 



Eye of Desolation, which is needed for crafting Blackstar main weapons, has been added.

Eye of Desolation can be used to summon the Incarnation of Corruption.
Use Manufacture in the Processing window (L) to combine Eye of Anguish x1 and Concentrated Boss's Aura x3 into Eye of Desolation.
Use Heating in the Processing window (L) on one of the following types of weapons to get Concentrated Boss's Aura.

Kzarka main weapon
Offin Tett's Radiant main weapon
Nouver sub-weapon
Kutum sub-weapon
Dandelion awakening weapon



Eye of Anguish can be obtained via the [Blackstar Weapon] quests.



Pure Magical Black Stone, which can be used to enhance Blackstar main weapons, has been added.

Use Heating in the Processing window (L) to combine Sharp Black Crystal Shard x1, Hard Black Crystal Shard x1, and Mass of Pure Magic x1 into a Pure Magical Black Stone.
Mass of Pure Magic can be obtained through various ways, such as excavating at the Star's End node, grinding Black Stone (Weapon) or Black Stone (Armor), looting from the monsters of Star's End, gathering, defeating field bosses, and hunting Khalks/whales.

Giant Mudster, Dim Tree Spirit, Red Nose, Dastard Bheg, Katzvariak, Khalk, and Blue Whale will drop Mass of Pure Magic at a certain rate.
It drops when defeating monsters and gathering, at a low rate (exceptions: water scooping, digging in the desert, and milking cows).
You can exchange Destructive Illusion x15 for Mass of Pure Magic x1 via O'Arma, an Ahib who can be found at Star's End.

You can get Destructive Illusion via several daily quests near Star's End.



Mass of Pure Magic cannot be listed on the Central Market.




Corrupted Magic Crystal has been added.

It can be transfused into sub-weapons, and there will be an additional effect when multiple Corrupted Magic Crystals are equipped.
Item effect: Critical Hit Damage +10%, All AP +2, All Damage Reduction -2
2 Crystal Set Effect: Critical Hit Damage +2%
Use Simple Alchemy in the Processing window (L) to combine Clear Blackstar Crystal x1, Magic Crystal of Infinity - Critical Hit x1, and Forest Fury x3 into Corrupted Magic Crystal.
Clear Blackstar Crystal drops when defeating monsters in Star's End.



A new item for the residence, Garden of a Fallen God (Landscape Painting), has been added.

You can get this item via the Star's End main quests. Although this item cannot be listed on the Central Market, it can be sold at a high price to NPC vendors.



For more on Star’s End and Blackstar weapons, please check the official announcement !

There is a rumor spreading about a ghost in the Ash Forest.


System

You can now collect enclosed items and silver from the Mailbox (B) even when in combat areas.

Added a feature which allows you to hide Campsites which belong to other adventurers.

However, the Campsites will not be hidden when adventurers are lying down on the Campsites.



When leveling up a Life Skill or enhancing an equipment while in Privacy Mode, notification messages will no longer be sent to guild members.

Fixed the issue where the camera movement would be unnatural when closing up to the face in the Customization (F4) window.


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

Fixed the issue where islands which do not exist would be displayed in certain areas of the World Map (M).

Fixed the geographical features of certain areas inside the sea near the port of Arehaza.

Fixed the issue where characters could not get out of certain areas of Manshaum Forest.

Fixed the issue where shadow effect would not show or the light effect would be excessively bright in some areas. 


NPC

Shakatu is too busy now, so you can now exchange the [Event] Shakatu's Seal through NPC Dellus, who is Shakatu's right-hand man.

Dellus is near Shakatu.



Fixed the issue where NPC around the Great Library of Calpheon would disappear when greeted by a lord character.

You can now search for Furniture Dealer Vatputa of Valencia City by using the Search NPC feature.

The completion NPC for the [Returning] Crio's Welcome quest (for returning adventurers) will now be from the same Crio NPC you accept the quest from, instead of another Crio near the beach. This is to avoid confusion.

While you are going through the quest, another Crio will not appear.



Mounts

Fixed the issue where using the Transport function to move a character on a wagon to Heidel would get the wagon stuck at the stable there.

Because of this, when you take out your mount from the stable in Heidel now the mount will appear closer to the road than the stable.



You can no longer delete or change courser skills from a courser horse (i.e. the skills that make that horse a courser).

The skill, elegance and strength stats (which are needed for to awaken a courser) of a Tier 8 courser will now reset when it is bought from a horse market.


Class Changes

All Classes

A key guide will now appear when your character is using a Fortress Gate 

A key guide will now appear when your character is using a ladder.

The invincible effect that is applied when your character makes a cheering motion after getting a high-grade item will now only apply for PvE, and not for PvP.

Fall damage will no longer apply in the Red Battlefield.


Berserker

Fixed the graphical issue with the Epheria Marine Helmet that occurred with certain customizations.

Fixed the issue where Yianaros Headpiece would be worn awkwardly. 


Witch

The graphical effects of the skill Aad Sphera Training have been improved.

The last movement of the skill Black Spirit: Meteor Shower has been made to look more natural.

The PvE damage for the skill Toxic Flood has increased as follows. 

903% x 23 → 1500% x 23



Hits of the skill Toxic Flood will now have a magic DP reduction effect.
 
The movement speed reduction effect of Voltaic Pulse skills has been replaced with an evasion rate reduction effect.
 
The damage for Yoke of Ordeal skills has increased as follows.

443% x 12 → 543% x 12 
526% x 12 → 722% x 12
608% x 12 → 901% x 12



Cooldown for the skill Flow: Perfect Sign has been removed.

The skill Flow: Perfect Sign will now always be performed after Fissure Wave skills, unless Flow: Perfect Sign is locked.

The PvE damage for Thunder Storm skills and Black Spirit: Thunder Storm skills has increased as follows.

504% x 6 → 564% x 6 
665% x 6 → 745% x 6
827% x 6 → 926% x 6



The PvE damage for Fissure Wave skills, when not in cooldown, has been increased as follows. 

538% x 10 → 646% x 10
600% x 10 → 720% x 10
663% x 10 → 796% x 10
726% x 10 → 871% x 10



The PvE damage for Black Spirit: Fissure Wave skills has increased as follows. (The number of hits has not changed.)

1065% → 1279%
1188% → 1426%
1313% → 1576%
1437% → 1725%



Hits of Equilibrium Break skills and Black Spirit: Equilibrium Break skills will now have an AP reduction effect.

Hits of Equilibrium Break skills and Black Spirit: Equilibrium Break skills will now have a Critical Hit Rate +50% effect in PvE.

The casting speed for a skill after the skill Evasion is used in Aad Sphera mode has been increased.

The number of PvE targets the skill Magic Lighthouse registers has been increased from 7 to 10.


Wizard

The last movement of the skill Black Spirit: Meteor Shower has been made to look more natural.

The PVE damage for the skill Lava Field has increased as follows.
903% x 23 → 1500% x 23
 
Hits of the skill Lava Field will now have a magic DP reduction effect.

The casting speed for Chilling Wave skills has been increased.

The damage for Chilling Wave skills has increased as follows.

443% x 12 → 543% x 12 
526% x 12 → 722% x 12 
608% x 12 → 901% x 12



The PVE damage for Cataclysm skills has increased as follows.

723% x 7 → 814% x 7
832% x 7 → 957% x 7
941% x 7 → 1045% x 7
1058% x 7 → 1240% x 7



The movement speed reduction effect of Aqua Jail Explosion skills has been replaced with an evasion rate reduction effect.

The PVE damage for Aqua Jail Explosion skills has increased as follows.

349% x 13 → 408% x 13 
392% x 13 → 469% x 13
435% x 13 → 530% x 13 
478% x 13 → 591% x 13



The PVE damage for Black Spirit: Aqua Jail Explosion skills has increased as follows.

558% x 16 → 653% x 16 
627% x 16 → 750% x 16 
696% x 16 → 848% x 16
765% x 16 → 946% x 16



Hellfire skills and Black Spirit: Hellfire skills will now have an magic AP increase effect.

The PVE damage for Hellfire skills has increased as follows.

472% x 11 → 634% x 11
526% x 11 → 697% x 11
578% x 11 → 760% x 11
632% x 11 → 823% x 11



The PVE damage for Bolide of Destruction skills has increased as follows.

554% x 6 → 681% x 6
731% x 6 → 894% x 6 
911% x 6 → 1107% x 6



The casting speed for a skill after the skill Evasion is used in Godr Sphera mode has been increased.
 
The number of PvE targets the skill Magic Lighthouse registers has been increased from 7 to 10.


Striker

Fixed the graphical issue with the arms that occurred when equipped with Backflow Gardbrace or Dandelion Gardbrace.


Mystic

Fixed the issue where pressing LMB to cause an instant explosion during the skill Infinite Fortitude did not cause the skill's grapple resistance buff to cancel.

Fixed the issue where the invincible effects for the skills Wolf's Frenzy and Enhance: Wolf's Frenzy were applied even when the character was visible.

Fixed the issue where equipping Leebur's Gloves would make it overlap with gauntlets.


Lahn

Fixed the issue where the position of the Kibelius Crimson Glaives was awkward in standby mode.

Information about the amount of skill points needed to learn Earthly Pain I has been removed from its skill description, because it can be learned during the awakening quests.


Archer

Fixed the issue where galloping at full speed on horseback while in combat mode made the camera move awkwardly.


Item Changes

Fixed the issue where certain parts of the Coral Wardrobe did not look natural.

Added a feature which restores the Upgraded Compass Parts and Map of Unknown Piece to their original states.

You can restore them through a ‘great NPC’ and an ‘old book’ located somewhere in the Black Desert world.
When restoration is successful, the icons for each item will change.
The items which are successfully restored can be mixed and combined with the original items.



A caution message has been added to the item description for the Reset Mount Growth item.

Fixed the issue where the hair would occasionally appear abnormal when equipping and unequipping equipment which has hair on it.

Added Marni's Stone (Stone Waragon) and Marni's Stone II (Stone Waragon)

These items can be purchased from Wacky Toshi.
Just like the Marni's Stones from before, you can exchange them from Wacky Toshi with EXP after defeating monsters.



Silver Embroidered items now have descriptions which explain how to enhance.

Added the missing "Luck +1" text to the item descriptions for the following items.

Apprentice Sailor's Clothes (Costume)
Skilled Sailor's Clothes (Costume)
Professional Sailor's Clothes (Costume)



Fixed the issue where the game would occasionally shut down when equipping mount equipment.

The Remnants of the Rift can now be obtained from the Golden Treasure Chest, which randomly appears in Black Desert.

You can now obtain the Mass of Pure Magic when harvesting crops which grow from planting Magical Seeds and Mysterious Seeds in the garden.

You will have a low chance to obtain it through harvesting the crops when they are at 100% or higher growth.



You can obtain 5 Mass of Pure Magic by Manufacturing 1 Remnants of the Rift and 1 Black Spirit's Claw.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Quests & Knowledge

Quest

The following daily quest has been added to the Waragon Nest region in Valencia.

[Daily] Moria’s Fervor for Research



A guild mission to defeat Waragons has been added.

The villagers of Valencia need help with all the Stone Waragons that became de-petrified.



Fixed the issue where it was sometimes impossible to return back to your original location after being transported during the main questline to the Ancient Stone Chamber in Balenos.

Fixed the issue where the button to hand over Special Wheat Crate to Norma Leight during the quest [Farming Lv. 30] The Best Wheat Farm looked like a button to gain knowledge.

The quest name “To be the Best Huntsman!” has been changed to “True Hunter”.

Revised the information related to when the White Wolf boss disappears, which is displayed in the quest summary for the "Do or Die" quest.

The dialogue for the Excavation Site quest has been changed to better suit the background of the quest.

The conditions for the button for obtaining Contribution EXP being displayed for exchanging the Balenos Defense Token from Cliff at Western Guard Camp has been changed like the following.

Complete The Compliment of a Veteran quest or have at least 1 Balenos Defense Token



Added a button which explains the usage of Balenos Defense Token when interacting with Cliff after completing the Complement of a Veteran quest.

Quests related to Protty Cave and Sycraia Underwater Ruins will now be displayed within the Recommended tab of the Quest (O) window.

They will be displayed in the [Lv.58] Call of the Ocean: Journey to the Deep Sea group within the Recommended tab when you are Lv. 58 or higher.



Interface Changes

The Node Management button will no longer be displayed in certain situations when selling Trade items through interacting with Trade NPC's.

Fixed the issue where the hotkey for the Acquire All button would not reflect changes made to the Acquire All (R) button in the Get Item window.

Fixed the issue where the success range would appear abnormal when playing minigames like ‘Capture Horse’  and ‘Working Bellows’ in Florin.

The Pearl Shop (F3) shortcut button on the bottom right side of the screen, and the Pearl Shop icon in the ESC menu has been changed to represent the Pearl Shop better.

When a worker cannot be recovered, the explanation describing the status will now be properly displayed like the following:

The Worker's stamina is already at max.



Fixed the issue where the descriptions for main quests and the quest widget would remain on the screen when you move to the Customization (F4) window.

The Guild Mark and Guild Name will no longer overlap when changing the size of the chat window after using the Promote Guild feature.

Fixed the error message which is displayed when you take out a mount in certain situations.

When using the Villa Scroll at a Campsite, you can now select Silver from either the Inventory or from the Storage.

Fixed the issue where the Acquire All button would be marked as "R" from the Get Item window even after changing the interaction key from the game settings.

The Item Count window, which appears when you right-click a countable item from your Inventory, will no longer change positions when you adjust the game screen size.

The Sell Trade Item button in the Trade window has been improved.

Fixed the issue where the Customization window would not close when using Toggle UI from the Customization(F4) window.

When you press the BDO Wiki button in the Crafting Notes menu (F2), the BDO Wiki window will now be placed on top of the Crafting Notes window.

Added 9 new background loading screens (3 of which are played while you are waiting to be connected).

You can now check the Recent Price, Recent Transaction, and Total Trades in the Central Market's purchase and sell windows. 

The Remnants of the Rift item has been added to the list of obtainable items seen in the Dark Rift window.

The selection range which appears when you select the See Other’s Campsite settings from the game settings has been expanded to make selection more convenient.


Resolved Issues

Fixed  the issue where the game client would occasionally shut down when equipping mount equipment.

Fixed the issue where a fairy that has learned the skill Miraculous Cheer would occasionally cause potion consumption when it shouldn't.

Fixed the issue where abnormal outlines appeared around crops that were selected while new crops were being placed in a fence garden.

Fixed the issue where abnormal outlines appeared around furniture that were selected while new furniture were being placed in a residence.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where certain NPC and objects are not being displayed properly after connecting to the game for the first time or after a loading process.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - May 29th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/WOyDiru.gif

Greetings Adventurers, 

Have you ever wondered how exactly the Mediah kingdom fell under chaos and destruction? Why are the Shroud Knights pursuing the witch Illezra? Is it Neruda Shen the rightful king of the new Mediah kingdom? This is getting more interesting than the last episode of your favourite TV show, therefore complete the renewed main story quest of Mediah to get a full scope of this mysterious story!
 
We also have a new in-game event will start after maintenance: complete guild missions and earn various rewards. If you are new or returning to our game, don’t forget to check out the completely renewed attendance rewards! Moreover, we have a special contest for those artists of our community who seek glory and recognition, so we would like to introduce our new contest “Art of Thrones”.
 
As usual other fixes and changes have been applied to the game, so keep reading to know all details about this week’s patch! We hope you enjoy the new events and the new additions!


Event & System

New Event

Operation Guild Support

Event Period: May 29 after maintenance - June 12 before maintenance
Tackle various guild missions for various rewards!
Click  to learn about events that require collective work in detail.



Better Attendance Rewards!

Event Period: May 30 (00:00 UTC) – September 4 (23:59 UTC)
Don’t forget to log in every day and claim your scorching rewards for ‘Rookie’ and ‘Returning’ attendance rewards!
Click  to see newly-update reward set!



Adventurers who have access to Olvia server and classified as Rookie or Returning adventurers will now automatically receive Value Pack effect for 15 days.

If a Value Pack is already active, additional 15 days will have been added to your Value Pack usage period.



[New Community Event] Art of Thrones Fan Art Contest

Win your very own Black Desert Online branded “Throne of Art” by depicting your favourite Black Desert character sitting on a throne or gaming chair.

Submission Period: May 31 - June 24 10:00 UTC
Staff Pick: June 28
Community Vote: June 28 - July 8 10:00 UTC
Winner Announcement: July 8



Please check the official forum link  for the rewards list and full announcement! (the Submission thread will be live on May 31, check in the event section of the forums).



Ongoing Events

2019 Spring Video Contest:

Winner Announcement: May 30!

Rewards will be distributed with future maintenance.




Hands of Gold Returns: May 8 after maintenance - June 5 before maintenance.


Ended Events

Starry Night


Content

Fixed the issue where information about the growth of your crops appeared abnormally.

Fixed the issue where it was occasionally possible to fish at locations that should have impossible to fish at (such as objects and roads next to body of water).

Fixed the issue where it was impossible to fish in the following locations:

Lake Valencia
Shakatu
The pond near Glutoni Cave
The lake located north of Calpheon Castle Site



Fixed the issue where characters would get stuck at barricades while auto-navigating to Port Epheria.

Fixed the issue where characters would get stuck in walls or obstacles while auto-navigating to Calpheon City.

Fixed the issue where navigation in certain regions of Valencia was awkward.


Mediah Quest Renewal

Mediah Main Quests have been renewed.


Your perspective on the world of Black Desert Online will broaden and a clear distinction of relationships between NPCs and associations will be made.

The new Mediah Main Quests start by choosing between 2 Crossroads Quests in Abandoned Iron Mine of Altinova.

The first storyline opens with the 'Until We Meet Again' quest and delves into the events that lead to the downfall of Kingdom of Mediah and the siding with the Shroud Knights. As part of the Shroud Knights, you will earn about the Kingdom of Mediah and be in pursuit of Illezra.

The second storyline opens with the '[Crossroad] For Altinova' quest and delves into the events that lead to the reconstruction of Kingdom of Mediah and the siding with Neruda Shen and the Shen Merchant Guild. You will endeavor to bring prosperity to Mediah again.

※ If you selected first storyline (crossroad quest), then you can't obtain knowledge for playing the second storyline (crossroad quest). However, you can play it again with another character to obtain Knowledge of the second storyline as well so feel free to explore both quest lines!


Adventurers who finished previous Mediah main quests can accept and progress with renewed Mediah main quests.

Adventurers who have not finished previous Mediah main quests can accept and progress with the renewed Mediah main quests only. The previous Mediah main quests will be unavailable.

Adventurers who were in progress of the previous Mediah main quests up until May 29 maintenance can finish the previous quests as well before moving to try the new Mediah main quests. (You do not need to complete the previous quests in order to accept and progress with the new Mediah main quests)

※ Renewed Mediah main quests can be accepted from Herman Feresio of Kalis Parliament.


New Black Spirit quests have been added to help with the progress of the renewed Mediah main quests.  The quests can be accepted from the Black Spirit while you are progressing through the renewed Mediah main quests and these quests will require your character to reach a certain AP and DP in order for completion.

Journey into a Bigger World #1
Journey into a Bigger World #2
Journey into a Bigger World #3
Journey into a Bigger World #4



New sub-quests that narrate the three legendary blacksmiths of Mediah Mevo Muranan, Barattan Lancer, and Dorin Morgrim have been added. You can accept the sub-quests with a character of Lv.52 and above from Tulem the blacksmith of Altinova.

Please make sure you have already completed the Mediah main quests in order to accept these sub-quests.
Dorin Morgrim, one of the legendary blacksmiths, has surfaced from his long hiding in the Helm underground cavern.

The Three Legendary Blacksmiths
The Master of the Forge
Barattan Lancer
The Reclusive Blacksmith
Greeting the Gloomy Helms
Dorin Morgrim
An Advice from Dorin
A Nostalgic Weapon
The Prideful Blacksmiths
Everything Gets Better with Beer!
The Blacksmiths at the Arena
Mevo Muranan
Altinova, the Land of Blacksmiths




Game World, NPC & Effects

Node Manager NPC at Marlen Island has been fixed to act more naturally.

All exchangeable items will now be properly displayed in the exchangeable item list when talking with Stonetail Horse Club NPC Shamhain. 

The list of items sold by Arms Dealer NPC Olinto in Trent has been changed.

When you steal from NPC Dichzy Borne, the NPC's mustache will no longer disappear.

Fixed the graphical issue where Waltz of the Helms appeared as a goblin, and the conversation in the quest [Repeat] Waltz's Secret Mission has been changed to fit Waltz’s appearance.

You can now check the appearance of the horse at the Stable in advance when you interact (R) with the Stable Keeper of Drieghan.

Now you can Repair your horse gear and ship items from Stable Keepers and Wharf Managers.

Fixed the graphical issue where a question icon would be displayed for NPC Leo Laurie in the minimap.

Fixed the issue where GM NPCs would appear in Trent.

The Gavinya Great Crater Dwarves and Kamasylvia came to an agreement to start building a wharf for Sky Balloons under the sacred tree Kamasylve.

Fixed the issue where the screen flickered when at Sycraia Abyssal Zone in Remastered Mode or Ultra Mode.

Feather dropping effects have been added to the feathers of the Kibelius Divinus Armor when equipped.


Mounts

Fixed the issue where Heilang and campsites were being killed/destroyed at Battle Arena, Red Battlefield, Aakman Temple, and Hystria Ruins, Sycraia Underwater Ruins.

Mounts that are in areas that should be inaccessible to them (e.g. Battle Arena, Red Battlefield, Aakman Temple, Hystria Ruins, Sycraia Underwater Ruins) will now be killed/destroyed.

Fixed the graphical issue with the walls of ship that occurred when standing on the walls.


Class Changes

By Class

Warrior

Fixed the issue where a system message appeared and the character's movement stopped when a character that had already learned the skill Absolute: Kick used Charging Thrust as a final blow to kill a target.

When the skill Head Chase is locked, and the W key is held while the Shift+Space keys are entered in the Awakening Weapon mode, the character will now jump before performing Burning Moxie.

Fixed the graphical issue with the neck that occurred when wearing a Shadow Chaser Hood.


Ranger

Fixed the issue where the skill description about the number of hits for the skill Absolute: Tearing Arrow did not reflect the actual stats.


Fixed the issue where the arrow that is fired at the end of the skills Absolute: Tearing Arrow and Ultimate: Tearing Arrow for x0, x1 Charge Hit and x2, x3 Charge Hit was only applied for 1 hit.


Berserker

When the Shift+Space keys are entered while pressing the W key in Main Weapon mode, the character will now perform Lava Piercer before jumping.


Tamer

When the Shift+Space keys are entered while pressing the W key in the Main Weapon mode or the Awakening Weapon mode, the character will now perform Legendary Beast’s Power before jumping.


Witch

Fixed the issue where the Witch would not be wearing a hat in Customizing mode (F4) when the Witch is first selected, then another class, then Witch again.


Maehwa

Fixed the issue where the Rosa De Sharon Headpiece couldn't be dyed when a certain hair type was applied.


Ninja

When the Shift+Space keys are entered while pressing the W key in the Main Weapon mode or the Awakening Weapon mode, the character will now jump before performing Brace.


Kunoichi

When the Shift+Space keys are entered while pressing the W key in the Main Weapon mode or the Awakening Weapon mode, the character will now jump before performing Brace.


Item Changes

Special Offer

Check your Loyalties tab now and find these offers available for 1 Loyalty only:

Combat & Skill EXP 530% Scroll (60 min)

A gift from the producer of Black Desert Online!
The buff from this item will stack with any other EXP buffs.
You can combine 3 Combat & Skill EXP 530% Scroll (60 min) using Simple Alchemy to create 1 Combat & Skill EXP 530% Scroll (180 min). You can also perform Simple Alchemy to divide up the 180-min. scroll to make 3 60-min. scrolls.
Max 53 purchases per family.
Available from May 30 (00:00 UTC).



[Event] Sealed Book of Combat (7 Days)

Gives additional Combat EXP and Skill EXP buff.
Max 1 purchase per family.



[Event] Item Collection Increase Scroll (60 min)

It not only increases the drop rate of ordinary items, but that of rare items as well
Max 1 purchase per family per day until June 5th maintenance.




You can now get Shiny Golden Seal - [Work Supervisor] when you use workers to lumber at the Shady Tree Forest node.

The item description of certain Guild items have been updated in terms of information about who can use the item, and if the item will be erased if you leave a Guild.

Fixed the text issue where the set effect that gives a percentage of swimming speed increase did not match the actual amount of increase from the set effect as written in the item tooltip for the following items.

Splat Fisher's Clothes Set
Da-Dum Da-Dum Diving Suit Set
El Pento Set
Coco Set.



Fixed the issue where certain effects did not appear when aiming with an [Event] Bobble Bobble Matchlock.

Improved the effects that appear when squatting and aiming with an [Event] Bobble Bobble Matchlock or [Event] Frosted Matchlock.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Quests & Knowledge

Quest

New quests for Hunting has been added to areas of Epheria.

Return, the Next Legend, and Prelude to Hunting
Sweet Rest
Strange Rumor
Between Chance or Fate
Bloodthirsty Instinct
Let's Begin the Hunt
[Time Attack] Quick and Accurate
Wolf Track 
Breathtaking Chase
Do or Die
A Spectacular Finale
The Only Family
Cure for the Incurable
A Happy Ending


※Players who have completed the quest ‘Return, the Next Legend, and Prelude to Hunting’ can move onto accept the following quest ‘Sweet Rest’ from Igor Bartali of Velia.


Fixed the issue where Interaction (R) with Neutt's Sand Castle of Iliya Island was not possible.

The quest series Preparing for the Festival, from which you can get a Garnier Guitar, can now be completed once per character.

You can now accept the quest I Miss You, My Dear on characters who did the renewed main quests, as long as the character is at least Lv. 58 and Cooking Skilled 6, and completed the quest [Boss] The Final Battle of the quest series [Crossroad] The Lamenting Head of the League of Merchants.

You can now get the title Hope of Peasants after completing the quest The Scale of Justice.

Fixed the issue where navigation in the quest The Curious Shai was awkward.

A new button has been added to the starting NPC Viyarani of the quest Enervated Black Dragon which will lead you to the destination that will help you get the item Symbol-Engraved Black Bead again if you lose it.

Fixed the issue where Morco of the Crow Merchants Guild would lead you to a different location when guiding you to Patrigio.

Fixed the issue where an NPC unrelated to the quest appeared while progressing through the quest The Origin of the Rumors.

Fixed the issue where Crio’s name and quest icon did not appear while progressing through the quest [Returning] Crio's Welcome.

Navigation has been improved so that it will lead you to a faster route for the quest [Returning] Crio's Welcome.


Knowledge

You can now search for the knowledge entry Cultist Assassin in the Knowledge window once you have acquired that knowledge.

You can now learn the knowledge Cultist Assassin when completing the quest [Boss] Muskan of Madness.

If your character has already completed [Boss] Muskan of Madness, the character can talk to NPC Annalynn to get the knowledge.



Knowledge Hint for Information of Ramlo the Crow Merchant will now display correct information.

Characters that are Lv. 15 or up can now get the knowledge Captured Ogre from NPC Armstrong of Western Guard Camp.


Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where the highlighting UI came out for mounts that were not selected when scrolling after having selected a mount in the Stable menu. The highlighting UI will now come out for mounts that are actually selected.

As Black Spirit’s Safe has been introduced, the text under Combat Fame, Life Fame, and Special Fame has been changed:

Before: You can collect the silver from your mailbox (B).
After: You can collect the silver from the Black Spirit's Safe.



The following text has been added to item tooltips make clear the repairability of the items:

Repairable Gear
Unrepairable Gear



Fixed the issue where the Inventory (I) window size would occasionally be abnormal when opening it.

Fixed the issue where pressing ESC or F4 would close the Beauty window entirely when the window for purchasing Appearance Change Coupons is displayed.

Changed the description in the item tooltip where it says a certain Sailing level is required to use the item to make it clear.

The guide text that tells you how to place HP Potion into the Hotkey will no longer bleed out of the text UI.

The default color of the Family Buff icon has changed to yellow.

Fixed the issue where region name would not change in the minimap when moving in Observe Mode after being on a Mount (i.e. Sailboat).

Fixed the blinking issue on the portrait image of the character in End Game window when using the mouse wheel.

The loading screen text that comes out when reconnecting  or disconnecting from the game has been relocated to the top-right corner of the screen.

Completion requirement and progress will no longer be displayed on the new Adventure Journal notification.

When using the Find NPC function, instead of only being able to click on the icons, you can now also click on the text next to the icons.

Fixed the issue with text bleeding out in the Knowledge (H) window when a knowledge entry name was too long.

Fixed the issue with the scroll function of the Pearl Shop's Cart window.

Fixed the issue where the text indicating the amount of Kakao Cash overlapped with icons in the Pearl Shop window, if the amount was large.

Fixed the issue where the wrong amount, different to the amount that was inputted, was entered if a number and the confirm option were entered simultaneously e.g. when entering the amount of Silver to be deposited into a Storage.

The "Weapon" icon in the Find NPC window has been renamed to "Weapon/Armor."

Selecting it will direct you to the nearest Arms Dealer or Armor Vendor.



A loading screen will now appear after you click on the Resurrect button after dying in the Red Battlefield.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the graphical issue where the NPC Center of the Ruins was not being properly displayed while progressing through the quest The God of the Protties.

Fixed the issue where Farming actions became slower at high Farming levels.

Fixed the issue where certain monsters didn't disappear after being defeated if another adventurer defeated the monster.


Known Issues

Updated 30/05

We are aware of an issue where a minus stat. appears for Black Spirit’s Rage gauge or that the gauge stat. does not increase. You can resolve this by restarting your game client for now.

[strike]We are aware of the issue where +15 day Value Pack bonus is not being applied to Returning adventurers who have returned after May 29th 12:00 UTC/ 14:00 CEST. This issue is under review and we will resolve it right away. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/strike] *Please restart your client to resolve this issue and obtain your Value Pack bonus.


Updated 31/05

We were aware of an issue where If you had created a Family but not a character before May 30 maintenance, you could not connect to the game. We have resolved this issue so please restart your client to proceed with your gameplay. We apologize for the inconvenience.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.
