notes.title: Patch Notes - May 22nd 2019
notes.content:
https://imgur.com/WOyDiru.gif

Greetings Adventurers, 

The human world is a mess, life under the sea is better than anything they got up there, that is why adventurers should visit the new Underwater Ruins available to explorers from today! Along with this, a new watery event will start that will allow players to complete special quests in this new zone for exquisite rewards!

And for those Rulupee fans out there, new Rulupee quests have been added to the game. Complete as many quests as possible to get special rewards!

Enjoy the new expansion and remember that under the sea we got no troubles, life is bubbles!


Event & System

New Events

Call of the Ocean event will start.

Event Period: May 22 after maintenance - June 19 before maintenance.
Accept and complete special quests, and collect and exchange items from the underwater ruins for exquisite rewards!
Click  to take a closer and deeper look into the event.



Special Attendance Rewards will be offered.

Event Period: May 23 00:00 UTC - June 12 23:59 UTC
Log-in every day and claim special attendance rewards!
https://i.imgur.com/eyIhNGN.jpg



Special Challenges (Y) will be offered.

Event Period: May 23 00:00 UTC - June 5 23:59 UTC
https://i.imgur.com/Oocp4Um.jpg


※ You can get up to [Event] Extra Combat EXP Scroll x14, [Event] Extra Life EXP Scroll x14, and [Event] Shakatu's Seal x14 if you claim all possible rewards during the 2-week event period.

Ongoing Events

Starry Night: May 15 after maintenance - May 29 before maintenance.

Hands of Gold Returns: May 8 after maintenance - June 5 before maintenance.

2019 Spring Video Contest: 

Staff Pick: May 20 - 22.
Community Vote: May 22 - 29.
Winner Announcement: May 30.



Reward Distribution

Rewards have been sent to the Winners of the Community Event: Create your own Easter Egg. Please check your in-game mailbox (B) to claim your reward.


Content:

Underwater Ruins have been added.

There will be 3 new areas to explore: Protty Cave, Sycraia Upper Zone, and Sycraia Abyssal Zone which you need to sail out and dive underwater to reach.
Featuring brand new enemy types and powerful items for you to acquire, the Underwater Ruins also adds a new summonable boss named Sycrid.
Please find the details on the Underwater Ruins via the official Wiki below (Only available in English):

Protty Cave
Sycraia Upper Zone
Sycraia Abyssal Zone




A new Rulupee's Travel Log entry has been added. It is about her travels underwater.

You can read all about brave Rulupee's travels in ESC Menu > Adventure Log > Rulupee's Travel Log.
Every time a quest is completed (except for Daily and Recurring Quests), it will count towards the goal of completing a certain number of quests. The goal for this new entry of Rulupee's Travel Log is completing 19,235 quests.
Once you complete the goal, you will not only get the reward mentioned on the travel log, but also one from the Black Spirit.



Game World, NPC & Effects

NPC

NPC Zawoon at Zagam Island has been fixed to act more naturally.

Following NPC name has been changed as below. 

Imperial Trade -> Imperial Guild Trade 



Mounts

The speed at which a wagon moves when its Power/Lifespan has been completely consumed has been increased by 200%.

Fixed an issue where the "Communicate" button would not be displayed on certain Tier 1-8 horses.

After May 29 regular maintenance, any Mount that are placed in restricted areas that cannot be accessed in a normal route (Battle Arena, Red Battlefield, Aakman Temple, Sycraia Underwater Ruins) will be forcefully killed or destroyed. 

Please remove your mounts that are placed in these restricted areas before May 29 maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience.



Class Changes

All Classes

Optimized the visual and sound effects of other Adventurers.
The effects of other Adventurers will not be as intense as before. (Lighter)

Fixed an issue where the character would move awkwardly when trying to swim by pressing RMB while underwater.

Fixed an issue where players in the tutorial phase who were Lv. 5 or below were not visible to other players.


By Class

Ranger

Fixed an issue where the quiver would not be displayed in a combat stance when equipped with the [Ranger] Stella Longbow.


Witch

Added information in the skill description for "Protected Area" about the number of allies affected by the skill.


Wizard

Added information in the skill description for "Protected Area" about the number of allies affected by the skill.


Maehwa

Fixed an issue where the twister effect would not be displayed when using the Absolute: Nemesis Slash skill.


Darkn Knight

Fixed an issue where the character's facial expression was unnatural when using the social actions below.

Narcissist
Flirt
Fighting Spirit
Confident



Item Changes

Enhanced the ways metallic items look for certain cash shop items.

The stats for certain Dim Magical Sub-weapons and Concentrated Magical Sub-weapons (Dagger, Trinket, Talisman) have been changed to be the same for all classes.

The name of Elion's Tear which is purchasable with loyalties has been changed to ‘[Loyalty] Elion's Tear’.

You can now obtain the "Trace of Wave" items from the following Elite monsters at Pirate Island.

Cox Pirates
Cox Elite Warrior
Deck Elite Combatant
Cox Elite Gladiator
Elite Sentinel



Fixed an issue where an exploration node from which you cannot obtain the Dried Dolphinfish was displayed in the Crafting Notes (F2) for Dried Dolphinfish.

Fixed an issue where there was incorrect information about certain Exchange NPC's in the item descriptions for the Horse Race Seal item.

Fixed an issue where the outlines of items at the Pearl Shop (F3) would look unnatural when viewing their previews.

Added descriptions of certain Life Clothes explaining that they can be exchanged by the Equipment Tailoring Coupon.

Fixed an issue where the descriptions for the Lahr Arcien Classic Set would say that certain classes could obtain the items when they actually could not.

The names for the Crimson Knight Outfit Set have been changed.

Crimson Knight A: Crimson Shadow Knight
Crimson Knight B: Crimson Knight



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Following monster's name has been changed. 

Before: Rhutum Chief Priest 
After: Rhutum Chief Shaman



Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Enhanced the legibility of the quest list's order and titles displayed on the Recommended tab within the Quest window (O).

When going through the quests below, these quests will now properly reflect changes made to the Hotkeys.

The quest summary for the "Do as Ordered".
The quest summary for the "Gathering Sunrise Herb".
The quest completion conditions for the "Lovers' Secret".
The quest completion conditions for the "What Are They Talking About?".
The quest summary and completion conditions for the "Late King's Desire for Eternity".



Fixed an issue where the Dim Magical Ra'ghon was displayed as a Noble Sword in dialogues.


Knowledge

The hint for obtaining the "Caphras' Seal" knowledge has been revised to show accurate information.


Interface Changes

When you change the hair or face type in the customization window (F4), there will now be a warning message which warns that your hair or face type will reset.

You can now control the scroll button in the chat window even when the chat options window is open.

Fixed the issue where the mount information's weight was incorrect when searching for ships at the Wharf.

Fixed the issue where the Quest Summary text would overlap in the situations below:

When you bring the mouse cursor on top of the quest icon in the World Map.
When you bring the mouse cursor over the Complete Quest area in the minimap.



The information you save for Combat Focus Mode will now be displayed properly when loading the information.
 
Fixed the issue where the creator name for items would be incorrectly displayed (or disappear) when equipping PEN items.
 
When you enter an outfit and then remove it from the Outfit Extraction feature, the slot from where you removed the item from will no longer display the item information.
 
When you are successful in a Fishing minigame, the minigame UI will now disappear.
 
Fixed the issue where the Node Management button would not be displayed when you select the Trade button on a Trade NPC while nodes are not connected.
 
The "Sell All" button which appears when a bargain is successful in the Bargain window for Trading has been changed to the Remastered design.
 
The button for calling boat mounts will no longer be displayed in the guild mount list.
 
Fixed the issue where the list button on the bottom of the Item Drop Information window would look unnatural.
 
The mount UI will now refresh on the Guild Wharf.
 
The tooltip which shows the time remaining for cash item buffs have been revised to be consistent, and added buff descriptions to the Appearance Change Coupon.
 
Fixed the issue where pressing the "ESC" or "F4" key while the Save File/Load File window was activated (for customizations) would close the customization window.
 
When extracting Reform Stones, you can no longer select within your inventory the equipment which have been enhanced with Caphras Stones.
 
The Reward Log will be displayed by default within the Black Spirit's Safe.
 
When you go on another adventurer's Ship, there was an issue where the UI for the ship would not disappear even when the Ship is not in view. This issue has been fixed.
 
Fixed the issue where a notification would appear on the garden icon on the top left of the screen even when only a Scarecrow was installed on the garden.
 
Fixed an issue where certain video clips and situations (or UI) occasionally did not close normally (Lv. 1 introduction clip, Beauty Album, Black Spirit's Adventure, skill video clips).

Renamed the main "Outfit" tab of the Pearl shop to "Apparel." Under Apparel, you can access the Outfit, Costume, Underwear, and Accessory categories. Because of this, some items have been renamed as follows.

Renamed the item Patrigio's Costume Bag to Patrigio's Apparel Bag.
Renamed "Outfit" DC Couposns to "Apparel" DC coupons (e.g. Outfit 20% DC Coupon has been renamed to Apparel 20% DC Coupon).



Central Market

Announcement on Weapon Exchange Coupons
 
The items with identical grade and name which can be exchanged using the Weapon Exchange Coupon will now have identical prices, by averaging out the price difference between the most and least expensive items in current Central Market.
 
During the maintenance of May 8th, we implemented purchase limit on the Weapon Exchange Coupon to once per Family. This was implemented as a countermeasure against those who attempt to make great profit quickly by taking advantage of the liquidity of the Central Market with the Weapon Exchange Coupon.
 
As a result, this type of market manipulation has harmed the way the market is meant to be used. First of all, we would like to sincerely apologize for not foreseeing the negative effects of lifting the Weapon Exchange Coupon purchase limitations.
 
Also, in addition to allowing all adventurers to freely use the Weapon Exchange Coupon like before, we are planning on implementing the below actions to fundamentally prevent the abuse of the Weapon Exchange Coupon.
 
The prices of the items which are exchangeable with the Weapon Exchange Coupon will be priced at the same level. The unified prices will be based on the average of the current items of the identical grade and name at the Central Market. The one time per Family purchase limit on the Weapon Exchange Coupon will be removed.
 
We will be more careful going forward, and will try our best to prevent these types of issues. Thank You.


The one time per Family purchase restrictions for the Weapon Exchange Coupon will be removed after the maintenance on May 22nd.

The set prices for the Main/Sub/Awakening weapons at the Central Market will now be adjusted together.

Ex) The set prices for the equipment with the same type such as Azwell Longsword, Staff, and Kriegsmesser will be adjusted together.
Ex) The set prices for the equipment of the same grades will be adjusted together (Kite Shield, Parrying Dagger, etc.)



You can now register green grade items of certain enhancement levels at the Central Market, after you obtain them while defeating monsters in a party.

The quantity displayed on the top right of the Sell window's "Sell" button, and on the top right of the Status window's "Items Listed" button at the Central Market will now display the proper amount.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where the character would fall in certain areas of the Manshaum Forest.

Fixed the issue where characters were unable to go up a ladder at the roads of the Eastern Border.

Fixed an issue where the sound volume would change to 0 when you exited a dungeon in the “The Ritual” quest (Calpheon main quest) while a cut scene was playing.


Known Issues

We are aware of the graphical issue where the NPC Center of the Ruins is not being properly displayed while progressing through the quest The God of the Protties. We apologize for the inconvenience. This issue will be resolved next maintenance.

We are aware of the graphical issue where the motion of receiving damage from the skill Dragon's Rip of Mystic while the character is jumping appears abnormal. This will be resolved soon.

We are aware of the issue where you can not check the Level and Special skill of a Fairy or Pet taken out after reconnecting to game client.

This can be resolved by checking in and taking out your Pet or unsummoning and summoning Fairy again for the time being.




Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - May 15th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/5FjUKhj.gif

Greetings Adventurers, 

Get amazing rewards from the new poacher who will give you Kamasylvia Treasure Chests to break! Also, don’t forget to collect Moon and Star Shards during the Starry Night event and stack up on your Silver!

Please read on below for the rest of changes and revisions in this week's patch notes! 


Event & System

New Event:

Starry Night

Event Period: May 15 after maintenance - May 29 before maintenance
During the event period, defeat monsters, fish, and gather to obtain [Event] Moon Shard and [Event] Star Shard which can be sold at a high price! You can also combine them to create [Event] Luminous Token worth 300,000 Silver!
Click  to find out more about this starry event.



Ongoing Events

Hands of Gold Returns: May 8 after maintenance - June 5 before maintenance.

Community Event: Create your own Easter Egg: May 3rd to May 17th (voting period).

Winners Announced: Friday, May 17th via official Forums!



2019 Spring Video Contest: 

Submission Period: April 24 – May 20.
Staff Pick: May 20 - 22.
Community Vote: May 22 - 29.
Winner Announcement: May 30.



Ended Events

Equestrians, Assemble!


Content:

A poacher that can be defeated to obtain a treasure chest will now appear in the following regions in Kamasylvia: Polly's Forest, Loopy Tree Forest, Navarn Steppe, Manshaum Forest, Mirumok Ruins, Tooth Fairy Forest, Gyfin Rhasia Temple.

Treasure chests will disappear if it is not attacked for two minutes.
The following message will appear when the poacher appears with the treasure chest:

The nearby poacher seems to be moving a suspicious looking box.



Defeat the poacher and destroy the treasure chest to get Silver and one of the following items. 

Sturdy Alchemy Stone of Life, Kamasylve Fruit of Harmony, Narc Ear Accessory, Valtarra Eclipsed Belt, Gyfin Rhasia Sculpture of Earth, Krogdalo's Origin Stone, Forest Fury, Forest Ronaros Ring, Lemoria Helmet, Lemoria Armor, Lemoria Gloves, Lemoria Shoes, Krogdalo's Tear, Pure Forest Breath, Manshaum Voodoo Doll, Valtarra Relic Fragment



Some of the items you can get from the treasure chest can be exchanged for Peridot Fruit or Peridot Tree.

Valtarra Relic Fragment: Peridot Fruit x1
Krogdalo's Tear: Peridot Fruit x10
Gyfin Rhasia Sculpture of Earth: Peridot Tree x1
Kamasylve Fruit of Harmony: Peridot Tree x10



Peridot Fruit can be sold for 100,000 Silver to NPC vendors. Peridot Tree can be sold for 10,000,000 Silver. 
Sometimes the poacher’s treasure chest will be possessed by the Black Spirit. It will start moving and may attack you with a ferocious attack.

The chest contains the same items as the chest not possessed by the Black Spirit. However, looting the chest possessed by the Black Spirit will give you a higher chance of getting one of the more valuable items.




System:

Items which do not change in prices due to not meeting the conditions to fluctuate prices will now slowly change prices.

You can now access the Web Central Market with the Chrome browser.

Unnecessary logs will no longer be collected to the Black Desert log files when you run the game.


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

The trees near the Longleaf Tree Forest in the world map (M) will now appear properly.

Fixed an issue where you could get stuck at a certain spot at the Abandoned Monastery.


Mounts

The amount of Stamina consumed when using the Forest Path Wagon's Forest Rush skill has been decreased by 50%, so you can now continuously use it for double the time compared to before.

When using the Forest Rush skill while auto-moving, the condition for switching to manual moving has been changed to when you have less than 5% Stamina remaining (used to be 25% or less).



Class Changes

All Classes

Fixed the issue where falling off of a ship while repairing the ship would continue to display a hammer in the character's hand.


By Class

Warrior

The hitting motions for the Absolute: Shield Strike skill will be displayed properly to match the timing of actually hitting the target.

Fixed the issue where the spark effects for the Absolute: Forward Slash skill would not be displayed when Graphics settings were lower than "Slightly High" settings.


Archer

The Black Spirit: Luthraghon's Call I, II, and IV skills will not cast when each skill is locked.


Item Changes

When the prices for Pearl Set items change at the Central Market, the prices of the individual items in those packages/sets will now also change.

The weight of certain items (obtainable from sea monsters) have been changed to the following:
https://i.imgur.com/ys61qoI.jpg

The following items will no longer have descriptions related to exchanges:

Parasitic Bee Larva
Beetle Shell
Sturdy Fang
Broken Longsword Fragment
Bandit's Bandana
Cracked Horn
Red Orc Fang
Cursed Fang
Stoneback Crab Rock Armor
Cobweb
Kuku Bird Feather
Thin Bee Wings
Pumpkin Vine
Altar Imp's Trumpet
Old Hood
Rusty Longsword
Rusty Helmet
Fogan Webfoot
Thick Reptile Hide
Naga Webfoot
Sturdy Shoes
Shoddy Pickaxe
Lustrous Feather
Rock Pickaxe
Withered Leaf
Cracked Fang
Imp's Torn Ornament
Broken Goblin Amulet
Rusty Scythe Shard
Withered Plant Stem
Old Longsword
Brand Token
Broken Rhutum Fang
Black Hood
Tough Boar Meat
Tough Red Boar Meat
Metal Armor Fragment
Giant Shell
Ruins Rock Fragment
Contaminated Tooth
Thick Hide
Cursed Crystal
Troll Hide
Huge Spear
Crude Waragon Hide
Hard Rock Fragment
Thin Wings
Corrupt Crystal
Shimmering Green Liquid
Catfishman Scale
Sharp Bone Fragment
Hard Tree Bark



You can now search Wagon Registration: Forest Path Wagon from the Crafting Notes.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

You can no longer acquire EXP when the Stone Waragon and Stone Mutant Waragon from the Colossal Stone Waragon despawns.

The Ancient Kutum and Nouver world bosses will now go berserk when 8 minutes have passed after they have initially spawned.

The two bosses will have greatly increased AP when they go berserk, and their attacking patterns will change. However, their DP will greatly decrease.

Fixed the issue where the following Sherekhan Necropolis (Day) monsters would have awkward stances when they appear.

Garud
Lateh
Belcadas
Nybrica
Federik



Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Fixed the issue where the dialogue for accepting the [Boss] Fogan Prince Titium quest was unnatural.

A hint about obtaining a key has been added to the quest dialogue for the Memories of Eliza quest.

Revised the location of the guide for the Elionian Doctrines quest.

The Recurring Quests which were available separately for different characters can now be shared with all characters within a Family.

If you were in the process of going through a quest which has been changed, then all characters within the Family will now be able to share the quest.



Fixed the issue where you could not go through the Torenandu's Declaration of War 


Interface Changes

The size of the event window has been enlarged.

Fixed the issue in the minimap where the locations for the Durability Reduction and Arsha server Red Battlefield entry icons would be abnormal when switching from 2D to 3D view while in full screen mode.

Fixed the issue where there would be UI overlapping issues for products which have selectable options for selecting different items.

Added the description below which appears when you try to recover a worker's Stamina beyond its full capacity:

The Worker's stamina is already at max.



Demolition Axe and Matchlock items will no longer be displayed for the "You got better gear!" notification.

Fixed the issue where the Red Battlefield entry icon and Durability Reduction UI overlapped next to the minimap for the Arsha server.

When you select the Adventure Journal completion notification which is displayed on the left side of the screen, the relevant Adventure Journal will now open up.

Fixed the issue where the Gamma/Contrast settings would revert back to the previous settings when you reconnect after adjusting the settings.

Fixed the issue where entering a backspace into the chat window while searching for items at the Central Market would move you back to the previous window.

Certain equipment will no longer be deselected from the Enhancement window when reaching the maximum Enhancement level.

When using the auto-align Quick Slot, fixed the issue where you were unable to use the F10 key while near mounts or NPC's which you can interact with.

The Red Battlefield entry icon's location will now be properly displayed in the 3D minimap mode.

Enemy HP bars will no longer shine when their HP has not decreased.

When selecting the Item Count option in the Inventory (I) window, the location for where the number of items appear will now be properly placed.

Improved the alignment for the Pearl Shop (F3) scrollbar.

Fixed the issue where the bullet UI would disappear when changing to cropping mode or resetting Edit UI menu while equipped with a Matchlock item.

Fixed the issue where the remaining time for quests would not be displayed properly when setting the Recently Updated Quest to "Do Not Show" in the Quest Widget settings.

Fixed the issue where the Quest Widget location would be out of place after making changes in the Quest Widget settings.

Reduced how much the Monster Zone monster images would move when using the mouse wheel in the World Map to expand/downscale the map view.

Fixed the issue where a previously selected Appearance Change Coupon would be selected by default in the Apply Customization window when you closed and reopened the Apply Customization window.

A BDO Wiki button will now be displayed in the Start Game screen when you press Settings.

A completion notification for the Garden icon on the top left of the screen will now appear even when one crop has been completed.

Fixed the issue where the amount of silver or items would not be properly displayed after an item was bought or sold at the Central Market.

You can no longer talk to NPC's while a confirmation window/message is opened up on the screen.

The sound effect for removing/extracting crystals in the Extract Crystal window (Black Spirit's Transfusion window or through NPC's) has been improved.

Sound effects will play when you add or remove a crystal to the equipment.
Additional sound effects have been added for placing equipment in the Transfusion or Extract Crystal windows, and for returning the equipment back to the Inventory.



When you press the ESC key in the character selection window and customization window (F4), you will now cancel the character entry animation.

When you press the ESC key after the character entry animation has played, you will move to the previous screen.



When using a Value Pack, the Value Pack icon description will now be properly displayed at the bottom left of the Central Market.

Fixed the issue where the number of materials (260 materials) used in Courser Training was being abnormally displayed upon use.


Resolved Issues

Fixed an issue where certain pets would disappear.


Known Issue

Updated 16/05/2019

We are aware of the issue where certain monsters in waves of Savage Rift, and certain boss monsters summoned from boss scrolls don't disappear right after being defeated if you had not directly damaged the monsters.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - May 8th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/5FjUKhj.gif

Greetings Adventurers, 

Marni is great! And so are his inventions! Rumor has it that new Marni's Stones have been dropping from monsters around Valencia, Kamasylvia and Drieghan. These new Marni's Stone will grant special accessories when completed and will always grant a new Marni's Stone, so there is no excuse now to help Marni with his craziness!
 
On the other hand, Hands of Gold event is returning for one more year. Collect special coins and exchange them for items that will make even Midas jealous!
 
You can also read the rest of changes and fixes in this week's patch notes! Have fun!


Event & System

New Events

Hands of Gold Returns event will begin.

Event Period: May 8 (after maintenance) -  June 5 (before maintenance)
During the event period, collect [Event] Golden Troupe Coin and exchange for precious items including [Event] Shakatu's Luxury Box!
Click [ to learn more about this golden event!



Golden rewards will be offered for the Loyal Attendance Rewards.

Event Period: May 9 00:00 UTC - June 12 23:59 UTC
This time, claim Gold Bars (from 1G to 100G) as attendance rewards during the event period.



Roses will bloom in the world of Black Desert.

Event Period: May 8 after maintenance - June 5 before maintenance



Ongoing Evnets

2019 Spring Video Contest: April 24th – May 20th.

If you missed Mystical Ellie’s Water Festival and Tulips, there will be roses freshly blooming in the world of Black Desert now!



Equestrians, Assemble!: April 30 (after maintenance) – May 15 (before maintenance).

Community Event: Create your own Easter Egg: May 3rd to May 17th (voting period).


Ended Events

Mystical Ellie’s Water Festival


Content

A new item, Marni's Research Box, has been added.

You can get this item by defeating monsters in Valencia, Kamasylvia, or Drieghan at a low rate.
There is a higher chance of getting the box when defeating a "Gatekeeper" monster in Valencia, or a Kvariak in Drieghan.
When you open the box, you will get a Great Marni's Stone. 



A new type of Marni’s Stone, Great Marni’s Stone, has been added. 

Defeat monsters corresponding to the type of Great Marni's Stone you have to fill it up. Once the stone is full, you can hand it over to Wacky Toshi and get a Marni's Supply Box. You will also get the same type of Great Marni's Stone back but it will have been reset.

Great Marni's Stone (Bashim)
Great Marni's Stone (Cadry)
Great Marni's Stone (Desert Naga)
Great Marni's Stone (Desert Fogans)
Great Marni's Stone (Gahaz Bandits)
Great Marni's Stone (Crescent Shrine)
Great Marni's Stone (Basilisk)

Great Marni's Stone (Forest Ronaros)
Great Marni's Stone (Tshira Ruins)
Great Marni's Stone (Kagtum)
Great Marni's Stone (Sherekhan - Day)




A new item, Marni's Supply Box, has been added. When you open the box, you will randomly get one of the following items.

Tungrad Belt
Tungrad Earring
Ogre Ring
Laytenn’s Power Stone
Eye of the Ruins Ring
Valtarra Eclipsed Belt
Orkinrad's Belt
Basilisk's Belt
Narc Ear Accessory
Ring of Crescent Guardian



A new knowledge category "Marni's Great Discovery" has been added, and new knowledge entries have been added for it. You will gain knowledge every time you get a new type of Great Marni's Stone.

Great Marni's Stone (Bashim)
Great Marni's Stone (Cadry)
Great Marni's Stone (Desert Naga)
Great Marni's Stone (Desert Fogan)
Great Marni's Stone (Gahaz Bandits)

Great Marni's Stone (Fadus)
Great Marni's Stone (Polly's Forest)
Great Marni's Stone (Forest Ronaros)
Great Marni's Stone (Tshira Ruins)
Great Marni's Stone (Kagtum)
Great Marni's Stone (Sherekhan - Day) 



The following titles have been added. You will gain a title every time you get a new type of Great Marni's Stone.

Bashim Soul Harvester
Desert Fogan Soul Harvester
Desert Naga Soul Harvester
Gahaz Bandits Soul Harvester
Cadry Soul Harvester

Centaurus Soul Harvester
Basilisk Soul Harvester

Polly's Forest Soul Harvester
Fadus Soul Harvester
Manshaum Soul Harvester
Forest Ronaros Soul Harvester
Tshira Ruins Soul Harvester
Kagtum Soul Harvester
Sherekhan Soul Harvester



Here are the steps for a clearer view regarding Great Marni’s Stones:
[olist]
Get Marni’s Research Box by defeating and looting from monsters.
Open the Marni’s Research Box to obtain a Great Marni’s Stone.
Fill up the requirement of the Great Marni’s Stone (defeating certain number of certain monsters).
Take the filled-up Great Marni’s Stone to Wacky Toshi, exchange it for a Marni’s Supply Box. You will also get your Great Marni’s Stone reset.
Open the Marni’s Supply Box to obtain a random reward!
[/olist]


You can now exchange 10 Shiny Golden Seal - [Imperial Delivery] items with the [Guild] Special Iron Ingot (Calpheon Workshop) item.

Velia Imperial Delivery Manager Mathias
Heidel Imperial Delivery Manager Radolf Hansen
Calpheon Imperial Delivery Manager Lamiro Iadans
Altinova Imperial Delivery Manager Woodrey
Valencia Imperial Delivery Manager Damac



Life Skill Level has been expanded.

While there are adventurers who have reached the Guru level in certain Life Skills, there are also certain Life Skills where adventurers are remaining at a relatively lower level.
Last week, we adjusted the amount of EXP required for each Life Skill in order to adjust for the amount of effort put into each Life Skill.
Also, in order to provide a target goal for adventurers who have already reached the top level, we have expanded all Life Skill levels up to "Guru 50".
Due to the increase in Life Skill levels, you can now receive more benefits from the higher levels, and we will also continue to provide various updates to enhance the Life Skill content.



Some of the regions near Calpheon Shrine has been changed from Kamasylvian to Calpheonian territory.


System

The text which appears when you attempt to open up an item with a character of a gender which does not meet the gender condition of the item has been changed like the following:

Before: There is no item.
After: Class is restricted.



Fixed the issue where the camera rotation would occasionally be unnatural in windowed mode.


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

Fixed the issue where certain geographical features of the Valencia Waragon Nest would look unnatural.

Made improvements to the issue where it was difficult to get out of the Irrigation System at Valencia Castle and Mediah when an elephant dropped inside of it.

The seagulls will fly normally around the skies of Port Epheria.

Fixed the issue where certain geographical features would look abnormal in the World Map.

Fixed the issue where distant views of the game world would occasionally not be visible.

Mystical Ellie's Water Festival area's Pearl Mullets have all disappeared and have been replaced with the previous fish.


NPC:

New NPC voice overs have been applied to the regions below.

New: Drieghan
Changed: Mediah and initial parts of the main quests



The conditions for activating the Trade button for the Trade Manager NPC's have been removed.

You can now immediately check out the Trade system after a Family has been created.



Edited the dialog which appears when you encounter Edan again at the Ancient Stone Chamber to be more natural.

Fixed the issue where you could not search for Yianaros's Field Node Manager in the Find NPC feature.

Fixed the issue where the Yianaros's Field Node Manager NPC would be displayed as a question mark in the minimap.

The locations of certain NPC's at Sand Grain Bazaar will now appear more natural.

When you greet NPC Dichzy Borne, the NPC's mustache will no longer disappear.


Mounts

Fixed the text overlapping issue of the text for the DP and DP value in Mount Information UI.


Class Changes

All Classes

You can now auto-move while equipped with both the Matchlock and Trina Demolition Axe.

A common female voiceover has been added.

Added a 13th voice when selecting a voice for a new female character.



Fixed the issue where the character would occasionally scoop up water multiple times at once when attempting to continuously scoop water.

Fixed the issue where you were able to move abnormally when gathering Lakiaro while equipped with Matchlock and Sniper Rifle items.

Fixed the issue where the increased reload speed effect from consuming food would not be applied when reloading Matchlock while moving.

Fixed the issue where the 2nd and 3rd shooting effect when shooting continuously while equipped with the [Event] Matchlock would look unnatural.

Fixed the issue where you were occasionally unable to reload when you received a debuff effect attack while you were using the Matchlock or reloading it while moving or on a mount.

The Matchlock reloading motion will now look more natural.

Item looting effect will now be properly displayed in the spot where the looting happens upon defeating a monster.

Only items you can actually loot will be displayed.

After you enter the game, when you click on the mouse button while the character is facing the screen, you will now immediately see the character's backside.

Fixed the issue where the auto-navigate would guide you to the incorrect NPC for the Workshop Refining Technique quest.

The navigation route at Calpheon Workshop has been changed so that the characters will not run into obstacles.


By Class

Warrior

The effects for Charging Thrust have been improved.


Sorceress

Fixed the graphical issue with the chest when wearing Bern Armor.


Witch

Voltaic Pulse IV will now cast more quickly.


Musa

Fixed the issue where the Carver: Typhoon skill would not activate when acquiring the Absolute: Carver skill.


Maehwa

Fixed the graphical issue with the chest that occurred when wearing Le Vladian Underwear with Kibelius outfit or Kibelius Divinus outfit under certain character customization settings.

Added a description about the "pushes the target on hits" effect on the skill description for Backstab.

Divider III will no longer display abnormal motions when you press Q and E at the same time.


Dark Knight

Changed the Shadow Strike skill effects.

Fixed the issue where the Obsidian Ashes and Shadow Strike skill would not activate when used in areas where the ceiling was low.


Striker

Fixed the graphical issue with the neck that occurred when toggling on the Head Gear Setting while wearing Garnier Troupe Garb (Costume).


Lahn

When hitting a target with the Cymbidium skill, you can now properly combo to the Three Point Stipple skill by holding down LMB.

Additional visual effects to make the skills appear more dynamic have been added for the following skills:

Absolute: Pendulum Kick I
Absolute: Pendulum Kick II
Absolute: Salp'uri Purge
Absolute: Blooming Nether Flower
Absolute: Cymbidium



Archer

The knockdown effect for the Black Spirit: Full Bloom and Full Bloom skill will now only apply to PvE.

Additional visual effects to make the skills appear more dynamic have been added to the following Absolute skills.

Absolute: Meteor Dive
Absolute: Arrow Explosion
Absolute: Bolt of Radiance
Absolute: Storm of Light
Absolute: Earth Shatter



Certain effects for Deadly Explosion has been changed.


Item Changes

Fixed the issue where the Sub-weapon would look abnormal when equipping the [Combat] Trina Matchlock.

The number of tokens required for an exchange for the Hunter's Token has been changed, and additional items available for exchange have been added.
*Items that can be exchanged with Hunter's Tokens.

[Hunting] Beginner Matchlock: 4
[Hunting] Apprentice Matchlock: 5
[Hunting] Skilled Matchlock: 8
[Hunting] Professional Matchlock: 15
[Hunting] White Wolf Boss Subjugation Scroll: 45
[Hunting] King Brown Bear Boss Subjugation Scroll: 45
Spirit Pouch of Ferocious Beast: 25



The description related to summoning time for the Fat Catfishman Summon Scroll descriptions has been revised as follows:

The boss will disappear after 5 minutes of idleness or in 30 minutes after being summoned.



Fixed the issue where items which should not be displayed on the Volatile Price Items of the Central Market was being displayed.

Main Weapon Exchange Coupon, Sub-Weapon Exchange Coupon, and Awakening Weapon Exchange Coupon will now have a purchase limit of 1 per Family.

We wanted to make the process of re-rolling your class a bit easier, so we introduced the Main Weapon Exchange Coupon, Sub-Weapon Exchange Coupon, and Awakening Weapon Exchange Coupon. Unfortunately, it came to our attention that it was possible to abuse these in order to increase profit over the Central Market. As this was not the intention of the system, these coupons will now be restricted to a one-time purchase per Family. We will continue to monitor the Central Market and all other game mechanics to prevent unintended use of the systems.
The one per family limit will be applied from 8th May 2019, allowing all adventurers to make a purchase from this date.



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

The Phnyl and Feather Wolf monsters located at Kamasylvia will no longer abnormally chase the adventurers.


Quests & Knowledge

Fixed the issue where you could not complete the "Do You See That? Right There!" quest.


Quest

Fixed the issue where you could not re-accept the quest Excavation Site if you had forfeited it.

A condition for interacting with the Unstable Crevice has been added to the quest summary for the Laila's Scattered Petals quest.

The icon for the Lonesome Jacob quest will be properly displayed.

Changed the icons of the Leaves of Grace and [Daily] Lanka and Kamasylve quests.


Knowledge

Fixed the issue where the Max Energy of some adventurers may have decreased by 1 due to the amount of knowledge entries under the Valencia Waragon knowledge category being increased from 5 to 6 knowledge entries. We have decreased the required amount of knowledge entries for this category back to 5 so that the players who lost 1 Energy will recover the Energy back.


Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where the skill level would occasionally not update properly when a character would level up while on a mount.

The purchase window will no longer close after you make a purchase from the Central Market.

Fixed the issue where the window for setting up the number of participants would not disappear in a guild Final Battle.

Fixed the issue where the size of the icon used for an item link would be abnormal when an item link was used together with an emoji in the chat window.

The Black Spirit Quest completion notification will no longer be displayed if you do not have any Black Spirit quests completed.

Fixed the issue where the Inventory (I) size would occasionally be abnormal when opening it.

Certain cash buff icons will now be continuously displayed on the screen (Value Pack, Blessing of Kamasylve, Appearance Coupon, Merv's Palette).

Fixed the issue where there was an incorrect description being displayed for an item used in Courser Training.

Fixed the issue where the 'delete' button was displayed on the Saying of the Day within the Guild window (G) under certain conditions even when you were not the Guild Master or writer.
 
Fixed the issue where the arrow and prices would overlap for items on discount when the price of the items at the Pearl Shop (F3) would go over 10,000.
 
Fixed the issue where the Enhance button could be clicked on multiple times when there was network connectivity issues.
 
You can now chat while the Central Market's Buy/Sell window is opened.
 
The "Rent" button will no longer be displayed when you select a horse which is connected to a wagon at the Stable.
 
The text which is displayed when you plant a seed through the Place Mode while you are not located inside the garden has been improved like the following:

You must plant it inside the fence.



Fixed the issue where the scrollbar in the Friend List would scroll outside of the actual scrolling area.
 
The skill guide widget will no longer be displayed when you are underwater.
 
Scrolling through the Cart will now work properly at the Pearl Shop.
 
Fixed the issue where you could not select the 'Boss Vision Range' button when the notification for obtaining better gear appeared.
 
Fixed the issue where the 'Boss Vision Range' button would not be visible when expanding the map in 3D map mode.
 
Fixed the issue where the extract button would be displayed on the Enhancement window even when you did not have the Blacksmith’s Secret Book item.
 
Improved the icon sizes and location of text in the Challenge window which appears when you first log in.
 
Added a feature which allows you to skip the Outfit Extraction animation.
 
Made improvements to the descriptions which appear when you press the Shift key in the World Map.

Before

Press SHIFT: Share your location with a party member
Press CTRL: Share your location with a guild member
Press ALT + RMB: Set auto-navigation
Press LMB: Share your location
Double-click: Display a flag



After

Press SHIFT+LMB: Ping location for party members
Press CTRL+LMB: Ping location for guild members
Press ALT + RMB: Set auto-run path
Press SHIFT + Double-click: Pin Location for party members



 
Fixed the issue where the topography information would not refresh in the 3D minimap.
 
Removed buttons you cannot use for the Supply Depot Stable for Node War and Conquest War.
 
Fixed the issue where the "Price" text would overlap with the actual price when the price of a horse has increased at the Horse Market.
 
When you extract Black Stones, the information for the item you are extracting them from will now be displayed.
 
You can now assign a hotkey for the Black Spirit's Safe.

Settings -> Interface -> UI Hotkeys



Fixed the issue where the text location for the guild declaring war and the guild being declared a war against looked unnatural in the Guild window.
 
Fixed the issue where the scrollbar would drag outside of the windows in the Central Market.
 
Edited the reflection graphics on certain items in the Pearl Shop to appear more natural.


Resolved Issues

We resolved an issue where the Guild House bidding and Guild disbanding functions were intermittently unavailable. We apologize for the time it took to resolve this issue.

The issue occurred for Guilds that was bidding on a Guild house before June 21, 2018 or did not collect the Silver from a failed bid before that date and has been disbanded and reformed by the same Guild Master since.



Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where the reward titles that should be given when reaching certain life levels were not given with the life skill EXP adjustment from last week.

You can obtain any missing title by leveling up the affected Life Skill to the next level.



Updated 09/05/2019

We are aware of the issue where continuous Water scooping cannot be performed. This will be resolved shortly.

We are aware of the issue where the quest Torenandu's Declaration of War cannot be completed. This issue will be resolved in a future maintenance.

When the enhancement grades of the items you obtain while Special Deals are set up in a party are like the below, we are aware of an issue where the enhancement levels of the items were not properly registered at the Central Market. This issue will be resolved in a future maintenance.
https://i.imgur.com/lkKV9ds.jpg



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 30th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/jRo5QuT.gif

Greetings Adventurers, 

Unleash Doom from the wildest dark flames with this week's new update! Doom is the Dream Horse with the strongest attacks and is also the swiftest! Only the most devoted horse trainers will be able to unleash it, so what are you waiting for?
 
On the other hand, a known threat is blighting Drieghan again... Adventures claim to have seen Garmoth outside her nest! From now on, there is a chance that Garmoth will appear in other Drieghan zones with a chance to drop special rewards.
 
As usual other fixes and changes can be found by reading this week’s patch notes. Enjoy!


Event & System

New Events

Equestrians, Assemble! Event will begin.

Event Period: April 30 (after maintenance) – May 15 (before maintenance)
Part 1: During the event, enjoy a Training EXP +100% and Mount EXP +100% boost!
Part 2: During the event, obtain the items to help train and level your Coursers up by defeating monsters, gathering, and fishing!
Click  to find out more!



Ongoing Events

2019 Spring Video Contest: Apr. 24 (after maintenance) - May 20

Mystical Ellie’s Water Festival: Apr. 24 (after maintenance) - May 8 (before maintenance)


Ended Events

Spring Fever


Content

Dream Horse Doom, one of the offspring of Krogdalo of Kamasylvia has finally arose from the darkness.

The new trail-blazing Dream Horse performs the strongest attacks and is also the swiftest.
Doom can be obtained by training then awakening a Tier 8 Lv. 30 courser with a Krogdalo's Origin Stone via NPC Gula of Stonetail Horse Ranch and NPC Melabee of Grána.
You want to focus the training of your courser to increase Strength (over Skill and Elegance) if you want to get a higher chance to obtain Doom from successfully awakening your courser.
If you succeed in awakening your Tier 8 courser, it will be reborn as one of the three Dream Horses: Arduanatt, Diné, or Doom.
If you fail in awakening your courser, its stats for Skill, Elegance, and Strength will all reset. If you used Cron Stones during your attempt at awakening your courser, only half of the training stats will disappear.
Click  to learn all about Doom.



Rewards

As shared with the Dev Note published yesterday (4/29), the +530% Combat & Skill EXP Scroll x53 will be available for 1 Loyalty in the Loyalties tab in the in-game Pearl Shop (F3) from May 29 after maintenance - June 5th before regular maintenance. This special item consisting of 53 scrolls will be available once per in-game Family.


Large Ships (Galley, Epheria Sailboat, Epheria Frigate, Old Bartali Sailboat) can now be Repaired continuously.

You can perform this when Repairing a Ship with materials for Repair held in Inventory.
If you use up all the necessary materials for Repair or if the Durability of the Ship becomes 100%, Repairing will stop automatically. (However, if you are attacked, Repairing may stop.)



Fixed the issue where the attacking guilds in the offensive side appeared to be fighting each other in Conquest War.

The apprentice Guild Member promotion method has been changed as follows:

Apprentice promoted after two weeks have passed at noon → Apprentice promoted when entering the game after two weeks of requirement period has passed.



In order to alleviate the difference among Life Skill levels, the required EXP and obtained EXP have been readjusted for Hunting, Training, Farming, and Sailing. (However, Life Skill EXP obtained from quests will not change.)

We have decided to make adjustments for the 4 Life Skills above in order to alleviate the difference among Life Skills Levels. Therefore, we reduced required EXP for Sailing and increased obtainable EXP for Hunting, Training and Farming. We’ll bring our best to preserve the value of every Adventurer’s efforts.

Required EXP decreased – Sailing
Obtainable EXP increased – Hunting, Training, Farming, Sailing, Fishing, Trade



With the change of the obtainable and required EXP amount, Life Skill Level for Hunting, Training, Farming and Sailing will also increase proportional to the adjustment made.



Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

The Airship cruising over Velia, Heidel, Calpheon and Altinova will now fly over Kamasylvia and Duvencrune as well. (Please note that you cannot board the airships).


NPC

The dialogue with NPC Tachros in Velia has been changed to sound more natural for adventurers who have already met Tachros in Olvia.

Fixed the graphical issue where an Auction icon was displayed for NPC Hans in the minimap.

Fixed the issue where the character would appear to go under the ground in areas of Altinova.

The following structures will no longer be searchable using Find NPC function.

Class Changes

All Classes

Improved the issue which location differences may occur due to lag, after hitting an opponent.  

Information regarding Max targets that the skill can inflict damage on has been added to every skill tooltip.

Information regarding Injury has been added to tooltips of skills that require Black Spirit’s Rage to be performed.

Certain summoning skills for Mystic, Musa, Valkyrie, and Sorceress that implement push or pull effects will now be properly applied during PvP.

Boss Slaughter

Fixed the issue where the number of actual targets that received damage from the skill differed from what was written in the skill’s tooltip.

Combo: Venom Fang

Item Changes

Fixed the issue where the following accessories were not applying the correct effects according to its stats. written in the items’ tooltip.

Herman Feresio's Necklace
Marco Faust's Necklace



Waragon Nest has been added to the ‘Where to Obtain’ description in the tooltip of the following items:

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Vell will now appear in all servers.

Vell’s overall HP has been adjusted accordingly to match the global spawn system.
Fixed the issue where you could not control your Ship if Vell was killed while performing the jump and dive attack that caused tidal waves.



Garmoth will now appear at a chance in Sherekhan Necropolis, Blood Wolf Settlement, and Tshira Ruins of Drieghan at a certain chance. This Garmoth cannot be attacked, but this one may give you a crate at a chance for you to get free items!

After the system message “Garmoth has appeared!” is displayed, Garmoth’s terror will begin. 
Please keep in mind this ‘special’ version of Garmoth is separate from the World Boss Garmoth that appears in a routine schedule from Garmoth’s Nest.
Garmoth will breathe out flames to attack 2 to 3 times then disappear.
The first flame breath attack contains Knockdown CC status effect so be aware.
This Garmoth is invincible and you cannot kill it. If you get killed from this Garmoth, you will not receive any death penalty.
From the ground where Garmoth’s flame breath has scorched, there may be an Old Drieghanese Crate that can appear at a chance. The number of flame breaths from Garmoth is not related to the number of Crates that will spawn. 
Old Drieghanese Crate will disappear 1 minute after it shows up so hurry to destroy the create and randomly obtain 1 of the items below. Please keep in mind Item Drop Rate buffs will not influence this item.

The Stone Waragons located in Waragon Nest have awoken after being exposed to the black stones for a long time.

Recommended AP for Waragon Nest has been changed to 165.
Monsters in Waragon Nest have been relocated.
 Stone Waragon has been renamed to  Colossal Stone Waragon.
The HP and AP of Stone Waragon, Stone Mutant Waragon, and  Colossal Stone Waragon have increased greatly.
 Colossal Stone Waragon will no longer attack first.
Upon attacking  Colossal Stone Waragon, it will now continuously spawn, at max 100, Stone Waragon and Stone Mutant Waragon monsters.
Stone Waragon and Stone Mutant Waragon monsters spawned by  Colossal Stone Waragon cannot be gathered upon after being defeated.
When  Colossal Stone Waragon resets, it will have a cooldown of 2 minutes then recovers its HP.

Quests & Knowledge

Quest

Quest Requirement written in the Quest Summary of the quests ‘Identity of the Artifact’ and ‘Secret Revealed will now state the correct quest requirement.

The part about navigation written in the Quest Summary of the quest ‘To Shakatu's Territory’ has been removed.

The navigation for the following quests has been fixed.

Quest Requirement for the quest ‘Tasting John Dory’ has changed to fishing Bigeye x3.

As the Quest Requirement has changed, the Quest Name and Summary have changed as well.



Fixed the graphical issue with Quest Completion icon looking awkward for the quest ‘How Kind Our Miss Is..’

Text regarding Quest Requirement has been added and revised for the quest ‘[Returning] Crio's Welcome.’

Navigation will now be marked properly from your location to the target destination for the quest ‘The World From Above.’


Knowledge

Knowledge Hint of Node Manager of Elder’s Bridge Post will now display correct information.


Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where the Ship Durability would be displayed abnormally when a party member checked your Ship's information though a Wharf Manager while repairing your ship.

Fixed the issue where Vision Range UI would be displayed intermittently when your character has gone far away from a boss monster.

Fixed the issue where Enhancement Chance would not be displayed in certain situations.

There will now be a special effect and a system message notifying of the success of Enhancement when you succeed in Enhancing your gear.

When you succeed in Enhancing your gear to PEN level, Cron Stones will now automatically be deselected in the Enhancement window.

Pop-up UIs will now close when putting in Fishing command (keys).

‘Repeat’ button will no longer be displayed in the Worker List for Workers registered to Worker Exchange.

The icon that appears when a skill to spawn a Guild Member or a Party Member is used will now disappear after a certain time.

Fixed the text overlapping issue of “energy required.”and “Click to Play Cutscene” under certain situations when interacting with an NPC.

Fixed the issue where the sound effect would not stop if you put the mouse cursor over the Recharge, Polishing, Growth tabs under Alchemy window while performing these functions.

The Fish that can be caught in the lake next to Marni Cave Path will not be displayed on World Map (M).

Made an improvement so that sound effect would be played when extracting crystals out of gears.

Fixed the issue where the sound effect would not stop when closing Dye window (J).

The Special Skills of pets will only be saved for pets taken out. If a pet is checked in, it’s Special Skill has to be selected again when you take it out.

Notification for obtaining better gear will no longer appear for the following situations:

When you obtain gear that increases Life Skills and there is such gear already equipped for every equipment slot.
When a character that has not been Awakened yet gets an Awakening weapon.
When you get gear with a level requirement higher than our current character’s level.



A new notification message will now appear after you have completed all Main Quests of a territory.

The following text has been added to Guild item tooltips to state that the item is bound to Guild:

Bound (Guild)



Fixed the issue where the wrong message stating that you have completed deleting the Knowledge even though you failed to delete Knowledge for not having enough Energy.

Fixed the issue where the ‘Remove Guild’ button would be activated after disbanding Guild Alliance.

Some of the Guild Skill icons have changed in color.

Fixed the issue where the Growth button would not work intermittently when trying Grow Fairy.

A notification message has been added when expirable items is removed.

Fixed the issue where you could not select your Silver held in Storage if the amount exceeded 20 billion Silver in the Cleanse Gear window.

Extract Chance button will no longer be activated in situations when Enhancement Chance cannot be extracted in Enhancement window.

Titles have been to the descriptive text that appears when putting the mouse cursor over Breath, Strength, and Health texts in My Information (P).

Fixed the graphical issue where the graph of the work progress in Housing Crafting menu seen via the World Map (M) wasn’t well-aligned. 

The gap between the title and description of Open Special Item window has been removed.

Improved the scroll alignment in the 1 on 1 chat window from the Friend List (N).

Fixed the graphical issue where the scroll button image would appear awkward when clicking on it from Stable.

Forfeit Quest button will no longer be displayed under available quests in Quest window (o).

Fixed the issue where the Accuracy on the tooltip of a Horn Bow item successfully enhanced from Caphras Enhancement was not being displayed properly.

The gender of the Dream Horse will now be displayed everywhere Mount Information is shown.

The alignment of the HP and MP(EP) gauge bar on top of the character has been improved.

Fixed the text overlapping issue of the text “Waiting for approval from the guilds.” and delete button for Guild Alliance.

Fixed the issue where number Inventory slots would not be displayed when opening and closing World Map (M) with the Inventory open.

Fixed the awkward placement of Silver, Pearl, and Loyalties in the Inventory window that occurred intermittently when performing Cleanse Gear.

Fixed the issue where mouse scroll would not work when having more than 10 items placed in Cart of Place Mode in Residence.

Fixed the game client crashing issue that occurred at the end of the introductory video clip when starting a new character.

Fixed the issue where skill videos did not play properly in the Skill window.

Fixed the issue where Beauty Album window  would not appear in Character Customization screen.

Fixed the graphical issue where main skill icons would not be properly displayed in the skill guide for Mystic and Archer.

Fixed the issue where Skill Combo guide window for Lahn and Archer would pop up when using Recommended skills.


Central Market

When registering an item via Items Listed on Central Market, the price shown on Status and notification message section will now reflect the additional cost from Enhancement Level of the item.

Fixed the issue where abnormal items would appear in the item list of Central Market.

Fixed the issue where Enhancement Level would be displayed abnormally when clicking [+] to increase the Enhancement Level under Select Enhancement Level option.

You can no longer select Enhancement Level when trying to purchase an item via Central Market when there are no Items Listed for that particular item.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where less Palm Plywood would be obtained as Processing level would be increased when Processing Palm Plank.

Fixed the issue where Guild Mounts (e.g. Galleys, Elephants) cannot be retrieved if they have been reset after being killed/destroyed more than 256 times.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where the quest ‘Do You See That? Right There!’ can be accepted but the quest cannot be completed even after destroying Stone Waragon Egg.

This issue will be resolved with next maintenance.



We are aware of the issue where items that cannot be registered to Marketplace seems to appear on the Volatile Price Items screen when you first enter Central Market.

These items cannot be purchased and if you scroll down on the Volatile Price Items screen or reenter the Central Market, you will not see these items. We apologize for the inconvenience and we will resolve this issue soon



We are aware of an issue where the UI for the Cross Roads Main Quests is occasionally not displayed after completing the "Paying Off Debts" quest.

As a temporary solution, you can change servers or reconnect to your character to resolve the issue.



Updated 02/05/2019

[strike]We are aware of the graphical issue where some nearby objects are not being properly displayed intermittently, depending on different viewing angles. This issue will be resolved shortly.[/strike] Solved

We are aware of the graphical issue where some objects faraway are not being properly displayed.

We are aware of an issue where Max Energy may have decreased by 1 due to the amount of knowledge entries under the Valencia Waragon knowledge category being increased from 5 to 6 knowledge entries. During next week's maintenance, we will decrease the required amount of knowledge entries for this category back to 5 so that the players who lost 1 Energy will recover the Energy back.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.
