notes.title: Patch Notes - April 24th 2019
notes.content:
https://imgur.com/jRo5QuT.gif

Greetings Adventurers, 

Mystical Ellie's Water Festival is back one more year! This time, the festival will be bigger and fancier as its location has been changed to Terrmian Beach. So get those fish rods ready after maintenance!

And for those who prefer the sands of the desert, a new enemy will appear randomly in the zones of Valencia. Once Afuaru the graverobber spawns, players will have to defeat him before he flees away with some valuable treasures!

Keep reading to know all details about this new feature and other fixes included in this new update. Enjoy!


Event & System

New Events

Mystical Ellie’s Water Festival

Event Period: April 24 (after maintenance) – May 8 (before maintenance)
Ellie is back, and the festival is bigger and bolder than before. So, head over to the new venue at Terrmian Beach to join in on the fun!
(Click   find out all about the event quests full of splashing fun and learn about the rare but luxurious Pearl Mullet to fish! - Available soon)



2019 Spring Video Contest

Submission Period: April 24 – May 15
Winner Announcement: May 30
We are holding a fan-made trailer contest so you can show us how you would showcase springtime in the world of Black Desert Online!
Click  to learn how you can win the biggest prizes of the year with your very own video!



Ongoing Events

[Community Event] Create your own Easter Egg!: April 12th - May 3rd.

Create your Easter Egg into your character! Match the color of your character's outfit/costume, or just design an egg that looks like your in-game character and post a picture via our official forum post!



Ended Events

The Egg Hunt


Content

Updated 25/04/2019

The Red Battlefield has been revamped.

The Combat EXP and Skill EXP that can be gained during Red Battlefield have been increased.
The Combat EXP increase is as follows.
https://i.imgur.com/lxKR7hg.jpg



The way Silver is rewarded in Red Battlefield has been changed. Before, the Silver rewarded depended on your AP and DP.

For example, if your character’s AP + DP was 400–499, you would get 2 million Silver for winning in the Red Battlefield. If your character’s AP + DP was over 500, you would get 2.5 million Silver for winning in the Red Battlefield.



Now, you will get a set amount of Silver for winning in the Red Battlefield, and another set amount for losing. Overall, you will get more Silver than before on the Red Battlefield whether you win or lose! 

Silver for winning: 6 million
Silver for losing: 4 million



The Red Seals obtainable from the Red Battlefield can now be used to make a wider variety of Red Battlefield crystals.
Red Spirit Crystal

Red Battlefield Crystal: Harphia
Red Battlefield Crystal: Cobelinus
Red Battlefield Crystal: Viper
Red Battlefield Crystal: Hystria
Red Battlefield Crystal: Carmae
Red Battlefield Crystal - Addis



The Additional Damage against Humans buff from Red Battlefield Crystal: Power has been increased by 1.

The AP+DP cap for the Red Battlefield has been changed.


Graverobber Afuaru has been added to Valencia. 

Afuaru the graverobber will spawn in monster zones around Valencia at a certain rate (excluding Aakman Temple and Hystria Ruins).
If Afuaru spawns near you, the following message will appear.

Afuaru, the graverobber, has appeared!



If you approach Afuaru, he will try to flee you from you to protect his spoils. Defeat Afuaru if you want to get those spoils.
Afuaru may try to use a smokescreen to escape your pursuit. If this happens, you can try using a skill with CC effects to prevent him from escaping.

However, it would be best to defeat Afuaru swiftly, because when Afuaru uses his smokescreen for the third time you will not be able to stop him from escaping.



Afuaru will appear on your minimap when he spawns.
Afuaru will disappear one minute after he spawns. Please try to defeat it in its brief spawn time frame.
Item Drop Rate buffs will not influence the drop rate of Afuaru’s loot. You can use one of the loot items, Parchment Dropped by a Graverobber, to accept a special quest from NPC Nerasabi Alom. The lists of quests you can receive can be checked under [Quest] category.
Graverobber Afuaru is a permanent addition.



Some of the region near Calpheon Shrine has been changed from Kamasylvian to Calpheonian territory.

You can now transfer horses, wagons, and camels (if you have enough slots at the Stable) to the Stable at Northwestern Gateway.

The buff icons for the following Guild skills have been changed.

State of Perseverance
Complete Perfection
Sweet Luck
Sharp Eyes of a Gatherer
Merchant's Art of Persuasion
Scholarly Ambition
Endless Exploration
Regained Senses
Horrors of Battle
Frenzied Fighter
Intimidating Force



Fixed the issue where Dark Rift monsters would appear even if you did not have a Lv. 56 or up character, as long as you had a trial character. 

Fixed the issue where the following titles could not be used since the closing of Shadow Arena.

Shadowed Hero
New Challenger



Buying one of the following items from Datu Varudatu of Mediah will now consume one amity point per item.

[Scroll] Graveyard Dominator
[Scroll] Dominator of Ancient Weapons
[Scroll] Dwarf Dominator
[Scroll] Wiping Out Pirate Island
[Scroll] Elite Hunter
[Scroll] Cute Little Things
[Scroll] Fist to Fist II
[Scroll] Robbing the Rogues II
[Scroll] Food Chain II
[Scroll] Breaking the Spells II
[Scroll] Crushing the Steel II



A restriction on how many War Heroes can participate in Node Wars, depending on the tier of the Node, has been added. The number of War Heroes that can participate in Conquest Wars is unlimited, as before.
https://i.imgur.com/4o5osVY.jpg


System

Added a descriptive image to explain the Settings>General>Show/Hide>Attack Decisions option that will appear when you hover over the option.

Fixed the issue where the price to Collect certain grouped items would not be calculated properly. The price will properly reflect Enhancement level on the item.

The Black Spirit will now remind you of any unaccepted Main Quests under certain conditions after you log-in. You can find this in his textbox UI that appears on bottom right part of your screen. 


Central Market

Set Price of an item in the Central Market will now be calculated properly according to the Enhancement level on the item.

Changed the size of the scroll bar in the Central Market.

You can now see how much time you have left in the cooldown time for moving items from the Inventory/Storage to the Warehouse and vice versa. This cooldown is triggered when you fail to move an item to or from the Warehouse due to weight/volume limitations or network problems.

If you fail to register your items on Central Market under the following situations, the waiting time to register items again has been reduced from 15 sec. to 10 sec.

Example:

When moving an item to your warehouse exceeds the warehouse limit (VT).
When your network connection is unstable.




Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World

Fixed the strange rocks that appeared around Stonetail Wasteland.

Rearranged the rocks near Olvia Coast so that Berserkers won't get stuck there.

Fixed the graphical issue with the waterfront at Tarif in Remastered and Ultra Mode.

Fixed the issue where invisible NPCs would appear when you failed to Steal from NPC Martha Kiyen at Bree Tree Ruins.

Fixed the issue where the following NPCs would not disappear intermittently even after a certain period of time has passed.

 Soldier
 Kagtum Prisoner



NPC

The title of the following NPC has been changed.

Before:  Izella
After:  Izella 



You can no longer navigate to NPC Nerman in Drieghan via the Find NPC menu.

Removed some awkward NPCs near the Calpheon Parliament.

Fixed how the name of the Velia Guild Stable Keeper was spelled in the World Map.

Before: Leonaduro
After: Leonardo



You can no longer use the R key to buy First-grade Wagon Horse from NPC Gula, the Stable Keeper of Stonetail Horse Ranch.

In order to make sure Mystical Ellie’s Water Festival is kept well in order, Guards from Calpheon have been dispatched and placed at Terrmian Beach.


Mounts

When you press the S key to descend when using the Skill Wings of Wind of Wings of Freedom on an Arduanatt, you should now descend immediately, instead of first ascending then descending.


Class Changes

All Classes:

You now need to press the Q key instead of the Space Bar to dive in water. Press the Q key while floating in water to start diving.

You now need to press the F key instead of the Q key to recover Stamina in water.
The movements characters make while swimming have been made more natural.
A message will now appear when your character is swimming to explain the key commands for swimming.



By Class

Warrior:

Fixed the graphical issue that occurred when wearing Airblock Boxer Briefs or Python Boxer Briefs.

Fixed the issue where the Warrior would return to non-combat mode after climbing wall after going from non-combat to Main Weapon combat mode.

Fixed the issue where the Clead Armor would appear graphically broken on the chest area after applying certain customization.


Ranger

Fixed the graphical issue where the lace in the chest area would look awkward with the [Ranger] Atanis Armor equipped.


Valkyrie

Fixed the graphical awkwardness that appeared on the helmet when equipping Shadow Chaser Helmet in a certain customization.


Musa

Fixed the issue where certain text in the description of the skill Cyclone Slash was in the wrong color.

Fixed the issue where Musa moved awkwardly when the Q and E buttons were pressed simultaneously if his Divider skill was at level III.

Fixed the issue where the skill Absolute: Cyclone Slash was not being performed correctly after Whirlwind Cut: Cyclone.

Fixed the issue where the cooldown for Absolute: Cyclone Slash was applied and Rising Storm was performed after pressing the S + LMB+ RMB buttons to use Rising Storm after Whirlwind Cut.


Maehwa

Fixed the issue where certain text in the description of the skill Cyclone Slash was in the wrong color.

Changed the animation for the skill combo Whirlwind Cut: Cyclone and Cyclone Slash.

Fixed the issue where a strange message appeared and the character stopped her actions when the skill Maehwa's Will was used during frontal Slice (W + LMB) in Tiger Blade mode.

Fixed the issue where a strange message appeared and the character stopped her actions when the skill Divider was used during Slice (LMB) in Tiger Blade mode.

Fixed the issue where a strange message appeared and the character stopped her actions when the skill Roundhouse Kick was used after Blind Thrust I.


Item Changes

The following changes have been made to matchlocks.

You can now load matchlock while moving.
The bullet UI (like the one that appears when using a [Combat] Trina Matchlock) has been added for quest-related (e.g. practice) matchlocks and hunting matchlocks.
You must now first load before shooting a hunting matchlock.
The number of bullets loaded every time you load a quest-related, hunting, or Trina matchlock has been increased from two to three. This change has also been applied when using a matchlock while mounted on a horse.



The weight limit buffs of the following items for Guild Galleys have been changed as follows.
https://i.imgur.com/nRhaWlJ.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/3VN2vI0.jpg
Added different types of icons for different types of Pearl Shop outfit/costume sets.

The following items have been changed to orange-grade 

Epheria Marine Classic Set
New Year Hanbok Outfit Box



Fixed the item descriptions of the following items.

Broken Shackles
Rock Fragment



The following information has been added to the description of Da-Dum Da-Dum Diving Suit Set and Splat Fisher's Clothes Set for Striker and Mystic.

Striker: Your Gauntlet, Vambrace, and Gardbrace will be invisible.
Mystic: Your Gauntlet, Vambrace, and Cestus will be invisible.



There were items that listed a price in their item descriptions even though they could not be sold to NPC vendors. The selling price was removed from some of these items, while other items were changed so that they are now sellable to NPC vendors.

Added information about cooldown time to the item descriptions of Archaeologist's Map and Explorer's Map.

Golden Pig's Blessing item is now Family-bound (instead of being Character-bound). The item tooltip has been edited to reflect the change.

Fixed the issue where Hard Black Crystal Shard could not be obtained from Patrigio’s Secret Shop.

Fixed the issue where the following accessories were not applying the correct effects according to its stats. written in the items’ tooltip.

Herman Feresio's Necklace
Marco Faust's Necklace



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Changed how Back Attack affects the following creatures.

Hekaru: You can no longer inflict Back Attack on Hekaru by attacking it from behind.
Candidum: You can no longer Back Attack Candidum when it moves back to its initial spawn point.



Fixed the issue where Back Attack was possible on the following sea creatures when they performed certain motions or attacks:

Black Rust
Nineshark
Ocean Stalker
Young Candidum
Young Black Rust
Young Nineshark



New types of attacks have been added to the following Black Spirit quest boss monsters.

Biraghi
Kelcas
Dim Tree Spirit
Black Mane
Illezra's Servant
Mad Scientist's Assistant
Kavali



Fixed the issue where Red Nose boss monster would not have a weapon.

A UI to adjust vision range will now appear when you are facing the World Boss Mirumok Destroyer Offin.

Scratch attacks from an Ahib Griffon will no longer deal a knockback CC status effect.

Protector of the Fallen Kingdom monster will no longer spawn in the basement area of Valencia Castle.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest

The promise of treasure is lighting up Valencia with an influx of adventurers.

The following series of quests can be accepted if you have the item Parchment Dropped by a Graverobber which can be looted from Graverobber Afuaru. You must go to Nerasabi Alom to begin these quests after having  Parchment Dropped by a Graverobber in your Inventory.

Dawn in the New World
The King's Eyes
How to Face the Sun
Aiming for the Sun
A Journal Left Behind
Eyes that Watches Over the Treasure
Eyes of a Fallen Giant
Never-ending Riddles
A Person Qualified to Face the Treasure
Titium Valley Journal




You no longer need Shiny Golden Seal - [Calpheon Trade] or Shiny Golden Seal - [Mediah Trade] to complete the parts of the quest [Miniature Elephant] Permit from the Merchant League which required you to hand over the seals.

If you had those quests in progress, they have been reset with this maintenance.



You can now gain the knowledge Caphras' Seal, which was unavailable via the renewed main questline, by completing the quest What Was Left Behind.

Those who have already completed the quest What Was Left Behind can gain this knowledge from NPC Philance, who can be found at Caphras Cave.



Instructions on how to purchase and use an Empty Bottle has been added to the quest [Villa] Freshly Scooped Cool Water.

New trade quests have been added to replace old trade quests, which have been removed.

You can now get an Adventurer's Tome via the quest Lost Gift (Adventurer's Tome) with a Lv. 1 character, as long as a character in your Family has already completed the quest Black Spirit's Gift (Adventurer's Tome) and that character does not have an Adventurer's Tome in possession.

Changed a line one of the NPCs at the Ahib Conflict Zone says.

Before: Fighting is not the single best option.
After: Fighting is not always the solution.



Fixed the issue where the quest Precious, Precious Egg could not be completed.

Mystical Ellie’s Water Festival event quests will now show up in the Suggested tab in Quest window (O).

The quest line in the quest Lakiaro for Research has been changed likewise:

If you use the Manos Hoe imbued with magical powers. →  if you use the Manos Hoe. 



Fixed the issue where the quest Magic Shield Exchange I could not be accepted with a Wizard class when going through the new main quest.

The pre-requisite quest that needs to be completed in order to accept the quest Magic Shield Exchange I has changed from [Boss] The Witch of Horrors to Looking for Adventurers.

Fixed the issue where the quest [Co-op] Witch-Hunting could not be accepted with a Wizard class when going through the new main quest.


Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where you could not reaccept the quest Nantusa Letusa if it was forfeit after completing the quest objective.

Fixed the issue where the wrong notification was being triggered when you collected your horse at certain stables.

The location of the Red Battlefield icon that appears in the Arsha server will now adjust according to whether or not the minimap is on or off.

Fixed the issue where certain UI appeared wrongly after exiting the Red Battlefield.

The appearance of the messages that appear in the following situations has been changed.

When you can learn a new skill
When you have learned a new skill
When you have enhanced a skill
When you get a high-grade item
When you discover a new region
When you activate a Exploration Node
When you get new knowledge
When your mount levels up
When your mount learns a new skill
When you get a Contribution Point
When you contract a new worker
When you successfully produce/craft something
When you level up in Processing
When you get a Skill Point, or Guild Score point
When your Guild learns a new skill



UI for the Lakiaro minigame has been updated with an addition of new images.

Fixed the issue where the list of destinations and the list of characters to change to in the Transport UI to transport characters would overlap with certain buttons.

Fixed the issue where the Whisper message alert would not sound.

Fixed the issue where using pressing Shift + ' to reply to a Whisper message would select the wrong player to reply to.

Fixed the issue where you could select who to send a Whisper message by selecting a Family Name from your own sent messages.

Fixed the issue where the window to buy a villa invitation from a Villa Keeper would scroll unnaturally.

You should now only see the Extract Chance button under the Regular tab in the Enhancement window.

The Level Up button should no longer appear interactive after closing the Extract Enhancement Chance window.

Fixed the issue where contradictory information about Safe Enhance appeared when trying to enhance certain Pearl items.

Certain UIs will no longer take up memory.

We plan on implementing this for all UIs eventually to save any unnecessary memory usage.



Garmoth's Scale has been added to the drop lists of the following locations in the Item Drop window.

Tshira Ruins
Khalk Canyon
Blood Wolf Settlement
Sherekhan Necropolis



Changed the size of the text that appears when playing the cart minigame.

Fixed the issue where rapidly clicking the different tabs in the History tab of the My Information window would intermittently cause the stats to not refresh.

Fixed the graphical issue that occurred after selecting a filter in the Title tab of the My Information tab.

Fixed the issue where the text "Health (HP)" in the Basic tab of the My Information window disappeared when it was clicked on.

Fixed the issue where if you pressed on the 1 day, 7 days, 30 days, or Total tabs in the History tab of the My Information window the History tab did not appear selected.

Fixed the issue where you could not use the scroll wheel to scroll through the Skill List in the Mount Information window when your mouse was over a skill name.

Changed the size of the scroll bar in the Guild Skills Information tab of the Guild window.

Fixed the graphical issue with the scroll bar in the Journal tab of the My Information window.

The feature to check trade information by clicking the Transportation icon in the World Map has been temporarily disabled.

Combat Focus Mode and Adventure Focus Mode buttons have been added to the Edit UI mode.

Select Combat Focus Mode to toggle off all UI except the PvP button, HP bar, Black Spirit's Rage icon, and Quick Slots.
Select Adventure Focus Mode to toggle off all UI except the remastered HP bar, Minimap, Location/Time Information and Quick Slots.
After selecting these modes, you can further edit your UI by selecting Edit UI again.



Changed the color of the message that appears after you buy a Pearl or Loyalties item so that the name of the item you are buying and its quantity will be in different colors.

If you use one of the skills on the Skill Guide that appears in combat areas, that skill will not become highlighted in the guide.

You can now see how much Silver will be in your Warehouse after a purchase, in the bottom of the Central Market window the Purchase window.

The Find in Pearl Shop button has been moved to the top of the Buy (ENTER) button in the Purchase window of the Central Market window.

You can now zoom in/out, and spin your character in the Character Selection window with your scroll wheel and RMB.

Fixed the overlapping issue of certain terrain graphics of Gavinya Great Crater when the Graphics under Display Quality in Settings were set to Low or Very Low.

The icon that appears when a skill to spawn a Guild Member or a Party Member is used will now disappear after a certain time.


Resolved Issues

You can now place Lefkaritika Wardrobe against the wall in your residence.

HP of Guild Mounts such as Elephant, Ballista, Siege Tower will now be synchronized when engaged in battle.

Before the HP bar was not updated quick enough when got attacked and lose HP but now it will be updated more quickly (synchronized) recommend as below.



HP of Guild Mounts such as Elephant, Ballista and Siege Tower will now be correctly updated when engaged in battle.

Fixed the issue where 2 cancel buttons (X icon) for mobile devices with Android OS was showing up for Central Market Mobile Web.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where price of certain items appear abnormally when you enter Central Market for the first time after starting your client. You can temporarily resolve this issue by refreshing the CM by closing and reopening the CM window. This will be resolved with April 30th maintenance.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 17th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/VMMF9U5.gif

Greetings Adventurers, 

Good news for those quests completist and overachievers! With this week's update, Rulupee's Travel Log will be expanded, but this time won't be easy... you will have to complete 9,999 to get the new reward!
 
On the other hand, to celebrate Easter, the Combat EXP and Skill EXP bonuses for the Fever Times will be increased as well as the chance to get special items! So do not miss this special occasion as it will happen only during 2 weekends!
 
As usual, other fixes and changes can be found reading the rest of the patch notes, enjoy!


Event & System

New Events:

Spring Fever event will start.

[Part 1] Special Challenges (Y) for Easter
During the event period, simply play to get awesome items including the Blessed Message Scroll!
Event period: Apr. 18th 00:00 UTC - Apr. 24 23:59 UTC

Play 1 hour to get: [Event] High-Quality Food Box x1
Play 2 hours to get: Cron Stone x10
Play 3 hours to get: Blessed Message Scroll (100 min) x1

Blessed Message Scroll gives Combat +200% and Skill EXP +30% for 100 min.




[Part 2]: Double Fever Time
During this special event period, enjoy double the Combat and Skill EXP boosts offered from the Weekend Fever Time event!
Combat EXP +200%, Skill EXP +40%, and increased chance of obtaining Ancient Relic Crystal Shard, Sharp Black Crystal Shard, Hard Black Crystal Shard will be given. 
Event period: 

[EU]
1st Round: April 19th 14:00 UTC/16:00 CEST - April 22nd 02:00 UTC/04:00 CEST (Total 60 hrs.) 
2nd Round: April 26th 14:00 UTC/16:00 CEST - April 29th 02:00 UTC /04:00 CEST (Total 60 hrs.)
[NA]
1st Round: April 19th 22:00 UTC/15:00 PDT/18:00 EDT - April 22nd 10:00 UTC/03:00 PDT/06:00 EDT (Total 60 hrs.) 
2nd Round: April 26th 22:00 UTC / 15:00 PDT / 18:00 EDT - April 29th 10:00 UTC / 03:00 PDT / 06:00 EDT (Total 60 hrs.)



Find out how you can get up to 580% Combat EXP boost through these fiery events !



Rookie and Returning Attendance Reward have been refreshed.

Event period: Apr. 18th 00:00 UTC - May. 29th 23:59 UTC



Ongoing Events:

[Community Event] Create your own Easter Egg!: April 12th - May 3rd.

Create your Easter Egg into your character! Match the color of your character's outfit/costume, or just design an egg that looks like your in-game character and post a picture via our official forum post!



The period for the NPC's spawning for the Glimmering Old Moon event has been extended. You can exchange TRI or higher grade Faint Old Moon Belt/Necklace items during the period below.

Period: April 17, 09:00 UTC - April 24, 08:59 UTC

NPC: Piper (Faint Old Moon Belt)
NPC: Rudd (Faint Old Moon Necklace)
NPC: Lunei




The Egg Hunt: April 10th (after maintenance) - April 24th (before maintenance)


Reward Distribution:

[Community Event] Bake a Cake for the Black Spirit! Winners have been announced !.


Content:

A new Rulupee's Travel Log entry has been added. It is about her travel to Drieghan.

You can read all about brave Rulupee's travels in ESC Menu > Adventure Log > Rulupee's Travel Log.
Every time a quest is completed (except for Daily and Recurring Quests), it will count towards the goal of completing a certain number of quests. The goal for this new entry of Rulupee's Travel Log is completing 9,999 quests.
Once you complete the goal, you will not only get the reward mentioned on the travel log, but also one from the Black Spirit.



If you are on vacation from your Guild, you can now be attacked by members of Guilds that your own Guild is at war with. However, as before, you cannot attack them.

You now only apply for vacation from your Guild when you are in a safe zone.

[strike]Fixed the issue where the Dark Rift monster would get ready to appear even when there were no Lv. 56 or higher characters within the Family when creating a Trial Character.[/strike] (Will be updated with 4/24 maintenance)


Central Market

Central Market Mobile Web will soon be available.

You will be able to access Central Market from your mobile device anytime, anywhere!
The exact launch will be released shortly, please click  for a sneak peek!



Added Web Central Market images due to the Pearl Outfit Boxes being divided into 4 different types.

Fixed the issue where the Manage Warehouse window would not refresh while recovering lost items at the Central Market.

When you are trading with other players, the price limitations will now be determined based on the Central Market set prices.
 
When you are making personal trades with other players, a notification will now be displayed if you register an item priced above the price limitations.
 
Added a cautionary note on the personal trading window about the price limitations.


System:

Savage Rift rewards, Red Battlefield rewards, and attendance rewards will now be distributed through the Black Spirit's Safe.

The Maid/Butler will no longer have a cooldown when it is registered for the first time.


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World:

NPC:

Fixed the issue where you were able to hand over certain Trade Items to the NPC's below.

Maonil
Gerold
Kunka
Sidimin
Isaria
Izaak
Andes
Bilao
Ninehart
Sion
Sagotts
Riotina
Seltin



Fixed a typo in the quest completion dialogue for Barhan Nesser during the Urgent Message quest.

Removed a rock which was unnaturally placed at a certain Shakatu area.


Mounts

The speed at which you descend when pressing the S key while gliding on an Arduanatt has been increased.

Adjusted the location where some of the wild horses at Mediah Northern Highlands and Rumbling Land appear, to prevent them from getting stuck in rocks or trees.

The speed at which camels move in the desert when using the skill Quick Steps has been increased by 40%.

The speed at which miniature elephants run by using 'Shift' key without having learned the skill Quick Run and without having equipped a Saddle has been increased by 65%.

Fixed the issue where the Drift skill intermittently could not be used by a horse when used after Instant Accel or S: Instant Accel.


Class Changes

All Classes:

Added information about accuracy in the skill description of the following skills. Please note that when it comes to skills with Grapple effect, accuracy is referring to hit damage accuracy and not the accuracy of the grapple effect itself.

Warrior: Take Down
Ranger: Spirit's Shackles, Flow: Rooting
Sorceress: Flow of Darkness, Blade of Darkness, Nightmare, Black Spirit: Cartian's Protection
Berserker: Flow: Shooting Mobility, Rooting
Tamer: Stretch Kick, Soaring Kick, Cloud Stomping
Musa: Blooming, Counter Assassination
Maehwa: Blooming, Sticky Snowflake
Valkyrie: Punishment, Wave of Light
Witch: Mana Absorption, Toxic Flood, Flow: Voltaic Tett, Flow: Rage Tett, Flow: Gorr Launch, Flow: Gorr Roll
Wizard: Mana Absorption, Lava Field, Flow: Fire Breath Marg, Flow: Fire Fist Marg, Flow: Arne’s Stream, Flow: Arne’s Guidance
Ninja: Flash Bondage
Kunoichi: Ninjutsu: Sinew Cut, Assassin's Trail, Delighted Blast
Dark Knight: Luscious Snare
Striker: Massive Suppression, Hell Break, Echo Spirit, Flow: Bite Off
Lahn: Soul Raid
Archer: Righteous Fire, Black Spirit: Radiant Explosion



You can no longer jump when you are carrying trade items and over 125% of your weight limit.


By Class:

Warrior:

Fixed the issue where hit effects were not displayed when performing a jump attack while sprinting in Awakening mode.


Sorceress:

Information about the skill Flow: Cry of Darkness has been moved from the skill description of Blade of Darkness to that of Flow: Cry of Darkness.


Tamer:

Fixed the issue where the graphical text "IMMUNE" did not appear when using the skill Soaring Kick.


Witch:

You can now attack characters below you with the skills Fissure Wave and Black Spirit: Fissure Wave.

Fixed the issue where using the skill Teleport triggered a message and abnormal movements.

Added additional information about what the skill Magic Lighthouse does in the skill description.

Fixed the issue where the Tritch Aad Sphera could not be dyed in Remastered mode.


Wizard:

Fixed the issue where using the skill Teleport triggered a message and abnormal movements.

Added additional information about what the skill Magic Lighthouse does in the skill description.


Lahn:

Fixed the graphical issue with Lahn's hair during customization.


Archer:

Fixed the issue where the skill Glissade was intermittently not dealing 1 Hit Damage or 2 Hit Damage.

Fixed the issue where the armpit and thigh area would appear graphically broken when wearing the Sailor's Clothes.


Item Changes

Fixed the issue where Dark Knight, Striker, and Mystic would get an outfit not suitable for their class when opening a Bloody Outfit Box.

Added new Box of the Dead items from which you can obtain Cron Stones when defeating monsters summoned from the Dark Rift.

Item list:

Box of the Desperate Dead
Box of the Distorted Dead
Box of the Silent Dead




The Box of the Dead items you already obtained before the April 17 maintenance will be changed to Box of the Spirit items. The contents of these items will be same as before (excluding Cron Stones)
https://i.imgur.com/74f1nIA.jpg

You can now sell the [Event] A Fateful Choice item to NPC's for 10,000 Silver.

Fixed a typo for the item descriptions for [Conquest] Sturdy Octagonal Fort.

Fixed the issue where the Exchange Info for the Robe Piece item (which can be obtained from the Sausan Garrison region) descriptions would not be displayed properly.
 
The name of the following items have been changed.

Japonesque Ceramic Teacup → Zen Ceramic Teacup
Japonesque Cherry Blossom Lantern → Zen Cherry Blossom Lantern
Japonesque Wall Lamp → Zen Wall Lamp
Japonesque Ceramic Tableware → Zen Ceramic Tableware
Japonesque Dining Table → Zen Dining Table
Japonesque Carp Wall Scroll → Zen Carp Wall Scroll



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Moved the Dark Rift graphical effects upwards, so that the effects will not interfere with combat.

Fixed the issue where the Ruins Guard Tower (from the Dark Rift) did not summon ancient weapons. 

Improved character animation when inflicting damage to the Ruins Guard Tower which appear through quests and the Dark Rift.

Added an effect which shows you the actual Dark Rift when a monster appears from it.

The Dark Rift effect does not affect actual combat.



When the Faraway NPC Detail option has been selected, monsters in cities (e.g. the protesters in Calpheon City) will appear as black silhouettes while loading.

When you break open the Red Orc Prison, the soldiers will now break free and fight together with you against the enemies.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest:

Fixed the issue where Awakening quests that could not be accepted were being recommended.

Added a quest which guides you on how to obtain the Miniature Elephant.

Adventurers who are Lv. 55 or higher can receive The Adorable and Trusty Porter, Miniature Elephant quest from Bochlo at Sand Grain Bazaar.



Added guide about the Desert Trade buff at the following NPC's.

Sand Grain Bazaar: Atui Balacs
Pilgrim's Sanctum: Sharing: Samaya
*These were added to enhance accessibility to the Desert content.



Fixed the issue where the Black Spirit's appearance would not change after completing a certain quest.

Fixed a typo in the "Fishing Trip, Huh." quest.

The options you have to choose between during the quest The Recovery of Aal's Light can no longer be selected by pressing the R key.


Knowledge:

Fixed the issue where the Gain Knowledge button would be displayed during dialogues for certain quests even after the knowledge was already obtained.


Interface Changes

The default color of empty Quick Slots have been changed to be clear. However, when you are dragging an item from your Inventory, the empty Quick Slots will become colored again.

Fixed the issue where opening the Challenge window crashed the client.

Fixed the issue where the chat highlight/bold feature did not work when using the @charactername command in the chat window.

Fixed the issue where the maid/butler icon and character switch icon would occasionally overlap when registering a maid after creating a Family for the first time.

Improved the GM Announcement feature.

You can now view multiple announcements within a single view.



There is now a cancel button while you are attempting to automatically reconnect to the game. You can quit the game while reconnecting by pressing this cancel button.

Fixed the issue where the game client would shut down when you repeatedly click on the Red Battlefield Revival button after dying in the Red Battlefield.

Improvements were made so that certain UI does not take up memory.

Fixed the issue where the mount information would overlap within the Mount Information window.

Fixed the issue where the sizes and placements of the item icons within the Trade Info window would be abnormal.

Fixed the issue where the sizes or placements for the reward icons within the Challenge tab of the My Info and Quest Summary window would be abnormal.

The arrow which is displayed while talking to the Overseer will no longer cover the dialogue during the Excavation Site quest.

The text for the effects which are displayed for Caphras Enhancements will now be displayed properly.

Fixed the issue where the placement for the dye information would be abnormal in item descriptions.

Fixed the effect and direction of the arrow which marks the dialogue button when talking to NPC's during the tutorial.

Revised the system messages for the Sell tab at the Central Market to be more simple.

Fixed the issue where the scroll button would look unnatural when you placed the mouse cursor on the Wharf scrollbar.


Resolved Issues

You can now properly use 1 Elephant per 1 Elephant Nursery built during Node/Conquest War.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where Fishing is unavailable in the following areas:

Lake in Valencia
Lake in Marni Cave Path
Lake in Shakatu



We are aware of the issue where Central Market Mobile Web is displaying 2 cancel buttons (X icon) for mobile devices with Android OS. The cancel button will work as intended, and this issue will be resolved next week. We apologize for the inconvenience.


(*Content will be released shortly) We are aware of the issue where Central Market Mobile Web is displaying 2 cancel buttons (X icon) for mobile devices with Android OS. The cancel button will work as intended, and this issue will be resolved next week. We apologize for the inconvenience.

We are aware of the issue where soldier monsters who escaped from Red Orc Prison are behaving abnormally near the Orc Camp area.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 10th 2019
notes.content:
https://imgur.com/VMMF9U5.gif

Greetings Adventurers, 

Easter has arrived to the world of Black Desert Online, collect all eggcentric eggs to trade in for special rewards! 
Keep reading this week's patch notes to know all details about the new event and the new additions in full detail!


Event & System

New Events:

The Egg Hunt event has begun.

Event Period: April 10th (after maintenance) - April 24th (before maintenance)
During the event period, complete quests, defeat monsters, gather, and fish to get eggcentric eggs!
Rewards that can be obtained through this event like [Event] Mystical Golden Egg will give you the chance to win one of Kzarka's Sealed Weapon Box, Nouver's Sealed Sub-weapon Box, Ogre Ring, and much more!
Click  to learn all about this eggciting event!



Tulip season is here! 

You can enjoy the tulips blooming up all over the world of Black Desert from April 10th (after maintenance) – May 8th (before maintenance).



Ongoing Events:

Out of the Woods: Apr. 4 00:00 UTC - Apr. 10 23:59 UTC


[Community Event] Bake a Cake for the Black Spirit!

Voting Period: Apr. 3 - Apr. 10

Vote for your favorite cake before the voting period ends now .



Winner announced: Apr. 11th



Ended Events:

Glimmering Old Moon

Event items (Old Moon Letters, Remnants, Moonlight Shards, Faint Old Moon Accessories) and unclaimed Old Moon Challenges will be removed on April 17th maintenance.



Blooming Blossoms


Reward Distribution:

Event rewards for the True or False have been distributed with this (4/10) regular maintenance. Please claim your reward items via in-game mailbox (B) and/or check your Title rewards directly from My Information window (P).


Content:

As announced previously, Shadow Arena will close in its current state to go back into development with this maintenance. 

We want to show our appreciation for your continuous support and affection for Shadow Arena since launch by offering [Event] Blessing of Kamasylve (20 Days) via in-game mailbox (B). Please claim the item enclosed inside within 7 days.
Accordingly, the UI button to enter Shadow Arena on ESC menu and as a pop-up notification banner on bottom right corner have been removed.



Fixed the issue of friendly fire incurring damage within the offense side of Conquest War.

Fixed the issue where the button to participate in a Node War was not working properly for War Heroes who are in a Guild Alliance.

Fixed the issue where Dark Rift monsters would not appear when you approached the rifts while gliding above a certain altitude on an Arduanatt.


System:

Fixed the issue where the game would intermittently shut down when claiming Silver that enters your Inventory (I).


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World:

Fixed the issue where the character would collide into an invisible wall when entering Cohen Farm from Epheria through the Irrigation System.


NPC:

Fixed the titles of the NPCs around the excavation site near the Ancient Stone Chamber.

Edited the dialog for the Town Soldier NPC at Duvencrune to be more natural.

Edited the dialog for the Brellin Farm NPC to be more natural.


Mounts

The following changes have been made for Dream Horses Arduanatt and Diné.

Arduanatt

Characters will now move more naturally during the skills Wings of Wind and Wings of Freedom.
You can now use Wings of Wind and Wings of Freedom during the descent after using the skill Leap.
You can now press the S key to quickly descend during Wings of Wind or Wings of Freedom.



Diné

You can now use the skill Charge faster after using Earth of Life or Earth of Protection.
You can now use the Earth of Life while the horse is moving, or using the skills Sprint or Instant Accel.




Fixed the issue where the fall damage reduction buff was not applied properly to Arduanatt after you landed it by pressing the S key after it performed the skills Wings of Wind and Wings of Freedom.

When you register a mount at the Stable while you do not have any mounts called, the mount you registered will now immediately be called.

The Turn and Brake for the Galley, Epheria Sailboat/Frigate has been increased like the below. (Therefore the Ship License descriptions have also been changed).

Galley

Turn 100% -> 110%
Brake 100% -> 110%



Epheria Sailboat

Turn 100% -> 110%
Brake 100% -> 110%



Epheria Frigate

Turn 110% -> 120%
Brake 110% -> 120%



It will now be easier to turn when using the Ram, Smooth-Turn, and AbruptTurn skills while on the Galley, Epheria Sailboat/Frigate.
The higher the Turn of the ship, the more you will feel this change.



Class Changes

All Classes:

When you first login with a character, the character will now appear facing towards your screen.


By Class:

Warrior:

Fixed the issue where the basic attack (W + LMB) after a basic jump attack (W + SPACE to jump forward, then LMB during the jump) was not dealing the correct amount of damage in Awakening Weapon mode.

Improved the animation for sprinting in Main Weapon mode.


Ranger:

Fixed the graphical issue with the abdomen that occurred when a Ranger goes into the combat stance without any defense gear or outfit/costume on.


Sorceress:

Fixed the issue where the stomach area would appear graphically unnatural when standing or sitting while wearing the basic outfit.


Berserker:

Fixed the issue where the character would appear graphically broken in combat and non-combat stance when equipped with the Zereth Armor. (Fixed the issue where the legs, left arm and hand areas would appear graphically broken).


Valkyrie:

Fixed the graphical issue that occurred when wearing Purnado Shoes with the Fallen Garzar Outfit.

Fixed the issue where there would be a graphical overlapping issue when equipping the Purnado Shoes and Enslar outfit.


Maehwa:

Fixed the graphical issue with the fox mask decoration of the Spring Blossom Outfit that occurred in combat stance.

Fixed the issue where the stomach area would appear graphically unnatural when standing or sitting while wearing the basic outfit.


Mystic:

Fixed the issue where Bheg's Gloves would appear on the hands when equipped with the Noel outfit.


Lahn:

Fixed the issue where the Kibelius Divinus Outfit would appear black in the character selection window when running the game in Remastered mode.


Item Changes

The list of items that you could get from a Golden Treasure Chest has been changed to the following.

Gold Bar 10,000G, Sharp Alchemy Stone of Destruction, Sharp Alchemy Stone of Protection, Tungrad Necklace, Tungrad Earring, Nouver's Sealed Sub-weapon Box, Dandelion Weapon Box, Ogre Ring, Ring of Crescent Guardian, Black Magic Crystal - Harphia, Magic Crystal of Infinity - Experience, Caphras Stone, Memory Fragment, Sharp Black Crystal Shard, Cron Stone, Black Stone (Weapon), Black Stone (Armor), Hard Black Crystal Shard, Golden Coelacanth



Fixed the issue where you were able to make different furniture overlap as you placed them in certain situations in Housing mode.

Added a Challenge which allows you to receive the "+15 Liverto Weapon Box" as a reward when reaching Lv. 55.

This is available once per Family and if your character is over Lv.55, you will have already completed the Challenge (Y) upon logging in and you can claim the completion reward.


 
Central Market was the first step to create a free market economy where you as the adventurer create your own market without much restriction. We wanted to ensure convenience and accessibility to bring more joy to the art of trading.

However, after the Central Market update, the price gap between equipment which were not upgraded and equipment which were upgraded to ultimate gradually increased due to the amount of equipment upgraded to blue grade rarely being sold or purchased.
Therefore due to profit margins being made by the use of these characteristics of the Central Market, we implemented the following changes.



1. Equipment upgraded to blue grade have been removed. from the Central Market.
-The previous upgraded blue equipment have been changed to the yellow grade (ultimate) equipment.

2. Equipment upgraded to yellow grade can no longer be bought or sold at the Central Market.
-All blue grade equipment which were registered at the Central Market (or placed on orders or purchased) will be redistributed back through the mail.
- Yellow grade equipment can be registered after the reform stone has been extracted and downgraded back to green from the Blacksmith or Arms Dealer NPC.
- For extraction, you need 1 Restoration Stone which is sold for 1,000 Silver from the Blacksmith or Arms Dealer NPC. Extraction will result in the following: the equipment prior to being upgraded and an Ultimate Weapon/Armor Reform Stone.

3. With grades 1, 2, and 3 Reform Stones, you will have a chance to upgrade to yellow grade (ultimate) equipment.

4. When Crafting from the Workshop, you can obtain the original crafting equipment and have a chance to obtain yellow grade (ultimate) equipment.

5. Added a visual and sound effect which is displayed when upgrade has succeeded or failed.

6. When attempting an upgrade, the upgrade value for the equipment you are attempting to upgrade will be displayed.

*We are also investigating if there are any ways this system is being abused.

**We resolved the issue where adventurers who have completed all the series of The Uncharted Sea, History of Margoria quest series prior to its revamp on April 3 could not complete the Discovered and Undiscovered quest.

The crystals below can now be obtained from the outfits described below. Therefore, the item descriptions have been updated:

Ancient Spirit's Crystal - Swiftness: Garnier Troupe Garb
Ancient Spirit's Crystal - Valor: Delphe Knights Armor



Fixed the issue where it would appear as if you are duplicating items when using the Central Market.

You can now dye Fiery sub-weapon gear.

You can no longer store bound items to the Central Market Warehouse.

Fixed the issue where the Striker and Archer characters could not equip the below clothes using the Equipment Tailoring Coupon even when reaching the required Sailing Level.

Apprentice Sailor's Clothes (Costume)
Skilled Sailor's Clothes (Costume)
Professional Sailor's Clothes (Costume)



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

The following monster names have changed, as well as any reference to them in quests, knowledge entries, etc.
https://i.imgur.com/qBQX1DQ.jpg

The Ahib Griffon from the Dark Rift will now return to its place if it strays too far away from the Dark Rift while performing its midair chasing motions.

The conditions for the initial availability of the Dark Rift has changed like the following:

Before: Needed to have at least 1 character within the Family which completed the Awakening quest.
Now: Need to have at least 1 character within the Family which reached Lv. 56.



The Moghulis from the Dark Rift will now use a skill based attack even when the adventurer is nearby.

Fixed the issue where the Mad Screaming Orc Warrior would stand up awkwardly when attacked by an attack which should lift and knock it down.

The location where the boss is spawned for the [Boss] Black Spirit and the Giant Imp quest has been changed from Velia Beach to Altar of Agris.

Fixed the issue where Red Nose boss monster would not have a weapon.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest:

Changed the text for the the quest Lucky Well.

Changed the icon for the quest Support from the Church.

The color of the highlighted text in the following quests has been changed.

The Confession I
The Confession II
Rising Black Energy
Down in the Deep



The button "Lost Weapon of Basteer" in the Black Spirit window will now only appear to adventurers who are Lv. 45 or below.

Fixed the issue where the following daily quests in the Quest window (O)>Recommended>[Lv.46] Departure! Path to Hunting would appear even when they were completed.

[Daily] Easy Game
[Daily] Hunter's Honor
[Daily] The Reckless One



Fixed the issue where you could keep handing in items to NPCs for the following quests even after the quests were completed.

[Gathering] Strong Timber
[Processing] The Beauty of Planks
[Processing] Glossy Plywood
[Gathering] Ow, My Stomach



Changed the quest objective icon for the quest Warmish Life (?).

Changed the quest objective icon for the quest With an Elixir's Power.

Fixed the recipe for Steamed Seafood in the quest summary of [Cooking Lv23] Stamina Food of the Sea.

Fixed the recipe for Seafood Pasta in the quest summary of [Cooking Lv26] I Can Never Forget!

The conditions for completing the Trading with the Shen Merchant Guild #2 quest has been changed.

Before: Craft the Apprentice's Alchemy Box using Imperial Alchemy 
Now: Hand over Clear Liquid Reagent
Before: Earn silver by delivering the Apprentice's Alchemy Box to the Imperial Delivery Manager
Now: Hand over Pure Powder Reagent



The auto-navigate feature will now take you to the destination to complete The Isolated Supply Route quest (which is an existing main quest).

Adventurers who are going through the renewed quests can now accept the [ADV] Beginning of the New Journey quest which is provided by Rulupee of the Inn in Altinova.

However, since this is a Family quest, characters who have already completed the quest cannot accept the quest.



We resolved the issue where adventurers who have completed all the series of The Uncharted Sea, History of Margoria quest series prior to its revamp on April 3 could not complete the Discovered and Undiscovered quest.

Therefore adventurers who were affected have forfeited the quest mentioned above, yet were given the First Time in Margoria quest from the Black Spirit so that the series of Margoria quests can be completed.
Adventurers who have completed all of the series of Margoria quests prior to April 3 have already received the rewards for the Discovered and Undiscovered quest, therefore will now receive additional quest rewards from the First Time in Margoria quest.
The quest completion conditions for the Discovered and Undiscovered quest has changed from "Restore Old Treasure from Blacksmith Bindo" to "Talk to Blacksmith Bindo". Once you complete the quest conditions, you can restore the Old Treasure from Bindo.
Added a list of items which can be restored based on quantity of the Old Treasure item. The list can be viewed on the item description.
Added the First Time in Margoria quest to the quest Recommended tab.
Added a warning message on the quest completion text for Treasure of the Ancient Shrine I-VI.



The conditions for receiving the Welcome to Altinova! quest has changed like the following:

Reach Lv. 52 or higher -> Reach Lv. 52 and complete the Bridle of Destiny quest.



Certain Gain Knowledge buttons will no longer be displayed after they have been obtained.

Added gender conditions for accepting the [Repeat] Bad Hair Day and [Repeat] Violence is not the Answer quests.

The "[Daily] To Become Karlstein" quest which was displayed at the bottom of the Suggested tab's "Karlstein Outfit Crafting: The One Who Follows the Path of Vetor", has been moved to the Recurring tab.

Fixed the issue where quests which cannot be accepted due to the quest renewals were being displayed on the Recommended quest list within the Quest window.


Knowledge:

Changed the text of the knowledge entry "The Weakness of Azunak's Guardian Snake."

You can now also get the knowledge for Valencian Mission from Ganin Arth at Ancient Ruins Excavation Site.

Fixed the issue where an unattainable knowledge entry related to a “Merchant for Returning Adventurers” was being referred to.


Interface Changes

A notification icon for the Dark Rift will now appear when you reach Lv. 56.
 
Fixed the issue where the guide which is intended to only show up when you first discover a mount was appearing in irrelevant situations.
 
Added a background color to the Quick Slots to make them more visible.
 
Fixed the issue where the border colors (rewards, knowledge, EXP,  etc.) would change within the Quest window .
 
Improvements were made so that certain UI does not take up memory.
 
Mount skills will now appear in the skill guide when boarding a mount.
 
Fixed the issue where the skill guide would not appear when getting off from a mount.
 
When you come out of the Stable after finding your first mount, a guide text will now appear on the mount icon at the top left of the screen.
 
You can now select Tier 1 Nodes through the Node War Information tab's Tax Grade section from the World Map.
 
Fixed the issue where the icon tooltip would disappear when joining a party.
 
The "Slots" and "View as List" buttons within the Central Market's Sell tab will reflect the latest view you selected.
 
You can now view the tax benefits of Tier 1 Nodes (Easy/Medium/Hard) through the Node Tax Info. window from Node Management NPC's.
 
When you have items which do not stack together with items which are stackable when Processing, the same items will not have the "Processing" button anymore.
 
Fixed the issue where the Node Manager names would bleed out of the Node Information window in the World Map (M).
 
The detection area of the scrollbar has been expanded for all of the UI's in the game.
 
When using Party Assembly and Return of an Archaeologist, the icon on the top right side of the screen will now disappear after the time limit expires.

notes.title: Shadow Arena Closing Statement
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/PInHY1p.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,

This January, Black Desert Online set out on a new challenge by introducing Shadow Arena which has been widely acclaimed and is currently in its Spring season.

We had originally planned to provide continuous updates to Shadow Arena to keep it fresh and fun, but over time we had to consider how to balance making improvements to it, whilst working on fresh content. We felt that the focus on new updates was deviating from our original direction, partially due to the time being dedicated towards this mode. In addition, the recent rise of 3rd party software added to our concerns, making us further contemplate on its place within the scope of Black Desert Online.

As a result, we have decided that partial improvements on Shadow Arena would not be enough to keep it running as a regular feature. So after much consideration and discussion, we have ultimately decided to close Shadow Arena in its current state with the April 10th maintenance.

We recognise this may not be good news for those of you who have enjoyed Shadow Arena since its launch. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience we may have caused due to the relatively short notice we have provided, however, we are preparing a compensation package and we will share the details on this with a future announcement.

The Black Desert Online development team is currently focusing on not only introducing new content such as Star’s End, additional Adventure Log updates, and much more but also on improving the existing content already in the game.

We are committed to ensuring the best possible experience and creating new and exciting content for all the adventurers of Black Desert Online.

Thank you.


- BDO Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 3rd 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/gheCkzP.gif

Greetings Adventurers, 

Treant Spirits are known to be playful entities that surround the forests of Calpheon, however, one strayed Treant Spirit has been spotted recently seeking for Adventurers' help in Calpheon City. Something horrible is happening in the forests and he needs your help to restore peace again. By helping this little fellow, Adventurers' will be able to earn special axes, so what are you waiting for? The forests are waiting to be saved from the corruption!
 
As usual, new changes and various fixed will be applied to the game, so keep reading to know all details! Peace!


Event & System

New Events:

Out of the Woods

Event Period: April 4th 00:00 UTC - April 10th 23:59 UTC
Accept and complete quests from  Treant Spirit for a chance to get your very own Gold Spirit Axe or Silver Spirit Axe!
Find out in detail how you can help the Treant Spirit 



The Loyal Attendance Rewards have been reset.

Event Period: April 4th 00:00 UTC – May 8th 23:59 UTC



Ongoing Events:

Glimmering Old Moon: Mar. 14 00:00 UTC - Apr. 10 23:59 UTC

[Please Note!] Event NPC Piper will spawn 1 additional week. His spawn period is as follows:

Before: Mar. 27 after maintenance - Apr. 3 before maintenance
After: Mar. 27 after maintenance - Apr. 10 before maintenance




Blooming Blossoms: Mar. 21 00:00 UTC - Apr. 10 before maintenance

True or False: Mar. 28th 00:00 UTC – Apr. 3rd 23:59 UTC


Ended Events:

[Community Event] Bake a Cake for the Black Spirit!: Mar. 20 - Apr. 3


Reward Distribution:

Added the "Hall of Famer" title which is given out as rewards for the 3rd Anniversary in NA/EU.


Content:

The Uncharted Sea, History of Margoria quest series has been revamped.

The quest location will now be easier to find.
After you complete what used to be the final quest in the series (Completed Map, Toward the Ancient Shrine), you will now be able to receive the quest The Discovered and Undiscovered from NPC Katio at Nada Island.
Katio Pirates NPCs on Nada Island have been given names. 



The Uncharted Sea, History of Margoria quest series has been revamped.

Once you complete the Completed Map, Toward the Ancient Shrine quest and Treasure of the Ancient Shrine I-VI quests, you can receive the additional The Discovered and Undiscovered quest through NPC Katio at Nada Island.



The following quest locations have changed to be located at places which are easier to navigate to

Sagotts NPC: Underwater Cave Exploration
Batermann NPC: It's a Done Deal
Yiscule NPC: Dream Crushed by Cox Pirates



The auto-navigate for the destination for the Lema Borne and Lancelot Bartali quest (which can be accepted from Dichzy Borne) has been improved.

Increased the Max Durability of the Fort, Command Post, Field HQ, and Annexes used for Node/Conquest War by 20%. (Siege Defense Towers are not included).

Increased the Max Durability of Flame Tower and Hwacha by 20%.
Increased the Max Durability of Enhanced Flame Tower and Big Hwacha by 30%.
Increased the Max Durability of Wooden Fences by 10%.
Increased the Max Durability of Wooden Fence Gates by 20%.
Increased the Max Durability of Barricades and Iron Barricades by 20%.
Increased the Max Durability of Medium Siege Tower Workshop/Large Siege Tower Workshop, Indomitable Flag Factory, and Indomitable Flag by 20%.
Increased the Max Durability of Ballista Siege Weapon by 200%.
Amount of damage dealt by Flame Tower, Hwacha, Enhanced Flame Tower, and Big Hwacha on adventurers has been increased by 20%.
Amount of damage dealt by Flame Tower and Enhanced Flame Tower on horses or elephants has been increased by 10%.
Amount of damage dealt by Hwacha or Big Hwacha on horses or elephants has been increased by 20%.
Amount of damage dealt by horses on Siege Defense Towers has been increased by 50%.
Amount of damage dealt by horses on Cannons has been increased by 30%.
Amount of damage dealt by horses on Medium Siege Tower/Large Siege Tower has been increased by 50%.
Amount of damage dealt by Cannons on adventurers has been increased by 50%.
Amount of damage dealt by Cannons on Siege Defense Towers has been increased by 50%.
Amount of damage dealt by Cannons on horses has been increased by 100%.
Amount of damage dealt by elephants on adventurers has been increased by 20%.
Amount of damage dealt by elephants on Siege Defense Towers has been increased by 30%.
Amount of damage dealt by elephants on horses has been increased by 100%.
Amount of damage dealt by elephants on Medium Siege Tower/Large Siege Tower has been increased by 20%.
Amount of damage dealt by Ballistas on Node/Conquest War annexes has been increased by 30%.
Amount of damage dealt by Ballistas on Gates has been increased by 20%.



System:

Although Summer Time in Europe affects the UTC time for the following contents, please note that the times will not appear to have changed for CET/CEST. For example, Node Wars used to start at 20:00 CET, and now starts at 20:00 CEST.

Node/Conquest Wars
Tribute Wagon
World Boss spawns

Please refer to our official Forum post for boss spawn schedule .




The default value for the Blur Effect has been changed from 50 to 10 (Settings → Display → Camera Graphics).

Game was optimized to stabilize memory usage.


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World:

The auto-navigate feature for Nada Island has been improved to work more smoothly.

Fixed the issue where frames would drop in certain areas of the Sulfur Mine.

The chance of the voice of the Fairy being played has been decreased.

Fixed the issue where you could not move to the Exploration Point of the Ancient Goblin Altar due to a rock blocking the route.


NPC:

The location for the 2 NPCs who appear in the "What's Wrong With That Guy?" quest have been relocated to the collapsed bridge area of the Watchtower.


Mounts

The use of mouse movements will not be available while boarding the Galley, Epheria Sailboat, Epheria Frigate, and Old Bartali Sailboat.


Class Changes

All Classes:

Improved the way characters change directions when using auto-navigation.

Fixed the issue where certain skill icons in the Skill Guide that appears when you are in a combat area did not appear.

The key you press to leave the Stamina replenishing state when you are swimming (which you enter by pressing Q in water) has been changed.

Before: Q
Now: Q, directional keys



Improved server optimization.

When in a space where many characters are concentrated, the actions of the surrounding characters may be reflected with a delay.



Several adjustments have been made to the character balance in Shadow Arena.


By Class:

Ranger:

Fixed the issue where the shoulder area would look awkward when equipping the Atanis Armor.


Sorceress:

Changed the number of dye slots for Treant Camouflage.


Berserker:

Fixed the issue where damage from the skill Flow: Final Strike was not applied in PvP after Ultimate: Fierce Strike was learned.

Fixed the issue where the Damage Reduction effect for the skill Ultimate: Fierce Strike was not applied in PvP.

Fixed the skill description for Absolute: Fierce Strike.

Fixed the issue where the legs would look unnatural in combat and non-combat stance when equipped with the Zereth Armor.


Valkyrie:

Fixed the issue where the legs would look unnatural when equipped with both the Arrendo outfit and Purnado Shoes.


Witch:

Fixed the graphical issue with the staff remaining visible in non-combat stance.


Wizard:

Fixed the graphical issue with the staff remaining visible in non-combat stance.


Musa:

Fixed the issue where some of the hit damage for the skill Divider V was not applied during PvP when used with Tiger Blade.


Maehwa:

Fixed the issue where some of the hit damage for the skill Divider V was not applied during PvP when used with Tiger Blade.

Fixed the issue where the extra hit damage from the skill Maehwa: Decapitation V was not applied during PvP.


Kunoichi:

Fixed the issue where the arm area would look awkward when equipping the Puff Mini outfit.

Fixed the issue where the lower area of the character would look awkward when equipped with the Pila Fe Outlaw and Karlstein Outfit.

Fixed the issue where the back side of the cape would look unnatural when changing from regular/combat stance after selecting the Karlstein outfit from the Pearl Shop (F3).

Fixed the issue where the character's shoulder area of the cape would appear graphically broken when looking backwards after switching from normal/combat stance while the Karlstein outfit has been selected from the Pearl Shop.


Dark Knight:

The Smoky Haze skill can now be viewed on the main skill guide list.

Fixed the issue where the arm area would look awkward when equipped with both the Vespena Armor and Kibelius Vediant.

Fixed the issue where damage from the Absolute: Kriegsmesser Training was not applied during PvP when used with Vedir’s Dogma.


Lahn:

Fixed the issue where jump attack damage was not applied during PvP in Crimson Glaive stance.


Archer:

Fixed the issue where the main weapon appearance would change when equipping the Canape sub-weapon.


Item Changes

The Golden Pig’s Blessing buff that can be received by mail has been changed into an item. You can use the item when needed, from your inventory.

The Golden Pig’s Blessing item can be used within 7 days of receipt.



The following items can now be sold to NPC Shops.

Fiery Nouver Ra'ghon
Fiery Kutum Ra'ghon



Revised certain descriptions of the Adventurer's Tome. 

Removed the shop prices in the descriptions for the following items:

Cron Stone Bundle: 10
Hard Black Crystal Shard Bundle: 3
Sharp Black Crystal Shard Bundle: 3
Black Stone Bundle



Changed the item icon for the Old Treasure item which you can obtain through the Treasure of the Ancient Shrine I-VI quests during The Uncharted Sea, History of Margoria quest series.

Improved the descriptions about item Processing to be more straightforward.

Revised descriptions for certain items related to crops.

Fixed the issue where some of the item descriptions had incorrect descriptions.

Fixed the issue where you were able to use types of Potions which were not for your class.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

The attacks made by Red Nose (summoned through the [Boss] Red Nose: Engulfed in Darkness quest) has been improved to be more natural.

When the boss monster disappears after being summoned through the Dark Portal after a certain period of time, a guide will now appear and explain that you can attempt the combat again by forfeiting the quest and then by interacting with the Dark Portal again.

Fixed the issue where the Ogre's waist area would appear graphically broken when viewed from behind.

Fixed the issue where the grass growing on the surface of the Tree Spirit pet would move around unnaturally.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest:

[Lv. 55 the Great Ocean] The Uncharted Sea, History of Margoria quest series have been revamped.

Once you complete the Completed Map, Toward the Ancient Shrine quest and Treasure of the Ancient Shrine I-VI quests, you can receive the additional The Discovered and Undiscovered quest through NPC Katio at Nada Island.
Improvements have been made to allow you to navigate to the quest locations more easily.
The NPC's of the Katio Pirates of Nada Island now have individual names.
To reflect the revamped quests, the knowledge entries related to the quest series have been changed.

Lema Borne the Great Explorer
Reluctantly Helping Katio I
Reluctantly Helping Katio II
Reluctantly Helping Katio III



The following quest locations have changed to be located at places which are easier to navigate to:

Sagotts NPC: Underwater Cave Exploration
Batermann NPC: It's a Done Deal
Yiscule NPC: Dream Crushed by Cox Pirates



The auto-navigate for the destination for the Lema Borne and Lancelot Bartali quest (which can be accepted from Dichzy Borne) has been improved.



The quests Seal of the Secret Guards and Entrusted Seal of the Secret Guards have been added. You can complete one of these quests to get a special horse emblem.

Seal of the Secret Guards

You can accept the quest from NPC Martha Kiyen after you complete the quest The Qualities of a God and accept the Calpheon main quest Another Way Through.



Entrusted Seal of the Secret Guards

You can accept the quest from NPC Bevel, the Stable Keeper of Trent, after you have completed the quest The Qualities of a God or [Boss] The Witch of Horrors, if you have not accepted or completed the Seal of the Secret Guards.



You cannot do both Seal of the Secret Guards and Entrusted Seal of the Secret Guards.
The horse emblem you will get for completing either quest is for a Tier 5 male horse. The horse has already learned Sprint and Instant Accel, and both skills are already at 100%.
You can read more about the above quests under the "Suggested" tab in the Quests window (O).



The choose-able reward for the main quest Onward to New Horizons has been removed.

The main quest A Loyal Companion has been replaced with Embarking on an Adventure.

You will now get the Footprint of the Wind buff after accepting the quest The Gateway to Heidel.

Fixed a typo within the quest information window for Magic Horn Bow Exchange I.

Revised the quest completion dialog for the Black Spirit's Gift (Adventurer's Tome) quest.

The auto-navigate for "An Eye for an Eye, a Tooth for a Tooth!" quest will now guide you through the shortest route towards NPC Sara.

There are no longer any conditions for using the Value Pack (1 Day), which is a reward for the [Special Gift] Travelling Light I quest.

Fixed the issue where the [Special Gift] Travelling Light II quest would appear in duplicates for certain adventurers.

(Even if duplicates appear, only one of the quests can be completed. However, the duplicates were removed due to the confusion it may cause.)



Knowledge:

Fixed the issue where the button for obtaining knowledge for "A Talk with Elion" would be displayed even when you had the knowledge.


Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where the descriptions for the "All" and "By Category" buttons at the Central Market were incorrect.

Added an icon which is displayed for new adventurers and returning adventurers.

When you bring the mouse cursor over the their icons, the period available for logging into the Olvia servers will be displayed.
The icons are located where the Value Pack icons appear.



The font for the 'Sailing' button in the Rankings section has been changed.
 
The Black Spirit Emojis window has been revamped.
 
When crafting from the World Map (M), the material descriptions which appear when you bring the mouse cursor over the material items will no longer bleed out of the description window.
 
Improved the alignment for the required level and points which appear in the description window of unlearned skills (which appear when you bring your mouse cursor over unlearned skills).
 
Fixed the issue where the spaces between the quest widgets were not natural.
 
Fixed the issue where the Guild Emblem and Family Name would overlap in the Monster Rank window.
 
The image for the Fishing minigame has been improved to look more natural.
 
The descriptions for Fishing will no longer bleed out of the description window.
 
Improved the design for the Black Spirit's Safe menu.

You can now view rewards according to their categories such as Family Fame Funds and Shadow Arena Ranking rewards.



The chat window has been improved to scroll down more smoothly.
 
Fixed the issue where going to the Pearl Shop through the “Find in Pearl Shop” feature would not properly show the list of items as you scroll through the list of items.
 
When you go to the Pearl Shop through the “Find in Pearl Shop” feature, bundled items will now also be displayed.
 
The effect which appears when you bring the mouse cursor over the empty spaces in the Inventory (I) will now appear at the right location.
 
Improved the Adventure Journal menu from the ESC menu.

It will now display the conditions for accepting Adventure Journal quests which you have not yet accepted.



When the Orders and Items Listed text overlap with the price display at the Central Market, only the quantity will be displayed.
 
Added an icon which displays main quests on the quest button within the NPC conversation windows.
 
Improved the alignment of the Usage icon in the Workshop menu in the World Map (M).
 
To provide a smoother gaming experience, certain UI will no longer take up memory.

We plan to implement this feature for all UI in the future.



Black Spirit icon will now be displayed on the equipment enhancement window when enhancing TRI (III) or TET (IV) equipment.

When you click on the Black Spirit icon, the Black Spirit will make a random comment.



Fixed the issue where descriptions would occasionally disappear when bringing the mouse cursor over the notification icon on the top left side of the screen.
 
Due to the level restrictions being removed from the skill guide widget, the skill guide will be displayed when you experience combat with the first Gray Fox you encounter.
 
Fixed the issue where certain guide text would not be displayed on the quest widget when going through the tutorial.
 
Fixed the issue where the notification icons on the bottom right side and minimap would appear even when they were disabled from the Edit UI menu.
 
Fixed the issue where the Change Character Order button would not work for certain characters in the Character Selection window.

*Characters which could not be switched before will be moved to the bottom of the character selection window.



Fixed the issue where the default settings for the Mount icon UI was disabled when creating a character from a new Family.

You can now enable or disable the newly added Family buff and Function buttons from the Edit UI menu as well.



Improved the effects which appear when you receive rewards for Bartali's Adventure Journal.
 
Fixed the issue where the game would occasionally crash when you download your information from the ESC menu's Setting Archive.

Added a "Reward Log" feature for the Black Spirit's Safe which allows you to see where you obtained the rewards from and the amount of rewards you received (you can view up to 100 records).

Items inside the Black Spirit's Safe can be stored for up to 2 weeks.



Fixed the issue where the Barrier Tower's HP would not be displayed at Savage Rift.

When you close a chat window which you opened through the "Separate Chat Window" tab, you will no longer see the Add Chat Window button which appeared on the original chat window.

Fixed the issue where the Find NPC feature in the World Map (M) would scroll unnaturally.

Fixed the issue where you would go to the incorrect location when using the Storage per Territory (Balenos) searching feature in Find NPC.

Fixed the issue where the tooltip on the top right was incorrectly displayed when using the Lafi Bedmountain's Upgraded Compass.

Fixed the issue where the Guild History UI would occasionally not be displayed.


Resolved Issues

The 2 titles [Edana’s Third Descendant] and [Hall of Famer] will now be available. They will see it highlighted under My Information > Title section but they first need to restart their client.


Known Issues

We are aware of an issue where the scrollbar will not scroll all the way down in the game settings in certain situations. This will be fixed in next week’s maintenance.

We are aware of an issue where adventurers who have completed all the series of The Uncharted Sea, History of Margoria quests prior to when it was revamped on April 3rd and adventurers who have completed parts of the Treasure of the Ancient Shrine I - IV cannot complete the Discovered and Undiscovered quest.

We are aware of an issue where the “@(character name)” chat feature is not working properly (it is not changing the chat color and it is not making the font bold).


Updated 04/04/2019:

We are ware of the issue where if the Red Nose boss spawned from you is killed by another adventurer during the quest [Boss] Red Nose: Engulfed in Darkness, the quest cannot be completed. We will resolve this with next maintenance.


Updated 04/04/2019:

Background, NPC & Effect:

Fixed the issue where graphical anomalies (such as abnormal objects) may appear in certain areas.

Fixed the issue where you could physically go through certain cherry blossom trees and not collide with them


Updated 04/05/2019:

We are aware of the issue where the enhancement level displayed in the purchase window at the Central Market is different from the equipment you purchase from the +12 or lower equipment (for when there are 2 or more enhancement levels in a single category of a group of equipment you are purchasing the equipment from).

If the item you want to purchase is registered at the Central Market, then you will be able to purchase the item at the enhancement level you selected, and you will pay the amount based on the price of the selected enhancement level.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.
