notes.title: [Banwave] Update on Follow-up Measures
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

This announcement is regarding the recent banwave that took place during the maintenance on March 27th, 2019. After the banwave was implemented, we found that some players have been wrongfully banned. The bans on the affected accounts have now been overturned.

We would like to offer our deepest apologies for making a critical mistake on our part.
We are taking this issue very seriously and are committed to taking measures to prevent such a mistake in the future. We will also reassess our ban process and procedures to ensure it will not happen again.

We are truly sorry that this occurred and would like to offer a sincere token of apology by compensating those who were wrongly affected by the banwave. The compensation will be sent out individually and we hope that your trust can be regained in due time. We ask for your patience as distributing the compensation may take a little bit more time.

Once again, we are deeply sorry for this mistake and ask for your kind understanding.

- The BDO Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - March 27th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/gheCkzP.gif

Greetings Adventurers, 

Rumours are spreading like wildfire in the world of Black Desert Online this week. Is Santo Manzi as tough as he seems or does he sleep with a stuffed bear at night? Nothing seems as it is... that is why with this week’s patch note we would like to introduce the new event "True or False". Every day, players will have to track down a rumor, and depending on the answer, special prizes will be awarded to those who chose the least popular option, so beware and do not get yourself fooled!


Event & System

New Events:

True of False event will begin.

Event Period: Mar. 28th (00:00 UTC) – Apr. 3rd (23:59 UTC)
During the event period, obtain one [Event] A Fateful Choice a day via the Challenges tab (Y). Then use [Event] A Fateful Choice to go to NPC Dosogan Nia who will lead you to other NPCs where you will have to make a choice between 2 answers! The answer choice you make, if it is the choice selected by ‘lesser’ number of other adventurers, will become the Lie and you will get to win prizes!
Click  to learn more about the deceitful lies!
Check the daily results to see if your choice won !

Updated 00:30 of the next day for results.




Ongoing Events:

Glimmering Old Moon: Mar. 14 00:00 UTC - Apr. 10 23:59 UTC

Blooming Blossoms: Mar. 21 00:00 UTC - Apr. 10 before maintenance

[Community Event] Bake a Cake for the Black Spirit!: Mar. 20 - Apr. 3


Ended Events:

Black Spirit’s Adventure 1

Cron Collector


Reward Distribution:

‘Hall of Famer’ titles

Unfortunately the Hall of Famer titles for Hall of Fame will not be distributed until Apr. 3rd maintenance. We apologize for the delay once again.



Content:

Auto-navigation around Hope Pier, Valencia has been improved.

You can no longer use the Devour function on items that are transfused with crystals, or has Caphras stats.

Such items will be faded out when you open the Devour window, and warning messages have been added.



Fixed the issue where promoted workers could not be registered on the Worker Exchange immediately.

Fixed the issue where the Guild Bonus would occasionally not be distributed.


System:

Fixed the issue where the auto-navigate feature would not work for certain island areas. 

Changed the Black Spirit tutorial guide dialog to be more natural. 

Changed the appearance for the Black Spirit's 2nd awakening.

Fixed the issue where the Fever Time was not properly applied for the NA servers.


Shadow Arena

Shadow Arena Rankings for both Solo/Party play has been reset.

Once the first match of Shadow Arena has been played after the maintenance, all rankings will reset.
You can view the previous season’s rankings through the Shadow Arena Rankings window on the top right menu.



Fixed the issue where the skill descriptions for the Kunoichi's Flash Slash skill was not normal in the Shadow Arena's View Skill Details feature.

Kunoichi's Flash Slash skill description when pressing the Alt key in Shadow Arena will now mention Stiffness.

Fixed the issue where the Shadow Arena survival time points would not be counted towards the points.


Central Market

Improved the search feature at the Central Market (you can now search single characters).


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World:

The names of the titles below have been revised to match the actual Life Skill level at which you obtain the titles:
https://i.imgur.com/ZVBAi9c.jpg

Fixed the issue where the cliff near the Crescent Shrine area would look unnatural.

Removed bushes which were awkwardly placed near the starting point of the main quest.

Removed bushes from the walls of certain areas in Valencia.

Added a shorter path that leads you back up to Cron Castle when falling from the castle.


NPC:

Orwen has disappeared from the Kamasylve Temple in Mediah.


Class Changes

All Classes:

Improved the animation for the movements characters make when they try not to fall.

Improved the hit effects which are displayed when successfully landing hits with the following skills/attacks.

Witch: bare hand attacks without gear equipped
Wizard: bare hand attacks without gear equipped
Dark Knight: Unveiled Dagger, Twilight Dash
Ninja: Sura ChaoSpree
Tamer: bare hand attacks without gear equipped
Berserker: bare hand attacks without gear equipped



Fixed the issue where the character could not be switched when attempting to change characters while not equipped with any weapons.

When multiple adventurers are crowded together in confined spaces, the direction at which the other adventurers are facing will be reflected slowly from the player’s perspective. This is to help with optimization of the servers.

This means that the server will run more smoothly when multiple players are crowded together, but the actual directions each adventurer is facing will be synchronized slowly.



By Class:

Warrior:

The damage activated when switching to main weapon mode from awakening weapon mode by pressing the W/A/S/D+C key will now reflect the damage from the currently obtained Slash skill.

Fixed the issue where the camera effect would be too intense when using the Slash skill while on a mount.


Ranger:

Fixed the issue where the sound for the Descending Current skill would play when using the Evasive Shot skill immediately after casting the Flow: Crossing Wind and Descending Current skill.

The speed of the arrows fired during the following skills has been increased. The amount of time after which you can swap gears after using these skills has also been changed.

Descending Current I, II, III, IV and V, as well as Ultimate: Descending Current.



Made the hit effects for the skill Tearing Arrow the same when used while mounted and not mounted.

The graphic effects of the skill Dagger of Protection should no longer follow the movements of your character.

Fixed the issue where the back side of the head would move when customizing the eyes.

Fixed the issue where the character's motion would look awkward when standing still after using the Evasive Explosion Shot III and Absolute: Evasive Explosion Shot 2 times consecutively.

Improved the hit effect of Tearing Arrow to be more dynamic.


Sorceress:

Fixed the issue where the hit sound would not play when casting Dream of Doom I - III while on a mount.

Fixed the issue where the hair would look unnatural in character customization.

The damage activated when switching to main weapon mode from awakening weapon mode by pressing the W/A/S/D+C key will now reflect the damage from the currently obtained Dark Split skill.


Berserker:

Fixed the issue where the damage would not be applied when attacking as you switch to main weapon mode by pressing the W/A/S/D+C key while attacking in awakening weapon mode (when you have obtained the Elastic Force X skill).


Tamer:

You can now board a mount while sprinting.

Attacking while switching to main weapon mode (by pressing W/S+C key while attacking in awakening weapon mode) will now result in the same attack as when attacking as the character changes directions.

Fixed the issue where damage would not be applied when attacking as you switch to main weapon mode by pressing A/D+C key while attacking in awakening weapon mode.


Witch:

Instead of Magical Shield and Healing Aura, Fireball and Lightning Chain will appear in the Skill Guide that appears when you are in a combat area.

The proper amount of hits will now be applied for the Toxic Flood and Lava Field skills.


Wizard:

Instead of Magical Shield and Healing Aura, Fireball and Lightning Chain will appear in the Skill Guide that appears when you are in a combat area.

The proper amount of hits will now be applied for the Toxic Flood and Lava Field skills.


Musa:

Fixed the issue where you could not move or use skills momentarily after the ending motion of switching to awakening weapon mode by pressing W/A/S/D+C key from main weapon mode.

The following skill name has been changed.

Before: Musa’s Spirit
Now: Musa’s Resolve



Maehwa:

Fixed the graphical issue with the Kerispear that occurred when wearing the Peach Blossom Outfit.

Fixed the issue where you could not move or use skills momentarily after the ending motion of switching to awakening weapon mode by pressing W/A/S/D+C key from main weapon mode.


Ninja:

The damage activated when switching to main weapon mode from awakening weapon mode by pressing the W/A/S/D+C key will now reflect the damage from the currently obtained Wind Slash skill.


Kunoichi:

The damage activated when switching to main weapon mode from awakening weapon mode by pressing the W/A/S/D+C key will now reflect the damage from the currently obtained Wind Slash skill.


Striker:

Fixed the graphical issue with the head that occurred when wearing Garnier Troupe Garb (Costume).


Mystic:

Fixed the issue where the only 5 hits were applied for the  Combo Damage of Soul Basher III and Absolute: Soul Basher when used with Martial Spirit Shards.


Item Changes

The total amount of Caphras Stones required for a level 0 - 20 Caphras Enhancement on PEN (V) weapons (main weapon/sub-weapon/awakening weapon) has been reduced by 25%.

Though the amount of Caphras Stones required has decreased, the Caphras stats effects will be the same as before.
The number of upgrade enhancement levels are the same as before (20), and the amount required for each level has been adjusted due to the reduced maximum amount.
If you had already invested enough Caphras Stones to reach level 20 in the new system, you can find the extra Caphras Stones in your in-game mail. They are sent out during this, March 27 maintenance.



Fixed a typo in the description for the button for using the Elion's Tear item, which is displayed when you die.

Fixed the issue where the Fairy voice would not play.

Added a sound effect which plays when Devour is successful.

Added a popup window which describes the Devour feature.

The tooltip for the Fat Catfishman Summon Scroll item (which can be obtained through the [Boss] The Mastermind of the Catfishmen quest), will no longer have the description which mentions interacting with the Dark Portal. Instead, it will now mention that you can use the item by moving to a certain location.

Also, the item's expiration period has been removed.



Fixed the issue where certain contents (shoes and gloves) of the [Musa] Blue Tiger Classic Set would not be displayed in the description which appears after you open the item.

The Dark Spirit's Greed will no longer be exchanged when pressing the R button at Odelphin NPC in Drieghan.

Fixed the issue where the number of Hwachas and Flame Towers you can build for the [Conquest] Sturdy Octagonal Fort would not match the descriptions. 

The following item name has been changed.

Before: The Forgotten Secret Garden of Cron
Now: Scroll of Cron Remembrance



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Removed the warning display for the Ahib Griffon boss monster which appears from the Dark Rift.

The Ancient Puturum boss monster from the Dark Rift will display a warning message before it deals a powerful attack.

Fixed the issue where you were able to obtain the Harpy Plume trade item when defeating Harpy at Karanda Ridge.

Increased the normal attack range for Dastard Bheg.

Certain monsters at Imp Cave will no longer initiate attacks. This is to allow you to engage in a conversation with Small Nose more easily.

The Gray Boss Wolf has been added in front of the Ancient Stone Chamber, and it has been placed at an area which allows the scene to look more natural.

The camera movement and attack range for boss monster Giath (which you encounter during a quest) have been improved to match the movements more naturally.

In order to provide better combat experience, boss monsters you encounter in quests will now continue to be summoned for 5 minutes when in non-combat mode.


Quests & Knowledge

The completion goals for Rulupee's Travel Log have been adjusted.
https://i.imgur.com/Sznzbkf.jpg
Fixed the issue where the Frightening Witch Summon Scroll, a quest reward from the quest Tears of the Wind, was not working properly.

If you possess the Frightening Witch Summon Scroll but have not accepted the main quest [Boss] The Witch of Horrors, you can accept the quest [The Ritual Entity] from NPC Ribley to use the summon scroll.



The quest acceptance condition for the quest Dying Abun has been changed.

Even if you have completed the quest Mediah Merchants Union Chairman, you will no longer be able to accept the quest Dying Abun.



Removed the unnecessary warning descriptions from the quest summary for [Co-op] Story on Cron Castle.

The quest locations for Troublemaker of the Mountain and Rare Gray Fur will now be displayed properly.

Fixed the issue where characters who were going through the beginning stages of the renewed main quests could not accept the following sub quests.

Claus Can't Contain!
I Care About You
[Returning] Do you want to go to Velia?



The number of Weasels, Foxes, and Wolves has increased for the areas relevant to the following sub quests.

Self-Sufficiency at Western Camp #1
Self-Sufficiency at Western Camp #2
Self-Sufficiency at Western Camp #3



The Value Pack (1 Day) item for completing [Special Gift] Travelling Light I quest has been replaced during maintenance to you to complete the quest. Please check your in-game mailbox (B) if you had a Value Pack (1 Day) item which did not function properly to proceed and complete [Special Gift] Travelling Light I.


Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where the mount skill name and description would overlap or bleed out of the Mount Information window.

Certain equipment icons have been fixed so that they look more natural in the UI.

The sizes for the following Inventory UI have been adjusted:

Item icons & grade borders
Trade item expiration display
Time limit icons
Cooldown icons



The Part for Explorer's Compass has been added to the list of items dropped in the Hystria Ruins region.

Revised the description about the maximum enhancement value for PEN gear Caphras enhancements.

Fixed the issue where a notification message for obtaining better gear would appear when obtaining Life Skill related accessories.

Added a feature where the Black Spirit make a relevant comment when you accept the early main quests.

Made an improvement so that effect (visual and sound) would appear when extracting Garmoth's Heart.

You can now view the "Easy, Medium, and Hard" information for the Tier 1 Nodes from the Participation Region window which is displayed when building a Node War Fort.

Revised the message which is displayed on the Dark Rift UI when the Dark Rift has not yet appeared.

Fixed the issue where extraction would not properly work for the Caphras Stone extraction when using the Inventory's Auto Arrange feature after putting an equipment onto the Extraction window.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where certain effects would look unnatural when running the game below the "Low" graphic settings.

We apologize for the NA weekend EXP boost not working during 3/22 - 3/25 as announced on our forum post. Weekend EXP boost for NA will work normally from this weekend. 

As compensation, we have distributed the following items via in-game mailbox (B) for NA adventurers. Once again we apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

Extra Combat EXP Scroll x15
Extra Skill EXP Scroll x15

Please make sure to claim this within 1 week (until 4/3 23:59 UTC).





Resolved Issues

We are aware of the issue where [Archer] Canape Crossbow cannot be dyed. This is expected to be fixed next week.

We are aware of an issue where graphical anomalies (such as abnormal objects) may appear in certain areas.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - March 20th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/gheCkzP.gif

Greetings Adventurers, 

Spring has finally arrived to the world of Black Desert Online, it's finally warm enough to grind outside without a coat! Flowers are also starting to bloom and with them new events are arriving for you to enjoy!

As spring means new life, also new changes are being applied to the main story quest and to the Node Wars, so keep reading this week's patch notes to know all the details about the updates coming to your favourite content!


Event & System

New Events:

Blooming Blossoms event will start

Event 1: Collect and Exchange

Event Period: Mar. 21 00:00 UTC - Apr. 10 before maintenance
Collect an [Event] Cherry Blossom every hour and exchange them for amazing rewards! 



Event 2: Plant a Tree

Event Period: Mar. 20 after maintenance - Apr. 3 before maintenance
Purchase an [Event] Cherry Blossom Seed for 3 Loyalty from the Pearl Shop (F3) and plant and grow it for your very own Cherry Blossom Pot that you can place in your residence!



Click  to find out more about this more blooming event.



Cherry Blossom/Spring-themed background UI will take place.

Event Period: Mar. 20 after maintenance - Apr. 10 before maintenance



Community Event:

Bake a Cake for the Black Spirit!

Submission Period: Mar. 20 - Apr. 3
Voting Period: Apr. 3 - Apr. 10
Winner Announcement:  Apr. 11
Click  to bake your own cake and show us what you got!



Ongoing Events:

Black Spirit’s Adventure 1: Mar. 6 - Mar. 27 before maintenance

Glimmering Old Moon: Mar. 14 00:00 UTC - Apr. 10 23:59 UTC

Cron Collector: Mar. 13 after maintenance - Mar. 27 before maintenance


Ended Events:

Get a +15 Cliff's Weapon!

Gratitude of Black Spirit


System:

Added a feature at the Warehouse which allows you to automatically recover items back to your Warehouse when items occasionally disappear. (Items can occasionally disappear due to network connectivity issues while attempting to register/list items at the Central Market.)

When failing to move items from the Inventory/Storage to the Warehouse (or vice versa), you will now be able to proceed to the next process.

However, failures due to the volume limits or due to connectivity issues with the Central Market will result in a waiting time like before.



Node War Changes:

Tier 1 Nodes are now divided into Easy, Medium and Hard levels, each calibrated to enforce different max AP and DP caps.

We hope that this change will make Node Wars more accessible to newer Guilds, and Guilds first venturing into the Node War scene. These max AP and DP caps for each node was implemented to provide a more obtainable goal as adventurers participate in Node Wars.

This system was first implemented in the Black Desert Global Lab on February 28th, and tier 1 nodes were divided based on your feedback. Tier 1 Nodes are now divided into Easy, Medium and Hard levels, each with different AP and DP restrictions.

The max AP and DP calibrations will be applied to skills performed by characters and their summons in PvP, but not when they are mounted on guild mounts or siege weapons. Damage reduction rate will be calculated without taking in the DP calibrations into account.

Please note that the new AP and DP calibrations will be applied to all those who are in an area in which a Node War for a Tier 1 Node is taking place.
https://i.imgur.com/06HOqUi.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/3v85GlU.png
https://i.imgur.com/TmyXfmh.png


The total Node War tax pool has been increased by 5%.

The tax ratio for the Tier 1 - 4 Node Wars has changed like the following.
https://i.imgur.com/I0WsgKf.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/uKW1M2p.jpg


The amount of Node War individual rewards, Shining Medal of Honor, increased for the wins for each tier. Also, adventurers in the top 5% in regards to Contribution will receive more medals depending on the tiers.

Adventurers who are a part of a guild and join a Node War can obtain the Shining Medal of Honor by clicking on the rewards button after a Node War has ended. (The Node War in which the guild has participated must end in order for the adventurer to receive the rewards.)
Adventurers who do not accept the rewards after the end of a Node War cannot participate in the next Node War. 
The number of medals you can obtain are like the following.
https://i.imgur.com/E7W33VT.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/qTAwWdf.jpg



Updated 21/03/2019:

We would like to provide a little more information about the max AP/DP caps which were implemented for Tier 1 Node Wars.

Tier 1 Node Wars are now divided into Easy, Medium, and Hard. Each difficulty level has its own max AP/DP caps.

We'll take a look at a Tier 1 Easy Node War as an example.

For Easy Tier 1 Node War, the max AP cap is 230 and the max DP cap is 260.

Adventurers who have higher AP and DP than the max cap can still participate in the Easy Tier 1 Node War, but their AP and DP stats will be calibrated down to match the max AP and DP cap of the Easy Tier 1 Node War. These adventurers CANNOT receive AP and DP buffs from consumables such as food or elixirs (draughts). (However, the Damage Reduction Rate buffs will still be applied).

Adventurers who have stats below the max AP and DP cap CAN receive buffs from consumables such as food, elixirs, or Alchemy Stones to buff their stats up to the max caps.

The Damage Reduction Rate for DP will still apply for the sake of the adventurers who are mainly equipped with DP items rather than AP items.


Shadow Arena

The Shadow Arena rankings window has improved so that you can see rankings from monthly resets.

The records within the Accomplishments tab of My Information (P) while in Shadow Arena will no longer reset.

Fixed the issue where the minimize and close buttons would not function when playing in windowed mode.

The size of the time UI at the bottom of the Shadow Arena mini map has been adjusted.

Added character skill descriptions in the Shadow Arena.

Added a feature which shows you the skill descriptions of your current skills in Shadow Arena when you press the ALT key.



Fixed the issue where the View Skill Details part for certain languages were not applied properly in Shadow Arena.

Shadow Arena Rankings for both Solo/Party play will now reset at intervals of approximately every month starting with Mar. 27th maintenance. 

※ Please note that the reset schedule of rankings may change depending on the status of Shadow Arena. Resetting of the rankings will be announced beforehand via official channels.



Fixed an issue where an error would occur on the quick slot when possessing a character.

Fixed an issue where duplicate descriptions would appear in the quick slot.


Central Market

The Desired Purchase Price and Set Price will now stand out more conspicuously within the price list of the Purchase and Sell window at the Central Market.

Added a feature at the Central Market which shows you the Pearl Shop when there are items which are on sale in the Pearl Shop (F3).

Fixed the issue where a notification would not be displayed when registering pearl items at a higher price than the set price at the Central Market.

When using "Collect All" at the Central Market, the buff status for Value Packs will now be displayed in the descriptions.


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World:

Fixed the issue where trees would occasionally look abnormal.

You can no longer repeatedly receive the HP Potion (Beginner) from the Common Rack.


NPC:

After obtaining loot below from defeating boss monsters, you can now properly exchange the loot through NPC's at the Western Guard Camp.

*You can check the location of the NPC's by right-clicking on the items.

Red Nose's Blade Fragment
Giath's Mask Fragment
Bheg's Iron Mace Fragment




The conditions for interacting with the following NPC's at Kamasylvia have been removed.

Surichi
Leminei Lain
Mauriel
Obi Bellen
Rileysaman



Mounts

Fixed the issue where certain parts of the Horse portraits were abnormal.

Adjusted the sizes of the graphs which appear when you press the Mount list at the Stable in the World Map.

Changed the look of the description button at the bottom right of the Breeding Market and Horse Market windows which can be seen through the Stable menu.


Class Changes

All Classes:

Bonus AP/damage reduction effect that can be obtained for completing an Adventure Log or reaching Lv.56 and Lv.60 will now be properly applied to AP/DP increase effect that is activated when reaching certain level or certain stat.


By Class:

Berserker:

Fixed the issue where the target getting hit by the additional hit of the  Ultimate: Frenzied Destroyer skill would receive a melee AP buff as well.


Item Changes

The hitting effect for the [Combat] Trina Demolition Axe has been changed to reflect the direction of the hit.

Fixed the issue where you could not sell an item when the selling price was more than the amount of Silver you had in possession.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Adjusted the difficulty level of Dastard Bheg appearing from quests due to the renewal of the beginning quests.

The monsters near NPC Beedle have been relocated to ease the interaction with the NPC when going through the Finding a Way Out quest.

The number of Steel Imps in front of the Western Guard Camp has increased due to the renewal of the beginning quests.

You will no longer get Penalty for Death from getting killed by  the Fireballs summoned by Boss Giath from the Dark Rift.


Quests & Knowledge

The beginning stages of the main quests have been revamped.

The quests and balance of the monsters for the initial quests have been changed so that adventurers who are new to the Black Desert world can enjoy the growth of their characters.
New characters will now begin near the Ancient Stone Chamber instead of the Western Guard Camp.
Once new characters reach the Western Guard Camp, the characters will go through the same main quests as before.
Due to these changes, the difficulty level of monsters appearing during the quests for the Balenos area has been adjusted.
The Node Manager of the Ancient Stone Chamber will now be changed to the Stone Chamber Excavation Lead.
The knowledge for Node Manager - Jarette Domongatt has been changed to the Stone Chamber Excavation Lead, and the amount of energy consumed when obtaining the knowledge for the Ancient Stone Chamber from the Stone Chamber Excavation Lead will be changed from 10 to 0.
*Characters who were going through the previous main quests cannot go through these revamped quests. Instead, they will continue with their current quests.
The auto-navigate for "The Isolated Supply Route" quest has been changed to navigate you to where the Gray Wolves are located.
The amount of small potions given out as rewards up until arriving at Velia has been slightly increased.

Characters who were going through the previous main quests cannot go through these revamped quests. Instead, they will continue with their current quests.
Characters going through the revamped main quests can obtain knowledge through the following quests.

Ancient Stone Chamber, Mural of Experience I
Ancient Stone Chamber, Mural of Experience II
Ancient Stone Chamber, Mural of Experience III
Ancient Stone Chamber, Mural of Experience IV
Ancient Stone Chamber, Mural of Experience V

You can obtain the quests through Igor Bartali right before enter Heidel (starting from Velia while going through main quests).
Characters who begin their adventures from the Western Guard Camp (not the Ancient Stone Chamber) cannot receive the quests above.




You can now properly go through the following quests, which you go through at Western Guard Camp.

Desperate Soldiers



Tether Stronger
Report to Feinia
Fixed an unnatural description for the knowledge for "A Spineless Strategy".
You can now receive various rewards, such as items for equipment enhancement, by completing part I of main quests in Valencia.



The following quests can now be normally completed at the Western Guard Camp

Desperate Soldiers
Tether Stronger
Report to Feinia



Fixed the issue where you were able to continue to receive the "No Longer Human" quests even after completing the "Finding Clues" quest.

When you complete "The Securing of Safe Passage" quest while going through the crossroads [III] main quests, the Black Spirit will now be summoned and you can now receive "The Delphe Knights in Chaos" quest.

Fixed the issue where a quest you cannot accept (The Story of the Hero Borne Upon the Winds quest) would be displayed on the quest widget.


Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where the underwear button beneath the equipment window would not be displayed when you enter and then leave the equipment repair screen.

Improvements have been made to the Adventure Log within the ESC menu.

When you close and then re-open the ESC menu's Adventure Log, the recently selected bookshelf will now appear.
Added a sound effect which plays when you open the ESC menu's Adventure Log.



Due to the removal of the limits to the amount of Silver you can possess, you can now select where to receive your Silver when you sell items worth more than 500,000 Silver at NPC's.

Added a feature which displays the amount of materials needed for enhancing gear when more than 2 materials are consumed for the enhancement.

Improved the Black Spirit's Safe UI.

Certain parts of the Black Spirit's Safe has been re-designed.
The number of rewards you can receive will now be displayed beneath the Black Spirit's Safe.
The icon on the bottom right which used to show the total number of items will now show the number of rewards.
Added a sound effect when receiving Silver.



Fixed the issue where the size of the quest icons above NPC heads would appear abnormal.

Improved the Node button description for Tier 1 Node wars in the World Map (M) by displaying Easy, Medium, and Hard on the Node button.

The amount of Flawless Magic Black Stones/Cleansed Magic Black Stones/Stabilized Magic Black Stones will now be displayed for 100% Enhancement Chance enhancements.

The borders of the quest icon above the NPC heads will now change color depending on the type and progress of the quests.

Added descriptions about Horoscopes when selecting Horoscopes in the character creation process.

The character introduction clips which are displayed when creating characters will now show the Awakening clips first.

Due to the change in the location of where new characters begin, the contents and location of the tutorial has also changed.

Changed the shapes of the buttons which appear when you die (Guild Resurrection, Observe Mode, Ally Viewpoint, Exit, Revive at Outer Gate, Revive at Inner Gate, Black Spirit Spectate Mode buttons).

Added a feature in the Mount list (from the Stable at the World Map) which shows the amount of time remaining for Breeding.

Fixed the issue where workers purchased from the NPC Amity and then registered at the Worker Exchange would appear as if Promotion was available.

The Promotion button will no longer be displayed for Workers without enough Amity for promotions.

The Pearl Inventory will open by default for outfit extractions.

Fixed the issue for the Transaction Maid/Butler where the first slot's weight and quantity would not be applied when using the Transaction Maid.

Fixed the issue where the Black Spirit's Safe would display a "0" when there was more than a certain amount of Silver rewards accumulated.

Fixed the issue where the amount of wage would be incorrectly displayed when collecting wage from the Guild Mission tab in the Guild (G) window.


Resolved Issues

System:

Fixed the issue where registering a Maid/Butler would occasionally make you log out.


Class Changes:

Lahn:

Fixed the issue where certain customizations while equipped with Garnet Marniera Headpiece would make the hair look unnatural.

Fixed the issue where the decorations of the right hip area would appear unnatural when in non-awakening combat mode while equipped with the Garnet Marniera outfit.


Interface Changes:

Fixed the issue where a message would appear and say that you discovered a node when exploring near Duvencrune Mountain.


Quest:

The incomplete [Special Gift] Travelling Light II quests have been completed and the missing Value Pack (7 Days) reward has been distributed to all affected adventurers.


Known Issues

We are aware of the issue where the Skill Guide icon is not being properly displayed. This will be resolved with Apr. 3rd maintenance.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - March 13th 2019 (Part 1)
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/rQ6iaPB.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Our 3rd Anniversary continues with Special Attendance rewards. Additionally we know you have all been waiting and we are excited to announce that the Glimmering Old Moon event, also known as the “Tri Accessory” event, is beginning!

The highly requested Black Spirit’s Rage has been added to certain skills! Enjoy battling with these new abilities that are sure to give you a tactical advantage. As always, thank you for your continued support and we look forward to hearing what you think!


Event & System

New Events:

Glimmering Old Moon event will start.

Event Period: Mar. 14 00:00 UTC - Apr. 10 23:59 UTC
Complete special quests from the Old Moon Guild to get TRI accessories!
Click  to find out more about this surprise event!



Cron Collector event will start.

Event Period: Mar. 13 after maintenance - Mar. 27 before maintenance
During the event period, collect [Event] Sky Blue Lollipop item through defeating monsters, gathering, and fishing. Depending on the amount of lollipops you collect, you can exchange them for the [Event] Cron Stone Box I, II, and III from certain NPCs and open them for Cron Stones!
Click  to find out more about this event!



3rd Anniversary Special Attendance will be held.

The 3-week attendance special rewards to celebrate the 3rd anniversary is available! Check daily under the Special tab from your attendance rewards UI window.
Event Period: Mar. 14 00:00 UTC - Apr. 10 23:59 UTC



Ongoing Events:

Get a +15 Cliff's Weapon!: Feb.27 - Mar. 20 before maintenance

Gratitude of Black Spirit: Mar. 6 - Mar. 20 before maintenance

Black Spirit’s Adventure 1: Mar. 6 - Mar. 27 before maintenance


Ended Events:

A Box of Wonders


Reward Distribution:

Shadow Arena Countdown Rewards

We have sent out all missing rewards for Shadow Arena Countdown rewards. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you once again for your understanding.



Shadow Arena Bonus Mission Event Rewards

Reward for completing Bonus Mission twice: Advice of Valks (35-45) x1
Reward for completing Bonus Mission once: [Event] Lauren Family Gift Box x3

You can obtain both rewards if you complete Bonus Mission twice.




Content:

A “Black Spirit’s Safe” feature has been added.

You can receive Shadow Arena rewards and Family Fame Funds through the Black Spirit’s Safe.
You can access Black Spirit’s Safe through an icon in the bottom right.
The Family Fame Fund will now be distributed to the Black Spirit’s Safe. The amount distributed will be notified via mail.



Added the Arsha's Chest exclusive for Trial Characters.

The item can be purchased from NPC Haz (exclusive for Trial Characters) at the Battle Arena.
You can obtain equipment for your class when opening Arsha's Chest.



Added a feature which allows you to extract materials used when crafting the Fiery Nouver and Fiery Kutum Sub-weapon.

The Mirror of Equilibrium is required in order to use the extraction feature.
You can obtain the Inverted Heart of Garmoth and Nouver/Kutum Sub-weapon when extracting the Fiery Nouver and Fiery Kutum Sub-weapon.
The Inverted Heart of Garmoth can be registered at the Central Market.
The Mirror of Equilibrium can be purchased from NPC Hughol at Duvencrune.
The Extraction feature is available through the Blacksmith NPC's of each town.



System:

The start and end times of Node/Conquest Wars, as well as the departure times of Tribute Wagons will now be as follows, to observe daylight saving hours in our NA servers.

Fixed the issue where the chat would not be displayed on the top center area when using the ! prefix on the Guild/Arsha chat window.

When extracting materials from the Fiery Nouver and Fiery Kutum Sub-weapon while their durability is depleted, the weapon's durability will not recover.

The limitations to the amount of Silver you can have has been removed. Now you can have more than 100,000,000 Silver.

Fixed the issue where the War Hero title would reset during maintenance.

You can now whisper to the Game Masters even when you are playing in Privacy Mode.


Central Market

Fixed the issue where the search results were not matching the type of search when you search without ever changing the search type (All, By Category) at the Central Market.

Fixed the issue where the [Register] button at the Sell window would not be displayed normally in certain languages for the Central Market.

Fixed the issue where the prices in the graphs of the Central Market's Orders/Sell window would be negative numbers.

The default search settings when searching for items at the Central Market has been set to “All” instead of “By Category”.


Shadow Arena

The damage dealt by the following skills has been changed, due to the skills also being changed in main gameplay. Please refer to the rest of the Patch Notes for more details on the skill changes of individual classes. 

Warrior

Kick



Sorceress

High Kick
Low Kick



Musa, Maehwa

Upper Kick



Valkyrie

Flurry of Kicks



Striker    

Taeback Kick

Soul Basher

The Bonus Missions window will expand when the descriptions for the missions are long.

Fixed the issue where the time remaining and skill descriptions would overlap in resolutions lower than 1600 * 900.

Added a sound effect which plays when the Boss Red Nose appears and dies in the Shadow Arena.

When the screen occasionally freezes on the loading screen (where a black screen appears and displays a "Please wait" text), the loading screen will now close after a certain period of time.

Fixed the issue where the Silver rewards were not displayed properly in the rewards menu within the Shadow Arena lobby.

The notification icon which appears at the top right while in Shadow Arena will continue to be displayed when Shadow Arena is opened or when you reconnect.

The Shadow Arena banner on the bottom right side of the screen will no longer be displayed when you cannot enter Shadow Arena.

Game World:

A giant mysterious object appeared near the Ancient Stone Chamber.

Jarette Domongatt is now the Stone Chamber Excavation lead.
The knowledge entry for Jarette Domongatt has been changed accordingly.
You will not consume Energy when obtaining the Ancient Stone Chamber knowledge from the Stone Chamber Excavation Lead.

notes.title: Patch Notes - March 6th 2019
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/rQ6iaPB.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Have you ever doubted about choosing the perfect class for your playstyle? We know this is a hard choice with 17 classes to choose from, therefore with this week's update we have a new system that will let you try all classes in-game at high level. 

Meanwhile enjoy the new anniversary event starting this week where you will be able to earn silvers and do not forget there’s so much more to come in our month-long anniversary celebration!


Event & System

New Events:

Gratitude of Black Spirit

Event Period: Mar. 6 after maintenance - Mar. 20 before maintenance
Event 1: During the event period, defeat monsters, gather, and fish to obtain the items [Event] 3rd Anniversary Thanks and [Event] 3rd Anniversary Love which you can align in your Inventory bag and combine to create the item [Event] Together until the 100th Anniversary! [Event] Together until the 100th Anniversary! will be worth more Silver!
Click  to find out more about the celebratory event!



Black Spirit’s Adventure 1 is back.

Event Period: Mar. 6 after maintenance  - Mar. 27 before maintenance
The popular Black Spirit’s Adventure 1 is back in style. New addition to the possible reward list is Valk’s Cry!



Ongoing Events:

Get a +15 Cliff's Weapon!: Feb.27 - Mar. 20 before Maintenance

A Box of Wonders: Ferb. 27 - Mar.13 before Maintenance


Content:

Trial Characters are here.

You will have at max 3 Trial Character slots available.
Start in Battle Arena at Lv. 60! You can also try Red Battlefield, Arena of Arsha, and Savage Rift with your Trial Character.
4,000 Skill Points are given.
NPC Haz in Battle Arena operates an exclusive shop selling various gear, accessories, and items at 1 Silver.
You can purchase Arsha's Chest from NPC Haz starting next week (after the maintenance on March 13th). However, note that you do not need Arsha's Chest in order to play through the Trial Character content.
Click  to find out more about Trial Characters.



Fixed the issue where Transport would not work between Epheria and Altinova.


System:

Fiery Nouver and Fiery Kutum items can no longer be registered to Central Market.

Any relevant items listed for sale up to today’s maintenance have been sold and any uncollected Silver (of your listed Order) will be sent via in-game mailbox (B). 
A new function to extract Inverted Heart of Garmoth will be added with Mar. 13 maintenance.



Increased the speed of automatically adjusting the screen brightness when playing on Remastered Mode or higher settings.

Added a feature which allows the in-game announcement to be displayed for a certain period of time.

Fixed the issue where Silver received through Storage for an item on NPC Shops would disappear intermittently.

Any picture/video taken using Ansel function can now only be performed when your character has full HP.

If a crash occurs during your play in Black Desert Online, your character will be applied Invincible effect so that your character will be unharmed.
We have found an abuse related to this feature and thus the function to allow shooting of pictures/videos using Ansel function will be available only when your character has full HP.



Shadow arena

The guide UI regarding direction and possessing into characters has been improved.

The location of the guide has been changed so that it will no longer hinder the sight. 



Fixed the issue where intermittent crashing of client occurred even when a match of Shadow Arena was not finished.

You can now customize your hotkeys for Shadow Arena Quick Slots (Settings -> Interface). This is to reduce the inconvenience experienced by keyboards with different layouts depending on your country. (However, note that the changes you make to your Shadow Arena Quick Slot hotkeys will remain in normal gameplay as well).

https://i.imgur.com/BcYgvoe.jpg
If unchanged, the default setting on Hotkeys will be applied for your Shadow Arena play.



Fixed the text overlapping issue with the Survival Time text and its actual clock time in the minimap during a match in Shadow Arena.

When in spectator mode in a Shadow Arena party match, you will now automatically spectate party members after loading when party members are far away even without having to press the spectate button again.

The Black Spirit flying sequence will no longer play when you start a practice match.

Fixed the issue where Striker, Ninja, and Maehwa would not be displayed in the Shadow Arena Stats window.

Changed the design of the UI which appears when you die in Shadow Arena.

The Shadow Arena banner on the bottom right corner will not appear anymore when Shadow Arena is not open.

Your mic volume on Windows will  no longer be affected from controlling the mic volume of your Voice Chat in Shadow Arena.


Sorceress:

Fixed the issue where the command combo could not be performed during cooldown of the skill Darkness Released.


Tamer:

Fixed the issue where the command combo would connect to the skill Soaring Kick and not Surging Tide as it should after using Heilang: Trample.


Witch/Wizard:

Fixed the issue where the skill Multiple Magic Arrows used during cooldown would not connect to the next skill when performing one command combo.


Ninja:

Fixed the issue where the command combo would connect to the skill Shadow Stomp after using Ankle Cutter.


Valkyrie:

Fixed the issue where the skills Judgment of Light and Divine Power would not be activated even when they are not in cooldown when performing the command combos. 

The following skills for these classes have had its damage adjusted.
https://i.imgur.com/SS1d1Ta.jpg

Boss monsters (Bheg, Giath, and Muskan) will now target other adventures who have not hit them as well. 

You should now start automatically spectating your party members after the loading screen, even when they are far away.


Central Market

You can now search with one letter at the Central Market.

Fixed the issue where the "Exceeded the maximum number of items that can be searched at once." message appeared when you searched for certain words.

A tax discount will be applied to the taxes for selling items at the Central Market in all cases. The discount amount will depend on the Family Fame like the below:

Family Fame of 1,000 - 3,999: Silver Collected from the Market +0.5%
Family Fame of 4,000 - 6,999: Silver Collected from the Market +1%
Family Fame of 7,000 or higher: Silver Collected from the Market +1.5%



Max Price for items sold by NPCs that can be registered to Central Market has been changed for the following items:

Certain Crystal items
Cannon Ball items
Wagons Registrations



Added a button in the Central Market which allows you to conveniently select the Max Price or Min Price when selecting the desired price.

Fixed the issue where you intermittently could not select the Min Price items among the items listed at the Central Market.

Added text at the Central Market which shows the tax benefits you can receive in the Central Market.

The Central Market's 'Set Price' window's scrollbar has changed as follows:

Sell: If there are items listed, it will be placed below the Min. price of the items listed. If there are no items listed, it will be placed at the Max price.
Order: If there are orders, it will be placed right above the Max price of the orders. If there are no orders, it will be placed at the Min. price.



Added a notification about selling at the bottom right of the Central Market for the following situations:

When an order has been purchased.
When an item listed has been sold.



Added a button which allows you to sort by item grade at the Central Market.
 
The conditions for the initial purchase desired price in the purchase window of the Central Market has changed.

When there are items listed: The lowest price among the items listed will be selected.
When there are orders placed: The price immediately above the highest price of orders will be selected.
When there are no orders placed and no items listed, the lowest price will be selected.


 
The scrollbar on the Set Price window will be adjusted according to the initial desired price for purchase/sales in the Central Market's Purchase/Sell window.

Fixed the issue where the scrollbar would unnecessarily reset for the Warehouse item list.
 
A graph that shows the Central Market prices has been added to the Sell UI to help you grasp the market value of items and help you Set Prices.

You can check the Unit Price (in Silvers) on top-right corner of the graph to view information of expensive items easily.
For example, when the Unit Price is 1,000 and the graph of an item hits 100 on the Y-axis, that means the item’s real price is 100,000 Silver. 



Fixed the issue where pressing Space key on the Buy and Sell window in Central Market would make the character Jump.


Game World, NPC & Effects

NPC:

The NPC that gives positive effects to the Elionism in Heidel has been renamed as  Arsen.

A Stone Pagoda that gives positive effect upon praying on it while offering Gold Bars has been added to Duvencrune area.

This Stone Pagoda is located near guard captain Guntama Diouf.



A button to exchange 1 Asula’s Crimson Eye Accessory to 2 Asula's Weakened Magic Accessories has been added to the following NPCs who can exchange Asula Accessories. This button will only be activated if you have more than 1 Asula’s Crimson Eye Accessory in possession.

Yisar Pjetyo of Tarif
Lasmin of Rock Post
Belgar of Altinova
Binvane of Sand Grain Bazaar



Mounts

Enhanced the performance of beginner horses to help new Adventurers in their journey.

Horse Emblem: Beginner's Brown Horse
Horse Emblem: Beginner's Maroon Horse
Horse Emblem: Beginner's Gray Horse

Speed and Accel have increased by 20%.
Turn and Brake have increased by 10%.




The graphical effect that appears when inflicting damage from the Ballista has been changed.

Text regarding gender of the horses has been added to Horse Emblem items.

Ballista will no longer apply Back Attack effect.

Fixed the issue where Mounts could not be recovered from the Stable NPC when the number of the mount's death was higher than 256.

Fixed the erroneous item descriptions of the item Horse Emblem: Beginner's Maroon Horse.


Class Changes

All Classes:

Fixed the issue where the character movement would be unnatural when clicking on the Ship icon to board while in a position to recover Stamina by pressing Q while swimming.

Characters will now stop swimming right away when releasing hotkeys like Q or E after diving.

Swimming movement will be more natural when you press Q while diving.



Changed graphical effects that appear when leveling up.


By Class:

Warrior:

You can now use the Forward Slash or Shield Charge skills while using the basic attack, Slash.

You can now combo more quickly to other skills after the final hit of Slash.


Sorceress:

When in Scythe mode, you can now use the Night Crow skill in midair up to 3 times consecutively.

The damage of Ultimate: Dark Flame will now inflict damage based on the obtained skill level of Dark Flame.

Fixed the issue where damage reduction has been applied to all skill levels during Dark Flame's cooldown.


Berserker:

For the Feral Rage Rabam Skill, the final hit will now be activated when pressing LMB after pressing Shift + X.

Increased the speed of the initial sprint motion when moving while in Main weapon mode.

The character will now combo into Ground Lifting when you press spacebar after the additional hits for Predatory Hunt, Headbutt, and Frenzied Destroyer.

When you maintain W+F+RMB while using the Giant Leap skill forwards, the Streak Leap skill will activate first.

When you press A/D+LMB or RMB after Ultimate: Fierce Strike attack, the left/right basic attack or Shake Off skill will activate.

When you press A/D+LMB+RMB after using Shake Off, the final hit for Raging Thunder will activate first.


Maehwa:

You can now use the Petal Drill skill when pressing Shift + LMB during Main weapon mode.


Ninja:

Added the Forward Guard effect up until before the attacking motion for the Ninjutsu: Shadow Stomp II-Absolute: Shadow Stomp skills.

When getting hit or when making the Forward Guard motion before attacking with the Ninjutsu: Shadow Stomp skill, the character will now immediately attack.

Increased the beginning attack speed of the Ninjutsu: Shackles skill.


Kunoichi:

The beginning attack speed has been increased for the Flash Slash skill.

Added the Forward Guard effect up until before the attacking motion for the Ninjutsu: Shadow Stomp II-Absolute: Shadow Stomp skills.

When getting hit or when making the Forward Guard motion before attacking with the Ninjutsu: Shadow Stomp skill, the character will now immediately attack.

Increased the beginning attack speed of the Ninjutsu: Shackles skill.


Dark Knight:

Stamina will now be recovered while using Shattering Darkness, Trap of Vedir, and Flow: Bombardment.

Fixed typos in the skill descriptions for Twilight Dash and Spirit Hunt.


Mystic:

Fixed the issue where Jumping while Sprinting would only be performed when doing standing Jump in Awakening mode.


Lahn:

The following effects have been added to Blood Moon Twist.

All DP +10 for 10 sec. when using the skill.



When pressing RMB while holding W+Shift during the Bloody Stride skill or sprinting, Flailing Blades now be prioritized.

Effects will now properly be displayed when using Eye of the Phoenix after using certain skills.


Archer:

Improved the graphics such as the impact effect, direction of blood splatter, and attacking directions when hitting targets with the following skills.

Ascending Spirit
Ensnare
Radiant Explosion
Uproot
Piercing Light
Flow: Light's Trail
Righteous Smite
Low Sweep
Ravenous Talon



Item Changes

Fixed the issue where some of the gear NPCs Grandus and Ronatz were selling did not appear on the shop list.

Removed the level restrictions for equipping the Archer Awakening weapon, Katan Greatbow.

(You can equip Katan Greatbow starting from Lv. 1)



Added a feature which guides you to the nearest Storage Keeper when right-clicking on Gold Bar items.

Fixed the item descriptions of Horse Emblem: Beginner's Maroon Horse.

The Permanent Enhancement Chance value gained from completing goals for Adventure/Travel Logs will be obtainable at max +5.

NOTE: This maximum number of value that can be gained will be available in the near future when further expansion of Adventure/Travel Log contents become updated.



The exchange button will only be displayed from the NPC's when you have the Dark Spirit's Greed.

The Inverted Heart of Garmoth can now be registered at the Central Market.

Fixed the issue where Desert Tent Toll could not be sold in NPC Shops.

Fixed the issue where Design: Karlstein item could not be sold in NPC Shops.

Fixed the issue where the destination target of auto-navigation came out wrong when right-clicking on the Cyclops Summon Scroll.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

The Goblins near Node Manager NPC Beedle at Cron Castle Site have gone home.

Increased the chance of obtaining "Magic Crystal of Infinity - Critical Hit" by 50% when defeating monsters at Manes Hideout.

Added the following Monster Zones of Mediah to the list places where you can defeat monsters for a chance to obtain the "Magic Crystal of Infinity - Critical Hit" item.

Elric Shrine
Soldier's Grave
Marni's 2nd Lab



The location of spawn for Boss Ferrid from Dark Rift has changed to inside the Omar Lava Cave.

This location is easier to auto-navigate to and does not overlap with the spawn location where Guild boss monster spawns.



Quests & Knowledge

Quest:

Cyclops will no longer instantly spawn during the quest Retrieve a Sealing Stone.

After accepting the quest, you need to interact (R) with a specific Dark Portal to spawn a Cyclops.



Changed the method for obtaining the knowledge for the Central Neutral Zone, which has become impossible to obtain due to the main quest renewals.

You can check the changed method through the knowledge hint.



Removed the repetitive contents of the quest summary for [Alchemy Lv24] Make a Crystal Yourself.

Fixed the issue where the quest fish could not be caught in the "Tapertail Anchovy and Skipjack" and "Problem Fish" quest area.

Fixed the issue where rewards for completing Extra Quests given in a specific areas was not being received properly.

Quest completion count of a deleted character will not be tallied to your Family.


Knowledge:

The text for the following knowledge has been changed:

Mariam
Shen Merchant Guild
Companion of Shultz
Carcass of Shultz the Gladiator
Maudi Budar



The content of the hints that can be seen if the following Knowledges haven’t been obtained yet has been improved.
https://i.imgur.com/ZnayfER.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/knLm6M4.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/6SDeFAM.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/0jheLxd.jpg



Interface Changes

Added “Carefully” and “Boldly” button text to the descriptions for the Bargain window for Trading.

NPC that can only be met during a quest will no longer be searchable through Find NPC function.

Find NPC will only locate NPCs that are always present in the game world.



Improved the alignment within the Character Transport window (the title of the window, destination, character list, scroll bar).

Added the following description next to the cut scene's play button within conversation windows:

Click to Play Cutscene



Changed the text about skipping the animation being displayed when you attempt Caphras Enhancements:

Skip Enhancement Animation → Skip Animation


 
The image that appears when selecting Optional reward for a quest completion reward has been changed.
 
Fixed the issue where the attendance check tab would not be displayed properly after you have claimed all of the attendance rewards.
 
Fixed the issue where Apply for Vacation and Return from Vacation buttons were not being displayed even after the Guild Master has appointed a new Guild Master.

The following text will now be displayed when an adventurer without a Value Pack active sells an item through Central Market.

You can receive a X% bonus with an active Value Pack.



Fixed the issue where some of the text in the Buy/Sell UI did not appear in Central  Market.


Resolved Issues

System:

Fixed the issue where you were able to build forts in Node War areas where it was not intended to allow you to create forts.


Class Changes:

Wizard:

Fixed the issue where different gloves would be exposed upon equipping gloves after wearing [Wizard] Crescent Moon Clothes.


Maehwa:

Fixed the issue where the character would appear graphically broken when in a sitting position or in a Retaliation Stance while wearing the Ladybell outfit.

Fixed the issue where there would be a big shade casted on on the face when selecting the 6th hairstyle.


Lahn:

Fixed the issue where the character would appear graphically broken when in the sitting position while wearing the Sanguine underwear.

Fixed the issue where the upper part of the [Lahn] Sanguine Petal outfit would look unnatural while walking.


Item Changes:

Fixed the issue where the Life EXP Boost would not be applied properly when activating the following items:

[Event] 3rd Anniversary Cake

From the fix above, the number of times you can use the [Event] 3rd Anniversary Cake’s buff has been reset. If the item has been removed, it will be distributed back to you through the in-game mail (B) with today’s maintenance.




Quests & Knowledge:

Fixed a typo in the quest summary of The Story of Glish.

Fixed the issue where Qoobe would spawn instantly upon accepting the quest [To Level 50!] Giant Catfishman Qoobe.

Fixed the issue where interacting with Dark Portal was not possible during the quest [Co-op] Stop Illezra's Plot.

Fixed the issue where the Dark Portal was not spawning during the quest [Co-op] Defeat the Weakened Belmorn!


Interface Changes:

Fixed the issue where the effect which appears when you bring the mouse cursor over the skill icon would disappear when selecting a skill in the Pet exchange window.

Removed the line break in the middle of the description in the Family Name Change window.

Fixed the issue where the text within the Add Guild button and Remove Guild button would bleed out of the buttons in the Alliance tab of the Guild window (G).

The Inventory and Warehouse will no longer block the conversation window when you click on the Warehouse button within the Storage.

Fixed the issue where the attendance check tab would not be displayed properly after you have claimed all of the attendance rewards.

Fixed the issue where text would bleed out of the Enhancement window when enhancing items which can be safely enhanced.

Fixed the issue where the 'Permanent Enhancement Chance' text would bleed out of the Total Family Bonus window from the Adventure Journal window.

Fixed the issue where the "Unoccupied Territory" text would bleed out of the minimized Conquest War window.

Fixed the issue where inactive buff icons would be displayed.

Fixed the graphical issue where the reward icon would appear to go out of the slot in the Quest Rewards window after having completed a quest.

Fixed the issue where the background of the Set Price window located on the right side of Sell window was not being shown properly.


Known Issue

Updated 11/03/2019

We are aware of the issue where the title “Fighter,” which you can get from playing War Hero, is not being given out. We will resolve the issue with the Mar. 13th maintenance.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Presenting the Official Kakao Games Discord (Now Open)
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/dpxgNUI.png

As part of our efforts to be closer to the community, we will be opening up an official Kakao Games discord server.

We will be adding a number of features that we hope will improve the service that we offer and enhance your experience of Black Desert Online and all future Kakao Games titles.

Announcement Bot

Our server will have a bot that will bring you all the news from our website and forum pages, directly into Discord, meaning you can stay up to date with all the latest events and news, without having to check the pages individually. Furthermore, via webhooks, you will be able to integrate this bot into your own Discord server, be it a small guild server or one of the larger Discord communities that are already out there.

Customer Support Integration

You will be able to submit a ticket directly from Discord and receive your answer there. With a simple bot command, your message will be picked up and delivered directly to the Game Master team. Whilst we won’t be able to answer every type of ticket via Discord as we won’t be able to link it to your game account, we can answer simple questions and take player reports, hopefully streamlining the support service to you.

Going Live

If you’re a streamer and a partner, you’ll be able to broadcast to the server when you go live, keeping people informed of your activity and hopefully growing your own community.

Road Map

As there are a number of features to test and because we want to hear your feedback, we will be rolling out invites in waves. Our tentative schedule is as follows:-

- Alpha Phase: March 6th:

We will invite 500 handpicked community members to our server to ensure that all the functionality is working as intended and to listen to your feedback on how you want the server to be. We are looking specifically for community and guild leaders as well as content creators. So if you already have an established community, please apply for this phase so we can establish how the server will best support you.

- Beta Phase: March 13th:

We will invite 3500 random applicants. This will give us a chance to see how everything works with a larger group.

- Fully Open: March 20th:

On March 20th we will open the gates to everyone and let all hell break loose. By this time we hope the bot hasn’t yet become self-aware and that the server set-up is the best it can possibly be to meet your needs.

Please note: This schedule is subject to change based on how many broken things we find.

What’s next?

Head over to the sign-up page and register for an invite, it will just take you a few seconds. If you are chosen, you will receive an invite through Discord on one of the above dates.

*Steam Users

For those playing on Steam that would like to sign-up for the Kakao Games Discord, just create a trial account on our website and send your apply. Having a game account linked to your e-mail is not necessary.


We look forward to hanging out more with you.


Updated 20/03/209:

Discord is now fully open for everyone. Come and join us!

https://discordapp.com/invite/kakaogames


-BDO Team

Quests & Knowledge

Quests:

The method of using boss scrolls to summon and fight a boss monster during main quests has changed to the method where you have to interact with a Dark Rift to summon and fight a boss monster.

Fixed the issue where the quest The First Sailboat Bound to Margoria was not progressing normally.

Fixed the awkwardness in how Karcenov addressed players when they hand over the Calpheon Defense Token.

Fixed the issue where the NPC dialogue was awkward during the Clear Justification quest.

The knowledge hint for the Stone Mountain Turtle Dragon has been revised from being Stone Mountain Iguana to Stone Mountain Turtle Dragon.

The "Karlstein Outfit Crafting: The One Who Follows the Path of Vetor" quest will be displayed in the Suggested tab after you press the 'O' key.

The Slave Becomes Master
The Cost of Labor

Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where you were able to use Transport function change with characters below Lv. 5 in the End Game window.

When you purchase an item from the Pearl Shop (F3) while your Inventory (I) is opened, your Inventory will now automatically refresh.

The durability notification will no longer be displayed when the durability is low for tools which cannot be repaired.

The accumulated number of trades will now be displayed when you search at the Central Market.
 
An icon will now be displayed in the Trade section of the tab which shows quests in progress within the Quests window.
 
Since Safe Enhance (+1~7 for Weapon/+1~5 for Armor) is not affected by increased Enhancement Chance, it will now display a description about Safe Enhance instead of displaying a description about Enhancement Chance.
 
The Apply button can no longer be selected when you do not have any items applicable to Item Brand/Item Brand Removal.
 
The Optimization (Beta) menu has been removed from Settings > Performance Settings, and the options from the menu have been merged into the Optimization menu.

The "Update Cycle Optimization" settings have been removed from the Game Settings -> Performance Settings -> Optimization (beta) menu.
 
The Graphic Quality menu has been moved to be at the top of the Performance Settings menu.
 
Fixed the issue where text would bleed out of the skill guide window for the German version.

You can now set a hotkey for Adventure Log icon via Settings > Interface Settings > UI Hotkeys.
