notes.title: Patch Notes - November 21st 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/F3mdyjX.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

As we gear up for the yearly tradition of eating too much food we want to make sure everyone can get into the holiday spirit. The ‘Roast Turkey Feast’ returns! Defeat monsters, gather, or fish away for a chance to obtain your very own Roast Turkey Feast! For those who are not in the appetite for some turkey, you can chase after the golden geese for some golden eggs!

Another great tradition is the famous Black Friday sale! In honor of this event we will be having exclusive sales just for you in the pearl shop. Check out our amazing deals now.


Event & System

New events:

Celebrating Millions Part 3 Continued…

Event 7: 1,000% Boost

Event Period: 11/23  ~ 11/25
During this special weekend, enjoy 1,000% Combat EXP boost!
To provide a better experience for the event, the Olvia servers 5 through 8 will be switched to Drieghan (Normal) servers 1 through 4 temporarily after the maintenance on November 21st (Wed).
Check the event page for exact schedule.



Event 8: Light up the Skies

[EU] Fri. 11/23/2018: Exact time will be announced shortly.
[NA] Fri. 11/23/2018: Exact time will be announced shortly.
During this grand finale, enjoy the fireworks display from the coast of Velia.



Check details of the grand finale again !



A Box of Wonders

Event Period: 11/21 After Maintenance ~ 12/12 Before Maintenance
During this special event period, purchase Shakatu's Luxury Box and Shakatu's Rarity Box with Silver from the Pearl Shop (F3)!
Click  to see this luxurious event in detail.



Roast Turkey Feast

Event Period: 11/21 After Maintenance ~ 12/5 Before Maintenance
During this Thanksgiving period, obtain the following items through Defeating Monsters, Fishing, and Gathering: [Event] Turkey Meat, [Event] Cranberry Sauce, and [Event] Mashed Potato which can be combined to make [Event] Roast Turkey Feast!
Click  to find out more about this festive event!



Golden Goose Egg

Event Period: 11/21 After Maintenance ~ 12/5 Before Maintenance
During the event, search for the golden geese that lay Golden Goose Egg which can be exchanged for big prizes!
Click  to check this golden event out!



BDO Calendar 2019

Help us design our BDO Calendar 2019!
Start Submission Date: November 21, 2018 (After Maintenance)
Final Submission Date: December 5, 2018
Voting Period: December 7 to December 10, 2018
Winners Announced: December 11, 2018
Season Dates:

Autumn Orange Trees (Sept, Oct, Nov): Nov 21 - Nov 28
Spring Cherry Blossoms (March, April, May): Nov 28 - Nov 30
Summer Roses (June, July, Aug): Nov 30 - Dec 3
Winter + Snow (Dec, Jan, Feb): Dec 3 - Dec 5 (Effects Will Remain Until Jan 16)



Please click  for full event details and how to submit your screenshot!



Ongoing Events:

King Targargo Rises: 11/14 After Maintenance ~ 12/05 Before Maintenance

Don’t forget to face off the menacing King Targargo at Fleme Hills for awesome prizes!



Celebrating Millions Part 1: 10/31 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance

Celebrating Millions Part 2: 11/7 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance

Celebrating Millions Part 3: 11/14 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance

1,000% EXP Boost and Fireworks headed your way!



Double Boss Drop: 11/7 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance

Drieghan Opening Event: 11/14 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance

Guild Missions x5: 11/14 After Maintenance ~ 12/12 Before Maintenance

Loyal Attendance Rewards: 11/15 00:00 UTC ~ 12/19 23:59 UTC


Reward Distribution:

Fixed the issue where the Guild Skill EXP increase rate for Guild Quest rewards would not be applied properly.

The Guild Skill EXP which was not acquired due to this issue from November 14th through November 21st will be distributed to the Guild Master on November 28th.



Content:

If a guild has built a Node War Fort after a Conquest War Fort/Command Post/Field HQ and an Annex, the Annexes of their ally guilds can be seen by other adventurers when they participate in a Node War where the forts are. To prevent this, a Node War Fort can no longer be built after the same guild already built a Conquest War Fort/Command Post/Field HQ. Please build your Node War Fort first to prevent not being able to participate in the Node War.

New guild skills have been added.
https://i.imgur.com/pUVI5Eg.png


System:

Client crashing and lag issues that occurred in large-scale battles, Node Wars, and Conquest Wars have been reduced. 


Mounts

Fixed the issue where the mount skill guide would not show the skill used when using the drifting skill through the S+D command while riding a horse.


Class Changes

All Classes:

Made improvements so that Rabam’s Enhanced skills can be directly used through control keys (Shift+Z/Shift+X) while in Awakening combat mode. After using a Rabam’s Enhanced skill while in an Awakening combat mode, the character will switch to the main weapon stance.

The max number of monsters which can be attracted has been increased from 7 to 10 targets.
 
The summoned objects such as Tamer’s Heilang or Wizard’s Lava Field will be categorized differently by ‘summoned objects’ and ‘summoned creatures’. To even out the total number of monsters that can be taunted, the max number of monsters attracted by the summoned objects/summoned creatures has been adjusted as follows:

In combat, ‘summoned objects’ will be able to attract up to 1 monster, and the ‘summoned creatures’ will be able to attract up to 4 monsters. (However, when using Black Spirit's Rage or when the skill being used summons a ‘summoned object’ for a short period, the number of objects will not be adjusted.)
[Summoned objects]

Sorceress - Sinister Omen, Blade of Darkness
Witch - Toxic Flood
Wizard - Lava Field



[Summoned creatures]

Tamer - Heilang
Witch & Wizard - Magic Lighthouse
Witch - Gorr, Tett
Wizard - Marg, Arne




Fixed the issue where the effects for the Berserker, Dark Knight, and Lahn character would not show for the Pavilla Costumes when Awakening.


Warrior:

Improved the falling motion when landing on the ground after using the Black Spirit: Solar Flare, Head Chase skill from a low height. 

Fixed the issue for the Warrior where only 1 hit would be applied when using the Absolute: Heavy Strike skill while mounted.


Ranger:

Improved the falling motion when landing on the ground after using the Wind Step skill from a low height. 

Fixed the issue where the Longbow could not be seen when the character came off from a horse and then moved backwards.


Sorceress:

Fixed the issue where the damage for the downward slash for the Violation skill would also apply the previous level’s damage.


Berserker:

Fixed the issue for the Crown Eagle Outfit in which the cape would disappear when doing the following motions:

When changing into the Main Weapon Combat Stance while moving left and right in an Awakening combat stance.
When throwing the target using the Rock Smash skill by using the skill slot in an Awakening combat stance.



Tamer:

Improved movements so that you can move in a diagonal direction when in a crawling position.

Fixed the awkward appearance of the shortsword when moving left, right, or backwards after getting off of a horse.

Fixed the issue where a black line would appear behind the Tamer’s neck.


Valkyrie:

Made improvements to the motion when falling from a low height while using the Hastiludium and Death Line Chase skills. 


Witch:

Made improvements to the motion when falling from a low height while using the Teleport skill. 

Fixed the graphical issue where the head of the Witch would be seen outside the hat when equipping the Karlstein Hat with the default face appearance.

Fixed the issue where the Kyrill Ear Cuff would poke through the Karlstein Hat when worn together.


Wizard:

Made improvements to the motion when falling from a low height while using the Teleport or Hellfire skill.

Added improvements to when the character gets off from a horse while moving, so that the character will be in a sprinting position when immediately moving forwards after getting off the horse.


Musa:

Made improvements to the motion when falling from a low height while using the Chase skill.


Maehwa:

Made improvements to the motion when falling from a low height while using the Chase skill.


Ninja:

Made improvements to the motion when falling from a low height while using the Ghost Step skill. 

Fixed the issue for Ninja where the “Please wait” message would appear and the character would stop its motion when the character did not have enough Stamina while using the Ninja Evasion skill after equipping the Main and Awakening weapon.

Ninja Evasion will not be used when there is not enough Stamina.



Fixed the issue where the Gorca Swimsuit would overlap with the Marine Romance outfit when worn together.


Kunoichi:

Made improvements to the motion when falling from a low height while using the Ghost Step skill. 

Fixed the issue for Kunoichi where the “Please wait” message would appear and the character would stop its motion when the character did not have enough Stamina while using the Ninja Evasion skill after equipping the Main and Awakening weapon.

Ninja Evasion will not be used when there is not enough Stamina.



Fixed the issue where the Epheria Marine outfit would look unnatural when equipped with low durability.


Dark Knight:

Made improvements to the motion when falling from a low height while using the Smoky Haze skill. 


Striker:

Made improvements to the motion when falling from a low height while using the Flash Step or Double Flash skill. 

Fixed the issue where the character’s motion would freeze when getting off of a horse while the horse is moving forward with the main weapon unequipped.


Mystic:

Made improvements to the motion when falling from a low height while using the Flash Step or Double Flash skill.

Fixed the issue where the top and bottom of the Roaring Magical Armor would overlap.

The additional Damage Reduction applied when using skills that grant the effect has decreased by 10.


Lahn:

Made improvements to the motion when falling from a low height while using the Bloody Stride skill. 


Item Changes

Marketplace registration price for Caged Owl has increased by 6.5 times.

Changed the weight of the [Guild] Pledge of the Blood item from 0.3Lt to 0.01Lt.

Black Friday Sale is here! Enjoy some of the biggest discounts of all year! For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click  !


Monster Changes

Vell will now spawn in 12 servers. Please find the servers below:

Velia 4, 5 (Newly-added)
Serendia 4, 5
Calpheon 4, 5
Mediah 4, 5
Balenos 4, 5
Valencia 4, 5
Reminder: Vell spawns every Sunday at 14:00 PST for NA and 16:00 CET for EU.



Some of the World Bosses are enraged by the fearless challenges being made by the countless Adventurers. Many Adventurers lost their lives as they underestimated the powers of the World Bosses. As a result, the artifacts of the Adventurers have piled up around the area.


Increased the AP of the following World Bosses, and changed some of their attack patterns.

Kzarka, the Lord of Corruption: Increased AP by 13%, and increased the damage of each punch by 50%.
Nouver: Increased by 15%, and added an attack decision for the tail attacks when performing moving attacks.
Karanda: Increased by 4%.



You have a certain chance to obtain the Belongings of an Adventurer when defeating the following World Bosses.

Kzarka, the Lord of Corruption
Nouver
Karanda
Ancient Kutum
Quint
Muraka
The higher your contribution in the subjugation of World Bosses, the higher your chance to obtain better loot.



You can obtain one of the following accessories from the Belongins of an Adventurer. You can obtain up to a TET (IV) grade.

Ogre Ring
Laytenn’s Power Stone
Eye of the Ruins Ring
Orkinrad's Belt
Valtarra Eclipsed Belt
Narc Ear Accessory
Basilisk's Belt
Ring of Crescent Guardian



When obtaining green or blue grade Accessories from monsters through loot, you can now obtain item grades up to TET (IV) grade.

Changed the placements of some of the monsters in the Castle Ruins area.


Interface Changes

When the title description on the equipment window for the View Set Effect text is too long for certain languages, the text will now have a line break to fit properly.
 
Added a feature which allows you to view all the equipped crystals for currently equipped items in the Equipment window (I).

Equipment window (I) -> View Equipped Crystals



Fixed the issue where the Enhancement and Transfusion windows would occasionally overlap when using low resolution settings.

Changed the background color of the quest optional reward slots.
 
A scrollbar has been added to the Quest Summary for instances when the description is long.
 
Fixed the issue of not being able to cancel a Worker’s task when you use the Complete Now feature while the worker’s current task of crafting has been canceled.
 
Increased the selection area of the checkboxes for the following:

Chat Window settings, Quests, Quest Settings, Dye Window’s Dye Entire Outfit, Guild Bonus’s radio button, Storage Status, bottom of the Worker Exchange window, Marketplace Notification, Friend List, Repair Max Durability, Discard Useless Items (from Fishing).



Fixed the issue where the right side of the title bar for the Cooking / Alchemy window could not be clicked and dragged.
 
Expanded the “Learned Only” checkbox area to match its text length within the Cooking / Alchemy window.
 
Fixed the issue of the Team Name and Team Battle text overlapping from the widget which shows the points and teams for Individual Battle in Arena of Arsha.
 
Expanded the “Character Name/Family Name” checkbox area to match its text length within the window which pops up when you click on Add Friend from the Friend List.
 
The following warning text has been added when you remove crystals through right-clicking in the Transfusion window and Blacksmith NPC’s Extract Crystal window.

※ The removed crystal will be destroyed forever.


 
Bonus stats increased through the use of Caphras Stones and bonus stats from AP and DP will be shown separately.
 
Fixed the issue where the text alignment for the Life Info and Life EXP progress bar looking unnatural from the My Info’s Basic tab.
 
Added a tooltip in the Equipment window which shows the effects of the currently equipped equipment. The tooltip can be seen by bringing the mouse cursor over the AP, Awk. AP, and DP text.
 
Fixed the issue where the lock icon from the Skill window would not disappear when the mouse cursor was outside of the skill icon.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where the background music would not play in the church of Velia.

Fixed the issue where the camera movement would not be smooth during the character’s sitting or standing movement.


Known Issues:

If a guild has built a Node War Fort after a Conquest War Fort/Command Post/Field HQ and an Annex, the Annexes of their ally guilds can be seen by other adventurers when they participate in a Node War where the forts are.

Please try to build the Conquest War Fort/Command Post/Field HQ/Annex after the Node War has ended if you plan on building them on the day the Node War Fort has been created.



We are aware of the issue of [Mystic] Trilby Hat, [Lahn] Trilby Hat, and [Lahn] Grolia Hat items are under the wrong sub-category and showing the wrong sale percentages in the Pearl Shop.


We are aware of the issue where Pet List does not load correctly when opened upon log-in. We are looking to resolving the issue right away. For the time being, please go back to the Character Selection screen and re-enter the game to have the Pet List appear correctly.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German, French or Spanish click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes
Spanish Patch Notes

notes.title: Patch Notes - November 14th 2018 (Part 2)
notes.content:
Item Changes

New ways to reform Nouver/Kutum Sub-weapons have been added.

The Fiery Nouver/Kutum Sub-weapon can be obtained by upgrading the Inverted Heart of Garmoth as a material from the Black Spirit’s Item Reform menu.
Reform can be done regardless of the Enhancement Level, and the durability and equipped crystal will be maintained.
The Inverted Heart of Garmoth can be obtained by heating an Inverted Energy and Garmoth's Heart.
The following effects will be added by reforming the Fiery Nouver/Kutum Sub-weapon.

Max HP +150
Max Stamina +100
Special Attack Evasion Rate +10%




A new boss armor, ‘Leebur’s Gloves’ has been added.

It can be obtained by defeating Leebur who is summoned through the Blood Wolf Boss Summon Scroll.



New crafting weapons Hughol’s Awakening Weapon and Dragon Slayer Awakening Weapon have been added.

Hughol’s Awakening Weapon and Dragon Slayer Awakening Weapon can be crafted from the Duvencrune Weapon Workshop at Duvencrune 5.
You can obtain the Blueprint used as material through a daily quest reward from Duvencrune’s Blacksmith Hughol. (Can be accepted with a Lv. 3 or higher character)
Materials other than the Blueprint can be obtained through crafting. You can use the Crafting Notes in the menu after pressing ESC to view details on how to craft.
A new quest in which you can obtain information about processing the Caphras Stone has been added. Characters who complete the [Boss] Witch-Hunting quest can obtain it from the following NPC (only once per Family):

Duvencrune: Hughol




The following Marni's Stones have been added.

Marni's Stone (Kagtum)
Marni's Stone (Sherekhan Necropolis - Day)
Marni's Stone (Sherekhan Necropolis - Night)
Marni's Stone (Tshira Ruins)



New blue grade armor, Akum armor, has been added.

Akum armor can be obtained by defeating monsters throughout the Drieghan region, and it has similar defensive effectiveness as Grunil and Rocaba armor.
2 set effect: All Evasion +5
4 set effect: Max HP +150, Damage Reduction +5
5 set effect: All AP +7
Akum armor can be reformed with the Ultimate Armor Reform Stone.



New item ‘Dragon Scale Fossil' has been added.

The Dragon Scale Fossil can be obtained at Monster Zones throughout the Drieghan region.
You can trade 30 Dragon Scale Fossils for Advice of Valks (+20) from  Valks NPC at Calpheon City.



The higher ranked version of the Adventurer's Tome item has been added. The item is called 'Chenga - Sherekhan Tome of Wisdom'.

You can obtain Chenga - Sherekhan Tome of Wisdom through Simple Alchemy of Adventurer's Tome and Chenga Crystal of Wisdom.
Chenga Crystal of Wisdom can be obtained by completing the new suggested quest of Drieghan called ‘Hoom's Song’, which is a consecutive quest.
The Hoom's Song consecutive quest can be obtained from Aljai NPC located at Macalod Hill, which is on top of Khimut Lumber Camp. It can be obtained once you complete the ‘Black Spirit's Gift (Adventurer's Tome)’ quest which is obtainable upon reaching Lv. 53.
When equipping Chenga - Sherekhan Tome of Wisdom, the following effects will be applied: Combat EXP Gain from performing quests +30%, Prognyl Silver Bar Gain +20%, Vision Range +150M.



Combined Magic Crystal has been added.

The Combined Magic Crystals can be applied onto all sockets, and a set effect will be applied when equipping 2 or 4 Combined Magic Crystals. (2 set and 4 set effects can all be applied, just like the other set effects.)
https://i.imgur.com/66RyAdt.jpg



HAN Magic Crystal can be obtained through Simple Alchemy of JIN/BON/WON Magic Crystal x1, Combined Magic Crystal x1, and Garmoth's Scale x3.

Garmoth's Scale can be obtained from Monster Zones in Drieghan.

HAN Magic Crystal is a special crystal which provides its own item effects in addition to the set effects obtained through regular Combined Magic Crystals.
https://i.imgur.com/9W0YMUQ.jpg


3 new Accessories have been added.
https://i.imgur.com/kqG1Wc8.jpg


The new crystal, Dark Red Fang Crystal has been added.

The Dark Red Fang Crystal - Armor/Valor can be obtained through Simple Alchemy of Kagtunak and Black Magic Crystal - Armor/Valor.
Kagtunak can be obtained from the Monster Zone of Drieghan, and can also be crafted through Alchemy. However, you must have knowledge of Kagtunak for the Alchemy.
https://i.imgur.com/rpzzaEa.jpg



Food, Elixir, and Draught which can be crafted with Drieghanese materials or ingredient have been added.  

Cron Meal and Draught can be crafted through Processing - Simple Cooking/Simple Alchemy.
https://i.imgur.com/mISnQ74.jpg



The following types of hide can be gathered using a Tanning Knife in Drieghan.

Yak Hide (Same category as Dinosaur Hide, Lizard Hide, Worm)
Goat Hide (Same category as Rhino Hide, Pig Hide, Ox Hide, Belladonna Elephant Hide)
Llama Hide (Same category as Deer Hide, Sheep Hide, Fox Hide, Black Leopard Hide, Gazelle Hide)
Marmot Hide (Same category as Raccoon Hide, Monkey Hide, Weasel Hide)



The following types of blood can be gathered using a Fluid Collector in Drieghan.

Yak Blood (Same category as Troll Blood, Ogre Blood, Dinosaur Blood, Bear Blood, Lion Blood)
Goat Blood, Llama Blood (Same category as Deer Blood, Sheep Blood, Ox Blood, Waragon Blood, Pig Blood)
Marmot Blood (Same category as Raccoon Blood, Monkey Blood, Weasel Blood, Fox Blood, Scorpion Blood)



The following furniture can be gathered from Butchering.

Stuffed Drieghan Male Goat Head
Stuffed Drieghan Female Goat Head
Stuffed Yak Head
Stuffed Llama



The following furniture can be crafted at Duvencrune 9-2.

Duvencrune Antique Bench
Duvencrune Wide Bench
Duvencrune Vertical Bench

Duvencrune Large Thuja Bookshelf

Duvencrune Hardwood Bedside Table
Duvencrune Lamp Bedside Table
Duvencrune Leaf Bedside Table
Duvencrune Giant Wood Wardrobe
Duvencrune Target Dining Table
Duvencrune Wooden Dining Table
Duvencrune Sunrise Chandelier
Duvencrune Sunset Chandelier
Duvencrune Bronk Lamp



Due to an increasing demand for good quality alchemy products, alchemy boxes have started to command higher prices in all regions.

The value of the following alchemy boxes has been increased by 20%.

Apprentice's Alchemy Box
Apprentice's Elixir of Wings Alchemy Box

Skilled Alchemist's Elixir of Mentality Alchemy Box

Artisan's Grim Reaper’s Elixir Alchemy Box
Artisan's Precious Alchemy Box

Artisan's Elixir of Carnage Alchemy Box

A new consumable item Small Atanis Firefly has been added.

Right-click to release the firefly and brighten up your surroundings for 30 minutes.
Small Atanis Firefly can be purchased from a General Goods Vendor.
The cooldown of Small Atanis Firefly is 5 minutes.



Fixed the issue where Silk Honey Grass Supplement and Brady's Supplement Powder would not be shown on the Crafting Notes.

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

A new chief monster, Kuhvariak, has been added to the Tshira Ruins of the Drieghan region.

Kuhvariak is very powerful, so a party is recommended, and up to 5 players can receive rewards.


 
New monsters for Hunting have been added to areas of Drieghan.

South side of Khimut Lumber Camp: Drieghan Male Goat, Drieghan Female Goat
West side of Dormann Lumber Camp: Yak, Llama
When you butcher these monsters after defeating them, you will have a chance to obtain a taxidermy decoration.



New monsters have been added to the Drieghan region.

The main Monster Zones are Sherekhan Necropolis, Tshira Ruins, and Blood Wolf Settlement.
The difficulty level for each Monster Zone is different, and you can enjoy various combat situations, from small scale to large scale.



There is a Traitor's Jail located at the Blood Wolf Settlement area of Drieghan.

When you destroy Traitor's Jail, the Kagtum Prisoner escaping from the jail will give a random buff for 30 seconds to the adventurer, and will follow and participate in combat for 1 minute.
If there are already 10 or more Kagtum Prisoners following, then no more Kagtum Prisoners will appear even when the jail has been destroyed.



There is a Kagtum Guard located at the Blood Wolf Settlement of Drieghan.

There will be a chance for the Katgum Guard to appear along with a notification message when there are more than 5 Kagtum Prisoners following around the adventurer.
Adventurers will fight the Katgum Guard once all the 15 Warders summoned by the Katgum Guard have been defeated. If the Warders are not defeated within a certain amount of time, the Katgum Guard will disappear without fighting the adventurer.



Black Energy Residue will be obtainable when defeating monsters throughout all of the Black Desert world.

There will be a slightly higher chance to obtain the Black Energy Residue within the Drieghan region.
The Black Energy Residue can be crafted into the Refined Black Energy Residue from the Duvencrune Weapon Workshop at Duvencrune 5.
The Refined Black Energy Residue is used as a material for crafting Hesed's Crystal or as a material for restoring the Max Durability of a Dragon Slayer weapon.


  
The Wasteland Iguana lost and wandering aimlessly in near western gateway of Altinova has been sent home into the grass.

The following loot you can obtain from defeating Mirumok Destroyer Offin has been changed.

Fixed the issue where the following monsters at sea could be inflicted hit when returning to its original spawn point for being too far away.

Candidum, Nineshark, Black Rust, Hekaru, Ocean Stalker, Goldmont Small Battleship, Goldmont Medium Battleship, Young Candidum, Young Nineshark, Young Black Rust.



Quests & Knowledge

Quest:

If your character is at least Lv. 58 and Cooking Skilled 6, and have completed the Drieghan main quests and [Co-op] Defeat the Weakened Belmorn! you can go to Jordine Ducas at the Fountain of Origin for the following quests. 

I Miss You, My Dear
For Dear Jordine



If you have learned all the knowledges under the category Foreigners of Drieghan, your max Energy will increase by 2.

If you have learned all the knowledges under the category Drieghan Mythology: Chenga Sherekhan, your max Energy will increase by 2.

Complete the following exploration quests with Rulupee to get back the money she swindled from adventurers in the quests Adventurer and Old Moon Adventurer Fund.

The Graves of Great Fighters
Serene Lake in the Highlands
Serene Yet Shadowy Tower



If your character is at least Lv. 58 and has completed the Drieghan main quests, complete the following series of quests to get Inventory +2 Expansion as the final reward. The first quest of the series can be accepted from NPC Odelphin in Duvencrune. This quest series can be done once per character.

The Lying Father
Back in My Days

Mercenary's Diary - Forest Ronaros
Mercenary's Diary - Shultz Guard
Dear Comrade
I Want to Be Like Father!



Guild subjugation quests are available to fight Drieghanese monsters at Tshira Ruins, Blood Wolf Settlement, and Sherekhan Necropolis.

If your character is at least Lv. 56, NPC Durgeff the Chief of Duvencrune will give out Dragon Slayer Weapon Blueprint Bundle x7 once per Family.

If you possess a Garmoth's Heart item, you can go to NPC Hughol of Duvencrune to accept the following weekly quest to process Garmoth's Heart.

Inverting the Energy


 
The following Special quest can be done in Drieghan with characters Lv. 58 or up that have done the Drieghan main quest Collecting Samples. The quest can be accepted from the Black Spirit.

[Special] Confronting Leebur (1/W)



To gain knowledge on Garmoth, you can accept the quest About the Crimson Dragon Garmoth from NPC Odelphin, the Head of the Mercenary Office at Duvencrune.

The following story quests about Drieghan after the Great Battle can be done after completing the Drieghan main quest A Gift for a Hero.

The first quest of the series can be accepted from A Curious Child

The following series of quests can be accepted by characters at least Lv. 58 and have completed the quest A Trustworthy Friend. The first quest of the series can be accepted from NPC Odelphin in Duvencrune.

The following series of quests can be accepted by characters that have completed the following quest series: Hoom's Song, An Archaeologist at Tshira Ruins, Drieghan main quests. Go to the office of Durgeff, Chief of Duvencrune, and interact with an old book there.

Go to Quests (O) > Recurring to see the repeatable Duvencrune Contribution and Drieghan Contribution quests.

The following series of quests can be accepted by characters at least Lv. 58 The first quest of the series can be accepted from NPC Melana, an archeologist at Tshira Ruins.

An Archaeologist at Tshira Ruins
Bronk Huts

How Many Sheep?



If your character is at least Lv. 58, the following series of quests can be accepted from NPC Nerman in Duvencrune. The quest series can be done once per Family.

Bad Drinking Habit

If your character is at least Lv. 58 and has completed the Drieghan main quests (including A Gift for a Hero), you can do the following repeatable quests. The quests can be accepted from NPCs at the Night Crow Post.
[Repeat] Enormous Blood Wolf
[Repeat] Kagtum’s Faith

[Repeat] Before Gaining Strength

Fixed the awkward Quest Summary and conversation that came out upon accepting Cat on the Roof as a Recurring Quest.

The Manager NPC who is the Quest Target of the quest Gold From River Water? has been renamed to Bartholomeo.

Fixed the text error in the quest completion requirement of the quest [Trading Lv. 31] New Luxury Item in the Market.

The completion requirement of the quest [Fishing Lv. 34] All Because of Trash! has been changed to a Fish that could be caught at a designated spot.

Fish Species which could not be caught around the area for the quest requirements of [Fishing Lv. 44] A Challenge! The Master Fisher of Splashing Point have been removed.


Knowledge:

The following knowledges can be learned by doing quests in Drieghan.

Glory of the Sherekhans

The following knowledges can be learned by doing the Seiri’s Dilemma quest series. They fall under the category Drieghan Adventure Journal II.

Seiri's Past I

You can gain knowledge for defeating Kvariak at the Tshira Ruins.

You can earn the following titles in Drieghan.

Interface Changes

Drieghan Node has been added to the World Map’s Production Node filter.

Drieghan region information has been added when looking at the Market Price from the Trade Shop.
 
Fixed the issue where Dye window would not close intermittently.
 
The alignment of text in the Max Durability window has been made more natural.
 
Farming Guide has been revamped.

The estimated time to wait for harvesting Crop will now be shown on top of the Farming window on the right.


 
Gift Letter of Repayment window has been remastered.
 
Node Tax Info window has been remastered.
 
Fixed the awkward outlining of the Sticker UI.
 
Fixed the text going out of the text box issue in the description section on the bottom of the Alliance window when having enlarged the font to maximum size. 
 
The message that came out when cooldown of a skill ended has been removed.
 
The Team Name and their score shown while playing rounds in the Arena of Arsha has been realigned.
 
Fixed the issue where pressing Backspace key to go back did not work after opening Marketplace from the Menu (ESC).
 
Fixed the issue where the Temperature Information icon would be displayed with Humidity Information icon instead on World Map (M).

The margins in the End Game window has been resized to be narrower.
 
A new notification that informs you of items with less than 3 days left in their sale period has been added to the Pearl Shop.

This notification will lead you the Sale tab under the sub-category Hot & New. (Sale item notification will only be displayed on the first log-in to the Pearl Shop, once a day).


 
Fixed the issue where the starting point, arrow icon, and destination point overlapped in World Map (M) > Storage > Transport > Status.
 
Fixed the issue where (?) button would be displayed on Give Gift window when giving a gift to an NPC.

The Help button for NPC Dating content has been removed.
 
Fixed the issue where the amount of Silvers would not be displayed from the mailbox (B) if there was more than 5 billion Silvers.
 
Fixed the issue where arrows that appear to point at Residences upon searching by the filter Residence after clicking at a Town in World Map (M) would point in the wrong direction. 
 
Fixed the text going out of the box issue that occurred on the combo box with the filter Residence found on top-right corner on World Map (M).
 
The gradation on the top part and bottom part of the Pearl Shop item that shows up upon looking at the item in detail has been removed.
 
Fixed the issue where the tooltips for the Remaining Price and Sale Price were switched from the My Listings menu of the item Marketplace.

Improvements to the World Map has been made so that you can view the latest transport information of Ships and Wagons when you click on their icons. (Previously, the transport information did not refresh to the selected transportation even when clicking on other transport icons.)

The text which appears when you press on the Cancel button while a Worker is Crafting goods has changed like the following:

"Do you want to cancel crafting? All crafting work done up until now will be reset. Goods already used at the start of the work will not be restored."



The text which appears when you press on the Cancel button while a Worker is working has changed like the following:

"Are you sure you want to cancel the queued work? A work in progress cannot be canceled. Goods already used at the start of the work will not be restored."



There is now an option to promote Workers instantly.

Fixed the issue where a camping anvil UI would show up when repairing an item via an Blacksmith NPC after using a camping container.

Fixed the issue where the price and current value of trade items overlapped.

The Promotion button will no longer be displayed for Artisan Workers.

Fixed the issue where an Enhancement attempt would be automatically made when reopening the Black Spirit UI after it was closed in the middle of the Enhancement animation. The Black Spirit UI could have been closed because of an attack, or the "Exit (ESC)" button being pressed.


Resolved Issues

Known Issues:

If a guild has built a Node War Fort after a Conquest War Fort/Command Post/Field HQ and an Annex, the Annexes of their ally guilds can be seen by other adventurers when they participate in a Node War where the forts are.

To prevent the ally guilds’ Conquest War Annexes from being destroyed by other adventurers, please build Conquest War Forts, Command Posts, Field HQs, and Annexes on the day of Conquest War, if possible.
This issue is expected to be resolved next maintenance.



The camera angle is awkward when changing between non-combat, combat, and Awakening combat stances in the Dye (J) window.

There is a graphical issue with blood effects in the Ultra Mode.

The UI goes back a step if the Enter key is pressed after applying a customization from the Beauty Album.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German, French or Spanish click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes
]Spanish Patch Notes

notes.title: Patch Notes - November 14th 2018 (Part 1)
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/33mTX8J.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

The gates are open and the roads to Drieghan are ripe for exploring. Get ready to check out this exciting new land, home to the new world boss, Garmoth. There are new awakening weapons, field boss, a baby dragon to call your own, and so much more! To celebrate this release we have a slew of events to help you get into the dragon slaying mood. Celebrating Millions continues with part 3: Enjoy Blessed Message Scrolls, a substantial EXP boost, and the grand finale with a fireworks display! All of these wonderful changes and more await you in the rest of the patch notes so continue on and see what else we have in store!


Event & System

New Events:

Celebrating Millions Part 3: The Gift of Appreciation

Event 06: The Gift of Appreciation

Event Period: 11/15 00:00 UTC ~ 11/28 23:59 UTC
During the event period, play for 100 consecutive minutes to complete the event Challenge and get Blessed Message Scroll (100 min) x1.



Event 07: 1,000% Boost

Event Period: 11/23  ~ 11/25
During this special weekend, enjoy 1,000% Combat EXP boost!
Check the event page for exact schedule.



Event 08: Light up the Skies

[EU] Fri. 11/23/2018: 18:00 UTC/ 19:00 CET
[NA] Fri. 11/23/2018: 01:00 UTC/ 17:00 PST
During this grand finale, enjoy the fireworks display from the coast of Velia.



Please click  for the full details on this conclusive part 3 of the Celebrating Millions event!



Drieghan Opening Event

Event Period: 11/14 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance
During the event period, defeat Monsters, Fish, and Gather in all areas of Black Desert online to collect [Event] Drieghan Seal. 
Usage of [Event] Drieghan Seal?

Usage 1: From your Processing window, select Shaking and perform Shaking with [Event] Drieghan Seal x10 to get [Event] Drieghan Military Supply Box I x1.

Right-click [Event] Drieghan Military Supply Box I to randomly obtain one of the following:

Beast's Draught x1-2, Giant's Draught x1-2, Verdure Draught x1-2, Elixir of Sharp Detection x1-5, Elixir of Steel Defense x1-5, Elixir of Flowing Time x1-5, Splendid EXP Elixir x1-5. Elixir of Endless Fury x1-5, Superior Whale Tendon Potion x1, Whale Tendon Potion x1-2.




Usage 2: From Processing window, select Simple Alchemy and perform Simple Alchemy with [Event] Drieghan Seal x20 to get [Event] Drieghan Military Supply Box II x1.

Right-click [Event] Drieghan Military Supply Box Ii to randomly obtain one of the following:

Sharp Black Crystal Shard Bundle: 3, Hard Black Crystal Shard Bundle: 3, Sharp Black Crystal Shard, Hard Black Crystal Shard, Memory Fragment, Cron Stone, Black Stone (Weapon) x1-2, Black Stone (Armor) x1-2.






King Targargo Rises

Part 1: 11/14 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance: Enjoy a special daily quest requested by Imperial Chefs!
Part 2: 11/21 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance: Face off against the menacing King Targargo in Fleme Hills of Velia.
Click  to find out how to get more turkey in detail.



Guild Missions x5!

Event Period: 11/14 After Maintenance ~ 12/12 Before Maintenance
During this special period, recieve 5 times the silver rewards and Guild Skill EXP for completing Guild Missions!



Loyal Attendance Rewards have been refreshed.
 
Reward Period: 11/15 00:00 UTC ~ 12/19 23:59 UTC



Ongoing Events:

Double Boss Drop: 11/7 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance.

Check out the updated event page with Garmoth added into the event!
Click  for the updated boss timetable with Garmoth and Targargo!



Celebrating Millions Part 1: 10/31 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance

Celebrating Millions Part 2: 11/7 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance


Ended Event:

Recruiting Drieghan Expedition

Be sure to right click on the Rulupee’s Ratty Flag you have obtained to learn what to do next! Don’t forget to get your Sealed Drieghan Treasure Chest while exploring the new Drieghan region.



Reward Distribution:

Bonus Back event distribution has been given out during the maintenance. Please check your mailbox (B) for your bonus back rewards!


Content:

New region, Drieghan, has been added.

New Nodes and NPC’s have been added to Drieghan, and new knowledge topics have been added for them.
Drieghan is opened to all adventurers. Adventurers will be able to explore the entire area more conveniently if Kamasylvia has already been conquered.
You will not get diseases such as heat strokes or hypothermia in Drieghan, so don’t worry about getting sick.
There are indoor and outdoor hot springs in Duvencrune, a large city within Drieghan. Your characters can receive special effects by going into the hot springs.
Duvencrune’s indoor hot springs have a capacity of up to 5 adventurers, and the outdoor hot springs have a capacity of up to 10 adventurers. Adventurers who enter after the maximum capacity has exceeded will not receive any of the effects from the hot springs.
Characters Lv 58 or higher who have completed 'Heart of Kamasylve' quests can receive the ‘[Drieghan] A Message from the Queen’ quest from the Black Spirit. This quest provides you a guide for the Drieghan region.



The new world boss ‘Garmoth, the Crimson Dragon’ has been added.

Garmoth, the Crimson Dragon appears 3 times per week (exact times can be found via our official boss timetable ) from Garmoth's Nest of all world servers excluding Olvia and Arsha.
When the notification message for the appearance of Garmoth, the Crimson Dragon appears, Kagtum Tribe monsters (worshippers of Garmoth) will appear along with sculptures. Garmoth will appear as you begin to destroy the sculptures.
When 15 minutes passes after you begin fighting Garmoth, Garmoth will despawn.
Whenever Garmoth’s HP decreases lower than a certain point, a system message will appear and a random sculpture will be activated among the remaining sculptures. However, Garmoth will still despawn in a total timeframe of 15 minutes regardless of the random sculpture activation.
Garmoth utilizes various aerial pattern attacks and deals powerful area damage, so adventurers must be well prepared.
When defeated, Garmoth flies away into the sky and leaves behind loot. Adventurers who provide significant contribution during the battle will be able to obtain various items such as Garmoth’s Heart, which gives you a chance to reform Nouver or Kutum’s Sub-weapon.


https://i.imgur.com/fqZYS3I.jpg

The new pet, ‘Young Crimson Dragon’, has been added.

You can obtain the Young Crimson Dragon by exchanging the ‘Garmoth’s Horn’ item from NPC Gerson. Garmoth’s Horn can be obtained by defeating Garmoth, the boss monster.

You can exchange it to randomly obtain one of the five items below.
Young Crimson Dragon: Heat Stroke, Hypothermia Resistance
Young Crimson Dragon: Hostility detection
Young Crimson Dragon: Auto-fishing Time Reduction
Young Crimson Dragon: Taunt Monster
Young Crimson Dragon: Rare Monster Detection



Just like the other pets, you can right-click on the item to register and use.
The item can be registered at the Marketplace. The Max Price and Min Price are 300 million and 100 million Silver, respectively.
You can only summon one Young Crimson Dragon each time.
The Young Crimson Dragon is initially Tier 1. You can increase the tier through exchanging as you collect more Young Crimson Dragons.
The Young Crimson Dragon has a talent of Increase Max HP, and for each tier increase it increases to 25/50/75/100.
The Young Crimson Dragon pets are "Special" type pets. They are the only Special type pets currently available so they can only be exchanged with each other. They cannot even be exchanged with Wizard Gosphy.
Click  to see how you can earn your very own young crimson Dragon in detail!



The new field boss monster Katzvariak has been added.

Katzvariak appears from the hills north of Tshira Ruins at Drieghan.
Katzvariak randomly appears within ten servers. (Does not appear in Olvia and Arsha.)
The monster disappears if there is no battle for 2 hours after its appearance.
Once defeated, you can obtain various loot such as Eye of the Ruins Ring and 3 types of Combined Magic Crystals.



The maximum character limit for your team name in Arena of Arsha has been increased.

Invitation to Arena of Arsha will now be able to be accepted by a character with negative Karma. 

A new guild skill which provides a buff for all guild members for a certain amount of time has been added.


In Black Desert Online, guilds are not only where you can find fellow adventurers to embark on a journey with, but also where you can share various useful information with each other. Guilds can grow into stronger guilds depending on the efforts of its guild members, and it’s also a system in which guild members can receive the benefits of higher daily wages and guild bonuses as their guild grows.
 
Throughout the years of the game service, the amount of wealth guilds could accumulate through Node Wars and Conquest Wars has greatly increased. However, there were smaller guilds and newer guilds which had difficulty participating in Node Wars or Conquest Wars. Completing Guild Quests was not enough for these guilds to collect as much Guild Skill EXP and funds as the more advanced guilds. Since the Guild Funds are directly related to the amount of daily wages or bonuses given out to individual guild members, many adventurers only tried to join guilds which were already advanced.
 
We want to gradually make improvements to this system so that adventurers can be encouraged to create many new guilds, and also actively recruit fellow adventurers. As a first step, we’ve started an event where you can obtain the EXP and funds received for completing Guild Quests 5 times more compared to before. Though this will equally benefit all guilds, we expect newly created guilds to especially benefit from this change and experience faster growth.
 
If you’re a part of a guild which is already quite advanced, then you should look out for the newly added guild skill. Unlike the existing guild skills which are mostly passive skills, the new guild skill provides a buff which can be used by all the guild members. Furthermore, guild members will be able to select the desired type of skill depending on the situation for the perfect timing. You can also expect more new skills in the future.
 
We are also preparing to revamp Guild Quests, the way the quests are accepted, and the rewards for completing the quests.


You can check out the new guild skill from the Guild Skills Information tab from the Guild window (G).

In order to acquire the new guild skill, the guild must have already acquired certain guild skills.

You can consume the [Guild] Pledge of the Blood item to receive various buffs.

The following Guild skills have been added.
https://i.imgur.com/7K3PFbv.jpg


System:

Client crashing and lag issues that occurred intermittently in large-scale battles, Node Wars, and Conquest Wars have been improved.


Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World:

Fixed the issue where the grass would not get stained by blood intermittently in Remastered or Ultra Mode.

Fixed the issue where too much blood splattered on the grass during combat in Remastered Mode or Ultra Mode.

Fixed the graphical awkwardness with the trees in Longleaf Tree Forest.


NPC:

Fixed the naming of certain NPCs located in Glish to match with the NPCs’ appearance.

Villager → Soldier



Fixed the graphical issue of the NPC Patton Dairuch’s appearance looking awkward.


Mounts

Information about your Ship that has been taken out will now show up on top right corner of the Wharf when clicking the Wharf menu with a Ship taken out.

Fixed the issue where the buttons for Ships stored would be displayed first instead of the Ship in use when using the Wharf function.

Fixed the text inconsistency between the Mount Information UI seen on the ship and at the Wharf when referring to Durability.

Fixed the graphical awkwardness that appeared on the character’s main weapon when unmounting a horse in combat mode.

The character will go into combat mode now if the character moves forward after unmounting a horse while moving.

Fixed the issue where characters get inflicted with a hit when performing Social Action while mounted on certain mounts such as Epheria Sailboat, Hwacha, Flame Tower, etc.

Fixed the issue where using ESC key to close the Mount window after checking an item information by putting the mouse over did close the Mount window.

Fixed the text error in the Wharf information window.

Fixed the issue where Galleys appeared to have be taken out even when they weren’t if they were selected in the Guild Wharf UI.


Class Changes

All Classes:

Fixed the awkwardness of the outlines that separate the skills in the Skill window (K).

Warrior
Maehwa
Witch
Ranger
Valkyrie
Dark Knight
Mystic
Lahn



Fixed the graphical awkwardness of the character’s facial expression when performing the Social Action, Surrender.

Fixed the issue where a character in combat/non-combat mode would change after the character performs a Cheer motion for obtaining a specific item.

It has been fixed so that the character would remain in combat mode when jumping onto a wall or cliff and then jumping right off them.

Fixed the graphical issue with the outer appearance of the Harpoon upon equipping Terrmian Harpoon.

Fixed the graphical issue where the outer appearance of the Harpoon would not be visible when moving to land from sea with a Harpoon equipped.

Fixed the issue where the dye would not apply to certain slots when dying Blanchard Gloves for female characters.

Fixed the issue where the blue potion effect for the chest area would not be displayed when equipping the Pavilla Costume with female characters.


Warrior:

Fixed the issue where the skill Heavy Strike did not work intermittently upon using the skill on mount while having learned Absolute: Piercing Spear.


Ranger:

Fixed the issue where the graphical effect would not disappear even when the skill Blasting Gust was cancelled in progress.


Sorceress:

Fixed the issue where the character would go into non-combat mode after using the skill Mark of the Shadow on mount.

Fixed the issue where the chest area would appear awkward when equipping the [Sorcerer] Karlstein Outfit.


Berserker:

Fixed the issue where hiding Cape Setting did not work while having the Treant Camouflage outfit equipped.

Fixed the graphical issue of where a part of the [Berserker] Arken Gloves would appear to penetrate through the gloves.


Tamer:

notes.title: Patch Notes - November 7th 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/LpKgZDW.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

As one event ends, another one begins! This week we usher in the second part of the ‘Celebrating Millions’ event filled with more golden rewards and fun!

This weeks patch also includes many routine fixes so scroll down to the rest of the patch notes to see what we’ve been working on!


Event & System

New Events:

Recruiting Drieghan Expedition

Event Period: 11/7 After Maintenance ~ 11/14 Before Maintenance
Drieghan is preparing to open its roads up to adventurers, and Rulupee is already getting ready. She is recruiting for an expedition to explore this brand new region. 
Learn how to go see her for your own Rulupee’s Ratty Flag 



A new Title has been given out!

To continue the celebration of reaching 10 million players globally, we have sent out the new title, ‘Roar of the Millions’ to all adventurers during maintenance! Please check your in-game mailbox (B) now!
Please claim the Title from your mail before 12/7 23:59 UTC as it will expire afterwards.

The Title will be valid for 30 days from the point you claim it. Please keep in mind that it will disappear after the period of 30 days.




Celebrating Millions Part 2: Choice of 10 Million

Event Period: 11/7 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance
3 new events filled with event Challenges and event quests have arrived. Please click  to see how you can earn gold after gold!



Double Boss Drop

As the cherry on top to celebrate 10,000,000 registered players worldwide, and to welcome the start of November, the Double Boss Drop event will be added.



1. During the event periods starting with 11/7 maintenance, the chance to obtain boss items as loot will be doubled for the following monsters.
https://i.imgur.com/19Q6TOs.jpg

2. The following boss monsters spawned using summon scrolls will drop Memory Fragment x1~2 at a 100% chance during this special period starting with 11/7 maintenance.
https://i.imgur.com/MRVBH8u.jpg

Click  to see the Double Boss Drop event in detail.


Ongoing Events:

Celebrating Millions Part 1: Choice of 10 Million : 10/31 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance


Ended Events:

2018 Halloween Escapade
Mischievous and Fortunate
Bonus Back


Content:

Daylight savings is over! Please check the official forum post   to track the world boss spawn and Node/Conquest War time updates.

The EXP gained from a Lv. 57 character turning in full Marni’s Stones for the following monster has been increased.

Forest Ronaros



Fixed the issue where you could not build annexes for a Conquest War fort if a Node War fort was built after the Conqust War fort was built.


System:

When the Guild Bonus (incentives) which is given out to one Guild member per distribution exceeds 500 million Silver, additional taxes will now be applied.

1. Does not apply for less than 500 million Silver. 

2. Tax of 50% will be applied to the amount of Silver exceeding 500 million Silver.

*ex) When each Guild member is given a Guild Bonus of 600 million Silver, a tax rate of 50% will be applied to the exceeding 100 million Silver. (Actual amount of Silver given per member: 550 million Silver) 

3. Additionally, a tax rate of 70% will be applied for amounts exceeding 1 Billion Silver.

*ex) When each Guild member is given a Guild Bonus of 1.2 Billion Silver, a tax rate of 50% will be applied to 500 million Silver, and then a tax rate of 70% will be applied to the remaining 200 million Silver (Actual amount of Silver given per member: 850 million Silver)


This was done in order to prevent an excessive amount of Silver from being distributed to certain Guild members. The additionally collected tax will be included in the Support Funds for all guilds.

Fixed the issue where Messenger Alert sound and Display under Friend List were not working properly.

Interface Changes

Additional instructions have been added to the bottom of the Quick Hotkey Settings window:

Select and press Delete to unbind Quick Hotkeys.

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 31st 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/Hszq9aK.png

Greetings Adventurers,
 
It's said that time spent with pets is never wasted. They are essential during our adventures and therefore with today's update we are revamping the pet exchange system! From now on, trying to get a higher tier pet will be easier than ever so there's no excuse to improve your favourite pets!

Also to celebrate the milestone of 10,000,000 players registered worldwide we will be conducting a really special event which will last for 3 whole weeks. Thank you so much for all your continuous support and devotion! 

But that's not all, there's more to check on this week's patch notes, so let's get this patch started!


Event & System

New Events:

Celebrating Millions event will start.

We reached 10,000,000 registered players worldwide! A huge thank you to all of our fantastic Adventurers who have supported our game so far. Celebrating Millions event will consist of 3 sub-sections and will be held for 3 consecutive weeks. Please check details below:



Starting from 1st Week: Choice of 10 Million

Period: 10/31 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance
Event 1. Weapon Giveaway Quests: Complete event quests that give away the newly-added ‘Cliff’s Weapons’!

If you are below Lv.56, you will be given the quest to defeat 50 monsters at a designated region.
If you are of or above Lv.56, you will be given the quest to defeat an Awakened boss monster.
You will still choose an optional reward among Cliff's Main Weapon (+15) Box or Cliff's Sub-Weapon (+15) Box or Cliff's Awakening Weapon (+15) Box.




Event 2. Check in everyday for bonus rewards during this special period!

Log-in daily and check the ‘Special’ tab for special rewards up to 14 days!


 
Starting from 2nd Week: Festival of 10 Million

Period: 11/7 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance
More info. on Events 3, 4, 5 will be revealed later



Starting from 3rd Week: Gift of Appreciation

Period: 11/14 After Maintenance ~ 11/28 Before Maintenance
More info. on Event 6 will be revealed later



Click  to see Event 1 and Event 2 of this global celebration in detail!


Ongoing Events:

2018 Halloween Escapade: 10/17 After Maintenance ~ 11/07 Before Maintenance

Mischievous and Fortunate: 10/24 After Maintenance ~ 11/7 Before Maintenance

Bonus Back: 10/24 After Maintenance ~ 11/7 Before Maintenance


Ended Events:

Lauren Family’s Gift


Content:

Pet Exchange has been renewed.

The Tier chances will be displayed when exchanging pets.
You can now exchange 2 to 5 pets at once for a higher or even a guaranteed chance for a higher tier pet.
The exchanged pet will inherit the main pet’s EXP.



※What is a Main Pet?

It is the pet you register first when making an exchange. The increased EXP and tier will be based on this pet.

When making an exchange, you cannot register a pet of a higher tier than the main pet. Also, you will not get a pet that has a lower tier than the main pet when you make the exchange.

If you do not select an appearance to inherit for the pet used for the exchange, you will receive a randomly selected appearance for a pet that matches the main pet’s tier, and it will also inherit the talent of the main pet.


You can now exchange pets of different Species. However, exchanges can be limited based on the Type of the pet. For example, though a dog can be exchanged with a cat, Premium pets such as a Choppy cannot be exchanged with a cat.

You can check the exchange type from the portrait which appears by clicking on the Pet Exchange button.

[+]Pets which have a tier difference of 2 tiers or more can now be exchanged. (However, the main pet you register first must be the highest tier.)



Trainer NPCs located in large cities will now offer Shop (items for pets) function.
https://i.imgur.com/Oq40jfC.jpg


Guild Missions will now be cancellable in all servers.

Guild items held when a guild member leaves or the guild disbands will now be deleted. Note that if a character possesses a guild item after quitting the guild, the character will be automatically logged out.

Fixed the issue where guilds that are not participating in Conquest Wars would be shown on Conquest Status window.


System:

As daylight savings will end 2:00AM Local Time 11/4(Sunday) for NA, the Node/Conquest War times will progress 1 hour early before the times are readjusted with 11/7 regular maintenance.

EU boss spawn time and Node/Conquest war times has returned to the usual times with this maintenance.
NA boss spawn times and Node/Conquest war times will return to the usual times with 11/7 maintenance.

Gyfin Rhasia Temple



When Voraro is summoned from Mirumok Watcher Mirumok Lookout, Voraro will now chase a nearby adventurer as soon as the adventurer is detected.


Quests & knowledge

Quest:

Fixed the issue where the button to interact (R) in order to light up a Beacon Tower with fire would not be displayed intermittently during the quest ‘Torenandu's Declaration of War.’

In order to make the completing the quest Abelin's Secret Fishing easier, the Quest Target that you need to catch has been changed to Fish Species available in nearby sea.



Interface Changes

Adjusted the brightness and color scheme of the revamped UI buttons.

The appropriate icons will be displayed in front of the Family Combat Fame, Life Fame, and Special Fame in the My Information window.

Certain stats that appear under the Battle Stats area within the Basic tab of My Information (P) have been fixed to look more natural.

Reduced the unnecessary empty spaces in the Journal tab of the My Information (P) window, and a text abbreviation mark will be displayed when the text is too long.

Fixed the text overlapping issue of the number of Challenges shown on the Challenge tab (Y).

The notification message that appears on the bottom right corner of the game screen when a Hunting monster appears has been changed as follows:

You discovered a new hunting monster.



Upon placing an item with Durability inside a residence, the Current Durability/Max Durability will now show up to the right side of the item name.

When reservation for Arena of Arsha is unavailable, a notification message will appear and the reservation-related UI’s will be hidden or deactivated.

Fixed the text going out of the text box in certain parts of Arena of Arsha window.

When Arena of Arsha cannot be used, the reservation feature will no longer be visible in the Arena of Arsha reservation screen.

Fixed the issue where Guild Leaders (except for Alliance Head) could not disband Guild Alliance.

Changed the color of the Collect Money button in the Guild Member Status tab of the Guild window (G) to white.

Fixed the issue where the character name would not be displayed from the Guild (G) window’s Recruit Guild Member tab.

Fixed the misalignment in ‘Today’s Journal’ section of the End Game window.

Skill icons on the skill tooltip has been resized.

The tooltip that appears upon putting your mouse cursor over the skill icon listed in Quick Slot will no longer play the skill video.

Fixed the issue where the description text at the bottom of the Skill window would overlap with the Guide icon and the combo guide button.

The skill description will be displayed on the top of the screen when there is no space for the description in lower resolution settings.

Content of the tooltip that appears when putting a mouse cursor over the Settings button located on bottom right corner has been updated.

The Family Name creation window has been remastered.

Improved the convenience of Mail UI.

When receiving a mail with an item enclosed, the gift icon will no longer disappear, but will be grayed out instead. (The text will also be grayed out).
The mail title font size has been changed.
When receiving a mail through the Read Mail window, the window size will no longer change.



The default settings for the ‘Open Special Item’ window which appears when you open a box containing multiple items has been changed from ‘Open Only One’ to ‘Open Continuously’.

The following color display feature, which will be applied to the digits showing the remaining space, has been added to the Inventory (I) window:

Ratio of spaces remaining 0% - 90%: Yellow
Ratio of spaces remaining 90% - 99%: Orange
Ratio of spaces remaining 100% or more: Red



Reduced the size of the weight gauge at the bottom of the Inventory window.

The equipment window will now be aligned with the Inventory window when it pops up.

Fixed the issue where the Inventory of the land mount and water mount would appear overlapped when they were near each other.

The Occupied / Total Slots display which was placed at the top right side of the Inventory window has been moved to the bottom left side.

The knowledge section on the right side of the Processing window can now be hidden. It will be hidden by default.

You can now bring your mouse cursor over your other characters in the End Game window to use certain features such as Transport which were previously available only through selecting them.

Fixed the issue where the Purchase Maid button at the bottom of the Marketplace menu, when accessing to it in ESC > Marketplace order, would be displayed abnormally when bringing the mouse cursor over the button.

Fixed the issue where the Register Item button location would change in the Marketplace when clicking on a category.

Fixed the issue where the descriptions at the top right of the customization screen would bleed out of the text area.

The clickable area of the checkbox of the following texts have been enlarged:
https://i.imgur.com/CkBeeY3.jpg
Fixed the issue where the item registration button would appear overlapped when trading items through Transaction Maid.

Removed the duplicate Silver icon from the Current/Original information shown in the Trade window.

Fixed the issue where the description text at the top of the Militia window would appear awkward.

Fixed the issue where the Sell All Selected Items button at the NPC Shop would bleed out of the UI when the text was too long.

When the Enhancement Chance increase value accumulates due to failed Enhancements, an ‘Extract Chance’ button will appear depending on whether or not the chance can be extracted.

Fixed the issue where the ESC button would not function when bringing the mouse cursor over buff icons

The Node information bar was removed from the top of the screen when clicking a city from the World Map to increase visibility of the World Map.

Fixed the issue where the Node information window would be displayed when bringing the mouse cursor over Nodes which are covered by the World Map search filter settings window.

The following adjustments have been made to the Worker list window

Changed the Promote icon to show the number of promotions more clearly.
The number of promotions will always be displayed.
The Promote button will not be displayed if the number of promotions is 0 when the Worker is Lv. 30.
Changed the location of where the Nodes currently undergoing work would be displayed.
Increased the size and changed the color of the work time progress gauge.
Work history will now be displayed inside the gauge.



Fixed the issue where the location of the Worker Exchange window would reset when clicking on the Market List tab.

Fixed the issue where the Worker Exchange window would overlap with the dialog window.

Fixed the issue where the Worker name and region would overlap in the Worker settings window when sending a Worker to the garden.

Removed the ‘amount remaining’ message which appeared before requesting work to a Worker from the World Map house.

Fixed the issue where the selection icon in the Feed Pet window was not placed correctly.

Improved the Navigation guide clip window.

Fixed the issue where the Enhancement Chance Extract button would not be activated immediately after extraction was available.

The following warning message has been added when canceling production from the Mass Production UI: 

※ Items used as materials will not be returned.’



Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where Fish species that are not yet released for NA/EU client were being caught while Harpooning. As announced via official forum post, reimbursement in silvers for the mysterious Fish species caught will be made during 11/7 regular maintenance.

Fixed the issue were the Guild Officer would not be appointed as the Guild Master when the Guild Master has been absent for 15 days.

We are aware of the issue where Kibelius Outfits (except for Mystic and Lahn) are not being shown on the Pearl Shop (F3) currently. This will be resolved next maintenance.


Known Issues:

We are aware of the issue where the last pet you selected when exchanging five pets at once would still appear on your Pet List after the exchange. Although this pet appears on the Pet List, it cannot be taken out or exchanged. That pet should disappear from your Pet List if you reconnect to the game. This issue will be resolved in next maintenance.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German, French or Spanish click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes
Spanish Patch Notes
