notes.title: Patch Notes - 15th August 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/psHhy9r.jpg

Greetings Adventurers!

Take a little break and train while relaxing with the brand new Book of Training! Now you can hit some training scarecrows to hone your skills while focusing on equally as important tasks!

Huge tweaks to the Savage Rift will allow for more flexibility and a new event boss has been added. Can your team slay the Savage Ogre?

Round up your crew because the Squad Up! Event is now here! Work with your Guildies for special treasure and fun bonuses.

All of these along with even more exciting changes are here so continue on to the rest of the notes!


Event & System

Event:

Squad Up! Event is here.

Have you been enjoying double the Silvers and Guild EXP from the latest Guild events? For this newest addition, collaborate with your Guild members to complete missions and get your hands on special treasure chests!
Event period: 08/15 After Maintenance ~ 08/29 Before Maintenance
Click  for full details on the event.



Conquer Savage Rift! Event has been added.

Try conquering the revamped Savage Rift as bonus rewards await!
Event Period:  08/15 After Maintenance ~ 08/29 Before Maintenance
Click  for more on this new Savage Rift event.



Ongoing Events:

Double the rewards! Silver and Guild EXP given as Guild Mission completion rewards are doubled: 8/8 After Maintenance ~ 8/29 Before Maintenance

Guild Attendance Rewards: 8/9 00:00 UTC ~ 12/26 23:59 UTC

Loyal Attendance Rewards: 8/2 00:00 UTC ~ 9/5 23:59 UTC



Ended Events:

Saddle Up! Event


Content:

Book of Training - Combat and Book of Training - Skill items have been added, and also Black Spirit's Training system has been added.

Book of Training will allow you to go through Black Spirit's Training which will train you physically through combat and gain you either Combat EXP or Skill EXP.
You can purchase Book of Training from NPC Jamey Drucker in Velia, Heidel, Calpheon City, Altinova, and Valencia City.
If you use the Book of Training in your Inventory (I), a Book of Training buff icon will appear on top of your screen.
While Book of Training buff is in effect, you can Interact (R) with the scarecrows of each town to proceed with the training. 

There are different number of scarecrows positioned in each town, but please keep in mind 1 scarecrow can be occupied by 1 adventurer at a time.




You can gain the relevant EXP (Combat or Skill) every 3 minutes of training.

Even if you pause your training after 2 mins., you can train 1 more min. afterwards to obtain your EXP. However, training time will be reset if you close your client or change characters.



You cannot perform any other action while training, the amount of Combat EXP you gain will vary depending on the level of the character you are training with.

You cannot perform any other action while training, the amount of Skill EXP you gain will vary depending on the amount of Skill Points the character you are training with holds.
Book of Training - Combat can only be used with characters of Lv.50 and above. Combat EXP obtained from Book of Training will be up to 99% of the current level of the character; this means Book of Training cannot be used to level up the character.
Book of Training - Skill can only be used with characters of Lv.50 and above. Once a certain amount of Skill EXP is gained, Skill Points will be obtained.



Combat EXP gained from Black Spirit's Training can be altered as it is affected from all EXP buff effects.

Fever Time and event EXP buffs, Pet skills, Book of Combat, Golden Bells and Elixirs, Olvia Server boosts will all add on to the Black Spirit's Training when training for Combat EXP.
Book of Training - Skill effect cannot stack and items that add onto increasing and obtaining Skill EXP will not be stacked as well.
Please be aware that your training time (from Book of Training) is running without progress during Regular or Urgent Maintenances, and the effect cannot be extended after the maintenance ends. Please use the Book of Training items with awareness of the maintenance schedule which can be found via our official website



Book of Training can only be used with characters of Lv.50 and above.

Book of Training - Combat and Book of Training - Skill items can be used together.
For example, if you Interact (R) with a scarecrow while Book of Training - Combat and a Book of Training - Skill buffs are both in effect, you can obtain both Combat EXP and Skill EXP after a certain period of time.
Even if you don’t stop interaction with the scarecrow while in progress of Black Spirit's Training, Book of Training can be used.
While in progress of Black Spirit's Training, food and elixir items can be used.
Please note that you need to have both your Main Weapon and Sub-weapon equipped in order to Interact (R) with a scarecrow.



Savage Rift has had the following revisions:

Total duration of Savage Rift has been reduced to approximately 20 minutes.
Number of monsters in monster raids have been reduced by 40%.
As the duration of Savage Rift has been cut down, the amount of Silver obtained during Savage Rift has been halved. (Refer to the Silver reward table below)
The Savage Rift Reward Box which you can get for protecting the Sealed Tower from certain stages of monster raids will give slightly less rewards upon opening.
EXP gained has been reduced by 40%.
While the rewards obtained through a Savage Rift have been reduced, the reduced play time should allow players to participate in more Savage Rifts and gain more rewards overall.
Trace of Savagery will be given with 100% chance upon opening a Savage Rift Reward Box.
The Cooldown of the Hwacha and Lynch Cannon in Savage Rift has been reduced by 50%.
Rewards given for completing stages or waves of monster attacks have been changed as stated below (Please keep in mind rewards are given for completing Stage 4 and beyond in Savage Rift):
https://i.imgur.com/zV7UmAW.jpg
Please find the general guide on Savage Rift .


https://i.imgur.com/pcx9AUL.jpg

A new event boss, Savage Ogre, has been temporarily added to the Savage Rift.

Event period: 08/15 After Maintenance ~ 08/29 Before Maintenance
After the 25th stage of the Savage Rift, a 50% chance of triggering a new stage (Stage 26) will start. Thereby giving players a chance to fight the Savage Ogre
The Savage Ogre will only appear for 2 weeks as an event monster.
Defeating the Savage Ogre will yield an ‘[Event] Sage Rift Reward Box’ containing a Soiled Ogre Ring and Trace of Savagery at a 100% chance.
Pro-Tip: Aim for the head of the Savage Ogre for massive damage
Please Note: Failure to defeat the Savage Ogre will result in receiving rewards equal to completing  20 stages of the Savage Rift only! Please try your best to defeat the Savage Ogre with your group for the additional rewards!



It has been changed that items produced form Guild Crafting can be stacked in Inventory.

If you have the relevant items in the Inventory separately in Inventory, you can store them in Storage and retrieve again to have them stacked in Inventory.



Auto-navigation has been improved near Western Guard Camp.


System:

In preparation of Remastering of Black Desert Online, High-End Mode (Beta) under settings will not be available.

The Pearl Abyss company logo animation has been changed.


Game performance when many players are gathered in one area has been improved.

The Guild Bonus system has been changed in order to alleviate the inconvenience that can arise from a week-long waiting period of Guild Bonus distribution.

The week-long waiting period for the distribution of Guild Bonuses has been removed, and Guild Bonuses will reset every midnight (00:00 UTC) on Saturdays.
From midnight of every Saturday (24:00 UTC) to the midnight of following Saturday (24:00 UTC), Guild Bonuses can be distributed regardless of which day you decide to distribute.
For example,

If Guild A accepts Guild Bonuses on a Tuesday at 20:00 (from a cycle from Sunday to Saturday), that Guild can claim the Guild Bonus again after the count resets on Saturday at midnight without having to wait a full 7 days cooldown as before. This should allow for more flexibility when distributing Guild Bonuses.




Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World:

Floating airships will now circle around the skies of Calpheon, Heidel, Altinova, and Velia.

These airships cannot be boarded. Please do not try it.



The issue of being engulfed in instant darkness upon entering your Residence has been fixed.

Fixed the issue where the arrow would not be displayed upon checking node war information in World Map (M).


NPC:

You can now sell items to Stable Keeper NPC Melabee.

Fixed the issue where some NPCs were overlapping with the background inside Ibellab Oasis.

Fixed the issue where NPCs were placed inside certain Residences in Valencia.

NPC Hervano Tito in Eastern Gateway has been relocated. 

The NPC that exchanges Faded Metal Shard in Florin has been renamed to “Villager”.

Fixed the graphical awkwardness that occurred when greeting the Guild Military Supply Manager NPC of Velia.


Class Changes

All Classes:

Stamina will no longer be consumed when Jumping while moving or Sprinting during non-combat mode.
Due to exploits using Character Selection function, the following rules were will now be applied

In Combat Zones, Character Selection will only be allowed when the character is on standby.
In Combat Zones, Character Selection will not be available for a set amount of time after resurrecting from a node, or after logging into a character.
In Combat Zones, Character Selection will be available while on a mount but only when on standby.
In Combat Zones, Character Selection is not allowed when your character is on Auto-run.
In Combat Zones, Character Selection is possible underwater on standby and when rising to the surface due to lack of Stamina, but Character Selection is not allowed while swimming or moving underwater.
In Combat Zones, Character Selection is possible when a weapon is drawn or withdrawn and the character is on standby, but Character Selection is not allowed in other instances where the character is performing a skill of moving.
In Combat Zones, Character Selection is not allowed during and for 5 sec. after the Invincible effect is applied after resurrecting from a node.
Even in Combat Zones, Character Selection is allowed when carrying a load on your back.
In Safe Zones, Character Selection is always allowed.



Warrior:

Fixed the issue where using the skill Solar Flare with 100% Black Spirit's Rage would result in a falling movement even in low high situations.

Fixed the issue where the skill Grave Digging III launched with Black Spirit’s Rage did not apply damage properly on the skill’s last hit.

The skill description using Black Spirit’s Rage has now been expanded and will be displayed in a separate window.


Witch:

Fixed the issue where the character would perform the action of being attacked upon using the skill Spellbound Heart near a World Boss.


Wizard:

Fixed the issue where the character would perform the action of being attacked upon using the skill Spellbound Heart near a World Boss.

Fixed the issue where your character would be paused upon using the skill Commune: Calling.


Ninja:

Fixed the awkward movement that occurred when pressing T to go into auto-run after using the skill Target Chase in Sura Katana mode.


Kunoichi:

Guard will now be released if Kunoichi’s stamina falls below 100 while using the skill Kunai block. Kunai block will become available again once stamina recovers to over 400.


Dark Knight:

Forward Guard effect has been added to the skill Flow: Bombardment.


Lahn:

Fixed the issue where the flag appeared detached from the hand when performing the Social Action of Flagging.

Fixed the issue where a falling movement came out when jumping while transitioning into non-combat mode from Crimson Glaives mode.


Item Changes:

Atanis Firefly which is a consumable item that works just like a Lantern has been added.

You can purchase Atanis Firefly from a General Goods NPC for 100 Silver in all regions.



Fixed the issue where Gazelle Meat could not be sold to NPC shops.

Fixed the incorrect description of the item Gazelle Meat.

Fixed the issue where certain tables could not be withdrawn after they are placed in a Residence.

David Finto has published his research on “how to cook fish better” and as a result, the following recipes have changed.
https://i.imgur.com/xUSjUOt.jpg

Text for Sub-weapons and certain accessories regarding Back Attack Extra Damage has changed for additional clarity.

For example, 

Back Attack Extra Damage +1 →  Back Attack Extra Damage +10%




For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

After defeating Vell, a column of light will now show where loot can be collected

More Swamp Nagas have been added near Extraction Mill.

More Steel Imps have been added to the northwestern entrance of Western Guard Camp of Balenos.

Fixed the issue where some monsters did not attack back the NPCs they were engaged in battles with. (This includes monsters in Trina Fort, Western Guard Camp, and so on).

The loot dropped by Vell has been increased.

Number of Black Stones as loot increased by 100%.
Number of Gold Bar 10G as loot increased by 100%.
Number of Gold Bar 100G as loot increased by 30%.
Number of Coral Piece as loot increased by 25%
Number of Cron Stone as loot increased by 30%.
Blue Coral and Green Coral have been added as loot items.
Daybreak Blue Coral and Prairie Green Coral have been added as loot items.



Quests & Knowledge

Quest:

Quest summary of the quest [Cooking] Memory in Your Hands #1 has been changed to fit the changed Cooking recipe.


Knowledge:

A new way to obtain Knowledge of ‘Mark of a Secret Organization’ has been added. If you obtain the Knowledge of the following monsters below first then speak with Marzana, a button to obtain the Knowledge of ‘Mark of a Secret Organization’ will be displayed.

Aakman Flamen
Aakman Airbender
Aakman Punisher
Aakman Watcher



A new way to obtain Knowledge of ‘Bluish Sulfur’ has been added. If you obtain the Knowledge of the following monsters below first then speak with Marzana, a button to obtain the Knowledge of ‘Bluish Sulfur’ will be displayed.

Lava Tukar
Lava Searcher
Lava Faolun
Lava Taolun



A new way to obtain Knowledge of ‘Lost Piece of a Forbidden Book’ has been added. If you obtain the Knowledge of the following monsters below first then speak with Marzana, a button to obtain the Knowledge of ‘Lost Piece of a Forbidden Book’ will be displayed.

Sordid Deportee
Frenzied Executioner
Executioner
Iron Fist Warder



Interface Changes

It has been changed that in the Marketplace Notifications window, items will be listed in the order of most recently registered.

Fixed the issue where the number of registered items in the ‘Notification’ icon 
differed from the number of registered items on ‘Marketplace Notifications’ window. 



Fixed the issue where Knowledge obtainable for raising Amity was not being displayed in the NPC Amity window.
 
Fixed the overlapping of the item price and Silver icon.
 
Fixed the issue where only a part of the warning message, “ There is a strong monster in your vicinity!” was being displayed.
 
‘Withdraw tax’ button in the Territory menu has been removed.
 
 
It has been changed that if the text displayed goes out of the Conquest Status window box, will be abbreviated.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 8th August 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/Nh0V1dO.jpg
Greetings Adventurers, 

This week we bring some extra-exciting changes to Black Desert Online! Execute with 100% accuracy with the new Guaranteed Enhancement items. Added in are three different kinds of new blackstones to help you get your gear in tip-top shape!

We also bring Instant Potions to give you that much needed boost when you need it most.

Squad up with your Guildies. In addition to the refreshed Guild Attendance Rewards, we are doubling the rewards for completing Guild Missions.

All of this and more are awaiting you in these patch notes so keep calm and read on!


Event & System

Event:

Guild Attendance Rewards have been refreshed:

Event Period: 8/9 00:00 UTC ~ 12/26 23:59 UTC



Double the rewards! A new event where Silver and Guild EXP given as Guild Mission completion rewards are doubled has been added.

During this period, amount of Silvers and Skill EXP given for completing Guild Missions will DOUBLE.
Event period: 8/8 After Maintenance ~ 8/29 Before Maintenance.



The duplicated buff icon misplaced on top of the client screen has been removed.

Mount EXP +30% can be checked under the EXP buff icon.



Ongoing Events:

Saddle Up! Event: 8/1 After Maintenance ~ 8/15 Before Maintenance

Loyal Attendance Rewards: 8/2 00:00 UTC ~ 9/5 23:59 UTC


Ended Events:

Crio’s Favor event

WARS REVAMPED! 

Gather Serbianca’s Voucher event

You can still exchange [Event] Serbianca’s Vouchers for Logs until 8/18 before maintenance.



Content:

Instant HP Potion (S, M, L, XL) and Instant MP Potion (S, M, L, XL) have been added.

Though the HP/MP amount recovered is same as before, the cooldown is 2 sec.



Guaranteed Enhancement has been added.

Now you can perform Guaranteed Enhancement on Main Weapon, Sub-weapon, Awakening Weapon, Helmets, Armors, Gloves, and Shoes. 
Upon using the following items and performing Guaranteed Enhancement, you will consume 30 Durability and obtain 100% chance of successful Enhancement.

Stabilized Magic Black Stone: Allows you to perform enhancement on green-grade gear from +13 until +15.
Cleansed Magic Black Stone: Allows you to perform enhancement on blue-grade gear from +13 until +15.
Flawless Magic Black Stone: Allows you to perform enhancement on yellow-grade gear from +13 until +15. 



※ If a gear is reformed, you will need to use the same type of Magic Black Stone that you would need for the non-reformed version of the gear.


The Magic Black Stones are obtainable from defeating World Bosses and Field Bosses.
They are NOT marketplace-registrable.
The quantity of Magic Black Stones consumed in Enhancement is as follows:

When Enhancing to + 13: x5
When Enhancing to + 14: x8
When Enhancing to + 15: x13



Please click  for our official Wiki guide on Enhancement.



It has been changed that items cannot be moved around inside Inventory while Enhancement is under progress.
 
New challenges, “Gorgath's Gift” have been added under Challenges (Y).

The challenge can only be completed once per Family.
Upon achieving a certain level, Stabilized Magic Black Stone can be obtained:

Achieve Lv.50 ~ Lv.53: x5 each
Achieve Lv.54: x6



If you have already achieved Lv.54, you will have completed the relevant Challenge automatically upon logging-in.



The following titles have been added:


Dark Knight Costume Crafter
Dark Knight Costume Expert
Striker Costume Crafter
Striker Costume Expert
Mystic Costume Crafter
Mystic Costume Expert



If you design a class-specific Calpheon Noble Dress or Calpheon Noble Suit for the first time, you will receive the relevant Costume Crafter title for that specific class.
If you design a class-specific Calpheon Noble Dress or Calpheon Noble Suit ten times, you will receive the relevant Costume Expert title for that specific class.



A new system message will now be displayed upon destruction of Command Post/Forts during Node and Conquest Wars.


System:

The game client will now close without the message ‘Connection with the server has been lost.’

Fixed the issue where character set for Tag could escape from Jail fast.


Games World, NPC & Effects

Game World:

The Navigation near Western Guard Camp and Altar of Agris has been improved.


NPC:

Guard NPC under battle with Steel Imps has been added to Western Guard Camp.

The camera perspective of Edan located in Valencia Castle has been changed.


Mounts

In order to fix the difficulty in boarding your ship when multiple ships are crowded together, it has been changed so that clicking on the Ship icon on the top-left corner would teleport you instantly to the steering wheel of your ship.

This applies only to Epheria Sailboat, Epheria Frigate, and Old Bartali Sailboat.
Click on the Ship icon while on standby or swimming to move to the steering wheel of your ship.



The text that appears at the Stable when selling your horse to the Imperial Horse Delivery has been changed.


Class Changes

All Classes:

Damage Reduction effect has now been decreased by 5% during PVP.

Fixed the graphical abnormality in the shadow of the characters distant away.

Fixed the issue where the characters’ hair would seem to disappear at a certain angle when having [Event] Sweet Cone Hat on.

Fixed the graphical awkwardness in the hair part when equipping Snowflake Hat for Wizard, Warrior, and Striker.


Ranger:

Fixed the issue where the skill Flow: Crossing Wind I could be used even when the skill had not been learned.

Fixed the issue where the side hair in one of the types of hair of the Ranger would disappear upon wearing Coco Hat.


Berserker:

Fixed the wrong descriptions in the skill tooltip of the following skills:

Beast Roar I, Beast Roar II, Beast Roar III, Absolute: Beast Roar



Witch:

Musa:

Fixed the issue where Knockback effect of the additional hit would not be applied for the skill Counter Assassination in PvE.


Maehwa:

Fixed the graphical awkwardness in parts of the hair of the character upon equipping Lahr Arcien Helmet (R).


Striker:

Lahn:

Navigation to the location of spawn for the item Ancient Ruins Key has been improved.

The following text has been added to the tooltip of Ancient Ruins Key:

Use the item at the designated location to summon the Defender of the Ancient Holy Ground.
Fixed the awkward line breaks in the item tooltip of Ancient Ruins Key.
The summoned Defender of the Ancient Holy Ground will disappear after 10 minutes.

Chicken Feed

For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Gray Wolves located near Western Guard Camp have increased in number.

Shadow Knights located near The Watchtower have increased in number.

Some goblins that appear near Cron Castle Site have been relocated.

Defender of the Ancient Holy Ground that spawns from using Ancient Ruins Key will now die after 10 mins.

The loot from hunting Blue Whale and Khalk has been changed.

The following items have been removed from the loot for hunting Blue Whale and Khalk.

Magic Crystal of Infinity - Precision

Gold Bar 1G

Seaweed (Blue Whale)

Cursed Fang (Khalk)

Viscous Liquid (Khalk)




The drop rate of the following loot items has been changed.

Blue Whale:

Sharp Black Crystal Shard +400%
Hard Black Crystal Shard +1200%
Black Stone (Weapon) +400%
Black Stone (Armor) +400%
Ancient Magic Crystal - Harphia -70%

Quests & Knowledge

Quest:

Difficulty of the quest [Solo] Narc Magic Sealing Stone has been lowered.

DP of the Narc Brishka that spawns in the quest has been decreased by 60%.
However, EXP obtainable for completing the quest has been decreased by 50%.



It has been changed that interacting (R) with NPC Datu Varudatu will gain you its Knowledge now.

Fixed the issue where the title ‘Al Rhundi Champion’ could not be obtained upon completing the quest of defeating Al Rhundi.

The descriptive text that appears when putting the mouse over Gathering under Professions (Life Skills) in My Information (P) window has been changed likewise:

Level this up to increase the chance of not consuming Energy while Gathering.

notes.title: Trina box miscommunication - Apology
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

Both Kakao Games and Pearl Abyss are constantly looking for ways to create different and exciting events for you all to enjoy. The recent level 60 challenge was just one example of that, as we wanted to give many players the chance to experience the game in a new way, for a limited amount of time.

Our communication on this event was insufficient, not only on the original presentation of the event but as both the CM and GM team answered follow up questions, specifically on the removal date of the Trina Knights First Captain's Support Kit (7 Days).

We are deeply sorry for the confusion and misinformation we caused.

Please understand, that this was not done with any kind of malicious intent and we are committed to bringing new and exciting events to the game.

Due to the nature of these items and the impact they have, we concluded that we are unable to extend the event, as the items can be disruptive to the game if used outside of the event period and a controlled environment.

As a gesture of apology for the error we made we will be providing all players with the following compensation during the next scheduled maintenance:

1 x Item Collection Increase Scroll (60 min)
1 x GM Blessing 3 (1h)


To those that did not claim the challenge reward for reaching Lv.60 from the Challenges tab (Y), the following compensation will be additionally provided.

6 x Item Collection Increase Scroll (60 min)


In addition, Golden Bells will ring out across all channels at the following times:

EU

Saturday: 15:00 UTC (17:00 CEST)
Sunday: 15:00 UTC (17:00 CEST)


NA

Saturday: 01:00 UTC (18:00 PDT)
Sunday: 01:00 UTC (18:00 PDT)


*Please keep in mind all the compensations must be claimed before next week’s maintenance.

We look forward to sharing future events with you that will brighten up the world of Black Desert Online.


-BDO Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1st August 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/3A3wegf.jpg

Giddy-Up Adventurers, 

This week, we bring you an exciting patch that will get you to say neigh to anything else, because the Saddle Up!  event is here. Enjoy a horse EXP boost and bonuses to Imperial Horse Delivery. 

If you're not the speed on your steed type of player, we have also added a Lv.64 reward in the Challenge (Y) tab! 

Finally, obtain 9 newly added furniture items through hunting! So hoof it over to the rest of the patch notes, say hay to your guildies, and read the the rest of those patch notes because we’re not foaling around!


Event & system

Event:

Saddle Up! event has been added.

Event Period: 8/1 After Maintenance ~ 8/15 Before Maintenance
During the event period, enjoy Mount EXP +30% boost and also gain more rewards for using Imperial Horse Delivery!
Click  to gallop into this event in detail!



Loyal Attendance Rewards have been refreshed:

Event Period: 8/2 00:00 UTC ~ 9/5 23:59 UTC



Ongoing Events:

Crio’s Favor event: 7/25 After Maintenance ~ 8/8 Before Maintenance

WARS REVAMPED! event: July 22nd After Node War ~ August 4th Before Conquest War. 

Please remember all rewards (Scrolls and Titles) will be given out during maintenance on 8/8. 
Please remember you cannot claim the rewards if you quit your Guild before the maintenance on 8/8. You must have participated and met the requirements for Node/Conquest Wars during 7/22 ~ 8/4.



Gather Serbianca’s Voucher event: 7/18 After Maintenance ~ 8/8 Before Maintenance


Ended Events:

Challenge (Y) for reaching Lv.60: 7/25 After Maintenance ~ 8/1 Before Maintenance

Mysteries of Summer: Special titles Eternal, Darkness, and Light (for completing requirements and stages) has been sent out.


Content:

Challenge (Y) for reaching Lv.64, ‘[Lv. 64] A Knack For Hard Work’ has been added.

For reaching Lv.64 with your character, you will be rewarded Capotia Necklace (Once per Family allowed).



Benefits for occupying Territories of Calpheon, Mediah, and Valencia have been added.

For adventurers who belong to a Guild that successfully occupies a territory, 50% increase in item drop rate boost will be given.

Calpheon - Calpheon, Kamasylvia Territory
Mediah - Mediah Territory
Valencia - Valencia Territory (Including Aakman and Hystria)



(Please keep in mind the tax you can collect from occupying a territory will be the same as before.)



Fixed the issue where the location info. of a switched character that has been switched via Character Selection window would not be updated.


System:

The background loading speed of certain regions and towns in Calpheon has been optimized.

The loading speed of areas where there are many installments and objects has been optimized. Therefore, the game should now be more fluid even with a lower-spec PC or when travelling on your mount.



Game World, NPC & Effects

Game World:

Default setting of the skill Morning Star of the Fairy has been changed from ON to OFF.

Fixed the issue where the skill would turn on from Character Selection window or during Server Change.



NPC:

It has been changed that some NPCs sitting on chairs will no longer greet the Lord that conquers the relevant territory.


Mounts

Fixed the issue where a ship would spin rapidly when another adventurer who was invisible via the ‘Hide Other Characters’ setting boarded the ship.


Class Changes

All Classes:

Skill level for passive-type skills will now be displayed.

The fish effect that appears on top of the character upon a successful fishing during auto-fishing has now been removed.

Further improvements have been made to fix the graphical awkwardness in the hair part upon wearing the Coco Hat.


Maehwa:

Fixed the issue where Stiffness effect would not be applied to distant targets upon using the skill Stigma.


Dark Knight:

Fixed the graphical awkwardness in the ear part that occurred when wearing [Event] Seahorse Diving Hat.


Striker:

Fixed the graphical awkwardness in the head part that occurred when wearing [Event] Seahorse Diving Hat.


Mystic:

Fixed the graphical awkwardness in the skirt and body upon wearing Marine Romance outfit.

Fixed the issue where the string band part of the Vadabin Diving Mask appeared to be embedded in the neck part upon equipping it.


Item Changes:

The following description has been added to the item tooltip of Black Spirit's Claw.

You will only be able to equip crystals gained from heating craftable costumes tailored with Equipment Tailoring Coupon.



The weight of Apprentice's Five-Grain Chicken Porridge Cooking Box has been decreased from 90LT to 80LT.

Text regarding how to use the items have been added to the following items: 

[Guild] Sailor Contract Renewals, Sailboat Contract Renewals, Frigate Contract Renewals



Item tooltips on Grade 3 Weapon Reform Stone and Grade 3 Armor Reform Stone will now state that the NPC-to-exchange the Hunter’s Seals is now Jeweler Thyshelle Arms.

9 New Furniture obtainable through Hunting has been added.
https://i.imgur.com/T6imR3K.jpg

The following items can be obtained by Hunting Kamasylvian monsters located in the Western Valtarra Mountains.

Stuffed Belladonna Elephant Head
Stuffed Baby Belladona Elephant Head
Stuffed Gazelle Head
Stuffed Black Leopard Head
Stuffed Feather Wolf Head
Stuffed Phnyl Head
Stuffed Ferrica Head
Stuffed Ferrina Head




Do you remember the Berserker outfit that won the Global Costume Design Contest 2018? Well it’s finally here! Congratulations to our Grand Prize Winner once again for the flashy [Berserker] Jungle Beast outfit! You’ll find the latest addition in the Pearl Shop, please click !


Monster Changes

The Altar of Agris has been newly occupied by the Steel Imps now!

Some of the soldiers at Cron Castle deserted their posts. There will be less soldiers present at the Cron Castle now.

HP of Young Candidum, Young Black Rust, and Young Nineshark has increased by 50%.

The tree spirit will now appear more distant away from the node manager of Forest of Seclusion.

Boss Vision Range has been fixed to not be affected by another World Boss that spawns in a different territory.

The amount of time Quint the First Troll attacks by repeatedly jumping in the same place has been reduced by 60%.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest:

Some text have been added to the quests Tears of the Wind and Small Breaths to make the quest progression more natural.

The text “If you are carrying trade items, you cannot teleport to the Ancient Stone Chamber” has been added to the quest summaries of the following Valencia and Kamasylvia main quests:

The Leader
Edana's Descendant
There and Back Again..
Great Legacy



Fixed the issue where the quest would not be completed intermittently during progression of the quest Gardaka's Treasure.


Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where the Window size of the Crafting Note and Beauty Album would change according to the graphic resolution.
 
Renamed the PVP-exclusive server as Arsha (PVP-exclusive) server from the Server Selection screen.

Changed that the High-End Mode (Beta) can now be set via Performance Settings > Graphics & Textures > High-End Mode (Beta).

Fixed the issue where the client minimized to tray after a long uptime of the game would crash.

Fixed the issue where abnormal screenshots would be taken when changing Crop mode setting.

Fixed the issue where the shadows would look abnormal when changing Settings > Display Settings > Display Quality > Graphics.

Fixed the issue where Conquest Status and Score was not being displayed properly under Conquest window.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where Transport of items from Altinova to Ancado Inner Harbor was not possible.

Fixed the issue where Villas could not be displayed on World Map (M).

Fixed the client crashing issue that occurred when you were Fishing from a ship of another adventurer and that relevant adventurer would disconnect from the client.

We are aware that Mount EXP +30% boost icon appears duplicately on top left-hand corner. Please keep in mind only the Mount EXP +30% boost from the Saddle Up! Event will only be applied (as in only +30%) and the other boost icon will disappear in next week’s maintenance.`

Young Nineshark

notes.content:

Greetings Adventurers, 

This week we honor everybody's favorite otter with Crios Event! Fish, exchange items, or whip up some alchemy for some awesome treasures!

We are also adding a week long challenge to award those who have achieved Lv.60 before 08/1/18! Get those EXP scrolls ready, and pop those bells because the race is on!

Take to the seas and beef up your Frigate’s crew with the new Sailor Contracts!

Finally, hunters can take arms and head to Kamasylvia because new monsters have been spotted. Get those matchlocks primed and ready to fire!

We have plenty more in store you so continue on to the rest of the patch notes.


Event & System

Event:

Crio’s Favor event has been added.

Event Period: 7/25 After Maintenance ~ 8/1 Before Maintenance
During the event, Fish, Exchange, and Perform Simple Alchemy to obtain Sealed Golden Treasure Chest!
Click  for the details on this event!



Challenge (Y) for reaching Lv.60 has been added.

Event Period: 7/25 After Maintenance ~ 8/1 Before Maintenance
During the event period, a new Challenge to reach Lv.60 has been added via Challenges tab (Y). (Once per Family allowed).
Adventurers who have achieved Lv.60 with their characters before the maintenance will have the Challenge completed automatically upon logging-in.
Trina Knights First Captain’s Support Kit (7 Days) will require at max 34 Inventory Slots free in order to obtain all components inside.



Ongoing Events:

Loyal Attendance Rewards: June 28th 00:00 UTC ~ August 1st 23:59 UTC

WARS REVAMPED! (New Conquest/Node War event): July 22nd After Node War ~ August 5th Before Conquest War. (Plz keep in mind all rewards for Wars Revamped event will be given out after the event ends).

Gather Serbianca’s Voucher event: 7/18 After Maintenance ~ 8/8 Before Maintenance


Ended Events:

Mysteries of Summer has ended.

Terrmian Waterpark has ended.

Following Terrmian event items will be deleted on Aug. 1st maintenance:

[Event] Terrmian Coin
[Event] Terrmian Seal
[Event] Terrmian Coconut
[Event] Terrmian Festival Entry Coupon
[Event] Terrmian Fruit
[Event] Terrmian Pearl
Coconut Cannon Assembly Kit
Coconut Cannonball
[Event] Special Parfait
[Event] Special Ice Flower Sweets




Content:

Birthday Cakes!

With this update, a special in-game housing item ‘A birthday present from the Black Spirit’ will be given out on the birthday anniversary of your Family creation.
The birthday cake item will be sent out via in-game mailbox (B) every anniversary.
For any Family created before July 25th, 2017, their anniversary birthday cake will have already been sent out during this week’s maintenance.
For any Family created on and after July 26th, 2017, their anniversary birthday cake will be sent out on July 26th, 2018 and forward (1 year after the Family creation).
Click  to find out more!



Sailor Contract from before has been renamed as Sailboat Sailor Contract.

Frigate Sailor Contract that can be equipped on Epheria Frigate has been added.

Now you can hire 4 different types of Epheria Boatmen from the Amity Shop of Calpheon Worker Manager NPC.
You need to have at least 500 Amity points to access the Amity Shop with the relevant NPC and upon purchase of the contract, Amity Points will decrease by 500.

Tarte of Gabino Farm: Boatman Tarte and human boatman aide
Khaora of Falres Dirt Farm Boatman Khaora and dwarf boatman aide
Bravant of Trent Boatman Bravant and goblin boatman aide
Berocchio of Northern Wheat Plantation Boatman Berocchio and giant boatman’s aide



Depending on the type of the Boatman, a specific ability of the frigate will increase.



Frigate Contract Renewal: Professional Boatman has been added to the 
Amity Shop of NPC Tirol in Dias Farm of Calpheon.

You need to have at least 500 Amity points to access the Amity Shop with the relevant NPC and upon purchase of the contract, Amity Points will decrease by 500.
As with Sailboat Contract Renewals, right-click the Frigate Contract Renewal to open up the UI to renew the contract.
The contract renewal will extend the contracted period by 24 hours, and the Boatmen contracts can be renewed up to 7 times.



New quests to obtain Skilled or Professional Frigate Boatmen from Philaberto Falasi of Port Epheria has been added.

‘Skilled’ quest: The quest can be obtained from Philaberto Falasi with Amity over 1,000. This can be done with a character of Skilled 1 and above in Sailing who possesses a normal Frigate Boatman contract.
‘Professional’ quest: The quest can be obtained from Philaberto Falasi with Amity over 1,000. This can be done with a character of Professional 1 and above in Sailing who possesses a Skilled Frigate Boatman contract.



System:

Fixed the issue where the game screen would turn purple intermittently.

A new function to give an alarm message if there is a locked item when exchanging items with NPCs has been added.

Additional improvements have been made regarding the issues where an empty screen would be displayed upon opening up web UI in-game.

Fixed the issue where cancelling multiple item exchange with an NPC by pressing Cancel (ESC) button on the calculator UI during Exchange did not work and the Exchange was processed.  

It has been changed so that Exchange would not be possible when inputting the quantity of the item then cancelling it on the exchange UI while trying to exchange multiple items at once with an NPC.

In order to prevent possible system function failures, the game client window can now only be resized when your character is on standby.

Fixed the issue where resizing game client window while performing Concealment and Dash skills would allow irregular actions.


Game World, NPC & Effects

NPC:

NPC located near Keplan Quarry Node Manager Phirea has been relocated to acquire more space between the NPCs.  

Fixed the issue where NPC Muis didn’t return to his spot when the quest Goblin with Pearl Oyster was forfeited.


Mounts

Fixed the issue where using Sprint while Forest Path Wagon that was moving in auto-navigate would stop it intermittently.


Class Changes

Fixed the issue where the damage effect would not be displayed from perspective of the one being attacked or a spectator.

Ranger skill: Tearing Arrow II
Maehwa skill: Petal Drill
Kunoichi and Ninja: Suicide Fall
Dark Knight: Repeated Annihilation, Scarring Slash



Fixed the graphical issue where the hair would go outside the helmet or disappear when putting on Garnier Troupe Garb and Giath’s Helmet together with a female class.

Fixed the graphical glitch that occurred when the following classes wore Queen Heart Underwear and Marine Romance Outfit together.

Valkyrie
Kunoichi
Dark Knight



Fixed the issue where the characters’ outfit would look unnatural upon unequipping swimsuit while having on certain items on the Main Weapon slot in Equipment.

It has been changed so that any items other than Main Weapon and 
Fishing Rod would not be equippable while setting underwear/swimsuit.



Warrior:

Fixed the issue where the skill effects would look different for the caster and the spectator upon using the skill Heavy Strike.

A skill effect has been added to the skill Charging Slash.


Ranger:

Fixed the awkwardness in the text of the skill tooltip of the following skills:

Dagger of Protection I, II, III, Absolute: Dagger of Protection



Berserker:

Fixed the issue where the skill Frenzied Destroyer could not be used intermittently when the skill was performed continuously while moving left or right.

Fixed the awkwardness in the text of the skill tooltip of the following skills:

Frenzied Destroyer I, II, III IV, V, VI, Absolute: Frenzied Destroyer
Giant Leap I, II, III



Fixed the issue where CC skill effect would be applied even in PvP during Charge state when using the skill Giant Leap I, II, III to the rear.


Tamer:

Fixed the issue where detailed customizing of character could not be done when choosing the 1st hairstyle in character customization.


Witch:

The blood effect that was displayed while using the skill Fireball has been removed.


Wizard:

The blood effect that was displayed while using the skill Fireball has been removed.


Mystic:

Fixed the issue where the outfit would look awkward when wearing Epheria Marine outfit with certain underwear together.

Fixed the graphical glitch that occurred when Mystic wore the Marine Romance Outfit and Zebra Underwear together.


Lahn:

Fixed the issue where the outfit would look awkward when wearing Epheria Marine outfit with certain underwear together.


Item Changes:

A Cheer motion effect has been added when opening Kzarka, Nouver, Kutum, and Dandelion box items.

Fixed the issue where Oil for Lantern could not be purchased by the General Goods Vendor.

Tooltip of the following items will now describe which items can be obtained when combined:

Ancient Power - Red Shard
Ancient Power - Black Shard



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

Boss Time Schedule update!

Please click  to see the latest updates on the World Boss spawn schedule.



 New monsters for Hunting have been added to areas of Kamasylvia.

 Gazelle,  Black Leopard,  Ferrica,  Ferrina,  Belladona Elephant,  Baby Belladona Elephant,  Feather Wolf,  Phnyl
Ganelles of Kamasylvia have deep affection for animals and nature, but they advocate Hunting in general. Every time the monsters above are Hunted, your Karma will decrease by 5.



Fixed the overlapping issue of the name and HP of Cox Prison.


Questst & Knowledge

Quest:

 Daily Hunting Quest related to  Ferrica and  Ferrina have been added.

The quest can be obtained from NPC Jasmine, the Blacksmith at Acher Guard Post, with a character of Lv. 58 and above and with Professional 1 or above in Hunting.



Daily Hunting Quest related to  Belladona Elephant has been added.

The quest can be obtained from Acher Guard of Acher Guard Post with a character of Lv. 58 and above, with Professional 1 or above in Hunting.



Daily Hunting Quests related to  Gazelle and  Black Leopard have been added.

The quests can be obtained from NPC Aniki with a character of Lv. 58 and above, with Professional 1 or above in Hunting.
However, if you cannot have a conversation with Aniki, you cannot accept the quests and in this case, you need to proceed with the main quests of Kamasylvia Part 2 first.



Daily Hunting Quest related to  Feather Wolf and  Phnyl have been added.

The quest can be obtained from NPC Lucielle Monet with a character of Lv. 58 and above, with Professional 1 or above in Hunting.



Interface Changes

A “Show Stacked HP Bar” function has been added. This will help you see the amount of HP another adventurer has more easily.

You can toggle the function in Settings>General Settings>General>Show/Hide.
Your character’s HP bar will not appear stacked to you.
When you use this function, you will see HP bars in the colors of the rainbow. The colors will correspond to the HP an adventurer has, and it will change every 1000 HP.
If the HP is over 7000, the color cycle will loop back to red.
https://i.imgur.com/1O5JpvL.jpg



It has been changed so that Highest-spec mode for game settings can be selected from Graphics menu.

Fixed the issue where pressing all 3 filtering buttons on top right corner of the Inventory (I) would cause duplicate sounds.

Fixed the overlapping issue of text and the ‘Learned Only’ button in Cooking Utensil/ Alchemy Tool inside Residences.

Fixed the issue where abnormal message would be displayed upon using normal or Awakened Giath Summon Scroll.

It has been changed so that stats from Fairy skill ‘Feathery Steps’ would be applied in the Weight Limit Exceeded UI.

Fixed the issue where Fever Time event icon would not be displayed in the upper section of the game window where buff icons are displayed.

The display of the following icons in the old ESC menu has changed.

The NEW notifications on Quick Hotkey, Item Drop, and Setting Archive have been removed.



The display of the following icons in the new ESC menu has changed.

HOT notifications have been added to Savage Rift, Team Battle, Quick Hotkey, Item Drop, Imperial Auction House, and BDO TV icons.
The NEW notifications of Social Action and Notepad have been removed.



Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where error message was being displayed even when application to Global Lab testing was successfully made.

Additional improvements have been made regarding the issues where an empty screen would be displayed upon opening up web UI in-game.

Fixed the abnormal path that the liner at Ancado Inner Harbor followed.

Fixed the issue where items with weights that were not in whole numbers (e.g. 2.5 LT) were not registered correctly by the Naphart Campsite.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German, French or Spanish click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes
Spanish Patch Notes

notes.title: Patch Notes - 18th July 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/nDzZK1S.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

War, war never changes. Except today it does because new rules will be implemented for both Node and Conquest War. You can enjoy the Node and Conquest Wars again starting Sunday the 22nd. A lot is changing so make sure you read the notes carefully and let us know if you have any questions.

We are also restarting Serbianca’s Voucher gathering event! Gather around the world and turn in your vouchers to help you in your woodworking endeavours.

Once again, we are extending the Terrmian Waterpark and Mysteries of Summer event for some extra fun in the sun and a little more brain teasing. Please read on to the full patch notes because we have a lot of info for you!


Event & System

Event:

Terrmian Waterpark has been extended by 1 week!

Terrmian Waterpark will stay open until July 25th, before maintenance.
Event quests and mini-games will also be available until July 25th.
During the extended week, the amount of [Event] Terrmian Pearls you can obtain through the event quests and Challenge will double!
Everyone’s favorite invertebrate the Terrmian Octopus will also be staying one more week!
Weapon Exchange Coupons will also be available in the Pearl Shop until July 25th.



Mysteries of Summer challenge has been extended 1 week!
Mysteries of Summer will be available until July 25th, before maintenance.
During the extended period, general difficulty setting of the Mysteries of Summer will be lowered:

[Event] Deficient Meat: Quest Requirement of Beef x30 has been lowered to Beef x5.
[Event] The Immovable Stone: Quest Requirement of Gemstone has been changed to Rough gemstone.
[Event] Fire Resistant Gloves: Quest Requirement of bringing Clear Liquid Reagent x50 has been lowered to Clear Liquid Reagent x5.
[Event] Glove Used by a Blacksmith: Quest Requirement of Supreme Tough Hide x50 has been changed to Ox Hide x3, and Flax Fabric x50 has been lowered to Flax Fabric x10.
[Event] To Capture the Essence of Water: Quest Requirement of Distilled Water x100 has been lowered to Distilled Water x20.
[Event] Memory of that Day: The quest that could only be accepted at nighttime can now be accepted anytime of the day.
[Event] Unfinished Mission: Quest Requirement of defeating Pirates x100 from Pirate Island has been lowered to  Pirates x50 from Pirate Island.
[Event] Magnetic Field: This quest will now be accepted with an item received as a reward for completing the 5th stage of the floating platforms of Terrmian Waterpark.
[Event] Essence of Darkness: The required item in order to suit the requests of the third Guardian during the quest has been changed to an item that can be easily purchased.

Item Drop rate for items required for progressing with Essence of Earth quests has increased.
The life interval of the NPC with whom you can claim the Purple Greed with in the quest [Event] Purple Greed has been prolonged extensively.

Drop rate of Red Mercury, Samoga's Molar, Obsidian Dust, and Golden Mirage has increased.

Red Mercury: 80 times higher drop rate compared to before.
Samoga's Molar: 25 times higher drop rate compared to before.
Golden Mirage: 80 times higher drop rate compared to before.
Obsidian Dust: 80 times higher drop rate compared to before.


With the extension of Mysteries of Summer and difficulty setting being lowered during the extension, please find the reward specs. for earlier participants who completed the quests within the originally given amount of time:



[For participants of Mysteries of Summer before 7/18 maintenance]

Depending on the progress of quests (stages completed), at max 150 million Silvers will be rewarded additionally:

Fire Stage = Gold Bar 100G x1
Water Stage = Gold Bar 100G x1
Forest Stage = Gold Bar 100G x1
Metal Stage = Gold Bar 100G x2
Earth Stage = Gold Bar 100G x2
Spirit Stage = Gold Bar 100G x2
Darkness Stage = Gold Bar 100G x3
Light Stage = Gold Bar 100G x3 
(Grand total of 150 million Silvers)



Depending on the progress of quests (stages completed), more rewards (accumulated) will be given out:

For completing up to Forest Stage = Fine Accessory Box I x1
For completing up to Spirit Stage = Fine Accessory Box I x1
For completing up to Light Stage = Fine Accessory Box II x1



The special in-game Titles for completing Spirit, Darkness, and Light Stages will ONLY be given out to participants who have cleared the relevant stages before 7/18 maintenance.

All special titles available in Mysteries of Summer will be handed out after the event ends. Please check the chart below for conditions and the Title to-be-distributed.
https://i.imgur.com/OU4qOEG.jpg



Wanna find out who made it to Top 10 and hear the background story of Mysteries of Summer? 

Click  for the interview with the creative mind behind Mysteries of Summer!



Get Serbianca’s Voucher event has been added.

Event Period: 7/18 After Maintenance ~ 8/8 Before Maintenance
During the event period, [Event] Serbianca's Vouchers can be obtained everywhere through Lumbering. Exchange these from NPC Serbianca for Logs!
Click  to find out more!



Ongoing Events:

Mysteries of Summer: 06/28 09:00 UTC ~ 07/25 Before Maintenance (Extended 1 week!)
Terrmian Waterpark: 06/27 After Maintenance ~ 07/25 Before Maintenance (Extended 1 week!)
Loyal Attendance Rewards: June 28th 00:00 UTC ~ August 1st 23:59 UTC


Ended Events:

Summer Activities Screenshot Contest has ended.

Please click  to see if your submission made it!



Content:


The new rules can be enjoyed with the Node War that will restart on July 22nd. 
Please read on below to find the changes and additions made to our Node Wars and Conquest Wars. 


Node War

Now nodes will be classified into Normal Nodes and Conquest Nodes.

The Conquest Nodes will be classified into 3 different tiers with the higher tier giving more taxes to collect. Normal Nodes will give less amount of tax than Conquest Nodes. Conquest Nodes and Normal Nodes cannot be occupied at the same time.



Node Wars will now be available daily for guilds to participate in so that adventurers can enjoy large-scale battles more regularly. As a result, the maximum number of nodes that one guild can occupy will be extended from 2 to 6 nodes.

Instead, Guild Members who can participate in the Node Wars will be decided by the number of nodes occupied by the Guild.

To summarize the revisions and additions, please read on below:

At max, a total of 6 nodes will be allowed for occupancy by a single Guild.
Guild Masters can assign a ‘Chance to Occupy’ to the Guild Members through Guild window (G).
The Chance to Occupy will decide how many Node Wars the relevant Guild Members will be allowed to participate in the relevant week.
The Chance to Occupy for Guild Members will reset at the end of Conquest War on Saturdays.
Normal Nodes and Conquest Nodes cannot be occupied at the same time by the same Guild.
You cannot participate in a Conquest Node after conquering a Normal Node. And you cannot participate in a Normal Node after conquesting a Conquest Node.
Depending on the number of nodes occupied, maximum participants allowed for conquering additional nodes will be placed. Max participants allowed depending on number of nodes are as follows:
https://i.imgur.com/yLLaXiR.jpg
Guild Members-to-participate in the Node/Conquest War can be decided via the Chance to Occupy system. Guild Officers will use an exclusive UI window from Guild window (G) and grant at max 5 times the Chance to Occupy in Node/Conquest War for Guild Members.
You can place Chance to Occupy to 20 members at a time.
Regardless of actual participation of the guild member, the 1 Change to Occupy will be deducted every successful occupation of a node from a guild.
Guild Member who do not have any Chance to Occupy remaining will be classified as a non-participant and cannot take part in the Node War.
For example if there are total of 100 Guild Members in a Guild, the Guild Master can grant 20 members at a time the Chance to Occupy (from 1 to 5 times). However, all 100 Guild Members can be set to participate in the very first Node War and please check the chart with an example below for clarification.
If the 20 Guild Members who have been given 1 Chance to Occupy participates and successfully conquers to occupy a Node, that 20-member group can no longer participate in that week’s Node Wars. The remaining 80 out of a 100-member Guild, if this 80 Guild Members had been given 2~5 Chance to Occupy, will be able to participate in the next Node War.
https://i.imgur.com/eO11Jix.jpg
Chance to Occupy cannot be changed if Node War or Conquest War is in progress.
However, Conquest War allows at max 100 Guild Members to participate regardless of the number of nodes occupied by the Guild.



Conquest War

Conquest Wars have received new rules.

From the number of Conquest Nodes excluding the Normal Nodes, Guilds with 2 or more nodes occupied can build Fort/Command Posts and participate in the Conquest Wars.
In order to construct Fort/Command Post/Field HQ, you need to occupy 2 or more Conquest Nodes excluding the Normal Nodes. You can start constructing a day after occupying 2 Conquest Nodes.
In order to cut down on resurrection cooldown and time needed to move to the relevant areas, a new Castle Gate resurrection points have been added to Calpheon, Mediah, and Valencia Conquest Wars to bring the action faster to you.
Castle Gate resurrection point for Offensive and Defensive are located in different locations.
The Offensive Guild must have destroyed the Castle Gate in order to resurrect near the Castle Gate.
It has been changed so that Cannons cannot be installed inside the castle in Conquest Wars.
If a Guild with more than 2 nodes occupied is participating in the Conquest War, 2% of the tax from the territory can be collected every 10 minutes the Fort/Command post is successfully defended.
Forts/Command Posts/Field HQs needed to participate in Conquest Wars can be built on the day of the Conquest War.
The tax obtainable at this point equals 2% of the amount expected to be collected  excluding Security Budget.
This tax will be collected at the end of the Conquest War when the opposing side’s Fort/Command Post is destroyed.
Offensive side can obtain at max 20% of the territory tax.
If the Offensive side ultimately wins in the Conquest War, the tax obtained for successfully defending Fort/Command Post will not be counted in the calculation. Same as before, amount excluding Security Budget will be collected.
If the Defensive side ultimately wins in the Conquest War, total amount of tax excluding the tax already collected by the Offensive side and Security Budget will be given as the winning reward.
If there are several Guilds participating in the Offensive side, at max 20% of the tax collected for the Offensive side will be allocated by number of Guilds participating. 

For example if there are 3 Guilds participating in the Offensive side, about 6.66% (of the 20%) will be given to each Guild. Please be informed that the max 20% tax collected for the Offensive side is given only in the case where the Offensive side loses and the Defensive side wins.



If there is a Guild who defeats other remaining Guilds in the Offensive side after the Fort/Command Post/Field HQ of the Defensive Guild is destroyed, the single Guild remaining will be declared the winner and take all the tax of the territory.
Other participating Guilds in the Offensive side who loses to this single Guild cannot be given a share of the 20% tax collectable during the Conquest War.
If there is no Guild declared as the winner of the Conquest War even after the Fort/Command Post/Field HQ of the Defensive Guild is destroyed and the Conquest War time ends, the territory will be liberated and no Offensive Guild will be able to obtain the tax.



Other/Conquest War Balance

Damage of the Basic Attack, Horn Attack, Fore Chop, and Charge of the Elephant used on Castle Gates has been increased by 30%.
The number of target hits inflicted from Charge skill of the Elephant used on Castle Gate, Fort, Command Post, annexes and installments has decreased from 16 to 8 target hits.
Damage of the Basic Attack, Horn Attack, Fore Chop, and Charge of the Elephant used on other adventurers has been increased by 20%.
Damage of the Basic Attack, Horn Attack, Fore Chop, and Charge of the Elephant will now be applied on Cannons as well.
Damage from Cannons used on Castle Gates has been increased by 300%.
Damage from Cannons used on other adventurers has been increased by 400%.
Cannon’s DP has increased by 100%, and Durability has increased by 900%.
Cannons can be destroyed with ease if you utilize horses and Elephants.
Damage from horses used on Cannons has been increased by 700%.
Damage from horses used on Command Post/annexes and installments has been increased by 500%.
Siege Defense Tower’s DP has increased by 50% and Durability has increased by 900%.
Siege Defense Towers can be destroyed with ease if you utilize horses and Elephants.
Durability of Calpheon Castle’s, Mediah Castle’s, Valencia Castle’s Outer Gate and Inner Gate has decreased by 50%.
Wooden Fences and and Medium Siege Towers used in Conquest Wars has increased in height by 40%.
Moving Speed of Medium/Large Siege Towers has increased by 50%.
Medium/Large Siege Towers can be destroyed with ease if you utilize horses and Elephants.
Damage from Flame Towers used on other adventurers has been increased by 50%, and damage from Hwachas used on other adventurers has been increased by 20%.
Production time for the following items usable in Node/Conquest Wars has been reduced.

Medium Siege Tower Workshop 15 mins. → 10 mins.
Large Siege Tower Workshop 20 mins. → 15 mins.
Indomitable Flag Factory 30 mins. → 15 mins.



If the adventurer dies during Node/Conquest Wars, the corpse will disappear right away and Medical Kit or Resurrection skills will no longer be applicable.
In addition, a new view mode where you can observe the Node/Conquest War from the allies’ point-of-view called ‘Ally Viewpoint’ has been added. While using this function, press F5 to switch views amongst allies.
Due to the balance changes applied to Node/Conquest Wars, the price of the items sold by the Guild Military Supply has been changed.

[Guild] Siege Defense Tower 150,000 Silvers → 500,000 Silvers
[Guild] Wooden Fence 100,000 Silvers → 500,000 Silvers
[Guild] Barricade 25,000 Silvers → 50,000 Silvers




Node/Conquest War Schedule

The same as before:
[EU]

Sunday~Friday: Node War from 20:00 CEST until up to 22:00 CEST
Saturday: Conquest War from 20:00 CEST until up to 24:00 CEST



[NA]

Sunday~Friday: Node War from 21:00 EDT until up to 23:00 EDT
Saturday: Conquest War from 21:00 EDT until up to 01:00 EDT




Tax Collection

There will not be a separate process of collecting taxes and the tax stacked up for a week will be instantly sent as Guild Funds to the winning guild who successfully conquers and occupies a node/territory. Security Budget rules will remain the same.
Taxes will be classified among Normal Node 
https://i.imgur.com/PuX3Xps.jpg


https://i.imgur.com/PJ3r43r.jpg


https://i.imgur.com/FT8Nwdz.jpg


https://i.imgur.com/d8fE2jl.jpg

Please keep in mind Guild Alliance is a new content that will be updated in the near future and you may see texts related to Guild Alliance while you progress the new Node/Conquest Wars. As for now, please neglect the texts as Guild Alliance is not available content as of maintenance of 7/18/2018.
On last note, a special event to commemorate the new changes introduced to Node/Conquest Wars is underway and will be announced later this week.



New Transport route has been added between Sand Grain Bazaar and Altinova.

Fixed the issue where clicking ‘Get All’ button would only receive items one by one when there were both items to send and to receive on the Transport list.

It has been changed that when the Alchemy Stone can no longer go through Polishing if it has been fully upgraded.

Max amount of Skill EXP obtainable for completing Guild Quests has been increased.


System:

Fixed the issue where Boss Vision Range would not work properly when using the function with Quint and Muraka. 

It has been changed that Hotkeys on the item tooltip will also be changed when changing Hotkeys under Settings.  

It has been fixed that a system message would be displayed when there is insufficient amount of Black Stones upon trying Force-Enhance.

Fixed the issue where the voice of the Black Spirit will still come out even when the alarm for the Black Spirit was switched off under Settings.

Lv. UI of the character you want to switch to from the Change Character section on End Game window will now be placed from ‘above’ the Character Name to the ‘right of’ the Character Name. 

Application for Black Desert Global Lab will be given once per Family. (NA only)

The button for Global Lab will be more visible.

‘New’ icon has been added to Global Lab button.
Global Lab has been added to the Recommended Content located at the bottom of the new ESC menu.



Game World, NPC & Effects

NPC:

New NPC  Mano has been added to Valencia City.


Class changes

Fixed the issue where the effect of the damage being inflicted for the followed skills was not being displayed under the perspective of both the one being attacked/observer:

Ranger: Tearing Arrow II
Maehwa: Petal Drill
Ninja/Kunoichi: Suicide Fall
Ninja: Flash Bondage
Dark Knight: Repeated Annihilation, Scarring Slash



Fixed the issue where Black Spirit’s Rage was not being recovered when defeating enemies using the following summoned creatures:

Wizard: Marg, Arne
Witch: Tett, Gorr
Tamer: Heilang
Mystic: Dragon’s Pit
Defeating enemies while mounting Siege weapons like Cannons, Hwachas, and Flame Towers will also increase Black Spirt’s Rage by 1%.



Fixed the graphical awkwardness upon wearing the Coco Hat.


Ranger:

Fixed the awkward movement during the skill Pinpoint performed while moving left in Longbow combat mode.

Fixed the issue where the shape of the Giath’s Helmet would change in a specific part of customizing.


Sorceress:

It has been made easier and more natural now to switch to Scythe combat mode after using the skill Midnight Stinger.

Fixed the issue where HP equaling the amount of damage inflicted was being recovered instead upon using the skill Sinister Omen.


Witch:

Fixed the issue where the skill Absolute: Fireball could not be used when used with Charge through Quick Slot. 

Fixed the graphical awkwardness in the right shoulder upon wearing Pila Fe Outlaw outfit in a specific part of customizing.


Wizard:

Fixed the issue where the skill Absolute: Fireball could not be used when used with Charge through Quick Slot.


Musa:

Fixed the graphical issue of the back part of the Martillo swimpants.


Maehwa:

Added the missing designer name “Design: Nechu” for the outfit description of Rakshande outfit.


Ninja:

The following effect will be applied during Concealment from usage of the skills Ninjutsu: Concealment, Shadow Cloak, Ninjutsu: Oni Shadow, Shuriken: Moon Dive.

Constant consumption of Stamina -100 upon moving during Concealment.
Constant recovery of Stamina when on standby during Concealment.
Concealment will be nullified if Stamina falls below 150 during Concealment.



Defense effect of the skill Suicide Fall has changed from Invincible effect to Super Armor effect.


Kunoichi:

The following effect will be applied during Concealment from usage of the skills Ninjutsu: Concealment, Shadow Cloak, Ninjutsu: Oni Shadow, Tendon Cutter.

Constant consumption of Stamina -100 upon moving during Concealment.
Constant recovery of Stamina when on standby during Concealment.
Concealment will be nullified if Stamina falls below 150 during Concealment.



Defense effect of the skill Suicide Fall has changed from Invincible effect to Super Armor effect.

Fixed the graphical issue where the bikini part would appear on the outer part of the Cokro clothes  when wearing a bikini and Cokro clothes together in a specific part of customizing.


Dark Knight:

Fixed the issue where damage was not being applied properly upon using the skill Scarring Slash after performing Vedir’s Dogma.


Striker:

Fixed the issue where the skill Spiral Cannon would be activated upon pressing Shift + RMB after using the skill Knee Hammer.


Mystic:

Fixed the issue where the push effect of the skill Dragon’s Rip was not displayed to other adventurers.

Stiffness effect will now be applied only on the last hit of the skill Wolf’s Frenzy.

The text ‘Available with Cestus’ has been removed from the skill tooltip of the skill Wolf’s Frenzy.

Fixed the graphical issue where the bikini part would appear on the outer part of the Karlstein outfit when wearing a bikini and Karlstein outfit together in a specific part of customizing.


Item Changes

New food items have been added.
https://i.imgur.com/NXBjbbW.jpg
New Imperial Cooking box has been added.

Apprentice's Five-Grain Chicken Porridge Cooking Box.

Pack 20 Five-Grain Chicken Porridges via Imperial Cuisine to obtain the box.




New Processing Ingredient has been added.

Ground Bird Meat (Obtain by Grinding)



The text  has been added to the item tooltip of Fairy Wing items for exchange locations of Sweet Honey Wine.

Four new guild accessories have been added to the Guild shop.

These items can only be used for 7 days. They cannot be Enhanced.
You can purchase these items at a Guild shop from any Guild Manager NPC.

They can be purchased with Guild Funds by any guild member. However, your Guild Allowance must be set higher than the price of the item in order for you to purchase that item



The accessories have the same stats as the PRI versions of the following items: Ring of Crescent Guardian, Tungrad Earring, Ogre Ring, or Basilisk's Belt.
https://i.imgur.com/N06cnhT.jpg



Fixed the awkward part of the text that appears upon opening the following items.

Kamasylvia Storage +1 Expansion Bundle
Kamasylvia Storage +4 Expansion Bundle
Kamasylvia Storage +8 Expansion Bundle
Kamasylvia Stable +1 Expansion Bundle
Kamasylvia Worker Lodging +1 Expansion Bundle



For details on newly added Pearl Shop Update, please click !


Monster Changes

HP of Mirumok Destroyer Offin has been changed.

Root of Offin, Offin, Offin Tett: HP decreased by 30%
Offin's Force Shield: HP decreased by 50%



The distance that Young Khuruto would chase after has been reduced by 40%.

The Young Khuroto near NPC Karcenov in front of the Khuruto Cave has been relocated.

Color of the partial effect for the Ahib Griffon that appears in Special Quests and Co-op Quests has changed to white.

Detection range and the distance that the monster would chase after has been reduced by 50% for the following monsters at Soldier's Grave.

Frenzied Skeleton
Frenzied Skeleton Rifleman
Frenzied Skeleton Axeman
Frenzied Skeleton Watchdog
Frenzied Black Sorcerer
Grudged Skeleton



New Titles have been added for defeating monsters for Hunting.
https://i.imgur.com/3tHlC5W.jpg


Quests & Knowledge

Knowledg:

New Knowledge has been added.

Ground Bird Meat
Grilled Bird Meat
Five-Grain Chicken Porridge
Apprentice's Five-Grain Chicken Porridge Cooking Box



Interface Changes

Clicking ‘X’ on the text box that appears with less than 3 days left until expiration on items like Value Pack, Blessing of Kamasylve, Merv’s Palette will now stop the notice of expiration.

Conquest Status window UI has been improved. 

Fixed the issue where the UI name would not be refreshed intermittently when opening Mount Inventory and/or Campsite Storage.

Fixed the issue where it was not possible to tick the checkbox to use Silvers in Storage when using Stable from a territory without a Storage.

It has been updated so that Purchase would be possible right away from the Purchase window on the Stable even when not having items for Skill Change, Skill Removal, Skill Training under possession.
 
Fixed the issue where the text was cut off upon selecting Transport>Destination>Transportation for major towns from the World Map (M).
 
It has been changed that the icon of Calpheon Marketplace Director NPC Elle Belucci would be displayed at Calpheon North Gate from World Map (M).
 
Fixed the issue where a list of adventurers who had not been signed up to the guild would come out in Recruit Guild Member window.
 
The question mark icon without a function on the Extend Expiration Period window for frigates has been removed.
 
It has been changed so that registering items that cannot be stacked on the Extend Expiration Period window for frigates will no longer display +/- buttons.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where text would go out of the textbox upon selecting certain skills from the Skill Add-on UI.


Known Issues:

We are aware of the issue where the text of ‘marketplace unregistrable’ is being displayed for Marine Romance outfits. Please know that the outfits are, in fact, marketplace registrable.

We are aware that Black Spirit’s Adventure 1 icon is showing up in the ESC menu although it’s not the event period. We want to confirm that BS1 is not available at this moment and we’ll notify you when the event will restart.
