[Guild] MP Potion (Medium)
[Guild] MP Potion (Large)
[Guild] MP Potion (Extra Large)
[Guild] MP Potion (Jumbo)
[Guild] Fresh Orange Juice
[Guild] Sweet Wild Berry Juice
[Guild] Sour Green Grape Juice



The following Guild Accessories have been added to the Guild Shop:

Crimson Shadow Ring
Crimson Shadow Earring
Crimson Shadow Belt
Crimson Shadow Necklace

These items expire within 15 days of purchase, and can be purchased with Guild Funds by any Guild Member.
Please Note: You must have enough Guild Expenses available to cover the costs when buying the item(s).




Fixed the issue where Crystal information used on equipment in a Quick Slot was not displayed.

Equipped items that are expired no longer appear on your Character in the Knowledge and Pearl Shop UI.

The MAX price and MIN price of Pearl Items registered in the Marketplace will not decrease if there are less than 10 items in stock.

Fixed the issue in the description of the Grolia Hat, where it did not mention any information about the Outfit’s slot effect.


Pearl Shop:

Pearl Shop categories have been rearranged and renamed.

Please find Rookie and Skilled sub-categories under Black Spirit’s Pick tab which will offer items suitable for new and skilled adventurers.
Outfit & Costume Tab Reformed

Costume tab has been placed as a sub-category under Outfit category.
This is due to the recent revisions in the outfit/costume section that made a clear distinction between (regular) outfits and functional costumes.



New Travel Aid Tab

A new ‘Travel Aid’ tab has been added to display items that can help new adventurers get accustomed to the game.



“Other” Tabs Reformed

Tabs like 'FEED' and 'HORSE FLUTE' have been renamed or combined with other tabs.



Choose-your-own Bundle/Package

A new feature where you can choose from a selection of items and purchase your own bundle/package at a discounted price. Choose from the available items and explore the possibilities!
Currently available with [2nd Anniversary] Fluffy Friends Pack.




For details on newly added Pearl Shop items and the 2nd Anniversary Sale, please click !


Monster Changes

Fixed the issue causing unnatural movements from characters who were attacked by Red Nose.


Quests 6 Knowledge

3 New quests have been added to the Serendia Western Gateway location.

Characters level 21 or higher can proceed to NPC ‘Batuetta’ and interact to initiate the quest.
You can now gain “Happy Batuetta” Knowledge while performing the related quests.



Training EXP is now rewarded after completing the quest [Training] In Search of the Finest Courser.


Interface Changes

A Newly revamped UI and ESC Menu have been added.

Switch to the new UI by pressing the Switch Menu button located on the bottom of the original ESC Menu.
Newly created accounts will have this new ESC UI Menu on by default while others will need to enable it by using the button located at the bottom of the current ESC Menu.

Please Note: To return to the old UI from the new ESC Menu, press the ‘Switch Menu’ button located on the upper right-hand corner of the new ESC Menu.



You can adjust which side the new ESC Menu will open from (Left or Right side of screen), via the option “Open from the right” or “Open from the left” on the upper left hand side of the new ESC Menu.
Accessing the following windows should now be quicker and more intuitive:

Knowledge Base, Escape, Inventory, Setting Archive, Pearl Shop, Quick Hotkey, Settings, and Disconnect.




The Enhancement window has been reworked, and should be more intuitive. You should also be able to check the results of your Enhancements more easily.

The Trade Info window has been reworked. You can check the information on Imperial Delivery of each region more intuitively with 2 options of Show Name and Show Icon.

The Ranking window has been reworked to allow you to see all of your ranks at the same time, instead of having to go through each tab individually.

In the new ESC Menu, you can customize your own ESC Menu through ESC>My Menu>Edit Menu.

Along with My Menu, You can find additional functions in the Content, War/Co-op, Info/Function, and Community categories of the new ESC Menu.

With the roll-up type menu buttons, Recommended Content section at the bottom of the new ESC Menu will keep showing the various contents available to enjoy in Black Desert Online.  

A new function, Notepad, has been added to the ESC Menu.

You can have up to a maximum of 15 Notes, or delete Notes in the Notepad window..
You can write up to a maximum of 2,000 characters in a single Note.
Each Note will have a box you can check to pin the Note to your game screen.
You can edit your pinned Notes.
You can use the Sticker UI button to drag Notes out of the game window.



The Settings window has been reworked.

Previously this window contained the options for Screen, Audio, Game, Input, UI HotKey, and Performance categories. This has been reorganized into primary categories: Performance, Screen, Sound, Game, and Interface.
The option ‘Simple Setting’ has been added to the Settings window.

Allowing for the selection of 8 preset game settings, and 2 additional slots for custom settings, which can be uploaded and saved from the bottom left of the Settings Window.



The 8 presets are described in the chart below:

Please Note: The graduated scroll bars in the Settings window are divided into twenty sections. The left end of the bar is 0% and the right is 100%.
https://i.imgur.com/juACovk.jpg




The Marketplace Notification system (Notice) has been improved:

When an item has been registered in the Marketplace that is either an item you registered for notification, and/or that you have placed a pre-order for, a notification will now appear. When clicked additional related information will be shown. 
Within the additional information window, up to 20 notifications will be shown, these notifications can also be cancelled from this window.
The notifications listed in the additional information window will be reset when the game is loaded again after re-logging or changing servers.
When there is a notification alert, the notification icon will be visible at the bottom right of the screen. 
A Warning message will appear if a Pre-order price has been set to a value that exceeds triple the amount allowed for the maximum registration price of an item when placing the Pre-order in Marketplace.



Fixed the issue where the tooltip was not being displayed when mousing over the normal rank icon in the Guild Member Status window.

The font size of the Guild Funds amount within the Guild Shop window has been increased.

The Spanish language option has been added to Chat Channel in Settings.

Fixed the issue where the names of certain items in Marketplace were overlapping with Marketplace notifications due to the text length.

Notices for Marketplace items will show up even if those items were sold via Pre-Order.
 
Fixed the issue where the Help button on the Lv.50 Guide Window would not bring up the relevant page when pressed.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where Node Forts could be installed on top of the roofs and stables in 2 Serendia Swamp Node War Areas: Northwestern Gateway and Eastern Gateway.

Any forts and annexes built in the above mentioned locations have been removed. If there was a Node War in progress, the guild possessing the node will still remain as the victor of the node.



Fixed the issue where the Long-tailed Rosefinch would not sit on the character’s shoulder when either Hedgehog or Snowkid were also summoned simultaneously.

Fixed the graphical glitch causing pets to appear outside of the Residence while in the Place Mode.


Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German, French or Spanish click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes
Spanish Patch Notes

notes.title: Patch Notes - 28th February 2018 (1st Part)
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/m2db2kz.jpg

2nd Year Anniversary Update!
On March 3rd, 2016, Black Desert Online launched, embarking on an epic adventure in North America and Europe. To commemorate our 2nd anniversary of this special day, we have prepared several awesome events over the following weeks, released the Absolute Skills for all classes, and included a special Appreciation Gift in the in-game mail to commemorate this exciting day! Find out additional details on all the changes being introduced this week below.


Event & System

Content:

“Absolute” Skills have been added for All Classes.

After completing the Awakening Weapon quests at Lv.56, Absolute Skills can be learned through the Skill window > Main. 
In order to learn Absolute Skills, the relevant Skills must first be levelled up to their maximum. 
Absolute Skills inflict more damage and hits than regular Main Weapon Skills.  
Find Absolute Skill additions below under Class category or check  for full details.



A new search function has been added to the Alchemy and Cooking windows.

Knowledge filtering function and search function has been added while performing Alchemy and Cooking.
Click on the “Learned Recipe/Alchemy” box to filter to view only the ones that you have knowledge of.
Enter a word into the search field and all the Knowledges that contain the word will be displayed.
When using the search function, only Knowledges you have already obtained will be displayed. When searching for a Knowledge you have not obtained, it will display a message letting you know that there is no Knowledge that contains the search phrase.
Equipment items and Pearl Shop items can no longer be used as an ingredient for Alchemy and Cooking.



A Guild Expense system has been added.

This system will allow the Guild Master to set the MAX amount of Guild Funds any guild member can spend when purchasing from the Guild Shop.
Guild Masters can set an individual Guild Member’s spend amount by clicking on the individual’s name from the Guild Member Status UI.
The spending amount of a Guild Member can be set, the default being 0. If desired, no limit can be set for a member.
Once a Guild Member has depleted their allocated Expense funds, no further purchases can be made until the amount has been reset by the Guild Master, which can be done at any time.
Guild Funds can be used at the Guild Shop or Guild Military Supply Manager NPC’s.
Guild members, depending on their rank, will be allowed to purchase Guild Items and make use of the Guild Storage System as before. This has not been changed.



The recent price of items on the Marketplace will be reset during every maintenance.

The recent price after every maintenance will not be displayed until the very first transaction of the item has been completed.



The Cooldown (1 sec.) has been removed for: continuously moving items from the Mount Inventory or Campsite Store; or continuously switching your Main Weapon.


Fixed the issue where the Hwacha and Flame Towers would not fire intermittently during Conquest/Node Wars.


Event:

On behalf of the Black Desert Online team, we’d like to extend our gratitude for joining us on this adventure.

To show our appreciation for the affection and dedication you’ve shown us, we are sending out an ‘[Event] Appreciation Gift’ via in-game mail to every adventurer during the maintenance on February 28th, 2018. 
Please claim your ‘Event Appreciation Gift’ before maintenance on March 14th, 2018.
From the [Event] Appreciation Gift, you may receive one of the following items at random:

Red Nose’s Armor, Giath’s Helmet, Bheg’s Gloves, Muskan’s Shoes, Dim Tree Spirit’s Armor, Griffon’s Helmet, Urugon’s Shoes, Kzarka’s Sealed Weapon Box, Nouver's Sealed Sub-weapon Box, Kutum’s Sealed Sub-weapon Box, Dandelion Weapon Box




Discount Coupons will be given out to all Adventurers who log in.

10% Discount Coupon x1, Function 20% DC Coupon x1
Coupons are valid until March 14th, 08:59 UTC.



To commemorate the addition of Absolute Skills, Armstrong’s Skill Guide (1 Day)  will be available on sale for a limited period.

Special 20 pearl items have been included in the Pearl Shop for a limited period.

Selected Pearl Shop Categories are on Sale!

Lavientia's Accessory event has been added.

Event Period: February 28th (After Maintenance) ~ March 21st (At the start of Maintenance).
During the event period, Defeat monsters, Gather, and Fish to obtain a variety of event items.
During the event period (from Mar. 1st 00:00 UTC ~ Mar. 21st Before Maintenance), play 1 hour daily and receive rewards through the Challenges (Y) tab.
Click  for details on this glamorous event.



Seven New Event Challenges (Y) for Rookie Adventurers have been added to the game.

Event Period: February 28th (After Maintenance) ~ April 25th (Before Maintenance).
Only Rookie Adventurers with less than 1440 total minutes of gameplay time are eligible to complete special Challenges for rewards.
Adventurers who have already completed the 1st Day Challenge are then eligible to progress through the 2nd ~ 7th Day Challenges for more rewards.
The Challenge rewards are as follows:

1st Day: [Event] Settlement Pack, Horse Emblem for Adventurers (Tier 5)
2nd Day: [Event] Naughty Dog, [Event] Lahr Arcien Weapon & Outfit Box (7 Days)
3rd Day: Gold Bar 100G, [Event] Inventory +2 Expansion Coupon (x2)
4th Day: [Event] Horse Flute (7 Days), Black Stone [Weapon] (x10)
5th Day: Professional Worker Contract Bundle, Black Stone [Armor] (x10)
6th Day: Advice of Valks(+10), Advice of Valks(+20)
7th Day: [Event] Settlement Pack, [Event] Item Collection Increase Scroll




Special EXP Boost event will be held in commemoration of the 2nd anniversary!

2nd Anniversary Boost

Period: 3/1 ~ 3/5 
Boost: Combat EXP +200%  Skill EXP +20%



Weekday Boost

Period 3/6 ~ 3/9 
Combat EXP +100%  Skill EXP +10%



Weekend Boost

3/10 ~ 3/12 
Combat EXP +200%  Skill EXP +20%




2nd Anniversary Fireworks!

Fascinating array of fireworks will light up the dark skies in Velia, Heidel, and Calpheon City to celebrate our 2nd year together! 
Date: March 3rd, 2018

15:00 PM PST for NA
16:00 PM CET for EU




All Valentine’s themed decorations in the game world have been removed.

The “Lovely Drop Event” which increased the drop rate for Hard and Sharp Black Crystal Shards has come to an end and drop rate has returned to normal.

The Valentine’s Day Events “Love in a Bottle” & “Chocolate Fun” have ended.


System:

The new 3D Minimap feature has been added.

The button on the upper left-hand corner indicates the type of Minimap you are currently using. Press it to toggle between 2D and 3D.
Your Minimap setting (2D or 3D) will be maintained even after reconnecting to the game.
Thanks to the 3D Minimap, you will not only be able to see the topography of the landscape from your Character’s viewpoint but also have a 360 degree view of the topography around you on the map.
You will be able to see the 3D topography in the Desert and Great Ocean as well. However, buildings there will not be marked on the 3D Minimap while in these areas.
The 3D Minimap does not give directional cues for the location of your Quests or Party members.
However, location identification marks to show Quest objective regions and other special areas, such as locations marked by Pet alerts are planned to be added in the future.
You can adjust the 3D Minimap settings through the following area:

Settings > Game > Etc. > Misc. > Rotate Minimap to add even more functionality to the 3D Minimap.



For additional details on the how the 3D Minimap will function, please click .



Game World, NpC & Effects

Fixed the graphical issue in Mediah Castle where a part of the grass appeared to be floating.

Fixed the graphical issue in Mediah Castle where a part of the grass appeared to be floating.

Invisible walls at Mediah Castle have been removed.

Objects in Sausan Garrison that could be passed through have been removed.

Pillars have been added inside the Hystria Ruins.

The insides of the Hystria Ruins has been redesigned to contain less obstructions and improve ease of navigation while defeating monsters in the area.

The wagon located at the entrance of Kamasylve Temple has been removed.

Effects that are too close to the camera will not be displayed.

Fixed the graphical issue that would prevent certain skill effects from correctly displaying when the ‘Hit Effects’ setting was disabled.

The Gateway at the Closed Western Gateway Node, which was previously closed has now been opened, as a result of this the name of the node has been changed to Serendia Western Gateway.

Fixed the graphical glitch in certain areas of the Gyfin Rhasia Temple that would cause the screen to display underwater effects.

NPC Guards that were occasionally attacking characters with positive Karma Points have been fixed.


Class Changes

All Classes

Stamina consumption while Sprinting in the Awakening Weapon stance has been decreased by about 25%.
Please Note: Some skills may have reduced damage when engaging PvP targets. (Please check each skill description)



Warrior

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute: Slash, Absolute: Heavy Strike, Absolute: Chopping Kick, Absolute: Shield Strike, Absolute: Forward Slash, Absolute: Sideways Cut, Absolute: Counter, Absolute: Spinning Slash, Absolute: Take Down, Absolute: Shield Counter, Absolute: Shield Charge, Absolute: Charging Slash, Absolute: Deep Thrust, Absolute: Charging Thrust, Absolute: Ground Roar, Ground Smash, Absolute: Ground Slash, Absolute: Deep Ground Slash




Ranger

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute:  Bow Skill, Absolute: Dagger of Protection, Absolute:  Extreme Charging Wind, Absolute:  Charging Wind, Absolute: Crescent Kick, Absolute: Razor Wind, Absolute: Pinpoint, Absolute: Dash Kick, Absolute: Evasive Shot, Absolute: Evasive Explosion Shot, Absolute: Round Kick, Absolute: Tearing Arrow, Absolute: Blasting Gust, Absolute: Will of the Wind, Absolute: Penetrating Wind, Absolute: Descending Current



Fixed the issue where the skill ‘Flow: Piercing Wind’ was consuming more Stamina than  intended.



Sorceress

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute: Signs of Agony, Absolute: Shadow Eruption, Absolute: Mark of the Shadow, Absolute: Dream of Doom, Absolute: Sinister Energy, Absolute: Abyssal Flame, Absolute: Claws of Darkness, Absolute: Dark Flame, Absolute: Dark Split, Absolute: Sharp Nails, Absolute: Darkness Released, Absolute: Shadow Kick, Absolute: Crow Flare, Absolute: Beak Kick, Absolute: Scattering Shadow, Absolute: Midnight Stinger, Absolute: Bloody Calamity, Absolute: Rushing Crow, Absolute: Absolute Darkness, Absolute: Black Wave



Description of the Skill Shadow Kick has been modified.

Stiffness and Down Smash are not applied during the cooldown time.



The issue where the Air Attack effect was not applied while using the Skill Dark Flame twice has been fixed.



Berserker

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute: Fearsome Tyrant, Absolute: Storming Beast, Absolute: Smack Down, Absolute: Undertaker, Absolute: Headbutt, Absolute: Tackling Rock, Absolute: Fierce Strike, Absolute: Frenzied Destroyer, Absolute: Predatory Hunt, Absolute: Raging Thunder, Absolute: Elastic Force, Absolute: Falling Rock, Absolute: Weakling Hunt, Absolute: Corpse Storm, Absolute: Beastly Wind Slash, Absolute: Wrath of Beast, Absolute: Ire of Beast, Absolute: Beast Roar



“Pushes the target on lateral attacks (PvE Only)” has been added to the description of Berserker’s Skill Buster Training.
The issue where the damage from Tackling Rock was not applied correctly according to the Skill’s level has been fixed.



Tamer

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute: Leaf Slash, Absolute: Bolt Wave, Absolute: Jolt Wave, Absolute: Flurry of Kicks, Absolute: Evasive Attack, Absolute: Tree Climb, Absolute: Soaring Kick, Absolute: Flash, Absolute: Flash Pole Thrust, Absolute: Flash Stance Shift, Absolute: Void Lightning, Absolute: Trample, Absolute: Scratch, Absolute: Throat-Burn, Absolute: Roaring, Absolute: Surging Tide, Absolute: Whiplash, Absolute: Upward Claw, Absolute: Lightning of Earth, Absolute: Fearful Trembling, Absolute: Stretch Kick



If a monster dies from the Tamer’s first hit of the skill ‘Tree Climb’, Tamer will now move backwards in midair and land on the ground so additional combos can be performed. 
The skill command for ‘Heilang: Trample’ can now be locked.
Fixed the issue where Celestial Bo Staff stance would unintentionally switch to Short Sword stance while using the skill ‘Legendary Beast’s Power’ in an area with a difference in elevation.
Fixed the issue where Celestial Bo Staff would not switch to the Short Sword combat stance when using the skill ‘Legendary Beast’s Power’, followed by the skill ‘Bolt Wave’ from a Quick Slot without having obtained the skill ‘Ultimate: Bolt Wave’.
Corrected the skill description for ‘Flow: Scatter Stance’ to display the correct Preceding Skill name.
The issue where some descriptions of Main Weapon Skills did not mention their HP/MP recovery effects has been fixed.



Valkyrie

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute: Valkyrie Slash, Absolute: Forward Slash, Absolute: Charging Slash, Absolute: Sideways Cut, Absolute: Severing Light, Absolute: Breath of Elion, Absolute: Sword of Judgment, Absolute: Shield Strike, Absolute: Shield Throw, Absolute: Just Counter, Absolute: Skyward Strike, Absolute: Judgment of Light, Absolute: Counter, Absolute: Sharp Light, Absolute: Flurry of Kicks, Absolute: Flying Kick, Absolute: Double Flying Kick, Absolute: Punishment, Absolute: Divine Power, Absolute: Heaven's Echo, Absolute: Glaring Slash, Absolute: Celestial Spear, Absolute: Shining Dash, Absolute: Ultimate Righteous Charge



Fixed the issue where the cooldown time of the skill ‘Flurry of Kicks’ was activated simultaneously with either ‘Divine Power’ or ‘Righteous Charge’ after using the skill ‘Celestial Spear’.



Witch

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute: Earthquake, Absolute: Meteor Shower, Absolute: Fireball, Absolute: Lightning, Absolute: Residual Lightning, Absolute: Lightning Chain, Absolute: Lightning Storm, Absolute: Freeze, Absolute: Frigid Fog, Absolute: Blizzard, Absolute: Multiple Magic Arrows, Absolute: Concentrated Magic Arrow, Absolute: Fireball Explosion, Absolute: Dagger Stab, Absolute: Earth's Response, Absolute: Staff Attack

Improved the neck movement of the Wizard’s when looking up at the camera.



Musa

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute: Slice, Absolute: Whirlwind Cut, Absolute: Retaliation, Absolute: Upper Kick, Absolute: Blunt Kick, Absolute: Sweep Kick, Absolute: Roundhouse Kick, Absolute: Carver, Absolute: Stub Arrow, Absolute: Divider, Absolute: Dragon Bite, Absolute: Dragon Claw, Absolute: Blind Thrust, Absolute: Nemesis Slash, Absolute: Blooming, Absolute: Lunar Slash, Absolute: Rising Storm, Absolute: Cyclone Slash, Absolute: Blind Slash, Absolute: Gale, Absolute: Musa Spirit, Absolute: Backstep Slash, Absolute: Charged Stub Arrow




Maehwa

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute: Slice, Absolute: Whirlwind Cut, Absolute: Retaliation, Absolute: Upper Kick, Absolute: Blunt Kick, Absolute: Sweep Kick, Absolute: Roundhouse Kick, Absolute: Carver, Absolute: Stub Arrow, Absolute: Divider, Absolute: Dragon Bite, Absolute: Dragon Claw, Absolute: Blind Thrust, Absolute: Nemesis Slash, Absolute: Blooming, Absolute: Lunar Slash, Absolute: Red Moon, Absolute: Cyclone Slash, Absolute: Blind Slash, Absolute: Decapitation, Absolute: Backstep Slash, Absolute: Maehwa's Will, Absolute: Charged Stub Arrow




Ninja

Absolute: Wind Slash, Absolute: Fatal Blow, Absolute: Crescent Slash, Absolute: Brace, Absolute: Throwing Kick, Absolute: Floor Sweeping, Absolute: Kunai Throw, Absolute: Shuriken Throw, Absolute: Shuriken Malice, Absolute: Shuriken Flight, Absolute: Shadow Slash, Absolute: Heart Aiming, Absolute: Suicide Fall, Absolute: Ankle Cutter, Absolute: Ghost Greeting, Absolute: Fox Claw, Absolute: Shadow Stomp, Absolute: Shadow Clone, Absolute: Boss Slaughter, Absolute: Shackles, Absolute: Ground Thrust, Absolute: Blade Spin, Absolute: Black Moonlight, Absolute: Beheading the Dead



Forward Guard has been added to the skill ‘Flow: Mach Explosion’.



Kunoichi

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute: Wind Slash, Absolute: Fatal Blow, Absolute: Crescent Slash, Absolute: Brace, Absolute: Throwing Kick, Absolute: Floor Sweeping, Absolute: Kunai Throw, Absolute: Shuriken Throw, Absolute: Shadow Slash, Absolute: Heart Aiming, Absolute: Suicide Fall, Absolute: Ankle Cutter, Absolute: Ghost Greeting, Absolute: Fox Claw, Absolute: Shadow Stomp, Absolute: Shadow Clone, Absolute: Flash Slash, Absolute: Shackles, Absolute: Tragic Blade, Absolute: Ground Thrust, Absolute: Tendon Cutter, Absolute: Black Moonlight, Absolute: Shadow Explosion




Dark Knight

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute: Kriegsmesser Training, Absolute: Scarring Slash, Absolute: Sudden Attack, Absolute: Unveiled Dagger, Absolute: Hidden Strike, Absolute: Shadow Bullet, Absolute: Darkness Burst, Absolute: Air Strike, Absolute: Lunacy of Vedir, Absolute: Slanted Balance, Absolute: Pervasive Darkness, Absolute: Ravage Rake, Absolute: Flow Ravage Rake, Absolute: Repeated Annihilation, Absolute: Enforcement, Absolute: Split Second, Absolute: Kamasylvia Slash, Absolute: Wheel of Fortune, Absolute: Obsidian Ashes, Absolute: Corrupt Ground, Absolute: Nocturne




Striker

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute: Heavy Fist, Absolute: Fist of True Strength, Absolute: Triple Flying Kick, Absolute: Adamantine, Absolute: Mass Destruction, Absolute: Ankle Hook, Absolute: Deva King, Absolute: Taeback Kick, Absolute: Hidden Claw, Absolute: Rage Hammer, Absolute: Wolf's Fang, Absolute: Somersault, Absolute: Massive Suppression, Absolute: Twisted Collision, Absolute: Knee Hammer, Absolute: Rock Smash, Absolute: Tornado Kick, Absolute: Sweeping Kick, Absolute: Roaring Tiger, Absolute: Fist Fury, Absolute: Wolf's Hunger, Absolute: Crimson Fang, Absolute: Explosive Blow, Absolute: Stalking Wolf



Striker’s skill ‘Heavy Fist’ will now properly display effects when mounted on a horse.
Fixed the abnormal motion of the Striker when attacked while using the skill ‘Flow: Crosswind’.
Fixed the abnormal motion when landing from certain heights when performing the skill ‘Flow: Crosswind’.
Fixed the graphical issue where Striker appeared to be underwater inside a cave at Demi Riverhead during the Awakening Weapon quest.



Mystic

The following Absolute Skills for the Main Weapon have been added:

Absolute: Heavy Fist, Absolute: Fist of True Strength, Absolute: Triple Flying Kick, Absolute: Adamantine, Absolute: Sweeping Kick, Absolute: Soul Basher, Absolute: Ankle Hook, Absolute: Deva Queen, Absolute: Hidden Claw, Absolute: Thunder Pound, Absolute: Death Clout, Absolute: Elbow Edge, Absolute: Rib Crusher, Absolute: Tornado Kick, Absolute: Somersault, Absolute: Twisted Collision, Absolute: Roaring Tiger, Absolute: Rage Hammer, Absolute: Mass Destruction, Absolute: Binding




*Continue reading part 2 of the patch notes .

To commemorate the addition of Absolute Skills, Armstrong’s Skill Guide (1 Day)  will be available on sale for a limited period.

Special 20 pearl items have been included in the Pearl Shop for a limited period.

Selected Pearl Shop Categories are on Sale!

Lavientia's Accessory event has been added.

Event Period: February 28th (After Maintenance) ~ March 21st (At the start of Maintenance).
During the event period, Defeat monsters, Gather, and Fish to obtain a variety of event items.
During the event period (from Mar. 1st 00:00 UTC ~ Mar. 21st Before Maintenance), play 1 hour daily and receive rewards through the Challenges (Y) tab.
Click  for details on this glamorous event.



Seven New Event Challenges (Y) for Rookie Adventurers have been added to the game.

Event Period: February 28th (After Maintenance) ~ April 25th (Before Maintenance).
Only Rookie Adventurers with less than 1440 total minutes of gameplay time are eligible to complete special Challenges for rewards.
Adventurers who have already completed the 1st Day Challenge are then eligible to progress through the 2nd ~ 7th Day Challenges for more rewards.
The Challenge rewards are as follows:

1st Day: [Event] Settlement Pack, Horse Emblem for Adventurers (Tier 5)
2nd Day: [Event] Naughty Dog, [Event] Lahr Arcien Weapon & Outfit Box (7 Days)
3rd Day: Gold Bar 100G, [Event] Inventory +2 Expansion Coupon (x2)
4th Day: [Event] Horse Flute (7 Days), Black Stone [Weapon] (x10)
5th Day: Professional Worker Contract Bundle, Black Stone [Armor] (x10)
6th Day: Advice of Valks(+10), Advice of Valks(+20)
7th Day: [Event] Settlement Pack, [Event] Item Collection Increase Scroll




Special EXP Boost event will be held in commemoration of the 2nd anniversary!

2nd Anniversary Boost

Period: 3/1 ~ 3/5 
Boost: Combat EXP +200%  Skill EXP +20%



Weekday Boost

Period 3/6 ~ 3/9 
Combat EXP +100%  Skill EXP +10%



Weekend Boost

3/10 ~ 3/12 
Combat EXP +200%  Skill EXP +20%




2nd Anniversary Fireworks!

Fascinating array of fireworks will light up the dark skies in Velia, Heidel, and Calpheon City to celebrate our 2nd year together! 
Date: March 3rd, 2018

15:00 PM PST for NA
16:00 PM CET for EU




All Valentine’s themed decorations in the game world have been removed.

The “Lovely Drop Event” which increased the drop rate for Hard and Sharp Black Crystal Shards has come to an end and drop rate has returned to normal.

The Valentine’s Day Events “Love in a Bottle” & “Chocolate Fun” have ended.


System:

The new 3D Minimap feature has been added.

The button on the upper left-hand corner indicates the type of Minimap you are currently using. Press it to toggle between 2D and 3D.
Your Minimap setting (2D or 3D) will be maintained even after reconnecting to the game.
Thanks to the 3D Minimap, you will not only be able to see the topography of the landscape from your Character’s viewpoint but also have a 360 degree view of the topography around you on the map.
You will be able to see the 3D topography in the Desert and Great Ocean as well. However, buildings there will not be marked on the 3D Minimap while in these areas.
The 3D Minimap does not give directional cues for the location of your Quests or Party members.
However, location identification marks to show Quest objective regions and other special areas, such as locations marked by Pet alerts are planned to be added in the future.
You can adjust the 3D Minimap settings through the following area:

Settings > Game > Etc. > Misc. > Rotate Minimap to add even more functionality to the 3D Minimap.



For additional details on the how the 3D Minimap will function, please click .

notes.title: Patch Notes - 21st February 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/kbN9P1n.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

A new PvP experience is waiting for those who enjoy a good brawl between fellow Adventurers, the Arsha Server! The game mechanics on Arsha are slightly modified, notably increased defence stats and mechanics to enable fairer, less one sided fights.
This week’s patch brings also bug fixes, balance improvements and added functionalities.


Event & System

Content:

A PVP-specific Arsha Server has been added.

Red Battlefield is accessible in Arsha Server and the rewards will be same as other servers.
A specialized PVP balance will be applied in Arsha Server in comparison to the other regular servers.

All Characters’ PVP DP will be raised
Pressing Shift while ‘down’ will activate guard stance while still lying down and reduce the damage you are taking (Guard Gauge -50%, Damage Reduction +80%)
Characters will be immune from all debuffs for a certain amount of time if affected more than three times from Bound, Floating, Stun, and Grapple.
The damage calculations are different from that of normal servers and as a result, the buff “Damage Against Humans” may be less effective.
All monsters with the exceptions of field and world bosses and the Desert Merchant Caravan of Valencia will still be present.
PvP between Characters (including Forced PvP) will be free from all penalties. However, if a character with an evil Karma rating enters the new server, the usual negative Karma penalties will still be experienced.
You may still regain positive Karma points by killing monsters.
Like regular servers, if you have evil Karma and are killed by an NPC or another Adventurer in the Desert, you will be sent to jail.




The following items have been added to Patrigio’s shop.

Kzarka's Sealed Weapon Box
Nouver's Sealed Sub-weapon Box
Kutum’s Sealed Sub-weapon Box
Dandelion Weapon Box
※The Class-specific Boss Weapons that were already being sold will appear at the same rate as before.



The names of the following items have been changed to show a clearer difference:

Kibelius Armor/Set A → Kibelius Divinus Armor/Set
Kibelius Armor/Set B → Kibelius Armor/Set



Fixed the issue where you could see Characters from other Parties while using a monster Summon Scroll.

You can now try on Underwear and Accessories in Pearl Shop’s Mix&Match feature.


Event:

‘Send Love’ event of the Valentine’s Day Events has ended.

Valentine’s Day Screenshot Event submission period has ended.


System:

Depository has been renamed as "Settings Archive".

Fixed the issue causing the settings for Func 1 and Func 2 (Settings → Input → Gamepad Input Settings) would not properly stay cleared after reconnecting to the game.

Fixed the system message that appears when collecting Haystack for Elephant.

Fixed the abrupt camera transition during auto-run.

Adjustments have been made to the following servers.

Arsha Server has been added.
Valencia 6 has returned from PvP-exclusive to a normal server.
Olvia_Steam servers have become normal Olvia servers.



 Game World, NPC & Effects

Fixed the issue where Characters could swim in the cave inside Serene Spring.

Fixed the graphical glitch on tree branches near Mediah Shore.

Fixed the issue where Node Forts and Annexes were installable on top of round building during Node War.

Fixed the issue where Characters could go into some of the objects inside Hystria Ruins.


NPC:

Fixed the issue where players kept interacting with NPCs next to bookshelves instead of the books in the Great Library of Calpheon


Class Changes

All Classes

The amount of Stamina consumed while sprinting with any Matchlock equipped has been reduced.
Fixed the unnecessary jittering of the Matchlock when in a sitting stance.
Fixed the issue where Character’s frowning expression did not go away after getting hit while wearing one of the following equipment.

Fishing Rod, Harpoon, Terrmian Coconut, Matchlock, Trina Demolition Axe




Warrior

The Attack area for Flow: Ankle Break is now a circular shape.
The PvE damage from Flow: Armor Break has been increased.

568% x 3 → 653% x 3



The PvE damage from Merciless has been increased.
https://i.imgur.com/cVANzoT.jpg
The Attack Speed of Merciless has been adjusted so that one hit is now around 16% faster.
The Smash Attack Hit Damage of Flow: Slashing the Dead has been increased by one.
WP Recovery from Balance Strike has been increased twofold.
Damage from Spinning Slash (I-IV) has been increased.

Damage from using the Skill with Black Spirit's Rage has been increased as follows:
https://i.imgur.com/44BxVMs.jpg



Damage from Spinning Slash IV using Black Spirit’s Rage has been increased.
Fixed the issue where Spinning Slash using Black Spirit’s Rage was not being applied intermittently.
Attack ranges for the skills Ground Smash II and IV have expanded.
Damage of the skill Ground Smash has been increased.

Damage when using the Skill with Black Spirit's Rage has been increased as follows:
https://i.imgur.com/Y8sVHPg.jpg



Super Armor effect will now be applied when using Chopping Kick.

However, when used during Cooldown the Super Armor effect will not be applied.



WP Recovery from Chopping Kick has been increased.
https://i.imgur.com/5476Exe.jpg
The line “Hold RMB to perform extra attack” has been added to the Skill description of Merciless.
Fixed the issue where sometimes only one Smash Attack hit damage was applied when using Flow: Slashing the Dead with a Character that learned Grave Digging only up to level III.



Tamer

Fixed Heilang’s unnatural movement, which occurred when Allround Spinner was used after Summon Heilang.



Valkyrie

Fixed the buggy motion triggered upon using Flurry of Kicks while moving forward after using Guard.
Fixed how Sanctitas de Enslar was used first when Divine Power or Righteous Charge was used after Celestial Spear.



Witch

Fixed the issue where sometimes you could not summon Gorr and Tett.



Wizard

Fixed the issue where sometimes you could not summon Marg and Arne.



Musa

The WP required for Spinner has been reduced by 10 each.
The Stamina required for using Musa's Spirit has been reduced by 50.
The Hit Range of One Step Back has been increased by around 25% so that opponents near where your Character lands may also be hit.
Chaining from Fiery Angel to the following is now smoother.

Spinner, One Step Back, Below the Belt, Fiery Crevice, Flow: Backflow, Awakening: Haeam's Crescent Blade



Flow: Dash Slash has been changed as follows:

You can now use Quick Slot to use the Skill more quickly.
“Knockback on good hits” and “Bound on extra hit” effects have been replaced by Down Smash.
You can now use this Skill more quickly.



Fixed the issue preventing you from chaining to Crescent Blade Skills after using Fiery Crevice or One Step Back via Quick Slot in Blade combat stance.



Maehwa

Fixed the issue where the actual visual effect and the effect shown in the skill video of Roundhouse Kick were different.



Ninja

HP Recovery from Ninjutsu: Shadow Clone has been increased.
You will now recover 50 HP per good Fox Claw hit.
You can now use Ninjutsu: Shackles more quickly.
You can now land hits at a certain rate at the Max Hit Range when using Ninjutsu: Shadow Clone which is a change from the previous expanding Attack Ranges.



Kunoichi

HP Recovery from Ninjutsu: Shadow Clone has been increased.
You will now recover 50 HP per good Fox Claw hit.
You can now use Ninjutsu: Shackles more quickly.
Ninjutsu: Shadow Clone will now inflict the same amount of damage on the targets regardless of the distance covered by the attack range of the skill.



Dark Knight

Fixed the issue where the actual visual effect and the effect in the skill video of Flow: Spirit Blaze were different.
Fixed the issue where with certain customization presets, Dark Knight’s cape looked odd while running in a Rosa Cassius outfit.



Striker

Martial Spirit Skill is now passive.

If you use one of the following skills while having already learned Martial Spirit, you will get Movement Speed +30% and Accuracy +6% for 5 sec.

Fist of True Strength, Triple Flying Kick, Crimson Fang, Knee Hammer, Spiral Cannon, Rampaging Predator



If you successfully land hits from one of the following skills while having already learned Martial Spirit, the hit opponent’s WP/MP(EP)/SP will reduce by 5 at a time:

Adamantine, Fist Fury, Somersault, Crimson Fang, Flow: Explosive Blow, Taeback Kick Hidden Claw, Ultimate Crush, Spiral Cannon, Flow: Crosswind, Fallout, Ferocious Assault 




Improvements were made so that the skill Flow: Mass Destruction will function more smoothly when pressing  ← + RMB or → + RMB with the Gardbrace on during combat.  
Improvements were made so that the skill Fallout will activate upon pressing RMB while moving backwards with the Gardbrace on during combat.
Adjusted the Martial Spirit skill description to contain ‘reduction of WP/MP/SP upon good hit’ for the following skills:

Flow: Mass Destruction, Rising Blast Combo, Flow: Deathstrike, Combo: Hurricane, Combo: Venom Fang, Combo: Final Blow, Flow: Savage Fang, Ankle Hook, Deva King, Knee Hammer, Flow: Tornado Kick, Flow: Rock Smash



Using Taeback Kick with the Gardbrace will now have Martial Spirit effects applied.



Mystic

Fixed the issue when Mystic equipped Ahon Kirus armor, the dagger of the outfit looked awkward.



Item Changes

The item Blessing of Kamasylve (15 Days) is now available to be registered at the Marketplace.

Fixed how the Guild Military Supply Manager was not selling [Guild] Elephant Trap items.

Blue-grade items that have been Enhanced to PEN (V) will now be listed in the Marketplace even if they have never been sold there before.

You can also Pre-Order or set Notifications for these items even if they don’t have sales histories yet.



Pearl Shop

Classic (Weapon & Outfit) Sets on the Pearl Shop will be on Sale until March 7th Maintenance.

The Little Monster Box is back on the Pearl Shop for a limited time.

Event Period: Feb. 21st After Maintenance - Mar. 7th Before Maintenance

Little Monster Box is being sold until Mar. 7th Maintenance; Exchange period for Pet Seals will be until Mar 14th Maintenance.



All monster Pet Seals will be removed on Mar. 14th Maintenance.

Please make sure to exchange all of your remaining Pet Seals before the event ends as they will no longer be exchangeable hereafter.
Any remaining Pet Seals after the maintenance on March 14th, 2018, regardless of quantity, will be exchanged for Kanpacho’s Chewable Tablets. Please do exchange Pet Seals of 5 or more yourself before the event ends if you do not wish to have them exchanged for Kanpacho’s Chewable Tablets after the event ends.




For details on newly added Pearl Shop items, please click  to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement.


Monster Changes

Incarnation of Illezra can now be taken down with 3~5 hits with the Gannicus's Magic Bullet.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest:

Fixed the issue where Auto-navigation for the ‘[Event] Finding the Ideal Partner’ quests (claimable through [Event] Message in a Bottle) did not work properly.


Knowledge:

Upon defeating Ancient Puturum, knowledge of ‘Reanimated Ancient Puturum’ will now be appropriately gained.


Interface Changes

UI:

You will now have to click on a Skill in the Learnable Skill window for that Skill to be highlighted in the Skill window.

Fixed the issue where the bottom parts of the Resurrect buttons that appear when your Character dies were sometimes unresponsive.

Fixed the awkward line alignment in the Equipment Set Effect window.

 The product descriptions in the Pearl Shop that toggle when products are selected should disappear more naturally now.

Fixed the issue where the scroll button would be pulled down to the bottom in the Nearby NPC window while trying to use the Find NPC function.


Resolved Issues

More Wooden Beehives have been placed in Balenos Forest and Lake Flondor.

Fixed the issue where the island south of Kuit Islands did not appear on the minimap.


Known-issues

We are currently aware of and fixing the issue of Forts being built on unintended places in Serendia Node Wars (Glish Swamp, Northwestern Gateway, and Eastern Gateway).

Please keep in mind Forts built with this bug may be uninstalled and any exploitation or abuse of this bug may result in the restriction of your account.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 21st February 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/kbN9P1n.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

A new PvP experience is waiting for those who enjoy a good brawl between fellow Adventurers, the Arsha Server! The game mechanics on Arsha are slightly modified, notably increased defence stats and mechanics to enable fairer, less one sided fights.
This week’s patch brings also bug fixes, balance improvements and added functionalities.


Event & System

Content:

A PVP-specific Arsha Server has been added.

Red Battlefield is accessible in Arsha Server and the rewards will be same as other servers.
A specialized PVP balance will be applied in Arsha Server in comparison to the other regular servers.

All Characters’ PVP DP will be raised
Pressing Shift while ‘down’ will activate guard stance while still lying down and reduce the damage you are taking (Guard Gauge -50%, Damage Reduction +80%)
Characters will be immune from all debuffs for a certain amount of time if affected more than three times from Bound, Floating, Stun, and Grapple.
The damage calculations are different from that of normal servers and as a result, the buff “Damage Against Humans” may be less effective.
All monsters with the exceptions of field and world bosses and the Desert Merchant Caravan of Valencia will still be present.
PvP between Characters (including Forced PvP) will be free from all penalties. However, if a character with an evil Karma rating enters the new server, the usual negative Karma penalties will still be experienced.
You may still regain positive Karma points by killing monsters.
Like regular servers, if you have evil Karma and are killed by an NPC or another Adventurer in the Desert, you will be sent to jail.




The following items have been added to Patrigio’s shop.

Kzarka's Sealed Weapon Box
Nouver's Sealed Sub-weapon Box
Kutum’s Sealed Sub-weapon Box
Dandelion Weapon Box
※The Class-specific Boss Weapons that were already being sold will appear at the same rate as before.



The names of the following items have been changed to show a clearer difference:

Kibelius Armor/Set A → Kibelius Divinus Armor/Set
Kibelius Armor/Set B → Kibelius Armor/Set



Fixed the issue where you could see Characters from other Parties while using a monster Summon Scroll.

You can now try on Underwear and Accessories in Pearl Shop’s Mix&Match feature.


Event:

‘Send Love’ event of the Valentine’s Day Events has ended.

Valentine’s Day Screenshot Event submission period has ended.


System:

Depository has been renamed as "Settings Archive".

Fixed the issue causing the settings for Func 1 and Func 2 (Settings → Input → Gamepad Input Settings) would not properly stay cleared after reconnecting to the game.

Fixed the system message that appears when collecting Haystack for Elephant.

Fixed the abrupt camera transition during auto-run.

Adjustments have been made to the following servers.

Arsha Server has been added.
Valencia 6 has returned from PvP-exclusive to a normal server.
Olvia_Steam servers have become normal Olvia servers.



 Game World, NPC & Effects

Fixed the issue where Characters could swim in the cave inside Serene Spring.

Fixed the graphical glitch on tree branches near Mediah Shore.

Fixed the issue where Node Forts and Annexes were installable on top of round building during Node War.

Fixed the issue where Characters could go into some of the objects inside Hystria Ruins.


NPC:

Fixed the issue where players kept interacting with NPCs next to bookshelves instead of the books in the Great Library of Calpheon


Class Changes

All Classes

The amount of Stamina consumed while sprinting with any Matchlock equipped has been reduced.
Fixed the unnecessary jittering of the Matchlock when in a sitting stance.
Fixed the issue where Character’s frowning expression did not go away after getting hit while wearing one of the following equipment.

Fishing Rod, Harpoon, Terrmian Coconut, Matchlock, Trina Demolition Axe




Warrior

The Attack area for Flow: Ankle Break is now a circular shape.
The PvE damage from Flow: Armor Break has been increased.

568% x 3 → 653% x 3



The PvE damage from Merciless has been increased.
https://i.imgur.com/cVANzoT.jpg
The Attack Speed of Merciless has been adjusted so that one hit is now around 16% faster.
The Smash Attack Hit Damage of Flow: Slashing the Dead has been increased by one.
WP Recovery from Balance Strike has been increased twofold.
Damage from Spinning Slash (I-IV) has been increased.

Damage from using the Skill with Black Spirit's Rage has been increased as follows:
https://i.imgur.com/44BxVMs.jpg



Damage from Spinning Slash IV using Black Spirit’s Rage has been increased.
Fixed the issue where Spinning Slash using Black Spirit’s Rage was not being applied intermittently.
Attack ranges for the skills Ground Smash II and IV have expanded.
Damage of the skill Ground Smash has been increased.

Damage when using the Skill with Black Spirit's Rage has been increased as follows:
https://i.imgur.com/Y8sVHPg.jpg



Super Armor effect will now be applied when using Chopping Kick.

However, when used during Cooldown the Super Armor effect will not be applied.



WP Recovery from Chopping Kick has been increased.
https://i.imgur.com/5476Exe.jpg
The line “Hold RMB to perform extra attack” has been added to the Skill description of Merciless.
Fixed the issue where sometimes only one Smash Attack hit damage was applied when using Flow: Slashing the Dead with a Character that learned Grave Digging only up to level III.



Tamer

Fixed Heilang’s unnatural movement, which occurred when Allround Spinner was used after Summon Heilang.



Valkyrie

Fixed the buggy motion triggered upon using Flurry of Kicks while moving forward after using Guard.
Fixed how Sanctitas de Enslar was used first when Divine Power or Righteous Charge was used after Celestial Spear.



Witch

Fixed the issue where sometimes you could not summon Gorr and Tett.



Wizard

Fixed the issue where sometimes you could not summon Marg and Arne.



Musa

The WP required for Spinner has been reduced by 10 each.
The Stamina required for using Musa's Spirit has been reduced by 50.
The Hit Range of One Step Back has been increased by around 25% so that opponents near where your Character lands may also be hit.
Chaining from Fiery Angel to the following is now smoother.

Spinner, One Step Back, Below the Belt, Fiery Crevice, Flow: Backflow, Awakening: Haeam's Crescent Blade



Flow: Dash Slash has been changed as follows:

You can now use Quick Slot to use the Skill more quickly.
“Knockback on good hits” and “Bound on extra hit” effects have been replaced by Down Smash.
You can now use this Skill more quickly.



Fixed the issue preventing you from chaining to Crescent Blade Skills after using Fiery Crevice or One Step Back via Quick Slot in Blade combat stance.



Maehwa

Fixed the issue where the actual visual effect and the effect shown in the skill video of Roundhouse Kick were different.



Ninja

HP Recovery from Ninjutsu: Shadow Clone has been increased.
You will now recover 50 HP per good Fox Claw hit.
You can now use Ninjutsu: Shackles more quickly.
You can now land hits at a certain rate at the Max Hit Range when using Ninjutsu: Shadow Clone which is a change from the previous expanding Attack Ranges.



Kunoichi

HP Recovery from Ninjutsu: Shadow Clone has been increased.
You will now recover 50 HP per good Fox Claw hit.
You can now use Ninjutsu: Shackles more quickly.
Ninjutsu: Shadow Clone will now inflict the same amount of damage on the targets regardless of the distance covered by the attack range of the skill.



Dark Knight

Fixed the issue where the actual visual effect and the effect in the skill video of Flow: Spirit Blaze were different.
Fixed the issue where with certain customization presets, Dark Knight’s cape looked odd while running in a Rosa Cassius outfit.



Striker

Martial Spirit Skill is now passive.

If you use one of the following skills while having already learned Martial Spirit, you will get Movement Speed +30% and Accuracy +6% for 5 sec.

Fist of True Strength, Triple Flying Kick, Crimson Fang, Knee Hammer, Spiral Cannon, Rampaging Predator



If you successfully land hits from one of the following skills while having already learned Martial Spirit, the hit opponent’s WP/MP(EP)/SP will reduce by 5 at a time:

Adamantine, Fist Fury, Somersault, Crimson Fang, Flow: Explosive Blow, Taeback Kick Hidden Claw, Ultimate Crush, Spiral Cannon, Flow: Crosswind, Fallout, Ferocious Assault 




Improvements were made so that the skill Flow: Mass Destruction will function more smoothly when pressing  ← + RMB or → + RMB with the Gardbrace on during combat.  
Improvements were made so that the skill Fallout will activate upon pressing RMB while moving backwards with the Gardbrace on during combat.
Adjusted the Martial Spirit skill description to contain ‘reduction of WP/MP/SP upon good hit’ for the following skills:

Flow: Mass Destruction, Rising Blast Combo, Flow: Deathstrike, Combo: Hurricane, Combo: Venom Fang, Combo: Final Blow, Flow: Savage Fang, Ankle Hook, Deva King, Knee Hammer, Flow: Tornado Kick, Flow: Rock Smash



Using Taeback Kick with the Gardbrace will now have Martial Spirit effects applied.



Mystic

Fixed the issue when Mystic equipped Ahon Kirus armor, the dagger of the outfit looked awkward.



Item Changes

The item Blessing of Kamasylve (15 Days) is now available to be registered at the Marketplace.

Fixed how the Guild Military Supply Manager was not selling [Guild] Elephant Trap items.

Blue-grade items that have been Enhanced to PEN (V) will now be listed in the Marketplace even if they have never been sold there before.

You can also Pre-Order or set Notifications for these items even if they don’t have sales histories yet.



Pearl Shop

Classic (Weapon & Outfit) Sets on the Pearl Shop will be on Sale until March 7th Maintenance.

The Little Monster Box is back on the Pearl Shop for a limited time.

Event Period: Feb. 21st After Maintenance - Mar. 7th Before Maintenance

Little Monster Box is being sold until Mar. 7th Maintenance; Exchange period for Pet Seals will be until Mar 14th Maintenance.



All monster Pet Seals will be removed on Mar. 14th Maintenance.

Please make sure to exchange all of your remaining Pet Seals before the event ends as they will no longer be exchangeable hereafter.
Any remaining Pet Seals after the maintenance on March 14th, 2018, regardless of quantity, will be exchanged for Kanpacho’s Chewable Tablets. Please do exchange Pet Seals of 5 or more yourself before the event ends if you do not wish to have them exchanged for Kanpacho’s Chewable Tablets after the event ends.




For details on newly added Pearl Shop items, please click  to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement.


Monster Changes

Incarnation of Illezra can now be taken down with 3~5 hits with the Gannicus's Magic Bullet.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest:

Fixed the issue where Auto-navigation for the ‘[Event] Finding the Ideal Partner’ quests (claimable through [Event] Message in a Bottle) did not work properly.


Knowledge:

Upon defeating Ancient Puturum, knowledge of ‘Reanimated Ancient Puturum’ will now be appropriately gained.


Interface Changes

UI:

You will now have to click on a Skill in the Learnable Skill window for that Skill to be highlighted in the Skill window.

Fixed the issue where the bottom parts of the Resurrect buttons that appear when your Character dies were sometimes unresponsive.

Fixed the awkward line alignment in the Equipment Set Effect window.

 The product descriptions in the Pearl Shop that toggle when products are selected should disappear more naturally now.

Fixed the issue where the scroll button would be pulled down to the bottom in the Nearby NPC window while trying to use the Find NPC function.


Resolved Issues

More Wooden Beehives have been placed in Balenos Forest and Lake Flondor.

Fixed the issue where the island south of Kuit Islands did not appear on the minimap.


Known-issues

We are currently aware of and fixing the issue of Forts being built on unintended places in Serendia Node Wars (Glish Swamp, Northwestern Gateway, and Eastern Gateway).

Please keep in mind Forts built with this bug may be uninstalled and any exploitation or abuse of this bug may result in the restriction of your account.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes

notes.title: Patch Notes - 14th February 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/AgkkuXv.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

We wish you a Happy Valentine’s Day this year! We have some deliciously sweet events for you to dig into this year, in addition to freshly squeezed new drinks that can be purchased to give you and your Guildmates a refreshing boost. Scroll on down for all the latest changes that are available with today’s patch!

Also in the spirit of Valentines, Cupid’s Candy, a special decorative piece you can wear is prepared for all our beloved Adventurers!


Event & System

Event:

Sweet Valentine! A series of Valentine’s Day themed events have been added:

Event Period: 2/14/2018 After Maintenance - 2/28/2018 Before Maintenance


1. Love in a Bottle

2/14 After Maintenance - 2/28 Before Maintenance
During the event period, Fish to receive the item [Event] Message in a Bottle.
Upon opening the [Event] Message in a Bottle, you can obtain one of 3 types of messages which you may perform quests with, use to summon and defeat boss monsters, or sell for Silvers!
5 temporary Boss Monsters have been added for Valentine’s Day event:

Red Nose
Kelcas
Titium
Queen Stoneback Crab
Strong Altar Imp Trainer



2. Chocolate Fun

2/14 After Maintenance - 2/28 Before Maintenance
During the event period, Defeat Monsters or Gather to obtain [Event] Cacao.
Grind [Event] Cacao to get [Simple Cooking] Cacao Powder which can be combined with Mineral Water and Sugar via Simple Cooking to make [Event] Cacao Chocolate. You’ll need [Simple Cooking] Cacao Powder x10, Mineral Water x2 and Sugar x1 to create [Event] Cacao Chocolate x1


3. Send Love

2/15 00:00 UTC - 2/21 Before Maintenance
[Event] Sweet Gift Letter is available via Challenges (Y).
Right-click the [Event] Sweet Gift Letter to send a gift letter to the Adventurer of your choice. The Adventurer who receives your mail will get the [Event] Sweet Gift which can be opened to get  [Event] Sweet Chest and [Event] Cacao Chocolate as rewards and also an [Event] Sweet Reply. The receiver can then send the [Event] Sweet Reply to another Adventurer who will receive an [Event] Sweet Chest. Share the love with others!



For additional details on these three lovely events, click .



Lovely Drop Event!

The drop rate for Hard and Sharp Black Crystal Shards has been temporarily increased for the Valentine’s Day.
2/14 After Maintenance - 2/28 Before Maintenance



In the spirit of the season of love, there will also be a Valentine's Day Screenshot event.

Submission Date: February 14th - February 20th (Final Submission Date)
Staff Pick: February 21st - 23rd
Winner Announcement: February 23rd
Please click  for the details of the screenshot contest.



Firework Expert NPCs have been placed in Velia, Heidel, and Calpheon City to celebrate Valentine’s Day.

Events Quests of Fortune, Call of Moonlight Fragment, and Hoist your Sails! have ended.

However, Old Bartali Sailboat will continue to be claimable weekly through the same quests. Please continue to hoist your sails!



System:

NPC Wacky Toshi (Marni’s Stone NPC), has been placed in Valencia and Kamasylvia in the following areas:

Desert Naga Temple, Cadry Ruins, Bashim Base, Gahaz Bandit’s Lair, Titium Valley, Roud Sulfur Works, Tooth Fairy Forest (of Forest Ronaros Area)
Toshi is near each area’s node managers and also near Saira in Desert Naga Temple Nelindo in Tooth Fairy Forest.
You may purchase Marni’s Stones from Toshi, but you will not be able to sell any items to this NPC.



Black Spirit’s teeth have become brighter.https://i.imgur.com/WTq4ZXk.png

Improved effect optimization has been applied to the game which will help you enjoy smoother gameplay even when there are many other Adventurers gathered around you.

A Practice Matchlock can now be rented from NPC Dikzipo in Grána.

Fixed the floating Sunrise Herbs in Hexe Sanctuary.

Fixed the issue where some resources in Velia could be Gathered twice in a row.

Fixed the issue where some resources in Heidel could be Gathered twice in a row.

Fixed the issue where grass was floating in the air near the Feather Wolf area in the Navarn Steppe. 

Fixed an issue where some Characters would incorrectly display the Awakening Weapon effects while in the Main Weapon standby stance in the Character Selection window.


Mounts

Horse skill name ‘Dash’ has been changed to ‘Charge’ to better reflect the entire skill mechanics.


Class Changes

All Classes

Fixed the issue where the Great Sword non-combat stance would be incorrectly changed to the Longsword combat stance when changing to the Great Sword combat stance by casting the skill “Great Sword Training” while Sprinting.
Fixed how the Character would not Sprint when Head Chase could not be cast with key commands in the Great Sword combat stance.
The skill Awakening: Goyen’s Great Sword can now be casted by using key commands while Sprinting.
The Video for the skill Successive Charging Slash II has been adjusted to show the correct skill motion.



Sorceress

Fixed the graphical glitch on the Sorceress’s chest while wearing Karlstein outfit.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Sorceress’s wrists that occurred when she equipped Epheria Marine Amulet and was wearing her default clothes. 
Fixed the graphical glitch around Sorceress’s hands that occurred when she wore Kisleev/Karlstein/Snowflake Outfit.



Berserker

Fixed Berserker’s unnatural elbows that showed when he went into Iron Buster combat stance while equipped with Bheg’s Gloves and Acher Guard Armor.



Tamer

Fixed the graphical glitch that intermittently occurred on the lower part of Tamer’s Karlstein Armor when wearing it.
Fixed the graphical glitch around Tamer’s waist while in combat stance when wearing Karlstein Gloves and Armor.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Tamer’s hair that occured when wearing Treant Camouflage.



Valkyrie

Fixed the issue where SP was not correctly consumed when casting the skill Heaven’s Echo repeatedly from Quick Slot in combination with pressing key commands for Strong Defense, Guard, and Promptness.



Witch

Fixed the issue when the Witch class moved backwards in Staff combat stance while casting the skill to go into Aad Sphera stance and the key commands for Meteor Shower were pressed, Meteor Shower would be casted but she would not go into Aad Sphera stance.
Fixed the unnatural movements that occurred when the Witch class stopped moving while going from Aad Sphera to Staff combat stances.
Fixed the issue when the Witch class was Sprinting while going from Aad Sphera non-combat to combat stance, she would sometimes stay in non-combat stance.
Improved the functionality of Voltaic Pulse and Detonative Flow while Sprinting.

If you press the ↑ + Shift + F keys while Sprinting, Voltaic Pulse and Detonative Flow are cast.
When Voltaic Pulse is in Cooldown, Detonative Flow is cast instead.



Improved the functionality of Voltaic Pulse and Thunder Storm while evading backwards.

If you press the ↓ + Shift + F keys while evading backwards, Voltaic Pulse and Thunder Storm are cast.
When Voltaic Pulse is in Cooldown, Thunder Storm is cast instead.



Improved the functionality of Equilibrium Break and Yoke of Ordeal while evading backwards.

If you press the ↓ key while evading backwards, Equilibrium Break and Yoke of Ordeal are cast.



Fixed the graphical glitch that occurred when the Witch class went into combat stance while wearing Karlstein. 



Wizard

Fixed the issue when the Wizard class moved backwards in Staff combat stance while casting the skill to make go into Godr Sphera stance and the key commands for Meteor Shower were pressed, Meteor Shower would be casted but he would not go into Godr Sphera stance.
Fixed the unnatural movements that occurred when the Wizard class stopped moving while going from Godr Sphera to Staff combat stances.
Fixed the issue when the Wizard class was Sprinting while going from Godr Sphera non-combat to combat stance, he would sometimes stay in non-combat stance.
Improved the functionality of Hellfire and Cataclysm while Sprinting.

If you press the ↑ + Shift + F keys while Sprinting, Hellfire and Cataclysm are cast.
When Hellfire is in Cooldown, Cataclysm is cast instead.



Improved the functionality of Bolide of Destruction and Cataclysm while evading backwards.

If you press the ↓ + Shift + F keys while evading backwards, Bolide of Destruction and Cataclysm are cast.
When Bolide of Destruction is in Cooldown, Cataclysm is cast instead.



Improved the functionality of Aqua Jail Explosion and Water Sphere while evading backwards.

If you press the ↓ key while evading backwards, Aqua Jail Explosion and Water Sphere are cast.




Musa

The Skill Effect description for Blunt Kick has been changed from Floating to Stiffness, to be  consistent with its actual effects.



Dark Knight

Fixed the issue where some of Dark Knight’s skills were continuously causing Stiffness/Stun effects on certain monsters. 
Fixed the graphical issue where the length of the skirt for Dark Knight’s Frostbite Outfit was different between Kriegsmesser and Vediant stances.



Striker

Fixed the issue where the Gardbrace non-combat stance was incorrectly changed to Gauntlet combat stance. This occurred when changing to Gardbrace combat stance by casting the skill Gardbrace Training while Sprinting.
Now the skill Awakening: Enlightened Gardbrace can be casted by using key commands while Sprinting.



Mystic

Fixed how Mystic looked awkward while fighting in Ahon Kirus Armor.



Item Changes

New items have been added to Guild Shop.

[Guild] Fresh Orange Juice, [Guild] Sweet Wild Berry Juice, [Guild] Sour Green Grape Juice, [Guild] Golden Bell have been added.
Only Guild Masters can purchase and use [Guild] Golden Bell. It functions the same as regular Golden Bell.
You need to be at least a Guild Quartermaster to take out the juice items from the Guild storage, but even regular members may use these items if they are in their Inventory. Regular Guild members can also deposit these items to the Guild storage.
A Character’s Health, Breath, and Strength EXP gain is significantly increased while under the effects of these juices. However, the aforementioned Fitness levels must be 29 or lower to make use of these items.



The item Sealed Book of Combat (1 Day) has been added to Patrigio’s Secret Shop.

The item Sealed Book of Combat (15 Days) is now available to be registered at the Marketplace.

The item Blessing of Kamasylve (15 Days) will be registrable at the Marketplace the following week.



The following items are now bound to your Family instead of your Character:

Valtarra: Sky Token
Valtarra: Earth Token
Valtarra: Death Token
Valtarra: Ruins Token



All Accuracy Increase effects have been added to each Enhancement stage of Sicil's Necklace.

New package for new Adventurers will be temporarily available.

[Event] Premium Rookie Pack cannot be purchased by a character who already possesses a Weight Limit +100 LT item.
[Event] Rookie Pack cannot be purchased by a character who already possesses a Weight Limit +50 LT item.



There has been a change in categories for the following item(s):

Heidel Masquerade sets have changed categories from Costume to Outfit. Please find the item below Outfit tab in the Pearl Shop.



For details on newly added Pearl Shop items, please click  to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement.

[Event] Cupid's Candy x1 has been given out for the celebration of Valentine’s Day.

Please check your in-game Mail to claim the reward.



Monster Changes

The Practice Matchlock that you rent by investing Contribution Points has been fixed to inflict Hunting-type damage to Wooden Beehives.

Wooden Beehives (hunting objects) will now receive damage from basic attacks.

Fixed the issue of Guild Raid Boss Ancient Puturum temporarily freezing when using its charge attack.

The basic reward items you can get from defeating Vell have been improved.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest:

Fixed the issue where Navigation Guide was no longer available once you cancelled the Guide for the quest Yaak’s Sacrament.

The description of the quest “The Leader” has been changed to the following:

Meet Edana's Guardian at the Ancient Stone Chamber using the device behind the artifact



Combat EXP and Skill EXP have been removed from the following quest rewards:

[Repeat] Mad Scientist's Research Journal
[Repeat] Rhutums Clean-Up Operation
Skill EXP gained from the quest [Repeat] Helm Destroyer! and [Repeat] Destroy Spell! has been removed. 


Knowledge:

Descriptions for Crop/Wild Seed Knowledges (Life Skill - Farming) have been fixed.


Interface Changes

The text size of the description on the bottom of the Quick Hotkey Settings window has been made smaller.

Fixed the issue where the button to Connect in the Character Selection window was not activated even after clicking on Cancel when there is a queue.

The button for Auto Loop will now be displayed near the destination pin.

The titles of Set Effects tooltips have been adjusted.

Long area names in the Item Drop window should now appear correctly.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where [Musa] Palgong Outfit’s max price was incorrectly displayed under the Marketplace Information.

Fixed how some Functional Costumes’ effects were applied abnormally after using View Set Effect.

Fixed the issue when Pet level up by using Feed All function, it would not gain the rest of the EXP after the level increase.

Fixed how a Character would stop both reading and gaining Knowledge when you changed that Character, who was reading a book by interacting with a Bookshelf item in the Residence, to another.


Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes
