Firework Expert NPCs have been placed in Velia, Heidel, and Calpheon City to celebrate Valentine’s Day.

Events Quests of Fortune, Call of Moonlight Fragment, and Hoist your Sails! have ended.

However, Old Bartali Sailboat will continue to be claimable weekly through the same quests. Please continue to hoist your sails!



System:

NPC Wacky Toshi (Marni’s Stone NPC), has been placed in Valencia and Kamasylvia in the following areas:

Desert Naga Temple, Cadry Ruins, Bashim Base, Gahaz Bandit’s Lair, Titium Valley, Roud Sulfur Works, Tooth Fairy Forest (of Forest Ronaros Area)
Toshi is near each area’s node managers and also near Saira in Desert Naga Temple Nelindo in Tooth Fairy Forest.
You may purchase Marni’s Stones from Toshi, but you will not be able to sell any items to this NPC.



Black Spirit’s teeth have become brighter.https://i.imgur.com/WTq4ZXk.png

Improved effect optimization has been applied to the game which will help you enjoy smoother gameplay even when there are many other Adventurers gathered around you.

A Practice Matchlock can now be rented from NPC Dikzipo in Grána.

Fixed the floating Sunrise Herbs in Hexe Sanctuary.

Fixed the issue where some resources in Velia could be Gathered twice in a row.

Fixed the issue where some resources in Heidel could be Gathered twice in a row.

Fixed the issue where grass was floating in the air near the Feather Wolf area in the Navarn Steppe. 

Fixed an issue where some Characters would incorrectly display the Awakening Weapon effects while in the Main Weapon standby stance in the Character Selection window.


Mounts

Horse skill name ‘Dash’ has been changed to ‘Charge’ to better reflect the entire skill mechanics.


Class Changes

All Classes

Fixed the issue where the Great Sword non-combat stance would be incorrectly changed to the Longsword combat stance when changing to the Great Sword combat stance by casting the skill “Great Sword Training” while Sprinting.
Fixed how the Character would not Sprint when Head Chase could not be cast with key commands in the Great Sword combat stance.
The skill Awakening: Goyen’s Great Sword can now be casted by using key commands while Sprinting.
The Video for the skill Successive Charging Slash II has been adjusted to show the correct skill motion.



Sorceress

Fixed the graphical glitch on the Sorceress’s chest while wearing Karlstein outfit.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Sorceress’s wrists that occurred when she equipped Epheria Marine Amulet and was wearing her default clothes. 
Fixed the graphical glitch around Sorceress’s hands that occurred when she wore Kisleev/Karlstein/Snowflake Outfit.



Berserker

Fixed Berserker’s unnatural elbows that showed when he went into Iron Buster combat stance while equipped with Bheg’s Gloves and Acher Guard Armor.



Tamer

Fixed the graphical glitch that intermittently occurred on the lower part of Tamer’s Karlstein Armor when wearing it.
Fixed the graphical glitch around Tamer’s waist while in combat stance when wearing Karlstein Gloves and Armor.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Tamer’s hair that occured when wearing Treant Camouflage.



Valkyrie

Fixed the issue where SP was not correctly consumed when casting the skill Heaven’s Echo repeatedly from Quick Slot in combination with pressing key commands for Strong Defense, Guard, and Promptness.



Witch

Fixed the issue when the Witch class moved backwards in Staff combat stance while casting the skill to go into Aad Sphera stance and the key commands for Meteor Shower were pressed, Meteor Shower would be casted but she would not go into Aad Sphera stance.
Fixed the unnatural movements that occurred when the Witch class stopped moving while going from Aad Sphera to Staff combat stances.
Fixed the issue when the Witch class was Sprinting while going from Aad Sphera non-combat to combat stance, she would sometimes stay in non-combat stance.
Improved the functionality of Voltaic Pulse and Detonative Flow while Sprinting.

If you press the ↑ + Shift + F keys while Sprinting, Voltaic Pulse and Detonative Flow are cast.
When Voltaic Pulse is in Cooldown, Detonative Flow is cast instead.



Improved the functionality of Voltaic Pulse and Thunder Storm while evading backwards.

If you press the ↓ + Shift + F keys while evading backwards, Voltaic Pulse and Thunder Storm are cast.
When Voltaic Pulse is in Cooldown, Thunder Storm is cast instead.



Improved the functionality of Equilibrium Break and Yoke of Ordeal while evading backwards.

If you press the ↓ key while evading backwards, Equilibrium Break and Yoke of Ordeal are cast.



Fixed the graphical glitch that occurred when the Witch class went into combat stance while wearing Karlstein. 



Wizard

Fixed the issue when the Wizard class moved backwards in Staff combat stance while casting the skill to make go into Godr Sphera stance and the key commands for Meteor Shower were pressed, Meteor Shower would be casted but he would not go into Godr Sphera stance.
Fixed the unnatural movements that occurred when the Wizard class stopped moving while going from Godr Sphera to Staff combat stances.
Fixed the issue when the Wizard class was Sprinting while going from Godr Sphera non-combat to combat stance, he would sometimes stay in non-combat stance.
Improved the functionality of Hellfire and Cataclysm while Sprinting.

If you press the ↑ + Shift + F keys while Sprinting, Hellfire and Cataclysm are cast.
When Hellfire is in Cooldown, Cataclysm is cast instead.



Improved the functionality of Bolide of Destruction and Cataclysm while evading backwards.

If you press the ↓ + Shift + F keys while evading backwards, Bolide of Destruction and Cataclysm are cast.
When Bolide of Destruction is in Cooldown, Cataclysm is cast instead.



Improved the functionality of Aqua Jail Explosion and Water Sphere while evading backwards.

If you press the ↓ key while evading backwards, Aqua Jail Explosion and Water Sphere are cast.




Musa

The Skill Effect description for Blunt Kick has been changed from Floating to Stiffness, to be  consistent with its actual effects.



Dark Knight

Fixed the issue where some of Dark Knight’s skills were continuously causing Stiffness/Stun effects on certain monsters. 
Fixed the graphical issue where the length of the skirt for Dark Knight’s Frostbite Outfit was different between Kriegsmesser and Vediant stances.



Striker

Fixed the issue where the Gardbrace non-combat stance was incorrectly changed to Gauntlet combat stance. This occurred when changing to Gardbrace combat stance by casting the skill Gardbrace Training while Sprinting.
Now the skill Awakening: Enlightened Gardbrace can be casted by using key commands while Sprinting.



Mystic

Fixed how Mystic looked awkward while fighting in Ahon Kirus Armor.



Item Changes

New items have been added to Guild Shop.

[Guild] Fresh Orange Juice, [Guild] Sweet Wild Berry Juice, [Guild] Sour Green Grape Juice, [Guild] Golden Bell have been added.
Only Guild Masters can purchase and use [Guild] Golden Bell. It functions the same as regular Golden Bell.
You need to be at least a Guild Quartermaster to take out the juice items from the Guild storage, but even regular members may use these items if they are in their Inventory. Regular Guild members can also deposit these items to the Guild storage.
A Character’s Health, Breath, and Strength EXP gain is significantly increased while under the effects of these juices. However, the aforementioned Fitness levels must be 29 or lower to make use of these items.



The item Sealed Book of Combat (1 Day) has been added to Patrigio’s Secret Shop.

The item Sealed Book of Combat (15 Days) is now available to be registered at the Marketplace.

The item Blessing of Kamasylve (15 Days) will be registrable at the Marketplace the following week.



The following items are now bound to your Family instead of your Character:

Valtarra: Sky Token
Valtarra: Earth Token
Valtarra: Death Token
Valtarra: Ruins Token



All Accuracy Increase effects have been added to each Enhancement stage of Sicil's Necklace.

New package for new Adventurers will be temporarily available.

[Event] Premium Rookie Pack cannot be purchased by a character who already possesses a Weight Limit +100 LT item.
[Event] Rookie Pack cannot be purchased by a character who already possesses a Weight Limit +50 LT item.



There has been a change in categories for the following item(s):

Heidel Masquerade sets have changed categories from Costume to Outfit. Please find the item below Outfit tab in the Pearl Shop.



For details on newly added Pearl Shop items, please click  to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement.

[Event] Cupid's Candy x1 has been given out for the celebration of Valentine’s Day.

Please check your in-game Mail to claim the reward.



Monster Changes

The Practice Matchlock that you rent by investing Contribution Points has been fixed to inflict Hunting-type damage to Wooden Beehives.

Wooden Beehives (hunting objects) will now receive damage from basic attacks.

Fixed the issue of Guild Raid Boss Ancient Puturum temporarily freezing when using its charge attack.

The basic reward items you can get from defeating Vell have been improved.


Quests & Knowledge

Quest:

Fixed the issue where Navigation Guide was no longer available once you cancelled the Guide for the quest Yaak’s Sacrament.

The description of the quest “The Leader” has been changed to the following:

Meet Edana's Guardian at the Ancient Stone Chamber using the device behind the artifact



Combat EXP and Skill EXP have been removed from the following quest rewards:

[Repeat] Mad Scientist's Research Journal
[Repeat] Rhutums Clean-Up Operation
Skill EXP gained from the quest [Repeat] Helm Destroyer! and [Repeat] Destroy Spell! has been removed. 


Knowledge:

Descriptions for Crop/Wild Seed Knowledges (Life Skill - Farming) have been fixed.


Interface Changes

The text size of the description on the bottom of the Quick Hotkey Settings window has been made smaller.

Fixed the issue where the button to Connect in the Character Selection window was not activated even after clicking on Cancel when there is a queue.

The button for Auto Loop will now be displayed near the destination pin.

The titles of Set Effects tooltips have been adjusted.

Long area names in the Item Drop window should now appear correctly.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where [Musa] Palgong Outfit’s max price was incorrectly displayed under the Marketplace Information.

Fixed how some Functional Costumes’ effects were applied abnormally after using View Set Effect.

Fixed the issue when Pet level up by using Feed All function, it would not gain the rest of the EXP after the level increase.

Fixed how a Character would stop both reading and gaining Knowledge when you changed that Character, who was reading a book by interacting with a Bookshelf item in the Residence, to another.


Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes

notes.title: Update on Recent Connection Issues for NA Users
notes.content:
Network Issues

We want you to be able to enjoy the game to its fullest and we know a number of you have been experiencing technical issues that have impacted your enjoyment of Black Desert Online.

As it was previously announced, we noticed that a server disconnection issue started occurring from January 29th. We immediately contacted the server host company in order to resolve the problem.

When the network issue occurred, players were disconnected from the server every few minutes, which is similar to the issue from last November, caused by DDoS attacks. We are currently working with the hosting company to improve the server status. 

Further announcements will be made if there are updates about the server status and progress. We understand that the latest series of network interruption have caused inconvenience to many Adventurers. We promise that we will do our best to resolve the network issue as soon as possible to deliver a more enjoyable and pleasant gaming experience for our North America and Europe players.

CenturyLink Issue

We are also aware of a separate and ongoing issue specific to players using CenturyLink’s subsidiary ISPs such as Qwest, Embarq and CenturyTel, usually around 16:00 to 20:00 PST. After informing our provider about this situation, and them not being able to locate a problem from their side, we’ve spent the last few days trying to contact CenturyLink directly to find a resolution. 

However, with numerous attempts to discuss the issue at hand with CenturyLink’s staff and manager, we were unable to receive the support needed to fix the issue. We were met with the response ‘We cannot help you as you are not our customer.’ Unfortunately, our requests to co-operate and look into this problem together (with us providing all necessary data) were not answered; we were instead asked by CenturyLink to direct any of their customers experiencing a problem straight to their customer service department, either by ticket or phone call. Detailed information can be found here.

We want to extend our apologies for the disruption you have suffered and reassure you, we are investigating multiple avenues to improve the experience for everyone. We will announce the changes we plan to make for server and network improvements in the upcoming months. These changes should provide a much improved stability and connection for all Black Desert Online adventurers.

notes.title: Dev Diary
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

As you already know, we have gathered your concern and feedback about the recent AP change in the last weeks. Today we share with you the letter from the developers we have received in order to clarify some of your doubts on this matter.

Here is the letter:

Greetings Adventurers,
 
Thanks to the unwavering support you've shown the BDO Team over the past year, Black Desert Online was able to grow steadily to what it is now. New and returning Adventurers are on the rise, and tons of new content is being added to the game in North America & Europe region, faster than ever before. We thank you for making this happen.
 
There have been lots of patches applied at an incredible pace and we want to start off by better communicating with the North American and European Adventurers by addressing some of the concerns you have voiced about recent changes to the game.
 
Increased AP Efficiency
 
Characters with AP 160 ~ 243 will now have higher attack efficiency (Applied in KR, Jan. 25th)
 
We know that some Adventurers are interested in the details regarding the recent KR server patch made on January 25th, which increased attack efficiency of AP 160 ~ 243. Especially, some are discussing the fact that this patch was applied only in the KR server. We believe that there can be some misunderstandings about this patch and wish to lay out the facts and better elaborate our intentions.
 
The KR server had a slightly different balance system applied than other regions. Its attack efficiency of AP 245~300 were higher than other regions, while having a lower efficiency than other regions in AP 160~243 ranges.
 
In order to match the balance system of all regions, we implemented patches so that other regions (including North America and Europe) will have increased efficiency for AP 245~300 which is equivalent to that of KR server, while increasing efficiency for AP 160~243 ranges of KR server to the current level of North America and Europe server.
 
Effectively, with the aforementioned patch for the KR server, all regions now have the same balance systems applied.

We aim to develop Black Desert Online as a Single Global Build. By doing so, we believe that it will benefit both our players and us, as developers. It will allow the latest patches to be applied to all regions more quickly than any other game, and enable us to quickly reflect even the tiniest detail of valuable user feedback. Anyone who enjoys Black Desert Online will always have the same optimal experience from any region.
 
Also, by implementing the same balance change to all regions, we will be able to move one step closer to one of our future goals, a Global Arsha PvP Tournament and Global Siege War.
 
As much as we want to share more details to our players, unfortunately, it is not possible for us to do since it is still in the early concept phase. It excites us just by imagining a system which will allow players to compete with others from different regions. We will strive to make this a reality in the near future.
 
We apologize again for not delivering sufficient information in advance, and will do our best to prevent such misunderstandings in the future.
 
Finally, in order to give a little boost to North America and Europe Adventurers, we would like to send every Adventurer an [Event] Sealed Book of Combat (7 days). It is a small gift to thank all Adventurers for always caring and enjoying our game. As always, it is our greatest pleasure to see our Adventurers grow stronger and enjoy our game to the fullest every day. We will do our utmost to grow together with the community and make a better world of Black Desert Online for all our beloved fans.    
 

Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 7th February 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/Skl7IbO.jpg

Greetings Adventurers, 

Valentine’s Day is coming up next week and you will see the world of BDO to be a bit more flirtatious than usual and seasonal decorations reflect all the love in the air…xoxo. But not all is love and flowers, there is also a danger lurking. Ancient Puturum has been spotted in Valencia and Guilds are called in to face this threat.
Also a new attendance reward cycle has started so be diligent and be rewarded for it!

Event & System

System:

The Hide Other Character function (Shift + F5) has been adjusted now to function appropriately.

The Guild Bonus distribution conditions have been amended.

Any Guild with at least 30 members, whether or not they hold a Node or Territory, can now distribute Guild Bonuses.
Guild Bonuses can be distributed once every seven days, and can be up to 40% of your Guild Funds.
Since the Guild Bonus distribution conditions have been amended, the distribution date tracking has now been reset.



For Guilds with Guild Funds over 20 billion Silver, the Guild Welfare Reserves tax rates have been amended as follows:
https://i.imgur.com/ARE3Oof.jpg


If a Guild’s Guild Funds are over 90 billion Silver, then 20% will be taken for the Guild Welfare Reserves.



The Silver received from the Combat Fame portion of the House Fame Fund has been increased by 20%.


Content:

A new Guild Boss ‘Ancient Puturum’ has been added to Valencia.

Ancient Puturum Summon Scroll can be obtained from the new guild mission Boss Subjugation.
New titles have been added for delivering the final blow to Ancient 

Puturum.
Puturum Slayer
Irresistible Eyes
Ornithologist
Naked



Titles will vary depending on the size of guild summoning Ancient Puturum.



The amount of bonus Silver granted to the seller, when selling items via Pre-Order in the Marketplace, has been adjusted.

When you sell an item via Pre-Order, you will get a bonus of 20% of the difference between the the registered price and the price at which the item was sold.
The difference cannot be bigger than twice the registered price.



Items that are blue grade or higher and Enhanced to PEN (V) then are registered in the Marketplace will now be sold first to those who Pre-Ordered the items.

If there are no Pre-Orders in place, then the item will be sold via the Bidding process.
Although PEN (V) items are items with the highest level of Enhancement, their Marketplace prices are lower than what their value should dictate. To offset this, we changed it so that these items are first sold through Pre-Orders. Therefore, rather than us directly changing the maximum price for such items, we are leaving it on the hands of you Adventurers to decide how much these items are worth, by prioritizing Pre-Order.



Now, if an item is sold via Pre-Order the Recent Price will be listed not as the registered price but the price sold via Pre-Order.

The number of Farming Byproducts needed to make Stonetail Fodder have been amended.

Previously, 15 to 25 Farming Byproducts (depending on the type) were needed but now you can combine 20 each, from any two different types, of Farming Byproducts with Simple Cooking to more easily make Stonetail Fodder.



You can now find Stonetail Fodder in the Crafting Notes.

Advanced Altar of Training has been reopened.


Event:

New Attendance Rewards have been added for the period between February 8th 00:00 UTC to March 14th 23:59 UTC.

Check attendance daily and enjoy rewards like Memory Fragments, [Event] Lauren Family Gift Box, [Event] Shakatu’s Seals and more!



The game world has been decorated in a Valentine’s Day theme.

Since the Valentine’s Day theme may overlap with certain Soldier NPCs, some relevant Soldier NPCs have been moved slightly.



The additional period in which you could exchange [Event] Snowflake item has been ended.

The New Year Wish Lantern theme background has been removed.


Game World, NPC & Effects

If you want to exchange Peridot Leaf or Peridot Petal with NPC Variel, you will need to click on the relevant items for exchange, not press R key. 

Fixed the goat that was stuck in a stone on Goat Mountain, Serendia.

Fixed the issue where NPC Rumbling Spirit from Mirumok Ruins was intermittently missing.

Fixed the issue with unnatural falling motions Characters made when falling off the bridge handrails near Heidel.

The terrain of  Hystria Ruins have been improved so that Characters can move more naturally inside the area.

Fixed the graphical issue that cause some areas in southern Kamasylvia to look underwater.

Objects have been improved so you can now smoothly move towards the roof next to the castle gates inside Mediah Castle.


Mounts

Your horse will stay put if you move further than a certain distance after Calling it. 

Fixed the issue where your Mount could gain EXP from moving to another location via using some of the contents available from the ESC menu.


Class Changes

All Classes

Fixed the issue where Grapple Resistance was not properly applied up to the Max 60%.
The messages that shows when sitting, lying down, or walking are now displayed regardless of a Character’s level.
The message that appears when you are moving in the combat stance saying you should press Tab to change back to the non-combat stance will now only appear for Characters under Lv.30.
Fixed the unnatural appearance of the feathers on the back of Cavaro Shoes that appeared when the following Classes were Sprinting:

Witch, Maehwa and Valkyrie.



Fixed the issue where Emergency Escape intermittently did not work normally while using other Skills.
Fixed the issue where a Character that used Emergency Escape sometimes would walk towards another Character.



Ranger

Fixed the issue players experienced when the Ranger transitioned from combat to non-combat stance while moving forward, causing you to see her weapon in her hands intermittently.
Fixed the issue where when Ranger used Flow: Piercing Wind and later Ultimate/Extreme: Charging Wind while in the Kamasylven Sword stance, EP was consumed twice.



Sorceress

If Sorceress already learned the skill Flow: Rushing Crow, holding LMB + RMB after using Dark Flame in Amulet combat stance will activate extra hits followed by Flow: Rushing Crow.

In this case, after Flow: Rushing Crow is used, she will go into Scythe combat stance.


You should now be able to see the Sorceress’s Amulet and Talisman normally even when she is holding her Scythe.



Fixed the graphical glitch on Sorceress’s Snowflake costume that appeared around her neck.



Tamer

Fixed the graphical glitch with Tamer’s Atanis Helmet.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Tamer’s lower back while wearing Karlstein Armor.



Witch

The issue where the Witch could jump once more in midair while in combat after transitioning from Aad Sphera non-combat mode to combat mode has been fixed.
The issue where the Witch could not use Aad Sphera skills intermittently after transitioning from Staff (Main Weapon) combat mode to Aad Sphera (Awakening Weapon) mode has been fixed.
The issue where the Witch could not switch to Aad Sphera intermittently while jumping and transitioning from Staff (Main Weapon) combat mode to Aad Sphera (Awakening Weapon) mode has been fixed.
The issue where the Witch could not switch to Aad Sphera when the Witch’s Staff (Main Weapon) skills were being performed with keys while transitioning from Staff (Main Weapon) combat mode to Aad Sphera (Awakening Weapon) mode has been fixed.
The issue where the cooldown of transitioning skills to switch from Staff (Main Weapon) to Aad Sphera (Awakening Weapon) was not being properly applied while trying to switch while moving forward has been fixed.
The issue where the Witch could not switch to Staff (Main Weapon) while Sprinting in Aad Sphera (Awakening Weapon) combat mode intermittently has been fixed.
The issue where the Witch’s Aad Sphera (Awakening Weapon) skills were being performed intermittently even when Staff (Main Weapon) skills were initiated while Sprinting after switching to Staff (Main Weapon) combat mode from Aad Sphera (Awakening Weapon) combat mode has been fixed.
Fixed the graphical glitch for Witch’s Karlstein Outfit arm piece that appeared on combat stance.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Witch’s legs when wearing Muskan’s Shoes and any Armor together.



Wizard

The issue where the Wizard could not switch to Godr Sphera when the Wizard’s Staff (Main Weapon) skills were being performed with keys while transitioning from Staff (Main Weapon) combat mode to Godr Sphera (Awakening Weapon) mode has been fixed.
The issue where the cooldown of transitioning skills to switch from Staff (Main Weapon) to Godr Sphera (Awakening Weapon) was not being properly applied while trying to switch while moving forward has been fixed.
The issue where the Wizard could not switch to Staff (Main Weapon) while Sprinting in Godr Sphera (Awakening Weapon) combat mode intermittently has been fixed.
The issue where the Wizard’s Godr Sphera (Awakening Weapon) skills were being performed intermittently even when Staff (Main Weapon) skills were initiated while Sprinting after switching to Staff (Main Weapon) combat mode from Godr Sphera (Awakening Weapon) combat mode has been fixed.



Maehwa

The description saying that Quick Slot is available for the skill Ultimate Chaos: Red Moon has been removed.



Kunoichi

While moving after using Target Chase in Sah Chakram combat stance, Sah Chakram Training can now be used with RMB during the cooldown for Lunar Dash.



Striker

Flow: Landslide, Flow: Nimbus Strike

Flow: Landslide, Flow: Sky Rammer

Karanda’s Latent Aura 
Kutum’s Latent Aura



 Descriptions of the following items’ Set Effects have been modified.

Vodkhan, Elten

Knowledge:

Greetings Adventurers, 

Valentine’s Day is coming up next week and you will see the world of BDO to be a bit more flirtatious than usual and seasonal decorations reflect all the love in the air…xoxo. But not all is love and flowers, there is also a danger lurking. Ancient Puturum has been spotted in Valencia and Guilds are called in to face this threat.
Also a new attendance reward cycle has started so be diligent and be rewarded for it!

System:

The Hide Other Character function (Shift + F5) has been adjusted now to function appropriately.

The Guild Bonus distribution conditions have been amended.

Any Guild with at least 30 members, whether or not they hold a Node or Territory, can now distribute Guild Bonuses.
Guild Bonuses can be distributed once every seven days, and can be up to 40% of your Guild Funds.
Since the Guild Bonus distribution conditions have been amended, the distribution date tracking has now been reset.



For Guilds with Guild Funds over 20 billion Silver, the Guild Welfare Reserves tax rates have been amended as follows:
https://i.imgur.com/ARE3Oof.jpg


If a Guild’s Guild Funds are over 90 billion Silver, then 20% will be taken for the Guild Welfare Reserves.



The Silver received from the Combat Fame portion of the House Fame Fund has been increased by 20%.


Content:

A new Guild Boss ‘Ancient Puturum’ has been added to Valencia.

Ancient Puturum Summon Scroll can be obtained from the new guild mission Boss Subjugation.

Puturum.
Puturum Slayer
Irresistible Eyes
Ornithologist
Naked



Titles will vary depending on the size of guild summoning Ancient Puturum.



The amount of bonus Silver granted to the seller, when selling items via Pre-Order in the Marketplace, has been adjusted.

When you sell an item via Pre-Order, you will get a bonus of 20% of the difference between the the registered price and the price at which the item was sold.
The difference cannot be bigger than twice the registered price.



Items that are blue grade or higher and Enhanced to PEN (V) then are registered in the Marketplace will now be sold first to those who Pre-Ordered the items.

If there are no Pre-Orders in place, then the item will be sold via the Bidding process.
Although PEN (V) items are items with the highest level of Enhancement, their Marketplace prices are lower than what their value should dictate. To offset this, we changed it so that these items are first sold through Pre-Orders. Therefore, rather than us directly changing the maximum price for such items, we are leaving it on the hands of you Adventurers to decide how much these items are worth, by prioritizing Pre-Order.



Now, if an item is sold via Pre-Order the Recent Price will be listed not as the registered price but the price sold via Pre-Order.

The number of Farming Byproducts needed to make Stonetail Fodder have been amended.

Previously, 15 to 25 Farming Byproducts (depending on the type) were needed but now you can combine 20 each, from any two different types, of Farming Byproducts with Simple Cooking to more easily make Stonetail Fodder.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 31st January 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/Vh1nizJ.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,

Guilds are called to arms to face a new powerful foe, Guild Boss: Muskan. The challenge is to help and protect NPC Hakkon or you will have no chance of defeating Muskan. 
After a hard day of fighting evil, even the most accomplished hero needs some rest, repair equipment and also important, sort their pockets, containing all the shiny loot obtained. Naphart Campsite helps with that, by saving adventurers the commute after a long shift of sword work.

Event & System

Event:

A new Challenge “Call of Moonlight Fragment” has been added.

Event Period: Feb. 1st 00:00 UTC ~ Feb. 14th 09:00 UTC
During the event period, [Event] Moonlight Shard, which you can combine with a Memory Fragment with Alchemy, can be obtained from Challenges (Y) per one hour of playtime.

Max 2 [Event] Moonlight Shards are obtainable per Family per day.



Perform Simple Alchemy with Memory Fragment x1 and [Event] Moonlight Shard x1 to obtain:

Memory Fragment x1~3
A chance to get a [Event] Moonlight Shard x1




You can exchange [Event] Snowflake items during the following extended period.

Extended Period: Jan. 31st  After Maintenance - Feb. 7th Before Maintenance


System:

Item lots under the “Black Stone” category in the Marketplace can now be purchased even if they are not being sold at the minimum price.

However, in order to perform Bidding, the item must be at the minimum price.



You can now Transport Family-bound items between Storages

A new title “Fashionista” has been added for Mix and Match Event winners.


Content:

The chances of getting Cooking Honey, High-Quality Cooking Honey or Top Quality Honey from Processing after gaining the Knowledge “Beehive” have been changed. 

The quests to obtain Supporting Funds in Balenos, Serendia, Calpheon, and Mediah have been removed. In addition to this, the basic Combat Fame reward has been increased by 50,000 Silver Coins.

The tooltip for Combat Fame in the My Information window has been changed accordingly.


New game content has been added:

Guild Boss: Muskan of Madness
Naphart Campsite



Item Drop Information has been added to the ESC Menu.

With this new Item Drop Information window, you can get an overview of the items that are dropped at certain Monster Zones.




Game World, NPC & Effects

NPC:

Grána Imperial Crafting Delivery, Imperial Fishing Delivery, and Imperial Delivery NPC’s have been put to different locations.

NPCs Mizella (Imperial Crafting Delivery) and Falleve (Imperial Fishing Delivery) can now be found near the Storage Keeper NPC.
NPC Cyclamen (Imperial Delivery) can now be found near NPC Hyacinth (Stable Keeper).



Luciano Pietro’s dialogue after you have over 900 Amity with him has been changed.


World:

Now the steep slope path located south of Calpheon Castle has been improved for easier climbing, and the stairs leading to the Command Post inside the Castle have been widened.

The path between the Serendia Eastern Border and Mediah has been improved.

The bridge in front of Mediah Castle has become wider and you should now be able to go directly from that bridge onto the roof next to the castle gates inside.


Mounts

Fixed the issue where the camera shook violently when you were the rear passenger on a Two-seater horse. Also, the camera will now automatically zoom out so you will be able to get a better view of your surroundings.

Fixed the graphical glitch that showed boats such as Galleys and Epheria Sailboats to be floating mid-air.

The possibility of obtaining a higher Tier Horse after breeding has been increased.


Class Changes

All Classes

You can now jump while equipped with a [Combat] Trina Demolition Axe. 
If you are Knockdowned while equipped with one of the following items, you can now use Evasion by pressing a Directional Key (W/A/S/D) twice or SHIFT + Directional Key.

Matchlock, Cymbals, Fishing Rod, [Combat] Trina Demolition Axe, [Combat] Trina Matchlock, Trumpet, Drum



If you are Knockdowned while equipped with one of the following items, you can now use LMB or RMB to get up more quickly.

Matchlock, Cymbals, Fishing Rod, [Combat] Trina Demolition Axe



Fixed the issue where when these Classes fell from a low height in Awakened-non-combat stances, it automatically triggered their Awakened-combat stances.

Sorceress, Giant, Valkyrie




Warrior

Corrected the description for the skill Flow: Reckless Blow.	

Knockdown on good charged hits → Knockdown on good hits



Fixed the issue where the skill Pulverize would be casted erroneously when trying to cast Flow: Reckless Blow.
The stats for Attack Range and HP Recovery for the skill Flow: Tempest have been edited to accurately reflect the actual effect that is applied when the skill is used.



Ranger

Fixed the graphical glitch that occurred occasionally when Ranger went from her Longbow to non-combat stance while moving forward, causing her Longbow to still be in her hands.
Fixed the issue when EP was sometimes consumed twice when using Evasive Shot then Blasting Gust in quick succession.



Berserker

Fixed the graphical glitch that showed Berserker wearing Bheg’s Gloves on both arms when wearing Eckett Armor top.



Tamer

Description of Tamer’s skill Legendary Beast Dance has been edited to accurately reflect  the actual effect that is applied when the skill is used.



Valkyrie

Fixed the issue where Valkyrie’s Visor Setting was not properly applied when wearing Treant Camouflage.



Witch

Fixed the issue when sometimes the Witch could not swap from Staff to Aad Sphera stance.
Fixed the issue where the Witch would stop when using Toxic Flood while moving forward in Aad Sphera stance and then changing to Staff stance.
Fixed the issue where the Witch would stop when using Psyche of Aad Sphera while sprinting in Aad Sphera stance and then changing to Staff stance.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Witch’s chest while wearing Treant Camouflage.
Fixed the issue where sometimes the Witch could not go from Staff to Aad Sphera stance.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Witch’s knees upon wearing Grunil Armor.



Wizard

Fixed the issue where the Wizard would stop when using Lava Field while moving forward in Godr Sphera stance and then changing to Staff stance.
Fixed the issue where the Wizard would stop when using Controlled Madness while sprinting in Godr Sphera stance and then changing to Staff stance.



Maehwa

Maehwa’s landing motion when falling from a certain height should now be more natural looking.



Ninja

Fixed the graphical glitch that occurred when the skill combo Ninjutsu: Shadow Clone → Ninjutsu: Shadow Stomp was used right after the skill Shuriken/Kunai Throw while the skill Ninjutsu: Clone was in Cooldown.
Fixed the issue where the sprinting effect was not applied when jumping during sprinting while Target Chase effect is on.
You can now cast the Target Chase with ↓+ Q keys while in the transition stance.

The sprinting effect for Target Chase will now be applied during the transition stance too.




Kunoichi

The cooldown time of the skill Awakening: Crimson Sah Chakram will no longer be applied when using the skill Lunar Dash from Quick Slot in Sah Chakram stance.
Fixed the issue where only the cooldown time of the skill Flash Slash was applied while the actual skill was not activated when Flash Slash was used directly after Lunar Dash via Quick Slot in Sah Chakram/Shortsword stances. 
Fixed the graphical glitch that occurred when the skill combo Ninjutsu: Shadow Clone → Ninjutsu: Shadow Stomp was used right after the skill Shuriken/Kunai Throw while the skill Ninjutsu: Clone was in Cooldown.



Striker

Fixed the issue where Gauntlet skills were casting slowly after using the skill Crouching Wolf from Quick Slot in Gardbrace stance.



Mystic

Mystic’s landing motion when falling from a certain height should now be more natural.
Falling motions will now be properly displayed when using the skill Jump Attack from a height of 10m or higher.
The attack motions for the skill Jump Attack have been changed.



Item Changes

Grunil and Rocaba armor Set Effects have been changed from Helmet/Gloves and Armor/Shoes Set Effects to 2-Set and 3-Set Effects..

Fixed the abnormal Durability consumption of Hunting Matchlock and quest/rental Matchlocks.

You will not be able to use an Awakened Giant Chief Summon Scroll if you are in the middle of the quest “Confronting the Awakened Gehaku”.

Ship License: Raft, can now be bought from a Fish Vendor or Wharf Manager NPC.


You can now get the following items with a Sub-Weapon Exchange Coupon.

Green grade Sub-weapons that have been upgraded to Blue grade.
Accuracy Sub-weapons that got upgraded to Ultimate.
Krea Sub-weapons
Rosar Sub-weapons



The effect of thr the Pure Black Stone that gives AP boost has been changed from All AP +500 to +250.

Fixed the issue where 6 and 8-Set Effects were not properly applied when wearing following Life Clothes:

Alchemist’s Clothes
Craftsman’s Clothes
Cook’s Clothes
Farmer’s Clothes 



Monster Changes

A new Guild Boss Muskan of Madness has been added.

Essence of Fury is rewarded for completing the related Subjugation Quest. You can exchange 15 of them for a [Guild] Muskan of Madness Scroll or [Guild] Awakened Muskan of Madness Summon Scroll from NPC Hakkon or a Guild Manager NPC.
[Guild] Muskan of Madness Scroll and [Guild] Awakened Muskan of Madness Summon Scroll can be used at the Bloody Monastery.
You can obtain Muskan’s Shoes, JIN Magical Crystal – Hystria, BON Magical Crystal Hystria, or WON Magical Crystal – Hystria by defeating Muskan of Madness.
This monster is a Guild Boss. You’ll need to team up with and help protect NPC Hakkon to defeat the boss together.
This fearsome Guild Boss will require significant manpower and strategy to defeat.
Please note: Use of both Muskan of Madness Scrolls will not summon multiple Bosses if used concurrently. If a second scroll is activated while a Muskan boss has already been summoned, it will not spawn until the first is defeated or very low on HP



Recommended AP in the World Map has been changed as follows:

https://i.imgur.com/R7lNoQl.jpg

Fixed the issue where some Wandering Rogue Prisons were hovering in the air in the Wandering Rogue Den.

Rearranged some Pila Ku monsters so that they are no longer clipping into certain objects.

Fixed an issue where some monsters in the Pila Ku Jail character model would appear to be in a different physical location than they actually were.

Fixed the issue where the stones loaded in Saunil Immobile Catapults were invisible.

Additional Beehives have been added.

Grass Root Nymphs, Fire Root Nymphs, and Earth Root Nymphs have been added at a cave near Crioville.

Fixed the abnormal placement of some Grass Root Nymphs, Fire Root Nymphs, Earth Root Nymphs, and Root Nymph Rest Areas.

Fire Root Nymphs will drop Black Stones (Weapon) and Tough Tree Roots.

Grass Root Nymphs and Earth Root Nymphs will drop Black Stones (Armor) and Tough Tree Roots.

The following items can be obtained from Grass Root Nymphs, Fire Root Nymphs, and Earth Root Nymphs.

Ancient Relic Crystal Shard
Spirit's Leaf



You can now loot Tough Tree Roots after destroying Root Nymph Rest Areas.

You will now get 100% more EXP from defeating Grass Root Nymphs, Fire Root Nymphs, and Earth Root Nymphs.


Quests & Knowledge

The quest path for the Biraghi Den, a part of Black Spirit’s Main Quests, has been simplified.

New recurring quests for obtaining Sailing EXP have been added.

You can accept these quests from either Dius at Port Epheria or Croix at Velia with a Character who is at least Sailing Beginner 3.

A Treasure Swimming in the Ocean
Outlaws in the Ocean
Stay sharp!
Wanted: Hekaru
Wanted: Ocean Stalker
Looming Threats from the Ocean
Ocean Predators




Four new daily quests for obtaining Farming EXP has been added.

These daily Quests are available once per day, per Family.

https://i.imgur.com/AWe5UB1.jpg




New daily quests for obtaining Gathering EXP have been added.

These Daily Quests can be shared within a player’s Family.
There will be 5 Quests per Territory. You may only select one of these Quests per Territory, but you can do Quests from different Territories simultaneously.
For example, you can accept one of the following Gathering Quests in Serendia, and accept another one in Mediah then do them simultaneously.

https://i.imgur.com/FuXxzYh.jpg




New daily quests for obtaining Cooking EXP have been added.

These Daily Quests can be shared within player’s Family.
Depending on the Cooking Level of your Character, the Quest completion conditions may differ even for Quests with the same names.

https://i.imgur.com/iPgii16.jpg




The items needed to complete the quest “How to Survive the Wilderness” have been changed to items that can be easily Gathered in the surrounding area.

A new story Quest series have been added to Crioville. You can accept it from Crioville villager with a Character that has already completed the quest “Undecided Dilemma.”

Nightmare in Crioville
For the Root Nymph
Offer the Fish 
Inside the Cave 
A Fishy Offering



In the Quests window (O), the Recurring quests under “Calpheon City Contribution” are now in a different order.

In the Quests window (O), the quest for getting a Campsite is now under “Start of Camping” under the “Suggested” tab.

Now you must have the Black Seal in possession when talking to Freharau in order to see the dialogue for exchanging Black Seals with Black Stones.


Interface Changes

You can now see Set Effects on the bottom of your Equipment window.

Mouse over the round “View Set Effect” button to see the applied Set Effect(s).
Click the button to read more about it in detail.



Fixed the issue that prevented Red Battlefield Rankings from displaying correctly in the Ranking window.

Fixed the issue where the button “Return of an Archaeologist” wasn’t displayed after using the item Archaeologist's Map. 

The line above and below the alerts shown on the screen when getting an Item, Knowledge, etc. should now be correctly displayed.

Fixed the issue that sometimes caused the descriptions and icons of Marni’s Stones from correctly updating according to the Stones’ status.

Tooltips have been added for the Hide Helmet and Open Visor buttons in the Pearl Shop.

A new feature “Quick Hotkey” has been added.

You can set “Quick Hotkeys” (ALT + Key combination) for frequently used features such as:

Recharge Alchemy Stones
Open Maid Storage
Open Maid Marketplace
Find NPCs
Check in All Pets
Take Out Pet Group 3
Take Out Pet Group 2
Take Out Pet Group 1
Install Campsite
Remote Collect Campsite




After you upload your custom Preset in the Edit UI mode, the setting for toggling the Skill Guide should now be implemented correctly.

Different images now be will be used as backgrounds for Nouver, Kutum, and Karanda’s alerts.

The description in the item tooltips about not being able to register the following items in the Marketplace has been removed.

[Tamer] Fairy Jackie Costume Set
[Witch] Ghost Bride Costume Set
[Ranger] Audria Outfit Set



The following sets have been adjusted to display content that accurately reflects the items listed in their descriptions:

Golden Prop Set
Sunset Prop Set
Golden Sunset Prop Set
Sweet Home Prop Set
Sweet Bear Complete Prop Set
Cat Prop Set
Margoria Whale Prop Set
Spring Sun Prop Set
Spring Heart Prop Set
Spring Scent Prop Set
Coral Shine White Conch Prop Set
Coral Shine Blue Shell Prop Set
Coral Shine Star Shell Prop Set
Heidelian Wine Prop Set
Fintomaria Sailing Prop Set
[Spooky Halloween] Heart Prop Set
[Spooky Halloween] Diamond Prop Set
[Spooky Halloween] Spade Prop Set



Fixed the graphical glitch on Frosty Wood Prop Set A and Frosty Wood Prop Set B in the Pearl Shop.

The message stating ‘Durability will be reduced’ when Enhancing Accessories will not appear anymore.

Dye Window has been fixed to automatically show Awakening stance when you click on Awakening weapon, and show Main Weapon stance when you click on Main Weapon. 

The question mark button has been removed from when opening a Campsite Storage.

Fixed the issue where the Inventory and Equipment windows overlapping when opened.

Fixed the issue where resetting the Chat Filter in Settings did not work.

When you click on a Skill in the Learnable Skill window you should now be directed to the correct Skill.

Fixed the issue where the Notice window from ESC Menu would sometimes appear in front the window that appears when clicking on an Event banner. 


Resolved Issues

Fixed the graphical glitch that caused the grass near Calpheon Castle to appear as if floating.

Fixed the issue where a single resource was able to be gathered twice in the area near Calpheon Castle.

Fixed the issue where Characters would collide with their Residence doors.

Fixed the issue where the beard and helmet of Monster Pet Centaurus appeared crooked.


Known Issues

Uploading more than 1 image on the Photo Gallery is not working as intended and this issue will be investigated and resolved shortly.

Valtarra Advanced Training Manual will be available with the following update.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes

Max 2 [Event] Moonlight Shards are obtainable per Family per day.

Memory Fragment x1~3
A chance to get a [Event] Moonlight Shard x1




You can exchange [Event] Snowflake items during the following extended period.

System:

Matchlock, Cymbals, Fishing Rod, [Combat] Trina Demolition Axe, [Combat] Trina Matchlock, Trumpet, Drum

Knockdown on good charged hits → Knockdown on good hits

notes.title: Black Desert Online Free Weekend Deal!

Greetings Adventurers,

We have some exciting news for all of you. This weekend we are having our very first Free Weekend Deal! Whether you are a new adventurer, deciding if you want to take the plunge, or a veteran looking for opportunities to draw your friends into the game, we’ve got you covered!

For the next 3 days, immerse yourself in fantasy, slay your foes and claim victory over all who oppose you!

Free Weekend Deal Schedule:
UTC 1/25 Thu 18:00 ~ 1/28 Sun 21:00CET 1/25 Thu 19:00 ~ 1/28 Sun 22:00PST 1/25 Thu 10:00 ~ 1/28 Sun 13:00KST 1/26 Fri 03:00 ~ 1/29 Mon 06:00

We look forward to sharing your adventure.

        - The BDO Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - 24th January 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/oonRSh8.jpg

Vell will make its first appearance on Sunday, January 28th around noon, to celebrate the 1st  anniversary of the opening of Margoria. The Fortune Cookie Event and Wish Lantern Event have started so that Adventurers can kick off this New Year with a great start! And with the new Valks Attendance Reward Event, your inventory will soon be full of Advice of Valks. In addition, Artisan’s Memory has become even more powerful!

A major change in AP efficiency is also implemented with this patch. We hope that this will not only increase your efficiency in fighting monsters, but also help adventurers who were unable to venture into areas of higher difficulty due to struggles with upgrading their gear. With this change, users will be able to fight monsters at a faster speed, therefore able to make profits in a shorter amount of time!

We've been noticing that there has been a low number of Enhanced items available in the marketplace. To help players, there is a new Attendance Reward event that gives out Advice of Valks starting this week. Also, there will be a new event next week that will help everyone get more Memory Fragments. So, stay tuned for next week's event as well!

Event & System

Event:

‘Light Up the Skies!’ Wish Lantern Event has been added.

During the event period, Wish Lantern items will be available in the Pearl Shop for you to purchase, even with Loyalties! Make a wish and fly your beautiful wish lanterns!
Period: January 24th 09:00 ~ February 7th 09:00 UTC.
For more details on this heartwarming event, click .



Wish Lanterns will appear in the background during the event period.

‘Quests of Fortune’ Event has been added.
 
Check Challenges (Y) during the event period and claim either an [Event] Pit-a-pat Fortune Cookie or an [Event] Fortune Cookie for Rookies ONCE A DAY. 
Choose a fortune cookie, crack it open for an instant reward or one of 16 exciting quests to earn other stunning rewards!
Period: January 25th 00:00 ~ February 14th 09:00 UTC.
To find out more on how you can test your luck, click .



A new check-in reward that offers Advice of Valks has been added.

A whole new tab, [Valks], has been added under Attendance Rewards for players to obtain more daily rewards including the highly desired Advice of Valks!
Period: January 25th 00:00 - February 24th 23:59 UTC.
For reward specs and details on this rewarding event, click .



The Snowflake event has ended. The “turn in” voice on the related NPCs will be temporarily restored soon in order to exchange the leftover [Event] Snowflake.

New Year’s Food event has been ended. 

To commemorate the release of Vell and welcome new adventurers joining in, we will hold Weekend EXP boost (Combat EXP 200%) from Jan 25th 18:00 UTC ~ Jan 29th 18:00 UTC.


System:

Marketplace Registration Queue has been set to 15 minutes.

Items registered on Marketplace will be now shown on the Bidding window 15 mins after getting registered.



Fixed the client crashing issue during Character Selection.


Game World, NPC & Effects:

NPC:

Grána Guards have been fixed so they can go around an object and continue attacking an Adventurer with low Karma.

A Calpheon Guard wandering among the guards in formation in front of Valks has been removed.

Fixed the NPC near Grána 15 that could be found sitting on top of water.

A graphical glitch with Investigator Tez during the quest Five Rings of Illezra has been fixed.

Dialogue with the Villager NPC at Heidel Pass has become more natural.

Different greeting motions from some certain NPC to the Lord (Guild Master who owns the Castle) in Calpheon have been fixed.

Changed the graphical glitch with the NPC in front of Calpheon Jeweler Bianstimi.


Content:

Vell the Ocean Boss has been added.

Before Vell makes its appearance, there will be a large whirlpool in the area where Vell will appear. This whirlpool can cause a lot of damage, so please be cautious.
Vell can only be hurt by cannons and matchlocks. It also uses its critter “Lopters” by its side to defend itself against attacking ships. These Lopters can be defeated with [Hunting] Matchlocks. 
When you are fighting Vell, all members of the Party/Platoon will share the same combat contribution. This means that even if you don’t have a chance to directly fight Vell because you are busy sailing the ship or keeping watch, as long as your other Party/ Platoon members successfully attack Vell, you will also get the same combat contribution as them.
There will be no penalty for being killed by Vell. If you are killed, you can choose to be revived at the nearest Town (Lema Island) or the nearest Node (in the Great Ocean, near where Vell is located).
When Vell is defeated, you can loot from its remains. Parties/ Platoons that have dealt a certain amount of damage to Vell can loot their reward from this. You can loot the remains from your ship if you sail close enough to it.
Click  to check out where and when Vell spawns along with all the details!



Characters with AP over 245 will now have higher attack efficiency.

The extra damage applied will be as follows:
https://i.imgur.com/okbpjsc.jpg

The extra damage newly applied with the attack efficiency update for characters with AP 245 or up will be based on the AP shown on the Equipment window. 
Note that the above AP change will be separately applied to Main and Awakening weapons/attacks.



Due to the new, higher attack efficiency of high AP Characters (see above), for balancing purposes the monsters in the following Valencia and Kamasylvia Monster Zones has had their HP decreased and DP increased as followed: 
https://i.imgur.com/HAe6fhZ.jpg

The Recommended AP for Monster Zones shown on the World Map has been changed to the following:
https://i.imgur.com/Nodn11i.jpg

Weakened Magic Asula Accessories have been added.

These accessories are suitable for beginning Adventurers, and have a higher Enhancement success rate compared that of other accessories. You can enhance Asula’s Crimson Eye accessories with Weakened Magic Asula accessories.
Weakened Magic Asula Accessories will be dropped in certain specific Monster Zones in Valencia. Please refer to the item tooltips for more specific information.



A number of balancing work has been done for Conquest War/Node War.

Elephant Production Time (from Elephant Nursery): 12 min. > 10 min.
Siege Tower Production Time Reduction (from Large Siege Tower): 30 min. > 20 min.
[Combat] Trina Demolition Axe Damage: 20% increased
[Guild] Elephant’s Damage against Command Post, Fort, Gate or Annex: 50% increased
Cannon’s Damage against Command Post, Fort, Gate: 20% increased.


The chance of an item being sold via Pre-Order on the Marketplace has risen by 12.5%.
You can now buy the item lot you succeeded in Bidding in the Marketplace even if a cheaper lot of the same item became available.
Drill Sergeant at Battle Arena is now going to be respawned when it is killed.
Fixed the issue where fishing was unable at Navarn Steppe and some puddles in Capital City of Valencia.



The chance of an item being sold via Pre-Order on the Marketplace has risen by 12.5%.

You can now buy the item lot you succeeded in Bidding in the Marketplace even if a cheaper lot of the same item became available.

Drill Sergeant at Battle Arena is now going to be respawned when it is killed.

Fixed the issue where fishing was unable at Navarn Steppe and some puddles in Capital City of Valencia.


Mounts

The  “Auto-consume feed when Stamina is low” option will now be on by default when your mount is on Auto-run.


Class Changes

All Classes

The hit effect of guns will now vary depending on what kind of target they hit (except Frosted Matchlocks).
Fixed the issue with some skills’ effects that were not displaying properly near the ground.
All characters can now get up faster by pressing LMB or RMB after Knockdown.
Fixed the error that showed your Character’s Buff effects when they were supposed to be hidden (e.g. during Emergency Escape).



Warrior

Pressing any of the W,A,S,D keys twice in succession will activate Head Chase.
Fixed the graphical glitch that occured on the arms when equipping Bern Armor or Clead Gloves.



Sorceress

The area that can be Dyed on Sorceress’s Serendian Soldier Suit have has been changed to how it was before the January 10th patch.



Berserker

Fixed the issue where bounded Berserker was able to get up right after.
The following Skills’ effects have been improved.

Giant Leap
Giant Leap (Black Spirit’s Rage)
Titan Blow
Storming Beast
Slugfest




Tamer

Pressing any of the A,S,D keys twice in succession will activate Leaves Dropping and then Flow: Gust when in Celestial Bo Staff stance.
Pressing the W key twice in succession will activate Legendary Beast’s Power when in Celestial Bo Staff stance.
Leaves Dropping and Flow: Gust will not be activated while carrying 126% or more of the weight limit.



Valkyrie

Pressing the A or D key twice in succession in Lancia stance will activate the skill Shield Chase.
The following Skill’s effect has been improved.

Lancia Iustitiae




Witch

A graphical glitch on the lower part of Witch’s neck while wearing the Dreaming Star outfit has been fixed. 
The following Skills’ effects have been improved.

Equilibrium Break
Thunder Storm
Crevice Protection




Wizard

The following Skill’s effect has been improved.

Bolide of Destruction




Musa

Pressing the W or S key twice in succession in Crescent Blade stance will activate the skill Chase.
The following Skills’ effects have been improved.

Crust Crusher
Crust Crusher (Black Spirit’s Rage)




Maehwa

Pressing any of the A,S,D keys twice in succession in Kerispear stance will activate the skill Sleet Steps.
Pressing the W key twice in succession in Kerispear stance will activate the skill Chase.



Dark Knight

The following Skills’ effects have been improved.

Shattering Darkness
Lunacy of Vedir
Lunacy of Vedir (Black Spirit)




Striker

The skill Flow: Mass Destruction can now be activated by first using the skill Crouching Wolf and the pressing A/D and RMB.
Fixed the graphical glitch that caused Striker’s Gauntlet/Gardbrace to show while wearing a Calpheon Noble Suit.
The following Skills’ effects have been improved.

Ferocious Assault
Ultimate Crush
Skull Crusher
Hell Break
Infernal Destruction
Fallout
Deva King
Rage Hammer
Landslide
Rock Smash
Strikethrough
Wolf’s Fang
Rising Blast Combo
Nimbus Strike




Mystic

Fixed the graphical issue that darkened the back of Mystic’s ears and neck when the 16th hairstyle was chosen in the Beauty (F4) Window.
Fixed the graphical glitch that showed Mystic’s Gauntlet/Cestus when wearing the Gloomy Fox Costume.
The following Skills’ effects have been improved.

Deva Queen
Rage Hammer
Landslide
Rock Smash
Strikethrough
Sweeping Kick (Black Spirit’s Rage)




Item Changes

A new item “Vell’s Concentrated Magic” has been added.

You can get this item by defeating the Boss Monster Vell.



An new item “Vell’s Heart” has been added.

Vell’s Heart is an Alchemy Stone steeped in Vell’s powerful aura and gives useful combat buffs.
Buffs: AP +8, Accuracy +10, Ignores All Resistance +5%, Attack Speed +5%, Casting Speed +5%
You can get Vell’s Heart at a certain rate from looting the Boss Monster Vell.. You can also Process Vell’s Heart with Simple Alchemy by combining Alchemy Stone Shard X1500 and Vell’s Concentrated Magic.



A new accessory “Rainbow Coral Ring” has been added.

Basic Ability : AP +5, Max HP +100
AP +2 per successful Enhancement
You can get this accessory at a certain rate by looting the Boss Monster Vell.




The price of the following items have been increased to 70,000 Silvers:

Basilisk's Piece - Snake Skin Belt
Basilisk's Piece - Ring
Basilisk's Piece - Alignment Pin
Cadry's Piece - Blue Ring
Cadry's Piece - Ruby Ornament
Cadry's Piece - Obsidian Decoration



An issue where Luck Level +1 was not applied when equipping [Event] Coral Crown has been fixed.

On a description of Kutum Secondary Weapon, Extra Damage against Monsters has been changed to Extra AP against Monsters.

The order of descriptions on Enhancement effect of Dandelion Weapon has been rearranged as per the other Awakening Weapons.

Grána General Goods NPC Panzy will sell Lanterns now.

Fixed the issue where the 3-Set Effect was applied while wearing only 2 parts of the Zereth set.

The descriptions on how to process Grade 3 Weapon Reform Stones and Grade 3 Armor Reform Stones has been edited. 


Pearl Shop:

The maximum Durability recovered from using Artisan’s Memory has been increased from triple(x3) to quadruple(x4) the durability amount recovered.

Horse Flute (Permanent) will now be able to be registered at the Marketplace. 

When purchased from the Pearl Shop, Horse Flute (Permanent) will no longer be bound to the purchasing character. Once the purchased Horse Flute (Permanent) is opened, it will be bound to the opening character.
If a user has 2 or more Horse Flute (Permanent) items in a single character’s inventory, those items will be deleted and new Horse Flute (Permanent) items will be send to your Mail (B).



New Year Hanbok Costumes are back! Check out the traditional and classy fashion pieces now available at the Pearl Shop!

Arctic Rare Boxes are still hot and in popular demand. These cuddly Polar Bears and sweet Rosefinches are only sold until January 31st!

For details on newly added Pearl Shop items, please click  to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement.


Monster Changes

Bleeding effects are now displayed in the same direction as of when you are attacked by the following monsters: 

Mutated Obsidian Monster
Giath
Green Orc Skeleton Warrior
Moghulis
Helm Raid Captain
Ogre



Fixed graphical issue where Helm Raid Captains’ movements were awkward when swinging their axe.


Quests & Knowledge

You can now gain Knowledge of the Monarch of Darkness, Belmorn by talking with Freharau from Port Epheria after completing the quest “Heading to Epheria..”

In the quest dialogue for Valkyrie's Quality, Protection, Wilderness Golem has been changed to Mane.

During the quest Harder with Platinum, the possibility of finding Platinum from Helm Tribe Mineral Wagons has been greatly increased.

Changed the appearance of the button that appears when you talk to NPC Freharau when you have the Knowledge “Freharau and Enlightenment” and you have over 301 Amity with him from that of a Gain Knowledge button to a Dialogue button..

Typos from the Quest Objective of [Supply] Energizing Meal have been fixed.

Added more descriptions on how to use the group Out function on the tooltips for the Out buttons on the bottom of the Pet List.
The Feed All Window will now close along with the Pet List window when the Pet List window is closed.



A Knowledge (Ecology) Effect tooltip on the Knowledge Window has been added.
 
The Hotkey to switch between Walk/Run can now be customized in the Settings window .

Fixed the issue where the menu that appears after Right-clicking items in the Inventory came out of the screen.

The Save, Reset, and Depository buttons on the bottom of Interface Edit Mode window are now longer.

When you click on the Arena of Arsha in the ESC Menu, the Arena of Arsha and Booking Status (Server Time) windows should no longer overlap.

The Skill Add-on Window should remains open and the Dialogue window should not return to the default after you Add-on a Skill.

Replaced “Siege” and “Siege War” with “Conquest” and “Conquest War” in UI and system message texts.

Fixed the issue where a lock icon remained on Equipment Slots even after equipping a regular outfit and a Pearl outfit for the same corresponding part.

Fixed the issue that occured when the Enhancement Success message turned off automatically when the Horse Market/Worker Exchange message was turned off in the Settings window (Options).

Fixed the issue where Characters were able to go through the wall of Kzarka Shrine.

The names of all discovered Nodes, Towns, and Cities should now be displayed in your World Map.

When make changes in the “Turn off systems notifications” options in the Settings window and press “Cancel,” the changes you made should not be applied.

Guide Video buttons have been added. They can be found on the left side of the Minimap and and the lower right-hand side of the World Map.


Sound:

Fixed the issue where event sounds in event areas were sometimes not playing.


Resolved Issues

Fixed an issue with boats getting stuck at some certain locations.

Fixed an issue that caused slightly increased CPU share.


Known Issues:

Exchangeable period of [Event] Snowflakes will be extended with future notice so please do not delete these event items. Please follow us on this forum  for exact dates.

Graphical glitch with the 3rd Face Type for Mystic will be addressed with future maintenance.



Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes

The order of descriptions on Enhancement effect of Dandelion Weapon has been rearranged as per the other Awakening Weapons.

Grána General Goods NPC Panzy will sell Lanterns now.

Fixed the issue where the 3-Set Effect was applied while wearing only 2 parts of the Zereth set.

The descriptions on how to process Grade 3 Weapon Reform Stones and Grade 3 Armor Reform Stones has been edited. 


Pearl Shop:

The maximum Durability recovered from using Artisan’s Memory has been increased from triple(x3) to quadruple(x4) the durability amount recovered.

Horse Flute (Permanent) will now be able to be registered at the Marketplace. 

When purchased from the Pearl Shop, Horse Flute (Permanent) will no longer be bound to the purchasing character. Once the purchased Horse Flute (Permanent) is opened, it will be bound to the opening character.
If a user has 2 or more Horse Flute (Permanent) items in a single character’s inventory, those items will be deleted and new Horse Flute (Permanent) items will be send to your Mail (B).



New Year Hanbok Costumes are back! Check out the traditional and classy fashion pieces now available at the Pearl Shop!

Arctic Rare Boxes are still hot and in popular demand. These cuddly Polar Bears and sweet Rosefinches are only sold until January 31st!

For details on newly added Pearl Shop items, please click  to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement.


Monster Changes

Bleeding effects are now displayed in the same direction as of when you are attacked by the following monsters: 

Mutated Obsidian Monster
Giath
Green Orc Skeleton Warrior
Moghulis
Helm Raid Captain
Ogre



Fixed graphical issue where Helm Raid Captains’ movements were awkward when swinging their axe.


Quests & Knowledge

You can now gain Knowledge of the Monarch of Darkness, Belmorn by talking with Freharau from Port Epheria after completing the quest “Heading to Epheria..”

In the quest dialogue for Valkyrie's Quality, Protection, Wilderness Golem has been changed to Mane.

During the quest Harder with Platinum, the possibility of finding Platinum from Helm Tribe Mineral Wagons has been greatly increased.

Changed the appearance of the button that appears when you talk to NPC Freharau when you have the Knowledge “Freharau and Enlightenment” and you have over 301 Amity with him from that of a Gain Knowledge button to a Dialogue button..

Typos from the Quest Objective of [Supply] Energizing Meal have been fixed.

Added more descriptions on how to use the group Out function on the tooltips for the Out buttons on the bottom of the Pet List.
The Feed All Window will now close along with the Pet List window when the Pet List window is closed.



A Knowledge (Ecology) Effect tooltip on the Knowledge Window has been added.
 
The Hotkey to switch between Walk/Run can now be customized in the Settings window .

Fixed the issue where the menu that appears after Right-clicking items in the Inventory came out of the screen.

The Save, Reset, and Depository buttons on the bottom of Interface Edit Mode window are now longer.

When you click on the Arena of Arsha in the ESC Menu, the Arena of Arsha and Booking Status (Server Time) windows should no longer overlap.

The Skill Add-on Window should remains open and the Dialogue window should not return to the default after you Add-on a Skill.

Replaced “Siege” and “Siege War” with “Conquest” and “Conquest War” in UI and system message texts.

Fixed the issue where a lock icon remained on Equipment Slots even after equipping a regular outfit and a Pearl outfit for the same corresponding part.

Fixed the issue that occured when the Enhancement Success message turned off automatically when the Horse Market/Worker Exchange message was turned off in the Settings window (Options).

Fixed the issue where Characters were able to go through the wall of Kzarka Shrine.

The names of all discovered Nodes, Towns, and Cities should now be displayed in your World Map.

When make changes in the “Turn off systems notifications” options in the Settings window and press “Cancel,” the changes you made should not be applied.

Guide Video buttons have been added. They can be found on the left side of the Minimap and and the lower right-hand side of the World Map.


Sound:

Fixed the issue where event sounds in event areas were sometimes not playing.


Resolved Issues

Fixed an issue with boats getting stuck at some certain locations.

Fixed an issue that caused slightly increased CPU share.


Known Issues:

Exchangeable period of [Event] Snowflakes will be extended with future notice so please do not delete these event items. Please follow us on this forum  for exact dates.

Graphical glitch with the 3rd Face Type for Mystic will be addressed with future maintenance.
