notes.title: Patch Notes - 6th December
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/d4JOIJw.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,

Bedazzling all foes that stand in her way with flurry of kicks, Mystic will join the roster of BDO next week. This week, players will get an early access to customize their own Mystic so that they can get started right away on their journey upon launch. Enjoy customizing events for the Mystic this week where you can get great rewards while creating unique customizations! Check the Mystic out »here«!

Event & Systems

Event: 

Mystic Beauty Contest
Create a Mystic template, upload it to the Beauty Album, and have a chance to win big!
Period: 12/06/2017 After Maintenance ~ 12/20/2017 Before Maintenance
Winner Announcement (Staff Pick): 12/20/2017


Mystic Pre-Registration Event
Create and Win rewards simply for creating Mystic!
Period: 12/06/2017 After Maintenance ~ 12/13/2017 Before Maintenance
Click »here« to see these 2 beautiful events in detail!


Character Slot Expansion Coupon
To celebrate the arrival of Mystic (official launch 12/13/2017), a special Character Slot Expansion Coupon will be available on the Pearl Shop for 1 loyalty.
Regular Character Slot Expansion Coupon will also be available at -70% discount.


System: 

Energy Burning system has been added.
For characters of Lv.50 or above, consume 50 Energy while talking with the Black Spirit to receive Combat EXP and Skill EXP boost of 30 minutes.


Spectators will no longer get debuffs in Arena of Arsha.


Game World, NPC & Effects:

NPC: 

Fixed the issue where the Kid in front of Calpheon City storage was being tagged as Soldier.
The auto-generated Horse NPCs in stables have been changed to normal horse NPCs.
Fixed the issue where there were far too many seagulls above Velia.
Fixed the issue that prevented you from interacting with The Bautt Lithograph.
Fixed the issue that made the flag/weapon of Olvia/Serendia/Velia gatekeeper NPC disappear after it bowed to the Lord Guild Master who owns the Castle.


Content: 

Fixed the issue where trying to join a horse race during a duel resulted in no response.
The production time of Medium and Large Siege Towers has been reduced.
Medium Siege Tower: 20 minutes → 15 minutes
Large Siege Tower: 40 minutes → 30 minutes

Upon completing Imperial Delivery with the Nouveranto Net, you will receive Shiny Golden Seal - [Imperial Delivery] as completion bonus.
You can now receive the Gold Bar rewards of Savage Rift via mail.
Contribution system and report function has been added to Savage Rift.
From the Contribution Summary window that appears at the end of the Savage Rift, you can now ‘report’ on users who show malicious demeanors.
If majority of the party votes in favor, the ‘reported’ user will receive 1 ‘warning’ which will be accumulated.
Players can gain Savage Points as they play Savage Rift based on how much contribution they make for each game.
There is a minimum level of Savage Points which determines whether or not the player can be reported.
Players with over 100 Savage Points cannot be reported on.

Participants who exit Savage Rift before Round 4 will not appear on the Contribution Summary window.
If certain amount of warnings are accumulated, the ‘reported’ user will be blocked from entering Savage Rift for a set period of time.

         https://i.imgur.com/tNo8bpa.png


The grace period that you can stay in Savage Rift at the end of each game has been changed from 10 seconds to 2 minutes.
Gold Bar given as reward for Savage Rift will be sent out via in-game mailbox from now.
Even if the character is too heavy in Weight or there’s not enough slots in Inventory, Savage Rift rewards can be obtained via in-game mailbox.
However, opening an in-game mail and claiming the Gold Bar inside would mean you need to empty slots in Inventory.

Now you can command all your (taken out) pets at once. * When commanding a pet, left-click will give command to the selected pet, and right-click will give command to all pets.
‘Purchase Maid’ and ‘Nearby Marketplace’ buttons have been added to the Marketplace window.


Mounts:

Mounts such as horse and camel will not be shown around the fences near stable keeper NPCs.
You will now see fish swimming in the fish-tank ball of Terrminé Wagon.


Class Changes
All Classes 

You can now create Mystic now!
Non-weapon items for Main-Weapon slot will not appear in Character Selection even if they are equipped. Instead, the basic Main-Weapon suitable for each Class will be shown.
The drunk action after drinking Cool Draft Beer and Dark Beer has been removed.


Warrior 

Fixed the graphical glitch that happened when equipping Warrior’s Goyen Helmet and Teary Ear Cuff together.


Ranger 

Fixed the issue where the invincible effect was wrongly being applied when attacking monsters with basic lateral slashes of Kamasylven Sword (Kamasylven Sword Training).
Fixed the the issue where the skill Wind Step right after cancelling Blasting Gust applied slower when used towards the right-side compared to when used towards the left-side.
You can now use the rolling motion after being knocked down on Awakening stance using Shift + directional keys or AA/DD/WW/SS key commands.


Sorceress 

Fixed the issue where the skill effect of Mark of the Shadow did not disappear while using other skills.


Berserker 

Fixed the issue where you could see Berserker’s hand after wearing Tantu Iron Buster on Awakening stance.
Fixed the graphical glitch where skin did not show under the knee with [Berserker] Deathrone Shoes equipped.


Tamer 

Fixed the issue where switching back to non-combat stance from combat stance (Shortsword) while moving forward then stopping in the middle brought back the combat stance.
Using the skill Tree Climb on Celestial Bo Staff stance will automatically activate the Shortsword stance.
Fixed the graphical glitch from Anemos Outfit on Tamer’s arms.


Valkyrie 

Fixed the issue where the previous facial expression stayed when checking out character actions after checking facial expressions in the Customization screen.


Witch 

Fixed the issue where the Witch sometimes could not use skills after stopping sprinting.
Fixed the issue where the skill Toxic Flood sometimes made the character stop while being used if it is cast while sprinting.
Fixed the graphical glitch at the back of Witch’s hair (Hair customization #1)


Wizard 

Fixed the issue where the Wizard sometimes could not use skills after stopping sprinting.
Fixed the issue where the Controlled Madness was sometimes not applied if Controlled Madness is used while sprinting followed by Lava Field.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Wizard’s Inquirer's Destiny Hat that happened with certain a customization.


Musa 

Fixed the issue that sustained the effects on Maehwa and Musa’s weapons if they install Fence, Fort (Command Post), or other Annexes after using the skill Musa's Soul or General Apricot.
Fixed the issue where using the skill Blooming led you back to the Crescent Blade stance.


Maehwa 

Fixed the issue that sustained the effects on Maehwa and Musa’s weapons if they install Fence, Fort (Command Post), or other Annexes after using the skill Musa's Soul and General Apricot.
Fixed the graphical glitch near the character’s eyebrows in the customization screen.


Ninja

Fixed the issue where the text “In order to move more easily, press the ’Tab’ key and change into a non-combat stance.” was not being displayed when moving forward or sprinting on Shortsword combat stance.


Kunoichi 

Fixed the issue where the text “In order to move more easily, press the ’Tab’ key and change into a non-combat stance.” was not being displayed when moving forward or sprinting on Shortsword combat stance.
Fixed the graphical glitch from Anemos Outfit on Kunoichi’s arms.


Dark Knight 

Unnecessary information regarding skill cooldown has been removed from the description of the skill Flow: Termination. This skill does not have a cooldown time.
Description of the skill Flow: Termination has been changed.
All damage applied equals that of Enforcement’s damage x 3
→  All damage applied equals that of Enforcement’s damage, hit +1


Striker 

Fixed the issue where Jump Attack damage was not being applied at Lv. 56 with Gardbrace Training I learned.
Using Fist of True Strength with the Gauntlet will now have Knockback/Push effect on extra hits.
Fixed the issue where Forward Guard effect was being applied if the skill Twisted Collision was used during cooldown and in mid-air.
Fixed the issue where switching back to non-combat stance while moving was not smooth.
WP Recovery effect per extra hit has been added to the skill Fist of True Strength.
Fixed the issue where Striker’s Blazing Inferno Gloves were overlapping with the awakening weapon.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Striker’s Serendian Formal around its wrists.
Description of the skill Heavy Fist has been fixed regarding the WP recovery effect.


Item Changes


Information regarding Dream Horse types has been added to the description of Courser training items.
Descriptions of the following Trace items have been modified.
Trace of Chaos: Digging location info
Trace of Memory: Digging location info
Trace of Death: Info regarding digging removed. The item cannot be dug
Please refer to Crafting Notes for detailed information about all Trace items.

Using Alchemy Stones or GM’s Blessings will only show 1 buff icon.
Fixed the issue where the Attack and Casting Speed buff was only 4% for Sharp and Resplendent Alchemy Stone of Destruction.
The icon image of Old Moon Promissory Note has been changed.
It has been fixed so that you cannot use Archaeologist's Map when your mount is carrying trade items.
The font color of “Accuracy” in item spec tooltips has been changed to match other spec text.
New gear items have been added.
The following items cannot be traded or enhanced, and they have two Transfusion (crystal) slots.
Black Abyssal armors can be obtained from the monsters in Mediah, and they can also be obtained by completing a quest series.
Black Abyssall weapons can only be obtained through quests.
The specs are as follows:

https://i.imgur.com/Q1lcpbi.png


Quests for obtaining Black Abyssal weapons have been added.
Talk to NPC Konah at Altinova Arena if you are Lv. 55 or up.

Go to the Suggested tab of the Quest window (O) to find the quest. This quest can be done once per Family.
Complete this quest series to obtain Black Abyssal Weapon Box.
The Good Old Days
Legendary Fighters
Old Friend of Shultz
A Special Health Tonic...?
Making Blood Boil
Kunga’s Recommendation
God of Fight
The Best Teammate(?)
Worthy Opponent
Steel Brothers
Legendary Fighter, Red Shadow
Final Battle Contestants
Arena of Death I
Arena of Death II
Arena of Death - Final Battle
Legendary Fighter
 

Quests for obtaining Derek's Light Leather Shoes have been added.
Talk to NPC Theo Dango at Highland Junction if you are Lv. 53 or up.
Go to the Suggested tab of the Quest window (O) to find the quest. This quest can be done once per Family.


Complete this quest series to obtain Derek's Light Leather Shoes.
In Hot Haste
My Dear Brothers
A Rude Welcome
Finding Missing People
Suspicious Man, Suspicious Power
Keeper of the Graves
A Tale of Betrayal
Ghost of the Past
Lifting the Veil
Atonement
Passing on the Legacy


Quests for obtaining Mediah Merchants Union Helm have been added.
Talk to NPC Kesir Baum at Abun if you are Lv. 54 or up.
Go to the Suggested tab of the Quest window (O) to find the quest. This quest can be done once per Family.


Complete this quest series to obtain Mediah Merchants Union Helmet.
Kesir Baum’s Ambitious Plan
Borondo’s Mineral Appraisal
To Kesir Baum
It’s Not Rock Bottom Yet
News from the Crow Merchants Guild
The Tycoon Visiting Altinova
Shakatu Merchants


Procuring Mediah Rowboat
Craft a Rowboat: Get White Cedar Plywood
Craft a Rowboat: Get Brass Ingot
Craft a Rowboat: Lodging and Workers


Special Trade Item from the Island
Shakatu's Trade Pass
Mediah Merchants Union Support


Quests for obtaining Beia's Black Magic Gloves have been added.
Interact with the book on top of the tower behind Tarif Storage with the character that has completed the quest [Co-op] Awakened Black Spirit.
Go to the Suggested tab of the Quest window (O) to find the quest. This quest can be done once per Family.


Complete this quest series to obtain Beia's Black Magic Gloves.
Illezra’s Threat
Special Investigators from Tarif
Investigating the Abandoned Iron Mine
Collect Rough Information
Yaak’s Sacrament
Trade Manager of Tarif
Trading with the Shen Merchant Guild #1
Trading with the Shen Merchant Guild #2
Madelinot’s Sacrament
Back to Tarif
The Hidden Sacrament
A Lucky Coincidence
Kirderf’s Sacrament
Useless Investigator
Weight of the World
Punish the Wandering Rogue
Weakness of the Living Legend
Reforming Tarif
Most Painful Finger
To Elric Shrine
Incarnation of Illezra
Finlin
Magic Bullet of Last Hope
An Precious Item
Peace


A new title, Pride of the Outback, and a new Social Action, Combat Training, have been added.
After completing the 4 quest series associated with the new gears, receive the quest Pride of the Outback from Black Spirit to obtain the title.


Freed Magical Sub-weapons and Roaring Magical Sub-weapons have been added.
Complete certain main quests in Mediah and talk to Black Spirit to receive quests to obtain these.
When you exchange Sealed Magical sub-weapons to Freed and Roaring Magical sub-weapons, the DP and the number of crystal slots will decrease, but the sub-weapon’s AP will increase.


Quests have been added where you can obtain Freed and Roaring Magical sub-weapons.
Complete certain main quests in Mediah and talk to Black Spirit to receive quests.


[ Pearl Shop ]

New Pearl Shop items have been released. Click »here« to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement.


Monster Changes


Fixed the issue where Catfishman Fishers did not drop the item “Combat/Skill EXP +3%.”
Fixed the issue where Manshaum Great Warriors teleported to other spots from time to time.
Manshaum Great Warriors will not get debuffs any more.
Manshaum Great Warriors will not get damaged by performing jump attacks.
The standby motion of Desert Naga and Desert Fogan monsters became more natural.
Hedgehog’s gathering buff will be applied when gathering from the mushroom monsters in Polly’s Forest.
Bashim Base monsters have been rearranged to make auto-running more safer.
Mutant Ogre will now drop Shattered Necklace instead of Shattered Ring.
Movement of the monster Blue Whale has been improved. Also, player hits will be applied correctly to Blue Whales.


Quest & Knowledge


The awakening-related knowledge cards of Musa and Maehwa have been shortened.
Fixed the issue where you could accept quests Jewelry Thieves and To Rob, or Not to Rob? at the same time even though they were ‘Choose One’ type quests.
The accept condition of the quest There and Back Again.. has been changed so that you can accept it without completing the Valencia main quests.
If you completed the quest A Place of Old Memories, a Kamasylvia II main quest, you can accept the quest There and Back Again..

Loading a cannon during the quest Testing Cannon will now let you fire the cannon.
Fixed the incorrect navigation of the quest Explorer's Compass.
Fixed the issue where you could not proceed with the quest Kamasylve's Choice if your character has completed the Kamasylvia II main quests.
The knowledge card of NPC Baman has been modified.
The knowledge “Magic Bullet of Last Hope” can now be obtained by completing the quest Incarnation of Illezra.


Interface Changes

UI: 

Fixed the flickering cursor in the Customizing screen.
Fixed the issue where the durability reduction value did not get updated when Enhancement succeeded.
The tooltip for Drying in Processing window now says it is unavailable in the ocean.
Information regarding collecting ships has been added to the Wharf and Guild Wharf screen to clarify the rules around collecting ships that carry certain items.
Descriptions of Kzarka, Liverto, Nouver, and Kutum (sub)weapons have been changed to be more epic.
The icons in the bottom of the Marketplace registration window have been rearranged.
Fixed the issue where extra space for guide video was being seen in the description for passive skills.
Information regarding preceding skills have been added to the skill list in Horse Information window.
Imperial Delivery icon will be correctly displayed in the Trade screen for items that are eligible for Imperial Delivery.
When you register a Costume Bag with items in it to the Auto-align Quick Slot and then remove it from the slot, you will not see the icons of items inside the bag in the Quick Slot any more.
Special slots for displaying skill cooldown time have been added.
You can set up the slots from the Skill window.
You can register up to 10 skills to slots. You can turn the slots on and off or move the slots in the Edit UI menu.
 
The texture of the Reset Skills button has been changed.
Fixed the issue that froze the game momentarily while using Find NPC function.
After reaching Lv. 7 during the tutorial, the chat window will be displayed.
Depository for saving your game settings can be now accessed at the bottom of Settings.


Resolved Issues


Some areas along the Velia coast have been renamed to Velia Beach.
Fixed the issue where switching to Character Select screen after equipping Trina Matchlock made the character image look awkward.
Fixed the issue where you could not kick out a player that is offline if one of your party members is in Arena of Arsha.
The event items for making [Event] Roast Turkey Feast can now be sold to NPC shops.
Fixed the issue where you could not use the Guild Storage in Tooth Fairy Cabin.
Fixed the issue where certain spots in Grána were seen in underwater color scheme.
Fixed the issue where the “Apply Most Popular” function was not working properly in Beauty Salon.
Fixed the issue where it was impossible to ride horses at certain spots.
Fixed the issue where the Force PvP icon did not show next to the character during PvP mode.
Fixed the issue where the Margoria Phantom Ship sometimes shook awkwardly after appearing.
Fixed the issue that pressing Space Key would take Portrait pictures when Beauty Album was opened in Customization mode.


Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes

notes.title: Patch Notes - 6th December
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/d4JOIJw.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,

Bedazzling all foes that stand in her way with flurry of kicks, Mystic will join the roster of BDO next week. This week, players will get an early access to customize their own Mystic so that they can get started right away on their journey upon launch. Enjoy customizing events for the Mystic this week where you can get great rewards while creating unique customizations! Check the Mystic out »here«!

Event & Systems

Event: 

Mystic Beauty Contest
Create a Mystic template, upload it to the Beauty Album, and have a chance to win big!
Period: 12/06/2017 After Maintenance ~ 12/20/2017 Before Maintenance
Winner Announcement (Staff Pick): 12/20/2017


Mystic Pre-Registration Event
Create and Win rewards simply for creating Mystic!
Period: 12/06/2017 After Maintenance ~ 12/13/2017 Before Maintenance
Click »here« to see these 2 beautiful events in detail!


Character Slot Expansion Coupon
To celebrate the arrival of Mystic (official launch 12/13/2017), a special Character Slot Expansion Coupon will be available on the Pearl Shop for 1 loyalty.
Regular Character Slot Expansion Coupon will also be available at -70% discount.


System: 

Energy Burning system has been added.
For characters of Lv.50 or above, consume 50 Energy while talking with the Black Spirit to receive Combat EXP and Skill EXP boost of 30 minutes.


Spectators will no longer get debuffs in Arena of Arsha.


Game World, NPC & Effects:

NPC: 

Fixed the issue where the Kid in front of Calpheon City storage was being tagged as Soldier.
The auto-generated Horse NPCs in stables have been changed to normal horse NPCs.
Fixed the issue where there were far too many seagulls above Velia.
Fixed the issue that prevented you from interacting with The Bautt Lithograph.
Fixed the issue that made the flag/weapon of Olvia/Serendia/Velia gatekeeper NPC disappear after it bowed to the Lord Guild Master who owns the Castle.


Content: 

Fixed the issue where trying to join a horse race during a duel resulted in no response.
The production time of Medium and Large Siege Towers has been reduced.
Medium Siege Tower: 20 minutes → 15 minutes
Large Siege Tower: 40 minutes → 30 minutes

Upon completing Imperial Delivery with the Nouveranto Net, you will receive Shiny Golden Seal - [Imperial Delivery] as completion bonus.
You can now receive the Gold Bar rewards of Savage Rift via mail.
Contribution system and report function has been added to Savage Rift.
From the Contribution Summary window that appears at the end of the Savage Rift, you can now ‘report’ on users who show malicious demeanors.
If majority of the party votes in favor, the ‘reported’ user will receive 1 ‘warning’ which will be accumulated.
Players can gain Savage Points as they play Savage Rift based on how much contribution they make for each game.
There is a minimum level of Savage Points which determines whether or not the player can be reported.
Players with over 100 Savage Points cannot be reported on.

Participants who exit Savage Rift before Round 4 will not appear on the Contribution Summary window.
If certain amount of warnings are accumulated, the ‘reported’ user will be blocked from entering Savage Rift for a set period of time.

         https://i.imgur.com/tNo8bpa.png


The grace period that you can stay in Savage Rift at the end of each game has been changed from 10 seconds to 2 minutes.
Gold Bar given as reward for Savage Rift will be sent out via in-game mailbox from now.
Even if the character is too heavy in Weight or there’s not enough slots in Inventory, Savage Rift rewards can be obtained via in-game mailbox.
However, opening an in-game mail and claiming the Gold Bar inside would mean you need to empty slots in Inventory.

Now you can command all your (taken out) pets at once. * When commanding a pet, left-click will give command to the selected pet, and right-click will give command to all pets.
‘Purchase Maid’ and ‘Nearby Marketplace’ buttons have been added to the Marketplace window.


Mounts:

Mounts such as horse and camel will not be shown around the fences near stable keeper NPCs.
You will now see fish swimming in the fish-tank ball of Terrminé Wagon.


Class Changes
All Classes 

You can now create Mystic now!
Non-weapon items for Main-Weapon slot will not appear in Character Selection even if they are equipped. Instead, the basic Main-Weapon suitable for each Class will be shown.
The drunk action after drinking Cool Draft Beer and Dark Beer has been removed.


Warrior 

Fixed the graphical glitch that happened when equipping Warrior’s Goyen Helmet and Teary Ear Cuff together.


Ranger 

Fixed the issue where the invincible effect was wrongly being applied when attacking monsters with basic lateral slashes of Kamasylven Sword (Kamasylven Sword Training).
Fixed the the issue where the skill Wind Step right after cancelling Blasting Gust applied slower when used towards the right-side compared to when used towards the left-side.
You can now use the rolling motion after being knocked down on Awakening stance using Shift + directional keys or AA/DD/WW/SS key commands.


Sorceress 

Fixed the issue where the skill effect of Mark of the Shadow did not disappear while using other skills.


Berserker 

Fixed the issue where you could see Berserker’s hand after wearing Tantu Iron Buster on Awakening stance.
Fixed the graphical glitch where skin did not show under the knee with [Berserker] Deathrone Shoes equipped.


Tamer 

Fixed the issue where switching back to non-combat stance from combat stance (Shortsword) while moving forward then stopping in the middle brought back the combat stance.
Using the skill Tree Climb on Celestial Bo Staff stance will automatically activate the Shortsword stance.
Fixed the graphical glitch from Anemos Outfit on Tamer’s arms.


Valkyrie 

Fixed the issue where the previous facial expression stayed when checking out character actions after checking facial expressions in the Customization screen.


Witch 

Fixed the issue where the Witch sometimes could not use skills after stopping sprinting.
Fixed the issue where the skill Toxic Flood sometimes made the character stop while being used if it is cast while sprinting.
Fixed the graphical glitch at the back of Witch’s hair (Hair customization #1)


Wizard 

Fixed the issue where the Wizard sometimes could not use skills after stopping sprinting.
Fixed the issue where the Controlled Madness was sometimes not applied if Controlled Madness is used while sprinting followed by Lava Field.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Wizard’s Inquirer's Destiny Hat that happened with certain a customization.


Musa 

Fixed the issue that sustained the effects on Maehwa and Musa’s weapons if they install Fence, Fort (Command Post), or other Annexes after using the skill Musa's Soul or General Apricot.
Fixed the issue where using the skill Blooming led you back to the Crescent Blade stance.


Maehwa 

Fixed the issue that sustained the effects on Maehwa and Musa’s weapons if they install Fence, Fort (Command Post), or other Annexes after using the skill Musa's Soul and General Apricot.
Fixed the graphical glitch near the character’s eyebrows in the customization screen.


Ninja

Fixed the issue where the text “In order to move more easily, press the ’Tab’ key and change into a non-combat stance.” was not being displayed when moving forward or sprinting on Shortsword combat stance.


Kunoichi 

Fixed the issue where the text “In order to move more easily, press the ’Tab’ key and change into a non-combat stance.” was not being displayed when moving forward or sprinting on Shortsword combat stance.
Fixed the graphical glitch from Anemos Outfit on Kunoichi’s arms.


Dark Knight 

Unnecessary information regarding skill cooldown has been removed from the description of the skill Flow: Termination. This skill does not have a cooldown time.
Description of the skill Flow: Termination has been changed.
All damage applied equals that of Enforcement’s damage x 3
→  All damage applied equals that of Enforcement’s damage, hit +1


Striker 

Fixed the issue where Jump Attack damage was not being applied at Lv. 56 with Gardbrace Training I learned.
Using Fist of True Strength with the Gauntlet will now have Knockback/Push effect on extra hits.
Fixed the issue where Forward Guard effect was being applied if the skill Twisted Collision was used during cooldown and in mid-air.
Fixed the issue where switching back to non-combat stance while moving was not smooth.
WP Recovery effect per extra hit has been added to the skill Fist of True Strength.
Fixed the issue where Striker’s Blazing Inferno Gloves were overlapping with the awakening weapon.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Striker’s Serendian Formal around its wrists.
Description of the skill Heavy Fist has been fixed regarding the WP recovery effect.


Item Changes


Information regarding Dream Horse types has been added to the description of Courser training items.
Descriptions of the following Trace items have been modified.
Trace of Chaos: Digging location info
Trace of Memory: Digging location info
Trace of Death: Info regarding digging removed. The item cannot be dug
Please refer to Crafting Notes for detailed information about all Trace items.

Using Alchemy Stones or GM’s Blessings will only show 1 buff icon.
Fixed the issue where the Attack and Casting Speed buff was only 4% for Sharp and Resplendent Alchemy Stone of Destruction.
The icon image of Old Moon Promissory Note has been changed.
It has been fixed so that you cannot use Archaeologist's Map when your mount is carrying trade items.
The font color of “Accuracy” in item spec tooltips has been changed to match other spec text.
New gear items have been added.
The following items cannot be traded or enhanced, and they have two Transfusion (crystal) slots.
Black Abyssal armors can be obtained from the monsters in Mediah, and they can also be obtained by completing a quest series.
Black Abyssall weapons can only be obtained through quests.
The specs are as follows:

https://i.imgur.com/Q1lcpbi.png


Quests for obtaining Black Abyssal weapons have been added.
Talk to NPC Konah at Altinova Arena if you are Lv. 55 or up.

Go to the Suggested tab of the Quest window (O) to find the quest. This quest can be done once per Family.
Complete this quest series to obtain Black Abyssal Weapon Box.
The Good Old Days
Legendary Fighters
Old Friend of Shultz
A Special Health Tonic...?
Making Blood Boil
Kunga’s Recommendation
God of Fight
The Best Teammate(?)
Worthy Opponent
Steel Brothers
Legendary Fighter, Red Shadow
Final Battle Contestants
Arena of Death I
Arena of Death II
Arena of Death - Final Battle
Legendary Fighter
 

Quests for obtaining Derek's Light Leather Shoes have been added.
Talk to NPC Theo Dango at Highland Junction if you are Lv. 53 or up.
Go to the Suggested tab of the Quest window (O) to find the quest. This quest can be done once per Family.


Complete this quest series to obtain Derek's Light Leather Shoes.
In Hot Haste
My Dear Brothers
A Rude Welcome
Finding Missing People
Suspicious Man, Suspicious Power
Keeper of the Graves
A Tale of Betrayal
Ghost of the Past
Lifting the Veil
Atonement
Passing on the Legacy


Quests for obtaining Mediah Merchants Union Helm have been added.
Talk to NPC Kesir Baum at Abun if you are Lv. 54 or up.
Go to the Suggested tab of the Quest window (O) to find the quest. This quest can be done once per Family.


Complete this quest series to obtain Mediah Merchants Union Helmet.
Kesir Baum’s Ambitious Plan
Borondo’s Mineral Appraisal
To Kesir Baum
It’s Not Rock Bottom Yet
News from the Crow Merchants Guild
The Tycoon Visiting Altinova
Shakatu Merchants


Procuring Mediah Rowboat
Craft a Rowboat: Get White Cedar Plywood
Craft a Rowboat: Get Brass Ingot
Craft a Rowboat: Lodging and Workers


Special Trade Item from the Island
Shakatu's Trade Pass
Mediah Merchants Union Support


Quests for obtaining Beia's Black Magic Gloves have been added.
Interact with the book on top of the tower behind Tarif Storage with the character that has completed the quest [Co-op] Awakened Black Spirit.
Go to the Suggested tab of the Quest window (O) to find the quest. This quest can be done once per Family.


Complete this quest series to obtain Beia's Black Magic Gloves.
Illezra’s Threat
Special Investigators from Tarif
Investigating the Abandoned Iron Mine
Collect Rough Information
Yaak’s Sacrament
Trade Manager of Tarif
Trading with the Shen Merchant Guild #1
Trading with the Shen Merchant Guild #2
Madelinot’s Sacrament
Back to Tarif
The Hidden Sacrament
A Lucky Coincidence
Kirderf’s Sacrament
Useless Investigator
Weight of the World
Punish the Wandering Rogue
Weakness of the Living Legend
Reforming Tarif
Most Painful Finger
To Elric Shrine
Incarnation of Illezra
Finlin
Magic Bullet of Last Hope
An Precious Item
Peace


A new title, Pride of the Outback, and a new Social Action, Combat Training, have been added.
After completing the 4 quest series associated with the new gears, receive the quest Pride of the Outback from Black Spirit to obtain the title.


Freed Magical Sub-weapons and Roaring Magical Sub-weapons have been added.
Complete certain main quests in Mediah and talk to Black Spirit to receive quests to obtain these.
When you exchange Sealed Magical sub-weapons to Freed and Roaring Magical sub-weapons, the DP and the number of crystal slots will decrease, but the sub-weapon’s AP will increase.


Quests have been added where you can obtain Freed and Roaring Magical sub-weapons.
Complete certain main quests in Mediah and talk to Black Spirit to receive quests.


[ Pearl Shop ]

New Pearl Shop items have been released. Click »here« to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement.


Monster Changes


Fixed the issue where Catfishman Fishers did not drop the item “Combat/Skill EXP +3%.”
Fixed the issue where Manshaum Great Warriors teleported to other spots from time to time.
Manshaum Great Warriors will not get debuffs any more.
Manshaum Great Warriors will not get damaged by performing jump attacks.
The standby motion of Desert Naga and Desert Fogan monsters became more natural.
Hedgehog’s gathering buff will be applied when gathering from the mushroom monsters in Polly’s Forest.
Bashim Base monsters have been rearranged to make auto-running more safer.
Mutant Ogre will now drop Shattered Necklace instead of Shattered Ring.
Movement of the monster Blue Whale has been improved. Also, player hits will be applied correctly to Blue Whales.


Quest & Knowledge


The awakening-related knowledge cards of Musa and Maehwa have been shortened.
Fixed the issue where you could accept quests Jewelry Thieves and To Rob, or Not to Rob? at the same time even though they were ‘Choose One’ type quests.
The accept condition of the quest There and Back Again.. has been changed so that you can accept it without completing the Valencia main quests.
If you completed the quest A Place of Old Memories, a Kamasylvia II main quest, you can accept the quest There and Back Again..

Loading a cannon during the quest Testing Cannon will now let you fire the cannon.
Fixed the incorrect navigation of the quest Explorer's Compass.
Fixed the issue where you could not proceed with the quest Kamasylve's Choice if your character has completed the Kamasylvia II main quests.
The knowledge card of NPC Baman has been modified.
The knowledge “Magic Bullet of Last Hope” can now be obtained by completing the quest Incarnation of Illezra.


Interface Changes

UI: 

Fixed the flickering cursor in the Customizing screen.
Fixed the issue where the durability reduction value did not get updated when Enhancement succeeded.
The tooltip for Drying in Processing window now says it is unavailable in the ocean.
Information regarding collecting ships has been added to the Wharf and Guild Wharf screen to clarify the rules around collecting ships that carry certain items.
Descriptions of Kzarka, Liverto, Nouver, and Kutum (sub)weapons have been changed to be more epic.
The icons in the bottom of the Marketplace registration window have been rearranged.
Fixed the issue where extra space for guide video was being seen in the description for passive skills.
Information regarding preceding skills have been added to the skill list in Horse Information window.
Imperial Delivery icon will be correctly displayed in the Trade screen for items that are eligible for Imperial Delivery.
When you register a Costume Bag with items in it to the Auto-align Quick Slot and then remove it from the slot, you will not see the icons of items inside the bag in the Quick Slot any more.
Special slots for displaying skill cooldown time have been added.
You can set up the slots from the Skill window.
You can register up to 10 skills to slots. You can turn the slots on and off or move the slots in the Edit UI menu.
 
The texture of the Reset Skills button has been changed.
Fixed the issue that froze the game momentarily while using Find NPC function.
After reaching Lv. 7 during the tutorial, the chat window will be displayed.
Depository for saving your game settings can be now accessed at the bottom of Settings.


Resolved Issues


Some areas along the Velia coast have been renamed to Velia Beach.
Fixed the issue where switching to Character Select screen after equipping Trina Matchlock made the character image look awkward.
Fixed the issue where you could not kick out a player that is offline if one of your party members is in Arena of Arsha.
The event items for making [Event] Roast Turkey Feast can now be sold to NPC shops.
Fixed the issue where you could not use the Guild Storage in Tooth Fairy Cabin.
Fixed the issue where certain spots in Grána were seen in underwater color scheme.
Fixed the issue where the “Apply Most Popular” function was not working properly in Beauty Salon.
Fixed the issue where it was impossible to ride horses at certain spots.
Fixed the issue where the Force PvP icon did not show next to the character during PvP mode.
Fixed the issue where the Margoria Phantom Ship sometimes shook awkwardly after appearing.
Fixed the issue that pressing Space Key would take Portrait pictures when Beauty Album was opened in Customization mode.


Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 29th November
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/ZU6JHLY.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,
Set sail! Epheria Frigate is finally here. Armed with cannons on a sturdy body strong enough to face gargantuan naval monsters, have an Epheria Frigate in your docks. In addition, Epheria Frigate Events will enhance your naval adventures. If you are not fit for sea, the Conqueror Mammore Event and Sweet Cookie O’ Mine Event will delight your adventures on foot! Bite into delicious chocolate cookies while hunting down a real grizzly and furry colossus.


Event & Systems

Event: 

Open Up the Sea Gate, Epheria Frigate Event and Guide have been added
1. Event #A: Gather [Event] Serbianca’s Vouchers

Period: 11/29 After Maintenance  ~ 12/20 Before Maintenance
You can obtain [Event] Serbianca’s Voucher (x1~x3) while Gathering all around the world of Black Desert.
Go to NPC Serbianca in Trent and exchange [Event] Serbianca’s Voucher x2 for Log x1.
You can exchange Logs from Serbianca until 12/27/2017 (09:00 UTC).

2. Event #B: Collect Knowledges of the World Underwater!

Period: 11/29 After Maintenance  ~ 12/13 Before Maintenance
What to do: Discover 5 of the 7 points of interest and gain their Knowledge to earn rewards
Event Prize: Design: Epheria Frigate x2 and Jade Coral Ingot x5
The rewards will be sent via in-game mail in a future maintenance.

3. Guide : Epheria Frigate
Learn how you can craft your own Epheria Frigate and check the materials you’ll need.
Click »Here« to see these events in detail and receive aid in crafting your own frigate!


Underwater Exploration Screenshot Event has been added.

Submission Date: November 29th - December 13th
Staff Pick: December 14th - 17th
Winner Announcement: December 18th
Click »Here« to see the screenshot event in detail. Snap!


Conqueror of Earth, Mammore Event has been added

Period: 11/29 After Maintenance ~ 12/06 Before Maintenance
Mammore will bite, scratch, howl and inflict heavy damage so make sure to read its attack pattern. When it hides into the ground however, it is invincible.
Mammore will spawn in random servers (min. 5 servers to max. 6 servers) and will disappear after 30 minutes since its appearance.
Mammore can only receive damage if attacked with a [Hunting] Matchlock so make sure to have one handy.
Click »here« to see this vehement event in detail.


Sweet Cookie O’ Mine Event has been added.

Period for Challenges (Y): 11/30 00:00 UTC ~ 12/13 Before Maintenance

Play 30 minutes every day and receive [Event] Cookie x5
Play 60 minutes every day and receive [Event] Marshmallow x1
Perform Imperial Cuisine with [Event] Cookie x5 + [Event] Marshmallow x1 to make [Event] Chocolate Cookie x1
Right-click to obtain random items by opening [Event] Chocolate Cookie

Period of Drop: 11/29 After Maintenance ~ 12/13 Before Maintenance

Fish/Gather/Defeat monsters during the event period to obtain [Event] Cookies and [Event] Marshmallows.
Click »Here« to see this delicious event in detail.


Attendance Reward (Refreshed)

Period: 11/29 00:00 ~ 1/3/2018 23:59 UTC
Log-in daily and receive your attendance rewards.

Let it Snow! Winter-themed Background

Period: 11/29 After Maintenance ~ 1/31 09:00 UTC
Winter has come to Black Desert Online. Enjoy the snow snow snow!.

System: 

If you use Escape while doing a quest that teleports you to certain places, you will be moved back to the quest starting point and be able to play other content.
Even if the area the character enters is not fully loaded, the character should now be able to move around within the loaded area.
Even when pets follow the character, they will pick-up loots as priority.
If the pet is too far away in distance in terms of height, it will teleport next to the character. For example if you jump off the cliff of Sausan Garrison, your pet will teleport next to you after you land.
You can no longer mute Video Guides
The color of the "pet behavior" icon has been swapped:
Green: Cautious mode, consume less stamina
Red: Agile, consume more stamina


Game World, NPC & Effects:

NPC: 

Fighting Centaurus NPCs have been added to Barhan Gateway.
Heidel General Goods Vendor Lara will sell Lanterns now.


Content: 

Mounts of non-participants can easily be destroyed (killed) by the guild mounts in siege servers during siege wars.
Adjusted the damage difference of summons dealing excessive damage than proportioned when attacking Hwacha, Flame Tower, Wooden Fence, Wooden Fence Gate, and Mounts.
Summoned attacks include Blade of Darkness of the Sorceress, Cartian's Protection (Black Spirit’s Rage 100%), Gorr, Tett/Marg of the Wizard/Witch, Flow: Arne’s skills, and Luscious Snare and Trap of Vedir of the Dark Knight besides the Heilang and Echo Spirit.

The durability of Wooden Fence and Wooden Fence Gate for siege war has been reduced by 20%.
Skill EXP boost buff has been added as a reward for [Combat Reward] Challenges.
This reward is not an option, but an additional effect accompanying the Combat EXP buff.
[Combat Reward] Faster and Stronger I
[Combat Reward] Faster and Stronger II
[Combat Reward] Faster and Stronger III
[Combat Reward] Faster and Stronger IV
[Combat Reward] Faster and Stronger V
[Combat Reward] Faster and Stronger VI


Mounts:

The Max HP of Tier 1-8 horses has been increased 200-300%, depending on the tier and type.
The Max HP of Dream Horses has been increased 300-400%, depending on the type.
The DP of a Dream Horse is 150% higher compared to that of its Tier 8 counterpart.
The DP of Diné has been in increased to 150% higher than that of Arduanatt.
The Cooldown of Earth of Life, Diné’s Inherent Skill, has been changed from 5 to 3 minutes.
The HP and MP(WP/SP) Recovery effects of Earth of Life, Diné’s Inherent Skill, have been increased.

https://i.imgur.com/dVO6Yry.png

The effect “All AP +10 for 30 sec.” has been added to Earth of Protection,  Diné’s Inherent Skill.
The Imperial Delivery and Horse Market prices of Tier 1-8 horses have been increased up to 50% depending on the tier, level, and skills.
The Imperial Delivery and Horse Market prices of Dream Horses have been increased up to 20% depending on the level and skills.
Tier and Gender filters on the Horse Market will be revealed with left alignment from now.
The Max HP Increase effect of the gears for horse and camel has been increased 300%.


Class Changes
All Classes 

Fixed the issue where sub-weapons appeared on the back of Berserker, Tamer, and Dark Knight if they equip the sub-weapons and fishing rods at the same time.


Berserker 

Information regarding HP Recovery not applied while mounted has been added to the skill Fearsome Tyrant.
Fixed the WP recovery discrepancy while using the skill Fearsome Tyrant.
Fixed the graphical glitch where the inner skin of the Iron Buster did not show with [Berserker] Tantu Iron Buster equipped.


Witch 

Ultimate: Blizzard can now be used while mounted.
Fixed the error in the number of hits in the description of Ultimate: Blizzard.
986% x 7 → 986% x 12, Max 3 hits

The effect duration of the skill Blizzard (mounted) has been reduced.
Forward-moving Awakening toggle motion has been changed.
Fixed the graphical glitch where the [Witch] Epheria Marine Dagger seems to be piercing through the hand.
Fixed the intermittent latency in activating awakening skills while moving forward after switching from staff to the awakening weapon.
When moving forward and switching from staff to Aad Sphera, the Witch will now switch to a combat stance of attacking to the front.


Wizard

Ultimate: Blizzard can now be used while mounted.
Fixed the error in the number of hits in the description of Ultimate: Blizzard.
986% x 7 → 986% x 12, Max 3 hits

The effect duration of the skill Blizzard (mounted) has been reduced.
Forward-moving Awakening toggle motion has been changed.
The damage range of the skill Flow: Fire Breath Marg which is auto-triggered after using Cataclysm has been adjusted to be the same as the damage range of Cataclysm.
Connecting to other skills from Aqua Jail Explosion has become quicker (about 0.2 second). This improves the difficulty in connecting to a combo.
Fixed the intermittent latency in activating awakening skills while moving forward after switching from staff to the awakening weapon.
When moving forward and switching from staff to Godr Sphera, the Wizard will now switch to a combat stance of attacking to the front.


Ninja 

Fixed the graphical glitch on Lemoria outfit for Ninja.


Dark Knight 

Fixed the graphical glitch on Lemoria outfit for Dark Knight.


Item Changes

Epheria Frigate has been newly added.
Epheria Frigate can be built at Port Epheria 3-5, a Tier 3 Shipyard.
Epheria Frigate accommodates 4 cannons making it more suitable for combat than Epheria Sailboat.
Design: Epheria Frigate has been added as an Optional reward for the quest [Daily] Falasi Family’s Kindness.
Daily quests that will enable you to obtain materials for the frigate has been added to Port Epheria.
After having finished the quest ‘[Daily] Falasi Family’s Kindness,’ strike a conversation with Philaberto Falasi with a character with Professional Lv. 5 or above in Fishing to accept the quest.
Equipment items for Epheria Frigate have been newly added.
Equipment items for Epheria Frigate can be purchased from Wharf Manager in the Wharf Shop.

Mysterious Seed can now be stacked in one slot in the Inventory.
If you have too many Mysterious Seeds in your Inventory, store them in a Storage first, then place them back into the Inventory to find them stacked.
However, mysterious crop seeds and hyphas will not stack.

Information regarding Energy consumption for using Guild Promotion function has been added to the following items.
Silver Mane Horse Crown
Blue Lion Crown
Golden Eagle Crown
Asula’s Crown
Crown of Aal

All equipment items will show extra damage effect in the description now.
Fixed the issue where Green-grade and Blue-grade Awakening Weapons did not deal the effect of Extra Damage against species.
The effect of Extra Damage against species have been increased and higher damage will be applied.
Gathering the following resources with a Hoe or bare hands will yield various kinds of items.
Bush
Thicket
Shrub
Wild Herb
 
The icon for Capotia Belt has been changed.

For Dandelion Weapons +6 and above in Enhancement, the effect of ‘Extra Damage against Humans’ has been added.
Depending on Enhancement Level, ‘Extra Damage against Humans’ effect will vary from +1 to +5.

[Event] Clear Liquid Reagent Crate will not show up under Imperial Delivery list anymore.
 
A New Fishing Rod has been added.
Terrmian Fishing Rod: Your chance of catching rare or large fish will be greatly increased. Cannot be Repaired.

[Pearl Shop]

New Pearl Shop items have been released. Click »Here« to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement.


Monster Changes

Some monsters on top of the fort of Sausan Garrison have been rearranged.
Safety Zone will be more accessible.

The Margoria Phantom Ship’s Durability has been decreased to be 95% of the previous Durability.
The Margoria Phantom Ship will not summon the Spectre of Margoria anymore.


Quest & Knowledge

The prerequisite for Xerxes’s delivery quests in Sand Grain Bazaar has been modified.
If you are in the middle of the quest A Special Request, you can accept all 4 delivery quests from Xerxes.

A new quest to obtain “Kamasylve Pot,” a decoration item, has been added to Kamasylvia.
Any Lv. 58 (or up) character that has completed the quest Heart of Kamasylve can start the quest by summoning Black Spirit.

The conditions for completing the quest The Best Hide has been enhanced. Now you need to obtain the knowledge Shaking: Skilled and then craft a Supreme Soft Hide.
The summary of the quest Fisher’s Pride has been clarified to let you know that you can only use Stumpy Bullhead you caught on your own.
Upon talking to Edana's Slate, a button that teleports you back to the Ancient Stone Chamber will appear if you are in the middle of the quest “There and Back Again..”, OR have completed the quest “There and Back Again..” without completing the quest “Great Legacy.”
NPC-escorting quests are temporarily suspended for improvement.
Rewards for some life quests have been modified.
You can now obtain Improved gathering tools as a reward.
Some quests will give you Energy Recovery Boost as a reward.

Knowledge card has been added for NPC Baman at Nada Island.
Wild Spirit Stone has been added as a reward for the quest Dark Chaser.
Fluffy Milk Bread has been added as a reward for some Mediah and Valencia main quests.
It does not give you a buff, but it gives you Health EXP.

The quest summary of Wake-Up Juice(?) quest has been clarified.   * Hints for completing the quest have been added.
The quest summary Cokro Chamber quest has been clarified. * Information regarding the location of Valencia Castle has been added.
New quests have been added.
Velia Fisherman's Secret: The quest acceptance condition is either completion of the quest “[Co-op] Witch-Hunting” or being at least Lv.53.
Daughters of the Great Alchemist: Serial Quest
Abelin’s Secret Fishing: Serial Quest
Complete the quest chain above, and you will receive a “Terrmian Fishing Rod” as a Reward.


Interface Changes

UI: 

The tooltip “All Quests” has been added to the first button of Black Spirit’s quest filters.
If an item supports Choosing Enhancement Type, it should work properly now.
Fixed the issue where line space of certain item descriptions was bigger than usual.
Now Space will not work as a shutter for Portraits if Beauty Album or file explorer is open in the Beauty screen (F4).
Fixed the issue that prompted the message “Guild does not exist” to players without guilds after loading.
Fixed the issue where the Imperial Delivery icon did not appear in Trade Item purchase screen.
Texts Incentive, Deposit, and Collect Money on the bottom of Guild Member Status Window will now be abbreviated and the tooltip will show the actual words.
Skill Window will stretch according to fit the text length.
The 3 buttons of New Story window has been augmented in size.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue with party elixirs where the priority order wasn’t correctly applied when taking multiple elixirs. However, party elixirs do not apply to the caster.
Fixed the issue where clicking on armor parts with the Awakening weapon on in the Dye screen did not hide the Awakening weapon. The character pose should stay the same as you set. (combat and standby)
It is now possible to navigate toward Chenana at Rock Post.
Blood has been removed from ship cannon’s hit effects.
Fixed the issue where dying during Conversation did not display the proper screen.
Fixed the button icons for Collect Money, Deposit, and Welfare in the Guild window.
Fixed the issue where the condition of Sending Gifts (Lv. 56 → Lv. 50) was not properly applied for the Black Friday Sale. This lowering of level will return to normal when the sale concludes.


Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes

Texts Incentive, Deposit, and Collect Money on the bottom of Guild Member Status Window will now be abbreviated and the tooltip will show the actual words.
Skill Window will stretch according to fit the text length.
The 3 buttons of New Story window has been augmented in size.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue with party elixirs where the priority order wasn’t correctly applied when taking multiple elixirs. However, party elixirs do not apply to the caster.
Fixed the issue where clicking on armor parts with the Awakening weapon on in the Dye screen did not hide the Awakening weapon. The character pose should stay the same as you set. (combat and standby)
It is now possible to navigate toward Chenana at Rock Post.
Blood has been removed from ship cannon’s hit effects.
Fixed the issue where dying during Conversation did not display the proper screen.
Fixed the button icons for Collect Money, Deposit, and Welfare in the Guild window.
Fixed the issue where the condition of Sending Gifts (Lv. 56 → Lv. 50) was not properly applied for the Black Friday Sale. This lowering of level will return to normal when the sale concludes.


Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes

notes.title: Server Issue Resolution and Compensation
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers!

 First off, we would like to apologize to all adventurers who experienced difficulties playing Black Desert Online because of the disconnect issues.
 
 We used all means and methods to find the cause of the recent server problem. However, it was not easy identifying the issue since it was only occurring in the NA and SA servers. Whilst we thought it was an external issue, we kept an open mind to all possibilities as we searched for a solution. We found and fixed all suspicious areas, but the problem was not completely fixed until the issues with the ISP was resolved.
 
 All in all, we are truly sorry it took such a long time to resolve the problem. In the future, we will make sure to communicate openly regarding these types of problems.
 
 In addition, as a form of apology, we will be giving the following compensation, along with a 2 week-long 24-hour hot-time event. This includes compensation for the in-game losses (crystals, etc.) suffered during this period.
 

[NA]

Value Pack (7 Days) x2
Blessing of Kamasylve (7 Days) x1
Life EXP +10% Scroll x7
Kydict’s Crystal – Adventure x1
EXP Boost Event (24 hrs) (for 2 weeks) - Combat EXP +50%, Skill EXP +20%
Extra Mount EXP +10% event will be extended one more week.


Although the issues were predominantly experienced by NA players, we haven’t forgotten the EU side either. So, we’ll be providing all EU players with: 

[EU]

Blessing of Kamasylve (7 Days) x1
EXP Boost Event (24 hrs) (for 2 weeks) - Combat EXP +50%, Skill EXP +20%
Extra Mount EXP +10% event will be extended one more week.


Words are not enough to make up for your frustration, but please accept this small token of apology that we wish to give to all adventurers who trusted us and played through this difficult environment. We promise that we will do everything in our power to swiftly resolve any future server issues.
 

Improved Communications
 
Your feedback has been pivotal to bringing Black Desert Online to where it stands now. Black Desert Online matures with every weekly update which is based on this feedback. However, there would be times when miscommunication or misjudgment in the development process caused disappointment for users with some of the updates. We will work further to reach you with better communication.
 
1. 	Developers will discuss with GMs and CMs on how to better communicate with the
community. 
Our desire is to deliver improvements as soon as possible and we wish to maintain this by developing updates every week. Information regarding current issues on the live server and our future plans will be shared through more efficient communication. We will not be able to disclose everything, but we will further strengthen the partnership between Pearl Abyss, Kakao Games and the community, to help alleviate your discontent as much as possible.
 
2. 	We will try and fix the bugs as swiftly as possible.
We would like to apologize for the fact that small and big bugs are being built up for which we are truly sorry for. Our development team has been concentrating on optimization and during this process, many bugs have occurred as a side-effect. We are aware that our response to these bugs may be unsatisfactory. So, for a while, we are going to put all our efforts into fixing these bugs. We will also review and improve the overall process to ensure that the bugs, no matter how trivial they may be, are fixed on a regular basis.
 
3. 	We will enlarge our window of communication.
We believe that communication with the users has to be the main foundation in order for us to keep our current stance. So, we will strive to work together to provide more open communication routes. 
One of the basic things we have to do as a developer of a MMORPG is creating new areas and classes. We cannot be stagnant. We have to continue to move forward and do our best to meet the expectations of a diverse group of people. The game is not designed around predatory monetization but creating content that is engaging for our players and also commercially viable.
      	

And Finally,
 
We are opening the 5th slot for Pet for this update. Also, as we previously announced, we are working to reveal the hidden details of items. As part of our ongoing effort, evasion and damage reduction information will be displayed in the item descriptions. 

We are listening; we are keeping our eyes on all of our player’s comments. We are well aware that we are not perfect and believe that the feedback and interest of all users are critical to improving the game. With that said, we are also preparing answers to all other issues our players have pointed out and we plan on issuing a Developer’s Letter on a regular basis to better communicate with our NA/EU users. We will match the passion you show in both your compliments and criticisms, with our dedication to develop a better and more enjoyable, Black Desert Online. 

Pearl Abyss and Kakao Games team.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 22nd November
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/2gJO1Eh.jpg

On this Thanksgiving week, we truly want to show our thankfulness and offer you attractive events and amazing sales. 
Black Friday Deals hit the Pearl Shop this week. Enjoy discounts like never before and don’t miss your chance to save on this big and bold sale! 10 Pearls can get you far!
We do have 2 turkey-related events starting with today's patch. Return of King Targargo might leave players in fear but if you take Targargo down, luscious loot is waiting. Turkey on the Table will add a pumpkin spice kick to your experience but there is more! Even Patrigio will hold a sale on his Secret Shop!
The addition of Mysterious Seeds enriching your farming experience and last but not least, the long-awaited 5th Pet Slot will enter BDO! We hope you enjoy the rich week of giving thanks.

Event & Systems

Event: 

BLACK FRIDAY SALE. 
Prices are fall~ing as we move to late autumn. Enjoy the biggest sale of the year yet!
Period: November 22nd (after maintenance) ~ December 4th 08:59AM (UTC)
	
1. PEARLfect DEALS
Miraculous deals offering popular items like Elion’s Tear, Bleach, Mount Skill Change Coupon, Unknown Dye Box, Artisan’s Memory, Pet Appearance Change Coupon at only 10 PEARLS!

2. WEEKLONG DEALS
All your needs will surely be satisfied. Enjoy up to 40% discount on your favorites at the Pearl Shop. Come knocking the Pearl Shop doors to check out the shelves under Function, Outfit, Mounts, Pets, and so much more!

3. CLOSEOUT DEALS
Bolyn? Karin? Acher Guard? It’s time to say good bye. Take 30% off on last-chance-to-buy items that will long be gone in history after this sale. Don’t miss you chance on this exclusive and ‘last’ offer!

Click »here« to see in detail what you can SAVE BIG on!


King Targargo has returned
Period: November 22nd (after maintenance) ~ November 29th (before maintenance) 
Click »here« to check out this plump event in detail.


Turkey on the Table event has started
Period: November 22th (after maintenance) ~ November 29th (before maintenance) 
During this period, obtain the event items through killing monsters, Fishing, and Gathering.
Combine (align) the items [Event] Turkey Meat, [Event] Cranberry Sauce, [Event] Mashed Potato in chronological order into the shape of a ‘ㅡ’ to obtain [Event] Roast Turkey Feast.
You can obtain one random reward item by opening [Event] Roast Turkey Feast.
Click  »here« to check out this festive event in detail.


Patrigio’s Discreet Discount has started
Period: November 22th (after maintenance) ~ December 6th (before maintenance)
During the event, only 25 (compared to previous 50) energy will be consumed when accessing Patrigio’s Secret Shop.
Click »here« to check out this discreet event in detail.


5th Pet Slot Addition.
We are happy to announce the addition of the 5th pet slot. Now, enjoy quintuple the fun!


System: 

Arena of Arsha rules have been changed.
HP Recovery will be reduced for the participants as match time progress in Arena of Arsha.
When 1/3 of match time progresses, max HP Recovery allowed will be 80% and HP Potion and HP Recovery skills will heal only up to this amount. If current HP is above 80% of max HP,  the exceeding amount of HP will be cut to make your current HP at 80%.
When 2/3 of match time progresses, max HP Recovery allowed will be 50% and HP Potion and HP Recovery skills will heal only up to this amount. If current HP is above 50% of max HP,  the exceeding amount of HP will be cut to make your current HP at 50%.



Game World, NPC & Effects:

Content: 

You cannot put materials from your Inventory into the Processing window anymore when your Inventory is full. 
Rewards for delivering Clear Liquid Reagent box has been enhanced.
Fixed the issue where filling in 5 material slots in the Processing window and removing one of the items from the slot did not work correctly.
Fixed the issue where it was not possible to install a new object where Flame Tower and Hwacha were destroyed in Savage Rift.
Description on the icon that appears when weight limit is exceeded will now be more intuitive and specific.


NPC: 

Fixed the issue where interacting with a certain villager NPC in Velia showed the inside of the Goblin.


Class Changes
All Classes 

Sorceress, Valkyrie, Kunoichi, Ninja, Wizard, and Witch can now keep auto-running even if it is interrupted by a jump.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Lemoria outfit for Berserker, Musa, Striker, Warrior, and Wizard.


Warrior 

Fixed the placement of [Warrior] Teary Ear Cuff.
Fixed the graphical glitch on [Warrior] Cavaro Outfit that happened when the Warrior turned its head.


Ranger 

Fixed the issue where Blasting Gust could not be used successively.


Berserker 

Fixed the graphical glitch of Berserker’s body looking to be transparent with Da-Dum Da-Dum Diving Suit on.
Fixed the graphical issue in [Berserker] Noel Hat.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Berserker’s Scarecrow Mask that happens with certain character customizations.


Tamer 

Information regarding HP/MP recovery has been added to the descriptions of Tamer main weapon skills.


Valkyrie

Super Armor has been added to the description of Celestial Spear.
Fixed the SP recovery amount discrepancy of the skill Righteous Charge.
Using the skill Sword of Judgment while mounted will consume SP only on the first hit.
An additional line “Effects nullified while mounted” has been added to the skill Ultimate: Sharp Light.
SP recovery of the skill Flurry of Kicks has been changed from ‘on 1st hit only to on all good hits.’
“Pushes the target on good hits” has been added to the description of the skill Counter.
The SP recovery amount specified in the descriptions of skills Flying Kick and Flow: Double Flying Kick has been changed to “SP Recovery per every good hit.”
“Pushes the target on good hits” has been added to the description of the skill Flying Kick  and FLow: Double Flying Kick.


Witch

The attack type of the skill Voltaic Pulse has been changed.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Witch’s eye with Ghost Bride outfit when it is worn with a certain character customization.


Wizard

The attack type of the skill Cataclysm has been changed.


Ninja 

Carrying more than 125% of the Weight Limit will block the use of the skill Ghost Step.
Using the skill Drastic Measure after Murderous Intent while Black Spirit’s Rage gauge is 100% will now correctly activate the Black Spirit skill.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Ninja’s Shudad outfit.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Ninja’s Petroglyph outfit.


Kunoichi 

Carrying more than 125% of the Weight Limit will block the use of the skill Ghost Step.
Fixed the issue where using skills Lunatic Discus, Delighted Blast, and Danse Macabre caused Stamina consumption.


Striker 

Fixed the issue where using Ultimate Crush IV after Fallout then leaving the character alone would cause the character to limitlessly perform the 3rd hit of Ultimate Crush.



Item Changes

A new item ‘Mysterious Seed’ has been added.

It can be obtained by Yielding special crop, Plant Breeding, Pruning, or Killing Insects.
Use Shaking(L) to combine Mysterious Seed with Special Seeds or Special Hyphas to create a new mysterious seed which you can plant on a Garden.
When Producing the fully-grown mysterious seeds, the fruit according to the type of the mysterious seed can be obtained. And upon Harvesting, a larger quantity of crops can be obtained.

Evasion and Damage Reduction information will be displayed. However, set effect and other additional effects will not be displayed.

Other hidden stats are scheduled to be added into item descriptions in the following updates in the future.

The miscellaneous monster drop items you obtain from Balenos from Mediah have been made lighter. (Now 0.10LT)
* This does not include Cox Pirates, Sausan Garrison, and Shultz Guard.

The Crystal Covered in Black Ash that can be obtained from Abandoned Iron Mine can now be sold to Shops.
Max HP increase effect has been added to the following Lord costumes:

Silver Mane's Armor
Blue Lion's Armor
Golden Eagle's Armor
Asula's Armor
Armor of Aal

Fixed the issue where coupons received from Challenges (Y) couldn’t be used right after.

[Pearl Shop]
Certain coupons can be used even for multiple-item transactions.
For example, if you have a coupon that gives you 100 Pearls off for the purchase of 500 Pearls or more, you can use it for buying 5 100-Pearl items.

The effect of putting an item into the shopping cart has been modified.
The ‘Close’ button at the bottom of the Cart tab in Pearl Shop has been deleted. 

New Pearl Shop items have been released. Click  to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement.


Monster Changes

The destruction of Manshaum Narc’s Spear will now look more natural.
Argos Artifact Repository at Crescent Shrine has been pushed towards the wall.
The HP of Argos Artifact Repository has been increased.

The blood effect you get from being hit by Fox, Wolf, and Lion-type monsters became more natural.
Additional monsters have been placed around the entrance of Hasrah Ancient Ruins.
The attack range of Kukuri, Balten, and Kamol from Hasrah Ancient Ruins has been reduced.
The movement speed of Kukuri, Balten, and Kamol from Hasrah Ancient Ruins has been increased.
The number of monsters in the underground mine area of Helms Post has been greatly increased. 
Additional monsters have been placed in Crescent Shrine.
Quint and Muraka will now spawn in 14 ~ 18 servers.


Quest & Knowledge

The Black Spirit quest “Suppress the Sausans” will now appear to Lv. 55 and above.
The “Disappeared Basteer” button will not appear in dialogues with Black Spirit if the character is Lv. 50 or up.
A green-grade Magic Crystal for Weapon has been added as an optional reward for the quest series Better Weapon.
Fixed the issue where you could not watch certain story cut scenes again after completing certain quests.
Prerequisites for discovering Luke have been removed.
The quests [Combat Promotion] Uncomfortable Sea Otter and [Combat Promotion] Mediah Trio can now be received after finishing a character Awakening.
If you have enough Amity points with Lonamin, the button for obtaining knowledge “How to Meet Yianaros” will now appear regardless of the quest status.
Fixed the issue where Horio Tinya at Abandoned Iron Mine would sometimes disappear.
Prerequisites for some Mediah quests have been modified so that you can receive them with more ease.
Now Main Quests of Mediah region must be completed in order to accept the following quests:

Good Party Tonic
Kusha Pioneer
A Person Who Always Leaves Food
An Odd Barbarian Painting
Forge War
Harder with Platinum
Refugee Camp Request
Desire for Better Weapons
Anomie
Works of the Extraction Mill
A Deer in Love
The Missing Wagon
The Mane Problem
It's About Time...
This is Urgent
Awkward Request
[Repeat] Useful Junk
[Repeat] Disgusting Guys
[Repeat] Already Dead
The Awakened Ancient Ruins, The Expedition Without Any News
Theater Troupes of Mediah, Conch Shell #1

Amity points with Neruda Shen has been added as a reward for the quest Leader of Altinova.
Fixed the issue where Advice of Valks quest could not be accepted upon completion of the quest ‘The Dark Bautt Lithograph’
Fixed the issue where checking NPC location by right-clicking Huge Spear would not point at NPC Ronatz.
Fixed the navigation for the quest Man-Hunting Trolls so that it is easier to spot Troll Shamans.
Fixed the issue where using navigation for the quest Karanda Ridge I would lead you to Sand Grain Bazaar.
Narc Brishka will no longer use the DP-raising skill during the quest [Solo] Narc Magic Sealing Stone.
The quest area of [Solo] Narc Magic Sealing Stone has been partially changed.
The amount of EXP you get from the quest [Solo] Narc Magic Sealing Stone has been increased.
The amount of Peridot Petals you get from Narc Spell Sealing Stone Reward Bundle has been increased.
Now there is a chance of getting Forest Fury from Narc Spell Sealing Stone Reward Bundle.
The chance of getting Narc Ear Accessory from Narc Spell Sealing Stone Reward Bundle has been slightly increased.
The chance of getting Water Spirit Stone Fragment from Narc Spell Sealing Stone Reward Bundle has been increased. 
Quest filter has been added to the “Quest” interface of NPCs.
All main quests now have the Black Spirit icon.
The following quests will no longer be available. The NPCs specific to those quests (pickpocket, thug, etc) will no longer appear.

Sweet Revenge
Hide-and-Seek
Market Trouble
Protect the Customers

The number of Helm Destroyer’s Seals you get from the quest [Repeat] Helm Destroyer! has been increased to 6.  
The number of Corruption’s Seal you get from the quest [Repeat] Destroy Spell! has been increased to 7. 
100,000 Silver has been added as a reward for the quest Lake Keeper Tatar.
Quests have been added to NPCs Dichzy Borne (Lema Island) and Philaberto Falasi (Port Epheria) where you can obtain Professional Boatman and Professional Sailor, respectively.
* Your sailing level must be Professional 1 or up, and the Amity point with these NPCs must be 1000 or higher.



Interface Changes

The location of Quest details window has been slightly adjusted.
The “R” key indicator in quest dialogues has been changed. * The R indicator will appear inside the button on the right side.
Fixed the issue where the scroll bar length of the Friend window was abnormal.
You can now dye all parts at once from the Dye (J) screen.
Helpful information has been added to the bottom of the Marketplace window accessible from the ESC menu.
Purchasing Marketplace Maids became easier from the Marketplace window accessible from the ESC menu.
A system message will be shown to let you know that your EXP has been decreased when you die (If applicable). A line has been added to let you know that some of the EXP will be restored if you use a revive item.
Fixed the issue where the icons for Guild Quartermaster and Member were swapped.
The navigation route for main quests will appear in Yellow in the World Map.
Fixed the issue where the Worker recovery item window were blocking the Worker’s Stamina gauge while trying to recover a single worker’s Stamina.
Information regarding restoring lost EXP has been added to the revive item purchase screen.
Accuracy, Evasion, and Damage Reduction values will be displayed on the mouse-over tooltip of AP, DP, and Awakening AP in the Equipment window.
Fixed the issue where you could not rotate the camera if you go into the Installation mode while chat input field is on.
Fixed the issue where the System Message for newly gained Knowledge did not work properly in the World Map screen.
Icon for Shudad Kunai has been revised.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where the effect of the title Stormtrooper did not work after you revive.
Fixed the issue where the Minimap would disappear in the Great Ocean and the Great Desert.
If a character dies in certain areas of Valencia or a Node or Conquest War begins, the character will be moved to the nearest town.
Fixed the issue where the characters riding Elephants and Siege Towers (Medium and Large) were taking damage in the Conquest War.
Fixed the issue where the statues up on the pillars regarding the quest The Valkyrie Legend disappeared.
Fixed the issue where installed mounts in Savage Rift could be destroyed if characters not affiliated with guilds ride them.
Fixed the issue where video guides were not being displayed.
Fixed the issue where the character would hold a packaged Imperial Cuisine item if it performs a certain action while packing is in progress.
Fixed the issue in applying customization from the Beauty Album in Character Creation.


Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes
