During the event, only 25 (compared to previous 50) energy will be consumed when accessing Patrigio’s Secret Shop.
Click »here« to check out this discreet event in detail.


5th Pet Slot Addition.
We are happy to announce the addition of the 5th pet slot. Now, enjoy quintuple the fun!


System: 

Arena of Arsha rules have been changed.
HP Recovery will be reduced for the participants as match time progress in Arena of Arsha.
When 1/3 of match time progresses, max HP Recovery allowed will be 80% and HP Potion and HP Recovery skills will heal only up to this amount. If current HP is above 80% of max HP,  the exceeding amount of HP will be cut to make your current HP at 80%.
When 2/3 of match time progresses, max HP Recovery allowed will be 50% and HP Potion and HP Recovery skills will heal only up to this amount. If current HP is above 50% of max HP,  the exceeding amount of HP will be cut to make your current HP at 50%.



Game World, NPC & Effects:

Content: 

You cannot put materials from your Inventory into the Processing window anymore when your Inventory is full. 
Rewards for delivering Clear Liquid Reagent box has been enhanced.
Fixed the issue where filling in 5 material slots in the Processing window and removing one of the items from the slot did not work correctly.
Fixed the issue where it was not possible to install a new object where Flame Tower and Hwacha were destroyed in Savage Rift.
Description on the icon that appears when weight limit is exceeded will now be more intuitive and specific.


NPC: 

Fixed the issue where interacting with a certain villager NPC in Velia showed the inside of the Goblin.


Class Changes
All Classes 

Sorceress, Valkyrie, Kunoichi, Ninja, Wizard, and Witch can now keep auto-running even if it is interrupted by a jump.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Lemoria outfit for Berserker, Musa, Striker, Warrior, and Wizard.


Warrior 

Fixed the placement of [Warrior] Teary Ear Cuff.
Fixed the graphical glitch on [Warrior] Cavaro Outfit that happened when the Warrior turned its head.


Ranger 

Fixed the issue where Blasting Gust could not be used successively.


Berserker 

Fixed the graphical glitch of Berserker’s body looking to be transparent with Da-Dum Da-Dum Diving Suit on.
Fixed the graphical issue in [Berserker] Noel Hat.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Berserker’s Scarecrow Mask that happens with certain character customizations.


Tamer 

Information regarding HP/MP recovery has been added to the descriptions of Tamer main weapon skills.


Valkyrie

Super Armor has been added to the description of Celestial Spear.
Fixed the SP recovery amount discrepancy of the skill Righteous Charge.
Using the skill Sword of Judgment while mounted will consume SP only on the first hit.
An additional line “Effects nullified while mounted” has been added to the skill Ultimate: Sharp Light.
SP recovery of the skill Flurry of Kicks has been changed from ‘on 1st hit only to on all good hits.’
“Pushes the target on good hits” has been added to the description of the skill Counter.
The SP recovery amount specified in the descriptions of skills Flying Kick and Flow: Double Flying Kick has been changed to “SP Recovery per every good hit.”
“Pushes the target on good hits” has been added to the description of the skill Flying Kick  and FLow: Double Flying Kick.


Witch

The attack type of the skill Voltaic Pulse has been changed.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Witch’s eye with Ghost Bride outfit when it is worn with a certain character customization.


Wizard

The attack type of the skill Cataclysm has been changed.


Ninja 

Carrying more than 125% of the Weight Limit will block the use of the skill Ghost Step.
Using the skill Drastic Measure after Murderous Intent while Black Spirit’s Rage gauge is 100% will now correctly activate the Black Spirit skill.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Ninja’s Shudad outfit.
Fixed the graphical glitch on Ninja’s Petroglyph outfit.


Kunoichi 

Carrying more than 125% of the Weight Limit will block the use of the skill Ghost Step.
Fixed the issue where using skills Lunatic Discus, Delighted Blast, and Danse Macabre caused Stamina consumption.


Striker 

Fixed the issue where using Ultimate Crush IV after Fallout then leaving the character alone would cause the character to limitlessly perform the 3rd hit of Ultimate Crush.



Item Changes

A new item ‘Mysterious Seed’ has been added.

It can be obtained by Yielding special crop, Plant Breeding, Pruning, or Killing Insects.
Use Shaking(L) to combine Mysterious Seed with Special Seeds or Special Hyphas to create a new mysterious seed which you can plant on a Garden.
When Producing the fully-grown mysterious seeds, the fruit according to the type of the mysterious seed can be obtained. And upon Harvesting, a larger quantity of crops can be obtained.

Evasion and Damage Reduction information will be displayed. However, set effect and other additional effects will not be displayed.

Other hidden stats are scheduled to be added into item descriptions in the following updates in the future.

The miscellaneous monster drop items you obtain from Balenos from Mediah have been made lighter. (Now 0.10LT)
* This does not include Cox Pirates, Sausan Garrison, and Shultz Guard.

The Crystal Covered in Black Ash that can be obtained from Abandoned Iron Mine can now be sold to Shops.
Max HP increase effect has been added to the following Lord costumes:

Silver Mane's Armor
Blue Lion's Armor
Golden Eagle's Armor
Asula's Armor
Armor of Aal

Fixed the issue where coupons received from Challenges (Y) couldn’t be used right after.

[Pearl Shop]
Certain coupons can be used even for multiple-item transactions.
For example, if you have a coupon that gives you 100 Pearls off for the purchase of 500 Pearls or more, you can use it for buying 5 100-Pearl items.

The effect of putting an item into the shopping cart has been modified.
The ‘Close’ button at the bottom of the Cart tab in Pearl Shop has been deleted. 

New Pearl Shop items have been released. Click  to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement.


Monster Changes

The destruction of Manshaum Narc’s Spear will now look more natural.
Argos Artifact Repository at Crescent Shrine has been pushed towards the wall.
The HP of Argos Artifact Repository has been increased.

The blood effect you get from being hit by Fox, Wolf, and Lion-type monsters became more natural.
Additional monsters have been placed around the entrance of Hasrah Ancient Ruins.
The attack range of Kukuri, Balten, and Kamol from Hasrah Ancient Ruins has been reduced.
The movement speed of Kukuri, Balten, and Kamol from Hasrah Ancient Ruins has been increased.
The number of monsters in the underground mine area of Helms Post has been greatly increased. 
Additional monsters have been placed in Crescent Shrine.
Quint and Muraka will now spawn in 14 ~ 18 servers.


Quest & Knowledge

The Black Spirit quest “Suppress the Sausans” will now appear to Lv. 55 and above.
The “Disappeared Basteer” button will not appear in dialogues with Black Spirit if the character is Lv. 50 or up.
A green-grade Magic Crystal for Weapon has been added as an optional reward for the quest series Better Weapon.
Fixed the issue where you could not watch certain story cut scenes again after completing certain quests.
Prerequisites for discovering Luke have been removed.
The quests [Combat Promotion] Uncomfortable Sea Otter and [Combat Promotion] Mediah Trio can now be received after finishing a character Awakening.
If you have enough Amity points with Lonamin, the button for obtaining knowledge “How to Meet Yianaros” will now appear regardless of the quest status.
Fixed the issue where Horio Tinya at Abandoned Iron Mine would sometimes disappear.
Prerequisites for some Mediah quests have been modified so that you can receive them with more ease.
Now Main Quests of Mediah region must be completed in order to accept the following quests:

Good Party Tonic
Kusha Pioneer
A Person Who Always Leaves Food
An Odd Barbarian Painting
Forge War
Harder with Platinum
Refugee Camp Request
Desire for Better Weapons
Anomie
Works of the Extraction Mill
A Deer in Love
The Missing Wagon
The Mane Problem
It's About Time...
This is Urgent
Awkward Request
[Repeat] Useful Junk
[Repeat] Disgusting Guys
[Repeat] Already Dead
The Awakened Ancient Ruins, The Expedition Without Any News
Theater Troupes of Mediah, Conch Shell #1

Amity points with Neruda Shen has been added as a reward for the quest Leader of Altinova.
Fixed the issue where Advice of Valks quest could not be accepted upon completion of the quest ‘The Dark Bautt Lithograph’
Fixed the issue where checking NPC location by right-clicking Huge Spear would not point at NPC Ronatz.
Fixed the navigation for the quest Man-Hunting Trolls so that it is easier to spot Troll Shamans.
Fixed the issue where using navigation for the quest Karanda Ridge I would lead you to Sand Grain Bazaar.
Narc Brishka will no longer use the DP-raising skill during the quest [Solo] Narc Magic Sealing Stone.
The quest area of [Solo] Narc Magic Sealing Stone has been partially changed.
The amount of EXP you get from the quest [Solo] Narc Magic Sealing Stone has been increased.
The amount of Peridot Petals you get from Narc Spell Sealing Stone Reward Bundle has been increased.
Now there is a chance of getting Forest Fury from Narc Spell Sealing Stone Reward Bundle.
The chance of getting Narc Ear Accessory from Narc Spell Sealing Stone Reward Bundle has been slightly increased.
The chance of getting Water Spirit Stone Fragment from Narc Spell Sealing Stone Reward Bundle has been increased. 
Quest filter has been added to the “Quest” interface of NPCs.
All main quests now have the Black Spirit icon.
The following quests will no longer be available. The NPCs specific to those quests (pickpocket, thug, etc) will no longer appear.

Sweet Revenge
Hide-and-Seek
Market Trouble
Protect the Customers

The number of Helm Destroyer’s Seals you get from the quest [Repeat] Helm Destroyer! has been increased to 6.  
The number of Corruption’s Seal you get from the quest [Repeat] Destroy Spell! has been increased to 7. 
100,000 Silver has been added as a reward for the quest Lake Keeper Tatar.
Quests have been added to NPCs Dichzy Borne (Lema Island) and Philaberto Falasi (Port Epheria) where you can obtain Professional Boatman and Professional Sailor, respectively.
* Your sailing level must be Professional 1 or up, and the Amity point with these NPCs must be 1000 or higher.



Interface Changes

The location of Quest details window has been slightly adjusted.
The “R” key indicator in quest dialogues has been changed. * The R indicator will appear inside the button on the right side.
Fixed the issue where the scroll bar length of the Friend window was abnormal.
You can now dye all parts at once from the Dye (J) screen.
Helpful information has been added to the bottom of the Marketplace window accessible from the ESC menu.
Purchasing Marketplace Maids became easier from the Marketplace window accessible from the ESC menu.
A system message will be shown to let you know that your EXP has been decreased when you die (If applicable). A line has been added to let you know that some of the EXP will be restored if you use a revive item.
Fixed the issue where the icons for Guild Quartermaster and Member were swapped.
The navigation route for main quests will appear in Yellow in the World Map.
Fixed the issue where the Worker recovery item window were blocking the Worker’s Stamina gauge while trying to recover a single worker’s Stamina.
Information regarding restoring lost EXP has been added to the revive item purchase screen.
Accuracy, Evasion, and Damage Reduction values will be displayed on the mouse-over tooltip of AP, DP, and Awakening AP in the Equipment window.
Fixed the issue where you could not rotate the camera if you go into the Installation mode while chat input field is on.
Fixed the issue where the System Message for newly gained Knowledge did not work properly in the World Map screen.
Icon for Shudad Kunai has been revised.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where the effect of the title Stormtrooper did not work after you revive.
Fixed the issue where the Minimap would disappear in the Great Ocean and the Great Desert.
If a character dies in certain areas of Valencia or a Node or Conquest War begins, the character will be moved to the nearest town.
Fixed the issue where the characters riding Elephants and Siege Towers (Medium and Large) were taking damage in the Conquest War.
Fixed the issue where the statues up on the pillars regarding the quest The Valkyrie Legend disappeared.
Fixed the issue where installed mounts in Savage Rift could be destroyed if characters not affiliated with guilds ride them.
Fixed the issue where video guides were not being displayed.
Fixed the issue where the character would hold a packaged Imperial Cuisine item if it performs a certain action while packing is in progress.
Fixed the issue in applying customization from the Beauty Album in Character Creation.


Reach us on the »forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes

notes.title: Patch Notes - 15th November
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/1FvG64O.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,
The next dream horse Diné will breeze its way into Kamasylvia Part 2, the Healing Light. Feast your eyes on Grána City, the glorious capital of Kamasylvia filled with new, aesthetic residences and bustling lifeforms. Venture out in the vast, open fields and dense forests like Polly Forest and Gyfin Rhasia Temple where facing off against mystical yet fierce foes will prove to be a challenge. Kamasylvia Part 2 will be filled with immersive quests, areas, and newly added challenging monsters to enhance your PvE experience to the fullest. Kamasylvian Alchemist 2 event will get you scavenging out vast steppes and forests again and also, please welcome back the familiar events like Black Spirit Adventure and Mount EXP bonus event. Go out there, explore the fairy tales, and have a shot at looting high-grade items like the Lemoria gears!

Event & Systems

Event: 

The event Kamasylvian Alchemists 2 has been added.

Period: November 15th (after maintenance) - December 13th (before maintenance)
You can obtain [Event] Steppe Seal and [Event] Meadow Trail all over the world through monsters, fishing, and gathering.
In addition, you can obtain event items for simply playing the game.
From November 16th (00:00) - December 13th (before maintenance), Claim 3 [Event] Steppe Seals every hour by checking the Challenges tab (Y). Maximum of 18 can be received per day.
From November 16th (00:00) - December 13th (before maintenance), Claim 1 [Event] Meadow Trail every hour by checking the Challenges tab (Y). Maximum of 1 can be received per day.
Any leftover [Event] Steppe Seal and [Event] Meadow Trail items from Kamasylvian Alchemist 1 event have been deleted and cannot be reused in the Kamasylvian Alchemist 2 event.
Click  to check out this mystical event in detail.

Black Spirit’s Adventure 1 has returned.

Period: November 15th (after maintenance) - December 20th (before maintenance)
Mount EXP Bonus has been added.
Period: November 15th (after maintenance) - December 6th (before maintenance)
During this period, enjoy Mount Exp +10%!
System: 

It is now possible to use Advice of Valks in the Enhancement screen.
Fixed the issue where word filter did not work with Guild Advertising messages.
Now you will need twice the training material if an Awakening skill of a Dream Horse reaches 100%.
If you have a Lv. 50 or above character, creating a new character and skipping the tutorial once will block further tutorial from appearing. 
Battle Arena is now unavailable in Conquest/Node War servers.
Connecting to Conquest/Node War servers from 15 minutes before the warfare will automatically move your character to the nearest town.
Fixed the issue where it was possible to use Command to Gather (guild) or other similar commands even if the character had a trade item in inventory and/or mount’s inventory.
Fixed the crashing issue when entering game from a Windows 64-Bit 8-Core CPU.

Game World, NPC & Effects:

Now it is possible to use the Realization of Energy feature of Alustin all over the world.
You can find Alustin in Alejandro Farm, Glish, Keplan, Port Epheria, and The Great Library of Calpheon
New regions from Kamasylvia II have been added.

Grána City
Western Valtarra Mountains

Tooth Fairy Cabin
Acher Northern Camp
Weenie Cabin
Loopy Tree Forest
Polly's Forest

Lake Flondor
Looney Cabin
Southern Kamasylvia
Gyfin Rhasia Temple
Krogdalo Trace
Ash Forest
Okiara River
Yianaros’s Field
Main NPCs of Kamasylvia II have been added.

 Hazel Azealia

Jerrimo

The Stock Quantity of trade items with no Trading Lv. limit has been doubled.
Prices of some trade items from Valencia have been increased.
Max. selling prices of Luxuries, Military Supply, and Medicine trade items have been adjusted to 140%.
Min. buying prices of Food trade items have been adjusted to 60%, and Max. selling prices to 160%. The Price Guarantee period has been adjusted to 2 hours.
Min. buying prices of Raw Material trade items have been adjusted to 60%, and Max. selling prices to 140%.
Min. buying prices of Clothes trade items have been adjusted to 50%.

High-Quality Four-wheeled Wagon Badge has been added. * This item can be exchanged with Shiny Golden Seal - [Imperial Delivery] x150. * This item can also be crafted with Pure Tin Crystal x5, Flax Fabric x10, and Black Stone Powder x100 from Wagon Part Workshop Lv. 3.
High-Quality Merchant Wagon Cover can now be exchanged with Shiny Golden Seal - [Imperial Delivery] x100 (previously 250).
Navigation to Valencian towns and Ancado Inner Harbor from other territories has been improved.
Stock Quantity of some Valencian trade items with price increase has been adjusted.
Advanced Altar of Training has been added to Monster Ranking.
*]New titles related to Valtarra: Advanced Altar of Training have been added.
Venomous
What Goes Up Must Come Down
Kill First, Ask Questions Later
A Cultist Among Us
Time Controller
Valtarra Spirit’s Favorite

New Workers for Kamasylvia have been added.
Artisan Papu Worker (Grána)
Artisan Fadus Worker (Grána)
Professional Papu Worker (Grána)
Professional Fadus Worker (Grána)
Skilled Papu Worker (Grána)
Skilled Fadus Worker (Grána)
Papu Worker (Grána)
Fadus Worker (Grána)

Trading is now available in Kamasylvia.
Imperial Delivery group items have been slightly modified, and Grána Imperial Delivery has been added.
Now you can send and receive stuff to Old Wisdom Tree storage
Work Supervisor NPC and workers have been added to Old Wisdom Tree.

Mount:

A new Dream Horse, Diné, has been added.
Diné can use its magical horn to give temporary buffs to allies.
If your Lv. 30, Tier 8 Courser has filled the training gauge up to 200%, you can try awakening your Courser with NPC Gula at Stonetail Horse Ranch using Krogdalo's Origin Stone.

Your Courser will transform into Diné or Arduanatt if the awakening attempt succeeds. If it fails, the training gauge will be reset. (If you use Cron Stones, your Courser will lose only 50% of the entire training gauge.)
Dream Horses such as Diné can learn different skills which normal horses cannot learn. (The below skills can be learned by all Dream Horses.)
Courser's Spirit
Automatically recovers some HP and Strength on idle mode
Double Jump
Jumps mid-air one time. (Available after learning High Jump/Jump Sequence)
S: Charge
Allows an extra dash after using Dash (Available after learning Dash)

Dream Horse Diné is born with Courser’s Spirit, Double Jump, and Earth of Life. It may learn other skills while growing.
The below skills are exclusive to Diné.
Earth of Life
Recovers your HP by 200 per 3 secs., for 30 secs. Recovers your MP/WP by 100 per 3 secs., for 30 secs.
Recovers up to 10 Allies’ HP by 200 per 3 secs., for 30 secs. Recovers up to 10 Allies’ MP/WP by 100 per 3 secs., for 30 secs.
(Cooldown: 5 minutes)

Earth of Protection
All DP +10 for self and allies (up to 10) for 30 sec. / All Evasion +10

Fixed the issue that sometimes killed Arduanatt upon landing using the skill Wings of Wind.
Choose between Arduanatt or Diné! You can focus on three areas of Courser Training (Skill, Elegance, and Strength) to increase the chance of obtaining a Dream Horse of your choice.
The chance of obtaining a certain type of Dream horse can be raised up to 90%.
The three areas of training, Skill, Elegance, and Strength, can be trained up to 180% (previously 100%).
(As with before, the sum of three training areas must reach 200% to attempt at an Awakening.)
If you fail at Awakening using Cron Stone, the remaining Training Gauge’s decimal digits will be rounded down.
Three training areas have different leanings towards different Dream Horses.
Skill: Arduanatt
Elegance: Diné
Strength: Doom

If you invest in Strength for Doom, which hasn’t been revealed yet, the Strength training point will be shared between Skill and Elegance.

Peridot Forest Path Wagon has been added. 
You can craft related equipment in Grána 3, 2F, and the body at Grána 4 (housing).

Class Changes

All Classes 

Toggle key for Walking has been changed from CapsLock to ScrollLock.


Warrior 

Fixed the issue where the ear cuff looked odd when equipping Teary Ear Cuff


Ranger 

Invincible effect has been added against monsters while rolling in Kamasylven Sword stance.
After firing Blasting Gust (Q+A/D), you can now press (Q+A/D + SHIFT) to activate Ultimate: Blasting Gust.


Sorceress 

Fixed the graphical glitch on [Sorceress] Clead Shoes.


Witch 

Fixed the issue where the Witch would keep still the same stance after using Lightning V. 


Wizard 

Fixed the issue where the Wizard would keep still the same stance after using Lightning V.


Ninja 

Fixed the issue where Concealment was not working properly in certain situations.
Concealment effect will now be applied even when the skill is used through Quick Slot with Sura Katana.


Kunoichi 

Fixed the graphical glitch on [Kunoichi] Eunyoo Shoes.
Fixed the issue where Concealment was not working properly in certain situations.
Concealment effect will now be applied even when the skill is used through Quick Slot with Sah Chakram.


Striker 

Fixed the issue where the last hit of Ultimate Crush IV after Fallout would be reproduced repetitively.
Fixed the abnormalities in simulation of some outfits of the Striker upon use of Traveler’s Map while mounted.



Item Changes

The following items can now be used in polishing Alchemy Stone of Life.

High-Quality Fortune Teller Mushroom    
High-Quality Arrow Mushroom    
High-Quality Dwarf Mushroom    
High-Quality Cloud Mushroom    
High-Quality Sky Mushroom    
High-Quality Tiger Mushroom    
High-Quality Emperor Mushroom    
High-Quality Ghost Mushroom    
High-Quality Fog Mushroom    
High-Quality Hump Mushroom    
High-Quality Bluffer Mushroom    
High-Quality Ancient Mushroom    
High-Quality Amanita Mushroom

The following items can now be used in polishing Alchemy Stones of Protection.

Moss Tree Plywood    
Sturdy Moss Tree Plywood    
Loopy Tree Plywood    
Sturdy Loopy Tree Plywood    

The following items can now be used in polishing Alchemy Stone of Destruction.      
Noc Ingot    
Pure Noc Crystal

The descriptions of items that can be equipped on Farm Wagon, Trade Wagon, Merchant Wagon, and Noble Wagon will now individually name these wagons instead of saying it can be equipped on “Four-wheeled Wagon.”
Altar of Training’s Seals (5 different kinds) have been updated:


https://i.imgur.com/begn26G.png

The Seals can be combined into a Token.
Seals will be expired to use after 3 days.
Arrange the Sky Seal and Forest Seal in a horizontal shape of [-] to create a Token of Sky.
Arrange the Earth Seal, Sky Seal and Forest Seal in a horizontal shape of [-] to create a Token of Earth.
Arrange the Death Seal, Earth Seal, Sky Seal and Forest Seal in a horizontal shape of [-] to create a Token of Death.
Arrange the Relic Seal, Death Seal, Earth Seal, Sky Seal and Forest Seal in a horizontal shape of [-] to create a Token of Relic.
Each Token will grant you a special repeatable quest that you cannot perform 3 days after completion . 
Max 1 quest is available per Family per day.
You have to choose one of the 4 quests you receive from the Tokens.

Valtarra Eclipsed Belt has been added.
Basic Ability: AP +5
AP +3, Max Hp +25 per Enhancement
The Marketplace price of Valtarra Eclipsed Belt is the same as that of Ogre Ring.

Valtarra Training Reward Bundles (4 different kinds) and Courser Awakening Material Box have been added.
Valtarra's Scattered Aura has been added.
New yellow grade accessories have been added.
Tungrad Belt
Forest Ronaros Ring

New Kamasylvian recipes have been added, 6 for Cooking and 9 for Alchemy.
Weenie Elixir
Surging Weenie Elixir
[Party] Weenie Elixir
[Party] Surging Weenie Elixir
Looney Elixir
Reliable Looney Elixir

[Party] Reliable Looney Elixir

Special Kamasylvia Meal

New blue-grade gears have been added.

Lemoria Armor    
Lemoria Gloves    
Lemoria Shoes    

New Quest Reward accessories have been added.
Grána Guardian Necklace
Grána Oath Earring.
Grána Harmony Ring

Forest Path Wagon Wheel
Forest Path Wagon Cover
Forest Path Wagon Flag
Forest Path Wagon Badge

Makaraum Scroll has been added.
Collect Ancient Manshaum Ritual Tools and put them together to obtain Makaraum Scroll and summon a Boss monster.

Manshaum Narc’s Stone has been added.
Collect Manshaum Voodoo Dolls and put them together to obtain Manshaum Narc’s Stone and summon a Boss monster.
This item is for solo-play only. (Cannot be used if you are in a party)
Defeat the summoned boss to obtain Combat EXP, Skill EXP, and a reward bundle. There is a chance of obtaining Narc Ear Accessory from the bundle.
If the monster disappears, you can summon Black Spirit and proceed with a different quest to obtain some of the rewards.

Clump of Truffle Mushrooms has been added.
Pearl Shop categories have been reworked so that the list of items will come out in consecutive order from Tagged items (i.e. New, Hot) to regular items to Sold Out items.
Glowing effect for Coupon book in the Pearl Shop has been included. 

New Pearl Shop items have been released. Click  to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement.

Monster Changes

New Monster Forest Ronaros has been added.
Forest Ronaros can be found in the west of the Tooth Fairy Cabin, in the Loopy Tree Forest.
New hunting ground “Gyfin Rhasia Temple” has been added.
Gyfin Rhasia Temple is a Party grinding spot, and up to 5 Players can reap the rewards for each monster that is killed.
You can use your hoe to Gather from the killed monsters in the Polly’s Forest.
Fixed the issue where less than 7 monsters were aggravated sometimes.
Fixed the abnormally high APs of monsters in the following areas:
Aakman Temple
Hystria Ruins
Mirumok Ruins

Fixed the issue that occasionally prevented all players from receiving loot from a Boss monster.
The suggested AP of Valtarra: Advanced Altar of Training has been set to 150.
Even if you have higher AP, there is no significant difference in efficiency.

Upon slaying a Boss at Valtarra: Advanced Altar of Training, Characters near the Sacrament will get a Movement Speed boost of 50% for 10 sec.
AP and HP of Rock Gargoyle and Baby Rock Gargoyle have been lowered.
[CO-OP] Worship Ritual of the Manshaum has been added.
Collect Ancient Manshaum Ritual Tool x5 and arrange them in the shape of [+] to obtain Makaraum Scroll.
Monsters at Polly’s Forest now drop Water Spirit Stone Fragment.
Red Skirt Poison Mushroom
Cloudy Rain Mushroom
Twinkle-in-the-Dark Mushroom
Thief Imp Philum


Quest Changes

New knowledge cards and themes related to Kamasylvia II have been added.
New knowledge cards related to Kamasylvia II monsters have been added.
New quests have been added to Kamasylvia II.
Special weekly quest [Training Quest] Valtarra - To a Higher Place has been added.
It is available to Lv. 58 and up after completing the quest [Training Quest] Valtarra - Ruins Sacrament.
Talk to NPC Milford and complete the quest [Training Quest] Valtarra - To a Higher Place to obtain Valtarra: Advanced Training Manual.
Use Valtarra: Advanced Training Manual to start Advanced Altar of Training.
You must be in a party (at least 2 players) to be able to use Valtarra: Advanced Training Manual.
Monsters you will encounter at Advanced Altar of Training are very strong. Teaming up is recommended.

[Lv. 58] Altar of Training has been added to Quest window’s (O) Recurring tab.
[Wagon] Flondor Goose Spirit has been added.
Complete one of the [Wagon] Capricious Merindora quests to randomly receive one of five quests.
It is now easier to obtain Agile Mane’s Mane during the quest Trophies of the Manes.
Fixed the term Musket used in the quest [Hunting Advancement Lv. 15] Starting Point to Matchlock.
Fixed the issue in trade quests where the location of Daphne DelLucci was stated as DelLucci Farm.
The area allowed to use the boss scroll during the quest [Boss] Giant Chief Gehaku has been slightly reduced.
Objects have been added to the Great Valencian Desert.
Interacting with these objects will let you earn knowledges from the theme Great Desert Adventure Journal III.

The locations of gaining certain ecological knowledges from Valencia and Kamasylvia have been added to the World Map.
You can now complete the quest Barbarians' Tyranny by killing Abandoned Iron Mine Red Orc Guard and Khuruto Executor instead of Imp Work Supervisor.
The knowledge hints for A Valkyrie’s Role in War, Fundamentals of the Valkyrie: Integrity, and Fundamentals of the Valkyrie: Service have been fixed.
New special quests have been added.  
You will be facing enemies in Forest Ronaros area and Gyfin Rhasia Temple. You will be able to obtain a scroll that summons a strong Boss.
[Special VI] The Rules of the Forest (1/D)
[Special VI] Confronting Ronin (1/D)
[Special VI] The Mightiest Warrior (1/W)
[Special VI] Confronting Urugon (1/W)

Quests which you can complete immediately have been added to [Special V] and [Special IV] categories when you already have knowledge of Ahib’s Griffon and Narc Brishka.


Interface Changes

Fixed the issue where the Portrait from My Information was not being displayed if your Windows was not set to English language setting.
Fixed an issue so that clicking on Recharge button in Pearl Shop on Fullscreen mode will open a full window.
Fixed the awkward UI position in the Knowledge screen when entering from Cropping mode.
Fixed the issue with the Special Action button in Pearl Shop.
Fixed the issue with hiding chat option from UI edit mode.
A prompt will now pop up upon clicking on Reset All in Settings.
Mouse-overing on a skill icon after searching will now bring you straight to that skill.
Video guides will now be shown in a web form.
Now you can search by category in Beauty Album’s User Gallery.
Kamasylvia II monster information has been added to the World Map.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where it was impossible to move upon taking out a Sailboat from Shakatu Abandoned Ferry.
Fixed the issue that displayed an Exploration Points effect on the stairs of Valley Lily Inn in Heidel.
Fixed the issue where statues on top of Calpheon Holy College disappeared during the quest ‘The Valkyrie Legend.’’
Fixed the issue where the knowledge cards images of Kamasylvia Horn Deer, Kamasylvia Young Horn Deer, Kamasylvia Female Horn Deer, and Kamasylvia Herb Stoneback Crab were different from their actual appearances.

Reach us on the »Forums« to share your feedback, opinions, and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 15th November
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/1FvG64O.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,
The next dream horse Diné will breeze its way into Kamasylvia Part 2, the Healing Light. Feast your eyes on Grána City, the glorious capital of Kamasylvia filled with new, aesthetic residences and bustling lifeforms. Venture out in the vast, open fields and dense forests like Polly Forest and Gyfin Rhasia Temple where facing off against mystical yet fierce foes will prove to be a challenge. Kamasylvia Part 2 will be filled with immersive quests, areas, and newly added challenging monsters to enhance your PvE experience to the fullest. Kamasylvian Alchemist 2 event will get you scavenging out vast steppes and forests again and also, please welcome back the familiar events like Black Spirit Adventure and Mount EXP bonus event. Go out there, explore the fairy tales, and have a shot at looting high-grade items like the Lemoria gears!

Event & Systems

Event: 

The event Kamasylvian Alchemists 2 has been added.

Period: November 15th (after maintenance) - December 13th (before maintenance)
You can obtain [Event] Steppe Seal and [Event] Meadow Trail all over the world through monsters, fishing, and gathering.
In addition, you can obtain event items for simply playing the game.
From November 16th (00:00) - December 13th (before maintenance), Claim 3 [Event] Steppe Seals every hour by checking the Challenges tab (Y). Maximum of 18 can be received per day.
From November 16th (00:00) - December 13th (before maintenance), Claim 1 [Event] Meadow Trail every hour by checking the Challenges tab (Y). Maximum of 1 can be received per day.
Any leftover [Event] Steppe Seal and [Event] Meadow Trail items from Kamasylvian Alchemist 1 event have been deleted and cannot be reused in the Kamasylvian Alchemist 2 event.
Click  to check out this mystical event in detail.

Black Spirit’s Adventure 1 has returned.

Period: November 15th (after maintenance) - December 20th (before maintenance)
Mount EXP Bonus has been added.
Period: November 15th (after maintenance) - December 6th (before maintenance)
During this period, enjoy Mount Exp +10%!
System: 

It is now possible to use Advice of Valks in the Enhancement screen.
Fixed the issue where word filter did not work with Guild Advertising messages.
Now you will need twice the training material if an Awakening skill of a Dream Horse reaches 100%.
If you have a Lv. 50 or above character, creating a new character and skipping the tutorial once will block further tutorial from appearing. 
Battle Arena is now unavailable in Conquest/Node War servers.
Connecting to Conquest/Node War servers from 15 minutes before the warfare will automatically move your character to the nearest town.
Fixed the issue where it was possible to use Command to Gather (guild) or other similar commands even if the character had a trade item in inventory and/or mount’s inventory.
Fixed the crashing issue when entering game from a Windows 64-Bit 8-Core CPU.

Game World, NPC & Effects:

Now it is possible to use the Realization of Energy feature of Alustin all over the world.
You can find Alustin in Alejandro Farm, Glish, Keplan, Port Epheria, and The Great Library of Calpheon

Mount:

A new Dream Horse, Diné, has been added.
Diné can use its magical horn to give temporary buffs to allies.
If your Lv. 30, Tier 8 Courser has filled the training gauge up to 200%, you can try awakening your Courser with NPC Gula at Stonetail Horse Ranch using Krogdalo's Origin Stone.

Your Courser will transform into Diné or Arduanatt if the awakening attempt succeeds. If it fails, the training gauge will be reset. (If you use Cron Stones, your Courser will lose only 50% of the entire training gauge.)
Dream Horses such as Diné can learn different skills which normal horses cannot learn. (The below skills can be learned by all Dream Horses.)
Courser's Spirit
Automatically recovers some HP and Strength on idle mode
Double Jump
Jumps mid-air one time. (Available after learning High Jump/Jump Sequence)
S: Charge
Allows an extra dash after using Dash (Available after learning Dash)

Dream Horse Diné is born with Courser’s Spirit, Double Jump, and Earth of Life. It may learn other skills while growing.
The below skills are exclusive to Diné.
Earth of Life
Recovers your HP by 200 per 3 secs., for 30 secs. Recovers your MP/WP by 100 per 3 secs., for 30 secs.
Recovers up to 10 Allies’ HP by 200 per 3 secs., for 30 secs. Recovers up to 10 Allies’ MP/WP by 100 per 3 secs., for 30 secs.
(Cooldown: 5 minutes)

Earth of Protection
All DP +10 for self and allies (up to 10) for 30 sec. / All Evasion +10

Fixed the issue that sometimes killed Arduanatt upon landing using the skill Wings of Wind.

The chance of obtaining a certain type of Dream horse can be raised up to 90%.
The three areas of training, Skill, Elegance, and Strength, can be trained up to 180% (previously 100%).
(As with before, the sum of three training areas must reach 200% to attempt at an Awakening.)
If you fail at Awakening using Cron Stone, the remaining Training Gauge’s decimal digits will be rounded down.
Three training areas have different leanings towards different Dream Horses.

Greetings Adventurers!

Every week, we conduct a scheduled maintenance to restart the servers and add new content to the game. Please refer to the details below to see the maintenance schedule and what's being added.

Global - 09:00 - 14:00 UTC
North America (West Coast) - 1:00AM - 6:00AM PDT
North America (East Coast) - 4:00AM - 5:00AM EDT

A new capital Grána City will open its doors.

The Patch Notes, including improvements and new features, will be posted after the maintenance.

Thank you for your support and understanding.

Best regards,
BDO Team

Greetings Adventurers,

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1st November
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/mcNrDdt.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,

It is now possible to participate and have an impact on the “geopolitical fate of the world” even if you are not a member of one of the major guilds. We are very happy to announce the arrival of the next level of player-driven warfare in Black Desert Online in the form of the Militia system.
Another great new feature made it into this week's patch, the Platoon system. It allows to temporarily band together with other players in more spontaneous ways than a party.
Those of you, who are focused on life skills or just need a break from killing Monsters and fighting other players will be happy to hear about Manufacture, a new processing branch. Now you can craft your very own selection of siege weapons.
But that's not all. Below you will find many more updates and improvements. As always, let us know what you think about the update in the forums and have fun in Black Desert Online.

Event & Systems

Event: 

Hero of Militia Event has started. You will get awesome prizes just for participating, and much greater prizes including a GTX Graphic Card will be available on a lucky draw!
Event held: 2017.11.02 ~ 2017.11.22
Click Here to check out this amazing event
Militia content for Conquest War has been updated.

Click Here to find out the fine details in the Militia Guide.
Players can now join and participate in the Conquest War even if your guild is not one of the participating guilds in the Conquest War.
Militia is a group of mercenary adventurers that play a role in assisting the participating guilds.
Only the adventurers whose combined AP/DP is 400 or up can join Militia.
Select which role you want to play! Choose form either the Offensive Militia or Defensive Militia.
Join a Militia, play in Conquest War, and win some rewards!
Players can apply to join the Militia starting an hour before the Conquest War, for 45 minutes, on Saturdays, on the first servers of Calpheon, Mediah, and Valencia. 50 spots are available per each offensive and defensive side. (Maximum of 100 players total per region)
If there are no guilds challenging the reigning guild, then only Offensive Militia is available to join. In this case, maximum of 100 Offensive Militia spots are available to join.
You can apply for both Offensive and Defensive Militia even if your guild does not hold a node in the relevant territory. Only 10 players maximum from the same guild can apply for the Militia in the same region.
If the number of applicants is below 50% (50 players) of the maximum Militia positions available (Offensive  and Defensive combined), the Militia will not be able to join the war.
If a player withdraws his/her application for the Militia, he/she cannot reapply for the same war session.
Liberated territories are not open to Militia application.
The Offensive and Defensive Militia will be in the action from 2 to 3 hours (depending on the defense) starting at the same time of the Conquest War.
Defensive Militia will win if the Defensive Guild wins, and Offensive Militia will win if the Command Post of the Defensive Guild is destroyed. The participants in the winning Militia will be rewarded with 20 Million Guild Funds per player. (The reward is subject to change at a later time)
When dying while participating as a Militia, players can revive from Town or a designated revive location. Revival times are the same as normal Conquest War participants.
Militia members can communicate using Militia only chat channel.
The Militia can only attack players on the opposing side. However, non-Militia members participating in the Conquest War can attack all Militia players even if they are on the same side. (For example, Defensive Militia cannot attack the Defensive Guild, but the Defensive Guild can attack Defensive Militia.)
Adventurers participating in the Conquest War will not lose Karma even when killing others with forced PVP.

Some of the Conquest War Rules have been changed.

The schedule of the Conquest War remains the same every Saturday. (Check the official Militia guide for the exact time schedule)
However, if the Defensive Guilds of Calpheon, Mediah, and Valencia regions can fend off the attackers for 2 hours successfully without losing their Outer Gate, the Defensive Guild will win and the siege will end.
If the Offensive Guilds successfully destroy the Defensive Guild’s command post (Field HQ) within the first 2 hours, then a battle breaks between the Offensive Guilds and the new winner of the region is decided if one of these guilds is left standing alone.
If there is no one clear victor by the end of the siege, the the region will be liberated.

Platoon system has been added.

Platoon is a temporary group for players with the same goal.
You can invite other players by clicking on their names from the chat.
Use the command /inviteunit [character name] to invite someone to your Platoon.
You cannot invite a player who is already in a party or in another Platoon.
A Platoon can have up to 20 players. HP of the Platoon members will be visible to everyone within the Platoon.
Location of all Platoon members will also be shared on the World Map and Minimap.
There is no EXP distribution or special EXP gained from Platoon. There is no option to change Looting Method.
Items looted from Platoon activities cannot be registered to the Special Deals from the Marketplace.
Party effects activated by skills can be used (HP Recovery, Buffs, etc.), but other effects (i.e. Party Elixirs) cannot be used.
Summon Scrolls cannot be used if you are in a Platoon. (Guild Summon Scrolls are okay.)
Platoon members can use the Party chat channel.
System: 

Fixed the issue that repeatedly prompted fail messages even after successfully catching a fish.
Fixed the issue where the Minimap of Northern Plain of Serendia was not being displayed under the radar.
Sails of big ships will become transparent upon boarding them. They will be displayed again when a character gets off the ship.
The mount skill Caution will not be activated in the Desert area.

Class Changes

All Classes 

All Character’s basic Awakening skills (“Training” skills) now have only 5 ranks instead of 10.
All Characters will automatically learn basic Awakening (“Training”) skills.
If you have already learned the deleted skills, your skill points will be returned.
Fixed the glitch in the Customizing screen that cause the character to blink and be naked for a moment while changing outfits.
The amount of Combat EXP gained between Lv. 56 and 60 has been dramatically increased.
Fixed the issue that prevented players from getting Skill EXP if their character has already gained a certain amount of Skill Points.

Warrior 

Fixed the issue that stopped the auto-running and sprinting character (pressing Shift during auto-run) when the Stamina hits zero.


Sorceress 

Fixed the issue where Air Attack effect was not available while using Dark Flame.


Berserker 

“Pushes the target on lateral attacks (PvE Only)” has been added to the description of Berserker’s skill Buster Training.
Fixed the wrong damage value of the skill Tackling Rock. Now each rank of the skill should inflict the correct amount of damage


Tamer 

Fixed the graphical glitch of Angelic Queen and Demonic Queen outfits caused by certain Customizing data.


Valkyrie 

Fixed the wrong SP recovery value of Lancia Training attacks.


WitchWizard 

Fixed the issue where the Tamer and Witch could not shoot Matchlock in a crouching motion when their heights are set as the shortest.


Wizard

Fixed the issue where Wizard’s Grave Keeper Hat was not showing.
Fixed the issue where the pivotal point of the skill Cataclysm IV was set in front of the Wizard instead of the center of the Wizard’s body.
Fixed the issue where the pivotal point of the skill Cataclysm IV was set in front of the Wizard instead of the center of the Wizard’s body.

Musa 

“WP Recovery +10 on good hits” has been added to the description of Musa’s Crescent Blade Training.


Maehwa 

Fixed the graphical glitch on Maehwa’s Ladybell outfit near the shoulder and thigh areas.


Dark Knight 

Fixed the issue that made the Phantom Blades disappear while moving forward in combat stance.


Striker

Following has been added to the description of Striker’s skill Gardbrace Training.
Spins the target on lateral attacks (PvE Only)
Pushes the target on lateral attacks (PvE Only)
Fixed the issue that stopped the auto-running and sprinting character (pressing Shift during auto-run) when the Stamina hits zero.
Fixed the issue that hid the weapons upon equipping Crimson Knight outfit.
Following has been added to the item description:
Your Gauntlet and Vambrace will be invisible with this costume.
Your Gardbrace will be invisible with this costume.



Item Changes

A special shot using Black Spirit’s Rage 100% has been added to Matchlocks.
This special shot will be fired automatically when shooting a Matchlock when Black Spirit’s Rage is at 100%.
When using this special shot, the shot’s damage will deal much more damage compared to that of a normal shot.
When using the special shot with a [Combat] Trina Matchlock or [Savage] Enhanced Matchlock, the shot’s damage area will be enlarged and the number of targets that can be hit will be increased.
The special shot cannot be fired while in mounted combat.

[Combat] Trina Matchlock and [Combat] Trina Lead Bullet have been updated.
[Combat] Trina Matchlock is a weapon specialized for battles which cannot be used while in mounted combat.
[Combat] Trina Matchlock is used in Node / Conquest Wars and is effective for attacking or keeping your enemies back  from Wooden Fences, Wooden Fence Gate, Castle Gate, etc.
Matchlock is equipped in the main weapon slot and Lead Bullet is equipped in the sub-weapon slot. When both items are equipped, the matchlock must first load the bullets (same as reloading animation) in order to be able to fire the Matchlock. 2 shots can be fired per load.
[Combat] Trina Matchlock can be enhanced with Black Stone (Weapon) and Concentrated Magical Black Stone (Weapon) up to PEN: V rank.

[Combat] Trina Demolition Axe has been updated.
[Combat] Trina Demolition Axe is a weapon specialized in tearing down structures which cannot be used while in mounted combat.
[Combat] Trina Demolition Axe is used in Node/Conquest Wars and highly efficient for inflicting damage against Wooden Fences, Wooden Fence Gate, Castle Gate, etc.
[Combat] Trina Demolition Axe can be enhanced with Black Stone (Weapon) and Concentrated Magical Black Stone (Weapon) up to PEN: V rank.
[Combat] Trina Demolition Axe can be crafted from the Processing: Manufacture feature when [Combat] Trina Demolition Axe Knowledge is obtained.
[Combat] Trina Demolition Axe Knowledge can be obtained in Trent from NPC “Dalian” when completing quest “Reinventing an Old Weapon”. This quest is available for players level 50 or above.

A new Processing feature “Manufacture” has been updated.
Use the Manufacture processing feature to craft siege weapons. Currently, you can craft [Combat] Trina Matchlock, [Combat] Trina Lead Bullet, and [Combat] Trina Demolition Axe.
Manufacture is different compared to that of other processing features in that you can craft 1 item every 14 seconds.
Knowledge for [Combat] Trina Matchlock, [Combat] Trina Lead Bullet, and [Combat] Trina Demolition Axe can be obtained through quests.

The accessory items obtainable through Recurring Quests in Mediah can be exchanged back to Seals.

https://i.imgur.com/pArhqEk.png
Green-rank Awakening weapons can be upgraded to Ultimate level.
The color of candle lights (Candle/Lamp) used in Residence has been changed from white to yellowish hue.
Weight of trade items obtainable from monsters has been decreased for better weight management during grinding.
New Pearl Shop items have been released. Click Here to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement

Mechanic Changes

Once Flame Towers and Hwachas are destroyed in Savage Rift, players can now install other objects at the same spot in 15-20 seconds.


Monster Changes

Monsters in Helms Post have been rearranged.
The randomly-moving Helm Hunters have been changed to Helm Miners.
Helm Hunters have been moved to inside the herd.
Some Helm monsters have increased in number.

Monsters in Sausan Garrison have been rearranged.
Sausan Snipers and Tough Sausan Soldiers, previously located along the outer rim of Sausan Garrison, have been moved to the inner area.
Following monsters will no longer attack Adventurers and mounts first.
Serendia
Swamp Hermit Crab
Calpheon
Young Red Boar
Stone Crab
Rock Spider

Mediah
Vera Desert Crab
Rock Desert Crab
Blue Desert Crab
Desert Crab
Rock Spider

Kamasylvia
Bush Hermit Crab
Vera Grassland Crab

The number of items you get from killing the following monsters in Kamasylvia Entrance has been adjusted.
Rock Gargoyle, Baby Rock Gargoyle
Monsters at Mirumok Ruins will yield less EXP.
Fixed the issue where players could not summon Mirumok Watcher using an item.
Soldier NPCs have been added around the Desert Naga Spy NPC.

Quest Changes

The quest summary and objective of Mediah Cultist’s Whereabouts have become clearer.
Secret Letter from the Dark Chaser will be highlighted in the inventory while working on the quest Mediah Cultist’s Whereabouts.
Some prerequisites for being able to accept sub-quests have been modified to prevent new players from being side-tracked during level 1 ~ 50 main quest.
Players can now watch cut-scenes when they do the main quests with a new character even if they have other characters in the family which already completed said quests.
Fixed the issue where the cut-scene button “Shadow Knights' Sword” looked like a normal dialogue button.
Fixed the issue that prevented players from completing the following quests in Balenos.
Damaging Creatures
Crying Spirits
Imps and their Altar
The Steel Imps
Scary Wolves!
Cutting Through
Eye of Suspicion
For the Node’s Safety
For the Wagon’s Safe Return

Fixed the issue where some Families could not complete or forfeit the quest “Have You Seen My Ferrina?”
The NPC "Desert Naga Spy," encountered during the quest Suspicious Carcass of a Desert Naga, has been moved to the cliff in front of Sand Grain Bazaar.

Interface Changes
Graphics:


Tooltips have been added to the buttons in the “Ongoing” tab of the Quest window.
Setting button has been moved next to Disconnect in the ESC menu.
“Sort by item quantity” has been added to the Marketplace.
Find NPC button has been added to the lower right corner of World Map.
Tooltip for the Weight icon that appears while carrying more than Weight Limit has been modified.
Clicking on the Weight icon that appears while carrying more than Weight Limit will show the Weight Limit purchase screen.
Fixed the issue that did not display Black Spirit’s name when it is summoned.
Fixed the icon alignment for certain items.
Fixed the issue where players would still see the purchase window upon clicking on “Artisan’s Memory” button even when they already have the item in the inventory.
Fixed the issue where the “Call Off Protection” button would not appear in the Guild Member Status window.
Fixed the issue where the Weight Limit exceed tooltip overlapped with other UI elements.

Sound:


Fixed the issue where the sound effect of Striker’s Flow: Bite Off was being controlled by the setting of “Remove Other Users’ Effects”.
Fixed the issue where installing wall or flooring in Altinova 2-1 will not show the result properly from certain angles.


Resolved Issues


NA Conquest War Siege issue on 10/28/2017 has been resolved.
The issue of trading EXP given out lower for certain level caps has been fixed.
Navigation in some parts of Balenos, Serendia, Calpheon and Media has been improved.
Fixed the issue that guided players toward Kamasylvia upon using the Navigate feature during the quest “Border Between Life and Death”.
Fixed the issue where selecting Eyebrow No. 7 or 8 would make beards on Ninja’s face in the Customization screen.
Fixed the issue where Pearl items were being displayed as enhanced items in Received Mail List in certain circumstances.
Fixed the issue where it was impossible to proceed with a quest at Port Ratt because players could not talk to a villager NPC.
Fixed the issue that displayed Workers for hire even when a player did not have a Worker Lodging.
Fixed the issue where certain UIs were applied with snow-effect.
Fixed the issue where the Heidel fountain's knight statue disappeared.


To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes

Reach us on the Forums to share your feedback, opinions, suggestions and find helpful tips and hints.

[Combat] Trina Demolition Axe is used in Node/Conquest Wars and highly efficient for inflicting damage against Wooden Fences, Wooden Fence Gate, Castle Gate, etc.
[Combat] Trina Demolition Axe can be enhanced with Black Stone (Weapon) and Concentrated Magical Black Stone (Weapon) up to PEN: V rank.
[Combat] Trina Demolition Axe can be crafted from the Processing: Manufacture feature when [Combat] Trina Demolition Axe Knowledge is obtained.
[Combat] Trina Demolition Axe Knowledge can be obtained in Trent from NPC “Dalian” when completing quest “Reinventing an Old Weapon”. This quest is available for players level 50 or above.

A new Processing feature “Manufacture” has been updated.
Use the Manufacture processing feature to craft siege weapons. Currently, you can craft [Combat] Trina Matchlock, [Combat] Trina Lead Bullet, and [Combat] Trina Demolition Axe.
Manufacture is different compared to that of other processing features in that you can craft 1 item every 14 seconds.
Knowledge for [Combat] Trina Matchlock, [Combat] Trina Lead Bullet, and [Combat] Trina Demolition Axe can be obtained through quests.

The accessory items obtainable through Recurring Quests in Mediah can be exchanged back to Seals.

https://i.imgur.com/pArhqEk.png
Green-rank Awakening weapons can be upgraded to Ultimate level.
The color of candle lights (Candle/Lamp) used in Residence has been changed from white to yellowish hue.
Weight of trade items obtainable from monsters has been decreased for better weight management during grinding.
New Pearl Shop items have been released. Click Here to go to the Pearl Shop Update Announcement

Mechanic Changes

Once Flame Towers and Hwachas are destroyed in Savage Rift, players can now install other objects at the same spot in 15-20 seconds.


Monster Changes

Monsters in Helms Post have been rearranged.
The randomly-moving Helm Hunters have been changed to Helm Miners.
Helm Hunters have been moved to inside the herd.
Some Helm monsters have increased in number.

Monsters in Sausan Garrison have been rearranged.
Sausan Snipers and Tough Sausan Soldiers, previously located along the outer rim of Sausan Garrison, have been moved to the inner area.
Following monsters will no longer attack Adventurers and mounts first.
Serendia
Swamp Hermit Crab
Calpheon
Young Red Boar
Stone Crab
Rock Spider

Mediah
Vera Desert Crab
Rock Desert Crab
Blue Desert Crab
Desert Crab
Rock Spider

Kamasylvia
Bush Hermit Crab
Vera Grassland Crab

The number of items you get from killing the following monsters in Kamasylvia Entrance has been adjusted.
Rock Gargoyle, Baby Rock Gargoyle
Monsters at Mirumok Ruins will yield less EXP.
Fixed the issue where players could not summon Mirumok Watcher using an item.
Soldier NPCs have been added around the Desert Naga Spy NPC.

Quest Changes

The quest summary and objective of Mediah Cultist’s Whereabouts have become clearer.
Secret Letter from the Dark Chaser will be highlighted in the inventory while working on the quest Mediah Cultist’s Whereabouts.
Some prerequisites for being able to accept sub-quests have been modified to prevent new players from being side-tracked during level 1 ~ 50 main quest.
Players can now watch cut-scenes when they do the main quests with a new character even if they have other characters in the family which already completed said quests.
Fixed the issue where the cut-scene button “Shadow Knights' Sword” looked like a normal dialogue button.
Fixed the issue that prevented players from completing the following quests in Balenos.
Damaging Creatures
Crying Spirits
Imps and their Altar
The Steel Imps
Scary Wolves!
Cutting Through
Eye of Suspicion
For the Node’s Safety
For the Wagon’s Safe Return

Fixed the issue where some Families could not complete or forfeit the quest “Have You Seen My Ferrina?”
The NPC "Desert Naga Spy," encountered during the quest Suspicious Carcass of a Desert Naga, has been moved to the cliff in front of Sand Grain Bazaar.

Interface Changes
Graphics:


Tooltips have been added to the buttons in the “Ongoing” tab of the Quest window.
Setting button has been moved next to Disconnect in the ESC menu.
“Sort by item quantity” has been added to the Marketplace.
Find NPC button has been added to the lower right corner of World Map.
Tooltip for the Weight icon that appears while carrying more than Weight Limit has been modified.
Clicking on the Weight icon that appears while carrying more than Weight Limit will show the Weight Limit purchase screen.
Fixed the issue that did not display Black Spirit’s name when it is summoned.
Fixed the icon alignment for certain items.
Fixed the issue where players would still see the purchase window upon clicking on “Artisan’s Memory” button even when they already have the item in the inventory.
Fixed the issue where the “Call Off Protection” button would not appear in the Guild Member Status window.
Fixed the issue where the Weight Limit exceed tooltip overlapped with other UI elements.

Sound:


Fixed the issue where the sound effect of Striker’s Flow: Bite Off was being controlled by the setting of “Remove Other Users’ Effects”.
Fixed the issue where installing wall or flooring in Altinova 2-1 will not show the result properly from certain angles.


Resolved Issues


NA Conquest War Siege issue on 10/28/2017 has been resolved.
The issue of trading EXP given out lower for certain level caps has been fixed.
Navigation in some parts of Balenos, Serendia, Calpheon and Media has been improved.
Fixed the issue that guided players toward Kamasylvia upon using the Navigate feature during the quest “Border Between Life and Death”.
Fixed the issue where selecting Eyebrow No. 7 or 8 would make beards on Ninja’s face in the Customization screen.
Fixed the issue where Pearl items were being displayed as enhanced items in Received Mail List in certain circumstances.
Fixed the issue where it was impossible to proceed with a quest at Port Ratt because players could not talk to a villager NPC.
Fixed the issue that displayed Workers for hire even when a player did not have a Worker Lodging.
Fixed the issue where certain UIs were applied with snow-effect.
Fixed the issue where the Heidel fountain's knight statue disappeared.


To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes

Reach us on the Forums to share your feedback, opinions, suggestions and find helpful tips and hints.

Monster Changes

The number of items you get from killing monsters in Kamasylvia Entrance has been adjusted.
Killing monsters in southwestern Calpheon and Mediah now has a chance of obtaining  short-term buff scrolls.

There are 2 main kinds of buff scrolls of Stat+ and EXP+.
Combat/Skill EXP+ buff will last for 3 min., and the EXP gain will increase by 3%.
Stat+ buff are varied based on the grind spot. However, Combat/Skill EXP+ buff scrolls can be obtained in every grinding areas from south-western regions to Mediahn region.
You can gain the effect of both Stat+ and EXP+ buff at the same time. However, You cannot stack different types of Stat+ effect simultaneously.

https://i.imgur.com/WSpwX9M.png

Abandoned Iron Mine, Horio Tinya

AP of Rock Gargoyle and Baby Rock Gargoyle in Kamasylvia Entrance has been slightly increased while their DP has been greatly decreased.
Mirumok Watcher Offin Tett will now drop Valtarra Eclipsed Belt.

Hero of Merchants

Hero of Blacksmiths

Secret Request

The quest area for [Boss] Bree Tree Ruins Guard Tower will be highlighted in yellow on the Minimap.
Knowledge for Immature Griffon, Immature Black Leopard, and Immature King Griffon have been added.


Interface Changes

UI
Clicking on a guild member from the Guild window will now also display an option to Whisper.
Guild Promotion button has been added in the guild window. When the guild Promotion button is clicked and confirmed, a link with the guild’s name and a guild description will automatically be posted in the chat. When this link is clicked, it will open up the guild’s information window.

Only the Guild Master and Guild Officers can use this function.
50 Energy will be consumed per use.

No Watermark option has been added.
Challenge reward alert icon has been moved from lower right to top left.
Fixed the issue where the Savage Rift icon in the ESC menu displayed in a different color.
Fixed the issue that reset the saved chat options.
Fixed the issue where the price of your last registered item was being displayed as a Recent Price in the Marketplace registration window.
A tooltip has been added to the Marketplace’s Cancel Queue button.
Fixed the issue that caused the menu buttons to overlap when the resolution is set to below 800.
Tooltips have been added to the buttons on the Pet List window.
Tooltips have been added to the Inventory window for locked slots and Weight Limit increase.
Information regarding Max Durability restoration will now be shown to item descriptions whose Durability is 50 or below.
You can now purchase Artisan’s Memory from the Max Durability Restoration window.

If a player does not own an Artisan’s Memory during Max Durability restoration, clicking on the button “Artisan's Memory” will direct the player to the purchase screen.
Information regarding where to purchase Artisan’s Memory has been added to the Artisan’s Memory button tooltip in the Max Durability restoration window.
The item you get via this function will be instantly used upon purchase, and the Pearls used cannot be refunded. So think carefully.

Sound

Resolved Issues

Shop function has been added to the NPC Hush in Mask Owl's Forest.

Fixed the issue that caused the Crow’s effect to blink.
Fixed the issue where icons for Guild Managers in major cities would not appear on the World Map.
Fixed the graphical glitch of Ranger’s hair with [Ranger] Lahr Arcien Helmet R.
Fixed the issue where summoning items disappear continuously when interacting with a Guild Raid Boss repeatedly.

notes.title: Halloween Pumpkin Carving Competition
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/dLSbR7L.png
Greetings Adventurers,

Halloween is rapidly approaching and with it, we’d like to invite you to join us carving some Black Desert Online themed Pumpkins!

Want to add some Black Desert Online-themed Halloween flair to your home? Then break out the knives, scoops and other tools and carve yourself a #BDOpumpkin!

Need some help? *Download and check out these templates to use for your Pumpkin
*.png files - transparent background

Submit Date: October 19th ~ October 30th [11:59 pm PST] (Final Submit Date)

Staff’s Pick: October 31st

Winners Announcement: October 31st

Contest Rules:

Carve your pumpkin with a Black Desert Online related image

Post photo of your carving on Facebook, Twitter or Instagram including #BDOpumpkin17

Set your profile/photo to public

Include a (paper) note that says Black Desert Halloween '17

The screenshot winners will be selected by BDO Team.

Failure to abide by any of the rules above may result in voiding your eligibility to be selected as a winner.

Prizes: Winners will be announced through our Twitch Stream, and prizes will be delivered via mail.
The best 3 #BDOPumpkins will win a
Black Desert Online Goody Bag:
BDO T-shirt
USB Power bank


Submissions: You will need to submit the image as a public post on your own Facebook, Instagram or Twitter. It will require the post to be set to public so our team can find and view it, please be sure to include the required Hashtag

Disclaimer: By submitting your photo(s) for our event, you understand and agree that the rights and ownership for the use of the photo(s) will automatically belong to Kakao Games Europe B.V. and can be used at Kakao Games Europe B.V.'s discretion.

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 18th 2017
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/Jz3ttG8.jpg
Greetings adventurers,

Halloween is around the corner and Black Desert Online just became a bit more spooky. The red moon rises around this time of the year, which creates mysterious crevices across the entire world of Black Desert. Now, the Black Desert world gets mixed with the dimension of a strange world. New and returning events start today and a broad variety of cosmetic items will help setting the mood.
The patch brings also fixes for several issues as well as game and balance improvements and more.

Event & Systems

Event: 

Halloween event has begun.
October 18th - November 1st, 08:59 UTC
Halloween-themed decorations are added here and there of the world. The big bloody moon will be seen throughout the event period.
Halloween-themed music will be playing in Velia, Heidel, Calpheon City, Altinova, and Valencia City during the event period.
Gueldia the White Witch and Isabella the Black Witch are visiting from the strange world.
Gueldia the White Witch is currently staying at Alejandro Farm. She has a favor to ask to adventurers: to capture and defeat Isabella the Black Witch!
This quest is available once per Family. Players will get a Halloween Gift Box as a reward.
Players can get “Witch’s Bloody Brooch” by defeating Isabella. Hand this over to Gueldia to complete the quest.
Players can also obtain the following items by defeating Isabella.
[Event] Pumpkin Gift Box
[Event] Halloween Pumpkin Cookie
[Event] Halloween Gift Box
Black Stone (Weapon)
Black Stone (Armor)
Memory Fragment
Hunter’s Seal

The following event-quests have been added from which you can obtain Halloween-themed head gears.

https://i.imgur.com/Muhz41Q.png
Event quests can be accepted only during October 18, 09:00 until October 31st, 11:59, UTC.
The rewards are obtainable only from October 18, 09:00 until November 1, 09:00, UTC.
[Event] Sweep the Road for Sweet Jack O’ Lantern quest is available once a day per Family within the event period. However, the other quests are available only once per Family throughout the event.
[Event] Devil’s Night quest is available only during the night time of the game. You will be asked to defeat Thief Imp monster that appears only at night.
The following event-challenges have been added from which you can obtain the event items.

https://i.imgur.com/rt6AMjE.png
[Event] Halloween Coins can be exchanged by the White Witch NPC Gueldia at Alejandro Farm for the following items:
Halloween Coin X10 = Cron Stone X10
Halloween Coin X20 = Sharp Black Crystal Shard X6
Halloween Coin X30 = Valk’s Advice (+25)
Halloween Coin X50 = Fine Accessory Box X1

You can obtain a [Event] Halloween Gift Box by placing [Event]Halloween Candy Basket X1 and [Event] Halloween Cookie X1 in order in a shape of [-]. 
You can obtain one of the following items by opening a [Event] Halloween Gift Box:
Resplendent Alchemy Stone of Destruction
Kzarka's Sealed Weapon Box
Centaurus Belt
Tungrad Earring
Basilisk's Belt
Ogre Ring
Giath’s Helmet
Red Nose’s Armor
Bheg's Gloves
Muskan's Shoes
Black Magic Crystal - Harphia
Magic Crystal of Infinity - Experience
Sicil's Necklace
Ring of Crescent Guardian
Ring of Cadry Guardian
Black Magic Crystal - Sturdiness
Black Magic Crystal - Armor
Necklace of Good Deeds
Tree Spirit Belt
Blue Whale Molar Earring
Manos Ruby Necklace
Witch's Earring
Red Coral Earring
Ancient Guardian's Seal
Bensho's Necklace
Mark of Shadow
Ancient Weapon Core
Sharp Black Crystal Shard Bundle: 3
Hard Black Crystal Shard Bundle: 3
Sharp Black Crystal Shard
Hard Black Crystal Shard
Cron Stone
Memory Fragment
 

The following items can be purchased in the Pearl Shop for 1 Loyalty.
[Event] Kamasylve Pot Decoration, 3 per family
[Event] Blessing of Kamasylve (7 Days), 1 per family
[Event] Sealed Book of Combat (7 Days), 1 per family
System: 

Fixed the issue that prevented from applying wei	ght penalty when selling trade items.
Prerequisites for activating Social Actions (emotes) have been added to the Social Action window.
If certain quests need to be completed, you can also check out the prerequisites for receiving those quests.
Mount: 
Characters mounted on [Guild] Elephant cannot perform Force-PvP.
(Force-PvP can be activated again during Node/Conquest Wars.)
If a character with Force-PvP feature activated rides on a [Guild] Elephant, Force-PvP will automatically be deactivated.
Instant Accel or S: Instant Accel on Arduanatt can now be seamlessly followed by Double Jump.
An event field boss Izabella will appear in Costa Farm during the Halloween event period.
Chances of learning skills have been increased for Tier 1 to 5 horses.
Content:
To prevent abuse, being idle in Savage Rift without attacking or installing siege objects will cause an automatic kick-out.
Some changes have been made to the catalogue of Patrigio’s secret shop.
Black Stone (Weapon) x1 and Black Stone (Armor) x1 will no longer appear in the shop.
Kamasylvia monster information has been added to the World Map.
Lv. 58-60 (Party Recommended)   Navarn Steppe
Lv. 59-60 (Party Recommended)   Manshaum Forest
Lv. 59-60 (Party Recommended)   Mirumok Ruins
Fixed the issue where it was possible to build Conquest Forts in Sarma Outpost.
The Buffs that can be bought at the Villas have been modified.
Reminiscence of Old Tree, Noble Man's Grace, and Wisdom of Life have been combined into “Turning Gates.”
Combat Technique, Mercenary’s Experience, and Desert Adaptation have been combined into “Skill and Experience”
Ancient Grindstone, Ancient Hardener, Ancient Invigorant, Will of Knights, and Will of Outlaw have been combined into “Body Enhancement.”
“Turning Gates,” “Skill and Experience,” and “Body Enhancement” cannot be used together, so only one can be used at a time. (Modified)
 For example, if you activate “Skill and Experience” when “Turning Gates” is still in effect, “Turning Gates” will be canceled.
Below are the Buffs available at each Villa, and their prices.
https://i.imgur.com/WcrA2op.png

To enter a Villa, you need the specific Villa Invitation for that Villa. Inside the Villa, talk to NPC Serazad to get a Villa Scroll, which allows you to buy Buffs at the Villa.
The price of a Villa Scroll has been changed to Gold Ingot 100G X1.
Class Changes

All Classes 
Halloween effects for Awakening Skills, Halloween Costumes and Pets have been added.
Special ‘Bat’ effect will be seen when using Awakening skills that consume Black Spirit’s Rage 100% (Excluding Bloody Suit).
Fixed the awkward walking motion while moving via the auto navigation (T key) function.

Berserker 

Pulls in the target on good melee hits” has been added to the description of the skill Devastation.
The PvE damage of the skills Ground Lifting and Flow: General Disarray has been increased.  
Basic Attack (2 Hits)
I 391% → 823%
II 451% → 949%
III 521% → 1093%
Extra Attack (3 Hits)
I 782% → 1175%
II 902% → 1355%
III 1041% → 1562%
Using Ground Lifting during the cooldown time will decrease its damage.
The PvE damage of the skill Titan Blow Iustitiae has been increased.
Normal (7 Hits)
I 632% → 758%
II 772% → 926%
III 913% → 1096%
IV 1052% → 1262%
Charged (7 Hits)
I 1011% → 1175%
II 1235% → 1435%
III 1461% → 1699%
IV 1683% → 1956%
HP recovery effect has been added to the skill Titan Blow (per hit).
The PvE hit damage of the skill Flow: Ancient Wave has been changed from normal hit to charge hit.
“Damage reduced in PvP” has been added to the description of the skill Flow: Ancient Wave.

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 18th 2017
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/Jz3ttG8.jpg
Greetings adventurers,

Halloween is around the corner and Black Desert Online just became a bit more spooky. The red moon rises around this time of the year, which creates mysterious crevices across the entire world of Black Desert. Now, the Black Desert world gets mixed with the dimension of a strange world. New and returning events start today and a broad variety of cosmetic items will help setting the mood.
The patch brings also fixes for several issues as well as game and balance improvements and more.

Event & Systems

Event: 

Halloween event has begun.
October 18th - November 1st, 08:59 UTC
Halloween-themed decorations are added here and there of the world. The big bloody moon will be seen throughout the event period.
Halloween-themed music will be playing in Velia, Heidel, Calpheon City, Altinova, and Valencia City during the event period.
Gueldia the White Witch and Isabella the Black Witch are visiting from the strange world.
Gueldia the White Witch is currently staying at Alejandro Farm. She has a favor to ask to adventurers: to capture and defeat Isabella the Black Witch!
This quest is available once per Family. Players will get a Halloween Gift Box as a reward.
Players can get “Witch’s Bloody Brooch” by defeating Isabella. Hand this over to Gueldia to complete the quest.
Players can also obtain the following items by defeating Isabella.
[Event] Pumpkin Gift Box
[Event] Halloween Pumpkin Cookie
[Event] Halloween Gift Box
Black Stone (Weapon)
Black Stone (Armor)
Memory Fragment
Hunter’s Seal

The following event-quests have been added from which you can obtain Halloween-themed head gears.

https://i.imgur.com/Muhz41Q.png
Event quests can be accepted only during October 18, 09:00 until October 31st, 11:59, UTC.
The rewards are obtainable only from October 18, 09:00 until November 1, 09:00, UTC.
[Event] Sweep the Road for Sweet Jack O’ Lantern quest is available once a day per Family within the event period. However, the other quests are available only once per Family throughout the event.
[Event] Devil’s Night quest is available only during the night time of the game. You will be asked to defeat Thief Imp monster that appears only at night.
The following event-challenges have been added from which you can obtain the event items.

https://i.imgur.com/rt6AMjE.png
[Event] Halloween Coins can be exchanged by the White Witch NPC Gueldia at Alejandro Farm for the following items:

Halloween Coin X30 = Valk’s Advice (+25)
Halloween Coin X50 = Fine Accessory Box X1

You can obtain a [Event] Halloween Gift Box by placing [Event]Halloween Candy Basket X1 and [Event] Halloween Cookie X1 in order in a shape of [-].

Fixed the issue that prevented from applying wei	ght penalty when selling trade items.
Prerequisites for activating Social Actions (emotes) have been added to the Social Action window.
If certain quests need to be completed, you can also check out the prerequisites for receiving those quests.
Mount: 
Characters mounted on [Guild] Elephant cannot perform Force-PvP.
(Force-PvP can be activated again during Node/Conquest Wars.)
If a character with Force-PvP feature activated rides on a [Guild] Elephant, Force-PvP will automatically be deactivated.
Instant Accel or S: Instant Accel on Arduanatt can now be seamlessly followed by Double Jump.
An event field boss Izabella will appear in Costa Farm during the Halloween event period.
Chances of learning skills have been increased for Tier 1 to 5 horses.

 For example, if you activate “Skill and Experience” when “Turning Gates” is still in effect, “Turning Gates” will be canceled.
