[Guild] Tears of the Wind has been added. Revive guild mounts with this item.
More restrictions have been added to using the Upgraded Compass. The compass would not work in servers with on-going Node/Conquest Wars. If your character/mount carries a trade item, the compass will no longer work. It will also not work if the user is currently in a Platoon.
You can use Simple Alchemy to combine Alchemy Stone Shard and Black Stone Powder and obtain Black Stone (Armor).
Mutant Enhancers, obtainable from Savage Rift, can be exchanged into accessories through Gorgath in Calpheon.
Mutant Enhancer x20: Witch's Earring, Mark of ShadowZ
Mutant Enhancer x100: Ogre's Ring
Patrigio's Costume Bag has been removed from all Premium Sets
Pearl shop updated

Mechanic Changes

A Random System has been added to Savage Rift.
After the 10th Wave, there is a chance that a completely new monster might appear.
Players will have devise new strategies to fight random monsters. The chance of encountering a “Random Wave” is quite low.


Monster Changes

New monsters have been added to Kamasylvia.
Manshaum Forest, Navarn Steppe, and Mirumok Ruins are main areas of interest. These are suitable for Lv. 58 and above.
Manshaum Forest is home of Manshaums, ancestors of Mansha Goblins. Manshaum Priest can cast a powerful healing skill, so make sure to team up with other adventurers.
Various monsters appear in Navarn Steppe. It is best to deal with them one-on-one.
Mirumok Ruins is inhabited by the Treants. Those are some of the strongest in Kamasylvia. Forming a party is recommended.
Kamasylvian Monsters have been added.
Monsters native to Kamasylvia are categorized as Kamasylvian Monsters.
Griffon, King Griffon, Ahib’s Griffon have been added to Kamasylvia.
Ohonsey Archer’s attack will no longer have a knockback effect.
A guild raid monster, Mirumok Watcher Offin, has been added to Kamasylvia.
Mirumok Watcher Offin appears in Mirumok Ruins.
Accept the new guild quest [Boss Subjugation] Watcher of Mirumok Ruins and defeat Offin to obtain guild funds as a reward.
If you defeat Offin without first accepting the guild quest, you will not get any rewards.
Attack Offin’s legs first to conduct a more efficient battle.
The following monsters have a chance of yielding Forest Fury.
Manshaum Priest
Manshaum Warrior
Manshaum Great Warrior
Manshaum Hunter
Manshaum Fighter
Ohonsey Archer’s attack will no longer have a knockback effect.


Quest Changes

New quests about the Kamasylvia Territory have been added.
Accept the main quest Kamasylvia, the Land Behind the Veil from Black Spirit, and your journey that encompasses Calpheon, Lemoria Guard Post, and Valtarra Mountains will begin. (For Lv. 58 and above)
New quests have been added to Kamasylvia.
Guard Tower of the Forest
The Unseen Ore
Hidden Power
Ganelle and the Blue Stone
Blue Light of the Guard Tower
A Hunter's Eye
A Merchant’s Eye
[Repeat] Intact Research Material
[Repeat] Mysterious Competitor
New quests have been added to Kamasylvia.
[Repeat] Unwincing Tenacity
[Repeat] Struggle for the Forest
Encouraging Reinforcements
[Repeat] Nutritious Meal for the Wounded
[Repeat] Evidence of Someone
Oily Fish
Forest Angler

Battered Equipment

The Right Balance
New serial quests have been added to Kamasylvia.
Missing Girl
Book Loved by a Girl
The Story of Krogdalo
Facing a Legend
The Untold Secrets
These quests are for Lv. 58 and above.
Altar of Training quest has been added.
Lv. 58 characters can receive this quest from Milford the node manager after completing the quest Token of Lemoria Guards.
After receiving the quest, talk to Milford to obtain Valtarra - Training Manual. You will need to use 100 Energy.
If a party does the quest together, clear the Altar of Training summoned by the party leader so that all party members can complete the quest.
If you failed to complete the quest, talk to Milford again to get Valtarra - Training Manual.
You can receive this quest again 3 days after completing it.

New special quests have been added.
If you have completed [Co-op] Mutant Manshaum Narc, you can now accept [Special IV] Manshaum Mutant (1/D) from Black Spirit.
If you have completed [Co-op] Proof of Courage, you can now accept [Special IV] King of Navarn Steppe (1/W) from Black Spirit.
Be extra careful since King of Navarn Steppe is quite powerful.
New knowledges have been added.
Fadus Ascetic
The Nature of Valtarra Training
New knowledge cards have been added.
Mirumok Watcher Offin
Watcher Offin Tett
These knowledge cards can be obtained by raising Amity points with Kamasylvian NPCs.
Mirumok Destroyer Offin knowledge card has been added.
It can be obtained by raising Amity points with Anbelif in Old Wisdom Tree.
A new knowledge theme about Kamasylvian animals has been added.
New knowledge cards have been added to the theme Kamasylvia Entrance Adventure Journal II.
Fireless Forge
Blue Stone that Revived the Forest
Forest: Guard Tower of Nature
Forest: Guard Tower of Water
Forest: Guard Tower of Wind
These knowledge cards can be obtained via new Kamasylvia quests or object interactions.
An image of NPC Novara has been added to its knowledge card.
A new quest series, “Black Spirit’s Gift II” has been added.
Players can effortlessly get to this series while following the Black Spirit main quest line for Lv. 1-50.
Complete these quests to obtain gear items useful up to Lv. 50.
Available only once per family.
Daily quests for Savage Rift have been added.
[Repeat] Face the Endless Army
New story quests have been added for the Mediah region.
Darkness Between Rocks
Document Hidden by Cultists
Black Seal
Trace of the Fallen Kingdom
The Last Prophecy
Shadow upon Iliya Island
Difficulties of Vigilantes
Do-or-Die Resistance
Invasion from Above
Shadow Behind the Rift
Black Ambition
Now you can catch Rare/Big fishes in the sea near Velia.


Interface Changes

Now you can search for Dream Horses and Dream Horse Skills in the Horse Market.
Courser Training has been added to the Mount category in the Marketplace.
Courser training window UI has been changed.
Training gauge will be filled according to the number of items you put in. (Maximum 100 items)
The sum of training gauge for 3 skills cannot exceed 200%, and a single skill’s training gauge cannot exceed 100%.
Fixed the abnormal placement of NPC, Conversation icon, and Knowledge icon in Cropping mode.
You can now close panels with the ESC key while fishing.
Fixed the flickering Knowledge screen.
Summoned maids will not show on the Minimap.
A tooltip has been added to the option “Discard useless items caught during Auto Fish.”
Skill window scroll will now be reset when closing and opening it again.
Guild promotion function has been added to the Guild window (G).
“View Ranking” option has been added to Settings > Game Options.
In-game alert messages have been added for Savage Rift.
(“You can finely rotate with the ‘[’ or ‘ ] ‘ key.”)
Item link icons in the chat will now display actual item icons.
Tooltips have been added to each option in Chat Window Settings.
Now you can follow channels, check out channel feed, and read/write comments on BDO TV live channel through the ESC menu.
Fixed the issue where the help window would not pop up in Dye screen.
Monster Ranking has been added to the ESC menu.
Check out which guild finished Mirumok Watcher Offin and Mirumok Destroyer Offin the fastest.
Accept the guild quest "[Boss Subjugation] Mirumok Watcher Offin" and interact with Offin to start the Time Attack mode. Defeat the boss within the time limit.
The leaderboard is not updated in real-time. Check back some time after defeating the boss.
If a single guild tried multiple Time Attacks, their best record will be posted.



Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where attacking Savage Rift monsters with matchlocks would not work properly.
The base color of the Savage Rift atmospheric effect has been changed.
To prevent abuse, the auto-reconnect feature will now only work when the character's HP is full.
Pet buff rules have been slightly changed. Pet buffs will still be effective even if the hunger gauge is empty. However, the pet will not loot items in this case.
Fixed the issue where blood stains did not show up and looked awkward on enemies upon attack.
Being attacked by bigger monsters such as World Bosses, Ogre, and Cyclops will inflict bigger blood effects. The effect will be shown right in front of the character's perspective.
Blood effect when hitting middle sized monsters that are smaller than Ogre, Cyclops (e.g. Troll) will be bigger than the effect of small sized monsters.
“Skip Animated Effect” function has been added to Item Reform.
In the PvP server, the system message that notifies players of Karma deduction will not be displayed when attacking Calpheon protesters or wild horses.
Fixed the slow rendering issue on objects and characters such as Wandering Rogue Obsidian Altar.
Fixed the issue that softened your own sound effects when softening other players' sound volume in the settings.
Fixed the issue that omitted attack sound effects when using Berserker Axes and Warrior Great Swords on mid-sized monsters.
Fixed the issue where the horse call icon would be highlighted in blue even if there was no Horse Flute.
Fixed the graphical glitch for [Berserker] BD9 Helmet.
The name of Central Camp region is now called Central Guard Camp.
The tooltip of Lafi Bedmountain's Upgraded Compass has been corrected as “※ Cannot be used when You or the Mount you are on is carrying Trade items.”
Fixed the typos of Treant Outfit where the name Camouflage was applied wrong.
Fixed the issue that prevented players from selling Waterway and Scarecrow to NPC shops.


Policy Changes
Our privacy policy has been updated with the following information:
When using services provided by Kakao Games Europe, we may collect your session information, including your IP address, your MAC address, your hardware information, the time your session was begun, how long it lasted, how and when it ended.


To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes to be added soon - check here the list

Mechanic Changes

Monster Changes

New monsters have been added to Kamasylvia.
Manshaum Forest, Navarn Steppe, and Mirumok Ruins are main areas of interest. These are suitable for Lv. 58 and above.
Manshaum Forest is home of Manshaums, ancestors of Mansha Goblins. Manshaum Priest can cast a powerful healing skill, so make sure to team up with other adventurers.
Various monsters appear in Navarn Steppe. It is best to deal with them one-on-one.
Mirumok Ruins is inhabited by the Treants. Those are some of the strongest in Kamasylvia. Forming a party is recommended.

If you defeat Offin without first accepting the guild quest, you will not get any rewards.
Attack Offin’s legs first to conduct a more efficient battle.

Quest Changes

New quests about the Kamasylvia Territory have been added.

After receiving the quest, talk to Milford to obtain Valtarra - Training Manual. You will need to use 100 Energy.
If a party does the quest together, clear the Altar of Training summoned by the party leader so that all party members can complete the quest.
If you failed to complete the quest, talk to Milford again to get Valtarra - Training Manual.
You can receive this quest again 3 days after completing it.

New special quests have been added.
If you have completed [Co-op] Mutant Manshaum Narc, you can now accept [Special IV] Manshaum Mutant (1/D) from Black Spirit.

Interface Changes

Now you can search for Dream Horses and Dream Horse Skills in the Horse Market.
Courser Training has been added to the Mount category in the Marketplace.

Training gauge will be filled according to the number of items you put in. (Maximum 100 items)
The sum of training gauge for 3 skills cannot exceed 200%, and a single skill’s training gauge cannot exceed 100%.
Fixed the abnormal placement of NPC, Conversation icon, and Knowledge icon in Cropping mode.
You can now close panels with the ESC key while fishing.
Fixed the flickering Knowledge screen.
Summoned maids will not show on the Minimap.
A tooltip has been added to the option “Discard useless items caught during Auto Fish.”
Skill window scroll will now be reset when closing and opening it again.
Guild promotion function has been added to the Guild window (G).
“View Ranking” option has been added to Settings > Game Options.
In-game alert messages have been added for Savage Rift.
(“You can finely rotate with the ‘[’ or ‘ ] ‘ key.”)
Item link icons in the chat will now display actual item icons.
Tooltips have been added to each option in Chat Window Settings.
Now you can follow channels, check out channel feed, and read/write comments on BDO TV live channel through the ESC menu.
Fixed the issue where the help window would not pop up in Dye screen.
Monster Ranking has been added to the ESC menu.
Check out which guild finished Mirumok Watcher Offin and Mirumok Destroyer Offin the fastest.
Accept the guild quest "[Boss Subjugation] Mirumok Watcher Offin" and interact with Offin to start the Time Attack mode. Defeat the boss within the time limit.
The leaderboard is not updated in real-time. Check back some time after defeating the boss.
If a single guild tried multiple Time Attacks, their best record will be posted.



Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where attacking Savage Rift monsters with matchlocks would not work properly.
The base color of the Savage Rift atmospheric effect has been changed.
To prevent abuse, the auto-reconnect feature will now only work when the character's HP is full.
Pet buff rules have been slightly changed. Pet buffs will still be effective even if the hunger gauge is empty. However, the pet will not loot items in this case.
Fixed the issue where blood stains did not show up and looked awkward on enemies upon attack.
Being attacked by bigger monsters such as World Bosses, Ogre, and Cyclops will inflict bigger blood effects. The effect will be shown right in front of the character's perspective.
Blood effect when hitting middle sized monsters that are smaller than Ogre, Cyclops (e.g. Troll) will be bigger than the effect of small sized monsters.
“Skip Animated Effect” function has been added to Item Reform.
In the PvP server, the system message that notifies players of Karma deduction will not be displayed when attacking Calpheon protesters or wild horses.
Fixed the slow rendering issue on objects and characters such as Wandering Rogue Obsidian Altar.
Fixed the issue that softened your own sound effects when softening other players' sound volume in the settings.
Fixed the issue that omitted attack sound effects when using Berserker Axes and Warrior Great Swords on mid-sized monsters.
Fixed the issue where the horse call icon would be highlighted in blue even if there was no Horse Flute.
Fixed the graphical glitch for [Berserker] BD9 Helmet.
The name of Central Camp region is now called Central Guard Camp.
The tooltip of Lafi Bedmountain's Upgraded Compass has been corrected as “※ Cannot be used when You or the Mount you are on is carrying Trade items.”
Fixed the typos of Treant Outfit where the name Camouflage was applied wrong.
Fixed the issue that prevented players from selling Waterway and Scarecrow to NPC shops.


Policy Changes
Our privacy policy has been updated with the following information:
When using services provided by Kakao Games Europe, we may collect your session information, including your IP address, your MAC address, your hardware information, the time your session was begun, how long it lasted, how and when it ended.

notes.title: Patch Notes - September 27th 2017 [Part 1]
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/ptF7qel.jpg
Greetings Adventurers,

This week update brings many new things most notably the eagerly awaited Kamasylvia I content. But that’s not all. There are new and also returning events to take part in, class balance has been improved, Savage Rift now offers a queue system has been improved, Savage Rift offers now a queue system and much more ~1.48 GB.

Event & Systems

Content: 

A new region, Kamasylvia, has been unveiled.

New nodes, NPCs, and knowledge themes related to Kamasylvia have been added.
Kamasylvia is open for all adventurers. However, the journey becomes even smoother if your character is at least Lv. 58.
If you feel that Kamasylvia is too difficult to tackle, try teaming up with other adventurers.


Introducing Altar of Training

Following the Kamasylvia main quests will lead you to Altar of Training.
At the altar, use the item “Valtarra: Training Manual” you’ve obtained from a quest to start the training.
You need to defend a sacred object from a swarm of monsters.
Once the training begins, you will see the location of the Sacrament you have to protect.
Defeat all monsters rushing toward the Sacrament!


A new horse, Arduanatt, has finally landed on Kamasylvia.

Arduanatt can spread its gorgeous wings to gently glide down from above.
If your Lv. 30, tier 8 Courser has filled the training gauge up to 200%, you can try awakening your Courser with NPC Gula at Stonetail Horse Ranch using Krogdalo's Origin Stone.
Your Courser will transform into Arduanatt if the awakening attempt succeeds. If it fails, the training gauge will be reset. (If you use Cron Stones, your Courser will lose only 50% of the entire training gauge.)
Dream Horses such as Arduanatt can learn different skills which normal horses cannot learn.


https://i.imgur.com/SuEorGV.png

More details of “Courser” system has been unveiled.

A foal born to two Coursers is given 2 skills at birth.
A foal born to a Courser and a horse is given 1-2 skill(s) at birth.
Your Lv. 30, tier 8 Courser can be trained through NPC Gula at Stonetail Horse Ranch.After the training, you can try awakening your Courser.


New titles related to Kamasylvian monsters and quests have been added.

Protector of Endangered Species

Out of my way!

Lemoria Expedition Member


Fishes native to Kamasylvia have been added to the Fish Encyclopedia.

Stonetail Fodder recipe has been added to the Simple Cooking system.

Take 2 types of any Farming byproduct and use Simple Cooking to make Stonetail Fodder.
The mixing ratio may vary depending on which byproduct you choose to put in.


Krogdalo's Origin Stone recipe has been added to the Simple Alchemy system.

Pure Forest Breath recipe has been added to the Simple Alchemy system.

Pure Forest Breath recipe has been added to the Simple Alchemy system.


Horse Gear Workshop has been added to the house Stonetail Horse Ranch 3.

Granverre horse gears can be crafted at this address.


Event: 

The event Kamasylvian Alchemists has been added.

Start: September 27th
End: after maintenance - October 25th


Grab a chance to obtain a high-grade accessory from [Events] Shiny Kamasylvia Box. You can collect materials to make the box from monsters, gathering, and fishing all over the world.


Summary

1. Obtain [Event] Steppe Seal and [Event] Meadow Trail through killing monsters, fishing, gathering, and Challenges.
2. Produce [Event] Kamasylvia Box through Simple Alchemy (L key).
3. Produce [Events] Shiny Kamasylvia Box through Simple Alchemy (L key).
After the maintenance on September 27, you can obtain [Event] Steppe Seal and [Event] Meadow Trail all over the world through monsters, fishing, and gathering.
From September 28, 00:00, you can claim 3 [Event] Steppe Seals every hour from the Challenges window.
Challenges will be completed every hour, and you can complete up to 6 Challenges per day.
From September 28, 00:00, you can claim 1 [Event] Meadow Trail 6 hours after connecting to the game.
1 Trail available for 6-hour playtime. Maximum 1 per day.


Processing Formula
How to produce [Event] Kamasylvia Box and [Event] Shiny Kamasylvia Box

Collect [Event] Steppe Seal x20 > Use Simple Alchemy (L key) > Get [Event] Kamasylvia Box
Collect [Event] Kamasylvia Box x20 + [Event] Meadow Trail x20 > Use Simple Alchemy (L key) > Get [Events] Shiny Kamasylvia Box


What’s in the Box

[Event] Kamasylvia Box
Sharp Black Crystal Shard, Hard Black Crystal Shard, Memory Fragment, Black Stone (Weapon), Black Stone (Armor), Spirit Essence of Wind, Spirit Essence of Earth, Spirit Essence of Water.
You can get one of the above

[Events] Shiny Kamasylvia Box

Resplendent Alchemy Stone of Destruction, Laytenn’s Power Stone, Ogre Ring, Basilisk's Belt, Ring of Crescent Guardian, Blue Whale Molar Earring, Tree Spirit Belt
You can get one of the above



Spread Your Wings! The event has begun in celebration of the Arduanatt release.

Start: September 27 after maintenance
End: October 18 before maintenance
Mount EXP +10% during the event period!


Better Together! Growth of a Young Kamasylve Tree event.

Start: September 27 after maintenance
End: October 4 before maintenance

A young Kamasylve tree is planted next to Herawen in Kamasylve Temple, Mediah.
Accept the quest [Event] Sacred Energy of Spirit from NPC Cartima in front of Golden Toad Inn in Heidel to get a “Bowl of Spirit.”
Give the bowl to Herawen in Kamasilve Temple and spend 10 Energy to obtain “Energy of Spirit.”
Accept the quest [Event] Young Kamasylve Tree from Herawen, and give the “Energy of Spirit” to the Kamasylve tree through dialogue.
The number of Energy of Spirit given to the Kamasylve tree will be counted per server. The tree will grow after the 500 counts for the first time, and every 1000 counts thereafter. (500/1000/2000/3000)
You cannot give any more Energy of Spirit to a Lv. 5 tree. You will then have to try another tree in a different server.
Both quests can be completed once a day. Complete both of them to obtain [Event] Gift of Spirit as a reward.



Contents of [Event] Gift of Spirit

Kzarka's Sealed Weapon Box
Ogre Ring
Advice of Valks(+25 - 35)
+2 Silver Embroidered Clothes Box
Black Magic Crystal - Harphia

Sharp Black Crystal Shard Bundle: 3

“Go for the Golden Treasure Chest!” event awaits you!
With this event, a series of awesome rewards have been added to the Challenges window where you can claim rewards for playing the game for a fixed period of time every day!

New [Boss Subjugation]: Defeat Mirumok Offin has been added. Through this guild mission, your guild can obtain guild funds and skill EXP for taking down the ultimate monster.

Start: September 27 after maintenance
End: October 11, 09:00 UTC.

Step1. Under Guild Mission in Guild Window, a Guild Master or a Guild Officer accepts the [Boss Subjugation] Mirumok Watcher Offin mission
Step2. Event automatically entered upon completion of the mission.

Rewards:

Guild Funds: 200,000,000 Silvers
Golden Bell

Combat EXP will increase +100% for the next 1 hour in the entire server of the user.
Adventurers in servers with Golden Bell buff applied will receive extra boost in EXP.


*Rewards above will be distributed on the following maintenance after the event.​


Black Spirit's Adventure has returned.

Start: September 27 after maintenance
End: Until October 25 before maintenance


While you’re out exploring the new Kamasylvia content, make sure you snap some screenshots along the way and show them off in the Kamasylvia Screenshot and Fan Art Contests!

Find out more information on the Screenshot Contest here.
Find our more information on the Fan Art Contest here.


System: 

Optimization Options’ has been added to ‘Performance’ tab under Game Settings.
Under Optimization options, you can set the frame optimization, pet settings, and more.
Auto Frame Optimizer will be ticked automatically.
Optimization Options can also be set under Screen tab of the Game Settings and the settings can be reset here.
Effect Optimization will control the effects shown on the other characters. Moving the control bar towards ‘max’ statistic would smooth out the skill effects.
Selecting ‘Update Cycle Optimization’ will by priority show the movements of other characters closest to you first. Characters rather distant away may, under circumstances, show awkwardness in movement and graphical slowdown.
Character Optimization will help to show other characters within the distance of your settings in case FPS drops due to having too many objects and characters around. NPCs outside the distance you set will not be visible as well. However, pets, mounts, and summoned creatures will be displayed properly even if they are far away.
If FPS drops due to having too many characters around, press [Shift + F5] to make invisible all other characters except for hostile characters. This function is applicable regardless of Character Optimization, and even party members and guild members will become invisible. If another character triggers Force PvP and launches an attack, the attacking character will appear however.
FPS optimization is continuously under development and we’ll provide more improvements in the near future.
Background music has been added to the Kamasylvia Territory.
New NPC voices have been added including singing npc’s in the Kamasylvia territory.
If you obtain a Dream Horse, the horse’s name will be broadcast through the World Notification.

⬐⬐⬐Secondary password system has been added.⬎⬎⬎
A new secondary authentication system is being added for steam users to aid in account security.

Players attempting to log in from different devices (Computers) will be required to enter a secondary authentication code to register their device before being able to successfully log in and play.
The secondary authentication code will be sent to the email address in which the account was registered under.
Once the device has been registered, players will not be required to re-authorize the device and may launch the game with no additional steps required.

Please note there is no limit to the maximum number of devices that may be registered.



Word filtering is now also applied when finding characters through Black-Robed Man.

You can now change the order of pets when they are stored.

Queue system has been added to Savage Rift.

You can join a queue only on your current server.
Changing the server after joining a queue will void the reservation.
You can only join a queue when the game is already in progress.
A message will be sent to the player when the game finishes. Players can enter the game through the message.

notes.title: Patch Notes - September 27th 2017 [Part 1]
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/ptF7qel.jpg
Greetings Adventurers,

This week update brings many new things most notably the eagerly awaited Kamasylvia I content. But that’s not all. There are new and also returning events to take part in, class balance has been improved, Savage Rift now offers a queue system has been improved, Savage Rift offers now a queue system and much more ~1.48 GB.

Event & Systems

Content: 

A new region, Kamasylvia, has been unveiled.

New nodes, NPCs, and knowledge themes related to Kamasylvia have been added.
Kamasylvia is open for all adventurers. However, the journey becomes even smoother if your character is at least Lv. 58.
If you feel that Kamasylvia is too difficult to tackle, try teaming up with other adventurers.


Introducing Altar of Training

Following the Kamasylvia main quests will lead you to Altar of Training.
At the altar, use the item “Valtarra: Training Manual” you’ve obtained from a quest to start the training.
You need to defend a sacred object from a swarm of monsters.
Once the training begins, you will see the location of the Sacrament you have to protect.
Defeat all monsters rushing toward the Sacrament!


A new horse, Arduanatt, has finally landed on Kamasylvia.

Arduanatt can spread its gorgeous wings to gently glide down from above.
If your Lv. 30, tier 8 Courser has filled the training gauge up to 200%, you can try awakening your Courser with NPC Gula at Stonetail Horse Ranch using Krogdalo's Origin Stone.
Your Courser will transform into Arduanatt if the awakening attempt succeeds. If it fails, the training gauge will be reset. (If you use Cron Stones, your Courser will lose only 50% of the entire training gauge.)
Dream Horses such as Arduanatt can learn different skills which normal horses cannot learn.


https://i.imgur.com/SuEorGV.png

More details of “Courser” system has been unveiled.

A foal born to two Coursers is given 2 skills at birth.
A foal born to a Courser and a horse is given 1-2 skill(s) at birth.
Your Lv. 30, tier 8 Courser can be trained through NPC Gula at Stonetail Horse Ranch.After the training, you can try awakening your Courser.


New titles related to Kamasylvian monsters and quests have been added.

Protector of Endangered Species
Catch an Ogre Ring with your nose!
Hope to Fly
Dominator of the Sky
Moguly's Friend
King of the Wild
Stand Alone
Naughty
Young Heart
YOLO
Chief
Bugaboo!
Narc!
Almost Heaven, Kamasylvia
Out of my way!
Run, Forrest, Run!
Lemoria Expedition Member


Fishes native to Kamasylvia have been added to the Fish Encyclopedia.

Stonetail Fodder recipe has been added to the Simple Cooking system.

Take 2 types of any Farming byproduct and use Simple Cooking to make Stonetail Fodder.
The mixing ratio may vary depending on which byproduct you choose to put in.


Krogdalo's Origin Stone recipe has been added to the Simple Alchemy system.

Pure Forest Breath recipe has been added to the Simple Alchemy system.

Pure Forest Breath recipe has been added to the Simple Alchemy system.


Horse Gear Workshop has been added to the house Stonetail Horse Ranch 3.

Granverre horse gears can be crafted at this address.


Event: 

The event Kamasylvian Alchemists has been added.

Start: September 27th
End: after maintenance - October 25th


Grab a chance to obtain a high-grade accessory from [Events] Shiny Kamasylvia Box. You can collect materials to make the box from monsters, gathering, and fishing all over the world.


Summary

1. Obtain [Event] Steppe Seal and [Event] Meadow Trail through killing monsters, fishing, gathering, and Challenges.
2. Produce [Event] Kamasylvia Box through Simple Alchemy (L key).
3. Produce [Events] Shiny Kamasylvia Box through Simple Alchemy (L key).
After the maintenance on September 27, you can obtain [Event] Steppe Seal and [Event] Meadow Trail all over the world through monsters, fishing, and gathering.
From September 28, 00:00, you can claim 3 [Event] Steppe Seals every hour from the Challenges window.
Challenges will be completed every hour, and you can complete up to 6 Challenges per day.
From September 28, 00:00, you can claim 1 [Event] Meadow Trail 6 hours after connecting to the game.
1 Trail available for 6-hour playtime. Maximum 1 per day.


Processing Formula
How to produce [Event] Kamasylvia Box and [Event] Shiny Kamasylvia Box

Collect [Event] Steppe Seal x20 > Use Simple Alchemy (L key) > Get [Event] Kamasylvia Box
Collect [Event] Kamasylvia Box x20 + [Event] Meadow Trail x20 > Use Simple Alchemy (L key) > Get [Events] Shiny Kamasylvia Box


What’s in the Box

[Event] Kamasylvia Box
Sharp Black Crystal Shard, Hard Black Crystal Shard, Memory Fragment, Black Stone (Weapon), Black Stone (Armor), Spirit Essence of Wind, Spirit Essence of Earth, Spirit Essence of Water.
You can get one of the above

[Events] Shiny Kamasylvia Box

Resplendent Alchemy Stone of Destruction, Laytenn’s Power Stone, Ogre Ring, Basilisk's Belt, Ring of Crescent Guardian, Blue Whale Molar Earring, Tree Spirit Belt
You can get one of the above



Spread Your Wings! The event has begun in celebration of the Arduanatt release.

Start: September 27 after maintenance
End: October 18 before maintenance
Mount EXP +10% during the event period!


Better Together! Growth of a Young Kamasylve Tree event.

Start: September 27 after maintenance
End: October 4 before maintenance

A young Kamasylve tree is planted next to Herawen in Kamasylve Temple, Mediah.
Accept the quest [Event] Sacred Energy of Spirit from NPC Cartima in front of Golden Toad Inn in Heidel to get a “Bowl of Spirit.”
Give the bowl to Herawen in Kamasilve Temple and spend 10 Energy to obtain “Energy of Spirit.”
Accept the quest [Event] Young Kamasylve Tree from Herawen, and give the “Energy of Spirit” to the Kamasylve tree through dialogue.
The number of Energy of Spirit given to the Kamasylve tree will be counted per server. The tree will grow after the 500 counts for the first time, and every 1000 counts thereafter. (500/1000/2000/3000)
You cannot give any more Energy of Spirit to a Lv. 5 tree. You will then have to try another tree in a different server.
Both quests can be completed once a day. Complete both of them to obtain [Event] Gift of Spirit as a reward.



Contents of [Event] Gift of Spirit

Kzarka's Sealed Weapon Box
Ogre Ring
Advice of Valks(+25 - 35)
+2 Silver Embroidered Clothes Box
Black Magic Crystal - Harphia
Magic Crystal of Infinity - Experience
Sharp Black Crystal Shard Bundle: 3
Hard Black Crystal Shard Bundle: 3
Necklace of Shultz the Gladiator
Red Coral Earring
Golden Backpack
Ancient Guardian's Seal
Ancient Weapon Core
Tough Whale Tendon Elixir
Whale Tendon Elixir
Sharp Black Crystal Shard
Hard Black Crystal Shard
Cron Stone
Magic Butcher Knife
Magic Tanning Knife
[Mix] Time-Training Elixir
[Mix] EXP-Reaper Elixir
Black Stone (Armor)


“Go for the Golden Treasure Chest!” event awaits you!
With this event, a series of awesome rewards have been added to the Challenges window where you can claim rewards for playing the game for a fixed period of time every day!

New [Boss Subjugation]: Defeat Mirumok Offin has been added. Through this guild mission, your guild can obtain guild funds and skill EXP for taking down the ultimate monster.

Start: September 27 after maintenance
End: October 11, 09:00 UTC.

Step1. Under Guild Mission in Guild Window, a Guild Master or a Guild Officer accepts the [Boss Subjugation] Mirumok Watcher Offin mission
Step2. Event automatically entered upon completion of the mission.

Rewards:

Guild Funds: 200,000,000 Silvers
Golden Bell

Combat EXP will increase +100% for the next 1 hour in the entire server of the user.
Adventurers in servers with Golden Bell buff applied will receive extra boost in EXP.


*Rewards above will be distributed on the following maintenance after the event.​


Black Spirit's Adventure has returned.

Start: September 27 after maintenance
End: Until October 25 before maintenance


While you’re out exploring the new Kamasylvia content, make sure you snap some screenshots along the way and show them off in the Kamasylvia Screenshot and Fan Art Contests!

Find out more information on the Screenshot Contest here.
Find our more information on the Fan Art Contest here.


System: 

Optimization Options’ has been added to ‘Performance’ tab under Game Settings.
Under Optimization options, you can set the frame optimization, pet settings, and more.
Auto Frame Optimizer will be ticked automatically.
Optimization Options can also be set under Screen tab of the Game Settings and the settings can be reset here.
Effect Optimization will control the effects shown on the other characters. Moving the control bar towards ‘max’ statistic would smooth out the skill effects.
Selecting ‘Update Cycle Optimization’ will by priority show the movements of other characters closest to you first. Characters rather distant away may, under circumstances, show awkwardness in movement and graphical slowdown.
Character Optimization will help to show other characters within the distance of your settings in case FPS drops due to having too many objects and characters around. NPCs outside the distance you set will not be visible as well. However, pets, mounts, and summoned creatures will be displayed properly even if they are far away.
If FPS drops due to having too many characters around, press [Shift + F5] to make invisible all other characters except for hostile characters. This function is applicable regardless of Character Optimization, and even party members and guild members will become invisible. If another character triggers Force PvP and launches an attack, the attacking character will appear however.
FPS optimization is continuously under development and we’ll provide more improvements in the near future.
Background music has been added to the Kamasylvia Territory.
New NPC voices have been added including singing npc’s in the Kamasylvia territory.
If you obtain a Dream Horse, the horse’s name will be broadcast through the World Notification.

⬐⬐⬐Secondary password system has been added.⬎⬎⬎
A new secondary authentication system is being added for steam users to aid in account security.

Players attempting to log in from different devices (Computers) will be required to enter a secondary authentication code to register their device before being able to successfully log in and play.
The secondary authentication code will be sent to the email address in which the account was registered under.
Once the device has been registered, players will not be required to re-authorize the device and may launch the game with no additional steps required.

Please note there is no limit to the maximum number of devices that may be registered.



Word filtering is now also applied when finding characters through Black-Robed Man.

You can now change the order of pets when they are stored.

Queue system has been added to Savage Rift.

You can join a queue only on your current server.
Changing the server after joining a queue will void the reservation.
You can only join a queue when the game is already in progress.
A message will be sent to the player when the game finishes. Players can enter the game through the message.


NPC. Effect:

Marketplace Director NPC Auciel Renf has been added to Old Wisdom Tree.

New NPC lines and dialogues have been added to Kamasylvia.

Courser training effects have been added.

notes.title: Patch Notes - September 13th 2017
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/pNoXF9p.jpg
Greetings Adventurers,

Chase away the autumn chills with a pint! This week we are excited to bring you Beer Festival which is a great way for all to build up on silvers and draft beers! As the mountains and trees turn coat, please enjoy the autumn theme being added in-game. Also, Guild Screenshot contest and Pearl Sales prizes will be sent out!
Last but not least, we are excited to announce the long-waited, an exclusive PvP server added for those waiting to battle it out.
This week’s patch will be ~742,53MB.

Event & Systems

Event: 


Oktoberfest World Theme:

Start: September 13th, 09:00 UTC
End: September 27th 08:00 UTC

Patrigio’s Costume Bag has been included for every Premium Set.

From September 13th to September 27th, 09:00

New Attendance Rewards has been added.

Start: September 21st 00:00 UTC
End: October 25th 23:59 UTC

Beer Festival Quests have been added.

Duration: September 14th, 07:00 to October 18th, 09:00 (UTC)
Complete the initial Quests below starting at Heidel

https://i.imgur.com/9UJ7vJr.png

Starting NPC: Pasvinder at Heidel
Quest Receiving Period: Sep. 14, 07:00 - Oct. 11, 23:59
Only available once per family
[Event] Imperial Craft Delivery Invoice X5 will be given out to Adventurers who finished the final Quest.
Once the initial Quests above are done, the following Daily Quests are available:
Out of the 4 Daily Quests, you can choose only 1 per day.
Regardless of which City you are at, only 1 Daily Quest is available per Family.
[Event] Imperial Craft Delivery Invoice X5 will be also given out to Adventurers who finished any 1 of the 4 Daily Quests.

https://i.imgur.com/xqRhr5z.png


System: 


A PvP Server Valencia6_PvP has been added.

Please note this server will have the addition of line _PvP to the title to indicate the unique ruleset.
The PvP server will allow players to battle other players and target mounts without experiencing a decrease in Karma. This is applied for damaging and/or killing off the targeted player or mount.
In addition, defeating monsters that would normally decrease your Karma will not do so anymore.
However, adventurers with Karma less than 0 (-1 or below) may be attacked by vigilantes in towns.
In addition, adventurers with Karma less than 0 (-1 or below) who are killed by other adventurers in the desert may be teleported to prisons.
PvP Server will not affect your Karma but the Karma and Penalty System you would have in other regular servers will be reflected the same.
If you die with Karma below a certain statistic, you will still be applied the same death penalty as you would receive in the other regular servers so please be cautious.
*please ignore the pop-up message saying the karma will be decreased after a mount has been killed in the PVP channel. (text it will be removed soon)

4 New Servers have been added under the Server Group name: Kamasylvia. You know what that means… Kamasylvia Part 1 coming real soon!

These servers will be listed in a similar fashion to the already existing servers, for example:

NA_Kamasylvia1 or EU_Kamasylvia1
NA_Kamasylvia2 or EU_Kamasylvia2
And so on, up to the fourth server.


Players will be granted 30 points upon starting the Savage Rift.
The time limit for the bosses from stages 5, 10, 15, and 20 of the Savage Rift has been adjusted to 5 minutes.

The next stage will start if players fail to defeat the bosses within the time limit.
If the boss is defeated, the next stage will start after 30 seconds.

HP of the Savage Rift Boss monsters has been increased.
Text for upgrading steel barricades in Savage Rift has been changed.
Savage Rift shop can be closed with the ESC key. The Shop window UI can also be moved around.
Fixed the issue where installed objects were still showing after defeating the last boss in Savage Rift.
Pets will be automatically hidden during Conquest and Node Wars.


Class Changes
All Classes 

Skills learned through level-up will not be automatically registered to the Quick Slot.
Fixed the issue where previous passive skill icons were still showing after learning a new passive skill.
Walking in auto-run mode can now be activated or deactivated by pressing CapsLock Key once. (No need to hold the Key)


Warrior 


The basic mounted attack effect for the Warrior has been modified to suit the character.


Sorceress 


Fixed the graphical glitch for [Sorceress] Cavaro Helmet.


Berserker 


Fixed the issue where the Bound effect against monsters triggered with the two-hand smash attack from the skill Frenzied Destroyer was not being applied correctly.
The Bound effect of the passive skill Frenzied Destroyer that is activated via the skill Quaking Fury on its last good hit, which was only applied in PvE, is now also applied in PvP.
Fixed the damage value discrepancy of the skill Flame Buster when it is used with RMB.


Witch


Fixed the attack de-sync issue with Tett when using the skill Thunder Storm.


Wizard


The skill Lava Field can now be used through Quick Slot normally while the Wizard is standing still.


Maehwa

Ninja & Kunoichi

Normal hit damage will be applied to the skill Fox Claw along with the existing Stiffness effect.
The damage range of the skill Fox Claw has been increased to include the targets in front of the character. (The range of the Stiffness effect did not change.)
The skill Shadow Slash can now be used with Heart Aiming as a combo.
Removed the conflicted text “immune to attacks for 20 seconds” from the description of the skill Shadow Cloak.

The following items are added in Pearl Shop:

Elric Follower

Red Nose and Dastard Bheg (from quests [Boss] Black Spirit and the Giant Imp and [Boss] Frenzied Altar Imp Captain, respectively) will display the attack range before performing strong attacks.

Shultz Guard monsters will not drop following items.

Shultz Guard monsters now have a higher chance of dropping Forbidden Books.
HP of Shultz Guard monsters has been decreased, and they will yield more combat EXP.
Fixed the issue where players would sometimes fail to see the Spectre of Margoria when they encounter Margoria Phantom Ships.


Quest Changes

'Finlin' Quest has to be completed in order to start 'Someone Else's Treasure' Quest.
HP of the monster Incarnation of Illezra has been significantly reduced.
Fixed the issue where players could keep accepting the quest [Event] Meals Are Not To Be Skipped from Terrmian Waterpark.


Interface Changes

Social Action button has been added to the ESC menu.
A title has been added to the Social Action window.
Social Action keywords are case sensitive and you can’t designate more than one word as a keyword.
3 new Social Actions have been added.
Activate Social Actions by inputting the Keywords below, or click on the Actions you want from Social Action Window, after achieving certain conditions.

https://i.imgur.com/IYZyKx1.png

Clicking on Cancel after adjusting the transparency bar in Chat Option should now revert the window to the previous state.
Camera effects were added for entering and exiting Dye and Pearl Shop. The same effect will also be applied for the Knowledge (H) screen.
Knowledge (H) Screen’s question-mark-shaped icon showing undiscovered knowledge, has been re-applied.
The top-down drop animation has been added to the Item Reform screen.
Item link in the chat would now reflect the item’s grade through color.
Help tooltip would not be blocked by objects.
Players can now directly check pet skills of active pets from the Pet List window.
The Attributes and Amity panel in the Conversation screen can now be dragged and relocated.
The backlight in the character customization, dye, and Pearl Shop screens has been softened.


Resolved Issues

Fixed the issue where a Korean string was exposed after selecting Miniature Elephant in World Map's stable.

Fixed the issue where R key would not work if Black Spirit is summoned while the Event Page window is open.
Fixed the system message that appears while registering Guild Emblem, when there is no [Guild] Guild Emblem Certificate.
Fixed the issue where Pet Info window was blocked by the Pet list window.
Fixed the issue where the repair cost displayed in the pop-up prompt from the repair screen would not properly show thousand separators.

notes.title: Patch Notes - September 13th 2017
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/pNoXF9p.jpg
Greetings Adventurers,

Chase away the autumn chills with a pint! This week we are excited to bring you Beer Festival which is a great way for all to build up on silvers and draft beers! As the mountains and trees turn coat, please enjoy the autumn theme being added in-game. Also, Guild Screenshot contest and Pearl Sales prizes will be sent out!
Last but not least, we are excited to announce the long-waited, an exclusive PvP server added for those waiting to battle it out.
This week’s patch will be ~742,53MB.

Event & Systems

Event: 


Oktoberfest World Theme:

Start: September 13th, 09:00 UTC
End: September 27th 08:00 UTC

Patrigio’s Costume Bag has been included for every Premium Set.

From September 13th to September 27th, 09:00

New Attendance Rewards has been added.

Start: September 21st 00:00 UTC
End: October 25th 23:59 UTC

Beer Festival Quests have been added.

Duration: September 14th, 07:00 to October 18th, 09:00 (UTC)
Complete the initial Quests below starting at Heidel

https://i.imgur.com/9UJ7vJr.png

Starting NPC: Pasvinder at Heidel
Quest Receiving Period: Sep. 14, 07:00 - Oct. 11, 23:59
Only available once per family
[Event] Imperial Craft Delivery Invoice X5 will be given out to Adventurers who finished the final Quest.
Once the initial Quests above are done, the following Daily Quests are available:
Out of the 4 Daily Quests, you can choose only 1 per day.
Regardless of which City you are at, only 1 Daily Quest is available per Family.
[Event] Imperial Craft Delivery Invoice X5 will be also given out to Adventurers who finished any 1 of the 4 Daily Quests.

https://i.imgur.com/xqRhr5z.png


System: 


A PvP Server Valencia6_PvP has been added.

Please note this server will have the addition of line _PvP to the title to indicate the unique ruleset.
The PvP server will allow players to battle other players and target mounts without experiencing a decrease in Karma. This is applied for damaging and/or killing off the targeted player or mount.
In addition, defeating monsters that would normally decrease your Karma will not do so anymore.
However, adventurers with Karma less than 0 (-1 or below) may be attacked by vigilantes in towns.
In addition, adventurers with Karma less than 0 (-1 or below) who are killed by other adventurers in the desert may be teleported to prisons.
PvP Server will not affect your Karma but the Karma and Penalty System you would have in other regular servers will be reflected the same.
If you die with Karma below a certain statistic, you will still be applied the same death penalty as you would receive in the other regular servers so please be cautious.
*please ignore the pop-up message saying the karma will be decreased after a mount has been killed in the PVP channel. (text it will be removed soon)

4 New Servers have been added under the Server Group name: Kamasylvia. You know what that means… Kamasylvia Part 1 coming real soon!

These servers will be listed in a similar fashion to the already existing servers, for example:

NA_Kamasylvia1 or EU_Kamasylvia1
NA_Kamasylvia2 or EU_Kamasylvia2
And so on, up to the fourth server.


Players will be granted 30 points upon starting the Savage Rift.
The time limit for the bosses from stages 5, 10, 15, and 20 of the Savage Rift has been adjusted to 5 minutes.

The next stage will start if players fail to defeat the bosses within the time limit.
If the boss is defeated, the next stage will start after 30 seconds.

HP of the Savage Rift Boss monsters has been increased.
Text for upgrading steel barricades in Savage Rift has been changed.
Savage Rift shop can be closed with the ESC key. The Shop window UI can also be moved around.
Fixed the issue where installed objects were still showing after defeating the last boss in Savage Rift.
Pets will be automatically hidden during Conquest and Node Wars.


Class Changes
All Classes 

Skills learned through level-up will not be automatically registered to the Quick Slot.
Fixed the issue where previous passive skill icons were still showing after learning a new passive skill.
Walking in auto-run mode can now be activated or deactivated by pressing CapsLock Key once. (No need to hold the Key)

The basic mounted attack effect for the Warrior has been modified to suit the character.


Sorceress 


Fixed the graphical glitch for [Sorceress] Cavaro Helmet.


Berserker 


Fixed the issue where the Bound effect against monsters triggered with the two-hand smash attack from the skill Frenzied Destroyer was not being applied correctly.
The Bound effect of the passive skill Frenzied Destroyer that is activated via the skill Quaking Fury on its last good hit, which was only applied in PvE, is now also applied in PvP.
Fixed the damage value discrepancy of the skill Flame Buster when it is used with RMB.


Witch


Fixed the attack de-sync issue with Tett when using the skill Thunder Storm.


Wizard


The skill Lava Field can now be used through Quick Slot normally while the Wizard is standing still.


Maehwa

Normal hit damage will be applied to the skill Fox Claw along with the existing Stiffness effect.
The damage range of the skill Fox Claw has been increased to include the targets in front of the character. (The range of the Stiffness effect did not change.)
The skill Shadow Slash can now be used with Heart Aiming as a combo.
Removed the conflicted text “immune to attacks for 20 seconds” from the description of the skill Shadow Cloak.

notes.title: Emergency Patch notes - September 1st 2017
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/ZSFXCbc.jpg

Here you can find the details of today's emergency patch
The new mode Savage Rift has been adjusted and fixed accordingly.

Item Changes

Fixed the issue where Savage Rift Items could be stored in Morco’s Gear Bag upon re-entering the Savage Rift.
 Fixed the issue with the Pearl Shop pet Turtle’s marketplace price.


Mechanic Changes

 You can now join the Savage Rift on servers 2, 4, 5, and 6 of each server group (except Olvia servers).
 Fixed the issue where Adventurers could not enter the Savage Rift from non-Savage Rift servers.
 Item purchase in the Savage Rift is no longer possible until Savage Rift actually begins.
When Adventurers re-enter the Savage Rift after leaving in the middle of the session, Points now will be reset to 0.
Point transfer in the Savage Rift will not be possible until after the 4th wave, the last wave where adventurers can join the Savage Rift.
Gaining unfair advantages through use of exploits may result in restrictions from game usage.


Interface Changes

 Savage Rift Guide descriptions have been changed.

You can re-enter the Savage Rift room that you previously participated in if disconnected during the session.

However, all the Savage-Rift-related items must be removed from Equipment and Inventory in order to re-enter the room.




Resolved Issues

Known-Issue:

There is an issue with the re-entering participants having their points show up as 30 points when its 0 point in reality. This issue will be fixed at 9/13 maintenance.

notes.title: Patch Notes - August 30th 2017
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/ZSFXCbc.jpg
Greetings Adventurers,

Below you will find this week's Patch Notes: Highlight of this week’s game update is certainly the introduction of Savage Rift. Adventurers of all persuasions are called to challenge the dangers lurking in the Savage Rift. Summer is over as Fall is breezing in. Back to School event with tons of extra Pearls, free coupons and big sales starts now! The Lauren Family Coin Event is also back and many class balance changes made it into the patch. We hope you enjoy the new updates. This week’s patch will be ~1.02GB

Event & Systems

Event:

Back to School Event
Bonus Pearl Event for Pearl Box Purchases

Bonus giveaways of Pearls and Extra Items will be given out to those who buy Pearl Boxes.
Duration: August 30th. 2017(After Maintenance) ~ September. 6th. 2017(09:00 UTC)
Bonus Pearls and Extra Items will be given out only once for the highest value Pearl Box purchased during the event period.

Bonus Pearls and Extra Items will be sent on 13th of September, according to the highest Pearl Box purchased by 6th of September.

http://i.imgur.com/aoBfPbz.png

Discount Coupons

Discount Coupons will be given out to all Adventurers who log in. 
(i.e. Outfit 20% DC coupon, Weight 20% DC coupon, Inventory 20% DC coupon)
Coupons are valid from August 30th, 09:00 to September. 11th, 08:59 UTC.


Pearl Shop discounts available for many items. (See the pics for details.)
http://i.imgur.com/F0chI86.png

Savage Rift Completion Bonus
Special rewards for Adventurers that have successfully completed 1~25 waves of the Savage Rift
Event Period: August 30th - September 20th, 09:00 UTC
Rewards will be given out after September 27th Maintenance

http://i.imgur.com/dNouRg1.png

Lauren Family Coin event has been added.
Available from August 31, 00:00 to September 20, 09:00 UTC.
Play for 60 minutes to complete the achievement and claim 10 Lauren Family Coins. You can complete the achievement for up to 5 times a day. 
General Goods Vendor in major cities will give you 1 Lauren Family Gift Box for 30 Lauren Family Coins. 

Eileen, Velia 
Lara, Heidel 
Alchem, Calpheon City 
Nelople, Altinova 
Jursin, Valencia City



In celebration of the new Savage Rift, the drop rate for Black Stones has been increased.
Event Duration: August 30th ~ September 13th maintenance
Event Details:
The drop rate for Black Stones (Weapon & Armor) has been increased for killing monsters.
The drop rate for Sharp & Hard Crystal Shards has been increased from gathering.
The drop rate for Ancient Relic Stones has increased from fishing.


System: 
The game client will try reconnecting several times after being disconnected due to unexpected network error.
This feature will not function if the client is closed.
Fixed the chat type tag in German and French.
The language filter will now work properly.
Default setting is set at International
Fixed the issue that shut down the client from time to time after starting a match in Arena of Arsha.
Fixed the issue where the ESC key did not work while using Marketplace Maid and Shop at the same time.
You can scroll within the maid panel even when you clicked on the scroll bar. The maid panel scroll will not be reset when changing regions.


Class Changes
All Classes 
The Stamina consumption of the following classes with the main weapon on combat and non-combat stance has been adjusted.
Warrior, Ranger, Sorceress, Berserker, Tamer, Musa, Maehwa, Valkyrie, Witch, Wizard, Kunoichi, Ninja 

Ranger 

Relatively higher level of EP consumption for skills forced Rangers to use a lot of MP Potions. To solve this problem, we have updated the following skills:
Using the skill Breezy Blade will now recover 10EP per hit. (Not if it is used during cooldown)
Using the skill Elven Rage will now recover 15 MP(EP) per hit.
Using the skill Flow: Disillusion will now recover 20 MP(EP) per hit.
The EP recovery amount of the skill Wailing Wind has been increased. (Not during cooldown)
http://i.imgur.com/lRepq7A.png
Customized hair-styles now look more natural.
Fixed the issue where the image of underwear gloves are partially removed when both Stella Outfit and Queen Heart Underwear are equipped.

Berserker 

Berserkers have been experiencing problems in the early stages of gameplay due to low Accuracy and Damage while requiring high WP consumption. This makes it difficult for Berserkers to grind so we are applying the below adjustments to balance out this issue.
A new effect “Accuracy +13.5%” has been added to the skill Flow: Slugfest.
The Critical Hit Rate of the skill Seizing Fear has been increased from 5% to 10%, and a new effect “Accuracy +5%” has been added.
Damage of the skill Devastation has been increased. (Damage reduced in PvP.)
http://i.imgur.com/tMBxmrB.png
The duration of enemy’s movement/attack/casting speed decrease debuff from the skill Devastation has been increased from 5 sec. to 10 sec.
The WP consumption of the skill Lava Piercer I has been reduced from 25 to 15.
A line about Air Attack effect has been added to the description of the skill Raging Thunder.
The WP consumption of the skill Raging Thunder has been reduced.
http://i.imgur.com/F41BVmQ.png
Damage of the skill Raging Thunder has been increased.
http://i.imgur.com/tsnAlib.png
The WP consumption of the skill Beastly Wind Slash has been reduced.
http://i.imgur.com/yTxiItL.png
The WP consumption of the skill Frenzied Destroyer has been adjusted.
http://i.imgur.com/my4g8PQ.png
The WP consumption of the skill Frenzied Destroyer on both-hand hit has been reduced from 40 to 20.
Bound effect has been added to the skill Frenzied Destroyer on both-hand down smash in PvE.
Damage of the skill Frenzied Destroyer has been increased.
http://i.imgur.com/lZS38VC.png
Fixed the issue where the damage of the skill Frenzied Destroyer III was being applied to skills Frenzied Destroyer IV, V, and VI while mounted.
The WP consumption of the skill Fierce Strike has been reduced.
http://i.imgur.com/oAZokLQ.png
Damage of the skill Fierce Strike has been increased.
http://i.imgur.com/peZWBh1.png
The Accuracy stat of the skill Fierce Strike has been adjusted.
http://i.imgur.com/TNUP5R1.png


Tamer 

Fixed the issue where changing Standby Expression in the customization screen was not being applied correctly on combat stance.


Valkyrie 

We have reduced certain skills’ stamina consumption and cooldown time, while also increasing the overall damage in PvE for better grind-efficiency. This was due to Valkyries requiring a large stamina consumption while having relatively small AoE attacks during grinding.
The Stamina consumption of the skill Promptness has been reduced to 100.
The cooldown time of the skill Promptness has been reduced to 5 sec.
Damage of the skill Promptness has been increased. (Damage reduced in PvP.)
806% x2 → 1048% x2
The cooldown time of the skill Hastiludium has been reduced.
http://i.imgur.com/9SvrhHr.png
The cooldown time of the skills Blitz Stab and Ultimate: Blitz Stab has been reduced from 9 sec. to 8 sec.
The PvE damage of the skill Blitz Stab has been increased.
567% x6 → 624% x6
The PvE damage of the skill Terra Sancta has been increased.
1475% → 1696%
Removed the stamina consumption part from the skill description of Lucem Fluxum.
The PvE damage of the skill Hastiludium has been increased.
Dash Damage:
I: 618% > 818%
II: 754% > 997%
III: 890% > 1178%

Stab Damage:
I: 480% > 490%
II: 496% > 595%
III: 584% > 701%

The PvE damage of the skill Hastiludium has been increased.
http://i.imgur.com/VxH7PHD.png
The PvE damage of the skill Verdict: Lancia Iustitiae has been increased.
http://i.imgur.com/xwi2QVV.png


Witch & Wizard 

Fixed the abnormal character motion caused by using Lava Field or Toxic Flood.

[Only Wizard]

The skill Lava Field can now be used while moving.
Fixed the issue that caused the Wizard to stop sprinting when transitioning to the non-combat stance while sprinting on awakening combat stance.
The skill Lava Field can now be used through Quick Slot normally while the Wizard is standing still. 

[Only Witch]

Movement of Tett became more natural for all Flow skills.
Fixed the issue where the Witch would momentarily stop while using the skill Toxic Flood in motion, which was different from Wizard’s version. 
Fixed the graphical glitch on the character’s hair after putting on Rakshande Helmet.
The stockings from Jasmine Garter Belt Underwear will not show through Acher Guard Shoes


Musa 

Fixed the issue where the actual increase rate of evasion was applied lower than what is stated in the skill description of Maneuver Training.
The following Crescent Blade skills’ cooldown time has been adjusted to make more Flow skills available as it wasn’t readily available before and forced users to repeat the same skills due to the long cooldown time.
Cooldown time of the skill Below the Belt has been decreased. 
http://i.imgur.com/aEUtZQU.png
Cooldown time of the skill Fiery Crevice has been decreased, and frontal guard effect has been added.
http://i.imgur.com/f3558ra.png


Maehwa 

Fixed the issue where the actual increase rate of evasion was applied lower than what is stated in the skill description of Maneuver Training.

Ninja

http://i.imgur.com/pcGrBpW.png

Removed the incorrect text “completely immune to attacks” from the description of the skill Shadow Cloak.
Fixed the issue where a character with shaved head would get a different hairstyle during combat.
Fixed the decorations of Yurei Helmet that looked awkward when it was put on a shaved head.


Kunoichi 

The duration and sprint speed bonus of the skill Target Chase have been increased.
http://i.imgur.com/sWL3mTW.png
The line about immunity to attacks has been removed from the description of the skill Ninjutsu: Concealment.
Removed the incorrect text “completely immune to attacks” from the description of the skill Shadow Cloak.
The motion for the skill Wheel of Wrath has become quicker.
Connecting from Wheel of Wrath to Flow: Indignation has become a bit smoother.
The motion for the skill Sah Spree of Sonan has become quicker.
Connecting from Danse Macabre to other skills has become a bit smoother.



Dark Knight 

Dark Knight was the only class which can sustain a long duration of the Invincible state by chaining certain skills. With the long duration invincibility state in mind, our team determined after a lengthy analyses of internal testing data the following changes would be applied to the Dark Knight:
These changes will still allow Dark Knight players to enjoy almost the same style of gameplay during PvE, however in PvP, proper usage and timing for skills will be crucial to winning.

The stamina consumption for the skills Dusk and Chain: Dusk have been adjusted to 250.
The Invincible effect of the skill Smoky Haze has been changed to Super Armor.  
Dusk and Chain: Dusk can now be used during cooldown time.
Invincible effect is not available if used during cooldown time, and 50 Stamina will be consumed.
In order to maximize the effect of these movement/evasion type skills that no longer include the invincibility effect (During Cooldown) after this update, players can now use the skills themselves even during cooldown.

Following skills will not have the Stamina recovery effect:
Twilight Dash, Spirit Hunt, Trap of Vedir, Shattering Darkness, Flow: Bombardment, Smoky Haze

Fixed the graphical glitch that caused the overlapping of [Dark Knight] Venia Riding Attire and the Vediant.


Striker 

Using the Flow: Mass Destruction will not cause collision while moving, and it can now be used during cooldown time.
Connecting from any Gauntlet and Gardbrace skills to Flash Step, Silent Step, and Flow: Mass Destruction has become a bit smoother.  
Using the following skills under Martial Spirit state will incur MP(EP)/SP/WP decrease effect to target:
Ultimate Crush, Spiral Cannon, Flow: Crosswind, Fallout, Ferocious Assault

Sustaining the Martial Spirit state now consumes 25 WP every 3 seconds instead of 50 WP.
Fixed the discrepancy between the actual Evasion bonus stat and the stated value of the skill Howling Wolf.
Putting on Dim Tree Spirit's Armor after dying Blazing Inferno Gloves should no longer interfere with showing the correct colors.


Item Changes

The size of the Marketplace registration batch for the following items has been increased:

Ingots, Crystals (mineral), Gemstones, Plywoods, Reform Stones, Supreme Hide/Fur/Feather, Bloods, Oils, some Food Items, Mount Recovery Items, Traveler's Map

The 4 and 6-set effects of the Jarette’s Accessories have been changed to 3- and 5-set effects.
http://i.imgur.com/5gyNb2A.png


Mechanic Changes

[Mount]

Fixed the issue where a character under Lv. 50 on a mount could be attacked by other characters.

[Content]

Savage Rift is now open.

Players will be granted 30 points upon starting the Savage Rift.
The time limit for the bosses from stages 5, 10, 15, and 20 of the Savage Rift has been adjusted to 5 minutes. The next stage will start if players fail to defeat the bosses within the time limit. If the boss is defeated, the next stage will start 30 seconds after that moment.
Now you can synthesize higher-grade WP/SP potions with lower-grade potions through Simple Alchemy.

http://i.imgur.com/l33eHPZ.png
Fixed the issue where character’s life level bonus for repair time was not being applied in repairing forts during Conquest/Node Wars.
Fixed the issue where it was impossible to build a Field HQ even with two Lv. 3 nodes.
The condition for using Field HQ has been changed.


Monster Changes

When the target is moving, Ancient Kutum’s ranged attack will hit the initial target location instead of just following it.
Additional scarecrows have been placed in Velia, Heidel, Calpheon City, Altinova, and Valencia City. These scarecrows do not take damage from characters.


Quest Changes

The quest type of the three chimney sweeping quests in Calpheon has been changed from Combat to Repeat.


Interface Changes

Knowledge card images have been added for NPCs Finlin, Ekta, and Lucy Benkum.
If you press ESC with Storage, Mount Inventory, and Inventory windows open altogether, the Mount Inventory window will be closed first.

Press ESC again after closing the Mount Inventory window to close Storage and Inventory windows at the same time.

Right-clicking Cron Stone will open the Enhancement screen.
Fixed the issue where some letters were still visible after clearing the guild description then pressing Enter.
Fixed the issue where dragging to select the guild description text would let you also select the area outside the description window.
Fixed the issue where the buff description tooltip in the upper left corner would not disappear after removing the cursor off the icons.
Fixed the special action button in the Pearl Shop to work correctly.
A system message window will appear if a server change fails.
The “new” badge on the BDO TV icon now blinks.
Fixed the issue that changed the color of system message with a certain color when there was a linebreak.
Fixed the scroll glitch in the Pet List window that happened after clicking the Check In All button.
Fixed the scroll glitch that happened in the sell window of the shop after clicking Repurchase.
You can now drag and move the NPC information panel in the Conversation screen.
Fixed the issue that displayed the “Get All (Mount)” button at all times when obtaining items.


Resolved Issues

The cat inside the Kasula Farm’s well has been taken out of the well.
There should be no obstacle now on the route to Sebastian from the quest [Daily] Falasi Family’s Kindness.
Fixed the issue that prevented from talking to other NPCs after the NPC you were talking to signs off during talk.
Fixed the issue that abruptly prompted characters into swimming mode in Valencia’s Desert Fogan area.  
Fixed the overlapping Terrminé Wagons graphical issue in Velia.
Character’s legs and the bench in a ferry boat will now look natural after applying Belle Epoque Ferry Set and boarding the character.


To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes

notes.title: Maintenance Notice - August 30th
notes.content:
http://imgur.com/rQeOUak.gif

Greetings Adventurers!

Every other week, we conduct a scheduled maintenance to restart the servers and add new content into the game. Please refer to the details below to see the maintenance schedule and what's being added.

Date: Wednesday, August 30th, 2017

Global - 08:00 - 12:00 UTC
North America (West Coast) - 1:00AM - 5:00AM PDT
North America (East Coast) - 4:00AM - 8:00AM EDT
Europe (Central) - 10:00 - 14:00 CEST

Reasons:

Savage Rift will be added.
Lauren Family Coin Event will start.
Back to School Event (Shop Sale + Bonus Pearl Event for Pearl Box purchases) will start.

The Patch Notes, including improvements and new features, will be posted after the maintenance.

Follow us on Twitter to stay up to date on any potential changes to the maintenance times.

Thank you for your support and understanding.

Best regards,
BDO Team
