notes.title: June 21st Patch Notes
notes.content:
http://imgur.com/jYJvjoH.gif

Greetings Adventurers,

Below you will find this week's Patch Notes, including a Black Stone Drop Event, a new Battle Arena on Iliya Island, and who better than to try it out other than the Striker Awakening! We look forward to seeing all of you back in game and hope you enjoy the update.

Event & Systems

Event: 

In celebration of the Striker Awakening Release Event, the drop rate for Black Stones has been increased.

Event Duration: June 21 ~ July 12 (09:00 UTC)
Event Details:

The drop rate for Black Stones (Weapon & Armor) has been increased for killing monsters.
The drop rate for Sharp & Hard Crystal Shards has been increased from gathering.
The drop rate for Ancient Relic Stones has increased from fishing.


In celebration of  completing  “Growth of a Kamasylve Tree” Event, we will be preparing additional events as a reward to all users! These events will be opened shortly and we will let you know of the details soon!

Increased drop rate for Black Stones Event
Patrigio’s Secret Shop Sale Event
[Event] Blessing of Kamasylve (7 days)

Striker Level Up Contest has ended, the winners will be announced the tomorrow.
The following events have ended.

Golden June Event | June 7th 09:00 ~ 6/21 (08:59 UTC)
Rose Festival | May 31st 09:00 ~ June 21st (09:00 UTC)
Growth of a Kamasylve Tree Event | June 14th ~ June 21st (09:00 UTC)
Black Spirit’s Adventure Event



System: 

A new Battle Arena has been added.

All players who are level 50 or above can teleport to the Battle Arena by clicking on the Battle Arena icon from the Main Menu [ESC]
When escaping out of the Battle Arena, there is a 1-minute cooldown after first entering the Battle Arena to teleport you back to your previous location.
There are scarecrows placed within the Battle Arena so that you can practice your skills and combos.
There are no death penalties in the Battle Arena and can resurrect immediately.
There are invisible walls surrounding the Battle Arena and you can’t get outside the boundaries other than to teleport back to your previous location.
You can’t summon maids in the Battle Arena.
You can only teleport to the Battle Arena when you are at full HP.
Battle Arena is located in Iliya Island.

New titles have been added for hunting.

The following titles are located within the Combat title category.

Figure of Loneliness
Hit First, Think Later!
Wowww!
Sly Foe
Lonely Wolf


The Karma lost when flagging up and PKing another player has increased.

-60,000 Karma → 120,000 Karma.




Class Changes

All Classes:

The animation when your character loots an accessory item or Sharp/Hard Black Crystal Shard has been improved.

Valkyrie

The skill description for Punishment has been modified to include that the skill now ‘can be used with Lancia through Quick Slot ”E”.

Witch & Wizard

The Lightning Chain skill effect has been improved to be more natural looking.

Ninja

The issue which Shuriken: Malice III’s critical hit rate did not match the actual effect has been corrected.

Striker

The Striker Awakening has been released with a full set of Awakening Skills!
The new Awakening weapon for the Striker, ‘Gardbrace’ has been added!

You can claim your Gardbrace after completing all of Awakening Weapon Quests. Press “C” button to switch from main weapon to an awakening weapon and vice versa.

Damage of the awakening weapon skills is affected by the awakening weapon, main weapon, Martial Spirit Shards, and accuracy.





Item Changes

Text of ‘Gardbrace Weapon and Gardbrace Outfit being invisible upon equipping’ has been added to the description of [Striker] WeDan Gloves.
The special effect of Weight Limit -25 has been removed from All Elsh main weapons.
Item descriptions of Elsh main weapons have been changed.
[Guild] Galley Plan item’s icon has been changed by the addition of a red stripe to the original icon.
Item descriptions for Courser Training items will now show which training the item is used for.
http://i.imgur.com/TtMJ1ZI.png


Monster Changes

The monsters in the following areas of Mediah have been adjusted to give more EXP and have less HP:

Abandoned Iron Mine
Manes Hideout
Wandering Rogue Den
Helms Post
Elric Shrine

The following Mediah regions will no longer include the item ‘Magic Crystals of Infinity’ in the item drop table. Instead, the drop rate for Black Stone (Armor) has been increased:

Abandoned Iron Mine
Manes Hideout
Wandering Rogue Den
Helms Post
Elric Shrine

The monster spawns in the Sausan Garrison have been changed.

Some monster spawn locations have been removed, and new spawn locations have been added.

In the following locations within the Mediah region, there will be an increased drop rate for the item Armor of Hercules' Might:

Abandoned Iron Mine
Manes Hideout
Wandering Rogue Den
Helms Post
Elric Shrine 

New hunting ground Shultz Guard post will be added to Sausan Garrison with ferocious monsters below.  

Shultz Guard Gladiator 
Shultz Guard Sniper 
Shultz Guard Armored Soldier 

Hunting monster “Giant Fox” not being responsive at times when attacked has been fixed.  


Quest Changes

New Striker Awakening Weapon Quest has been added.

Quest can be accepted from the Black Spirit for Strikers of Lv. 56+
[Striker Awakening] Memory of That Day
[Striker] Calpheon Deep Forest
[Striker] Hideout
[Striker] Enlightened Martial Arts
[Striker] All Ready
[Striker] Descent of Fury
[Striker] Enlightened Gardbrace
[Striker] Enlightened Gardbrace - Combo
[Striker] Enlightened Gardbrace - Practice

New title ‘Wolf of Lonely Wilderness’ has been added.

Title can be gained after completing all of Striker Awakening Quests.

Striker Awakening Weapon Knowledges have been added.

Training of Wilderness #1
Training of Wilderness #2
Training of Wilderness #3
Striker's Quality, Pursuit
Striker's Quality, Asceticism
Striker's quality, Wilderness

Yan's assistant's name has been changed to Sahin. 
The quest “Bandits’ Treasure Chamber” now has auto-navigation to the Biraghi Den’s Well.
Adjustments have been made so that Worker’s Elixir can be given to Sugarsh in the quest ‘For the Weary Workers.’
The following new quests have been added:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/b8ccadfa5a0c403ab33a973541f9b2209b2c7b62.png


Interface Changes

Throwing away items can now only be done by using the trash can icon in the inventory window.

notes.title: Xigncode Developer Q&A
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

Last week we issued a response regarding your concerns with Xigncode. Within the article, we covered the basic functions of Xigncode and why it is a necessary component of our anti-cheat system, helping to ensure our service remains a fair playing field for all users.

As fellow Gamers, we understand the importance of being well informed on how software, such as Xigncode, functions. Our team has been gathering an extensive amount of excellent feedback from you, and we’d like to share our progress thus far:We’ll be adjusting the displayed message when a program has triggered Xigncode to now include the name of the program.
We’re investigating potential methods to remove the installation of Xigncode when Black Desert Online is uninstalled.
We’re looking into the addition of a notice when installing Black Desert Online, informing players about the installation of Xigncode.
Additionally, we have received a response from Welbia regarding the list of questions our team collected from your concerns. Included below are the questions & their respective answers:

1. What files does XIGNCODE3 scan/log/record?
When certain conditions are met, specific files will be added into a checklist for XIGNCODE3 to scan, log, and record. The certain conditions here refer to the malicious programs that are registered in the XIGNCODE3 database. The only reason for accessing the data is to check and determine whether the relevant file is a normal file or not.

If the conditions are met or the file seems suspicious, a part of the file data (one-way hash value and the file name) can be recorded as a log and transferred if necessary, but in a form that the original file cannot be recognized. Similar to an anti-virus program scanning for a virus, the sole purpose is to check the structure of the file. Apart from the one-way hash value and the file name, XIGNCODE3 does not collect the data of the whole file nor does it transfer the whole file to other external servers.

2. When does XIGNCODE3 collect data?
Once the game is launched and XIGNCODE3 is running correctly, it will start searching for hack tools existing in the user’s PC.

3. What does XIGNCODE3 do with my data?
With the data collected, XIGNCODE3 is able to determine if an error occurred and its cause. The recovered data helps us provide solutions for users who experience unexpected errors. Based on this data, we can also identify which users were using hacking tools, allowing us to restrict those users from accessing the service.

4. How long does XIGNCODE3 retain my information?
XIGNCODE3 strictly adheres to the Personal Data Privacy Law and manages the collected data accordingly. After the data is stored, it is disposed of after an average of 2 to 3 months. The stored logs are used for the sole purpose of checking if hack tools were used during gameplay, or to investigate XIGNCODE3 errors and nothing else.

5. How can I request Wellbia delete all of my data?
It is impossible for XIGNCODE3 to retrieve personal files as a whole. It is also not possible to identify any personal information from the collected data. The collected data is only specifically related to the game; no personal information or files are collected. Users can rest assure that there is no chance of personal information or files being leaked.

6. How do I fully remove XIGNCODE3 from my PC?
XIGNCODE3 is located inside the folder where the game was installed, only runs when the game is launched, and ends when the game is closed. (There are cases when the XIGNCODE3 tray icon may remain, but it is not actually running).

Nearly all files related to XIGNCODE3 are removed when uninstalling Black Desert Online. To remove XIGNCODE3 entirely from your system, users will need to complete the following steps after uninstalling Black Desert Online:Locate the file Xhunter1.sys [To remove this file the game must not be running]This file is located in this directory: C:\Windows\xhunter1.sysRemove the Registry Entry [Use caution when adjusting registry settings]The entry is located here: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE > SYSTEM > ControlSet001 > Services > xhunterPlease note: manually removing files and attempting to launch the game will result in errors and the inability to play. A reinstallation of the game is required to resolve this.

7. How do I find out what a XIGNCODE3 Error # means?
Please refer to this site for more information: http://www.wellbia.com/faq/index_en.html

8. What precautions are taken to protect the data that is collected by XIGNCODE3?
To prevent the data from the hands of outside sources, XIGNCODE3 uses security programs, anti-virus programs, and data encryption. Only specific accounts and IP addresses are allowed access to the data and are constantly monitored with heavy restrictions.

9. Why does the 32-bit version of XIGNCODE3 work differently from the 64-bit version?
Just like the game requires 2 different versions to be suitable for the 2 different Windows operating systems, XIGNCODE3 also requires each version to be compatible accordingly.

10. Is the data that is sent encrypted?
The data is encrypted with XIGNCODE3’s own encryption method.

11. Does XIGNCODE3 modify any of my files?
XIGNCODE3 does not tamper with any files and only scans files, similar to an anti-virus program, to see whether or not a hacking tool is installed. Also, you can rest assured that no data is collect from normal files, only from those that meet the conditions mentioned earlier in this FAQ.

12. Why does XIGNCODE3 prevent other anti-cheat from running?
XIGNCODE3 does not block other anti-cheat programs, but it cannot be executed at the same time as GameGuard (nProtect). XIGNCODE3 has already attempted to fix this compatibility issue, however at this time, it remains unresolved, pending further investigation with GameGuard.

If other anti-cheat programs are run at the same time as XIGNCODE3, there is a chance of a compatibility issue which may lead to a crash. Should you experience this, please share this information with XIGNCODE3 and so the issue be investigated further.

13. Have there been any known breaches of the data stored at XIGNCODE3?
XIGNCODE3 is constantly concerned about potential data leaks and is always seeking to improve data security. To date, XIGNCODE3 has not encountered any breaches or leaks.

In addition, any data stored by XIGNCODE3 is only kept for a specified period and is deleted afterwards. If a breach was to happen in the future, the data stored by XIGNCODE3 does not contain whole files or personal information, so your personal information cannot be leaked. 

14. Why does XIGNCODE3 flag some of Microsoft Windows updates as a threat?
In cases where Microsoft Windows releases preview build updates, there are numerous internal changes in the operating system making it difficult, from the technical standpoint, to address all of these changes in advance. Prior to the official Windows update, XIGNCODE3 runs tests with preview builds as well, working to apply fixes for any errors that may occur when the official update is released.

15. How large and how often is the data being sent to XIGNCODE3, will this negatively impact users with data caps?
There is no specified set size of the data since the size is determined by various factors such as file type, size, and etc. Also sending the data at regular intervals would reduce the performance of the user’s PC so it sends the data in a variable period or when a certain event occurs. Due to these precautions, there should be no negative impact at all for users that have a data cap.

16. Is there any support or guides provided by XIGNCODE3 on how to troubleshoot what software may be preventing the launch of the game client?
XIGNCODE3 has a detection code in the error pop-up with a simple description of the error. To find out exactly what the cause of the error is, you can email your XIGNCODE3.log file (located within the game folder) to support@wellbia.com and receive a detailed feedback regarding the error. 

We’d like to thank you for taking the time to share your concerns and hope this information helps ease many of them. We look forward to seeing you in Black Desert, and hope your adventures are filled with fantastic experiences and new friends!

 - The BDO Team

notes.title: Server Stability Update
notes.content:
Greeting Adventurers,

Many of you experienced performance issues lately, previously on the NA servers and most recently on the EU servers. We informed you about our ongoing investigations and now want to share some details of our findings as well as our ongoing efforts to make improvements.

First, the issues that affected the NA servers turned out to be related to our daily server backup.
This automated process is necessary and would kick in during times of high player activity. By shifting our schedule to more suitable times we have been able to improve server performance significantly.

The current problems players face on the EU servers appear to be even more complex.
As you know, many new players joined BDO after the Steam launch and we increased the number of servers accordingly. The growing user database and related server queries did, however, cause lag and other performance issues in a way that cannot just be fixed by opening more servers.

Our technical staff is closely monitoring all database queries that might have an impact on server performance and keep fine tuning these queries to improve the performance of our EU servers.
We would like to thank all of you who reported the problems so passionately. These have been a great help to us in determining the cause of the instability. We also want you to know, that we understand the frustration serious lag causes and that we treat it with the highest priority.

We are thankful to have such a dedicated and passionate community and deeply regret the impact these performance issues have had on your experience in Black Desert Online. We ask for your continued understanding and support, while we work diligently on a solution.

The BDO Team

notes.title: June 14th Patch Notes
notes.content:
http://imgur.com/qFkK7Wt.gif

Greetings Adventurers,

This week, we invite the community to participate in a brand new event where they can help grow a beautiful Kamasylve Tree! In addition to this, we’ve also introduced several adjustments to the available space within a number of Calpheon Houses.

Event & Systems

Event: 

The “Growth of a Kamasylve Tree” Event has begun!

Event Duration: June 14 ~ June 21 (08:59 UTC)

Do your part to help grow a Kamasylvia Tree, complete a short series of daily quests to contribute to its growth! Each day, participants may complete 2 of these quests to receive one “[Event] Gift of a Spirit”

Begin the daily quest “[Event] Sacred Energy of Spirit”  by visiting the NPC “Cartima” in front of the inn in Heidel to collect the event item “Bowl of Spirit”.
Once you have collected this, take “Bowl of Spirit” to the NPC ‘Herawen’ and use 10 energy to gain “Spiritual Energy”.
After spending the energy collect the quest “[Event] Young Kamasylve Tree” from the NPC ‘Herawen’, interact with the small Kamasylvia Tree to complete the quest.
Each server will track the individual growth of their Kamasylvia Tree up to five stages. Once the fifth stage has been reached, players can no longer turn in the daily quest(s) on that server and must find another tree in an earlier growth stage.
“[Event] Gift of a Spirit” contains one of the following items:
http://imgur.com/jcEXtIV.jpg





System: 

Some adjustments have been made to improve the available interior space within housing residences in the Calpheon Territory. Some homes will have an added staircase and a whole new floor to explore, raised ceilings, expanded floor space, and door placement changes.

notes.title: Xigncode Community Address
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

I am writing you today to bring some degree of closure to the recent Xigncode concerns. We've gone through your feedback and would like to ask for the opportunity to share our stance. For those who are not familiar with Xigncode, allow me to explain what this software does as stated on their website.

XIGNCODE3 - Source

XIGNCODE3 is the next generation of gaming security solution mainly for online gaming service, currently patented and registered as a “one-time executable code structure”, which allows levels of various security policies according to company management measurements.

XIGNCODE3 supports more than 2000 game environment clients, and operates under Linux or Windows game servers. We provide all interface codes that are easily applicable in various conditions, such as C/C++/JAVA/C#. In addition, the API is structured in simple fashion for convenient adjustment, allowing easy application and testing without any complicated studies.

Xigncode is essentially a blacklist of sorts; it acts locally and will not send any of your data until an illicit program is detected. When Black Desert Online is not running, Xigncode will remain offline. Once you launch the game, however, Xigncode will initiate and will continue to run until the game is closed. This means Xigncode does not operate as a standalone application. When active, Xigncode scans your computer’s random access memory (RAM) to check for unauthorized third-party programs. Should such programs be detected, Xigncode reports which software it was and the account that tried to use it. It should be noted that Xigncode has been critical to the security of the game, such as the blocking of previous malicious programs like PYX and many other similar programs that plague online games. 

Now that we have covered what Xigncode does, there are specific concerns we wanted to address directly:
Xigncode does not sit in the background to idly collect your personal information and share it with others.Xigncode is not a rootkit. It does not enable a user to gain control of a computer system without being detected. As explained above, it operates in a very strict manner.Xigncode is not an ever-present virus that is impossible to remove from your PC. Without a game running, the software is and will remain inert.
Your concern that Xigncode remnants remain after uninstallation is a very valid point. To shed some light on this, the following portions remain:
Xhunter1.sysC:\Windows\xhunter1.sys Registry EntryHKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE > SYSTEM > ControlSet001 > Services > xhunter
After Black Desert Online is uninstalled, you can remove these files as they are not needed. Ideally, this process would be automated through the uninstall process and we're currently looking into how we can accomplish this technically. At this time, however, this process is not automated.

We'd like to thank everyone for taking the time to share your thoughts regarding Xigncode and we hope we were able to address your concerns. If you still have some doubts, we've also collected the community's questions regarding Xigncode and submitted an FAQ to Wellbia (the creators of Xigncode). Once they've responded to the FAQ, we'll be making it into a sticky thread.

-The BDO Team

The “Golden Artifacts” have returned! Join us for the Golden June Event. Enjoy the added benefit of finding valuable Artifacts while you play. Learn more about the Golden Cache: Golden Coelacanth, Golden Dagger & the Golden Backpack here.

Event Duration: June 7th ~ June 21st



System: 

Added a 1-second delay when creating a screenshot.



Class Changes

Training EXP has been changed to Mount EXP in the description of the following items.

Trainer’s Clothes
Silver Embroidered Trainer’s Clothes
Horse Trainer’s Clothes
Value Pack

Farmer’s Clothes are now sold by Luxury Vendors.
Amerigo's Welcome Package has been added to the Pearl Shop.

This Package contains the following:

Value Pack (30 Days)
Inventory Expansion Coupon +16
Hedgehog
Elion’s Tear x10
Artisan’s Memory x10
Horse Skill Change Coupon x5
Black Spirit Essence x5




Mechanic Changes

Fixed the issue where galleys were not always taking damage when other players activated Force PVP mode and attacked your galley when the owner of the galley is on the wheel.
A new function where you can tag a player has been added.

Type @character’s name to tag a player.
The tagged player will receive an alarm.



Monster Changes

Valencia weekly quest boss “Ancient Puturum’s” movement animation has been adjusted to be smoother.


Quest Changes

Life Advancement Quests and  Processing Certificates Quests have been added to the Suggested Quests menu.
The quest “For the Weary Workers” that was given out by NPC ‘Epil Tanbu’ in Tarif is no longer given out by ‘Epil Tanbu’ and is now being given out by Sugarsh in Tarif. 
Obtaining the Stargazing Report knowledge from NPC ‘Zahad’ in Valencia Capital is no longer available. Now you can obtain it from the NPC ‘Walagala’ instead.
The following quests starting conditions have been changed. Now you may only accept one main quest at a time until you’ve reached Calpheon’s main quest line.

The Real Opponent
Break through the Weakness of the Big Ones
Bandit Extermination I
Bandit Extermination II
Assess the Khuruto’s military strength
Mysterious Energy
Cutting Down the Numbers
Smash II
Marni’s Experiments
Get Rid of the Giants
Incarnation of Revenge
Eastern Gateway Situation Report

NPC ‘Kuniteah’ appearing in multiple locations issue has been fixed.
An issue which some players were not able to complete the [Exchange] Necklace of Sealed Magical Power quest has been resolved. Quest progress will be reset for the players that have accepted related quests. The quest can be accepted from NPC ‘Bianstimi’ and the Black Spirit as before.


Interface Changes

When entering your house, furniture placement mode will not be enabled when there are unplaced furniture.
An issue which furniture items were able to be placed on top of each other has been fixed.
Adjust Effect Transparency feature not resetting to default in settings when reset has been fixed.
When opening the chat window settings, an issue which the window transparency scroll bar did not appear has been resolved.
Bugs for Simplify UI feature have been fixed.
When a guild or party member dies, the interface will now more clearly indicate it with a green color.

Fixed the issue where far away shadows of objects were too dark in the desert.
Fixed an issue where far away objects would appear suddenly, vanish and then slowly reappear.

Fixed an issue where using the worker window would occasionally reset to a default position with the Sticky UI enabled.

[Guild] Breezy Crystal
Breezy Crystal
[Guild] Origin of Wind
Origin of Wind

Guild intro text not properly lining up has been resolved.
Resolved the issue where sometimes when taking a screenshot from the Character Creation screen would sometimes result in the Portrait button appearing.
Fixed an issue with the chat panel scroll.

notes.title: May 31st Patch Notes
notes.content:
http://imgur.com/d3hZHjC.gif

Greetings Adventurers,

This week we invite you to join in the World Travel with Rulupee Event as well are the Rose Festival! There is no better time than right now to dive into the beautiful world of Black Desert Online. 

Event & Systems

The Rose Festival Screenshot Contest has begun!

Get out there and see the beautiful world of Black Desert Online, snap some amazing screenshots and join the contest!
Find out more information about the contest here.

The World Travel with Rulupee Event has begun!

Take a trip with Rulupee as you adventure around the Black Desert Online game world. The event features a new daily Travel Quest and Reward Quest over the duration of the event.
Find out more information about the World Travel Event here.

Due to the popularity and influx of new users from Steam, we've added 3 more servers to accommodate the growing playerbase.

Class Changes

Warrior

The skill description of Flow: Reckless blow has been modified.

Knockdown on successful hits → Knock down on successful charged hits.




Sorcerer

The skill description of Night Crow has been modified.

The word “Invincible” has been added.

The skill description of Mark of the Shadow V has been changed to read more naturally.



Berserker

Fixed an issue where the attacking motion was unnatural when using the skill Flow: Slugfest.



Ninjai

The skill description of Seamless has been modified.



Kunoichi

Fixed an issue where the Awakened Weapons were not properly disappearing when Non-Awakened Weapons were used in the quick slot in a non-combat stance.



Striker

An issue where the DP reduction was not applied correctly when using the skill Hidden Claw in Martial Spirit Mode has been fixed.


Item Changes

New Items have been added. After hunting these monsters, use Butcher Knife to gather items from its remains. There is a chance of getting the following loot.

Giant Elk: Stuffed Elk Head
Giant Boar: Stuffed Giant Boar Head
Giant Wolf: Stuffed Wolf Head

http://i.imgur.com/CAwyf8E.png

Mechanic Changes

A few items have been changed in Black Spirit’s Adventure.
The Node Manager, Schutgen, at Ginburrey Island and a Node Manager, Lucenin, at Pujara Island, can now repair items.
Trade Ship Liners that run to Epheria, Altinova, and Ancado Inner Harbor have been separated into 2 lines: Epheria ↔ Altinova and Altinova ↔ Ancado Inner Harbor.

Monster Changes

Blue Whale’s movement has been improved so they move naturally.
An issue where Blue Whale was staying in one place time to time has been fixed.
The number of Blue Whale’s attacks has been increased.
Between Taphtar Plain and Barhan Gateway, some of Centaurus, Centaurus Hunter, and Centaurus Axeman have been replaced to Centaurus Seeker.
Monsters near NPC Basilisk Den Quest Objective have been relocated.

Quest Changes

A Recurring quest, Necklace of Sealed Magical Power, has been improved that you can choose a hunting ground.

[Repeat] Necklace of Sealed Magical Power #1 has been changed to a non-recurring quest.
[Repeat] Necklace of Sealed Magical Power #2 has been removed.
After completing a quest, Necklace of Sealed Magical Power, you can choose any recurring quests below to proceed:

[Repeat] Necklace of Sealed Magical Power – Defeat the Catfishmen
[Repeat] Necklace of Sealed Magical Power - Defeat the Manshas
[Repeat] Necklace of Sealed Magical Power - Defeat the Rhutums
[Repeat] Necklace of Sealed Magical Power - Defeat the Treants
[Repeat] Necklace of Sealed Magical Power - Defeat the Calpheon Shrine Herd

Users that had already accepted [Repeat] Necklace of Sealed Magical Power #2 can accept the Necklace of Sealed Magical Power quest from the Black Spirit.

Following quests acceptance condition has been changed to level 59 or above:

[Co-op] Collecting Evidences of the Raid on the Merchant Guild
[Co-op] Punishment to Heretics: Destroying the Axe
[Co-op] Punishment to Heretics: Breaking the Bow
[Co-op] Punishment to Heretics: No Mercy
[Co-op] That Glittering Stuff

Following quest’s target has been changed from 2 Basilisks each to 1 Basilisk.

Basic Etiquette

Following quest’s target has been changed to Centaurus SeekerSearcher.

[Co-op] Centaurus Spiritual Being

Following quest’s location for NPC has been changed.

[Co-op] Wicked Basilisk

New quests have been added in Valencia. Stable Keeper in Valencia, Tanzine, can give you quests. 

Lonely Trade Manager.
Good Food Cures All.
The Recipe To Open One’s Heart.
Everything Comes with a Price.
Heartfelt Ingredients.
You Are Not Alone.

A new knowledge, Centaurus Seeker, has been added.
A quest summary for Magic Armor Exchange I has been added to guide the user on how to retrieve the armor when it is lost.

If you lose a Dim Magical Armor, you can exchange 2 Tokens of Promise for another one from NPC Grandus, the Armor Vendor of Calpheon City.
You can now exchange after completing [Co-op] Witch-Hunting instead of completing it in Mediah.


Interface Changes

[Customization History] Refine your character creation with forward and back buttons that scroll through your recent changes.

Customizing hair, face, or body can be saved as a history (i.e. all separate eye makeup, tattoo, etc.).
Shortcut key  can also work.
Pose does not save as a history.

Smooth chat scrolling, smooth chat scroll bar, smooth wheel scroll, and smooth reset scroll features have been included.

Chat message scroll has been improved so they scroll up softly.
Chat messages scroll up at once when they are more than 5 (a lot of messages are blocked to go up softly one by one).
If you click ‘Reset’ button on the bottom, it scrolls down to the first chat message softly,
Chat message moves softly with mouse wheel. 
Chat message moves softly with scroll bar on the right.


Resolved Issues
Resolved the issue where trees would sometimes block the view of your garden when planting crops.
Fixed the graphical issue with [Witch] Kibelius on would sometime not render underwear properly.
Fixed the issue where [Warrior] Doomsday Armor was not dyed partially.
Fixed the issue where [Maehwa] Kibelius’s chest part was not dyed.
Fixed the issue where graphics for left inner shoulder were broken in non-combat stance
Fixed the issue where graphics for left back were broken in non-combat stance.
Fixed the issue where PVP icon in Interface Edit Mode was going back to the default position after saving.
Fixed the issue where UI size was automatically changed to 100 when UI size was over 140 after setting the resolution over 1900 x 1080
Fixed the issue where a location for Black Spirit’s Rage and High Rank Equipment UI was going back to default after leveling up
Fixed the issue where UI panels in Interface Edit Mode were going out of window when they were being moved
Fixed the issue where clicking the interface scale bar in Interface Edit Mode didn’t change the value.
Fixed an issue where Mounts revived by Mount Resurrection Scroll would appear  when other characters logged in.
An issue where the image of Golden Siniperca was not being displayed in Crafting Notes has been fixed.
Fixed the issue where sometimes multiple chat windows would separate, overlap, and continue to show chat making it difficult to read.
An issue where chat messages were moving irregularly has been fixed. 

To read the patch notes in German or French, click the links below:
German Patch Notes
French Patch Notes

No matter how much you want to play Black Desert Online, there may be times when you're simply unable to. Regardless of how much time you have to play, however, there are a large variety of idle activities you can use to progress your character. 

Fishing
Fishing can be a great way to relax and clear your head after a long day of work. If you're unable to actively fish, however, you can AFK fish instead! Simply cast your line, sit back and watch as your character handles the rest. You will continue to fish until either your inventory is full or your fishing rod runs out of durability. 

Fishing Guide by Thomas Soren

Fish you catch can be dried and used as crafting ingredients or sold to Trade NPC’s. There is an Imperial Fish Merchant who will also buy your fish, however, he only accepts a limited amount so you will want to reach him before anyone else in order to ensure you get the best value for your fish.


Workers
You can hire workers to take care of a large assortment of tasks, such as gathering crafting ingredients, crafting ingredients into items, or tending your farms. Workers have Action Points, which can be refilled by giving them Beer! You can have a Worker repeat the same task, so long as it still has Action Points remaining, it will continue to work hard and gather what you need!

Beer, Workers and Node Guide by Thomas Soren

There are several valuable crafting materials Workers can harvest, or you can use them to process your materials into items. With housing, Workers can craft armor and weapons, tools, furniture and even trade packs for you! If you are a Cooking or Alchemy enthusiast, Workers are a great way to make sure you have everything you need to complete your work. 


Cooking/Alchemy
Cooking and Alchemy are also things that don’t always need your attention. If you want to craft bulk amounts of one recipe, doing so is easy. Simply put the ingredients for one of that particular item into your Tool and choose how many you would like to craft. Once you get it started, your character will craft until you either run out of materials, or your Tool has no durability left.

Cooking Mini Guide by Kyrandis
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uskLi0AroUw
Alchemy Mini Guide by Kyrandis
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VkGxRnL8JWM

Processing
You might have a large collection of raw crafting materials that you need to refine in order to craft the items you want. Pick the item you wish to process, make sure it is in your inventory, then open the Processing menu (shortcut key: 'L'). Select the type of processing appropriate for your materials and watch your character continue to Process until you are out of materials or you reach your maximum Carry Weight.


Horse Training
If you find horses more your style, you can set up an auto path to help train your horses while you are away. To do this, open up the map and set a destination. There, you should see an 'Auto Loop' button appear. Hit that button and your horse will then run in an endless loop from your starting point to the destination set.

If you are concerned about your horse’s endurance, simply check the box to have it automatically consume carrots. So long as you and your horse do not die or you run out of carrots, your character will continue to run that path!

Auto Path Guide by Meoni
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1DEioHElZlQ
Other Resources
There are many ways to advance your progress in Black Desert Online, even when you can’t actively play! If you would like to know more about how you can profit from these activities and earn additional Silver, check out some of these fan-made guides.

How To Make Silver - Plunge
Farming Guide - Not_Alice
All Horse Related Things - Lady Minuit

notes.title: Choose Your Pack!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/a1275b0b941e80d8ca5412ea8038b30501c12734.png

With the launch of Black Desert Online, we wanted to give you a little information on what packages are available and what the included items can do for you!

Basic Package
The Basic Package only includes Black Desert Online. 

Traveler’s Package

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/a70dea17bf0ec4532eaf56de2872e836a7922c6f.png

In addition to Black Desert Online, the following items are included with your purchase:

1x Value Pack (30 Days)
5x Elion’s Blessing
1x Tier 3 Horse
1x Pet of Choice
1x Character Slot Expansion Coupon
1x Inventory Slot +8 Expansion
1x Horse Flute (7 Days)
3x Housing Decoration Coupons
1x Silver Embroidered Life Clothes Exchange Coupon


Explorer’s Package

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/13cf6685684d3d41b81999bb5f4388efc9f10736.png

In addition to Black Desert Online, the following items are included with your purchase:

2x Value Pack (30 Days)
10x Elion’s Blessing
1x Tier 5 Horse
1x Pet of Choice
2x Character Slot Expansion Coupons
1x Inventory Slot +16 Expansion Coupon
1x Horse Flute Permanent
5x Housing Decoration Coupons
1x Silver Embroidered Life Clothes Exchange Coupon


There are a wide variety of items on these lists, some of which you might not be familiar with. Let’s take a look at them and see how they can help you on your adventures.

http://imgur.com/GXJn1An.gif

Value Packs benefit all of your characters. The perks include extra Inventory and Storage space, increased Carry Weight, and the ability to invest CP into Nodes remotely. You will also gain unlimited use of the Beauty Salon to change and customize your characters, and unlimited use of the Merv’s Palette to dye your armor, weapons and costumes whatever colors suit your tastes.
Character Slot Expansion Coupons allow you to unlock another character slot on your account. Remember, however, that there is a maximum number of character slots you can unlock.
Inventory Slot Expansion Coupons expand a single character’s inventory by the number of slots listed in the item’s name. Inventories can be expanded to a maximum of 192 slots.
Elion’s Blessings bind to the character whose inventory they are placed in, but allow you to resurrect immediately at your location, with full Health and MP. Any experience lost due to the death penalty is also restored.
Horses are the main form of transportation in Black Desert Online, and Tiers represent their strength, speed and endurance. Having a higher Tier of horse, up to 8, is going to help you get where you want to go much faster, and even unlock new skills your horse can acquire.
Horse Flutes are excellent for finding your mount in the heat of a chaotic battle, or simply make running errands around town a little more convenient. As long as your horse is within 500m, you can whistle for it with the Flute, and it will come running to your location.
In Black Desert Online, pets like cats and dogs can loot for you, while you focus on cutting a swath across the battlefield and achieving ultimate victory. Each pet has a loot speed determined by pet level and tier.
Housing Decoration Coupons will let you pick pieces of furniture to place in your Residence. Many furniture items have temporary buffs or other benefits, in addition to looking fantastic. 
If you are a fan of Life Skills, the Silver Embroidered Life Clothes Exchange Coupon will let you select an outfit to help with your favorite profession. These outfits have a variety of benefits for your character, like increasing the experience you gain for Processing, or the speed at which you combine Cooking or Alchemy ingredients.

notes.title: Your Ultimate Dream Home
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/2c9ec211519634a4831979a349557b375aedc089.png

The housing system in Black Desert Online is robust, allowing you to rent workshops to process materials or craft items. You can also rent a Residence to transform into your ultimate BDO Fantasy Home!

Any house in Black Desert Online can be rented as a Residence, as long as you have not rented the same space for a different purpose, like crafting Trade Crates. Houses have differing styles, sizes and options, depending on the town and region where they are located. Not all houses are created equal, however. Some houses are quite large, with multiple floors and rooms waiting for your unique sense of Interior Design, while others feature only a single room for a more utilitarian feel.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/21f740f6134b54ad6ad0b177c8caa06f5ceea21f.png

So you’ve selected your house and invested CP into it. Now what? Decorating of course! There are a large variety of items you can use to decorate your house. Let’s look at a few!
Beds - You can lay in a bed to recover Energy more quickly.Cooking/Alchemy Tools - These will allow you to practice more than the Simple Alchemy from the Processing menu.Bookcases - Using these will help you gain Knowledge you have not already acquired.Buff Items - Specific pieces of furniture will offer you a temporary buff, however, activating the buff will consume the item’s limited durability.
This is only the tip of the iceberg, however. Many more items can be placed in your Residence, but I’m sure you’re wondering where they all come from. Furniture Merchants will sell you pieces of furniture specific to their regions. You can also use Furniture Workshops to craft your own furniture, drapes and rugs. Certain quests and monsters (include a few bosses) can also reward you with furniture pieces and buff items. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/fde08485ca49ec15a2e57feedf7fea3d28d74b22.png

You have more to gain from owning a Residence than useful buffs, or the ability to Cook. Each house owner accumulates House Points which affect their ranking on the housing list. The person who has the highest rank unlocks a special Investment Bank in the town where they live. Furniture and decorative items have a specific point value, and placing them in your Residence raises your overall point total and can allow you to rise up the Housing Ranks.

Housing has several benefits, beyond the cosmetic. How will you decorate yours?

notes.title: For Honor and Glory!
notes.content:
http://imgur.com/03wIBZ2.gif

As you grow stronger in Black Desert Online, you can begin to participate in various Player Versus Player battles. These engagements can take many forms, from one on one battles, to large scale castle sieges. Here is a small peak at what’s in store!

Red Battlefield

http://imgur.com/uXy4sVf.gif

Do you enjoy random teams facing off to claim victory? Red Battlefield is perfect for you! You can sign up for the fight by pressing the Red Battlefield button on your main menu. You’ll be placed in a group with random players and transported to a special island where two teams can compete for points. What is your prize for winning? Collect Red Seals to receive powerful Magical Crystals and a myriad of other fantastic rewards!

Guild Wars

If you prefer cooperating with friends and allies to decimate your enemies, you can start a Guild War. For a small amount of Silver, guilds can declare war on one another. Take to the fields for large scale battles, or engage in guerrilla warfare to ensure success!

http://imgur.com/fEWQjm1.gif

Should your Guild wish to be more competitive, you can challenge the might of multiple guilds in Sieges. There are two forms Sieges take: Node Wars and Conquest Wars. Victory grants a Guild one week of ownership and Taxes to fuel their Guild Funds.

PvP Flagging

There's also an open world flagging system which will allow you to attack any player above the level of 50 who is not in a safe zone. There are consequences, however, for attacking another player this way. Every monster you kill grants you Karma, up to a maximum of 300,000. Attacking or killing players and their mounts costs Karma. 

If you allow your Karma to drop below zero, you are permanently flagged to other players. NPC’s will attack you when you try to enter town as well. If you continue to lose karma, at a maximum of one million, you can lose Magic Crystals or trade items from your inventory when another player kills you. You can take refuge in the desert, however, where other bandits have created sanctuaries free of petty laws. 

Arena

http://imgur.com/ENTkAsE.gif

There is one last area where you can attack any player, with no consequences. Small arenas reside near Capitals, and anyone who steps into its boundaries is automatically flagged for PvP. Dying in an arena has no negative consequences and a player can instantly resurrect at no cost. These serve as an ideal place for players to train their skills and practice for sieges.

Will you have what it takes!?

notes.title: For Honor and Glory!
notes.content:
http://imgur.com/03wIBZ2.gif

As you grow stronger in Black Desert Online, you can begin to participate in various Player Versus Player battles. These engagements can take many forms, from one on one battles, to large scale castle sieges. Here is a small peak at what’s in store!

Red Battlefield

http://imgur.com/uXy4sVf.gif

Do you enjoy random teams facing off to claim victory? Red Battlefield is perfect for you! You can sign up for the fight by pressing the Red Battlefield button on your main menu. You’ll be placed in a group with random players and transported to a special island where two teams can compete for points. What is your prize for winning? Collect Red Seals to receive powerful Magical Crystals and a myriad of other fantastic rewards!

Guild Wars

If you prefer cooperating with friends and allies to decimate your enemies, you can start a Guild War. For a small amount of Silver, guilds can declare war on one another. Take to the fields for large scale battles, or engage in guerrilla warfare to ensure success!

http://imgur.com/fEWQjm1.gif

Should your Guild wish to be more competitive, you can challenge the might of multiple guilds in Sieges. There are two forms Sieges take: Node Wars and Conquest Wars. Victory grants a Guild one week of ownership and Taxes to fuel their Guild Funds.

PvP Flagging

There's also an open world flagging system which will allow you to attack any player above the level of 50 who is not in a safe zone. There are consequences, however, for attacking another player this way. Every monster you kill grants you Karma, up to a maximum of 300,000. Attacking or killing players and their mounts costs Karma. 

If you allow your Karma to drop below zero, you are permanently flagged to other players. NPC’s will attack you when you try to enter town as well. If you continue to lose karma, at a maximum of one million, you can lose Magic Crystals or trade items from your inventory when another player kills you. You can take refuge in the desert, however, where other bandits have created sanctuaries free of petty laws. 

Arena

http://imgur.com/ENTkAsE.gif

There is one last area where you can attack any player, with no consequences. Small arenas reside near Capitals, and anyone who steps into its boundaries is automatically flagged for PvP. Dying in an arena has no negative consequences and a player can instantly resurrect at no cost. These serve as an ideal place for players to train their skills and practice for sieges.

Will you have what it takes!?

notes.title: Beating the Odds
notes.content:
http://imgur.com/gdQoBLU.gif

Are epic, large scale fights your interest, or do you prefer grouping up with your friends to take on smaller challenges? When facing bosses in Black Desert Online, you get to choose your battle! Check out the different types of bosses you can face, and some of their more interesting traits.

World Bosses 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/f598966bf57a036558b1c30eee2cd2ddb2498f5d.png

World bosses are challenging, and require a large group of players to ensure victory. Their rewards are worth the effort, however, as you will see! Let’s take look at a few of the World Bosses you can battle. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/8b650e75a7cac772be2a3210e197064698269b3f.png

The Lord of Corruption, Kzarka, is said to have the destructive might of a god. He was sealed away centuries ago by an unknown sacred organization. During the turmoil of the war, a suspicious group took control of Kzarka’s Shrine, with the intent to resurrect him. Heidel has sent troops to retake the shrine, but every attempt has been met with failure. 

http://imgur.com/Bdm16z2.gif

Kzarka’s most powerful and deadly attack is his Breath. It can devastate large amounts of players, if you get caught in its path. When you defeat Kzarka, he has a chance to drop a Sealed Weapon Box, which you can open on any one character to receive a Kzarka weapon for your class. 


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/9335f51c857baa13a3047a571225e6bd0d0b4fb4.png

This creature, shaped like a worm, is able to move only because an Ancient Shard embedded in it’s body functioned like a heart. It is said that Ancient Kutum used to live inside the Scarlet Sand Chamber, but when his heart fell silent, the doors sealed shut and the Chamber disappeared. Once again, however, the thunderous sound of Ancient Kutum’s heart has reopened the Scarlet Sand Chamber, allowing archaeologists and explorers to find its entrance.

http://imgur.com/5jvkBRw.gif

Ancient Kutum will challenge you, testing your reflexes and adaptability. Dodge him while he burrows under the ground and speeds across his chamber, only to errupt from the ground, damage anyone close enough to his location. Kutum’s has an even more devastating attack, however, so be prepared! Much like Kzarka, Ancient Kutum has a chance to drop a Sealed Weapon Box. However, his weapon is a sub-weapon or offhand. 


Field Bosses

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/157dab37c199400f21ec4c218432e7e1e991fe8f.png

While Field Bosses do not require quite as many players as World Bosses, the fights can still be intense! There are several Field Bosses you can defeat, each offering rewards like Silver and Black Stones. In addition to these rewards, specific bosses have a chance to drop rare armor pieces. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/f9803c5f52648074d50dc6798650b27ae975de5b.png

This creature was created to purify Black Crystal and its origin is completely unknown. The Dim Tree Spirit is hostile toward unnatural beings, including humans, and prevents them from entering the forest. It is terrified by fire, however, and whenever a flame is present, the Dim Tree Spirit will wait quietly until the fire dies out. 

http://imgur.com/3jHLS5K.gif

The Dim Tree Spirit is a fearsome enemy, using his massive arm-like appendages to knock players down, and deliver lethal attacks if you are not able to dodge out of the way, or block them. If you are able to triumph, however, he has a chance to drop a special chest piece of high quality. 


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/4b4df3ecc0c47e66f09a458249a7ccfa404cdfdd.png

Donatt was once the Chief of Glish. No one is sure if his is alive or dead, and many people still consider him missing. He had a deep fascination with Alchemy, second only to his greed, which caused villagers to fear and avoid him. As time wore on, Donatt’s mind started to fade. He caused a horrible explosion and as he finally finished his descent into madness, offered his soul for the Black Crystal to consume. This changed Donatt into a grotesque monster, built from the corpses and debris found around Glish. The monster is now known as the Giant Mudster and rumors suggest he still resides in the ruins of Old Glish.

http://imgur.com/HLPGArE.gif

This gruesome creature will attempt to crush anyone who approaches him, however he has more sinister attacks. Beware the spikes he summons from the ground, and make sure to get out of their range if you want to survive. Even long range players have something to fear once Giant Mudster burrows into the ground. Once he finds his target, he will surge up from the ground, intent on their destruction. 


Scroll Bosses 

Scroll bosses are smaller engagements that can be challenged by a single player, or a group. These scrolls are rewards from daily and weekly quests given to you by the Black Spirit. Right clicking the scroll will take you to the bosses location, where you can spawn it. Spawning the boss will automatically grant the summoner a quest for extra rewards like Black Stones and Hunter’s Seal exchange items. 

http://imgur.com/ftgLwDy.gif

There are a variety of challenges for you to overcome, stories for you to tell, and rewards to be won. Do you have what it takes?

notes.title: Black Desert Online is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Black Desert Online Launches on Steam May 24th

Kakao Games and PearlAbyss announced that the multiple award-winning MMORPG, Black Desert Online, will be made available on Steam to players in North America and Europe.

Add Black Desert Online to your Steam wishlist:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/582660/Black_Desert_Online/

 Pack your cloak, sharpen your weapons, and grab as many bags as you can carry, because it’s time to set off on an epic adventure!     Black Desert Online      is coming to Steam on May 24, bringing with it the   deepest character customization system  ever seen. Expect sweeping landscapes, ferocious monsters, and action-focused combat packed in an unforgettable experience that breathes new life into the MMO genre.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/d6e309c2fac0e8ee87b1602aac3e2e93b98bebf4.jpg

Choose from one of 13 unique classes  and create your character using the incredibly precise customization tools before entering the bustling world of Black Desert Online. Will you become a slayer of massive beasts? A wealthy trader? A master horse tamer? In this enormous open world lies a journey that will amaze MMO veterans and newcomers alike.  

Key Features
 Beautifully designed open world that’s as expansive as it is alive      Heart- pounding skill-based combat      Unprecedented character customization with incredible detail      Crisp next-generation graphics      Extensive open-world PvP modes (Arena mode, guild vs guild, node wars, castle sieges, and more)      Engaging story with deep lore and epic quests      Unique farming system - grow and perfect your crops      Personalized stable - catch, tame, and breed wild horses      Deep crafting, housing, fishing, hunting, and alchemy systems      Intuitive action gameplay complete with gamepad support      Frequently updated with enormous free expansions     
 
 Stay tuned to the Steam Community Hub for information, celebratory events and more.  

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28674304/3635678b01b1a2184b2af170e5dfd2bd72acf781.jpg

About Kakao Games 
Kakao Games is a leading online games publisher. Founded in 2015, Kakao Games is currently focused on publishing the critically acclaimed MMORPG     Black Desert Online in North American and European markets.

notes.title: Black Desert Online Steam FAQ
notes.content:
Black Desert Online Steam FAQ
Please contact us if you have any problems with Black Desert Online or your account. For issues with Steam itself, or your initial purchase, you can contact Steam support here.

Steam Account and Launcher FAQ
Can I play Black Desert Online directly from Steam?
Starting from May 24, 2017, Black Desert Online will be available for purchase on Steam. Players who purchase Black Desert Online from Steam will be able to play directly from Steam. There is a one-time Black Desert Online account registration process during the initial game start. Once this has been completed, clicking on the ‘Play’ button for Black Desert Online from the Steam launcher will launch and take you directly into the game.
Will Black Desert Online update via Steam or via the launcher?
The game will patch via the Steam Client.
Can I move my game account from Black Desert Online to Steam?
No. All Steam players will need to create a new Black Desert Online account. Pre-existing accounts will not be able to migrate or sync their accounts with a Steam account.
Do I still need a Black Desert Online website account if I buy the game on Steam?
Yes, the one-time Black Desert Online account registration step during the initial game start process creates a Black Desert Online account.  This account can be used to login to BlackDesertOnline.com to access ‘My Account’ page, Help Desk, and Forums.
Are there Steam achievements, trading cards or badges for Black Desert Online?
Trading cards will be available at launch and the Steam Achievement system is currently still being developed. We are hopeful that Steam Achievements will be ready by the release date of May 24, 2017.
Will Steam players be playing on the same servers as Black Desert Online accounts?
Yes, Black Desert Online operates in a single-world system. Black Desert Online players will all play in the same world, but can freely select servers within that world.

Steam Gameplay and Controller FAQ
Will Black Desert Online support (Steam) controllers?
Yes, Black Desert Online features partial controller support. For using features like chatting, we suggest using a (wireless) keyboard.
Does Black Desert Online support the Steam Link when played from Steam?
Yes
What is the difference between the Steam and classic PC versions of Black Desert Online?
Both versions will be identical and updated at the same time. Black Desert Online is frequently updated with free expansions and evolving content. 

Steam Billing and Subscription FAQ
Can I use the money I have in my Steam wallet to pay for Daum Cash?
Yes
After buying the game on Steam, can I buy Daum Cash directly from the Black Desert Online website?
No, you can purchase Daum Cash through Steam.
